jobs.title: Engineering Director (B2C)
jobs.text:
Spotlight Sports Group is a global media and technology company with a clear purpose, to set the standard for trusted, customer-driven experiences across global racing and sports betting. Guided by our mission to create experiences that fans love, we combine more than 40 years of heritage with bold innovation to deliver award-winning content, data and digital products. With over 400 employees worldwide, our portfolio includes Racing Post, myracing and Free Super Tips, as well as the international marketing agency ICS-digital and ICS-translate. Together, we partner with leading operators, affiliates and media groups to power growth and engagement across the industry.
Purpose
Own the B2C engineering organisation end to end — the four cross-functional squads, the Enabling function and the QA practice. Set the engineering standards, career paths and line management that let player-coach Lead Engineers keep decisions close to the work and a culture of shipping, measuring and responding. Active in the London tech scene for how other organisations are adapting to the changing approaches to software development given AI innovation.
Key responsibilities
Line-manage the 4 B2C Lead Engineers; own hiring, development, performance and career paths
Hold the Enabling/Architecture line (Engineering Architect and Principal Engineer), ensuring relevant modern day development practices are adopted (such as Agentic approaches)
Hold the QA practice via the Lead QA; automation where appropriate
Set and evolve engineering standards, patterns and ways of working across the squads — one engineering culture, not four. Lean on DevSecOps under DevOps for secure approaches
Accountable for engineering delivery health: DORA measures (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore) alongside the Senior Platform Manager and Senior Delivery Lead
Partner with the Senior Delivery Lead on the sequenced backlogs — and with the Engineering Director (Data Platform) on shared platform dependencies
Partner with the Product Director to enable squads to iterate with Product to develop solutions with as little process friction as possible
Own quality end to end through the embedded QA model
Develop the player-coach leads as the organisation’s management bench — no pure people-management layer inside squads
Represent B2C engineering at the CTO’s leadership table

jobs.title: Head of Data Feeds
jobs.text:
About Us:
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:
YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:
Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
About The Role:
YipitData is becoming the default intelligence platform for anyone evaluating companies and markets. Systematic Data Products & Feeds are central to that ambition. We make differentiated data easy for quantitative and systematic investors - as well as sophisticated fundamental investors with dedicated data teams - to discover, evaluate, trust, integrate, and use.
We are seeking a strategic business leader to turn this growing portfolio into a major, repeatable growth engine. This leader will own strategy and performance across Quant products, consumer transaction data, consumer receipt data and our broader portfolio of data feeds - including ARR, portfolio strategy, investment allocation, packaging and pricing, go-to-market and service motions, and overall business performance.
As the leader of this business, you will set the direction for the portfolio and unite leaders across Product, Quant, Data, Engineering, Revenue, Client Strategy, and Operations behind one business plan. You will determine where we compete, how we win, and where we invest - building the operating model and commercial motion required to deliver durable client value and financial outcomes.
As Our Head of Data Feeds, You Will:
Own business performance
Own ARR growth, retention, profitability, and overall financial performance.
Translate the strategy into a multi-year business plan with clear targets, assumptions, resource requirements, and risks.
Establish the business scorecard and give the Public Investor Leadership Team a clear view of performance, trajectory, and required decisions.
Define the portfolio and investment strategy
Determine which markets, buyer segments, and systematic workflows YipitData will pursue- and how we will win.
Shape transaction data, B2B data, Quant products, and other feeds into a coherent portfolio rather than a collection of independent offerings.
Identify opportunities to turn existing data into new products, use cases, and revenue streams.
Allocate investment across the portfolio, making explicit decisions about where to scale, maintain, change course, or stop.
Prioritize capabilities and data assets that can be reused across multiple products, workflows, and markets.
Build the commercial engine
Define a clear portfolio proposition that communicates how YipitData’s Systematic Data products fit together and why they are differentiated.
Own packaging, pricing, bundling, entitlements, and other core business-model decisions.
Partner with Revenue and Client Strategy to build repeatable sales, trial, onboarding, adoption, retention, and service motions for systematic-data buyers.
Build strong relationships with quantitative researchers, data scientists, portfolio managers, and other sophisticated data buyers.
Use client feedback, product usage, pipeline performance, and retention signals to continually refine the commercial strategy.
Establish a scalable operating model
Create an operating cadence that connects business priorities with product roadmaps, data investments, engineering dependencies, and commercial execution.
Establish clear decision rights and accountability across business, Product, Quant, Data, Engineering, Revenue, and Operations.
Resolve cross-product dependencies and sequencing conflicts so the portfolio operates as one business.
Build the leadership structure, talent, and organizational capabilities required to scale.
Prepare the business for the future of data consumption
Set the business requirements that make systematic products trusted and usable, including point-in-time integrity, history, coverage, stable identities, lineage, joinability, and delivery reliability.
Shape the portfolio’s distribution strategy across feeds, APIs, MCPs, agents, cloud platforms, notebooks, marketplaces, and third-party integrations.
Apply AI and automation to accelerate dataset evaluation, quality assurance, documentation, signal testing, support, and client implementation.
Anticipate changes in systematic and agentic investor workflows and translate them into new business and product opportunities.
You Are Likely To Succeed If:
Required
Senior leadership experience building or scaling a data, financial-technology, information-services, analytics, or enterprise-software business.
Direct ownership of a P&L or business line, including revenue performance, multi-year planning, resource allocation, and investment tradeoffs.
A record of turning individual products or differentiated data assets into a coherent, repeatable commercial business.
Strong market and portfolio judgment, with the ability to choose among competing buyer segments, growth opportunities, and investments.
Experience developing pricing, packaging, go-to-market, onboarding, and service models for sophisticated enterprise or technical customers.
The ability to build strong client relationships and translate market evidence into clear business and product choices.
Experience leading through a matrixed organization, establishing decision rights, aligning functional leaders, and creating execution discipline.
Sufficient technical fluency to engage credibly on data quality, methodologies, schemas, APIs, infrastructure, and delivery reliability.
A demonstrated ability to build teams, develop leaders, and design organizations that can scale.
Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with the ability to turn complexity into clear direction and decisions.
Preferred
Experience serving quantitative investors, systematic funds, data scientists, or other technical investment personas.
Experience in alternative data, market data, financial information services, or investment-research products.
Familiarity with systematic-data requirements such as point-in-time integrity, backtesting, identity mapping, schema stability, lineage, and reproducibility.
Experience commercializing data through feeds, APIs, cloud platforms, MCPs, marketplaces, third-party integrations, or agentic interfaces.
Experience evaluating, sourcing, licensing, or managing third-party data partnerships.
Experience using AI and automation to improve data-product development, quality, evaluation, or client delivery.
What We Offer:
Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:
We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $225k-$250k, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 25%. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
The compensation package also includes equity.
This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
Job Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.text:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.
As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.
By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.
About the Job:
Zone & Co. is seeking a Director of Procure-to-Pay Product Suite to define, build, and scale our flagship platform. As the strategic leader of this product area, you will set the vision, drive innovation, and lead a high-performing team to deliver transformative solutions for global businesses. This is a unique opportunity for a product executive with a proven track record or exceptional potential to shape the future of enterprise financial operations.
AI is changing what technology can do. We want someone who knows the problem space to see where it is heading, and who builds with AI to get there first.
What You'll Do:
Define and communicate a bold, actionable product vision and strategy for the Procure-to-Pay suite, aligned with Zone & Co.’s overall business goals and market opportunities.
Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and customer focus.
Own and scale the product roadmap, ensuring seamless integration of procurement and payment workflows that drive measurable value for customers.
Translate customer feedback, market trends, and competitive insights into data-driven product decisions and prioritization.
Champion design excellence by delivering intuitive, user-centric solutions that elevate the customer experience and differentiate our offerings.
Collaborate closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and executive leadership to align vision and execution, from ideation to launch.
Serve as a visible product leader—representing the Procure to Pay suite in customer conversations, internal leadership forums, and industry events.
What You'll Need:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Product Management, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
10+ years of experience in product management, with deep expertise in Accounts Payable (AP) automation and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) solutions.
Strong understanding of end-to-end AP workflows, including the day-to-day needs of AP teams and the strategic priorities of CFOs.
Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and successfully bringing them to market.
Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to drive outcomes end to end, act proactively, and identify and address challenges early.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapt quickly, and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, data, and market insights.
Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and market opportunities.
Proven experience leading and developing product teams, with excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with peers and executive leadership.
The base salary range for this position is €10,000 – €128,000 GBP + bonus + equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and education, as well as market and business considerations.
Benefits
At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.
We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers
Join Our Global Mission
Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.
Employment Terms
United States
Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.
Non-US Jurisdictions
This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.
Privacy Statement and Applicant Privacy Notice.
#LI-Remote

Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and successfully bringing them to market.
Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to drive outcomes end to end, act proactively, and identify and address challenges early.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapt quickly, and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, data, and market insights.
Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and market opportunities.
Proven experience leading and developing product teams, with excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with peers and executive leadership.

The base salary range for this position is €10,000 – €128,000 GBP + bonus + equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and education, as well as market and business considerations.

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
We are building a Digital Concierge Platform for 2–4 star hotels that transforms every hotel room into a digital sales channel for local services. Guests discover and book experiences, wellness, dining, and more via a simple QR code—while hotels unlock new revenue streams without additional operational effort.
The founding team consists of two experienced and successful entrepreneurs with a strong track record in building and scaling companies.
Our next step: build the MVP → launch pilot hotels and partners → raise seed funding.
Your Role
As CTO, you are a technical co-founder responsible for building the entire platform—from architecture to launch.
You will work directly with the founders and have full ownership of the product and tech vision.
Tasks
Your Mission (0–6 months)
Phase 1: MVP (0–3 months)
Define and build the technical architecture
Develop a mobile-first web or app MVP
Implement core features:
QR-based entry experience
Location-based content delivery
Booking and payment flows (via APIs)
Rapid iteration with real pilot customers
Phase 2: Validation & Fundraising
Stabilize and scale the platform
Integrate initial partners (via APIs or manual onboarding)
Support technical due diligence with investors
Requirements
Strong full-stack engineering background (e.g., React / Next.js / Node / Python or
similar)
Proven experience building MVPs and scalable platforms
Product mindset—you think in solutions, not just features
Ideally experience with:
Marketplace models
Booking and payment integrations
Location-based services
Hands-on builder mentality with the ability to scale into a leadership role
Startup mindset: speed over perfection
Benefits
What We Offer
Equity-based co-founder role
Opportunity to build a globally scalable product from scratch
Close collaboration with experienced serial entrepreneurs
Clear vision with a strong, revenue-driven business model
Compensation
No salary for the first 3–4 months
Focus: build MVP & secure funding
Salary and team expansion after successful fundraising
Why This Is Exciting
Large, clearly defined global market (hotels worldwide)
Immediate monetization potential (commission-based model)
Not a “nice-to-have,” but a revenue engine for hotels
Strong go-to-market strategy (QR + co-branding + local partnerships)

jobs.title: Associate Director, Technology Product Management- Medi-Span
jobs.text:
Location
This role the flexibility to work remotely while maintaining regular in-person collaboration. Preference is for the East Coast or Central Time Zones.
Job Summary (Basic Function)
The Associate Director, Technology Product Management for Medi-Span has two connected areas of accountability: owning product strategy for the North America Commercial market and leading strategy and roadmap direction for assigned product areas. These areas currently include solutions that support drug pricing and market access, supply chain and regulatory information, dispensing and pharmacy workflows, and patient-facing medication information.
This leader is the primary Medi-Span Product partner for Commercial Sales opportunities and turns customer, market, competitive, regulatory, and product-performance evidence into clear priorities and investment decisions. The role balances growth with customer commitments, security, modernization, regulatory needs, and ongoing product health, while ensuring priority work moves from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable results.
The role leads Product professionals and works closely with Engineering, Design, Content, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Customer Support, Systems Implementation, and other Product leaders. Success requires sound judgment, strong commercial healthcare knowledge, and the ability to align teams around customer problems and sustainable business value. This leader also leads adoption of AI-enabled ways of working and the Agentic Product Development Life Cycle across their product areas.
Wolters Kluwer Health is an established, fast-growing, and innovation-driven healthcare information technology company that delivers trusted clinical technology and evidence-based solutions to support decision-making and improve outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. Our flagship products include UpToDate, UpToDate Lexidrug, UpToDate Patient Engagement, and Medi-Span.
what you’ll be accountable for
Understand the Customer:
Own and continually refine the Medi-Span strategy for the North America Commercial market. Use customer needs, market trends, competitive intelligence, product performance, and business goals to identify growth, retention, and portfolio opportunities.
Ensure product decisions are supported by meaningful customer and market evidence. Define the problem, target customer, desired outcome, scope boundaries, and measures of success, and validate value before expanding scope.
Make Better Decisions:
Use customer evidence, experimentation, product telemetry, and business performance to make clear product and investment decisions that improve adoption, retention, customer value, and business outcomes. Help teams identify assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and adjust direction as new evidence emerges.
Own strategy and roadmap direction for assigned product areas. Translate product-line strategy into priorities and make trade-offs across growth, customer commitments, regulatory and standards-driven work, security, modernization, technical debt, and ongoing product health.
Build Valuable Products:
Oversee progress and outcomes from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, and Content to establish accountability, evaluate feasibility, manage dependencies and risks, and remove barriers.
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Customer Success, and Systems Implementation to define target buyers, use cases, value, positioning, packaging, launch readiness, adoption plans, and sales enablement for existing and new solutions.
Define and monitor measurable outcomes for assigned market and product responsibilities, including revenue contribution, retention, adoption, customer value, roadmap progress, product health, and launch results.
Ensure teams validate customer value, competitive differentiation, and willingness to pay before scaling investment, then use adoption, usage, retention, expansion, and financial performance to improve results after launch. Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance on commercialization, forecasts, and corrective action when outcomes fall short.
Scale AI-enabled ways of working and Agentic PDLC practices across Medi-Span North America Commercial product areas, using AI to accelerate discovery, synthesis, prototyping, and execution while remaining accountable for product decisions and outcomes.
Work with Customer Success, Customer Support, and Systems Implementation to create a coherent customer experience across product, onboarding, training, support, adoption, and ongoing value realization rather than a series of handoffs.
Lead Across Boundaries:
Serve as the primary Medi-Span Product partner for Commercial Sales opportunities. Provide product guidance, participate in customer conversations, connect opportunities to the right experts, and set clear expectations about fit, priorities, and timing.
Grow People & Capability:
Lead, coach, and develop Product team members through clear expectations, regular feedback, career support, and meaningful growth assignments. Build a culture of accountability, trust, shared ownership, and continuous learning.
Raise the bar for customer understanding, product judgment, experimentation, product craft, and AI-enabled practice across the team.
Other Duties
Other Duties:
Represent assigned market and product responsibilities in product-line strategy, governance, investment, and industry discussions.
Build shared understanding of customers, markets, competitors, and products through internal education and clear strategic communication.
Other duties as assigned by manager.
Job Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, healthcare, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, required.
Required Experience:
10+ years of progressive experience with healthcare technology, data, or software products, including product leadership responsibilities.
5+ years of hands-on product management experience leading B2B solutions from market discovery and validation through launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
Demonstrated success owning product or portfolio strategy and making roadmap trade-offs across growth, customer needs, regulatory requirements, security, modernization, and product health.
Experience partnering directly with Sales and go-to-market teams to support customer opportunities, product positioning, enablement, and launch readiness in commercial healthcare markets.
3+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, goal setting, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Content, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Customer Support, Systems Implementation, and senior stakeholders.
Experience using AI to accelerate customer understanding, insight synthesis, experimentation, and product execution while maintaining strong human judgment.
Experience using customer evidence, experimentation, and product telemetry to guide product decisions and improve outcomes.
Experience building, launching, or scaling AI-enabled products, capabilities, or agents and integrating AI into product-development practices.
Preferred Experience:
Experience with healthcare embedded data and embedded data workflows.
Proficiency with product-development and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, and visual collaboration tools.
Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:
Ability to guide teams in selecting appropriate customer-research methods, evaluating evidence quality, and synthesizing insight across a product domain.
Strong strategic, commercial, and financial acumen, including product strategy, monetization, forecasting, prioritization, and investment decisions across a product domain.
Working fluency in AI-enabled product development and the use of AI to accelerate learning, decision-making, and execution.
Ability to lead product outcomes in a complex, matrixed organization by aligning cross-functional teams, resolving dependencies, and influencing decisions without direct authority.
If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about healthcare technology and product leadership, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives.
What We Value in This Role:
Strategic Thinking: You see patterns, anticipate change, and turn complex information into a clear direction that connects customer value and business goals.
Sound Judgment: You make timely, well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information, distinguish what matters most, and adjust when new evidence emerges.
Accountability for Results: You create clarity about outcomes, ownership, and follow-through and stay engaged until the intended value is achieved.
Collaborative Influence: You build trust, listen to different perspectives, communicate clearly, and align people across functions without relying on authority.
People Development: You set clear expectations, provide direct and constructive feedback, develop talent, and create an environment where people can take ownership and grow.
Trave
This role includes up to 20% travel, typically amounting to one trip per month (2–3 days each) for customer engagement or team collaboration. Occasional international travel may be required 1–2 times per year, generally for about a week. We strive to keep travel purposeful and balanced with flexibility.
Our Interview Practices
To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.
Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
Compensation:
$133,400.00 - $238,400.00 USDThis role is eligible for Bonus.
Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.
Additional Information:
Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

jobs.title: Director, Data Trust
jobs.text:
SHIFT:
Day (United States of America)
Seeking Breakthrough Makers
Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.
At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.
CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.
A Brief Overview
Director of Data Trust will lead data governance providing both strategic and operational leadership across the enterprise data warehouse, business intelligence (BI) ecosystem, and analytical products, ensuring that data is reliable, secure, well‑understood, and responsibly used. As a leader within the Data & Analytics organization and reporting to the AVP of Data Science, this role oversees the Data Trust Office and drives the evolution of data governance capabilities that support clinical, research, operational, and enterprise reporting needs, as well as emerging AI‑enabled solutions.
The Director is responsible for establishing, executing, and advancing CHOP's data governance strategy which includes developing and refining the frameworks, policies, and standards that strengthen data quality, transparency, security, compliance, and ethical use.
While the role is anchored within the Data & Analytics organization, the Director will partner closely with clinical, operational, and technical leaders to improve data quality and stewardship at upstream source systems that feed the enterprise data warehouse. These partnerships are essential to ensuring downstream reliability for reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI.
As CHOP expands its use of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI, the Director of Data Trust will build and scale the governance foundation required for trustworthy insights, positioning the organization for future growth and maturity in enterprise data governance.
What you will do
Operational oversight of the Data Trust Office activities in support of clinical and operational analytic leaders:
Data Strategy & Trust Leadership
Define and execute a multi-year Data Trust and Data Governance roadmap aligned to organizational strategy, clinical and operational priorities, research needs, and AI initiatives.
Integrate data governance into broader Data & Analytics, digital, and AI strategies, ensuring governance efforts are sequenced, scalable, and outcome driven.
Ensure governance standards are consistently applied throughout the data asset lifecycle, including acquisition, integration, validation, use, maintenance, and archival.
Provide thought leadership on modern governance practices that balance innovation with risk management and regulatory compliance.
Promote enterprise-wide adoption of repeatable governance standards rather than one-off solutions
Data Quality, Metadata & Transparency
Scale and mature the Data Quality Center of Excellence (COE), including profiling, monitoring, root-cause analysis, prioritization, and remediation of data quality issues, imperative for trusted analytics and AI solutions.
Establish enterprise standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, and documentation that enable data consumers to understand, trust, and appropriately use data.
Define data quality metrics and KPIs and report progress to executive stakeholders.
Oversee adoption and optimization of the enterprise data catalog and metadata management processes, ensuring discoverability and usability across domains.
Access, Privacy, Security & Responsible Data Use
Align data governance practices with enterprise and/or regulatory privacy and security standards.
Refine and mature data access controls, balancing usability with protection of sensitive data.
Enforce data classification schemas and corresponding access controls to ensure data is securely managed and aligned with privacy, security, and compliance standards.
Ensure responsible data use and ethical considerations are embedded into analytics and AI initiatives.
Partner with enterprise AI governance efforts to ensure data readiness, documentation, and guardrails support responsible AI adoption.
Governance Operations & Policy Management
Develop, publish, and maintain enterprise data governance policies, standards, and procedures.
Establish and support data stewardship roles and accountability frameworks across clinical, research, and operational domains.
Translate governance decisions into actionable standards, priorities, and execution plans across the data ecosystem.

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.

CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.
A Brief Overview

Director of Data Trust will lead data governance providing both strategic and operational leadership across the enterprise data warehouse, business intelligence (BI) ecosystem, and analytical products, ensuring that data is reliable, secure, well‑understood, and responsibly used. As a leader within the Data & Analytics organization and reporting to the AVP of Data Science, this role oversees the Data Trust Office and drives the evolution of data governance capabilities that support clinical, research, operational, and enterprise reporting needs, as well as emerging AI‑enabled solutions.

The Director is responsible for establishing, executing, and advancing CHOP's data governance strategy which includes developing and refining the frameworks, policies, and standards that strengthen data quality, transparency, security, compliance, and ethical use.

While the role is anchored within the Data & Analytics organization, the Director will partner closely with clinical, operational, and technical leaders to improve data quality and stewardship at upstream source systems that feed the enterprise data warehouse. These partnerships are essential to ensuring downstream reliability for reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI.

As CHOP expands its use of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI, the Director of Data Trust will build and scale the governance foundation required for trustworthy insights, positioning the organization for future growth and maturity in enterprise data governance.
What you will do

items: Operational oversight of the Data Trust Office activities in support of clinical and operational analytic leaders:
Data Strategy & Trust Leadership
Define and execute a multi-year Data Trust and Data Governance roadmap aligned to organizational strategy, clinical and operational priorities, research needs, and AI initiatives.
Integrate data governance into broader Data & Analytics, digital, and AI strategies, ensuring governance efforts are sequenced, scalable, and outcome driven.
Ensure governance standards are consistently applied throughout the data asset lifecycle, including acquisition, integration, validation, use, maintenance, and archival.
Provide thought leadership on modern governance practices that balance innovation with risk management and regulatory compliance.
Promote enterprise-wide adoption of repeatable governance standards rather than one-off solutions
Data Quality, Metadata & Transparency

Scale and mature the Data Quality Center of Excellence (COE), including profiling, monitoring, root-cause analysis, prioritization, and remediation of data quality issues, imperative for trusted analytics and AI solutions.
Establish enterprise standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, and documentation that enable data consumers to understand, trust, and appropriately use data.
Define data quality metrics and KPIs and report progress to executive stakeholders.
Oversee adoption and optimization of the enterprise data catalog and metadata management processes, ensuring discoverability and usability across domains.

Align data governance practices with enterprise and/or regulatory privacy and security standards.
Refine and mature data access controls, balancing usability with protection of sensitive data.
Enforce data classification schemas and corresponding access controls to ensure data is securely managed and aligned with privacy, security, and compliance standards.
Ensure responsible data use and ethical considerations are embedded into analytics and AI initiatives.
Partner with enterprise AI governance efforts to ensure data readiness, documentation, and guardrails support responsible AI adoption.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Product
jobs.text:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.
We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.
What You'll Own
Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.
Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.
Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.
Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.
Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.
Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
What We're Looking For 
Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.
Comfortable working across different business functions.
Strong ownership and execution skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.
This Role Is Not For
People who only want to attend meetings. 
Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 
Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 
People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 
People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions
Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process:
Our process is designed to move fast:
Online assessment or practical task
Role-specific interview
CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.
Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Department: Development
Supervisor: Chief Technology Officer
Supervises: Engineering Team
Type: Full-time Regular
Classification: Exempt
Travel Required: Up to 15%
Location: This is a remote position.
Role Summary
The Director of Engineering leads Greenshades' development organization, ensuring the delivery of reliable, scalable, and secure payroll, HR, and workforce management software. This role sets engineering direction, builds and develops high-performing leaders and teams, and owns the metrics that define how engineering performs. You will partner with Product, QA, and executive leadership to turn business priorities into predictable outcomes, while championing platform reliability, engineering excellence, and an AI-first approach to building software.
Responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and Engineering Leads, building a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Own the engineering roadmap and delivery execution, aligning technical priorities with product strategy and business goals.
Own engineering metrics end to end: define, instrument, and report on delivery, quality, reliability, and productivity measures, and hold teams accountable for improving them.
Use engineering metrics to drive decisions on capacity, process, and investment, and communicate results and trends clearly to the CTO and senior leadership.
Drive platform reliability, performance, and scalability across multi-tenant, compliance-sensitive systems.
Establish and evolve engineering standards for architecture, code quality, security, testing, and release practices.
Lead the adoption of AI-first engineering practices across the organization, including agentic development workflows, tooling, and governance, and measure their impact on productivity, quality, and cost.
Partner with Product, QA, Customer Experience, and Implementations to prioritize work and resolve cross-functional dependencies.
Manage engineering capacity, hiring, resource planning, and budget in partnership with executive leadership.
Other duties as assigned.
Requirements
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering managers or multiple teams.
Proven track record delivering and operating production SaaS platforms at scale, ideally in payroll, HR, fintech, or another regulated domain.
Hands-on experience leading AI-assisted software development at team or organizational scale, including coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled testing and code review.
Demonstrated ability to turn AI adoption into measurable results, such as improved throughput, quality, or cycle time, and to manage AI tooling costs and licensing.
Working knowledge of AI governance in engineering, including security, data privacy, intellectual property, and human review of AI-generated code.
Experience defining and owning engineering metrics (such as DORA measures, quality, reliability, and productivity indicators) and using them to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
Strong technical foundation in modern engineering practices, with experience in .NET/C#, SQL Server, and cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining diverse engineering talent, and managing performance with clarity and fairness.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Agentic Engineering
jobs.text:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋
We’re looking for a Senior Director, Agentic Engineering to build and lead the platform, capabilities, and operating model that enable Lightspeed’s Product & Technology teams to work effectively with AI agents across the full product development lifecycle.
Reporting to the SVP, Engineering, this is a foundational leadership role with company-wide impact. You will turn rapidly evolving agentic technology into secure, reliable, and reusable capabilities that help teams discover, design, build, test, ship, and operate better products faster. Success will be measured not by experimentation alone, but by adoption and sustained improvements in product quality, engineering velocity, developer experience, and business outcomes.
Please note this role is based in the United States.
What you’ll be doing
Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for agentic engineering at Lightspeed, translating business and product priorities into a platform investment plan.
Build and lead the teams responsible for shared agentic platform capabilities, including reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance.
Create an extensible platform and paved-road experience that allows Product, Design, Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams to adopt agentic workflows without rebuilding core capabilities independently.
Partner with Retail, Hospitality, Payments, and platform leaders on highest-value product development use cases, launch them with early teams, and scale proven patterns across Lightspeed.
Establish a rigorous evaluation system for agent performance, output quality, reliability, security, cost, and human oversight so teams can use agents with confidence in production workflows.
Work closely with Security, Privacy, Legal, Data, and Architecture leaders to embed responsible AI, access controls, data protection, auditability, and risk management into the platform by design.
Define the operating model for agentic development, including standards, reusable patterns, ownership boundaries, enablement, support, and mechanisms for sharing learning across teams.
Drive adoption and change across a global organization by helping leaders redesign workflows, build team capability, and move from tool usage to measurable operating-model change.
Own outcome metrics for the platform, including adoption, active usage, developer and product experience, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, cost efficiency, and demonstrated business impact.
Hire, coach, and develop a strong leadership and technical bench, while building an inclusive, high-performing organization with high standards for execution and learning.
What you need to bring:
We’re looking for a senior engineering leader who can combine platform depth, AI fluency, product judgment, and enterprise change leadership. You should have experience with the following:
Leading leaders and senior technical talent in a software engineering organization, with a record of building high-performing teams through managers and staff-plus engineers.
Defining and scaling internal platforms, developer platforms, shared engineering capabilities, or infrastructure products in a complex, multi-product environment.
Building or deploying AI-enabled and agentic systems, including model and tool orchestration, retrieval and context systems, evaluation frameworks, automation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Partnering effectively with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business functions.
Leading organizational change across distributed teams, including workflow redesign, enablement, communication, and adoption at scale.
Establishing high standards for architecture, engineering quality, operational resilience, responsible AI, security, and cost management.
Communicating complex technical and strategic concepts clearly to executives, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams.
15+ years of experience and Bachelor’s degree in CS or related field.
We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!
Be a changemaker
You’ll enjoy:
A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
A culture that celebrates performance
The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
Career-defining opportunities
Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.
Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
Equity options, because this is your company too
Contributions to your 401k. Your future matters
Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
Fuel your growth. Find your people.
At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities
Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.
At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skillset, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $300,000 to $360,000 USD, depending on the candidate’s location. Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, 401K plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.
Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within the United States, and refers to the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting, which may vary depending on the candidate’s actual location. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.
To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
Where to from here?
Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.
Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.
Who we are:
Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.
Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.
Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

blocks.text: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

We’re looking for a Senior Director, Agentic Engineering to build and lead the platform, capabilities, and operating model that enable Lightspeed’s Product & Technology teams to work effectively with AI agents across the full product development lifecycle.

Reporting to the SVP, Engineering, this is a foundational leadership role with company-wide impact. You will turn rapidly evolving agentic technology into secure, reliable, and reusable capabilities that help teams discover, design, build, test, ship, and operate better products faster. Success will be measured not by experimentation alone, but by adoption and sustained improvements in product quality, engineering velocity, developer experience, and business outcomes.
Please note this role is based in the United States.
What you’ll be doing
Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for agentic engineering at Lightspeed, translating business and product priorities into a platform investment plan.

Build and lead the teams responsible for shared agentic platform capabilities, including reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance.

Create an extensible platform and paved-road experience that allows Product, Design, Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams to adopt agentic workflows without rebuilding core capabilities independently.
Partner with Retail, Hospitality, Payments, and platform leaders on highest-value product development use cases, launch them with early teams, and scale proven patterns across Lightspeed.
Establish a rigorous evaluation system for agent performance, output quality, reliability, security, cost, and human oversight so teams can use agents with confidence in production workflows.
Work closely with Security, Privacy, Legal, Data, and Architecture leaders to embed responsible AI, access controls, data protection, auditability, and risk management into the platform by design.
Define the operating model for agentic development, including standards, reusable patterns, ownership boundaries, enablement, support, and mechanisms for sharing learning across teams.
Drive adoption and change across a global organization by helping leaders redesign workflows, build team capability, and move from tool usage to measurable operating-model change.

Own outcome metrics for the platform, including adoption, active usage, developer and product experience, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, cost efficiency, and demonstrated business impact.
Hire, coach, and develop a strong leadership and technical bench, while building an inclusive, high-performing organization with high standards for execution and learning.
What you need to bring:
We’re looking for a senior engineering leader who can combine platform depth, AI fluency, product judgment, and enterprise change leadership. You should have experience with the following:
Leading leaders and senior technical talent in a software engineering organization, with a record of building high-performing teams through managers and staff-plus engineers.
Defining and scaling internal platforms, developer platforms, shared engineering capabilities, or infrastructure products in a complex, multi-product environment.

Building or deploying AI-enabled and agentic systems, including model and tool orchestration, retrieval and context systems, evaluation frameworks, automation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Partnering effectively with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business functions.
Leading organizational change across distributed teams, including workflow redesign, enablement, communication, and adoption at scale.
Establishing high standards for architecture, engineering quality, operational resilience, responsible AI, security, and cost management.
Communicating complex technical and strategic concepts clearly to executives, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams.
15+ years of experience and Bachelor’s degree in CS or related field.
We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!
Be a changemaker
You’ll enjoy:
A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
A culture that celebrates performance
The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
Career-defining opportunities
Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.
Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
Equity options, because this is your company too
Contributions to your 401k. Your future matters
Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities
Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skillset, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $300,000 to $360,000 USD, depending on the candidate’s location. Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, 401K plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within the United States, and refers to the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting, which may vary depending on the candidate’s actual location. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Product Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
We recently acquired Traject Data, home of SerpWow and Rainforest API, and now run an end-to-end data pipeline: from proxy and scraping infrastructure through to structured, ready-to-use data APIs. The next chapter is turning that into one coherent, AI-native platform and we're looking for a CTPO to lead the combined 25-person product and engineering org through it. You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table, and be the person who understands the stack down to the proxy layer while also setting where the product goes next.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Get hands-on with the heart of the product: proxy dynamics and anti-bot evasion, working directly with our Head of Ops to optimise vendor relationships and build up capacity.
Build real fluency in the product and the backend so you can operate as a genuine technical sparring partner to the CEO, not just receive direction.
Start bringing the ScraperAPI and Traject Data infrastructure together on a coherent technical roadmap
Your responsibilities
Own end-to-end product and technology strategy across our scraping infrastructure, proxy networks, and structured data API products (ScraperAPI, SerpWow, Rainforest API).
Lead, scale, and develop a 25+ person product and engineering organisation spanning multiple countries and time zones, building the management structure it needs as it grows.
Set technical architecture direction for high-scale, high-reliability infrastructure, including proxy management, anti-bot evasion, and large-scale scraping systems.
Drive AI and modern ML tooling into both the product itself and how the team builds and ships it.
Define and execute one product roadmap across the merged ScraperAPI and Traject Data lines.
Represent product and technology to the board, and work closely with the CEO and commercial leadership to keep product direction and business strategy aligned.
Stay close enough to the code and infrastructure to go in and troubleshoot, fix, or challenge a technical decision yourself when it matters.
What You bring to the table
Experience leading product and/or engineering at a highly technical company (CTO, CPO, VP Engineering or similar), at a 25+ person org or larger
Real hands-on depth in web scraping, proxies, or closely adjacent infrastructure. You understand the operational reality of this space and you don't rattle when a source breaks overnight and it's suddenly all hands on deck
A genuine track record with AI/ML, both shaping AI-powered product capability and pushing AI-native ways of working through an engineering team
Experience owning product vision and technical architecture together, not just one side of that line
Comfort operating at board level: a clear communicator who can hold their own with an ambitious, hands-on CEO and knows when to push back
Bonus: experience integrating product lines after a merger or acquisition
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Head of Cloud Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
Job Summary
The VP, Cloud Platform Engineering leads the infrastructure layer beneath ACI's application platform. This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the paved roads, tooling, and guardrails that let application teams build, deploy, and run on Azure (primary), AWS (secondary), and ACI datacenters quickly, securely, and at a predictable cost. The role leads a global organization across the US and India, including the Cloud Infrastructure, Engineering & Operations and Cloud Architecture functions, and partners with Product, Security, Application Platform, Observability, and FinOps leadership to move ACI to a consistent, supported cloud foundation.
Job Responsibilities
Set the vision, multi-year roadmap, and operating model for Cloud Platform Engineering; define success metrics and report progress to executive leadership.
Own paved roads and Terraform modules: supported, opinionated ways to build and deploy infrastructure on Azure and AWS, delivered as versioned, reusable infrastructure as code.
Own Kubernetes as a service: one control tier across the datacenter and cloud, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, multi-tenancy, and supportability.
Own the infrastructure automation, provisioning, and deployment capabilities required to deliver Cloud Platform Engineering services, and partner with Application Platform on standardized application CI/CD patterns, developer tooling, and integration points.
Own landing zones and network as code: account and subscription setup and connectivity declared in files and provisioned automatically, with consistent segmentation and hybrid connectivity.
Own baseline identity, secrets, and guardrail patterns: access patterns, secrets handling, and policy as code, in partnership with Security and Compliance.
Own lifecycle, end-of-life, and resilience standards: rebuild rather than patch, standard images, pinned versions, tracked exceptions, and DR patterns.
Lead the Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) for cloud infrastructure standards, reference architectures, governance, and enablement, in partnership with Architecture, Security, Application Platform, and other technology teams.
Partner with the Director, Cloud FinOps on unit economics, tagging, and cost visibility, including AI token costs, and hold platform teams accountable to cost targets.
Own the infrastructure platform capabilities required to securely run and scale the AI Gateway, partnering with the accountable AI/Application Platform team and Cloud FinOps on service integration, governance, and token economics.
Drive adoption through lighthouse application teams, publish clear service catalogs and SLAs, and treat application teams as customers of the platform.
Support PCI, SOC, FFIEC, and other audit and regulatory evidence requests, and ensure platform controls are measurable and automated.
Manage platform reliability, capacity, and hyperscaler relationships, including technical input to commercial agreements and spend commitments.
Build, develop, and retain a high-performing, globally distributed leadership team; set clear goals, hold the team to them, and manage organizational budget and headcount.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
Understand and comply with Risk Management program requirements including identification of risks, key controls, and control testing as applicable to their responsibilities.
Scope Boundaries
The Application Platform and observability capabilities are owned by other teams. Cloud Platform Engineering owns the underlying cloud infrastructure platform, infrastructure automation, and cloud-foundation services. This role partners with Application Platform, Observability, Architecture, Security, and Product through clearly defined interfaces and shared standards, but does not own application-platform capabilities, application developer experience, or observability tooling.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
15+ years of information technology experience, including 8+ years leading engineering or infrastructure teams, with experience leading managers.
Deep, hands-on background in public cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS in large enterprise or regulated environments.
Proven delivery of infrastructure as code (Terraform), Kubernetes platforms, and CI/CD at scale.
Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Experience operating in 24/7 mission-critical production environments with strict availability and compliance requirements.
Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience
Experience building an internal developer platform or platform engineering organization with measured developer adoption.
Familiarity with FinOps practices, cloud cost governance, and AI or LLM cost management.
Payments, banking, or other regulated financial services background.
Experience with policy as code, secrets management, and landing zone frameworks, for example Azure Landing Zones or AWS Control Tower.
Experience with hybrid environments spanning datacenter and public cloud.
Master's degree or MBA; relevant cloud certifications.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Work Environment
Remote work within the United States; periodic travel to ACI offices, including Bangalore and Pune, India.
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Up to 25% travel, which could be international.
Participates in executive escalation for major incidents in 24/7 mission-critical environments.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at Job ID (Requisition #20443)
ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.
Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.
