jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About ImpruvonImpruvon builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.
Our platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. We support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and we recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.
Our results so far:
48% reduction in medication errors
39% increase in compliance
69% improvement in audit-ready documentation
About the RoleWe are looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution at Impruvon and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today, a Product Lead and a Product Specialist, with plans to grow.
We are a growing startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to the CEO and senior leadership. Product has been driven by our leadership team to date, and we are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you, including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.
We are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and our engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together. Our engineers are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and we are intentionally not prescribing a rigid handoff model.
Our product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and our customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.
Key Responsibilities
Own the roadmap
Own product strategy and the roadmap across our full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy and EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12 to 24 months, and make the case for it, including to leadership when it conflicts with what we currently believe. Product strategy has been set by our leadership team to date. The point of this hire is for that to change.
Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them. In our environment, "ship it and iterate" is not always available
Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product. Audit-ready documentation is one of the main reasons customers choose us
Lead discovery
Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders, and observe workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
Design for three very different users: administrators who need oversight and audit readiness, caregivers who need speed and clarity mid-shift, and the individuals receiving care, some of whom are building medication independence for the first time
Design into existing routines rather than around them. Our customers cannot absorb a system that reshapes how a shift runs, and for non-clinical staff on shared devices, usability is a safety requirement rather than a preference
Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork. Define success measures before work starts, and measure what actually happened after release
Build the function
Establish how product gets practiced here: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, and how outcomes get measured
Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and hire as scope expands, including roles that do not exist yet
Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and what is changing, and support them on strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters
Work with AI
We expect our product leader to set the standard on AI rather than delegate it.
Use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic development environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes rather than relying only on mockups and specs
Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value, not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize.
You do not need to be a software engineer, and you will have strong engineering partnership for that. You do need to be willing and able to build.
What This Role Is NotThis is not a purely strategic or advisory position, and it is not a roadmap-maintenance or backlog-management role. You will be the most senior product person in the company, with no layer between you and the problem.
It is also not a role where you stay there. You will be hands-on from day one because that is what this stage requires. You will also be building the function that eventually changes that: developing the two people already here, making the case for who we hire next, and forming a view of what this product organization needs to become. If you want only the hands-on work, or only the organizational work, this is not the right role.
Skills, Knowledge, & Experience
Requirements
8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a roadmap covering discovery, definition, and delivery, not solely execution of a roadmap someone else set
Experience leading product people, including hiring and onboarding rather than only managing an inherited team
A track record of shipping B2B SaaS in close partnership with Engineering
Experience building product process where little or none existed
Strong discovery skills: customer interviewing, problem validation, prototyping, and experimentation, with examples of how evidence changed your approach
Experience with products where the buyer and the user are different people. Our contracts are signed by provider executives and state agencies, and the software is used by non-clinical caregivers mid-shift
Practical, frequent use of LLMs in your day-to-day work
Comfort working with data directly, strong written communication, and the judgment to decide with incomplete information and own the outcome
Willingness to travel occasionally, up to roughly 15%, for customer and facility site visits, team meetings, and industry events
Nice to Have
Experience in healthcare technology, IDD services, assisted living, behavioral health, long-term care, or medication management, or another regulated environment where safety and compliance shape product decisions
Experience with enterprise, government, or state agency customers, including procurement and reporting requirements
Experience shipping products that combine software and connected hardware
Experience with integration-dependent products (HL7, JSON, REST APIs, pharmacy management systems, EHRs)
Experience scaling a Product function from a small team, or shipping products and internal tools you personally prototyped using AI-assisted development
Personal Attributes
A builder. Your instinct when you have an idea is to make something and test it.
Low ego and strong point of view. You advocate hard for a position and change it when the evidence changes.
Comfortable with ambiguity. You do not need a detailed roadmap to know what to do next.
Intellectually curious. You want to understand why a workflow works the way it does, not just what feature someone asked for.
Energized by the mission. Many of the people affected by our product cannot advocate for themselves. Medication management failures are not abstract software problems here.
Benefits & Compensation
At Impruvon, we know our people are our greatest asset. We provide a benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth, including:
Base salary of $183,000 to $225,000, depending on experience
Equity participation
100% company-paid medical coverage (base plan)
Dental and vision available
401(k) retirement plan
Company-paid life, AD&D, STD and LTD insurance
Lifestyle Spending Account (wellness, personal use, and company swag)
Flexible PTO plus company holidays
Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
Why Join Us
Working at Impruvon means being part of a mission-driven, passionate, and collaborative team. Every role contributes to improving lives and reducing risks in care settings across the country. Your expertise will help ensure we can continue to innovate, grow, and deliver on our promise of safer, smarter care.

blocks.text: About ImpruvonImpruvon builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.

Our platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. We support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and we recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.
Our results so far:

items: 48% reduction in medication errors
39% increase in compliance
69% improvement in audit-ready documentation

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Debt Optimizer)
jobs.text:
As Director of Product Management for Achieve Debt Optimizer*, you will own the company's next-generation consumer debt product end to end. Achieve Debt Optimizer*evaluates a consumer's whole debt picture and matches them to the right solution across Achieve and partner products, loan and non-loan alike. It is not a budgeting app and not a single-product lender.
This is a core product leadership role with two amplified mandates: building the partner ecosystem that powers the marketplace and taking the product to market. You will turn a validated zero-to-one concept into a scaled, monetized platform heading into 2027. Achieve Debt Optimizer* is a strategic initiative anchoring the company's long-term growth objective. It runs a decoupled front end and back end, and its roadmap evolves on transitioning from single product solutions into multi product bundles that include multiyear debt plans that transform consumers’ future and shape the way they think about debt. Many concepts are backed by user research that clearly point out that users are highly interested in comprehensive solutions.
What you'll own
1. Product strategy and execution
Lead the product from validated prototype to scaled platform: define requirements, sequence releases and make clear trade-offs across scope, speed and risk.
Define the decisioning experience: whole-portfolio debt evaluation, Fit Score and account-level ratings, Smart Move recommendations, bundling logic and liability drag.
Partner with design and research to run rapid concept tests and turn findings into product decisions.
Shape AI-enabled and agentic experiences, including the conversational navigator, so they lift conversion and consumer trust.
2. Partner integration and ecosystem
Build the partner strategy for loan and non-loan solutions and partnerships: partner with BD to identify, prioritize and onboard partners across refinance, auto and student lending, balance transfer, credit counseling and other external solutions.
Own the partner API and integration product: pre-qualification and pricing exchange, eligibility, offer return, attribution and reporting.
Define partner onboarding, certification and performance standards; manage the integration pipeline with Partner B2B and Engineering.
Design marketplace economics with Finance and Partnerships: revenue share, lead and funded-loan monetization, and partner-level reporting.
Evolve the platform toward partner and B2B packaging, including platform-as-a-service use cases.
Ensure every partner offer meets compliance, fair-lending and data-sharing requirements, in partnership with Legal and Compliance.
3. Go-to-market
Partner with Marketing on GTM for each release: positioning, target segments, pricing and packaging, launch plans and success criteria.
Partner with Marketing, Channel and MarTech to plan acquisition across paid, owned, partner and direct channels, and to optimize channel mix.
Integrate Debt Navigator into the unified prequalification platform across business units so it becomes a front door to the Achieve portfolio.
Build the measurement framework: funnel conversion, engagement and return visits, partner yield, revenue per user and unit economics.
4. Agentic strategy
Define product content and functionality so the product can be properly represented and show up in LLMs and agents
Develop the decision methodology on how the product, bundle and logic are exposed in a form agents can explain and trust.
Define MCP and API interfaces so agents use to query and act on the product.
What you bring
10+ years in product management, with hands-on experience.
A track record of taking a zero-to-one consumer product to scale and owning its P&L or revenue outcomes.
Experience building marketplace or platform products with third-party partners: partner APIs, integrations, offer exchange and partner economics.
Hands-on go-to-market leadership: positioning, pricing and packaging, launch, and channel strategy with Marketing and Sales.
Consumer-facing experience and strong understanding in experimentation.
Strong analytical skills: funnel and unit-economics fluency, experiment design and data-driven prioritization.
Executive presence and the ability to align senior leaders, partners and cross-functional teams around a clear direction.
Preferred
Experience with lending marketplaces, loan-matching or offer-aggregation platforms.
Experience shipping AI-enabled or conversational products in a regulated setting.
Familiarity with credit data, tradelines, credit decisioning or credit prediction models.
Experience with B2B or platform-as-a-service packaging of a consumer product.
Who you'll work with
You'll work directly with senior executives to shape and pressure-test product direction. You'll also work cross functionally with Design, Research, Engineering, Marketing, BD and Legal & Compliance.
This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for a leader who is hands-on that thrives in ambiguity, moves fast and wants to define a new category in consumer debt.
The Impact You'll Make
Your work will directly reshape how millions of people find financial freedom and think about debt. You'll define the experience that power the company's core growth engine. You'll measure success by how many people you empower to take control of their financial future—and by how much you help Achieve grow sustainably and responsibly.
Achieve well-being with:
Hybrid and remote work opportunities
401 (k) with employer match
Medical, dental, and vision with HSA and FSA options
Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days
Access to wellness support through Employee Assistance Program, Talkspace, and fitness discounts
Up to $5,250 paid back to you on eligible education expenses
Pet care discounts for your furry family members
Financial support in times of hardship with our Achieve Care Fund
A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups
Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.
Work from home/hybrid:
We are proudly offering hybrid options in the San Francisco, CA and Phoenix, AZ metro markets. Hiring remotely in selected locations throughout PST, MST, CST.
Salary Range: $210,000 to $240,000 salary + bonus + benefits.
This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.
Join Achieve, change the future.
At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.
Attention Agencies & Search Firms: We do not accept unsolicited candidate resumes or profiles. Please do not reach out to anyone within Achieve to market your services or candidates. All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.
Achieve is a leading digital personal finance company. We help everyday people move from struggling to thriving by providing innovative, personalized financial solutions. By leveraging proprietary dataand analytics, our solutions are tailored for each step of our member's financial journey to include debt consolidation, personal loans, home equity loans, financial tools and education. Every day, we get to help our members move their finances forward with care, compassion, and empathetic touch. We put people first and treat them like humans, not account numbers.
The fintech industry is large and growing. Over $11T in home equity is sitting untapped across US homeowners - most haven’t borrowed against it yet, while personal loan balances just hit a record $276Bn from four years in a row of growth, with no signs of slowing. Consumers continue to face mounting debt. Credit card delinquencies are up 38%, leading to more demand for debt relief services. Achieve continues to support members and meet them wherever they are on their journey. Since 2002, Achieve has grown into one of the largest private consumer fintech unicorns in the U.S., with over $57B in enrollments for our industry-leading, tech-enabled debt resolution services business, and over $16Bn in personal and home loans originations.

jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage is one of the nation’s leading direct mortgage lenders, driven by innovation, data, and a relentless focus on customer experience. For over two decades, we’ve redefined how consumers access mortgage financing—combining digital technology with a high-performance sales organization. Our aggressive investment in marketing and lead generation fuels consistent growth, and our technology teams are at the center of that success.
Position Summary
We are seeking a strategic, hands-on VP of Software Engineering to lead the development, scalability, and innovation of our marketing technology ecosystem. This leader will partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Sales to deliver high-impact digital experiences, optimize lead generation, and maximize conversion performance.
This is a player-coach role—you will not only lead high-performing engineering teams but also contribute directly to the codebase, helping drive architecture decisions and accelerate delivery. This position will report to the CIO.
What You'll Do
Lead and scale high-performing engineering teams focused on marketing technology and customer acquisition platforms
Contribute hands-on to system design and development, writing high-quality, production-ready code
Drive the architecture, development, and optimization of systems supporting digital marketing, lead management, and conversion funnels
Partner with Marketing leadership to enhance lead generation efficiency and ROI through technology innovation
Oversee integrations across CRM, martech platforms, analytics tools, and third-party lead providers
Champion data-driven decision-making, A/B testing frameworks, and performance optimization initiatives
Establish engineering best practices for scalability, reliability, security, and speed-to-market
Collaborate with Product and Analytics teams to deliver personalized customer experiences
Manage vendor relationships and make strategic build vs. buy decisions
Build and mentor engineering leaders, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement
Own and oversee the architecture, performance, and continuous optimization of the AmeriSave website as a core marketing and lead generation platform
AmeriSave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
**Please note that the compensation and benefit information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to applicable state and local laws on pay transparency. It is estimated based on what a successful applicant in the relevant state might be paid. **
Compensation:
The annual compensation for this position generally ranges between $160,000 - $225,000.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence. We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers.
Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated. Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers.
At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!
What We’re Looking For:
AmeriSave is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our Enterprise Technology & AI organization, software engineering, infrastructure, and security function responsible for our proprietary technology stack, including our Digital Mortgage platform and the systems that run our loan origination business end to end.
This is an executive role for a hands-on technology leader who has run large engineering organizations at scale, ideally within the mortgage industry or at a well-known lender, and who is equally credible discussing Azure architecture with a principal engineer, disaster recovery posture with an auditor, and technology strategy with the Board. You will own the reliability, security, scalability, and roadmap of the systems that power the company, while building and developing the engineering talent that maintains them. Seeking candidates with expertise and hands-on experience with Aloha software.
What You'll Do:
Engineering Organization Leadership: Lead a software engineering organization that designs, builds, and maintains AmeriSave's proprietary technology platforms, setting engineering standards, architecture direction, and delivery cadence across multiple product and platform teams.
Cloud & Database Infrastructure: Own the Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server database environments that run the company's proprietary systems, including architecture, cost management, performance tuning, and long-term platform strategy.
Reliability & Uptime: Hold accountability for system uptime and reliability in the high 99.99% range across production systems; drive the monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and engineering discipline required to sustain that bar at scale.
Information Security: Own the organization's information security posture and security infrastructure, partnering with Compliance and Risk to ensure systems, data, and customer information are protected against evolving threats, and that the company meets regulatory and investor security requirements.
AI Strategy: Set direction for the company's AI strategy and investment, overseeing in-house AI initiatives (including proprietary AI-powered platform capabilities, automation, and applied AI/ML use cases) and evaluating where AI can responsibly improve efficiency, customer experience, and decisioning.
Networking Infrastructure: Own enterprise networking architecture, including data center, cloud, and remote/hybrid workforce connectivity, ensuring performance, security, and scalability of the network as the business grows.
Disaster Recovery: Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for all critical systems, including recovery time/point objectives, failover testing, and readiness, ensuring the business can withstand and recover from major disruptions.
Capacity Planning: Lead capacity planning across infrastructure and applications, forecasting growth and ensuring systems scale ahead of business demand without over-provisioning cost.
Development Resource Management: Build, develop, and retain engineering talent and leadership; manage development resourcing and prioritization across competing business and technology initiatives; establish career paths and a strong engineering culture.
Executive Partnership & Communication: Partner with the CEO, CIO/CISO, and executive leadership team to translate business strategy into a technology roadmap; represent Technology in Board and investor conversations, and communicate complex technical topics in terms executives and non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Budget Ownership: Manage the technology budget, including infrastructure spend, tooling, and headcount, balancing innovation investment against operating efficiency.
AmeriSave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
**Please note that the compensation and benefit information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to applicable state and local laws on pay transparency. It is estimated based on what a successful applicant in the relevant state might be paid. **
Compensation:
The annual compensation for this position generally ranges between $275,000 - $350,000.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About the Organization
Millions of Americans feel politically homeless and left out of the two-party structure. Too many electoral choices are settled before most voters have a meaningful say, and our political system consistently fails to address the nation’s biggest challenges. We are a stealth team building an ambitious cross-partisan political venture to make American democracy more open, competitive, and responsive. We will build the infrastructure to effectively challenge the two-party political establishment, and create fundamentally new pathways to elected office and engaged citizen participation.
Our first major initiative will launch publicly in spring 2027 with the objective of materially influencing the 2028 national election cycle. This project will combine the scale of a mainstream consumer technology product, the reach of a modern media operation, and the ground game of a national political campaign – complete with digital and IRL field organizing across dozens of states – to engage tens of millions of Americans and build a constituency that outlasts this election cycle.
Our leadership team has raised and deployed over $100M toward democracy reform, winning dozens of state and local reform campaigns. Backed by seed funding from prominent investors and a cross-partisan board of civic leaders and company-builders, we are now assembling a multidisciplinary operating team of technologists, storytellers, politicos, and operators to build it from the ground up.
About the Role
You are a technologist who believes in the American political experiment and is convinced that more political competition is needed for a more productive, representative government. As our Chief Technology Officer, you will architect and build a civic consumer product with a fixed launch date that millions of Americans will join to inform themselves, deliberate together, and make their voices count in 2028. You will own every engineering decision, including how you build the team and choose partner firms. You are comfortable doing this under a media microscope, with adversaries actively seeking any crack in security to show that the system can't be trusted. In short, you'll build a secure, leading-edge platform that brings our democracy into the 21st century.
You'll start in January 2027 with tight product requirements, a fixed public launch in the spring, and a mandate to turn an ambitious vision into a working system over the next year. You'll architect the product, scope and hire the team (FTEs, contractors, vendors), and lead them to:
Deliver a secure, trusted platform that verifies identity at national scale. It must confirm that every participant is a real, unique, and eligible American, and protect what they do on it from end to end.
Make the core actions on the platform both secure and easy to use: signing verified petitions, taking part in online polls, starting local chapters, and taking part in democratic innovations like virtual citizen assemblies and online town halls.
These are the foundational goals, and we're seeking someone excited to champion them and ask, "what's next?" once they are delivered.
What you'll own
Identity verification. Your single most important accountability. Working with specialist vendors, you'll design, spec, integrate, and manage identity verification at national scale, layer it onto proven, end-to-end encrypted technology, and make it feel seamless inside a mobile-first experience. Knowing that every participant is real, unique, and eligible is the foundation everything else stands on.

You set the bar for a design and user experience that makes participating simple and rewarding, and you oversee how the product learns from the data it creates: data architecture, structured evaluations, and the product changes that follow. You build privacy and data governance in from day one, with clear rules about what is collected, where it lives, and what can be shared.
An AI-forward team. You design platform operations around frontier tools and hire people who use them by default, so a small in-house team plus contractors can carry a national-scale build.

Too many electoral choices are settled before most voters have a meaningful say, and our political system consistently fails to address the nation’s biggest challenges. We are a stealth team building an ambitious cross-partisan political venture to make American democracy more open, competitive, and responsive. We will build the infrastructure to effectively challenge the two-party political establishment, and create fundamentally new pathways to elected office and engaged citizen participation.

Our first major initiative will launch publicly in spring 2027 with the objective of materially influencing the 2028 national election cycle. This project will combine the scale of a mainstream consumer technology product, the reach of a modern media operation, and the ground game of a national political campaign – complete with digital and IRL field organizing across dozens of states – to engage tens of millions of Americans and build a constituency that outlasts this election cycle.

Our leadership team has raised and deployed over $100M toward democracy reform, winning dozens of state and local reform campaigns. Backed by seed funding from prominent investors and a cross-partisan board of civic leaders and company-builders, we are now assembling a multidisciplinary operating team of technologists, storytellers, politicos, and operators to build it from the ground up.

jobs.title: Vice President - Product [Remote-US]
jobs.text:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.
About Us
Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.
Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com
Our Team
Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.
As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.
The Role
We’re looking for a strategic and customer-obsessed product leader to shape the future of insurance through AI-native, data-driven solutions. As the leader of our product portfolio, you’ll define vision, strategy, and operating models that deliver measurable impact for our clients, including State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company. This is a highly influential leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, data, operations, and business strategy. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, modernize how products are built and scaled, and help drive innovation in a highly regulated industry.
Your Day-to-Day
Define and lead the product vision, portfolio strategy, and roadmap across the organization
Partner with executive leaders and clients to align product investments with business priorities and customer outcomes
Drive product lifecycle excellence from discovery and prioritization through launch and continuous improvement
Build and evolve product operating models, governance practices, and portfolio decision frameworks
Use customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to identify opportunities for innovation and growth
Collaborate closely with Technology, Data, Operations, Underwriting, and Actuarial teams to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product organization grounded in accountability, clarity, and collaboration
Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and product performance to senior stakeholders across the business
About You
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Insurance, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
12–15 years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, insurance products, or related leadership roles
Deep insurance industry expertise, ideally within P&C, insurtech, or data-enabled insurance products
Proven success leading product vision, portfolio strategy, prioritization, and cross-functional execution at scale
Strong understanding of modern technology platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and product development tradeoffs
Experience influencing executive stakeholders and connecting product strategy to enterprise business goals
Exceptional communication, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex, matrixed environments
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams while fostering healthy collaboration and accountability
Passion for building customer-centered, AI-native experiences that modernize the insurance industry
Bonus Points
Experience in insurtech, fintech, or another highly regulated, technology-enabled industry
Background leading organizational transformation, modernization, or product operating model evolution
Experience building or scaling direct-to-consumer digital products
Advanced degree or certifications in business, product, technology, strategy, or insurance
Experience launching AI-native products, capabilities, or transformation initiatives
Salary: $550,000 – $650,000*
*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization.
Additional Details:
Benefits: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match.
Work from Home Equipment: Given our virtual environment— in order to set you up for success at home, a one-time payment of $2K will be provided to cover the purchase of in-home office equipment and furniture at your discretion. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.
Paid Time Off: All employees accrue four weeks of PTO in their first year of employment. New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.
Personal and Professional Development: We’re committed to investing in and helping our people grow personally and professionally. All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp.
Location: We are a remote-first company for most positions so you may work from anywhere you like in the U.S, excluding U.S. territories. For most positions, occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee. Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired.
Hours: We maintain core meeting hours from 9AM - 2PM Pacific time for collaborating with team members across all time zones.
Quanata, LLC is an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
If you are a San Francisco resident, please read the City and County of San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance notice.
This role is employed by Quanata, LLC which is a separate company in the State Farm family of companies.
If you require a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner for assistance.

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform
jobs.text:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.
Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!
We're seeking a Director of Data Platform to provide technical and architectural leadership within the data engineering organization. In this role, you'll champion to build out modern data platform cross the data space that is critical to enable business growth with AI at scale at Credit Acceptance. As a director, you'll be responsible for leading the technical vision, strategy, architecture, and execution of modern data platform, collaborating both within the data team and outside to ensure successful deliveries in production, representing the data team in various technical forums across engineering to contribute the success at the ecosystem level. The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of engineering experience with significant depth in data technology, cloud, and AI. You'll serve as both a hands-on technical leader and a strategic advisor, helping to establish robust, scalable foundations that enable innovation across the organization.
Outcomes and Activities:
This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member.
Develop and drive the long-term vision for enterprise data platforms and architecture, ensuring alignment with business growth and AI success
Formulate and implement data platform strategy across the data space including but not limited to big data, real time, transaction/operational, governance, that transform the way how we work with data in the era of AI
Oversee the architecture, design and development of scalable data platform that enable self-serve success with various use cases across the company by taking a platform and AI first approach
Ensure solid production success that meets business need and speed, establish strong finops discipline with timely and insightful info to continuously optimize our economics including forecast, runtime and “showback” to the business
Effectively communicate data technologies, strategies, roadmap and progress to executive leadership and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with the firm’s broader vision and goals.
Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, translating them into actionable initiatives to drive innovation and maintain the firm’s market leadership.
Build strong engineering organization and foster solid engineering discipline by leading with examples and mentoring team members
Collaborate both with the data team and cross engineering on technology and architecture strategy and decision
Exemplify technical innovation and contribute to critical system design, implementation and operation success
Formulate technology and architecture decision framework that embeds engineering discipline
Become an expert in the business process domain to better support the business and align technologies with the business outcomes
Work with the engineering leadership team to develop and execute on the company’s technical and business strategy
Conduct impact analysis to proactively identify impact of a change across multiple applications/systems
Perform technical due diligence and architectural assessments of third-party technologies and solutions.
Experiment and test ideas, validate assumptions against needs, reach conclusions and recommend solutions
Document standards, best practices, and engineering artifacts so others can easily understand, build and maintain best in class software systems
Debug the critical problems which arise in production and execute effective solutions within the application and across multiple applications/systems
Lead continuous learning and process improvement activities to improve design and overall engineering practices
Grow talent by participating in hiring and mentoring team members
Competencies: The following items detail how you will be successful in this role.
Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related field of study; or equivalent work experience
Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience or comparable depth of experience
Experience in the leadership role overseeing technical direction of data platform, technology and architecture
Expert knowledge of software engineering best practices with experience building modern data platform, product and solutions, especially in enabling AI success
Expert understanding and use of modern data technology end 2 end including but not limited to source system, data integration, data acquisition, data ingestion, data transformation, data aggregation, data governance, business intelligence, data warehouse, data lake, NoSQL, object storage, streaming etc.
Extensive experience with building and driving adoption of software engineering best practices
Strong understanding of AI, distributed systems, cloud computing, and microservices architectures
Demonstrated success in building strong engineering organization and attract/recruit/grow/retain talents
Demonstrated success in building mission-critical enterprise class data platform that delivers business impact
Demonstrated ability to work with business partners, cross functional team members and coach and mentor experienced team members
In-depth experience with building big data real time production system that delivers business success
Experienced in communicating and articulating technology subjects in the context of business and providing timely and clear communication
Well versed in delivery mechanisms such as Agile
Preferred:
Financial services or FinTech industry experience
Knowledge and Skills:
Architecture and Design: Ability to implement world class solutions that meet the needs of the business and customer, and help deliver growth and innovation.
Leadership: Be a thought leader and demonstrate leadership to mentor team members, influence change and drive for the business outcome
Ability to challenge the status quo and influence stakeholders to create innovative solutions
Be collaborative with other team members, seeking a diversity of thought to meet business outcomes
Ability to foster strong relationships across the organization
Bring a strong understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, provide input and coach team members and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
Strong experience and understanding of how to connect the work being done and how it drives business value
Ability to communicate complex technical information (both verbal and written) to all levels, including senior leadership
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $208,761 – $347,935. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity, between 20-60%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications.
Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego.

Benefits
Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work
Our Company Values:
To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be:
Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions
Respectful by collaborating and actively listening
Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions
Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage
Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting
To create an environment where people do their best work, we focus on the dimensions of Organizational Health. All leaders must:
Identify the Right People by recognizing top talent
Set Clear Expectations by managing change and directing others
Train team members and focus on developing talent
Performance Manage by ensuring accountability and driving results
Create the Right Environment by establishing trust and managing conflict
Maintain the Right Number of team members needed to build an effective team
Expectations:
Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines
All other duties as assigned
Attendance as required by department
Advice!
We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application!
P.S.
We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk!
Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent.
Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing a safe and inclusive working environment for all. As part of our Culture of Compliance, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value our culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of the person’s age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or any other legally protected characteristic.
California Residents: Please click here for the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) notice regarding the personal information Credit Acceptance may collect from you.

Collaborate both with the data team and cross engineering on technology and architecture strategy and decision
Exemplify technical innovation and contribute to critical system design, implementation and operation success
Formulate technology and architecture decision framework that embeds engineering discipline
Become an expert in the business process domain to better support the business and align technologies with the business outcomes
Work with the engineering leadership team to develop and execute on the company’s technical and business strategy

Experiment and test ideas, validate assumptions against needs, reach conclusions and recommend solutions
Document standards, best practices, and engineering artifacts so others can easily understand, build and maintain best in class software systems
Debug the critical problems which arise in production and execute effective solutions within the application and across multiple applications/systems
Lead continuous learning and process improvement activities to improve design and overall engineering practices
Grow talent by participating in hiring and mentoring team members

items: Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.

jobs.text:
Are you a technology leader who is not only passionate about AI but is also excited to be at the forefront of solving one of the most challenging problems that have plagued IT for years and could result in organizations becoming highly challenged or possibly extinct as digital transformation sweeps every sector?
Are you looking for a role with the opportunity to:
Execute core research in AI knowledge management that leads to patentable technologies?
Take an idea from research to a commercially successful cloud-based enterprise software product?
Build a solution that will have a meaningful impact on one-third of the US economy - both for-profit and not-for-profit organizations?
Are you seeking the potential to:
Be the first to bring a unique combination of AI and data management to the market?
Work with experienced, successful Silicon Valley entrepreneurs with 4X startup experience leading to IPO and acquisition exits?
Be mentored by a team of research advisors known in the industry as thought leaders?
Participate in a Silicon Valley-style equity opportunity within a venture with the potential for significant value creation?
Work with a company built around a remote model before COVID-19 made it a requirement?
Give back to your community through a 1-1-1 philanthropic model as pioneered by Marc Benioff’s Salesforce?
The Essentials:
Master or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Operation Research or other equivalent quantitative fields
Experience in AI with a demonstrated understanding of expert systems, knowledge management, and digital assistants
Experience managing a team of data scientists and AI researchers and engineers using Agile methodologies and tools
Previous startup experience with a proven track record of leading teams that drive innovation and deliver products in a fast-paced, high-energy environment
Excited to work with new technologies and approaches
Experience working within an SBIR NSF (Small Business Innovation Research - National Science Foundation) Program grant award model
Responsibilities:
Get to know our customer (or know them already) and use that empathy to inform shaping the product’s vision and requirements and building an exceptional product
Serve as a thought leader and technology strategy driver along with the CEO and Co-Founders to make decisions on the product technology architecture including building block components - with a preference for open source technologies
Build, build, build - especially in the early days, you will be rolling up your sleeves and writing code, from core platform to fixing bugs
Help form a top-performing team of talented and responsible software engineers, data scientists and product designers, and provide them the freedom to be creative and innovative
Lead product engineering including research and development of unique proprietary and patentable intellectual property that yields competitive advantages
Embody the company’s culture and mission by fostering a culture that is passionate about building awesome products that deliver measurable value and a customer experience that delights
Evangelize the company’s technology vision, roadmap and capabilities with customers, investors, employees, and other stakeholders
Stay current on technology advances in the field of AI - especially digital assistants, knowledge engineering, data-driven reasoning, expert systems - and in the field of data management - including column databases and other advanced decision analytics technologies
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The benefits of using C-Plan.IT increase as the platform’s membership grows toward the bold goal of becoming the world’s largest IT investment platform with $100B annual IT investments under management across 2000 organizations in the next 10 years.
Privately funded, we are a fully remote company with a 100% distributed team allowing us to hire the best people regardless of where they are located.

jobs.title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Nira Energy
Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.
We are profitable!
Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.
We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.
About The Company
Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change
The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner
We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country
We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets
We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company
This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market
About The Role
This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.
The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.
The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.
Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.
The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e <50 people and $10M in revenue, and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led in that capacity. You’ve also ideally held a prominent role at at a company that has scaled, i.e. 50-250 people and >$50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.
What you'll own
Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals
Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention
People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.
Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale
What we're looking for
A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat
A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value and can speak competently to results; i.e. Built a product from $0 to >$10M in revenue, Improve retention of a product by 30%, scaled a product from $10M to $50M etc
You are willing to be hands on and get in the weeds. This is a ~17 person org and a 30 person company. While you are ultimately in charge of managing the team we expect you to be a hands on operator and willing to roll your sleeves up
Ability and interest in learning a highly niche, complex domain fast. Transmisison planning is incredibly intricate and becoming fluent in the language of “transmission” is critical to success in the role
Low ego and mission driven. Your energized by the mission of the company and by building a team, motivating them, and partnering with world class founders
Excellent communication and people leadership skills
Ideal backgrounds
VP Product / CPO at a technical B2B SaaS company.
GM of a complex technical product line.
A product leader who has run a team or product function end to end.
A former technical or product founder who scaled into executive leadership.
Bonus points for experience in energy, grid infrastructure, climate, utilities, transmission, interconnection, or power markets, but not required

jobs.title: Director, MHE Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role:
As the Director, MHE Systems Engineering, you’ll lead the strategy, design standards, and operational growth of the team responsible for designing material handling automation systems. Moving beyond individual solution ownership, this role establishes design methodology, engineering standards, solution development tools, and department-wide metrics to drive innovative material handling solutions across complex warehouse and distribution environments. You will participate in resource planning in collaboration with Sales and Consulting Services leadership. You will directly oversee resource execution, lead departmental capacity allocation, drive process improvements to increase design and budget development efficiency, and serve as the final authority on engineering quality control, ensuring scalable, delivering ‘value driven’ automated solutions to our customers.
You will lead team development across the entire project lifecycle, from concept through implementation, and serve as a key technical advocate at the executive level for both clients and solution partners. This executive role balances deep technical mastery in material handling automation (conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, and storage) with strategic business acumen to ensure high performance, safety, and financial accountability.
In this role, you will:
Govern Departmental Standards: Champion consistent engineering methods, design principles, and value-engineering practices across the entire team to maximize equipment utility and ensure predictable output.
Lead System Alternatives & Recommendations: Oversee the structural evaluation of automated material handling solutions for Tier 1 systems, evaluating pros/cons to deliver optimized, defensible final proposals to the executive board and customers.
Drive Process & Tool Optimization: Lead the development and refinement of departmental engineering tools to increase design efficiency and Customer acceptance ratee. Maintain oversight of the group's budget workbook models to ensure pre-contract cost projections land within 20% of Final Estimation.
Manage Quality Assurance Frameworks: Mandate and direct structural inter-department peer design reviews, comparing complex layouts to ensure robust quality control prior to estimating and client presentation.
Scale Technical Sales & Proposals: Provide executive-level technical oversight to the Sales and Pre-Contract groups, transforming concept solution alternatives into viable, integrated multi-million-dollar solution engineering projects.
Mentor and Build Capability: Directly structure and guide career growth matrices for systems engineers, instilling strict value-engineering design disciplines and polishing high-impact client presentation and solution advocacy capabilities.
Direct Continuous Improvement: Drive long-term systems engineering process updates, tool adoption, and cross-functional operational workflows in partnership with Solutions and Growth leadership.
Build Intercompany Business Relationships: Partner closely with peers across Operations, Engineering, Controls, and Supply Chain to break down operational silos, align on company-wide objectives, and foster deep departmental collaboration.
We’re Excited About You Because:
Extensive Industry Expertise: You bring 10+ years of proven material handling system design leadership experience covering extensive, large-scale midlevel to highly automated solutions.
Educational Background: You possess a bachelor’s degree, with a strong preference for discipline in Engineering.
Advanced Technical Tooling: You maintain 7+ years of hand-on expertise operating Autodesk/AutoCAD alongside advanced 3D modeling and simulation packages.
Strategic Financial Acumen: You have experience directing system pricing models, resource rate plans, and accurateprecontract project lifecycle estimation.
Precontract Systems Lifecycle Experienced: You have successfully managedsystems development from early opportunity scoping through conceptual engineering designs, budgeting, and Customer presentations.
High-Impact Communication: You possess exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to present, validate, and defend core technical systems to prospective customer decisionmakers.
Resilient Leadership: You thrive in urgent, fast-moving environments and excel at managing cross-functional technical teams under tight milestone constraints.
About Us:
Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982 and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.
And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.
More reasons to join our team:
We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment
We offer competitive salaries and health benefits
Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%
Participation in our Discretionary Profit-Sharing Program
We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy
We do community outreach projects throughout the year
We know how to throw company events
We work hard, but we also know how to have fun - darts, anyone?
Individuals seeking employment at Designed Conveyor Systems are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Accommodation is available to applicants with a disability condition, when applying, testing, or interviewing for a position. Please let us know if you need accommodation.

You will lead team development across the entire project lifecycle, from concept through implementation, and serve as a key technical advocate at the executive level for both clients and solution partners. This executive role balances deep technical mastery in material handling automation (conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, and storage) with strategic business acumen to ensure high performance, safety, and financial accountability.
In this role, you will:

items: Govern Departmental Standards: Champion consistent engineering methods, design principles, and value-engineering practices across the entire team to maximize equipment utility and ensure predictable output.

Lead System Alternatives & Recommendations: Oversee the structural evaluation of automated material handling solutions for Tier 1 systems, evaluating pros/cons to deliver optimized, defensible final proposals to the executive board and customers.

Drive Process & Tool Optimization: Lead the development and refinement of departmental engineering tools to increase design efficiency and Customer acceptance ratee. Maintain oversight of the group's budget workbook models to ensure pre-contract cost projections land within 20% of Final Estimation.

Manage Quality Assurance Frameworks: Mandate and direct structural inter-department peer design reviews, comparing complex layouts to ensure robust quality control prior to estimating and client presentation.

Scale Technical Sales & Proposals: Provide executive-level technical oversight to the Sales and Pre-Contract groups, transforming concept solution alternatives into viable, integrated multi-million-dollar solution engineering projects.

Mentor and Build Capability: Directly structure and guide career growth matrices for systems engineers, instilling strict value-engineering design disciplines and polishing high-impact client presentation and solution advocacy capabilities.
Direct Continuous Improvement: Drive long-term systems engineering process updates, tool adoption, and cross-functional operational workflows in partnership with Solutions and Growth leadership.

Build Intercompany Business Relationships: Partner closely with peers across Operations, Engineering, Controls, and Supply Chain to break down operational silos, align on company-wide objectives, and foster deep departmental collaboration.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Shared Service
jobs.text:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.
Taxwell is the parent company of Drake Software (professional tax prep for firms and SMBs) and TaxAct (consumer DIY filing). The brands stay distinct for customers; we invest in shared, AI-native platform products so both scale with consistent quality through tax season and beyond.
The role
We’re looking for a Director of Product Management to lead Taxwell’s shared platform portfolio and digital experiences across B2B and B2C:
Customer Document Platform – Lead a central, AI-powered platform spanning document ingestion, storage, classification, extraction, validation, and telemetry. Enable internal product teams to deliver automated document import and form completion across brands and filing environments.
Website experiences - Lead merchandising and conversion across Drake Software, TaxAct, and 1040.com. For Drake, own the end-to-end customer experience, from discovery and purchase through support, renewal, and retention. For TaxAct and 1040.com, own pre-authentication merchandising and acquisition to increase paid starts and completes.
Customer Success & Communication Platforms - lead shared capabilities for internal tooling, support AI and automation, and customer communications across email, chat, and SMS, connecting customer context to timely, relevant support.
You’ll set the product vision and roadmap, lead a team of PMs, and partner across functions to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes. AI will be central to both the experiences you build and how your teams develop products.
What you’ll do
Set portfolio strategy and priorities
Define the vision and roadmap across document, website, and Customer Success platforms.
Align leaders on investments and tradeoffs, balancing shared capabilities, brand priorities, and seasonal demands.
Scale the Customer Document Platform
Lead the evolution of a shared, AI-powered platform for document ingestion, storage, classification, extraction, validation, and telemetry.
Partner with internal product teams to enable automated document import and form completion across brands and filing environments.
Drive platform adoption and reuse through a roadmap grounded in internal client needs and end-customer impact.
Define success measures for accuracy, speed, reliability, cost, and adoption, partnering with Engineering and Data/AI to improve performance.
Drive website growth and conversion
Own the merchandising and conversion strategy across Drake Software, TaxAct, and 1040.com.
For Drake, lead the end-to-end website experience with a heavy focus on commercialization across product discovery, purchase, onboarding, renewal and retention.
For TaxAct and 1040.com, improve pre-authentication merchandising and acquisition journeys to increase paid starts and contribute to completed returns.
Guide investment in CMS capabilities, analytics, and experimentation to improve customer experiences and help teams deliver content faster.
Advance Customer Success and communications
Set the strategy for agent tooling, support automation, and customer communication platforms across email, chat, and SMS.
Partner with Marketing, Sales and Operations to improve customer satisfaction, resolution rates, agent productivity, and costs.
Turn AI opportunities into customer value
Identify and prioritize AI applications that simplify customer workflows, improve quality, or reduce operating costs.
Use AI across discovery, analysis, prototyping, and delivery to accelerate product development and shorten time to value.
Partner with Engineering, Legal and Business Development on build-versus-buy decisions, reusable capabilities, and responsible handling of sensitive data.
Establish product quality standards, evaluation criteria, and human review requirements. Scale AI experiences based on demonstrated results.
Build and lead a strong product team
Lead, coach, and develop PMs, establishing clear ownership and accountability for customer and business outcomes.
Coach teams on AI tools and workflows to accelerate product development process and drive customer value
Raise the standard for customer discovery, strategic thinking, experimentation, and data-informed decisions.
Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Data, Brand, Marketing, and Operations, with clear responsibilities and timely decisions.
Lead portfolio reviews that assess outcomes, inform Business reviews to delivery and prepare teams for peak tax season.
What you bring
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading PMs or a horizontal/platform domain
Track record owning shared or platform product used by multiple products or business units
Shipped customer-facing AI/ML at scale—especially documents, assistants, or workflow automation—in regulated or high-stakes settings
B2B and B2C experience; comfortable with seasonal demand and exec-level tradeoff conversations
Systems thinking, strong metrics discipline, and clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
Nice to have: tax/fintech familiarity, preparer workflows, contact-center or agent-assist products, multi-brand portfolio experience.
Why Taxwell
Platform choices here affect millions of returns and thousands of preparers. Document intelligence and AI-assisted filing are core strategy, not experiments. You’ll shape how two strong brands compete together over the next several tax seasons.
At Taxwell, we believe our work benefits from the diverse perspectives of our employees. As such, Taxwell welcomes and celebrates diversity and inclusion and is committed to equal opportunity employment. At Taxwell, you can expect a supportive, open, and inclusive atmosphere and a team that values your contributions.
Taxwell is committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and any other status protected under applicable law. Taxwell considers information gathered in the hiring process, including information on this application, confidential, and only shares it on a need-to-know basis or as required by law.
If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at or by calling 828-349-5887 to speak with a member of the HR Talent Acquisition team.
