jobs.title: Data & AI Associate Director
jobs.text:
Ciklum is looking for a Data & AI Associate Director to join our team full-time in the US.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
About the role:
As a Data & AI Associate Director, become a part of our strong and professional team. You must be talented, experienced, and eager to drive rapid growth of the Data & AI Service Line across the US market. This role will execute and scale the service line within North America, driving local strategy and execution with high autonomy and accountability.
In this key leadership role, you will report directly to the Data & AI Global Head of Service Line, collaborating closely with global and local stakeholders to drive how Ciklum offerings produce better business outcomes for our US clients, win work, and grow Ciklum in the region. You will work in lockstep with global leaders across Data Engineering, Data Science, and IoT to build and maintain a consistent, scalable, and world-class Data & AI service line.
Responsibilities:
US market growth and GTM partnership. Work with US sales and industry leaders on account plans, target sectors, partnerships and market priorities. Find and qualify new opportunities, including those that start before a formal RFP
Executive advisory and opportunity creation. Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs and business sponsors. Lead conversations that clarify the business problem, challenge assumptions and turn Data & AI ambitions into a clear investment case
Pre-sales and solution leadership. Own the technical side of selected pursuits: discovery workshops, solution options, architecture, delivery approach, team shape, estimates, risks, proposals, statements of work and executive pitches. Partner with sales teams through contract award
Direct delivery of client engagements. Lead selected paid engagements as a principal consultant or solution lead. Examples include data estate assessments, platform strategy and selection, modernisation roadmaps, data readiness for AI, architecture reviews and focused discovery programmes. Take responsibility for the quality and value of your own client work
Strategic client leadership. Help strategic US accounts turn initial engagements into wider programmes. Maintain strong client relationships, manage senior stakeholder expectations, and work with delivery leaders to resolve critical issues and protect client outcomes
Propositions and thought leadership. Shape market-relevant offers, workshops, demos, accelerators and case studies. Speak at client and industry events, contribute new ideas, and track platform and AI changes that matter to clients
Global delivery and capability development. Work closely with India and other global delivery centres to design realistic solutions, support smooth handovers and build the right skills. Mentor consultants and architects, help develop local talent, and foster an inclusive, collaborative practice
Requirements:
Strong consulting and commercial track record. Substantial experience advising US enterprise clients, shaping complex Data & AI work and contributing to new client wins. Able to create opportunities, not only respond to requests
Hands-on delivery background. Prior experience designing or delivering complex data engineering, analytics or platform programmes. Credibility to defend architecture choices, scope and delivery plans with senior technical stakeholders
Modern data platform expertise. Strong knowledge of cloud data architectures and practical depth in at least one leading platform, such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Google BigQuery or ClickHouse. Broad awareness of the others is valuable; expertise in every platform is not required
Breadth across Data & AI. Ability to advise on data strategy, platform modernisation, integration, analytics and BI, governance, and enterprise data readiness for AI. Clear understanding of business value, cost, security and operational trade-offs
Client engagement skills. Confidence in leading executive workshops, presenting a point of view, writing clear proposals, estimating delivery, and explaining technical choices in business terms
Ability to deliver consulting work personally. A track record of leading client-paid assessments, advisory assignments or architecture work, with high-quality outputs and clear recommendations
Leadership across global teams. Experience working with sales, product, architecture and distributed engineering teams. Able to influence senior stakeholders, mentor talent and work effectively across time zones
Commercial impact. A clear contribution to qualified US pipeline, new client wins and the expansion of strategic accounts
Client value. A consistent record of personally delivered advisory and solution work that clients value and are willing to invest in
Scalable growth. Stronger market propositions, repeatable solution assets, effective GTM
collaboration and high-quality delivery handovers
What’s in it for you?
Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
Care: Healthcare, Basic Life Insurance, Short and Long-term disability insurance according to the Company’s Benefit Plans
About us:
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. In the US, Ciklum is growing fast—inviting experienced professionals to lead digital transformation alongside Fortune 500 clients. Be part of a company where innovation and impact go hand in hand.
Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.
You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.
Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.
About the Job
This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.
You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.
You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.
For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.
Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.
What We're Looking For
Required Experience & Qualifications
10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
SQL, plus Python or R.
Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Nice to Have
Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
Experience in a B2C subscription business.
Core Expectations
You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.
Life360 Values
Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Diversity
We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.
We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About Dune
Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.
We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones 🌍️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.
We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.
If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.
Learn more about us:
About Dune
https://dune.com/about
Values and working at Dune
https://dune.com/careers
About the role
Dune’s mission is to make onchain finance observable. Since 2018, we have made blockchain data accessible and useful. Our next opportunity is to build products that financial institutions depend on to commit capital, assess risk, and enter new onchain markets.
As these institutions expand their activity on blockchains, they will need reliable, trustworthy and timely data to power decision making across more markets than ever before. They will need to compare opportunities, monitor changes, and integrate data into their existing systems. For Dune these recurring needs will become a substantial and core part of our business.
We are looking for a Head of Product to help transition Dune into this new era. We will build on top of Dune’s existing data foundation, which already powers thousands of companies. You will decide which customers and use cases to serve first, which problems matter most, and which needs can become scalable products for institutional usage.
You will identify valuable customer problems and guide the company to deliver a reliable product and grow its usage.
What we are looking for
You care about markets and have a background in either traditional or onchain markets. You navigate fluently financial jargon and know how market participants use and leverage data.
You can set a clear direction, make difficult choices, and work hard through the details required to deliver. The job’s not finished with a PRD, a hire or a ticket. The job’s finished when the product is creating value in the hands of our customers, being recursively improved by tight knit relationships.
You will work closely with Dune’s engineering, data, and commercial teams while being an integral part of the leadership team. You will report to the president. Your responsibility extends from understanding a customer’s problem to delivering a product that solves it, while navigating the requirements from a large customer base.
You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s data requirements and deciding what the team must deliver this week.
In this role you will
Define the product strategy for market data and institutional customers. Decide which customers, problems, and products deserve our attention.
Own the product experience from data creation to delivery. Set clear requirements for coverage, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
Understand how financial institutions consume data. Turn their research, investment, trading, and operational needs into clear product priorities.
Work with engineering and data teams to deliver reliable datasets, data feeds, and integrations that fit customer systems.
Make explicit decisions about scope, quality, and delivery dates. Resolve dependencies and keep important work moving.
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales and other teams on customer evaluations, pricing, and adoption. Convert repeated customer needs into products we can serve at scale.
Define how we measure success of our products. Use the results to decide what to improve or stop.
Define and improve on our operational practices.
Leverage AI to improve our customer research, operations and feedback loops.
Lead and develop a product team that takes responsibility for customer results.
Say no and prioritize.
You might be a great fit if
You're excited to spend real time with customers: on calls, in their offices, learning from them.
You have delivered technically complex data products that customers (ideally institutional) depend on.
You understand market data and how financial institutions evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use it.
You have good knowledge of onchain markets, tokenized equities and RWAs
You can connect customer needs with technical requirements and a sound business case.
You have strong product judgment. You can make decisions with incomplete information and change them when the evidence changes.
You stay close to the work. You investigate problems, challenge assumptions, and help teams resolve difficult details.
You are known to be an excellent communicator.
You have startup experience, ideally a former founder or operator.
Perks & Benefits
A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖
A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺
We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).
On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.
An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
#LI-Remote

You will work closely with Dune’s engineering, data, and commercial teams while being an integral part of the leadership team. You will report to the president. Your responsibility extends from understanding a customer’s problem to delivering a product that solves it, while navigating the requirements from a large customer base.
You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s data requirements and deciding what the team must deliver this week.
In this role you will
Define the product strategy for market data and institutional customers. Decide which customers, problems, and products deserve our attention.
Own the product experience from data creation to delivery. Set clear requirements for coverage, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
Understand how financial institutions consume data. Turn their research, investment, trading, and operational needs into clear product priorities.
Work with engineering and data teams to deliver reliable datasets, data feeds, and integrations that fit customer systems.
Make explicit decisions about scope, quality, and delivery dates. Resolve dependencies and keep important work moving.
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales and other teams on customer evaluations, pricing, and adoption. Convert repeated customer needs into products we can serve at scale.
Define how we measure success of our products. Use the results to decide what to improve or stop.
Define and improve on our operational practices.
Leverage AI to improve our customer research, operations and feedback loops.
Lead and develop a product team that takes responsibility for customer results.
Say no and prioritize.
You might be a great fit if
You're excited to spend real time with customers: on calls, in their offices, learning from them.
You have delivered technically complex data products that customers (ideally institutional) depend on.
You understand market data and how financial institutions evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use it.
You have good knowledge of onchain markets, tokenized equities and RWAs
You can connect customer needs with technical requirements and a sound business case.
You have strong product judgment. You can make decisions with incomplete information and change them when the evidence changes.
You stay close to the work. You investigate problems, challenge assumptions, and help teams resolve difficult details.
You are known to be an excellent communicator.
You have startup experience, ideally a former founder or operator.
Perks & Benefits
A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖
A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).
On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.
An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Director of Data Architecture
jobs.text:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.
Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.
For more information, visit .
The Opportunity
The Director, Data Architecture owns the strategy, standards, and team behind how data moves through Supplier.io, from source systems and web-scraping pipelines through ingestion, transformation, and governed delivery into the warehouses and marts the rest of the business relies on. You'll operate as a peer to our other engineering leaders, setting data architecture direction jointly with the CTO, while staying accountable for the reliability, quality, and governance of every data workflow we run.
You'll lead two distinct groups: a Data Engineering team building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and a Data Operations Engineering team running and maintaining the processes already in production. In the near term, before the team and its processes are fully built out, this role is hands-on: you'll be designing pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly, not just directing from a distance.
What You Will Do
Data Architecture & Platform Strategy
Own the multi-year data architecture strategy across our data warehouses and operational data stores, including evolving toward a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) lakehouse model.
Design and own our data lake and warehouse architecture, including the formation and population of data marts that serve analytics, product, and stakeholder reporting needs.
Set the orchestration strategy and standards for all data workflows, including source ingestion, web-scraping pipelines, ETL/ELT, and automated workflow management, and standardize the tooling used across the function.
Own the infrastructure and administration behind our data warehouses and pipelines, including capacity, reliability, and cost.
Own data governance end to end: the policies, standards, and practices for data quality, lineage, access, retention, and classification across every system of record.
Team & Execution Leadership
Build, lead, and grow two functions: Data Engineering, building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and Data Operations Engineering, running and maintaining existing production data processes.
Decide how the function is organized as it scales, including when and whether to add management layers beneath you to run day-to-day execution.
Stay hands-on early: design and review pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly until the team is built out to carry that execution independently, and stay close enough to the technology afterward to make credible architecture calls.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with engineering leadership to keep data architecture decisions aligned with company-wide standards.
Work closely with data engineering teams on technical planning and delivery for our core data products.
Partner with product, analytics, and other business stakeholders across the company to understand data needs and translate them into warehouse and data mart designs.
Data Quality & Compliance
Define and enforce data quality gates, lineage tracking, and auditability standards across all data pipelines.
Own data access controls, classification, and retention policy across the data estate.
Ensure compliance-relevant and audit-sensitive data is handled according to governance standards as our data sources and customer base grow.
What You Will Need to Succeed
10+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, including 5+ years in a Director or Manager-level leadership role owning architecture strategy and a team, not just individual delivery.
Deep, hands-on experience designing and operating cloud data warehouse or lakehouse architectures (Snowflake and/or BigQuery), including medallion (bronze, silver, gold) patterns.
Experience integrating a range of source systems (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and building ingestion and ETL pipelines from varied and unstructured sources, including web-scraping pipelines and background job orchestration.
A track record of building and scaling a data engineering or data platform organization, including deciding when and how to split engineering and operations functions.
Strong data governance background: establishing policies and standards for data quality, lineage, access, and retention in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment.
Experience setting technical direction jointly with peer engineering leaders and influencing architecture decisions across teams.
Excellent communication skills, comfortable setting strategy with peer leaders and reporting data platform health, cost, and risk directly to the CTO.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience consolidating or re-architecting data platforms following an acquisition or significant data source expansion.
Experience with orchestration tooling such as Airflow or dbt, and with scraping or crawling infrastructure at scale.
Background establishing data marts and self-service analytics layers for non-engineering stakeholders.
Familiarity with data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Soda, or similar).
We do no accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment/search firms.
AI Use Policy: The use of artificial intelligence tools during your interview is strictly prohibited. This includes, but is not limited to, AI chatbots, real-time answer generators, transcription-based assistants, and any other software that generates or suggests responses.Any detected use of AI during the interview will result in immediate disqualification and removal from consideration for this position.

Supplier.io is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
Supplier.io is unable to sponsor work visas (e.g., H-1B, TN, OPT, etc.) for US positions. Candidates must meet in-country work authorization requirements.
If you require reasonable accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact the Human Resources department at or 978-843-5747.

jobs.text:
Head Of Product
Full-time | Toronto, Ontario (hybrid) or remote within Canada
Toronto-based candidates should plan to work from our downtown office a minimum of four days per week. For the right talent, we are open to considering candidates for a remote arrangement within Canada.
About Big Viking Games
Big Viking Games exists to make fans.
We are a profitable, independent Canadian gaming company focused on building, operating, and growing long-standing online game communities. Our flagship titles, YoWorld and FishWorld, have entertained millions of players over their lifetime. These are enduring live-service virtual worlds with rich in-game economies, virtual goods, deep social interaction, and player communities measured in years, not sessions.
We are now rebuilding the company as an AI-first studio. That is not a slogan here. It is an operating standard.
About the Role
As Head of Product, you will report to the Founder and CEO and own product strategy, roadmap, and growth across the BVG portfolio. Your first priority is to expand distribution and grow the player base across platforms. You will lead the product team across growth, monetization, retention, community and VIP, and game design.
You will make clear choices about where to invest, how to measure results, and what to prioritize across the portfolio. You will also use AI directly in your own work and lead the team in applying it to product discovery, experimentation, and day-to-day operations.

jobs.title: Director of Technical Program Management - Engineering
jobs.text:
About Mistral
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced Director of Technical Program Management to lead and scale our TPM function across Engineering.
You will build and develop a high-performing team of Technical Program Managers, shape the function's strategy and operating model, and drive the execution of complex technical programs.
Working closely with senior leadership, you will play a key role in how Mistral delivers across critical areas such as:
Functional/Technical Programs — Drive complex engineering initiatives, roadmap alignment and cross-team delivery.
Engineering Operations — Improve engineering efficiency through automation, tooling and scalable processes.
Customer Programs — Coordinate strategic enterprise deployments across Product, Engineering and Solutions.
Release & Portfolio Management — Orchestrate model and product releases, ensuring seamless cross-functional execution.
Location & Office Policy
The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.
What You Will Do
People Leadership — Lead, grow and develop the TPM organization through hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.
Organizational Strategy — Define the vision and operating model of the TPM function, scaling it in line with Mistral's growth and strategic priorities.
Program & Portfolio Management — Oversee complex technical programs, ensuring effective prioritization, resource allocation, dependency management and delivery.
Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Science, Infrastructure and Solutions to align priorities, facilitate decisions and resolve blockers.
Operational Excellence — Establish scalable program management practices, tools and processes that improve engineering execution while preserving team autonomy and speed.
What We're Looking For
• You have extensive experience managing complex technical programs within engineering or technology organizations.
• You have proven experience directly managing, developing and scaling teams of Technical Program Managers.
• You have experience building organizational strategy and establishing scalable program management practices.
• You have a strong understanding of software architecture, development lifecycles and deployment processes.
• You have excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and executive stakeholders.
• You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution.
Ideally, you have:
• Experience as a Software Engineer or in another hands-on technical role.
• Experience building or scaling a TPM function within a high-growth technology company.
• Experience managing teams across multiple technical domains or organizational units.
• Exposure to AI/ML, cloud infrastructure or complex distributed systems.
What We Offer
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
Privacy Policy
Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.text:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

jobs.title: Senior Director, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
Every ride on Lyft runs on infrastructure. Every match between a rider and a driver, every price, every payment, every map and every arrival estimate depends on platforms that have to be fast, reliable and efficient at a global scale. This role leads the organization that builds and runs those platforms.
Why this role matters
This is one of the most impactful engineering leadership roles at Lyft. You will be accountable for one of Lyft's largest operating investments: the cost of hosting, running and scaling the entire company on a public cloud, including our growing AI infrastructure spend. This role spans the full infrastructure stack, carries one of Lyft’s largest operating budgets, and directly determines how well Lyft’s product works and what it costs to run.
Reporting to Lyft’s Chief Technology Officer, you will lead an organization of approximately 200 engineers, engineering managers and senior technical leaders to efficiently execute on the right goals to drive impact while maintaining a sense of community.
Responsibilities:
You will lead the organization that builds and runs the platforms every Lyft engineer depends on. You’ll guide a team of engineering managers and senior technical leaders, and you’ll be accountable for the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of the systems that keep riders and drivers moving.
What you’ll own
Core hosting infrastructure. The hosting and compute foundation Lyft runs on in the public cloud, including our Kubernetes clusters and container platform, networking, storage, and the core services every product team depends on.
Data infrastructure. The databases, data stores and foundational data services that keep rider, driver and marketplace data available, durable and fast.
Developer platform and experience. The internal platforms, tools, libraries, software development kits (SDKs), and build and release systems that determine how quickly and safely every Lyft engineer can ship.
Mobile and client infrastructure. The shared build, release, testing and client platforms behind Lyft’s Android, iOS and web applications.
AI and machine learning infrastructure. The compute, serving and platform capabilities that let Lyft’s teams train, deploy and run machine learning and AI workloads, including the capacity, reliability and cost discipline that AI product development requires.
Observability and reliability. Stats, logging, metrics and tracing across Lyft. You’ll also define and champion engineering-wide standards for reliability and operational excellence, and build the mechanisms that make them stick: service level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, incident review and production readiness.
Infrastructure economics. A significant operating budget across hosting, cloud and AI spend, including capacity planning, efficiency, unit economics, and the tradeoffs between cost, reliability and speed. You’ll drive sustained efficiency without compromising reliability, and make the cost of scale visible and understandable to the teams that create it, in close partnership with Finance and executive leadership.
How you’ll lead
Set strategy and plan. Turn company priorities into a multi-year infrastructure strategy and roadmap, and own org-level planning, including headcount and budget, to put resources against the highest-leverage problems.
Drive major platform evolutions. Lead cross-functional initiatives and platform changes, and make sure architectural decisions scale with Lyft’s growth.
Balancing speed and safety with continuous improvement. Shape a culture where Lyft ships quickly without compromising production stability. Make the hard calls when the two are in tension, and instill continuous improvement in architecture, process and operational practices across your teams and beyond.
Represent infrastructure to executive leadership. Communicate risks, tradeoffs and investment needs in business terms.
Build and develop the organization. Hire, grow and retain strong engineering managers and senior technical leaders, building a deep bench and an inclusive, accountable organization with clear ownership and a high bar for performance
Experience:
15+ years of progressive experience, including at least 5 years leading teams.
Strong technical background. You contribute to planning and design discussions and earn the respect of senior engineers on consequential architecture decisions.
Large-scale public cloud infrastructure. You’ve led infrastructure for a product that couldn’t afford to be down, including Kubernetes and container platforms, distributed systems, networking and storage.
Deep experience in several of the following: data infrastructure (databases, data stores, foundational data services); developer platforms and experience; mobile and client infrastructure for Android, iOS and web; and/or infrastructure for machine learning and AI workloads.
Understanding of Infrastructure economics at scale. You’ve owned a large cloud, hosting or infrastructure budget, delivered efficiency and cost outcomes without sacrificing reliability, and can speak fluently in business terms to the tradeoffs.
Leadership at scale. You’ve led managers of managers and senior technical leaders in a large organization at comparable scale, and guided teams through planning, prioritization, execution and major platform migrations.
How you work. You focus on impact, execution and internal/external customers. You build teams and products that scale, collaborate well, instill a strong sense of ownership, and plan ahead.
Benefits:
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
401(k) plan to help save for your future
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Subsidized commuter benefits
Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program
Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid
The expected base pay range for this position in San Francisco is $246,560- $308,200. In addition to the base pay, this role is eligible for competitive equity awards, bonuses, and benefits. You can read more about Lyft’s employee benefits here.
Total compensation is dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.
Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. As the Director, Data Science for Lyft EU, you will work in a dynamic environment, where we embrace moving quickly to build the world’s best transportation. Data Scientists take on a variety of problems, ranging from shaping critical business decisions to building algorithms that power our business insights.
We’re looking for a passionate, driven Director, Data Science with strong experience in two-sided marketplaces and production machine learning to take on some of the most interesting and impactful problems and lead some of the best scientists in the industry.
This role will be overseeing the Product Science teams, which drive experimentation, metrics, and product insights across rider and driver experiences, and the ML Engineering teams, which build and operate the production models behind pricing, matching, ETAs, and marketplace efficiency. You will be working on one of the most profitable and fastest growing revenue centers in our company. We are the team that solves some of mobility’s hardest problems: balancing supply and demand in real time, setting prices that work for riders and drivers, and measuring the true impact of product changes in a two-sided marketplace.
As a trusted leader in the broader Data Science org, you will define and drive the Data Science strategy, vision, and roadmap for Lyft EU, while ensuring that the team has all the necessary tools and infrastructure to perform their work. You will also be responsible for building and executing a strategy for self-service data science and analytics experiences across the organization, overseeing the Science, Product, and ML Engineering teams for Lyft Europe. In this role, you will be a key partner to Engineering, Operations, Regional leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent delivery of what the organization and our partners need.
Responsibilities:
Build and lead a high-performing team of data scientists
Experience leading and managing teams of managers is preferred
Work with cross-functional partners in product, engineering, design, finance, and operations to achieve business goals
Prioritize and lead deep dives into our data to uncover new product and business opportunities
Prioritize and lead development of productized models to automate operational decision-making and drive operational productivity
Develop analytical frameworks, roadmaps, and metrics for the team and broader organization
Collaborate with other leaders and executives to build data-informed business strategy and product roadmaps
Serve as a champion of sound decision-making at all levels of the company
Experience:
Advanced Degree in a quantitative field like statistics, economics, applied math, operations research or engineering
4+ years demonstrated experience leading work in the two-sided marketplace space
3+ years demonstrated experience building scaled products and services from early stages
10+ years general hands-on technical experience in a data science or equivalent ML role
5+ years people management experience building and leading data science teams
Track record of guiding teams through unstructured technical problems to deliver business impact
Skilled at managing cross-functional relationships and communicating with leadership across multiple teams
Willingness to collaborate and communicate with others to drive cross-team and cross-organization initiatives forward
Benefits:
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
401(k) plan to help save for your future
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Subsidized commuter benefits

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Job Description | About the Role
The Product Manager ascertains what’s next for the product. Head of Product is a visionary who is also rich with applied experience. We’re looking for someone will work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, and marketing to bring unique value-based features to market across B2B2C.
This role moves at a fast pace while maintaining excellent quality and a positive working attitude to strategize the Fabulous product roadmap.
Expectations | Duties
Outreach and Data Accumulation
Connect with users: dig into user data, both qualitative and quantitative
Ascertains trends while being a champion for user-first experiences
Collaborate with researchers, data scientists, and business development teams to understand user needs and identify new product opportunities.
Immerse yourself in the psychology, pain points and behavior of users to develop strong intuition about solutions that will work for them.
Develop compelling roadmaps and metric targets that keep us on track towards our desired goals and continuously measure progress towards them.
Lead product ideation and prioritization within a key product area.
Evaluate ideas and lead product prioritization and releases
Have a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas that can help move the needle, through user research/feedback, driving brainstorms sessions, and doing competitive research
Ruthlessly prioritize these ideas in a robust, data-informed way, with an aim to have the most impact with limited resources – time, engineering resources, user volume, etc.
Leverage data to drive product development and experimentation.
Lead a cross-functional team through the product development cycle–UI/UX, engineering, QA, and data analysis.
Be the overall point-person to build compelling products and features for users.
Write design documents and web updates for new content/features/initiatives with input from curriculum, design & engineering partners.
Initiate data-driven experimentation and analysis on new products and features.
Requirements
Qualifications | Requirements
8+ years of relevant product management experience:
Experience in a prior startup or other high-ambiguity environment
Prior consumer-facing product development experience, ideally with mobile or subscription-based products
Prior experience with psychology-based products, gamification, or other user behavior-oriented apps
Additional PM skills we highly value:
Consumer user empathy & perspective
Driving strategy & big-picture thinking
Experience with data analysis, metrics, and goal-setting
Analytical dexterity a.k.a. critical problem solving
Scrappy–execution & outcome-focused
Curious and teachable
Benefits
About Us
An award-winning health, wellness, & coaching company that creates apps which fall the top ten internationally. Our science-based approach sits squarely in the tech-for-good lane, helping people live their best lives. Everyone who has joined this company is committed to using evidence-based research to find the absolute best ways to change lives for the better.
Our History
Three co-founders created the Fabulous app: Sami, Amine, and Taylor. Growing up in Tunisia, Sami and Amine were only 16 when they met. With their early iteration, they reached out to Taylor, an award-winning designer in Malaysia. Their vision was welcomed into an incubation lab for startups at Duke University led by world-renowned Behavioral Economics Professor Dan Ariely. Our Chief Storyteller Jaz co-founded the Introductory Psychology program at Stanford University.
Our Approach
We use a behavioral economics lens to help individuals find that 'on switch' inside them to achieve their fullest potential. What has emerged is a system that transforms tiny habits into profound long-term changes. A world in which people with ADHD thrive. A method for gratitude to reach through difficulty. A sanctuary to seek out your true purpose. A fountain of knowledge. A space for rest and self compassion.
Our Mission
Help every individual discover the wonderful person inside themselves by creating: beautiful, evidence-based, life-changing products.
Our Environment
The first thing that sets us apart is that we’re not a place at all. While we’re a remote company, it’s not unusual to feel you know your teammates better than those you’ve shared an office with in the past. Ours is a professionally nourishing environment that is flexible and fully remote. Team members enjoy in house challenges and Slack event and work across a variety of tools. Meetings are kept to a minimum and deep work is encouraged.
Our Awards
Apple Best Apps of 2018
Editor’s app choice in more than 30 countries
Winner of Google’s Material Design Award
Best App Finalist in Google Play Awards
Consistently ranking in the top ten Health & Fitness apps across platforms
Backed by Facebook Startup Lab and Microsoft Venture
Our Norms
Ownership: Be the CEO of your tasks. No one is watching over your shoulder. Be the proof.
Open Communication: Constructive ideas are always flying across time zones.
Deep Work: Disconnect. Find your flow. Become industrious. It’s about the work here.
Always Offer Context: Sharing rationale works wonders in asynchronous conversations.
Impeccable Agreement: Promise, then follow through. Everyone relies on everyone.
Egos are checked at the door. Those who join our workforce place themselves in service of our members.
Our Values
#collaboration #craftsmanship #feedback #respect #responsibility #simplicity #speed
Our Future
To this day, over 30 million people have started their journey to better themselves with our apps. We are creating a generation of change-makers, with the same drive to help others, each in their own way.
Our Invitation
At Fabulous, every team member is a sculptor in their own right. Together, we help millions of users step out of their block of stone and step into the fullest version of their life through behavioral science. Tell us what drives you; if you were to pick up your tools, what would you contribution look like?
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Field CTO, Media & Entertainment AI Infrastructure
jobs.text:
About Nebius:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role
The Field CTO, Media & Entertainment AI Infrastructure is a senior engineering leader who will initially operate as an individual contributor at the intersection of deep AI infrastructure engineering and the business of media and entertainment, with a clear path to building and leading a team as the business scales.
You will work alongside CTOs and engineering leaders at studio groups, VFX houses, gaming studios, agency holding companies, and generative AI model companies. Your role is not to pitch them; it is to build with them. You will translate their most complex infrastructure problems into engineered solutions, own the technical relationship with our most strategic ISV and cloud-native partners, and use what you learn in the field to directly influence the M&E product roadmap alongside Nebius's global Head of Product and Head of Engineering.
This is a ground-floor opportunity to define what AI-native infrastructure looks like for an industry in the middle of a fundamental transformation.
You are welcome to work remotely from the United States (SF Bay Area or NYC preferred) Travel expectations 10% - 20% for executive meetings and key industry events.
Your responsibilities will include:
AI Infrastructure Architecture
Own the Technical Blueprint: Personally architect the infrastructure solutions for our most strategic M&E partnerships , studio-scale content production pipelines, agency data consolidation plays, generative AI model deployments. These architectures must be engineered to survive real-world scale, not just pass a POC.
The Physics to P&L Narrative: Fluently demonstrate to executive stakeholders how infrastructure decisions , data lake locality, storage tiering, inference optimization, directly impact their business model and operability.
Forensic Requirement Gathering
Deconstruct the Bottleneck: Go beyond the stated problem to find the technical truth. Translate vague business goals (e.g., “We need lower rendering costs”) into precise engineering requirements (e.g., “We need to optimize the inference batch size on L40s to reduce cost-per-token by 30%”).
Map the Transition: Identify exactly where a customer sits on the curve from legacy service bureau to AI-native tech platform and prescribe the specific infrastructure intervention needed to move them forward.
ISV & Partner Technical Strategy
Build and Validate the Integration Layer: Identify, engage, and technically validate relationships with the most critical ISVs in the media and entertainment landscape, from rendering and VFX toolchains to generative AI platforms.
Define the Standard: It is not enough to support these tools. You will define the reference architectures for how they run best on Nebius infrastructure, and work directly with ISV engineering teams to build and publish those standards.
Decide What’s Worth Doing: In partnership with the GM, evaluate ISV and partner opportunities on their technical merit and strategic leverage , and be equally rigorous about what not to pursue.
Internal Technical Influence
Shape the M&E Roadmap: Use forensic evidence from the field to prioritize and justify the M&E vertical roadmap. You will work directly with Nebius’s global Head of Product and Head of Engineering to translate partner and customer needs into product direction.
Lead the M&E Product Summit: Chair a quarterly summit with Core Engineering leadership, using field evidence to drive roadmap decisions and maintain vertical momentum.
We expect you to have:
12+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, distributed systems, or a closely related technical domain.
Executive Presence: Capable of commanding a room of engineers and presenting a layered technical roadmap to a C-Suite. You have operated at the top-to-top level , your counterparts are CTOs and VPs of Engineering.
Builder Mentality: This role begins as a hands-on individual contributor position. You will architect and ship solutions alongside partners and build the assets (reference architectures, integration playbooks, technical frameworks) that make Nebius's M&E infrastructure strategy defensible and scalable. As the business case develops, this role is explicitly designed to grow into a team-building and leadership function, with the expectation that you will recruit, shape, and run that team. You may have come from a startup, run your own company, or operated within a large org in a way that felt like building from zero, and you know how to transition from maker to multiplier.
Product-Minded: Experience defining a platform strategy, not just executing tickets. You are comfortable telling a customer “No” when a request creates technical debt, and proposing a better alternative.
Ambiguity Tolerance: You thrive in environments where requirements are evolving. You do not wait for a roadmap; you build it.
Forensic Mindset: You are not satisfied with surface-level answers. You dig into the kernel, the logs, and the P&L to find the truth.
AI Infrastructure Expertise
Mastery of the Stack: Expert-level, production-grade knowledge of GPU architectures (H100, L40s), Kubernetes orchestration including Soperator, high-performance and parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, WEKA), data lake architecture, and networking constraints (InfiniBand/Ethernet).
Inference Optimization: You understand the nuances of model serving , batch sizes, quantization, KV caching, latency tradeoffs , and can architect solutions for both massive throughput and real-time (sub-50ms) demands.
Domain Context: Media & Entertainment
Industry Fluency: You have operated within the M&E ecosystem and can speak to the infrastructure implications across the following sub-sectors:
Gaming
Multimodal Generative Models
AdTech
VFX / Content Production
Non-negotiable: Candidates without deep, production-grade working knowledge of GPU infrastructure and inference-based solutioning will not be considered. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
AI Infrastructure Expertise
Mastery of the Stack: You must be an expert in the physics of AI infrastructure. This includes deep, production-grade knowledge of GPU architectures (H100 vs. L40s), Kubernetes orchestration (K8s), high-performance storage parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, WEKA), and networking constraints (InfiniBand/Ethernet).
Inference Optimization: You understand the nuances of model serving—batch sizes, quantization, KV caching, and latency tradeoffs—and can architect solutions for both massive throughput and real-time (sub-50ms) demands.
Key Employee Benefits:
Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.
Pay Transparency
We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.
Base Compensation Range
$200,000—$245,000 USD
Benefits & Perks:
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams
What's it like to work at Nebius:
Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Map the Transition: Identify exactly where a customer sits on the curve from legacy service bureau to AI-native tech platform and prescribe the specific infrastructure intervention needed to move them forward.

blocks.text: ISV & Partner Technical Strategy

items: Build and Validate the Integration Layer: Identify, engage, and technically validate relationships with the most critical ISVs in the media and entertainment landscape, from rendering and VFX toolchains to generative AI platforms.

Define the Standard: It is not enough to support these tools. You will define the reference architectures for how they run best on Nebius infrastructure, and work directly with ISV engineering teams to build and publish those standards.
Decide What’s Worth Doing: In partnership with the GM, evaluate ISV and partner opportunities on their technical merit and strategic leverage , and be equally rigorous about what not to pursue.

blocks.text: Internal Technical Influence

items: Shape the M&E Roadmap: Use forensic evidence from the field to prioritize and justify the M&E vertical roadmap. You will work directly with Nebius’s global Head of Product and Head of Engineering to translate partner and customer needs into product direction.
Lead the M&E Product Summit: Chair a quarterly summit with Core Engineering leadership, using field evidence to drive roadmap decisions and maintain vertical momentum.

blocks.text: We expect you to have:

items: 12+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, distributed systems, or a closely related technical domain.

Executive Presence: Capable of commanding a room of engineers and presenting a layered technical roadmap to a C-Suite. You have operated at the top-to-top level , your counterparts are CTOs and VPs of Engineering.

Builder Mentality: This role begins as a hands-on individual contributor position. You will architect and ship solutions alongside partners and build the assets (reference architectures, integration playbooks, technical frameworks) that make Nebius's M&E infrastructure strategy defensible and scalable. As the business case develops, this role is explicitly designed to grow into a team-building and leadership function, with the expectation that you will recruit, shape, and run that team. You may have come from a startup, run your own company, or operated within a large org in a way that felt like building from zero, and you know how to transition from maker to multiplier.

Product-Minded: Experience defining a platform strategy, not just executing tickets. You are comfortable telling a customer “No” when a request creates technical debt, and proposing a better alternative.
Ambiguity Tolerance: You thrive in environments where requirements are evolving. You do not wait for a roadmap; you build it.
Forensic Mindset: You are not satisfied with surface-level answers. You dig into the kernel, the logs, and the P&L to find the truth.

blocks.text: AI Infrastructure Expertise

items: Mastery of the Stack: Expert-level, production-grade knowledge of GPU architectures (H100, L40s), Kubernetes orchestration including Soperator, high-performance and parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, WEKA), data lake architecture, and networking constraints (InfiniBand/Ethernet).

Inference Optimization: You understand the nuances of model serving , batch sizes, quantization, KV caching, latency tradeoffs , and can architect solutions for both massive throughput and real-time (sub-50ms) demands.

blocks.text: Domain Context: Media & Entertainment

items: Gaming
Multimodal Generative Models
AdTech
VFX / Content Production

blocks.text: Non-negotiable: Candidates without deep, production-grade working knowledge of GPU infrastructure and inference-based solutioning will not be considered. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
AI Infrastructure Expertise

items: Mastery of the Stack: You must be an expert in the physics of AI infrastructure. This includes deep, production-grade knowledge of GPU architectures (H100 vs. L40s), Kubernetes orchestration (K8s), high-performance storage parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, WEKA), and networking constraints (InfiniBand/Ethernet).

jobs.title: VP of Product, Platform Architecture
jobs.text:
Company Description:
Veracross provides SaaS-based School Information Systems (SIS) designed to meet the specific needs of independent K-12 schools worldwide. Our one-record solution combines the power of a fully integrated single-record database, personalized communication tools, and an elegant architecture that is unique in our industry.
We are a growing, values-led community of employees in the US, UK and Australia who share a vision to unify school communities, improve the quality of education, and enhance learning.
Veracross is five product brands in one global tech company
Veracross SIS is a one-person, one-record school management platform
Magnus Health provides cloud-based Student Health Record (SHR) solutions
Digistorm connects with their communities through Digistorm Websites, Digistorm Funnel, and Digistorm Apps.
Epraise incentivizes student well-being and connects teachers, students, and families.
Firefly provides an online learning space for students and teachers
Role Description:
We're standing up a new Platform Architecture Group to take the Veracross Platform, and everything built on top of it, into the agentic AI era. This is a rare opportunity to lead product for a brand-new initaitive from day one: partnering daily with our CTO to build the platform that makes AI-native, workflow-driven school software possible.
You'll own product strategy across four foundational pillars: Axiom (our core platform), AI, APIs, and Automations. This isn't a single feature area — it's the connective tissue that determines how fast every other Veracross product team can ship, and the foundation for our future: a modern monolithic unified platform that allows for quick innovation, autonomous agents that complete school workflows end-to-end, a FinTech suite that competes with purpose-built tools, and a partner ecosystem built on a modern, monetizable API.
In addition to running the Platform Architecture team, you’ll have 2 PMs reporting to you who own Platform Automations, AI including Veracross’s first AI tool, VC Studio.
Responsibilities:
Together with the CTO, define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the Platform Architecture Group across Axiom's core architecture, AI infrastructure, APIs, and Automations.
Partner daily with our CTO to turn platform investment into a sequenced, shippable roadmap for a 10-person engineering team.
Build the business case and success metrics for platform investment, translating technical modernization into measurable revenue impact: FinTech acceleration, agentic workflows, API monetization, and a growing partner ecosystem.
Champion a small set of foundational capabilities, such as a shared data layer, a central user identity service, and an agentic execution platform, that unlock revenue opportunities across the wider product organization.
Work directly with product teams across Veracross, including SIS, FinTech, and Business Suite, to align on platform dependencies and shared infrastructure.
Represent the platform investment to executive sponsors, reporting on velocity, adoption, and financial impact.
Establish the product processes, rituals, and hiring decisions for a function that doesn't exist yet, since you're building it.
Turn significant, well-understood technical debt into a clear, staged modernization plan the rest of the business can plan around.
Manage 2 PMs who own Automations and AI and continue to coach them and help define and drive their Roadmaps
