jobs.title: Director, Data Platform
jobs.text:
About TalkingPoints
TalkingPoints is an award-winning education technology nonprofit on a mission to unlock every student’s potential by activating one of the most underutilized forces in education - families. We believe that when families and schools work together, students thrive - and we’re building the tools to make that partnership possible for every family.
Our platform helps schools reach and engage every family - including those historically underserved - through accessible, two-way communication in 150+ languages, along with data, insights, and supports that strengthen relationships and drive student success.
Today, millions of educators and families are using TalkingPoints in their classrooms, schools, and districts across the U.S. to build stronger partnerships and improve outcomes for students. Our work is grounded in research and has been shown to meaningfully impact attendance, learning, and more.
We partner with leading school districts nationwide and are supported by a strong community of philanthropic and strategic partners, including major foundations, technology leaders, and education organizations.
TalkingPoints is at an exciting stage of growth and impact. As we continue to expand our reach and deepen our impact, we’re looking for passionate, mission-driven team members who want to help schools and families succeed - together. Learn more at.
Diversity: we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it!
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Director, Data Platform to lead our Data Engineering team and own the technical direction of our data platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for the architecture, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency of our data platform, while managing and developing our Data Engineers.
Our data platform supports company-wide analytics, core metrics, and research, as well as data products that power customer-facing application functionality.
Lead, manage, and mentor the Data Engineering team.
Own the architecture and technical direction of the end-to-end data platform, from ingestion and transformation through modeling, storage, and delivery to analytics and applications.
Co-own data governance, including data quality, access, privacy, lineage, and lifecycle policies, and establish engineering standards for pipelines, testing, and observability.
Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, performant, and cost-efficient.
Guide and review the design and implementation of data pipelines, curated datasets, and data products.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to design solutions and features for the application.
Define and negotiate clear ownership boundaries and interfaces between the data platform and operational application systems.
Enable Product, Engineering, Research, and other teams to safely self-serve trusted data and organizational metrics, including for AI-powered insights and workflows, without unnecessary dependencies on Data Engineering.
Remain hands-on and contribute to architecture, implementation, debugging, and optimization when needed.
Who You Are
8+ years designing and owning data architectures and end-to-end data platforms.
5+ years managing and mentoring Data Engineers, with experience leading complex technical delivery.
Deep experience across the data lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, modeling, orchestration, storage, and serving data for analytics, applications, and AI.
Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals.
Demonstrated experience co-owning data governance, including data quality, access controls, privacy, lineage, and observability.
Strong track record of collaboration with Product, Engineering, Research, and other stakeholders on product roadmap business priorities and clearly communicating technical tradeoffs.
Comfortable balancing hands-on engineering with technical and people leadership.
The base range for this role is $175,000 - $190,000 USD. The range reflects what TalkingPoints would pay for this position. The actual base compensation may vary depending on factors such as experience, location, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and does not include bonuses, other forms of compensation, or benefits.
Overall Fit With Our Org Culture - We Look for Team Members Who Are:
User and mission-oriented: we are devoted to our mission with empathy towards the communities we serve.
All-in together: we go above and beyond the job description, working together as a team.
Agile & action-oriented: we get things done, knowing that our progress is urgent to our communities.
Always Learning: we are always learning, with a growth mindset, to reach our full potential.
Boldly Courageous: we take risks in order to achieve big things.
Resourceful: We are creative, solution-oriented, and scrappy.
What We Offer
An incredible opportunity to build a mission-driven, rapidly growing startup tech nonprofit
Competitive salary, health insurance, benefits, and flexible time off
401K match
Annual professional development benefit
Flexibility to work remotely
Fun, smart, dynamic, motivated team focused on working together to transform family engagement to serve the families who need it most
How to apply
Please submit your resume, a brief paragraph describing your interest in TalkingPoints and this position, and a link to your LinkedIn profile.
Salary: 175,000-190,000
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the company
Nuitée is the API infrastructure powering travel, inside banks, AI assistants, airlines, loyalty programs and hotel brands. Nuitée Connect gives businesses one API for 2.9M properties, 600+ airlines and 200K+ experiences, built for apps and AI agents alike. Nuitée Cloud lets hotels reach new demand and control pricing, payments and operations in one platform.
Founded in 2017, Nuitée has 300 colleagues across 25 countries and a mission to make travel distribution simpler, faster and fairer for everyone in travel. We raised a $48M Series A led by Accel and work with companies such as Revolut, Grab, and Sabre.
About the role
Remote in Europe, or hybrid in Barcelona, Dublin, London, or Palma.
A live product making its mark in travel tech, a team ready to grow, and the engineering direction yours to set.
You’ll lead engineering for Nuitée Cloud: the platform hotels use to reach new demand and control pricing, payments, and operations in one place. It’s well past MVP, and 400+ hotel chains trust Nuitée to distribute their inventory. There’s still a lot to build from scratch.
Cloud has two engineering teams, and you’ll lead both: Connectivity, which builds the backend in Go, and Product, a full-stack team with real product ownership.
You’ll start with how the team works: how Cloud codes, designs, and tests. From there, you’ll set the technical direction with the senior ICs and grow the team. The challenge underneath is speed. Cloud has a lot of R&D, and a single product change can move metrics fast. How do you keep that pace while making the system more reliable and secure?
What makes it interesting for you
You set the standard. You’ll define how a whole product area writes code, designs systems, and tests, and shape those practices around how Nuitée works.
The architecture is still open. Cloud has to stay fast and also become more reliable and secure, and you’ll help set the technical direction to get there.
You build the team around you. You’ll own Cloud’s hiring strategy, career paths, and engineering culture.
You work closely with product. You’ll partner day to day with the Head of Product, Cloud, on what the team builds and why.
Nuitée raised a $48M Series A led by Accel and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, and Sabre.
The kind of problems you’ll work on
How do we build one engineering culture across a distributed team that ships much faster at higher quality?
How should Cloud’s architecture change so a product built for speed and R&D also becomes more reliable and secure?
How do we give every engineer clear work, a clear reason to be on the team, and a real path to grow at Nuitée?
This role fits if you
Have led at least 10 engineers as a Director, Head of Engineering, or Senior Engineering Manager at a well-known product scale-up with a high engineering bar.
Have built large-scale, challenging web products, including the front end, and can work out how to architect and scale a product for high volume.
Have put engineering practices in place (code, architecture, QA) and built a shared culture that raised the team’s level.
Lead as a manager who sets direction and hands out work, and still get into the code when something needs to ship.
Have built career paths, hired, and kept engineers motivated.
Communicate clearly and drive things forward without waiting to be asked.
You’re strong in at least one object-oriented language. Our backend runs on Go, so experience with it would be ideal.
Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your team actually delivers.

Nuitée is building the infrastructure to power travel.

jobs.title: Data Governance and Modernization Lead - Associate Director
jobs.text:
Job Family:
Data Science Consulting
Travel Required:
Up to 10%
Clearance Required:
Ability to Obtain Public Trust
What You Will Do:
We are seeking an experienced Data Governance Workstream Lead to support a large-scale State Health data modernization initiative. This individual will lead the development and implementation of practical governance, stewardship, data quality, metadata, and data management practices that improve the consistency, quality, and trusted use of enterprise data and assist in a broader digital modernization initiative.
This is a hands-on leadership role working across agency programs, business stakeholders, IT, and data teams. This role will lead a data workstream, facilitate key decisions, manage deliverables and team members, and help integrate governance requirements into data platform modernization, source onboarding, reporting, and ongoing operations.
What You Will Do:
Lead thedata governance workstream for a large-scale State Health data modernization program, partnering with agency leadership, business stakeholders, data owners, architects, engineers, and other project workstreams.
Establish and operationalize the data governance operating model, including roles and responsibilities, decision rights, governance forums, escalation paths, and processes for resolving data quality, access, definition, and reporting issues.
Establish and mature data ownership and stewardship, including identification and onboarding of data owners and stewards across key health and Medicaid data domains.
Develop and implement data governance policies, standards, business rules, definitions, and controls covering data quality, metadata, classification, access, security, retention, and data sharing.
Partner with business and technical teams to define and maintain data domains, critical data elements, authoritative sources, business definitions, metadata, and lineage as data sources are integrated into the enterprise platform.
Define and operationalize data quality and issue-management practices, including data quality rules, monitoring, remediation, ownership, escalation, and reporting.
Integrate governance requirements into source onboarding, data integration, reporting, and enterprise identity activities, helping ensure governance is part of day-to-day delivery rather than a separate compliance exercise.
Develop practical governance artifacts such as governance charters, RACI matrices, stewardship guidance, data inventories, business glossaries, standards, issue-management processes, and governance reporting.
Facilitate governance working sessions and decisions with stakeholders across agency programs, IT, privacy, security, data and analytics, and leadership.
Lead and mentor the governance team, manage workstream priorities and deliverables, and communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions to client and project leadership.
What You Will Need:
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
Based on contractual obligations, candidate must be located within the United States and be a U.S. Citizen.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD Public Trust.
Minimum seven (7+) years of overall work experience.
Experience in data governance, data management, analytics, data engineering, or enterprise data modernization, including experience supporting public-sector organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading data governance initiatives or workstreams, including governance operating models, policies, standards, stewardship, and organizational roles.
Strong knowledge of data ownership and stewardship, data domains, metadata, business glossaries, lineage, data quality, master and reference data, classification, privacy, and access controls.
Experience supporting enterprise data modernization, including data warehouses, cloud data platforms, data integration, or analytics environments.
Ability to work closely with architects and engineers to incorporate governance into source onboarding, data integration, transformation, data models, quality controls, metadata, lineage, and reporting.
Experience establishing data quality and issue-management processes, including rules, ownership, monitoring, remediation, escalation, and reporting.
Experience facilitating cross-functional governance discussions with business programs, executives, IT, privacy, security, and data and analytics teams.
Strong client leadership, facilitation, written communication, and team management skills.
Ability to travel up to 10% during key project periods.
What Would Be Nice To Have:
Experience leading data governance or modernization initiatives for State Health, Medicaid, or other health and human services agencies.
Experience with Medicaid or health data, including claims and encounters, eligibility, provider, managed care, pharmacy, behavioral health, or clinical data.
Experience with enterprise data warehouses, cloud data platforms, lakehouses, or enterprise analytics environments.
Experience with data governance and catalog tools such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Informatica, OneTrust, or similar platforms.
Experience establishing data catalogs, business glossaries, metadata repositories, lineage, data quality scorecards, or stewardship workflows.
Familiarity with HIPAA, health data interoperability, public-sector privacy and security requirements, and data-sharing agreements.
Data governance or data management certifications such as DAMA CDMP, or relevant platform certifications.
Experience supporting organizational adoption, stakeholder engagement, and training associated with new governance practices.
The annual salary range for this position is $149,000.00-$248,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

jobs.title: Head of Security Engineering & Operations
jobs.text:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Head of Security Engineering & Operations
Role Summary
Lead security engineering, identity and access management (IAM/IGA), and security operations across Agoda’s multi-brand environment. As a hands-on engineering and operational leader, own reliable, auditable workforce access, identity platforms running in production, SecOps infrastructure (including endpoint management), and the quality of day-to-day SecOps services. Lead a team of approximately 15 engineers and analysts that designs, builds, and ships security software, automation, and platforms, not only operates tools, partnering closely with IT and the service desk to keep access dependable, resolve incidents, and improve the employee experience.
Bring a builder mindset: stay hands-on in code and set the team’s engineering standards. Establish clear service ownership, healthy on-call, disciplined change control, and measurable operational performance. Hands-on with implementing, configuring, and debugging security tools. Use automation and self-service to reduce recurring work and improve reliability. Support cloud security posture (CNAPP) across public and private environments and practical AI-aware security as part of a well-run engineering and operations portfolio.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop the Security Engineering & Operations / IAM team (~15 engineers and analysts) as an engineering team that builds and ships software, with clear accountability, healthy on-call coverage, coaching, and a consistent operational and delivery cadence.
Set the team’s engineering direction and practice: design, build, and ship security tools, automation, integrations, and internal platforms; own technical design, architecture reviews, code review, testing, and release standards across the secure SDLC.
Stay hands-on in code: write, review, and debug the team’s software, and build APIs and integrations that connect identity, endpoint, logging, cloud, and ticketing systems.
Own workforce identity and identity governance and administration (IGA) end-to-end across tenants and brands: application onboarding, entitlements, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access requests and reviews, and migration of legacy access models to governed IGA, ensuring reliable, auditable access to critical business applications with minimal disruption.
Run identity platforms as production services, including privileged access management (PAM), federation / SSO, and break-glass access: own availability, monitoring, controlled changes, identity incidents, tested runbooks and recovery procedures, and controlled, auditable emergency access.
Drive operational excellence through intake SLAs, ticket and queue hygiene with the service desk, escalation paths, change management, knowledge articles, and maintained operational documentation.
Own day-to-day SecOps infrastructure and platform operations — endpoint management, logging, endpoint / DLP, and cloud security tooling — including hands-on implementation, configuration, and debugging of security tools; maintain platform health, monitoring, upgrades, support readiness, and coordinate incidents with response teams.
Lead security programme delivery across brands, including integrations, readiness checks, cutovers, hypercare, and explicit handover into steady-state support.
Support public and private / on-prem cloud security posture through CNAPP-class tooling, prioritising actionable posture, workload, and cloud entitlement risks with platform owners; build automated detection, remediation, and policy-as-code workflows where they reduce risk at scale.
Apply practical AI-aware security through secure AI tooling, controls for AI agents, and measured adoption of AI-assisted SecOps, including building and integrating AI-assisted automation with appropriate guardrails.
Build automation and self-service that reduce operational load, recurring incidents, and manual work; deliver changes to security infrastructure and tooling through automated pipelines, and design scalable, observable systems for supportability, monitoring, and safe recovery.
Partner with IT, service desk, GRC, incident response, cloud, programme, and brand stakeholders; make build-versus-buy decisions, evaluate vendors, and run focused POCs against operational and control requirements.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of relevant experience in security engineering and operations, with substantial responsibility for IAM and security operations.
5+ years leading engineers, including a team of approximately 15 engineers / analysts or a comparable span that builds and ships software as well as runs production services: hiring, coaching, development, technical direction, and sustainable on-call coverage.
Software engineering background, read and write production-quality code (Python, Go or similar), and work with Git, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
Hands-on infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code experience (Terraform or similar), managing security and identity platforms through code.
Experience designing and reviewing security architecture for identity, access and cloud platforms, including threat modelling and making secure design trade-offs.
Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable systems, APIs, and integrations, with attention to observability, failure modes, and secure SDLC practice.
Hands-on ownership of workforce identity services in production, combining IGA application onboarding, entitlements, joiner-mover-leaver workflows, access requests and reviews with federation / SSO, privileged access management, and controlled emergency access.
Proven operational ownership of service availability, on-call, incidents, SLAs, monitoring, runbooks, and change control; able to work effectively with service desk and IT partners.
Experience delivering services across multiple tenants, brands, or large organisations, including integrations, cutovers, and transition into steady-state operations.
A builder who designs, ships, and maintains security tools, automation, and platforms in production, and improves systems through engineering and self-service; comfortable implementing, configuring, and debugging security tools hands-on with engineers.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, sound prioritisation, and calm incident and delivery leadership.
Practical knowledge of public and private cloud security and CNAPP capabilities.
Practical AI security literacy, including secure AI use and identity / access considerations for AI agents.
Able to work Bangkok business hours (Asia/Bangkok).
Preferred Qualifications
Deep experience with workforce identity platforms and automation in SOX-scoped or heavily audited environments, including access certification and control evidence.
Strong ITSM and change-management practices, service-desk integration, and measurable service improvement.
SOAR and operational workflow automation that reduce manual triage and resolution effort.
SSE / zero-trust access and modern endpoint security / endpoint management.
Hands-on CNAPP experience across major public cloud providers and private / hybrid estates, including policy as code.

Head of Security Engineering & Operations
Role Summary

Lead security engineering, identity and access management (IAM/IGA), and security operations across Agoda’s multi-brand environment. As a hands-on engineering and operational leader, own reliable, auditable workforce access, identity platforms running in production, SecOps infrastructure (including endpoint management), and the quality of day-to-day SecOps services. Lead a team of approximately 15 engineers and analysts that designs, builds, and ships security software, automation, and platforms, not only operates tools, partnering closely with IT and the service desk to keep access dependable, resolve incidents, and improve the employee experience.

Bring a builder mindset: stay hands-on in code and set the team’s engineering standards. Establish clear service ownership, healthy on-call, disciplined change control, and measurable operational performance. Hands-on with implementing, configuring, and debugging security tools. Use automation and self-service to reduce recurring work and improve reliability. Support cloud security posture (CNAPP) across public and private environments and practical AI-aware security as part of a well-run engineering and operations portfolio.
Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Security Engineering & Operations / IAM team (~15 engineers and analysts) as an engineering team that builds and ships software, with clear accountability, healthy on-call coverage, coaching, and a consistent operational and delivery cadence.

Set the team’s engineering direction and practice: design, build, and ship security tools, automation, integrations, and internal platforms; own technical design, architecture reviews, code review, testing, and release standards across the secure SDLC.
Stay hands-on in code: write, review, and debug the team’s software, and build APIs and integrations that connect identity, endpoint, logging, cloud, and ticketing systems.

Own workforce identity and identity governance and administration (IGA) end-to-end across tenants and brands: application onboarding, entitlements, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access requests and reviews, and migration of legacy access models to governed IGA, ensuring reliable, auditable access to critical business applications with minimal disruption.

Run identity platforms as production services, including privileged access management (PAM), federation / SSO, and break-glass access: own availability, monitoring, controlled changes, identity incidents, tested runbooks and recovery procedures, and controlled, auditable emergency access.
Drive operational excellence through intake SLAs, ticket and queue hygiene with the service desk, escalation paths, change management, knowledge articles, and maintained operational documentation.

Own day-to-day SecOps infrastructure and platform operations — endpoint management, logging, endpoint / DLP, and cloud security tooling — including hands-on implementation, configuration, and debugging of security tools; maintain platform health, monitoring, upgrades, support readiness, and coordinate incidents with response teams.
Lead security programme delivery across brands, including integrations, readiness checks, cutovers, hypercare, and explicit handover into steady-state support.

Support public and private / on-prem cloud security posture through CNAPP-class tooling, prioritising actionable posture, workload, and cloud entitlement risks with platform owners; build automated detection, remediation, and policy-as-code workflows where they reduce risk at scale.

Apply practical AI-aware security through secure AI tooling, controls for AI agents, and measured adoption of AI-assisted SecOps, including building and integrating AI-assisted automation with appropriate guardrails.

Build automation and self-service that reduce operational load, recurring incidents, and manual work; deliver changes to security infrastructure and tooling through automated pipelines, and design scalable, observable systems for supportability, monitoring, and safe recovery.

Partner with IT, service desk, GRC, incident response, cloud, programme, and brand stakeholders; make build-versus-buy decisions, evaluate vendors, and run focused POCs against operational and control requirements.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of relevant experience in security engineering and operations, with substantial responsibility for IAM and security operations.

5+ years leading engineers, including a team of approximately 15 engineers / analysts or a comparable span that builds and ships software as well as runs production services: hiring, coaching, development, technical direction, and sustainable on-call coverage.
Software engineering background, read and write production-quality code (Python, Go or similar), and work with Git, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
Hands-on infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code experience (Terraform or similar), managing security and identity platforms through code.
Experience designing and reviewing security architecture for identity, access and cloud platforms, including threat modelling and making secure design trade-offs.
Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable systems, APIs, and integrations, with attention to observability, failure modes, and secure SDLC practice.

Hands-on ownership of workforce identity services in production, combining IGA application onboarding, entitlements, joiner-mover-leaver workflows, access requests and reviews with federation / SSO, privileged access management, and controlled emergency access.
Proven operational ownership of service availability, on-call, incidents, SLAs, monitoring, runbooks, and change control; able to work effectively with service desk and IT partners.
Experience delivering services across multiple tenants, brands, or large organisations, including integrations, cutovers, and transition into steady-state operations.

A builder who designs, ships, and maintains security tools, automation, and platforms in production, and improves systems through engineering and self-service; comfortable implementing, configuring, and debugging security tools hands-on with engineers.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, sound prioritisation, and calm incident and delivery leadership.
Practical knowledge of public and private cloud security and CNAPP capabilities.
Practical AI security literacy, including secure AI use and identity / access considerations for AI agents.
Able to work Bangkok business hours (Asia/Bangkok).

Deep experience with workforce identity platforms and automation in SOX-scoped or heavily audited environments, including access certification and control evidence.
Strong ITSM and change-management practices, service-desk integration, and measurable service improvement.
SOAR and operational workflow automation that reduce manual triage and resolution effort.
SSE / zero-trust access and modern endpoint security / endpoint management.
Hands-on CNAPP experience across major public cloud providers and private / hybrid estates, including policy as code.

jobs.title: Strategy & Technical Branding Specialist — CTO Office
jobs.text:
About Us
Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Role positioning
This is a strategic technical brand position under the CTO Office, with the core goal of helping the CTO establish external technical influence from scratch.
This person needs to possess strategic thinking, structured expression ability, and technical understanding, and be able to transform the core technical capabilities of the CTO, engineering team, and company into externally understandable, credible, and influential technical narratives.
This is not an ordinary brand operation, nor is it simply a position for writing articles. Must be able to truly understand technology - Understand what engineers are saying, judge the accuracy of technical content, and be able to directly communicate with CTO on technical issues. Do not require writing code, but cannot stay at the level of marketing copy.
Main responsibilities
Build a CTO technology brand system from 0 to 1, including positioning, content direction, communication channels, and release rhythm
Assist CTO in sorting out external technical narratives and forming a long-term, stable, and recognizable technical voice
Plan and produce technical articles, white papers, industry perspectives, speeches, interviews, media articles, and social media content
Track industry trends such as Web3, Crypto Exchange, AI, security, and system stability, and provide CTO with topic selection and viewpoint suggestions
Benchmarking technology brand actions against similar exchanges, outputting competitive insights, aligning with CTO with action list
Collaborate with engineering, product, risk control, security, PR, compliance and other teams to extract technical highlights and ensure content accuracy and compliance
Participate in necessary technical discussions, key project recaps and stability governance discussions, and precipitate real engineering creatives
Proactively break down problems, promote cross-team alignment in ambiguous environments, and implement them into actionable plans
Job requirements
Must have
Have experience as an MBB Associate or above in the past 5 years, or have experience in strategy, business strategy, business analysis, and strategic operation of major companies such as ByteDance/Tencent/Pinduoduo
Possess real technical understanding ability, be able to read what engineers are saying, judge the accuracy of technical content, and directly communicate with CTO on technical issues
Possess excellent structured thinking, problem-solving skills, business judgment, and Chinese and English expression skills
Experience in driving complex projects from 0 to 1, able to independently judge and promote implementation when the direction is not completely clear
Have ghostwriting experience, able to output content from the perspective of CTO or technical executives, rather than writing content centered on oneself
Samples of public content (technical blogs, white papers, speeches, industry reports or brand campaigns) are required
Proactive, passionate, strong ownership, able to quickly learn and fill in gaps in new directions
Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Data Partnerships
jobs.text:
About Us
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy. We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across sectors, including e-commerce, ridesharing, payments, and marketplaces.
Our proprietary technology identifies, licenses, cleans, and analyzes third-party data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We are backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners and have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. Our culture is focused on ownership, mastery, transparency, and impact.
About the Role
YipitData’s product portfolio is underpinned by a growing set of strategic data partnerships. Each partnership acts as a growth driver for the business, unlocking new product development opportunities and expanding our sector coverage.
We currently have ~40 active data partnerships and are looking to hire a senior, Director-level individual contributor to scale this motion. This role sits at the intersection of corporate development, strategy, and product.
The Director, Strategic Data Partnerships, will identify, evaluate, and execute exclusive, long-cycle data partnerships that meaningfully shape our future product direction. This is not a procurement or channel partnerships role. Instead, it requires strong strategic judgment, executive presence, and deep curiosity about how data creates competitive advantage.
In This Role, You Will
Identify and evaluate potential data partners with high strategic and product value
Engage directly with CEOs and senior executives — many of whom have not previously monetized their data — to assess opportunity and build alignment
Lead discovery and diligence processes to understand data quality, defensibility, and long-term product applicability
Develop strategic and economic business cases for partnership opportunities
Negotiate and execute complex, enterprise-level agreements, including exclusive arrangements
Coordinate cross-functionally with legal, product, compliance, engineering, and executive leadership
Exercise strong judgment in prioritizing opportunities and determining when to pursue, pause, or walk away
This role owns partnerships through signature. Ongoing relationship management and renewals are handled by a separate team.
What Success Looks Like
Signing one flagship, exclusive partnership within the first 12–18 months
Building a repeatable executive-level pipeline of high-quality partnership opportunities
Establishing clear internal conviction around which opportunities merit investment
You Are Likely to Succeed If
You have Director-level (or equivalent) experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, corporate development, investment banking, or strategy consulting with operating exposure
IC focused, ideal for enterprise sellers looking to transition into a non-traditional sales role and quota attainment.
You have experience evaluating and executing complex, multi-stakeholder transactions
You are comfortable engaging and influencing C-suite executives
You demonstrate strong judgment when evaluating ambiguous, high-stakes opportunities
You thrive in environments with less structure and enjoy carving new paths
You have grit and resilience to sustain momentum through long-cycle negotiations
You are genuinely curious about the data ecosystem and how data enables competitive advantage and new product innovation
What We Offer
Our compensation package includes a competitive base salary, performance incentives (OTE $350k), and equity.
We also offer:
Flexible work hours and an open vacation policy
Generous 401(k) match and parental leave
Wellness and work-from-home benefits
Learning and professional development support
Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact you make — not tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to self-improve and master their skills in an environment built on trust and accountability.
YipitData is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. We also have office hubs in Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, and Seattle. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.
Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
Job Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.text:
About Actian
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.
Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.
We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.
This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.
You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.
You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.
We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.
This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.
What You Will Own:
1. Platform Engineering & Architecture
Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.
2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment
Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.
3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
ELESSAR SYSTEMS INC.
Training. Left of Launch.
POSITION DESCRIPTION
Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Elessar Systems
Join a talented founding team and lead the technical strategy, engineering delivery, and security of an AI-enabled defense training platform built to protect communities and critical infrastructure.
Position Summary
Elessar is hiring a Chief Technology Officer to own the technical strategy, engineering execution, and commercial readiness of Q2 Holodeck™. This is a hands-on executive role for someone who wants to do more than manage backlogs and sit in architecture reviews. You will take a working, sophisticated platform — real-time multiplayer simulation, AI-driven NPC decision agents, deterministic scoring, and automated after-action reporting — and transform it into a secure, supportable, commercially deployed product. You will lead the 12-week commercial release, build the technical team, own the security posture, and set the architecture for the next 24 months of growth.
You will join a small, talented team of technologists, operators, trainers, and business builders. The decisions you make will be visible. Your work will directly determine what Elessar can promise customers, when it can deliver, and how the product scales. The role is designed for a senior technical leader who is execution-oriented, intellectually honest about risk and remaining work, and energized by the challenge of building a company around genuinely differentiated technology.
About Elessar and Q2 Holodeck™
Elessar is a defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, a browser-based, AI/ML-driven, scenario-based training and decision-rehearsal platform. Q2 Holodeck™ helps security, force-protection, and first-responder personnel identify a drone threat, select a lawful and effective response, and coordinate across agencies before a real event occurs. The platform is built to serve defense, homeland security, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and allied markets.
Our immediate commercial objective is straightforward: release a verified product, land the first paying pilots, and convert those pilots into annual subscriptions and enterprise deployments. The CTO is the person who makes that sequence possible.
What Makes This Opportunity Different
· Real technology, not a whiteboard. You will lead a platform with working, production-bound code — 75,000+ lines of Go, a live simulation engine, 26 operational scenarios, 93 documented system requirements, and a 24-month roadmap.
· Direct access and real authority. You will work alongside the CEO, customers, operators, and sales executives — not filtered through layers of product management. You make architecture, security, and delivery decisions.
· Equity. Your compensation includes possible equity participation in Elessar alongside a competitive base.
· Founding executive. You will have direct influence over hiring, culture, and strategy as Elessar scales from pilot to enterprise.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
· Technology Strategy and Architecture (20%). Own the roadmap, translate customer and commercial requirements into engineering priorities, and make and document decisions on platform design, technical debt, integrations, and deployment profiles (cloud, air-gapped, edge).
· Commercial Release Execution (25%). Lead the 12-week release from funded kickoff to signed pilot acceptance. Establish the delivery baseline, assign accountable owners, manage dependencies, and release against demonstrated security, functional, operational, and customer acceptance criteria. No untested claims ship.
· Engineering Leadership and Team Building (20%). Recruit, develop, and coordinate software engineering, platform operations, QA, security, and AI/data capabilities. Manage contractors and technology partners. Establish a disciplined software development lifecycle — requirements traceability, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, controlled releases, and clear ownership.
· Security and Reliability (15%). Own identity and access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management, monitoring, incident response, backup, recovery, and customer-specific assurance requirements. Lead the company toward FedRAMP-compatible and enterprise security posture.
· AI and Data Engineering (10%). Govern document ingestion, scenario generation, source provenance, retrieval quality, model evaluation, and human review workflows. Preserve the integrity of deterministic simulation behavior and scoring independently of advisory AI layers.
· Customer and Commercial Support (10%). Participate in technical discovery, demonstrations, proposals, integration planning, and customer assurance reviews. Ensure every commercial commitment reflects tested capabilities and supported configurations. Help Sales close by being the credible technical voice in the room.
Key Performance Objectives
OBJECTIVE - Baseline established
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Requirements, implemented functionality, outstanding work, staffing, costs, and release-blocking risks reconciled and documented
HORIZON - Month 1
OBJECTIVE - Release candidate delivered
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Approved instructor and participant workflows, scenario content, scoring, AAR, and operational controls demonstrated on a stable, pinned build
HORIZON - Weeks 8–10
OBJECTIVE - G1 pilot accepted
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Signed pilot acceptance from a real customer for an explicitly named capacity and configuration; all SRD exceptions visible and dispositioned
HORIZON - Month 3
OBJECTIVE - Team and process in place
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Release owner named; QA, security, and AI leads identified or contracted; CI/CD and controlled-release discipline operational
HORIZON - Month 3
OBJECTIVE - G2 infrastructure qualified
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Shared data, tenant isolation, observability, recovery, and increased capacity operational and tested
HORIZON - Month 6
OBJECTIVE - Enterprise posture achieved
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Enterprise identity, individual learning records, grounded AI assistance, and security certification readiness complete
HORIZON - Month 12
OBJECTIVE - Platform expanded
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - LMS integrations, disconnected/air-gapped deployment, and expanded capacity and content commercially supported
HORIZON - Month 24

jobs.title: VP, Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Join a National Top Workplace
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.
Join Us from Anywhere
While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:
·Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
·Nine Company-Wide Holidays
·A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being
Discover more about our perks and benefits here.
Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.
Travel Requirements:
As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.
About the team and what we’ll build together
Kobie is hiring a Vice President of Platform Engineering to lead the infrastructure and platform organization that powers our single-tenant SaaS loyalty platform. This is a new role, created to match the scope and complexity of a growing client footprint and an evolving technology strategy.
The successful candidate will own the production infrastructure that every Kobie client depends on, lead the completion of a significant AWS migration in progress, and set the platform direction for the next phase of the business, including the infrastructure foundation for Kobie’s expanding AI delivery. This role partners closely with the VP of Software Engineering, the VP of Delivery, and the leaders of product and production support to shape how Kobie's technology delivers competitive advantage to our clients.
This is a leadership role for an experienced operator. It requires clear judgment, strong opinions grounded in prior experience, and the ability to bring alignment across functions without relying on organizational authority.
How you will make an impact
The production infrastructure footprint for a growing SaaS platform serving enterprise clients across financial services, retail, and travel
A team of 15–20 engineers across DevOps, Cloud Engineering, and Systems Administration, distributed across the US and India
The AWS relationship at the technical level, including the multi-year commercial commitment, FinOps discipline, and the ongoing migration from Oracle-hosted infrastructure to AWS-native services
The platform strategy governing where Kobie invests in cloud-native managed services, where portability is preserved, and how those trade-offs are made deliberately
The underlying infrastructure supporting Kobie’s AI delivery, including data movement, ingestion and onboarding patterns for structured and unstructured data, the Snowflake environment, and the DevOps pipelines that serve both traditional and AI-native workloads
Reliability, performance, and cost outcomes across the environment, with corresponding budget authority and accountability
What you need to be successful
Required:
10+ years leading infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform organizations, with at least 5 years in senior leadership at the Director level or above
Extensive hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating AWS-based solutions in large-scale production environments.
Proven leadership experience guiding cloud strategy, architecture, and operational excellence within AWS ecosystems.
Demonstrated ownership of at least one significant cloud migration (data center to cloud, cloud to cloud, or major re-platforming) with measurable cost and reliability outcomes
Track record of cloud cost optimization and FinOps discipline, including material savings delivered against a committed spend baseline
Experience owning the infrastructure supporting modern data and AI workloads, including data platforms (Snowflake or equivalent), data movement and ingestion patterns for structured and unstructured data, and DevOps pipelines for AI-native workloads
Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams, including offshore or nearshore capacity
Experience influencing peer executives and cross-functional leaders on architectural direction and technology investment
SaaS or productized platform experience preferred; financial services, loyalty, or regulated-industry exposure is a plus
Strongly Preferred:
SaaS or productized platform experience preferred; financial services, loyalty, or regulated-industry exposure is a plus
Experience with at least one additional hyperscale cloud platform (e.g., Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform).
Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.
A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!
Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.
Ready to join us? If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!

jobs.title: VP of Design
jobs.text:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.
We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.
Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:
Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.
With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.
Position description
Sonar is looking for a VP of Design to own the end-to-end design vision and execution across our product portfolio. Reporting to the CPO, this is Sonar's most senior design leadership role, responsible for setting design strategy, scaling a high-performing global design organization, and ensuring our products deliver an exceptional, cohesive experience for developers and enterprise customers alike. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to translate customer needs and market trends into design decisions that drive measurable business impact.
What you will do
Own the end-to-end product design vision, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, and overall platform evolution across Sonar's product line.
Define and drive a design strategy that ties directly to measurable business outcomes, working with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments. Track and report on design's impact on key business and product metrics.
Build, scale, and lead a global design organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing design talent to foster a high-performing, creative, and inclusive team culture.
Champion and evolve Sonar's design systems and UX best practices, ensuring consistency and quality across a complex, technical, developer-facing product suite.
Guide the design approach for agentic and AI-driven features, ensuring the team understands emerging patterns and best practices in this space.
Engage directly with customers, users, and industry leaders to gather insights, and translate those insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.
Represent design at the executive level, communicating strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership and cross-functional, global stakeholders.
Partner with Product Management and Engineering to ensure design is embedded early in the product development process, not bolted on at the end.
Experience and qualifications
7+ years of management experience in product design, UX, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading and scaling teams globally.
Demonstrated success in end-to-end product design leadership, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, strategic product thinking, and platform evolution.
Deep expertise in design systems and UX best practices, including experience designing for developer tools, API based tools, or similar technical/complex products.
Good understanding of the agentic domain and how it shapes product and design decisions.
Experience defining design strategy that drives measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive leadership, cross-functional teams, and global stakeholders.
Proven ability to mentor and develop design talent, fostering a high-performing, creative, and inclusive global design culture.
Deep understanding of customer needs and market trends, with experience engaging directly with users and industry leaders to translate insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.
Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.
We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.
Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.title: Head of Product (H/F)
jobs.text:
Ta mission 🎯
En tant que Head of Product, tu seras amené·e à guider nos clients (Decathlon, Carrefour, SeLoger, Chanel, Deezer, ...) dans leur transformation Produit et l’amélioration de leurs pratiques, soit en immersion au sein des équipes, soit en tant que Coach ou expert Produit.
Tu seras également le Manager / la Manageuse d'une équipe chez Thiga pour faire d'eux·elles les meilleur·e·s consultant·e·s & Product People possibles !
Tu auras pour mission de :
- coacher et accompagner des équipes Produit chez ton client pour les faire gagner en maturité Product Management par la mise en place et la diffusion de bonnes pratiques ;
- évaluer la maturité produit d’équipes en place et proposer un plan d’action approprié pour optimiser l’organisation et les processus Produit ;
- cadrer et lancer un nouveau produit ou challenger et améliorer un produit existant ;
- déployer une vision long terme et coordonner la réalisation concrète de la roadmap ;
- encadrer ton équipe de Thiguys·girls avec du temps dédié pour permettre à tout Thiguy·girl d’être dans les meilleures conditions pour son développement professionnel et s’assurer de son épanouissement.
Compétences métier 🖇
Tu as déjà managé et, après une période d’onboarding, tu accompagneras et encadreras ton équipe de consultant·e·s Thiga.
Tu établis la stratégie et la vision produit.
Tu définis la roadmap et planifies les futures versions de ton produit avec une stratégie user-centric, orientée problèmes et outcomes.
Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et le Lean Startup.
Tu sais interpréter les KPI mesurant la performance de ton produit et en déduire l’impact sur les utilisateurs.
Tu peux accompagner ton équipe dans la définition de ses OKR.
Tu collabores avec des Product Designers pour concevoir l’expérience utilisateur et créer les interfaces web ou mobile, tu sais préparer des tests utilisateurs.
Tu connais et utilises des techniques de priorisations (Rice, MoSCow, Kano…).
Tu es à l'aise sur le Product Delivery et l'ensemble des rituels Agiles.
Compétences relationnelles 🎙
La communication : tu donnes de la visibilité et t’exprimes de manière synthétique en étant également à l’écoute des autres.
La diplomatie : tu sais défendre tes idées et tes convictions & gérer les relations entre différentes parties prenantes. Tu sais faire preuve d’assertivité.
La curiosité : tu t’informes des nouveautés et des meilleures pratiques en Product Management.
L’humilité : tu sais te remettre en question et apprendre de tes erreurs pour mieux évoluer.
Shameless : tu parles français couramment tout en ayant un bon niveau d’anglais même si quand tu prononces beer, bird, bear ou beard ça se termine en quiproquo 🍺 🐥 🐻 🧔🏻
Expériences 📇
Idéalement, tu as minimum 6 ans d’expérience dans une structure Produit (avec de la Product Discovery comme du Product Delivery).
Tu as déjà managé (en direct) et / ou tu justifies d’au moins une expérience de Product Leader (Head of Product, Lead PM,...) dans ton parcours.
Nous offrons 🎊
Un On-boarding d'une semaine pour rencontrer tes collègues dont 3 jours de formation pour bien démarrer.
Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon le client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.
Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Squad-building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).
De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année et beaucoup de contenus pour te faire monter en compétences, notamment un programme de formation dédié aux Product Leaders avec des modules permettant de maîtriser toutes les facettes de ce rôle (coaching, OKR, organisation Produit, stratégie Produit).
Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.
Les étapes 🎢
Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.
On te rencontre en personne ou par visio avec un·e dirigeant·e de l'équipe Thiga (Associé, Partner ou Principal) pour valider tes acquis.
Une étude de cas avec deux consultant·e·s du niveau Manager ou Principal afin de confirmer ce que tu sais mettre en pratique.
Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝
Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.text:
About the Role
Millions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance. As AI reshapes professional work, our customers expect software that is more intelligent, integrated and effective. Meeting those expectations requires rethinking how products are discovered, built, launched, measured and improved.
This newly created role reflects Wolters Kluwer's commitment to transforming how products are built in the age of AI. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Product Strategy & Transformation, you will help lead that evolution from the Corporate Strategy Office. Working in a small enterprise team, you will partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to strengthen the Product System and improve customer value, business outcomes and speed of innovation. A key focus will be advancing the Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (Agentic PDLC), using AI across product development. You will combine deep product expertise with a hands-on transformation mindset to implement and scale change.
How You Will Work
This is a senior individual-contributor role, leading through expertise, coaching, facilitation and influence. You will embed with business-unit teams on high-priority lighthouse initiatives, apply modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows, and turn proven approaches into reusable tools and operating practices for broader adoption.
The role can be based remotely in any country where Wolters Kluwer has an office and will require travel of approximately 35% to work directly with teams and stakeholders.
What You Will Do
Partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities and connect product decisions to customer and business outcomes.
Define, pilot and scale Wolters Kluwer's Agentic PDLC and broader AI-enabled product development capabilities.
Lead lighthouse engagements across product strategy, discovery, experimentation, delivery, launch and measurement.
Embed with cross-functional teams to diagnose barriers, build trust and translate insight into practical change.
Coach product leaders and improve operating models, portfolio practices, governance and metrics.
Turn effective practices into repeatable tools, learning experiences and standards for enterprise adoption.
Establish success measures, demonstrate impact and use evidence to guide broader rollout.
Required Experience & Qualifications
8+ years of hands-on Product Management and/or Product Leadership experience in B2B software, SaaS or technology companies.
Ownership of strategy and outcomes for a substantial product, platform or portfolio, from customer discovery through delivery and measurement.
A track record of leading cross-functional product, engineering and design teams to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
Strong product craft across discovery, strategy, experimentation, prioritization, roadmaps, launch and measurement.
Recent hands-on experience building AI-enabled or agentic products, transforming product development workflows through AI, or both.
Ability to enter unfamiliar contexts, diagnose root causes, build trust and translate insight into action.
Proven influence on product direction, operating models or organizational effectiveness beyond a single team, without relying on formal authority.
Strong analytical, communication, storytelling and facilitation skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity and align senior leaders.
Preferred Experience
Leading product transformation, operating-model change or organizational scaling initiatives.
Coaching product leaders and strengthening product management practices.
Working across multiple businesses, portfolios or complex matrixed organizations.
Scaling reusable capabilities such as playbooks, metrics, communities of practice or leadership-development programs.
What Makes Someone Successful
Customer obsessed and focused on solving meaningful professional problems.
Passionate about product craft and motivated by helping multiple teams become more effective.
Curious, adaptable and energized by ambiguity, with high ownership and a bias toward action.
Strong product judgment balanced with evidence-based decision-making.
Pragmatic and hands-on, able to challenge the status quo, build followership and move from strategy to implementation.
Why This Role Matters
This role is designed for accomplished product leaders who have successfully built products, led teams and delivered meaningful business outcomes and are ready to extend their impact beyond a single product, platform or portfolio. Rather than owning one roadmap, you will help shape how product strategy, discovery, delivery and AI-enabled product development are practiced across a global software company. Your influence will be reflected not only in individual initiatives, but in stronger teams, faster learning, better decision-making and improved outcomes for the millions of professionals who rely on Wolters Kluwer every day.
If you are motivated by helping define product excellence, shaping AI-native ways of working and influencing the future of product development at enterprise scale, this is a unique opportunity to leave a lasting imprint across an entire global portfolio.
Our Interview Practices
To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.
Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
Compensation:
$137,900.00 - $246,350.00 USDThis role is eligible for Bonus.
Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.
Additional Information:
Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.
Originally posted on Himalayas
