jobs.title: Director, Developer Success Engineering
jobs.text:
About Docker
Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.
_______________________________________________________________________
The Role
The Director, Developer Success Engineering leads the technical half of Docker's Developer Success team: the senior engineers who build the demos, Labspaces, workshops, tech talks and technical content that show developers what Docker can do. This role gives that team a leader who can go deep on the technology, raise the bar on technical quality, and grow senior engineers in their careers. It owns three outcomes:
Own Docker's technical story for developers. Demos, Labspaces, reference applications and content that make AI Governance, Sandboxes, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience easy to understand and adopt.
Turn technical content into adoption and revenue. Equip customer-facing teams, Captains and partners with enablement that lands and expands accounts, and measure its impact.
Be the developer's voice inside Docker. Bring hands-on feedback from developers, Captains and customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what Docker builds.
You will be part of the DevRel team's mission for Docker to become the destination where current and future developers improve their craft, get support and find their community home. You report to the VP of Developer Success (DevRel & Docs) and lead a team of four staff and principal engineers. You work side by side with the Director, Developer Success Programmes, whose team runs the community, Captain, influencer and partner programmes your team's technical work powers.
You'll be successful if you are an engineer at heart who loves building and explaining technology, and who wants to multiply that impact through a team. The FY27 centre of gravity is product adoption and revenue enablement, not awareness metrics alone.
_______________________________________________________________________
Responsibilities
Own Docker's technical story for developers
Set the technical content strategy for Developer Success, aligned with Docker's product priorities: agentic development with Sandboxes, AI Governance, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience.
Own the developer-facing product narrative for Captain briefings and launches, so the team delivers most briefings and demos itself rather than relying on ad hoc presenters.
Lead the Labspaces catalogue as Docker's reusable demo and learning format: every strategic demo, briefing, talk and workshop is packaged once and reused across Captains, revenue, partners, events and Docs.
Set technical quality standards for demos, code samples, reference apps and tutorials, including how they are tested, kept current with fast-moving products, and retired.
Partner with Docs on hands-on learning content on docs.docker.com, including the Learn experience.
Turn technical content into adoption and revenue
Scale the technical enablement content for customer-facing teams: tech talks, Docker Days, SDLC demos and workshops, prioritised with Revenue leadership on a regular cadence.
Equip Solutions Engineers, Professional Services, Captains and partners to deliver Docker's story themselves, with kits that cut their demo preparation time.
Track the impact of technical enablement on product adoption, pipeline and expansion ARR, and report it alongside the programmes team.
Bring the team's technical depth to tier-1 events, partner work and the community programmes run by the Developer Success Programmes team.
Be the developer's voice inside Docker
Build structured feedback loops from developers, Captains and customers into Product and Engineering, including pre-launch reviews of new features.
Test new products early, report friction in the developer experience, and follow it through to fixes.
Represent Docker credibly in technical forums: conference talks, open source communities, technical blogs and developer communities.
Lead the team
Lead and grow a team of senior developer advocates and engineers: set clear goals, give technical and career coaching, and build growth paths for senior individual contributors.
Balance the team's capacity between strategic content, revenue enablement and inbound requests through a clear intake and prioritisation process.
Hire to fill capability gaps as Docker's product portfolio grows.
_______________________________________________________________________
Qualifications
A software engineering background, with deep hands-on knowledge of containers, Docker and modern developer workflows. You can build and debug a demo yourself.
Working knowledge of AI and agentic development (LLMs, agents, MCP) and of software supply chain security. Experience in either is a strong plus.
Experience leading a team of senior engineers, developer advocates or solutions engineers, and a track record of growing senior individual contributors.
A strong technical public presence: conference talks, workshops, technical writing or open source contributions.
Experience building technical enablement for sales, solutions or customer success teams, and tying it to adoption or revenue outcomes.
Ability to build trusted relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and to influence roadmaps with evidence from developers.
Analytical and data-driven in how you prioritise and measure technical content and programmes.
Able to coordinate across many teams and perform in a fast-moving environment; self-directed, self-driven and able to prioritise strongly.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
_______________________________________________________________________
What to expect
First 30 days
Get to know each team member, their technical focus areas, current work and career goals.
Get hands-on with Docker's products, especially Sandboxes, AI Governance and Docker Hardened Images, and run the team's top Labspaces and demos yourself.
Meet key stakeholders in Product, Engineering, Revenue, Professional Services, Docs and the Developer Success Programmes team, and learn what they need from technical Developer Success.
Live the Docker culture: humility, developer obsession, open collaboration and a bias for considered action.
First 90 days
Set the team's technical content and enablement roadmap for the next two quarters, tied to product priorities and launch cadence.
Put in place an intake and prioritisation process with Revenue and Product so the team's capacity goes to the highest-impact work.
Agree the measures that link the team's work to adoption and revenue, such as Labspace usage by account and ARR influenced by tech talks.
Become a trusted technical partner to Product, Engineering and marketing leadership.
First year
Deliver a consistent, current catalogue of demos, Labspaces and talks that tells Docker's story across AI, security and developer productivity.
Show a measurable link from technical enablement to product adoption and expansion revenue.
Establish a regular feedback channel from developers and Captains that visibly influences Docker's product roadmap.
Grow a team of senior engineers and advocates with clear career paths, recognised internally and externally for technical excellence.
Help Docker succeed in its vision to increase the time developers spend on innovation and decrease the time they spend on everything else.
Visa sponsorship: Not available for this role.
_______________________________________________________________________
Compensation & Equity
All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.
Canada: CA$303,450 - CA$433,500 base
United States: $218,750 - $375,000 base
Europe: €149,100 - €213,000 base
______________________________________________________________________
Posting Information
Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.
______________________________________________________________________
Perks & Benefits
Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.
Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.
Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.
Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.
Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.
#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology? As Head of Data at Digital Forms, you will be responsible for translating business goals into measurable outcomes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their challenges, design actionable KPIs, and implement the data flows and dashboards needed to drive decision-making. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on data expertise, and outstanding communication skills. You’ll be a key player in delivering high-impact digital transformation solutions for our international clients.
Requirements
Responsibilities
Lead the company’s data strategy in alignment with business objectives and client goals.
Work closely with clients to understand their business context, define success metrics, and design clear, actionable KPIs.
Design and implement efficient data flows, pipelines, and architectures for business intelligence and reporting.
Build and manage dashboards that support executive-level decision-making and operational optimization.
Translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including tech, marketing, and sales, to deliver data-driven solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting, and automation internally and for clients.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
Proven experience in designing and implementing dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, or similar.
Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and modern data stacks.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and SQL proficiency.
Ability to design scalable data architectures and optimize performance across systems.
Demonstrated ability to set up data tracking and analytics for digital transformation use cases.
Soft Skills:
Excellent spoken and written English; able to work closely with international clients.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business goals and turn them into data solutions.
Comfortable leading discovery sessions, presenting insights, and defining success metrics with clients.
Clear, structured communicator who can explain data concepts to non-technical audiences.
Organized and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
Highlights
Lead the data strategy behind impactful digital transformation projects, translating business goals into measurable outcomes through smart KPIs, clear dashboards, and scalable data architecture.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Viseven Group is a leading global B2B MarTech service provider, empowering Pharma and LifeScience companies since 2009. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and excellence, offering comprehensive end-to-end software and digital marketing services tailored to the pharmaceutical industry. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies.
At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success.
With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele.
Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe.
Role description: Viseven is looking for a Head of Product to own and drive the success of the entire products and services portfolio, create synergies across solutions, and increase overall portfolio value and profitability.
Responsibilities:
Define and lead product portfolio vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals and a coherent value proposition.
Decide portfolio composition (invest/grow/maintain/change/sunset) to maximize market opportunity and business impact, ensuring products synergy and competitive advantage.
Continuously analyze market trends, competition, customer needs, stakeholder insights and synthesize it into product decisions and choices.
Identify and validate new product and business opportunities, including building business cases and managing new products before they are transferred to separate business lines.
Oversee product lifecycle (development, launch, evolution), balancing innovation and improvement.
Monitor and manage product performance (revenue, profitability, adoption, retention) and optimize accordingly.
Set cross-product priorities and allocate resources based on impact, ROI, and strategic fit, including the balance between building core and customer desired functionality.
Build and lead the product management function, including capabilities, standards, and best practices organization-wide, owning and building company-wide expertise related to products knowledge and product application.
Align and active cooperate with cross-functional stakeholders to drive go-to-market, customer acquisition and retention, adoption, and overall portfolio growth.
Hard skills required:
5+ years in product management with leadership of multi-product SaaS portfolios; MarTech/Pharma or regulated domain experience preferred.
Proven ownership of portfolio strategy and P&L, including product launches and scaling in international markets.
Strong strategic and analytical skills: portfolio decisions (invest/grow/sunset), business cases, pricing, ROI, SaaS metrics.
Deep product management expertise (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization, experimentation) across full product lifecycle.
Experience balancing innovation vs. optimization and core vs. customer-driven development.
Ability to build and scale product organizations, define standards, and develop product managers.
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment in a multinational environment.
Clear communication and data-driven, customer-centric, outcome-oriented mindset.
Soft skills required:
Both in-depth and agile mindset.
Strong leadership, planning, effective management of self and the team.
Advanced communication and presentation skills.
Great team player – optimistic, organized, flexible, helpful.
Wholistic, creative and critical thinking – ability to develop and create new ideas, systems, and relationships for the success of the company, analyze root causes and provide solutions.
What we provide:
We know our team members are key to achieving our goals, so we value and empower them to share their vision. We reward this passion with exceptional benefits, including:
Competitive Compensation: Regular performance-based salary and career development reviews.
Experienced Team: Join a passionate, experienced team in a friendly atmosphere.
Career Growth: Opportunities for professional and career advancement.
Paid Time Off: 18 business days per year (20 business days after 2 years of service).
Sick Leave:
Non-documented: 4 business days per year.
Documented: 20 business days per year.
Family Leave: 3 paid business days for marriage, childbirth, or bereavement.
Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage.
English Courses: Learning opportunities to improve your language skills.
Professional Development: Participation in forums and conferences.
Corporate Events: Regular team-building activities and events.
Work Environment: Enjoy a comfortable, fully equipped office and the possibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions & Engineering
jobs.text:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US
Role Overview
Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader to guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. This dual mandate combines solution architecture with organizational leadership, bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.
As department head, this person will assume direct leadership of the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure, with particular emphasis on Snowflake and modern cloud data architecture.
On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable solution approaches, support pre-sales technical strategy, and help ensure complex opportunities are well-defined and feasible.
This role is ideal for a strong technologist with leadership instincts—someone who can own a technical function, contribute meaningfully to client conversations, and bring structure to how Statara designs and delivers solutions. You don’t need to have done all of this before, but you should be ready to grow into the full scope.
Key Responsibilities
Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering
Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, and data product quality
Drive continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and modern data workflows across the organization
Align engineering and data product priorities with commercial objectives and the broader product roadmap
Solution Architecture & Strategy
Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through high-level design and delivery planning
Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases
Client & Pre-Sales Support
Partner with Business Development to scope opportunities, clarify technical requirements, and assess feasibility
Participate in client conversations as a technical resource, translating capabilities into clear business value
Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities
Feasibility & Validation
Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence
Cross-Functional Alignment
Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to align solution designs with platform capabilities and delivery realities
Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams
What Success Looks Like
The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear direction, strong execution, and alignment to company priorities
Snowflake-based data infrastructure is reliable, well-maintained, and evolving to meet growing demands
Client opportunities are scoped accurately and efficiently, with strong technical grounding
Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
The solutions function becomes more repeatable, effective, and scalable over time
Requirements
We’re looking for demonstrated technical depth and sound judgment—earned through real exposure to complex problems—more than a specific career path or title history.
Snowflake working experience required. You should have hands-on working knowledge of Snowflake. You don’t need to be a certified architect, but you need to be able to contribute to technical decisions confidently in a Snowflake-centric environment.
Experience in solutions engineering, data engineering, analytics, data products, or a related technical role
Familiarity with data integration, pipelines, data modeling, and solution architecture concepts
Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics workflows; AWS environment experience is a plus, as is Alteryx
Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and executable solution plans
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with complex datasets
Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Team leadership experience required—whether through direct management, tech-lead roles, or running cross-functional workstreams. Formal people-management experience is preferred but not the only path.
Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, or analytics functions is a strong plus
Plus: Background in data onboarding, identity resolution, audience strategy, martech/adtech, or measurement partnerships. Experience in activation, programmatic, or audience deployment.
Benefits
We believe that a diverse, inclusive staff is a fundamental strength. We’re committed to hiring people of all races, ethnicities, religions, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientations, and gender identities. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and members of untapped groups are strongly encouraged to apply and are welcome on our teams.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require an accommodation to apply for or interview for this position, please let us know (email Gideon at ).
We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.
COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION
Including a 401(k) with generous company matching.
100% REMOTE WORKING OPPORTUNITY
Always have been and always will be.
TOP-NOTCH MEDICAL COVERAGE
Domestic-partner inclusive, health, dental, vision, life, cancer coverage, and long-term disability insurance for you and your dependents.
GENEROUS PAID TIME OFF
23 days of PTO per year. We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to use your time off.
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE
10 weeks of fully paid time off. All genders qualify equally, and the policy includes adoptions.

jobs.text:
AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.
Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person – everywhere!
The Company:
Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.
What’s in it for you:
Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP, a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.
Address:
Ontario
The Sr. Director, Product Manager is a senior leadership role reporting to the Head of Product Management, responsible for leading strategic product initiatives and driving product excellence across the Digital Product organization. This role provides deep product leadership for critical customer-facing products and platforms while building product management capabilities, establishing best practices, and mentoring product teams throughout the organization.
The Sr. Director serves as a key strategic partner to executive leadership, translating business strategy into product vision and roadmaps that deliver measurable customer and business value. This position requires balancing hands-on product ownership with organizational leadership, coaching product managers, and driving consistent product discipline across teams.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Product Strategy & Leadership
Define and own multi-year product strategy aligned with EZCORP’s business and operating objectives.
Translate executive priorities into structured product roadmaps and investment plans.
Ensure consistent prioritization across platforms based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and operational efficiency.
Customer & Business Outcomes
Champion a customer-centric approach grounded in measurable business outcomes.
Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, digital adoption, and revenue performance.
Improve operational efficiency across store and corporate workflows.
Ensure product performance is measured, reviewed, and continuously improved.
Team Leadership & Development
Lead and develop senior product leaders, including Directors and Group Product Managers.
Establish consistent product management standards, governance, and accountability.
Build leadership depth and succession readiness within the product organization.
Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, and execution discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
About Avo
Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence-based decision-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high-quality care. Avo changes that.
We are product-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities.
The Role
Avo is hiring a Senior Director of Product to lead product strategy and execution across our platform. This is a leadership role and the ideal candidate will work with our CPO to refine, and operationalize Avo's product vision, driving roadmap decisions that accelerate customer value and long-term platform differentiation. You’ll work directly with our Engineering, Product, Clinical , Customer, and Commercial teams to shape what we build and ship fast.
You will report directly to our Co-Founder/CPO and be a key voice in how Avo evolves its AI copilots, clinical decision support capabilities, and enterprise platform. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped complex, technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving environment - ideally in healthcare or with a deep interest in clinical workflows - and who thrives owning problems end-to-end rather than coordinating around them.
Avo operates as a highly distributed organization, this leader will also be responsible for driving alignment and execution across Product and Engineering teams spanning the United States and South Korea, ensuring strong collaboration, communication, and delivery across multiple time zones.
What You'll Do
Drive the product roadmap across Avo’s suite of products and platform infrastructure, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation
Translate insights from customers, clinicians, sales, and the market into a clear product direction, turning complex clinical workflows and user needs into actionable product requirements and differentiated customer value.
Translate complex clinical use cases into product requirements that engineering can act on and customers can clearly recognize
Demonstrate deep expertise and understanding in UI/UX design by translating complex clinical workflows and product functionality into intuitive, scalable, and customer-centric experiences. Lead the application of user-centered design best practices, driving usability, adoption, and measurable customer value through thoughtful interaction and visual design
Partner with implementation and customer success to close the loop between what we promise, what we ship, and what actually works at the bedside
Work hand-in-hand with engineering leads to scope, sequence, and ship features - from early spec through rollout and iteration, tracking adoption and engagement and various impact metrics
Drive clarity on requirements and tradeoffs, unblocking engineering rather than adding process.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across distributed Product and Engineering teams , establishing effective operating rhythms and communication practices that enable rapid execution across time zones
Maintain a strong perspective on emerging AI technologies, market trends, and competitive dynamics to help define where Avo product should lead
Contribute to sales cycles and customer conversations as a product authority, helping close and retain enterprise accounts.
Mentor junior product team members and help build Avo's product culture as the team scales
What You Bring
7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead PM role
Experience in clinical decision support, or enterprise SaaS serving regulated industries, a plus
Hands-on experience building or managing AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how LLM capabilities and limitations impact user-facing workflows and UX
Track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products and iterating them to scale
Strong instincts for product strategy - you can identify the right problem to solve before prescribing the solution.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you write crisp specs, give clear demos, and can hold your own in a room with health system executives
Experience working closely with engineering and clinical teams - you understand technical architecture well enough to have useful tradeoff conversations
Prior experience at a startup or high-growth company, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move quickly
Comfortable working across US and Asia-Pacific time zones, including early morning or evening hours as needed
Periodic travel to Korea 2–3 times per year, approximately one week per trip. This is not symbolic travel; dedicated in-person engagement is a core responsibility of the role.
Why Join Avo
Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.
Ownership: You will own the execution of our product roadmap from clinical discovery through roadmap decisions, launch, and iteration
High Agency: We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy.
Great Team: Work alongside a talented, low-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft.
Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you’re in the area we’d love the chance to work in-person together 2 days/week.
How We Take Care of Our Team
Generous Time Off: Flexible and generous PTO
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
401K Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future
Personal Device Allowance: Tax-free funds for personal device usage
Compensation and Equity: $200,000 - $225,000 base salary and equity
Avo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Commercial Systems
jobs.text:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Director, who strives for taking ownership of the development and operations of internal software products serving Canonical business and a popular security solution Livepatch. A successful candidate has a track record of delivering full-stack software services, adheres to high engineering quality standards, and continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports. This is an exciting opportunity to work with highly enthusiastic people on exciting innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth and learn a lot about engineering for the business.
The engineering director will lead the Commercial Systems unit that is conceived as three engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business. We are looking for a software engineering director to oversee the three software teams led by software engineering managers.
The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business and payment systems.
The Contracts team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that will become the single source of truth for all contracts with all customers. The service provides a standardized CPQ capability and stores signed contracts in a structured format. The service further integrates with other engineering and business systems including a CRM system and an accounting system.
The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails
Leading multiple teams of engineers, ranging from graduates to seniors
Developing your engineering managers to maintain Canonical culture in their teams
Developing and evangelize great engineering practices and processes in the teams
Setting and implementing solid performance management with performance goals and objectives with your direct reports and teams
Identifying and measuring indicators of team health, and take action where needed
Being accountable for the product development roadmaps in the teams
Being an active part of the Commercial Systems leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
Expanding your teams by hiring great talent
Collaborating with stakeholders and product users
What we are looking for in you
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
Proven ability to drive multiple teams or large teams of software engineers to deliver outstanding results
Engineering experience in at least one of the following areas: Golang, Python, Java, or distributed integrations
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
Performance engineering and DevOps/SRE experience
Experience with accounting, sales, sales operations, or other business roles
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Program
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Data Governance and Analytics Architecture Director
jobs.text:
Overview
The Data Governance & Analytics Architecture Director is a leader within the Health Enablement Analytics organization responsible for ensuring all data, analytics, and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, standardized, and governed foundation. This role serves as a subject matter expert for data governance, analytics architecture, and AI/ML best practices across Health Enablement. This role provides advisory leadership, technical guidance, and architecture standards to ensure analytics and innovation efforts are aligned to enterprise data strategy and built in a scalable, sustainable manner.
This position operates as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Analytics, and Reporting teams helping shape how solutions are designed and delivered; enabling Health Enablement Analytics to operate as a reliable, high-impact capability, driving measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Data Governance & Standards
Contribute to the development of data governance standards, and best practices across analytics and reporting.
Provide guidance on data quality, consistency, and appropriate use of enterprise data assets.
Support the standardization of data models, business metrics, and reusable data assets to improve consistency and efficiency.
Implement governance frameworks, ensuring policies are embedded into day-to-day data and analytics workflows.
Establish clear data stewardship accountability across business and analytics teams.
Oversee data quality processes, metadata management, and governance monitoring to ensure sustained data integrity.
Serve as the primary point of contact for Information Governance, data risk, and compliance alignment.
Data Architecture & Platform Alignment
Drive standardization of data assets to reduce fragmentation and enable consistent cross-domain insights.
Provide subject matter expertise on analytics architecture across BI, reporting, and advanced analytics.
Partner with teams to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise data platforms and long‑term strategy.
Recommend architectural approaches that support scalability, interoperability, and reuse.
Technical Enablement & Scalable Delivery
Serve as a technical SME contributing to AI/ML standards and best practices.
Provide guidance to ensure analytic and AI solutions are designed for scalability and sustainability.
Advise on approaches to monitor performance, manage technical debt, and identify architectural risk.
Assess technical feasibility of innovation and analytics initiatives and provide input on viable solution approaches.
Consult on solution design to support production readiness and scalability.
Identify constraints in data or architecture and propose practical workarounds to enable business outcomes.
Define guardrails that enable faster decision-making and reduce execution friction.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Serve as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Data Science, Reporting, and broader enterprise teams.
Translate business and analytics requirements into technical solutions and executable designs.
Provide input on feasibility, architecture, and standards to support solution development.
Collaborate across teams to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise direction while meeting business needs.

jobs.text:
Description
We're seeking an exceptional, hands-on Data Scientist with deep expertise in data science, MLOps, and building GenAI solutions to join our Enterprise Data & Data Science team. In this role, you'll identify, evaluate, and develop solutions at the intersection of data science, generative AI, and enterprise data strategy—including GenAI evaluation frameworks and semantic data layers. You'll also serve as a community champion, driving the adoption of best practices across a large, collaborative data science organization.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and evaluate generative AI solutions and agentic systems
Develop and maintain data semantic layers and knowledge graphs for enterprise-scale data accessibility
Build evaluation frameworks and tools to assess GenAI systems' performance, reliability, and safety
Collaborate with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and business partners
Champion best practices and tooling across a broad data science community
Lead cross-functional working groups and contribute to innovation in AI/ML methods
Communicate complex technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Serve as a technical consultant on complex, high-impact projects
Please note this is an individual contributor role
Qualifications
Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
Preferred Experience:
Strong foundation in data science and machine learning
Proven MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle
Experience building GenAI solutions and agentic systems
Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies
Experience with data semantic layers and/or knowledge graphs
Track record of cross-functional collaboration in a large enterprise environment
Ability to work ET hours

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. jobs.title: VP, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges
Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Who are we?
Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.
The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.
Reporting line and scope
You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.
The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.
What will you do?
Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.
Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.
Requirements
What do you bring to the table?
Must have
12+ years in software engineering, including several years leading multi-team organizations through managers.
Distributed-systems and platform architecture ownership at scale — multi-tenant isolation, service decomposition, and the judgment to reduce complexity.
Domain depth in scientific or biomedical data platforms — genomics, bioinformatics, life sciences, or comparable data-intensive, workflow-driven scientific computing.
Delivery inside a regulatory boundary such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or GxP.
Reliability and modern delivery engineering: SLOs, error budgets, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with policy-as-code and progressive rollout.
Production AI/LLM capability shipped under a compliance regime, or AI-assisted engineering you landed, governed and measured — beyond pilots.
A track record of setting technical vision for a platform and carrying an organization there.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
CWL/WDL/Nextflow, GA4GH standards (DRS/WES), FHIR or OMOP.
Federated or cross-institutional data access at scale — bringing analysis to data held by someone else.
Federal program delivery and artifact literacy — authorization packages, significant-change requests, and corrective-action plans.
Architecture depth in inference topology: hosting trade-offs, retrieval that inherits per-tenant authorization, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails.
Shipping reusable product capability out of grant- or program-funded work.
Competences
Vision
The ability to step back from the daily routine, explore ideas for the future, and see the platform in a broader context and in the longer term.
articulates where the platform must be in three years, and why
combines scientific, regulatory, and technology trends into one coherent direction
spots opportunities for the platform early and acts on them
Technical Depth
Personal command of the technology the platform is built on, enough to shape and challenge its biggest decisions.
reads code, designs, and test results first-hand rather than relying on summaries
changes a team’s technical direction with evidence rather than authority
is treated as a peer by senior engineers in design review
Managing
The ability to lead and develop others so they perform at their best — setting direction, providing the means, and holding the bar.
builds a management layer capable of running delivery without them, then holds it accountable
makes hiring and performance decisions promptly and explains them plainly
builds confidence and momentum and creates a thriving team environment
Focus on Quality
Setting high standards and treating quality, security, and compliance as design constraints rather than gates to be cleared.
designs for auditability, traceability, and reproducibility from the outset
converts recurring incidents into architectural and process change
declines shortcuts that would trade a compliance position for a delivery date
Decision Quality Under Ambiguity
The ability to make timely, defensible decisions on incomplete information, and to revisit them when the evidence changes.
commits to a sequence when the data is partial, and states what would change their mind
separates reversible from irreversible decisions and spends attention accordingly
records the reasoning as well as the outcome
Benefits
Our core values
People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We practice empathy by treating others the way they want to be treated and assuming positive intent. We are proud of our inclusive diverse team and humble ourselves to learn about and build our connection with each other.
Patient focused. We act with swift determination without sacrificing our expectations of quality. We are driven by providing exceptional solutions for our customers to positively impact patient lives. Considering what is at stake, we challenge ourselves to develop the best solution, not just the easy one.
Integrity. We hold ourselves accountable and strive for transparent communication to build trust amongst ourselves and our customers. We take ownership of our results as we know what we do matters and collectively we will change the healthcare industry. We are thoughtful and intentional with every customer interaction understanding the overall impact on human health.
Curious. We ask questions and actively listen in order to learn and continuously improve. We embrace change and the opportunities it presents to make each other better. We strive to be on the cutting edge of science and technology innovation by encouraging creativity.
Impactful. We take our social responsibility with the seriousness it deserves and hold ourselves to a high standard. We improve our sustainability by encouraging discussion and taking action as it relates to our natural, social and economic resource footprint. We are devoted to our humanitarian mission and look for new ways to make the world a better place.
Velsera is an Equal Opportunity Employer:
Velsera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information

jobs.title: Director of Engineering- Integrated Sensor Team
jobs.text:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM
The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.
Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB
As Director of Engineering for GenLogs’ Integrated Sensor team, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling the hardware and software systems at the heart of our sensing network.
This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and cloud/software platforms. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.
You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.
This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.
WHAT YOU’LL DO Lead & Develop the Engineering Organization
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and software engineering.
Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.
Set Technical Direction
Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the Integrated Sensor product line across hardware, edge, and cloud systems.
Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.
Drive Product Delivery
Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.
Build Reliable, Scalable Systems
Ensure the Integrated Sensor platform is designed for reliability in demanding, real-world field environments.
Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.
Collaborate Across the Company
Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for the Integrated Sensor product line.
Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering talent.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
High effectiveness and communication working in a remote and distributed team.
English proficiency is required.
IDEAL CANDIDATE
You are a builder and a leader. You enjoy developing people and organizations while remaining technically engaged enough to understand complex systems and make sound technical decisions.
You think across the entire system. You can connect hardware, embedded software, edge systems, cloud infrastructure, and data into a cohesive product architecture.
You prioritize impact. You understand that engineering exists to solve meaningful customer and business problems, and you focus teams on delivering measurable outcomes.
You operate with urgency and ownership. You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, removing obstacles, and driving issues to resolution.
You raise the bar. You establish clear standards for engineering quality, reliability, execution, and accountability—and consistently hold yourself and your team to them.
You develop people. You invest in coaching, feedback, career development, and creating opportunities for engineers to take on greater responsibility.
You balance speed with durability. You know when to move quickly, when to invest in foundational work, and how to make pragmatic technical tradeoffs without accumulating unnecessary complexity.
You thrive in complexity. You are energized by systems that operate in the real world and understand that building reliable technology often requires solving problems across organizational and technical boundaries.
You communicate clearly. You can translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs for engineers, product leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You value transparency and collaboration. You actively seek input, give direct feedback, and build trust through clear communication and accountability.
You are curious and adaptable. You continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and look for better ways to build both technology and teams.
You are comfortable in a remote environment. You create clarity, alignment, and accountability across distributed teams without relying on proximity.
WHY GENLOGS
At GenLogs, you have the opportunity to build technology that operates at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. Our Integrated Sensor platform is foundational to our vision of creating ubiquitous visibility into the movement of commercial vehicles across the United States.
You will have a direct impact on the technology, people, and systems required to scale that network—and the opportunity to build an engineering organization capable of supporting one of the most ambitious sensing and intelligence platforms in freight.

jobs.title: Director Engineering, Retail Media& Marketplace
jobs.text:
About your tasks:
Shape Retail Media & Marketplace: Set the engineering direction across both domains, deciding where the platforms should converge to create the most value for brands, sellers and Redcare.
Lead and grow the organisation: Develop your Engineering Managers and their teams, shaping the organisation as the domains evolve while creating an environment with clear ownership and autonomy.
Drive engineering excellence: Own delivery, reliability, architecture and technical debt, continuously raising engineering maturity and enabling teams to move quickly without compromising quality.
Turn technology into commercial impact: Co-own roadmaps with Product and Commercial, connecting engineering priorities to outcomes such as take rate, advertiser ROAS, seller economics and contribution margin.
Own strategic partnerships: Lead engineering relationships with external platforms, integrators and agencies, including build/buy/partner decisions, integrations, SLAs and vendor performance.
About you:
You have 3+ years of experience leading multiple engineering teams through managers or leads and have successfully led organisations through significant change, such as merging domains, introducing new scope or replacing a platform.
You have led development of commercial B2B platforms such as a marketplace, retail media, ad tech, payments or a seller/partner platform, with experience across high-traffic and transactional systems.
You combine strong technical judgement with commercial thinking, connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes and confidently partnering with senior Product and Commercial stakeholders.
You care deeply about engineering excellence, can demonstrate measurable improvements you have driven, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, external partners and competing priorities. Strong English communication skills are essential.
About your benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:
Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers.
Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
Vacation: 30 days paid vacation per annum (plus another day on Rosenmontag) and the option to take unpaid vacation of up to 10 days (after one year working with us).
Corporate pension plan: We offer a company pension scheme and have a dedicated external consultant to offer you the best guidance and advice.
About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.
About the role:
Retail Media and Marketplace are two of Redcare Pharmacy’s fastest-growing and most strategically important domains — and this is your opportunity to shape how they evolve together. Leading an engineering organisation of around 40 engineers across 5–7 teams, you will decide where these two distinct platforms should converge to create a seamless experience for brands and sellers, and where they should remain separate to perform at their best.
This is a high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly influence our customer experience and commercial growth. Reporting to our Executive Director of Engineering / VP of Engineering, you will lead through two Engineering Managers and partner closely with Product and Commercial leadership to turn engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Head of Solution Engineering
jobs.text:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Head of Solution Engineering to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in an innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.
Responsibilities:
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Solution Engineers.
Provide technical leadership throughout all stages of client engagement: pre-sales, solution architecture, and implementation.
Act as a key technical consultant throughout the sales cycle: clearly and convincingly present product capabilities and business value to prospective clients.
Work closely with sales, product management, and development teams to design and deliver optimal client solutions.
Oversee the integration and implementation of solutions for clients, ensuring smooth and timely deployment.
Take into account all aspects when developing solutions: liquidity flows, execution models, risk parameters, and infrastructure compatibility.
Create and maintain up-to-date documentation, technical guides, and training materials for clients and internal teams.
Actively identify customer needs and suggest improvements based on feedback and market trends.
Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess team productivity and customer satisfaction levels.
Represent the company in technical meetings with external stakeholders, maintaining high standards of professionalism and technical expertise.
Requirements
Extensive technical experience in financial technology, trading platforms, risk management systems, and enterprise SaaS solutions.
Proven experience managing technical teams, preferably in solution engineering, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales within the financial sector.
Deep knowledge of liquidity aggregation, order routing, execution models, the FIX protocol, and trading system APIs.
Expertise in trading technologies and market infrastructure, particularly in the FX, CFD, and digital assets segments.
Familiarity with institutional platforms such as MetaTrader, cTrader, OneZero, PrimeXM, and proprietary OMS/EMS solutions.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business audiences.
A proactive, client-oriented mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a successful track record of working with diverse stakeholders.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Product Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our ScraperAPIteam, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
We recently acquired Traject Data, home of SerpWow and Rainforest API, and now run an end-to-end data pipeline: from proxy and scraping infrastructure through to structured, ready-to-use data APIs. The next chapter is turning that into one coherent, AI-native platform and we're looking for a CTPO to lead the combined 25-person product and engineering org through it. You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table, and be the person who understands the stack down to the proxy layer while also setting where the product goes next.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Get hands-on with the heart of the product: proxy dynamics and anti-bot evasion, working directly with our Head of Ops to optimise vendor relationships and build up capacity.
