jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Artificial Intelligence (AI)
jobs.text:
About Egen
Egen is a fast-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team.
Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.
Meet Egen
Life at Egen
Culture and Values at Egen
Career Development at Egen
Benefits at Egen
About the opportunity
We are seeking a high-impact Director of Engineering to spearhead a vital span of our AI Practice during a period of explosive growth. This is a dynamic player-coach role for a strategic engineering leader who excels at cultivating managerial talent and developing high-performing teams while staying directly engaged in transformative client delivery.
Our AI Practice comprises roughly 78 top-tier engineers across North America, Europe, and India, delivering cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions for global enterprise clients in healthcare, life sciences, hospitality, the public sector, and industrial markets. We don't just build proofs of concept—we architect and deploy robust, mission-critical production systems.
Role Overview
As our first dedicated engineering leader in this role, you will take full ownership of a team of roughly twenty engineers—shaping team structure, staffing engagements, and fostering accelerated professional growth. Beyond leading your span, you will partner with the AI Practice Lead to architect and refine practice-wide operational frameworks for hiring, onboarding, and continuous engineering enablement.
Reporting directly to the AI Practice Lead, you will work side-by-side with practice leadership, particularly during your initial two quarters. Approximately 50% of your role will be billable client engagement, positioning you as a high-value fractional advisor and platform leader across critical technical domains: AI SDLC, AI governance, agentic deployments, and cloud platform/pipeline architecture.
This position is tailored for a battle-tested leader with a proven track record of managing managers and engineering leaders. You have built and scaled the operational machinery that powers high-performing engineering organizations—and can showcase tangible, measurable outcomes from organizations that flourished under your design.
What You'll Do:
Span Leadership and People Management
Practice Machinery: Hiring, Onboarding, and Enablement
Hands-on Delivery and Client Engagement
Span Leadership and People Management
Empower and lead a dedicated span of roughly twenty world-class engineers.
Drive performance management, professional growth, career paths, and promotion pathways for everyone in your span in close alignment with the practice lead.
Serve as the primary leadership point of escalation for engineering challenges within your span.
Direct team staffing strategy in partnership with Resource Management and the practice lead, seamlessly matching engineering talent to high-impact engagements.
Oversee contractor operations to ensure smooth onboarding, strategic contract extensions, and healthy engagement delivery.
Mentor and coach team leads through crucial career conversations, performance coaching, and complex staffing decisions.
Practice Machinery: Hiring, Onboarding and Enablement
Spearhead the practice-wide hiring engine in collaboration with the practice lead: optimize interview panels, calibrate interviewer standards, expand capacity, prioritize top candidates, and elevate our partnership with Talent Acquisition.
Champion the entire career progression pipeline from onboarding to senior technical leader—refining mentorship, management enablement, and performance review cycles on top of existing practice frameworks.
Lead the practice's internal accelerator program alongside the practice lead, defining production-ready client standards, driving practice-wide adoption, and curating internal assets.
Hands-on Delivery and Client Engagement
Maintain an active billable portfolio (~50% focus) across strategic, fractional advisory and platform consulting roles spread intentionally across key client accounts.
Provide overarching technical leadership on AI SDLC initiatives—guiding client leadership in adopting modern AI tooling, setting standards of excellence, and measuring ROI.
Drive robust AI governance solutions within highly regulated industries, establishing comprehensive evaluation frameworks, observability platforms, audit trails, and production safety controls.
Architect enterprise platform and pipeline deployments, including agentic AI frameworks, automated promotion pipelines, and the operational infrastructure supporting them.
Serve as a trusted executive advisor to client engineering leaders, delivering expert guidance and constructively challenging technical approaches when needed.
What We're Looking For (Basic Qualifications)
12+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant leadership experience guiding full engineering organizations rather than single development teams.
Demonstrated experience managing engineering leaders and managers, with a track record of scaling teams and organizational structures effectively.
Proven ability to build high-functioning organizational infrastructure—recruiting engines, onboarding programs, engineering standards, and career pathways—with measurable outcomes.
Deep technical strength in platform, pipeline, and infrastructure architecture required to command respect and direct technical strategy in executive client settings.
Hands-on expertise deploying production AI/ML systems, with primary focus on platform architecture, MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, governance, and operational resilience over pure model research.
Deep Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, or the proven technical agility to master our GCP-centric delivery stack rapidly.
Sharp consulting acumen: adept at managing ambiguity, navigating client-facing dynamics, leading concurrent engagements, and balancing business drivers.
Preferred Qualifications
Professional services experience preferred.
Collaborative mindset and comfort partnering closely with practice leadership during a transitional quarter as operational authority shifts.
Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence C-suite client stakeholders and internal executive leadership alike.
Compensation & Benefits:
This role is eligible for our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being:
- Comprehensive Health Insurance
- Paid Leave (Vacation/PTO)
- Paid Holidays
- Sick Leave
- Parental Leave
- Bereavement Leave
- 401 (k) Employer Match
- Employee Referral Bonuses
Check out our complete list of benefits here - >
Important:All roles are subject to standard hiring verification practices, which may include background checks, employment verification, and other relevant checks.
EEO and Accommodations:
Egen is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to inclusion, diversity, and equity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Egen will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Egen welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process.

jobs.title: Game Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Would you like to work on a new IP and new genre at teamLFG that combines amazing action feel with lighthearted and whimsical characters? Are you on a mission to create games that bond players together into deeply invested communities?
As an Engineering Director at teamLFG, you will hire, build and direct a technology organization to deliver amazing never-seen-before game experiences. Your organization will build and utilize a wide range of technologies and workflows to develop, continuously deliver, and maintain a live production game service. As part of the project and studio leadership team, you will create and evolve a technology strategy that is aligned with project goals and initiatives and serves the needs of the game, its players, and employees. As part of a diverse company that prizes creativity and technical excellence, your servant leadership will inspire and motivate a cross-discipline team to help build a new franchise beloved by millions.
We look for candidates who value joining a mission-focused team with a diverse set of backgrounds, experiences, interests, and viewpoints.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary project leadership team to develop and maintain a product technology strategy that is informed by product vision, technical costs, and long-term technology goals
Leveraging the Unreal Engine and technology the team has built, direct the engineering organization to tackle challenging problems, find combinations of innovative technology with proven models, and build reliable solutions that deliver game experiences while sensibly managing technology risks
Recruit, nurture, and retain an engineering organization (30+ engineers, both internal FTE and external codev) with the skills, capacity, and adaptability to navigate uncertainty and deliver on the changing needs of the project
Manage multiple senior engineering leads, providing management support, technical guidance, constructive feedback, and career development coaching
Work with production leadership to schedule, track, deliver, and close out game features and releases, anticipating and mitigating any critical risks encountered, technical or otherwise
Communicate with PlayStation executives, directors, and technology teams, as needed
REQUIRED SKILLS
Experience managing an organization of 20+ engineers on AAA game engineering teams
Experience working with and directing co-development engineering teams
Experience with developing and running online games in a live service environment
Ability to align with leadership and executive stakeholders, translate goals into strategic technology solutions with a thorough understanding of cost, efficiency, and quality tradeoffs, and then lead an organization to execute on a technology strategy
Effectively communicate with and inspire fellow engineers by driving team alignment and buy-in on technology vision and architectural principles
Ability to work with a team in a hybrid environment, leveraging real time chat communications and documentation across an entire game studio
Ability to communicate with stakeholders of different business, technical, and non-technical backgrounds, to help align objectives and negotiate common goals
NICE TO HAVE SKILLS
Experience with development using the Unreal Engine
Experience with development on a variety of platforms (PC, console)
Experience with agile development methodologies
At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.
Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.
This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
$255,000—$383,000 USD
Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.
Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Leveraging the Unreal Engine and technology the team has built, direct the engineering organization to tackle challenging problems, find combinations of innovative technology with proven models, and build reliable solutions that deliver game experiences while sensibly managing technology risks

Recruit, nurture, and retain an engineering organization (30+ engineers, both internal FTE and external codev) with the skills, capacity, and adaptability to navigate uncertainty and deliver on the changing needs of the project
Manage multiple senior engineering leads, providing management support, technical guidance, constructive feedback, and career development coaching
Work with production leadership to schedule, track, deliver, and close out game features and releases, anticipating and mitigating any critical risks encountered, technical or otherwise
Communicate with PlayStation executives, directors, and technology teams, as needed
REQUIRED SKILLS
Experience managing an organization of 20+ engineers on AAA game engineering teams
Experience working with and directing co-development engineering teams
Experience with developing and running online games in a live service environment

Ability to align with leadership and executive stakeholders, translate goals into strategic technology solutions with a thorough understanding of cost, efficiency, and quality tradeoffs, and then lead an organization to execute on a technology strategy
Effectively communicate with and inspire fellow engineers by driving team alignment and buy-in on technology vision and architectural principles
Ability to work with a team in a hybrid environment, leveraging real time chat communications and documentation across an entire game studio
Ability to communicate with stakeholders of different business, technical, and non-technical backgrounds, to help align objectives and negotiate common goals
NICE TO HAVE SKILLS
Experience with development using the Unreal Engine
Experience with development on a variety of platforms (PC, console)
Experience with agile development methodologies

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.
About Bobtail
Bobtail is dedicated to increasing happiness by eliminating inefficiencies in the supply chain. We envision a supply chain without friction, fraud, waste, and abuse where companies succeed based on the value they create.
We work in a unique way at Bobtail, where we value teams over individuals and encourage experimentation and iteration to constantly improve. Teams are given flexibility in working towards a shared purpose and given the freedom to decide how they will accomplish their goals.
If you are an out of the box thinker that takes a proactive approach in collaborating with others to solve problems and achieve your goals - we would love to talk to you.
The things we value:
Mission
Teams over individuals
Collaboration
Communication
Iteration
Experimentation and failing fast
Initiative and solutions oriented approach
Documentation
Data
Mental health and work life balance
Diversity
Transparency
We're hiring a Director of Product to lead product strategy, development, and innovation at Bobtail. This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.
The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.
You should apply if you have:
8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.
A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.
Experience conducting product discovery, customer research, and market analysis. Strong commercial instincts and the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value and business economics.
Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.
Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.
Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.
Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather than a venture-subsidized one.
Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to clearly communicate product strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership. The discipline to say no - comfortable deferring or killing ideas that don't earn their place on the roadmap, even when they're compelling in isolation or popular internally. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
Financial fluency - comfortable modeling and defending the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of a roadmap bet directly to the CFO and other finance stakeholders. A track record of measuring product success based on customer and business outcomes.
An obsession with the customer and the product - you can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and you know the product as well as the people using it, not just the roadmap slide.
You will be responsible for:
Decide What to Build: Develop and maintain a product strategy that clearly connects product investment to the company's broader strategic and financial objectives. Look beyond incremental feature improvements to identify opportunities for meaningful product innovation.
Process around decision making: Create a disciplined process for gathering and evaluating ideas without allowing the product roadmap to become a collection of stakeholder requests. Ensure completed functionality solves the underlying customer or business problem rather than simply meeting documented requirements.
Decide What Not to Build: Exercise real judgment about scope. Establish clear criteria for when to build, continue investing in a new product, change direction, or discontinue an initiative.
Execute at a High Level: Partner closely with engineering - and with design, go-to-market, and senior leadership - to turn the roadmap into shipped product on a predictable cadence, not just a plan.
Defend the Business Case: Build and defend the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of each major roadmap bet to the CFO, so product decisions hold up under financial scrutiny, not just strategic conviction.
Own the outcome: Ensure new products have clearly understood operational, financial, regulatory, and risk requirements before launch. Measure product success based on business outcomes - not simply whether features were delivered.
Own the Product: Take full, unbounded ownership of Bobtail's product. There are no lanes here; if it touches the customer or the platform, it's yours to shape.
Obsess Over the Customer and the Product: Establish a disciplined process for identifying and evaluating new product opportunities. Spend meaningful time talking directly with customers rather than relying exclusively on feedback filtered through Sales or Operations. Develop a strong understanding of competitors and adjacent providers within transportation finance and fintech. Live inside the carrier's day-to-day and inside the product itself. We want someone who can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and who knows the product as well as the people using it.
Evidence-Driven Decision Making: Build the muscle - data, customer research, experimentation - to validate bets before committing engineering resources, while being willing to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin.
Team Building: Hire and develop the product management function at Bobtail, defining process and hiring bar as the first dedicated product leader.
Market & Competitive Judgment: Track how freight-tech and fintech infrastructure are evolving, including AI-driven disruption and industry consolidation, and stress-test Bobtail's roadmap against it.
Benefits
Generous PTO
Monthly Mental Break Day
Parental leave
Comprehensive healthcare coverage
Life insurance
401k with company match
Work from home (or wherever)
Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is Bobtail’s nucleus. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace people of different backgrounds, cultures, religions, national origins, races, colors, genders, gender expressions, sexual orientations, ages, marital status, veteran status, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.
Founded by the team that scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ in ARR and secured more than $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.
Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely.We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Product Engineering organization, the team responsible for Turnkey's core product. This spans our TEE- and HSM-based key verification and signing systems, the APIs, SDKs, and interfaces built on top of them, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable. This is a senior leadership role reporting to our CTO/Co-Founder Jack Kearney, owning both the technical direction and the people leadership of the org. If you're excited about the potential that web3 has to radically change the world for the better and have a sincere desire to help facilitate that change, join us as we redefine decentralized development.
What You'll Do
Strategic Vision and Leadership
Own the engineering strategy and technical vision for Turnkey's Product Engineering organization, spanning key management, the APIs and interfaces built on top of it, transaction processing, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable.
Build, manage, and grow a high-performing engineering org, including hiring and developing engineering managers and senior ICs
Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to translate customer and market needs into a clear technical roadmap
Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends in web3 and guide their integration into our product
Contribute to company-wide strategic planning and technical decision-making as a member of the engineering leadership team
Organizational & People Leadership
Define and evolve the org structure, leveling, and career paths for the Product Engineering team as it scales
Drive recruitment, onboarding, and retention of top engineering talent across the org
Set and uphold engineering rituals (planning, incident review, on-call, etc.) that keep the org fast-moving and accountable
Coach and develop managers and senior engineers, building a durable leadership bench
Architectural Oversight & Technical Direction
Provide technical guidance across security-critical product systems, ensuring intelligent architectural decisions that scale with customer demand without compromising trust
Oversee the design and implementation of TEE- and HSM-based key management and signing systems, the APIs, SDKs, and dashboards built on top of them, transaction construction and broadcast systems, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable
Ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of product infrastructure, addressing the complexities of decentralized systems and adversarial threat models
Define and drive processes that ensure quality and consistency across product development, from design through deployment
What We're Looking For
Proven experience managing engineering managers and/or leading a multi-team engineering org (not just individual teams)
Deep understanding of modern application architectures and security-critical systems (e.g., HSMs, TEEs, key management), with the ability to lead in-depth technical discussions and make final calls on tradeoffs
A track record of shipping security-critical or developer-facing products (key management, signing infrastructure, APIs, or SDKs) at scale
Excellence at holding a high bar on software quality and engineering process, even while moving fast
A healthy amount of paranoia :-)
Style Points
Prior experience working in fast-paced crypto/web3 and/or FinTech companies, especially with exposure to custody, key management, or HSM/enclave-based systems
Experience scaling an engineering org through a significant growth stage (e.g., Series B → C, or comparable)
Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going
Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.
Compensation range
$250,000—$290,000 USD

jobs.title: VP, Product Strategy & Operations
jobs.text:
Overview
We are looking for a VP of Product Strategy & Program Management to build and lead the operational and strategic backbone of our Product organization. This leader will own the connective tissue between product strategy and product execution - ensuring our roadmap is grounded in rigorous market intelligence, our launches land with commercial and customer impact, our cross-functional programs run predictably, and our product documentation is accurate, discoverable, and enterprise-grade.
This is a builder role. You'll stand up and mature four disciplines - Market Analysis, Launch Excellence, Program Management, and Product Documentation - inside a product organization that is scaling its maturity and rigor. You'll partner directly with the CPO, product line leaders, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to make sure great products actually reach the market and the market actually understands them.
Responsibilities
What You'll Own
Market Strategy & Analysis
Lead competitive intelligence, market sizing, and segmentation analysis that directly informs roadmap prioritization and portfolio strategy
Build repeatable frameworks for tracking market dynamics, buyer needs, and competitive positioning
Translate market insight into inputs product leaders and executives can act on - not just reports that sit on a shelf
Launch Excellence
Own the end-to-end launch framework: readiness criteria, cross-functional launch plans, tiering models, and post-launch retrospectives
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success to ensure every release has a commercial and adoption plan, not just a ship date
Establish the metrics that define launch success and hold the org accountable to them
Program Management
Build and lead a program management function that drives predictability across complex, cross-functional product initiatives
Own portfolio-level visibility: roadmap execution tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and executive reporting
Instill lightweight but durable operating rhythms (planning cycles, status reporting, escalation paths) appropriate for a scaling PM organization
Product Documentation
Lead the team responsible for product documentation, release notes, and internal/external knowledge resources
Ensure documentation quality keeps pace with product complexity, particularly for enterprise and technical buyers
Build scalable documentation processes that reduce support burden and improve customer self-sufficiency
Team & Organizational Leadership
Hire, develop, and lead a team of market analysis, launch, program management, and documentation specialists
Define career pathing and craft standards for a discipline that is often under-resourced and under-defined - you'll be building the operating model, not inheriting one
Act as a force multiplier for the CPO, translating strategic priorities into operational execution across the product org
Qualifications
Qualifications
10+ years in product strategy, product operations, program management, or a related discipline, with at least 3–5 years leading teams
Track record of building or significantly maturing a product operations, strategy, or program management function inside a scaling or transforming organization
Strong command of market analysis and competitive intelligence methods, and comfort turning ambiguous market signals into clear strategic recommendations
Demonstrated success running high-stakes product launches with measurable commercial outcomes
Program management rigor - you can run a portfolio, not just a project - with fluency in tools and frameworks for tracking cross-functional execution
Experience overseeing or partnering closely with technical documentation functions; you understand what “good” looks like for enterprise/technical audiences
Excellent executive communication skills; you can operate comfortably in front of the C-suite and PE/board audiences
Comfortable operating in an organization where product management maturity is still being built - you thrive on creating structure, not just working within it
Experience in enterprise software, legal technology, eDiscovery, or another complex B2B/enterprise domain is a plus
Why This Role Matters
Product strategy without execution rigor is just a slide deck. This role exists to make sure that doesn't happen - that every roadmap decision is grounded in real market understanding, every launch has a plan behind it, every cross-functional initiative has an owner and a rhythm, and every customer-facing document reflects the quality of the product itself. You'll report directly to the CPO and have a direct hand in shaping how the product organization operates as it scales.
Consilio’s True North Values
Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.
Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Experience overseeing or partnering closely with technical documentation functions; you understand what “good” looks like for enterprise/technical audiences
Excellent executive communication skills; you can operate comfortably in front of the C-suite and PE/board audiences
Comfortable operating in an organization where product management maturity is still being built - you thrive on creating structure, not just working within it
Experience in enterprise software, legal technology, eDiscovery, or another complex B2B/enterprise domain is a plus

blocks.text: Why This Role Matters

Product strategy without execution rigor is just a slide deck. This role exists to make sure that doesn't happen - that every roadmap decision is grounded in real market understanding, every launch has a plan behind it, every cross-functional initiative has an owner and a rhythm, and every customer-facing document reflects the quality of the product itself. items: Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
About Nexcess
Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.
Overview
You will run and own the product engineering organization end to end: their architecture,delivery,andengineering roadmap. You are here to build and enable an engineering organization that ships fast and reliably, and how much of it is AI-efficiently enabled.
How we work
Business alignment and focus come first. Engineering here exists to move the business.
Key Performance Indicators
Speed: DORA metrics with High/Elite as the target.
Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software.
AI adoption and its impact.
Responsibilities
Product and delivery
Own architecture design, delivery and engineering roadmap for your teams. Build the partnership with Product: shape it together, commit to it, and then deliver it.
Run delivery on monthly cycles with an explicit cut line. Scope, design and deliver demonstrable value each month. Your teams must have an evidence backed ability to meet commitments rather than explained afterwards.
Organization and people
Design teams that deliver. Draw team boundaries so a team can finish its work without waiting on any other team. One accountable Engineering Manager per team, so the owner of any piece of work is known the moment it arrives.
Build the manager bench. Hire, develop, and calibrate engineering managers, own the hiring bar, and know who is ready to run each team. Coach them to lead rather than code.
Qualifications
Required
12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ leading engineering teams, and experience leading managers.
Evidence you have made an engineering organization measurably faster. You instrumented DORA or an equivalent, you know your before-and-after numbers, and can walk through what you changed and what broke while it settled.
Real, hands-on AI-assisted engineering at organizational scale, with impact you can quantify. Not a pilot and not a vendor rollout: adoption driven across teams, agentic tooling you use yourself every week, your own harness you can describe, and a clear view of where it fails and what to verify. Bring the evidence: the harness you run, a skill you wrote and shared, a spec an agent executed, the review gates you shipped.
Experience redesigning how teams and work are organized: boundaries, ownership, cadence, and living with the result.
Delivered and modernized complex software through multiple teams, including reassessing scope or dates with senior stakeholders and absorbing the consequences.
Hands-on enough to review a design, read a change and hold a defensible technical position without owning the implementation.
Owned a hiring plan end to end and held a bar; run software in production with real accountability for availability; led remote teams across time zones with vendor squads inside them, on agreements you shaped.
Managed hosting, cloud or another high-availability service business is a must.
Hard skills
Depth in any single technology matters less than the judgment to specify, verify and decide; AI supplies the syntax and the reference. These are the areas we will test that judgment in.
AI-native engineering. Agentic coding tools as your daily instrument and a harness you designed: repository instructions, shared skills, tool connectors, permission boundaries. Specification-first working, automated review in the pull-request path, a defensible position on what may be auto-approved, and quota and cost governance.
The delivery system. DORA instrumented and moved, tests on every change with coverage gating, trunk-based delivery and feature flags, observability and service levels, one tracker with one intake door, incident command with actions closed on dates.
Long-lived cores. Leading change on twenty-year Perl and PHP monoliths without writing either: strangler seams behind an API gateway, an identity issuer and an event bus, characterization tests before change, a system of record chosen where there are two of everything, and knowing what not to rewrite.
Revenue-bearing systems. Billing and payments consolidation across processors, Stripe among them: dual-run, reconciliation to Finance, and a rollback you prepared.
Hosting platforms. cPanel and InterWorx, the control panel we develop ourselves; WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento and Shopware above them; Linux on bare metal, and a VMware to Nutanix migration that product delivery has to sequence around.
Security in an AI-assisted SDLC. Secrets hygiene and push protection, static analysis in the merge path, the tool and connector supply chain, prompt injection through repository content.

jobs.title: Head of Data Practitioner
jobs.text:
(This role can be based from anywhere in Europe on a fully remote basis)
Head of Data Practitioner
What we believe
Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.
Our role
We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.
Our approach
The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.
What we value
Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.
If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.
About the role
Crosslake is looking for a Head of Data to lead data engagements. In this role, you will work with private equity investors and portfolio company leadership teams to turn data opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
You will own senior client relationships on complex data engagements, building credibility with CDOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders while leading the work from strategic diagnosis through to practical delivery.
The ideal candidate combines the breadth of a strong consulting leader with deep expertise in data strategy, data transformation and modern data platforms.
You will be expected to shape the problem, develop the data strategy, lead complex transformations, manage senior stakeholders, drive the storyline and own delivery, while credibly challenging clients and specialists on the substance of the work.
This is a role for someone who can move confidently between business, technology and data conversations, connecting strategic ambition to the data capabilities, operating-model changes, investment choices and delivery roadmap required to realise value.
Role responsibilities
Own client relationships on data engagements, establishing trusted partnerships with senior business and technology leaders and acting as a credible advisor to CDOs, CTOs and executive teams.
Lead the development of data strategies that align business priorities, value-creation opportunities, target data capabilities, technology choices, operating model and delivery roadmap.
Lead complex data transformations from diagnosis through to implementation planning, including data platform modernisation, data governance, data quality, data product and analytics initiatives.
Bring structure to ambiguous data challenges, defining the key questions, building the workplan, managing workstreams and keeping the team focused on the issues that matter most to the client.
Develop compelling executive-level narratives that synthesise analysis, client input and specialist perspectives into practical recommendations and clear decisions.
Translate effectively between commercial and technical audiences, ensuring recommendations reflect business priorities, data realities, architecture implications, delivery feasibility and execution risk.
Link data initiatives to value creation economics, including opportunity sizing, business cases, investment requirements, benefits, trade-offs and dependencies.
Challenge assumptions, pressure-test recommendations and identify where deeper expertise is needed across data engineering, architecture, governance, analytics, AI or transformation.
Drive engagements beyond analysis towards prioritised actions, accountable delivery plans and a pragmatic path from recommendation to execution.
What we’re looking for
Experience operating at a level comparable to a high-performing consulting Director, Associate Director or Senior Consultant, with a track record of leading complex data engagements and senior client relationships.
A strong consulting toolkit, ideally developed in a leading strategy, digital, data or transformation consultancy, or through comparable experience in high-stakes advisory or transformation environments.
Deep expertise in data strategy and data transformation, with practical experience across areas such as modern data platforms, data architecture, governance, quality, data products, analytics or AI enablement.
Proven ability to take ambiguous business and data problems, impose structure, develop hypotheses, lead rigorous analysis, manage teams and translate findings into a clear executive storyline.
Credibility with senior executives and functional leaders, including CDOs, CTOs, CIOs, CEOs and leaders across data, technology, product and transformation.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to size opportunities, build business cases, quantify benefits, understand investment needs and evaluate strategic trade-offs.
Experience leading complex data programmes or transformations, with sufficient technical depth to challenge decisions on data architecture, platforms, governance, operating models and delivery approaches.
A hands-on leadership style: senior enough to build confidence with executives, while close enough to the work to guide analysis, challenge team thinking and personally shape the strategy and storyline.
A practical, action-oriented mindset aligned with Crosslake’s values of service, curiosity, credibility, commitment and creativity.

jobs.title: Director of Forensic Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role:
The Director of Engineering provides technical and people leadership within YA Engineering Services’ forensic engineering practice, focusing on the evaluation of damaged building structures and related mechanical and electrical systems for insurance carriers, law firms, and other stakeholders. The position leads and mentors engineers while remaining hands on throughout the project lifecycle—from coordinating site visits and conducting field inspections to performing engineering analysis, interpreting applicable building codes, and producing clear, defensible reports that determine the cause and extent of building distress or failure. Work is field based and investigative in nature, emphasizing physical assets, materials, environmental factors, and building performance rather than information technology systems. The ideal candidate has an established client network and has a strong track record of building rapport and maintaining lasting client relationships. Please note that this position is not an IT or Software Engineering role.
In This Role, You Will:
Lead and mentor a team of engineers, supporting their development and project work
Reviews junior consultants’ work to ensure accurate, high-quality, and timely deliverables before client submission.
Ensure project budgets and scope are timely communicated to clients and strictly adhered to.
Drive timely delivery of all project milestones, consistently meeting or surpassing established deadlines.
Coordinates with clients to set up site visits and complete deliverables on projects
Produces project reports that synthesize data collected from our onsite inspections with environmental factors, material properties, and engineering analysis to determine the most likely cause and scope of distress and failures to buildings and components.
Performs site visits to collect field data on residential and commercial properties.
Reviews and interprets the relevant building codes as necessary for issues pertaining to our scope of work.
Assist in business development activities. Work with business development representatives to attend conferences, events, dinners, lunches, when applicable, to promote the company and your personal capabilities.
Performs additional duties as assigned.
What You Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
Active PE license
15 + years of forensic engineering experience
Proven ability to write comprehensive technical reports on inspection results
Willingness to travel up to 50%
Who We Are:
YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. YA Engineering Services (“YAES”) is a national forensic multi-disciplinary consulting firm. YAES provides immediate response to new assignments, performs investigations in a timely manner, and provides comprehensive reports that are clear, concise, and backed by reasonable analyses and recommendations. YAES offers a team of highly qualified, technically excellent engineering professionals who work seamlessly together to service the needs of our clients in the model of an engineering cooperative.
What We Offer:
Employee-focused culture
Strong commitment to work-life balance
100% Remote work
Flexible vacation & Paid holidays
Paid family care/sick leave
Parental leave
Comprehensive benefits
401k w/match
Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:
Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding your application will come from or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us directly at .
Disclosures:
As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist—rather than replace—human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Management, Consumer
jobs.text:
About Ethos
Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
About the Role
We're looking for an exceptional product leader to join our Consumer Product team as Director of Product Management. This team is responsible for building a delightful digital consumer experience — from onboarding users and helping them understand their families' needs, to purchasing the right insurance products to protect what matters most. As Director, you will own the strategy and execution of our core consumer product surface, leading a team of product managers and partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Marketing. The ideal candidate combines first-principles thinking, deep consumer empathy, and organizational leadership to drive both team excellence and meaningful business outcomes. You'll set the vision, build the team, and be accountable for results at scale. We're looking for an entrepreneurial product leader who is passionate about advocating on behalf of users, building and developing high-performing PM teams, and driving sustainable business growth — all while operating with a high degree of ownership in a product-first company.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Leadership & People Management
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product managers, fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement
Set clear goals and development plans for direct reports; conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching
Partner with recruiting to grow the PM team as the business scales, identifying talent and building a strong hiring pipeline
Create clarity and alignment across the team on priorities, roadmap, and success metrics
Product Strategy & Vision
Define and own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for the Consumer Product team, aligned to company strategy and growth objectives
Translate business goals into clear product bets, sequenced for maximum impact and learnings
Identify new market opportunities — including new insurance products such as Indexed Universal Life and Whole Life — and develop go-to-market strategies to capture them
Stay ahead of consumer trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies to inform the product strategy
Execution & Delivery
Own the end-to-end consumer experience, from top-of-funnel acquisition through purchase and onboarding, driving measurable improvements to conversion rates and user satisfaction
Educate consumers on the need for Life Insurance and empower them to purchase the right type and level of coverage for their families
Champion a culture of rapid experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, and use results to drive product decisions with rigor and speed
Remove friction from the application experience and identify opportunities to motivate users toward completion and coverage
Ensure all consumer experiences are built on a foundation of accessibility, delight, and simplicity
Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Leadership
Serve as the senior product voice in cross-functional forums, influencing roadmap prioritization and resource allocation decisions
Build strong working relationships with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Actuarial partners
Communicate product strategy, progress, and results clearly to executive leadership and the broader organization
Drive alignment on shared goals across product, engineering, and business teams to ensure cohesive execution
Duties and Responsibilities:
12+ years of experience as a product manager at a high-growth technology company, building consumer products at significant scale
5+ years of experience managing and developing product managers, with a track record of growing high-performing PM teams
Experience in fintech, insurtech, or other regulated consumer industries is a plus
Exceptional ability to generate, test, and refine hypotheses using a blend of data, user insights, and market trends — ensuring product decisions are both innovative and impactful
Strong analytical orientation with a focus on data-driven decision making; ability to measure success rigorously across a portfolio of bets
Proficiency in self-serve analytics using tools like SQL and Amplitude; comfort partnering with data science for complex analysis
Proven ability to transform strategic ideas into actionable roadmaps, rapid prototypes, and iterative, feedback-driven product improvements
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling PM organizations, including hiring, onboarding, and developing talent
Ability to operate effectively at multiple altitudes — from setting long-term vision to rolling up sleeves on execution when needed
Exceptional communication and executive presence; ability to influence without authority across functions and levels
Deep track record of solving hard customer problems and translating them into durable business growth
The US national base salary range for this full-time position is $211,000 - $373,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include applicable bonus, equity, or benefits.
You can find further details of our US benefits at

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

jobs.title: Head of Hardware Engineering - Combustion Systems - Remote
jobs.text:
About Roadrunner Venture Studios
Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation's leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in frontier technology. We partner with scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs to turn deep technology into real companies. Our work spans energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, quantum computing, aerospace, advanced materials, artificial intelligence, and high performance computing.
About the Role
Roadrunner Venture Studios is recruiting a Head of Hardware Engineering for a portfolio company developing rainfall enhancement technology.
You will lead the deployment system from architecture and prototyping through operational qualification and production-scale manufacturing.
You will apply aerospace rigor to industrial hardware that must operate reliably in the field and support repeatable manufacturing at automotive scale. The work spans mechanical, thermal, combustion, fluid, structural, controls, and instrumentation systems.
This is a hands-on role. You will work with internal science and field teams and lead external engineering firms, fabricators, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
This role includes significant equity.
This is an early-stage startup building something that has not been built before. Priorities will change quickly. If this working environment does not excite you, this role is probably not for you.
What You Will Do
Technical Leadership
System Architecture: Own requirements and architecture across mechanical, thermal, combustion, structural, fluid, gas-handling, controls, and instrumentation systems.
Hardware Development: Lead the system from early design through prototypes, integrated builds, field-ready hardware, and production planning.
Combustion and Thermal Systems: Lead the design and qualification of combustion hardware, fuel and gas handling, flow and pressure systems, and thermal management.
Qualification and Field Operations: Define verification methods and lead shop tests, integrated system tests, field qualification, troubleshooting, and failure reviews.
Manufacturing and External Partners
Turn engineering concepts into computer aided design models, drawings, bills of materials, supplier packages, build instructions, and acceptance criteria.
Lead design for manufacturing and assembly so prototypes can mature into reliable production hardware.
Manage engineering, procurement, and construction firms, fabricators, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other external partners.
Use test data, field observations, supplier feedback, and failure analysis to drive design improvements and production readiness.
Business and Team Management
Outcome Ownership: Own the hardware schedule, budget, qualification timeline, technical quality, partner deliverables, and production plan.
Team Building: Recruit, mentor, and manage a small team of hardware engineers.
Work across science, field operations, business, and external partners to resolve technical risks and keep the hardware program moving.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or a related field.
Experience leading complex hardware from concept through prototype builds, operational qualification, and production planning.
High proficiency with computer aided design software such as SolidWorks or NX and product lifecycle management systems.
Experience with engineering release processes, configuration control, drawings, bills of materials, and supplier documentation.
Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly for industrial, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy, or other complex hardware.
Experience with combustion hardware, thermal systems, fluid systems, gas handling, pressure systems, large field equipment, or power systems.
Experience with test instrumentation, data acquisition, controls interfaces, inspection methods, qualification plans, and operational readiness reviews.
Experience managing engineering firms, fabrication shops, suppliers, contract manufacturers, or engineering, procurement, and construction partners.
Experience supporting field tests or deployments and making engineering decisions under changing operating conditions.
At least three years of experience leading hardware development and developing engineering talent.
Ability to move quickly, take broad ownership, and solve complex problems with limited resources in a startup environment.
Experience with computational fluid dynamics (CFD), especially for combustion, heat transfer, fluid flow, or gas-handling systems.
Experience taking hardware from prototype builds into first-article or low-rate production.
Experience with aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, robotics, or other high-reliability hardware programs.
Experience building a hardware engineering function at an early-stage company.
Location
This role is remote but may be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, or New Mexico if you would like to be near on of our hubs. The balance between in-person and remote work can be tailored to the candidate and team needs. Frequent travel is required.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Product
jobs.text:
Goodwall
Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.
Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.
As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.
Your Role
You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.
Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.
What you will do
Scale a product members love returning to. Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
Accelerate member acquisition. Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
Bring Product and Growth together. Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.
Set the standard for every detail. Take responsibility for the quality of the entire member experience, from the clarity of a notification and the simplicity of a product flow to the strength of an ad hook. Combine sharp copy, thoughtful design and precise execution.
Experiment with purpose. Speak with members, understand where they lose interest and test ways to keep them engaged. Run A/B tests, assess retention over time and use the findings to decide what to scale, improve or stop.
Hire and lead a strong team. Choose priorities, develop your people and direct budget toward lasting growth. Move quickly, remove obstacles and take responsibility for results.
What we offer
Competitivecompensation and equity: an ownership stake in a scale up raising its Series B.
Real authority across Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with the founders.
The opportunity to hire and lead yourownteam.
An establishedglobalcommunity and the chance to shape the experience of millions more members.
And most importantly, a mission to be proudof - helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures
Requirements
What You Bring
You know how to scale. You have personally helped scale a digital product serving millions, ideally where what worked early stopped working and needed new methods. You can explain what you owned, what you changed, and the results.
Depth in product growth. You have shipped experiments that improved retention and referrals alongside acquisition. Experience in Social, Gaming or EdTech is particularly relevant.
Ownership and urgency. You take ownership of the outcome, move with urgency and follow through with intensity. You find ways forward with limited resources and stay close enough to the work to solve problems yourself.
Instinctive Gen Z fluency. You live and breathe the platforms, creators, communities and formats shaping how Gen Z communicates. You know what earns attention, what gets shared and what feels forced.
Exceptional attention to detail. You recognise strong design and sharp copy, and notice the friction others miss. You care about the small decisions that make an experience feel effortless.
Analytical and creative judgment. You can interpret a retention curve, improve a creator brief and work through a product decision with engineers.
Commitment to the mission. You want to use your expertise to transform lives. Helping millions of young people gain skills, confidence and access to opportunity is work you are ready to invest yourself in.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering & Delivery
jobs.text:
About Zencore
Zencore was founded by former Google Cloud leaders and engineers with one singular focus: to reduce risk and ensure enterprise client success on Google Cloud. We are a Premier Google Cloud Partner and a four-time Google Cloud Partner of the Year. With private equity backing and a high-growth global delivery model (spanning the US, LATAM, and EMEA), Zencore combines senior technical talent, deep AI specialization, and rapid execution to tackle mission-critical cloud, data, and agentic AI initiatives.
About the Role
Zencore is seeking a proven, dual-threat executive to serve as Head of Engineering and Delivery.
In this role, you will be the primary architect of Zencore’s technology vision and the operational leader responsible for scaling our global delivery practice. You will ensure delivery quality across a multi-geo workforce, drive technical innovation, and serve as a prominent technical executive across our enterprise client base and the Google Cloud ecosystem.
This is a pivotal executive seat requiring a balance of deep technical credibility in cloud/AI, disciplined services operations (margin, utilization, governance), and executive presence to co-sell alongside Google Cloud field leadership.
Responsibilities
1. Technical Strategy & Leadership
Define Technical Vision: Set the overall technology strategy, solution architecture standards, and innovation roadmap for Zencore, keeping us at the forefront of cloud, data engineering, and agentic AI.
Productize Services & IP: Drive the evolution of Zencore’s proprietary assets and repeatable frameworks.
Market Presence & Thought Leadership: Serve as Zencore’s primary technical voice in the market—speaking at major ecosystem events, authoring whitepapers, and building relationships with Google Cloud go to market, product and engineering teams.
2. Professional Services & Delivery Operations
Global Delivery Model: Scale and govern an agile, multi-geographic delivery structure across North America, LATAM, and EMEA, ensuring seamless cross-geo resourcing and delivery consistency.
Portfolio Governance: Establish rigorous quality gates, RAID management, and project health reviews to ensure engagements land on time, on budget, and beyond SOW expectations. Personally serve as executive delivery sponsor for strategic enterprise accounts.
3. Go-To-Market & Google Cloud Alliance
Executive Pre-Sales & Deal Shaping: Partner with sales leadership on complex enterprise pursuits—shaping technical architectures, scoping SOWs, leading technical pitches, and converting opportunities into revenue.
Hyperscaler Channel Alignment: Build deep, trusted relationships with Google Cloud Account Directors, Regional Directors, and PSO leadership to position Zencore as the preferred co-sell partner for complex enterprise accounts.
Account Expansion (Land & Expand): Drive organic account growth by embedding discovery mechanisms into active delivery, converting one-off modernization projects into continuous, multi-year AI and managed service relationships.
Qualifications
15+ Years of Experience: Extensive track record leading complex technology programs, with 7+ years in an engineering leadership role within a professional services firm, systems integrator, or cloud consultancy.
Deep Google Cloud & AI Experience: Hands-on technical background and deep architectural credibility in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), modern data platforms, and enterprise AI/GenAI implementations.
Proven P&L & Operations Ownership: Accountability for professional services revenues, including billable utilization, gross margin optimization, blended rate card management, and delivery risk management.
Hyperscaler Co-Sell Experience: Demonstrated expertise navigating cloud partner ecosystems, co-selling alongside field sales teams, and leveraging partner incentive programs (e.g., Google RAMP/MDF).
Multi-Geo Delivery Expertise: Direct experience building and leading remote, distributed delivery organizations across onshore, nearshore, and offshore regions (US, LATAM, EMEA).
Executive Presence: Ability to engage effortlessly with C-suite executives (CTOs, CIOs, CDOs) as a trusted advisor, translating complex technical trade-offs into clear business outcomes.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior leadership experience at Google Cloud, a Premier Google Cloud Partner, or an enterprise Systems Integrator.
Active Google Cloud Certifications (Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, or AI/ML Specialist).
Experience navigating Private Equity governance, reporting, and value-creation milestones.
Why work at Zencore?
We Are Trusted Experts: Our teams bring deep, hands-on experience to solve the hardest cloud and AI challenges.

blocks.text: About Zencore

Zencore was founded by former Google Cloud leaders and engineers with one singular focus: to reduce risk and ensure enterprise client success on Google Cloud. We are a Premier Google Cloud Partner and a four-time Google Cloud Partner of the Year. With private equity backing and a high-growth global delivery model (spanning the US, LATAM, and EMEA), Zencore combines senior technical talent, deep AI specialization, and rapid execution to tackle mission-critical cloud, data, and agentic AI initiatives.
About the Role
Zencore is seeking a proven, dual-threat executive to serve as Head of Engineering and Delivery.

In this role, you will be the primary architect of Zencore’s technology vision and the operational leader responsible for scaling our global delivery practice. You will ensure delivery quality across a multi-geo workforce, drive technical innovation, and serve as a prominent technical executive across our enterprise client base and the Google Cloud ecosystem.

This is a pivotal executive seat requiring a balance of deep technical credibility in cloud/AI, disciplined services operations (margin, utilization, governance), and executive presence to co-sell alongside Google Cloud field leadership.

Portfolio Governance: Establish rigorous quality gates, RAID management, and project health reviews to ensure engagements land on time, on budget, and beyond SOW expectations. Personally serve as executive delivery sponsor for strategic enterprise accounts.

Executive Pre-Sales & Deal Shaping: Partner with sales leadership on complex enterprise pursuits—shaping technical architectures, scoping SOWs, leading technical pitches, and converting opportunities into revenue.

Hyperscaler Channel Alignment: Build deep, trusted relationships with Google Cloud Account Directors, Regional Directors, and PSO leadership to position Zencore as the preferred co-sell partner for complex enterprise accounts.

Executive Presence: Ability to engage effortlessly with C-suite executives (CTOs, CIOs, CDOs) as a trusted advisor, translating complex technical trade-offs into clear business outcomes.

Active Google Cloud Certifications (Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, or AI/ML Specialist).
Experience navigating Private Equity governance, reporting, and value-creation milestones.
