jobs.title: Director Product Management
jobs.text:
Overview
Director, Product Management for value-based payments is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing, developing, and executing the product strategy for the business. This role typically involves a combination of strategic thinking, team leadership, and hands-on involvement in product development and lifecycle management.
In this role, using subject matter expertise and market insights, you will support the current solution/product offerings and will be instrumental in guiding the development of new product offerings, delivering value with existing customers, and driving revenue opportunities. You will work with current clients as well as sales prospects to advance product innovation and growth in value-based care contracting and performance with payers and providers. The successful candidate will have experience working with or in a health plan, devising and implementing various value-based care contracting models with providers.
You will be leading a team of product managers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support and collaborate with cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, sales personnel, and customer managers to ensure effective solution design, development, and delivery. This role will be responsible for collaborating with sales and marketing to enable effective product commercialization.
Overall, the Director of Product Management plays a crucial role in shaping the direction of a company's products, ensuring they align with market needs and contribute to the overall success of the business.
Responsibilities
Product Strategy: Developing and articulating a clear product strategy aligned with the overall business goals. This involves understanding market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes. Working with corporate marketing to assess competition and lead product roadmaps and launch to provid3differentiated value in the market.
Team Leadership: Managing and leading a team of product managers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support. Ensuring that the team is motivated, aligned with company objectives, and delivering on product roadmaps.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborating with other departments such as engineering, marketing, sales, and customer support to ensure a unified approach to product development and delivery. Effective communication and alignment across these functions are critical. Utilize AI tools effectively to accelerate innovation via collaboration.
Roadmap Planning: Creating and managing product roadmaps that align with the company's strategic objectives. Prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
Market Analysis: Staying informed about market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies. Conducting market research to identify opportunities and threats, and using this information to inform product decisions.
Financial Management: Managing the financial aspects of the product management function, including budgeting, resource allocation, and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure product success.
Product Development: Providing oversight and guidance throughout the product development lifecycle. Using AI tools to enable product discovery, prototyping, and accelerated development in an AIDLC. Ensuring that products are delivered on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
Customer Focus: Advocating for the customer and ensuring that products meet or exceed customer expectations. Gathering customer feedback and using it to drive product improvements.
Innovation: Encouraging a culture of innovation within the product team. Exploring new ideas and technologies that can contribute to the company's competitive advantage.
Risk Management: Identifying and mitigating risks related to product development and launch. Proactively addressing challenges and adjusting strategies as needed.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Utilize AI for product development.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. Required This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and the requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (business, engineering, computer science, etc.).
10+ years of experience in product management or related roles.
5+ years experience working in a health plan environment devising and contracting value-based care contracting models.
Experience in leadership and managerial positions, preferably as a Senior Product Manager or similar.
Proven track record of successfully bringing products to market.
Ability to use AI tools effectively in an AI development life cycle for product concept, development, and launch.
Strong understanding of product development processes, including ideation, design, development, testing, and launch.
Ability to think strategically and align product initiatives with overall business objectives.
Understanding of AI applications in healthcare.
Experience in developing and executing product strategies that drive business growth.
Demonstrated leadership skills with experience managing and developing high-performing teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas to different stakeholders.
Strong presentation skills for both internal and external audiences.
Deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to advocate for the customer in product decision-making.
Understanding of how product decisions impact the financial performance of the business.
Experience identifying and mitigating risks associated with product development and launch.
Cognitive and Mental Requirements
Communicating with others to exchange information.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Critical thinker and problem solver with strong analytic modeling and technical skills.
Physical Requirements and Working Conditions
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
No adverse environmental conditions expected.
Base compensation ranges from $165,000 to $215,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 12/1/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.title: VP Product Interoperability
jobs.text:
Overview
As VP Product, Interoperability, you will own and execute Cotiviti’s market strategy, product roadmap and commercial growth for health plan interoperability — extending our leading industry position and expanding our impact into broader payer / provider collaboration. You will bring unique insight into payer priorities, challenges, and blind spots; prioritize market needs; run competitive analysis; engage experts within and outside our organization; and lead product launches that expand our client value proposition and advance Cotiviti’s market position. Hands-on knowledge of payer administrative processes and payer / provider interoperability is essential, along with a genuine passion for solving hard problems and improving the healthcare system.
Reporting to the SVP of Product, you will have full ownership and accountability for product vision, definition, packaging, and market success across Cotiviti’s interoperability platform and commercial solutions. You will lead a matrixed, multi-level team, prioritizing and enhancing our existing solutions while delivering next-generation payer / provider collaboration solutions. You will bridge product vision, operational design, and commercial success — defining Cotiviti’s approach across the product lines you support. You will advocate and solution to ensure that all Cotiviti’s product offerings are FHIR native and leveraging our Interoperability Platform[CC1.1].
Cotiviti is evolving our market approach to become the utility layer for healthcare—reducing friction and significantly improving coordination across the system. In this role, you will play a key role in defining and executing Cotiviti’s expanded vision and improving healthcare. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a leader who combines deep product and market domain expertise, healthcare knowledge, business acumen, creativity, sound business judgment, and sharp analytical thinking.
Responsibilities
You will lead a cross-sectional, matrixed team, driving a customer- and sales-focused approach to building and launching new products, capabilities, and offerings into the marketplace. Here’s what you’ll own:
Vision
Leverage deep subject matter expertise to provide input into Cotiviti’s strategic plan across business units.
Collaborate with executive leadership to develop targets for annual bookings, revenue, expenses, and client satisfaction.
Serve as a voice of the customer in new product management and development.
Strategic & Product Leadership
Develop multi-year roadmaps that provide deep insight into how we can become integral to the payer/provider collaboration journey, from provider workflows through post-adjudication.
Provide executive leadership for Cotiviti’s interoperability business, including product strategy, market strategy, operational strategy, revenue growth, client outcomes, and long-term business expansion.
Develop and influence corporate strategy related to interoperability, provider connectivity, healthcare data exchange, and payer-provider collaboration.
Serve as Cotiviti’s executive representative with key clients, strategic partners, regulators, industry consortiums, and market influencers.
Operational & Technical Leadership
Provide unique insight into the internal mechanics and challenges of payer platforms, processes, and administrative inefficiency, as well as payer/provider interoperability.
Process Improvement
Drive process re-engineering efforts leveraging AI and emerging technologies to drive transformative changes and improve the system.
Financial & Risk
Provide knowledge of how payers identify and eliminate administrative waste in claims processing, prior authorization, and other core operational processes through advanced data analytics tools, including areas of strength and gaps.
Leverage expertise in how payers currently perceive and manage costs with siloed or competitive approaches.
Own business performance, revenue growth, operating margin achievement, investment prioritization, and long-range financial planning for the interoperability business.
Compliance & Legal Oversight
Act as an authority for ensuring all products and operational workflows adhere to state and federal regulations.
Product Management
Lead a multidisciplinary organization through Directors, Senior Directors, and other senior leaders responsible for Product Management, Product Operations, Market Strategy, and Product Commercialization.
Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Marketing, Sales, Business Unit Operations, and R&D to develop and launch enhancements to the solutions portfolio.
Align with Business Unit and R&D processes, including SAFe Agile, as well as Product Management teams for delivering capabilities.
Define success criteria, review product performance against expectations, and facilitate or influence changes to the product portfolio to improve competitive position and optimize product performance.
Go to Market
Own the definition of customer experience for end-to-end solutions.
Lead completion and upkeep of Ready to Market (R2M) and Ready to Sell (R2S) tools, content, and training.
Team Leadership
Collaborate with the Product leadership team to establish and continuously improve processes for Product Management.
Assist Business Unit leaders in defining core processes and staffing needs to support new solutions.
Coaching
Champion the discipline of product development and product management practices, ensuring teams have the essential tools, processes, and skill sets to build product and service roadmaps that align with Cotiviti’s strategic and operational plans.
Growth
Define and execute three-to-five-year growth strategies, including market expansion, partnership strategies, acquisition integration opportunities, and innovation investments.
Be accountable for developing solutions that support profitability, efficiency, and growth targets.
Lead others in the design and development of new products.
Ask effective questions to fully understand client needs and engage others to solve those challenges. Assist in developing pricing strategies to maximize overall returns.
Quality
Work closely with technology, operations, and senior leadership to ensure releases are of the highest quality and the team can demonstrate progress against quality goals through clear metrics.
Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that employs best-in-class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal-setting process.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience required; Master of Business Administration degree preferred.
10 to 15+ years of progressive insurance and product experience, with a minimum of eight years in senior leadership roles overseeing matrixed teams.
10+ years of experience, with increasing levels of responsibility and oversight, managing Product, Operations, or Professional Services.
10+ years of experience preferred in the healthcare industry, with previous leadership experience in the appropriate domain, strong personnel management and presentation skills, and customer (internal/external) problem diagnostics and solution design capabilities.
Deep subject matter expertise in payer/provider interoperability and claims processing operations; direct experience managing claims operations or payer/provider interoperability for a health plan strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of standards, the regulatory environment, and compliance considerations for interoperability required. Ability to measure and articulate the business value of compliance preferred.
Advanced knowledge of claims management ecosystems and the ability to align R&D processes, such as SAFe Agile, with core operational needs.
Proactive leader with proven experience in strategic and tactical leadership and the ability to pursue and understand cutting-edge technologies.
The intellect and energy to excel in a complex and ever-changing environment, coupled with the poise and ability to act calmly in high-pressure, high-stress situations.
Proven experience in growth-oriented businesses in the healthcare information and analytics space, with strong competencies in developing and leading product development and strategy.
Excellent coach who is results-oriented and can build and motivate high-performance teams.
Cognitive / Mental Requirements
Problem-solving and thinking critically.
Completing tasks independently.
Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
Maintaining focus.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Physical Requirements and Working Conditions
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
No adverse environmental conditions expected.
Base compensation ranges from $225,000 to $265,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.
Date of posting: 9/30/2026
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 12/30/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

Own the definition of customer experience for end-to-end solutions.
Lead completion and upkeep of Ready to Market (R2M) and Ready to Sell (R2S) tools, content, and training.
Team Leadership
Collaborate with the Product leadership team to establish and continuously improve processes for Product Management.
Assist Business Unit leaders in defining core processes and staffing needs to support new solutions.
Coaching

Champion the discipline of product development and product management practices, ensuring teams have the essential tools, processes, and skill sets to build product and service roadmaps that align with Cotiviti’s strategic and operational plans.
Growth
Define and execute three-to-five-year growth strategies, including market expansion, partnership strategies, acquisition integration opportunities, and innovation investments.
Be accountable for developing solutions that support profitability, efficiency, and growth targets.
Lead others in the design and development of new products.
Ask effective questions to fully understand client needs and engage others to solve those challenges. Assist in developing pricing strategies to maximize overall returns.
Quality
Work closely with technology, operations, and senior leadership to ensure releases are of the highest quality and the team can demonstrate progress against quality goals through clear metrics.

Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that employs best-in-class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal-setting process.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience required; Master of Business Administration degree preferred.
10 to 15+ years of progressive insurance and product experience, with a minimum of eight years in senior leadership roles overseeing matrixed teams.
10+ years of experience, with increasing levels of responsibility and oversight, managing Product, Operations, or Professional Services.

10+ years of experience preferred in the healthcare industry, with previous leadership experience in the appropriate domain, strong personnel management and presentation skills, and customer (internal/external) problem diagnostics and solution design capabilities.

Deep subject matter expertise in payer/provider interoperability and claims processing operations; direct experience managing claims operations or payer/provider interoperability for a health plan strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of standards, the regulatory environment, and compliance considerations for interoperability required. Ability to measure and articulate the business value of compliance preferred.
Advanced knowledge of claims management ecosystems and the ability to align R&D processes, such as SAFe Agile, with core operational needs.
Proactive leader with proven experience in strategic and tactical leadership and the ability to pursue and understand cutting-edge technologies.
The intellect and energy to excel in a complex and ever-changing environment, coupled with the poise and ability to act calmly in high-pressure, high-stress situations.
Proven experience in growth-oriented businesses in the healthcare information and analytics space, with strong competencies in developing and leading product development and strategy.
Excellent coach who is results-oriented and can build and motivate high-performance teams.
Cognitive / Mental Requirements
Problem-solving and thinking critically.
Completing tasks independently.
Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
Maintaining focus.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Physical Requirements and Working Conditions
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $225,000 to $265,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Operations
jobs.text:
OEC provides software solutions to those who work in the automotive parts and repair industry. Our solutions make it easier for automotive industry professionals to buy and sell parts, conduct repair research & planning, optimize estimates, improve the parts supply chain, and more. OEC partners with many of the world’s largest manufacturers, dealers and suppliers, shops and repairers, and service providers, giving our customers access to a comprehensive network and a streamlined workflow.
Job Summary Provides guidance to assigned product leaders and their direct reports, and ensures work is distributed across the team in a manner that optimizes throughput and builds skills and capabilities. Monitors evolution in the industry, innovation in parallel industries, competitor products, market, and consumer trends, to drive product portfolio decisions. Establishes, directs, and maintains the overall policies and strategies for product operations.
Key Responsibilities
Leads, guides, evaluates and monitors deliverables of assigned product team(s). Ensures clarity around priorities and provides performance feedback and coaching. Motivates and empowers department leaders to manage day-to-day execution of team operations and removes obstacles to improve team productivity & effectiveness. Encourages leadership development and growth and implements professional development plans for high-potential employees. Ensures performance issues are addressed timely and appropriately.
Works in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and execute engagement, recognition, promotion, and retention strategies, focused on making sure the organization has the right talent to drive product strategy and initiatives forward.
Guides and assists the creation of the product roadmap, success criteria, and product launch plans to drive clear prioritization, organizational alignment, customer satisfaction, and sales.
Partners regularly with senior management and leadership teams to develop OEC and product line strategies and delivers on team and OEC’s goals.
Models adaptability by encouraging continuous evolution to product portfolio considering industry trends, emerging solutions, new insights, and changing customer and business needs.
Develops and builds business cases reflecting all necessary commercial and technical considerations required to secure product development funding. Ensures teams are creating detailed plans and executing them to meet financial commitments of projects.
Partners with Technology leaders to refine and deploy effective collaboration techniques between product and engineering.
Owns organizational approach to product lifecycle management, including clear and consistent frameworks for how investment decisions are made across the portfolio.
Designs product packaging, pricing, and name to distinguish product line(s) from other OEC and competitive products in line with the product’s value proposition and refines the approach to voice of customer (VoC) and market research so that customer and market insight consistently informs product decisions.
10. Defines core services across the portfolio that are customer-focused, revenue-generating, strategically sound, and operationally central. 11. Recruits, hires and onboards new product leaders and staff. Ensures newly hired employees have the tools, resources, and knowledge needed to be successful at OEC. 12. Supports the legal team and subsequent agreement needs, business development strategy, and related work. 13. Assists in developing annual department budget(s). Identifies, manages, and allocates company resources (budget and staffing) to ensure business goals can be accomplished, while ensuring fiscal responsibility. 14. Continuously innovates on best practices for how AI is leveraged, both internally and within the products themselves.
Education A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Business, Marketing, or related discipline. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.
Experience, Skills and Key Competencies At least 14 years of progressively responsible experience in a product development environment managing large scale projects and implementations, plus at least 10 years of people management experience with responsibility for leading a team of direct reports.
Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:
Ability to lead diverse teams and create an engaging and positive culture that motivates and empowers others to do their best work; can unlock the full potential of product teams.
Background as both a hands-on product manager and a senior people leader with a genuine passion for product operations.
Applied AI experience, ideally including designing and building AI agents.
Experience in a private equity-backed business, with software as a service (SaaS) background.
Experience with Profit & Loss (P&L) management and department budgeting.
Excellent at coaching and developing people, building strong leaders and a deep bench of talent.
Able to lead without authority, influencing and aligning stakeholders across product, engineering, and the broader business.
A proven change agent who drives adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working.
Monetization and pricing experience, including pricing strategy.
Strong interpersonal skills with executive presence, and able to collaborate across all levels of the organization.
Flexible and adaptable approach to work and can effectively support product leaders and their staff through change management and with adjusting to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
Travel
Travel for this position is required and anticipated to be approximately 10-20% of the time.
What makes working at OEC awesome? It varies from employee to employee. For some, it's the flexibility - whether it's remote work or a hybrid or in-person role, OEC takes our teams across multiple time zones and international communities. For others, it's the strong sense of camaraderie and community that celebrates both individuals and team-driven contributions. Or it could be the empowerment and how the team is encouraged to take risks, learn, and grow within a dynamic and supportive environment. But no matter what gets us out of bed in the morning, our whole global community is inspired to be forward thinking and drive innovative solutions for the automotive parts and repair industry.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Why Tenna?
We take pride that our roots are in the construction industry. With this experience and knowledge, we have built a platform revolutionizing construction equipment fleet operations. We provide innovative solutions to customers looking for competitive ways to better manage and track their assets, such as heavy and light equipment, large fleets, tools, and materials.
At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible.
When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets on one comprehensive platform anytime, anywhere.
Position Description
Tenna is searching for a Vice President of Product to partner with our Executive Team to define and execute the product strategy for our B2B SaaS, mobile, and hardware-enabled platform. This leader will translate Tenna’s product vision into practical, actionable plans and ensure our product teams deliver solutions that create measurable value for customers.
The VP of Product will lead multiple teams, establish clear priorities, and bring structure and accountability to product execution. This is not a strategy-only position. We are looking for a hands-on, outcomes-oriented leader who stays close to the work, regularly checks progress, removes obstacles, and ensures our commitments are met.
The right candidate is an analytical, low-ego leader who listens well, communicates clearly, and is equally comfortable with engaging executives, product and engineering teams, and prospective and existing customers. They will bring experience developing complex, high-value B2B products within industrial markets and supporting solutions deployed across thousands of users.
Your Responsibilities
Partner with the Executive Team to define and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy aligned with Tenna’s business goals, market opportunities, and customer needs.
Translate long-term product strategy into clear roadmaps, priorities, timelines, and executable plans for product, design, engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
Lead, and develop multiple and distributed product teams.
Maintain close visibility into product development, regularly reviewing progress, identifying risks, removing blockers, and ensuring teams deliver against commitments.
Oversee the development and evolution of Tenna’s web, native mobile, SaaS, and hardware-enabled product offerings.
Ensure products are designed to support large-scale deployment across thousands of users and complex customer environments.
Establish and monitor meaningful product metrics, using data to evaluate performance, prioritize investments, and communicate progress.
Present product plans, performance data, tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to executive leadership and other key stakeholders.
Promote disciplined product development best practices while adapting processes to meet the needs of the business.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations.
Develop and improve the tools, systems, and operating rhythms used to manage product work and communicate progress.
Cultivate a practical, customer-focused product culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and execution.
Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proventrack record of success in launching and scaling B2B technology products in a fast-paced environment.
2+ years of experience in senior leadership roles
Significant product management and product leadership experience within a B2B SaaS organization.
Demonstrated success leading multiple product teams, including teams or stakeholders operating across different regions or countries.
Experience developing and delivering complex B2B products within industrial verticals.
Strong record of moving beyond strategy to drive execution, monitor progress, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Experience with web applications and native mobile application development, including products deployed at scale to thousands of users.
Experience working with hardware-enabled products and connected software ecosystems.
Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud-based platforms, multi-tenant systems, and product development.
Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and understand how technologies and programming languages such as JavaScript, Java, Python, Swift, and Kotlin support product development. This role is not expected to read or write production code.
Experience reporting to and communicating directly with senior executives, including C-suite leaders.
Ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into clear recommendations, priorities, and decisions.
Experience using sophisticated product and project management tools to manage work, analyze data, and communicate plans and timelines.
Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Figma, Zeplin, or comparable platforms.
Experience directly engaging prospective and existing customers about current products, future offerings, and unmet needs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and persuasively.
Strong people-management skills and a demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and align high-performing teams.
Analytical, practical, and execution-oriented approach to leadership.
Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information
Full-time opportunity.
Opportunity is remote – nationwide.
Competitive compensation package.
Travel is required, up to 25%.
Robust, low-cost benefit packages.
Benefit coverage begins the first date of employment.
Dependent Care.
401k match.
Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Senior Director, System Engineering & Intelligence, Global
jobs.text:
About Nscale
Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.
At Nscale, our Data Centre Systems Engineering team designs the systems, data, and intelligence that let us build and operate AI data centres at a speed and density traditional operating models were never designed for. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
About the Role
Nscale's operational systems (BMS, DCIM, EPMS/SCADA, CMMS/EAM, ITSM, fabric and GPU telemetry) and equipment data were procured independently. Each works well on its own, but together they give overlapping and sometimes contradictory views of the same assets.
As Senior Director, System Engineering & Intelligence, you will bring that data centre insight together. You'll own the equipment digital thread — from product definition and procurement through commissioning and handover into maintenance — along with the telemetry and analytics foundation that lets the Nscale Operational Systems (NOS) act on our physical estate with confidence.
The goal is data centres that are measurably self-aware and progressively self-operating, where a site is declared ready based on evidence rather than judgement.
What You'll be Doing

- Own the asset master and governance: establish one canonical identity for every asset, along with taxonomy, hierarchy, configuration, and BOM standards, ensuring every critical data object has one system of record.
- Lead cleansing and validation-at-source programmes so governed lifecycle data replaces spreadsheets.
- Build the telemetry foundation: deliver a unified asset and topology model from grid connection down to GPU and network port, with OT/IT ingest (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, MQTT, Redfish, DCGM) and IEC 62443-aligned segmentation.
- Publish data-quality scores and agree single, shared definitions for PUE, WUE, capacity, stranded power, and availability.
- Make maintenance and reliability trustworthy: own the CMMS/EAM configuration baseline (criticality, PM strategy, spares, warranties) and controlled SOP/MOP/EOP libraries.
- Map condition data deterministically to assets so predictive maintenance raises work orders, not just reports.
- Move NOS intelligence toward autonomy: build anomaly detection, remaining-useful-life prediction, and thermal and power optimisation.
- Progress control loops through shadow, recommend-only, human-approved, and bounded-autonomous stages, each with explicit safety envelopes and engineering sign-off.
- Assure site readiness: turn commissioning (L1–L5) into data, set acceptance gates for handover, and score readiness quantitatively per hall and per site.
- Benchmark readiness across the portfolio so defects found on one build are designed out of the next.
- Act as the senior escalation point across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Operations, Reliability, Platform, Finance, and HSE, and enforce supplier and OFCI data deliverables.
- Build and develop a high-performing team spanning lifecycle engineering, data science, and data engineering.
About You
15+ years of experience across engineering, asset management, enterprise systems, or industrial analytics, including 7+ years leading cross-functional programmes at director level or above.
- Ownership of a CMMS/EAM platform at scale (e.g. Maximo, SAP PM, Infor, Nuvolo), plus depth in master data, PIM/PLM, BOM, and configuration management.
- Proven delivery of analytics or ML on physical infrastructure (data centres, energy, utilities, heavy industry, or similar), including hands-on experience with messy BMS/SCADA/historian data.
- Experience taking models into control or decision loops, along with the safety, validation, and governance work that requires.
- Strong judgement on enterprise and data architecture, including ERP, integration, streaming, time-series storage, lineage, and Palantir Foundry or an equivalent platform.
- Experience with ITIL-aligned operations and controlled MOP, LOTO, and permit-to-work regimes in mission-critical environments.
- Credibility with both facilities engineers and software teams.
- A track record of building a function from scratch.
- Honesty and clarity with executives about uncertainty.
Nice to Have
Knowledge of AI/HPC data centre plant, including liquid cooling, UPS, switchgear, and GPU and fabric telemetry.
- Familiarity with reliability standards such as RCM, FMEA, ISO 14224, and ISO 55000.
- Experience with digital twin or CFD-informed modelling.
- Experience with BIM/COBie handover.
Background in energy and grid optimisation.
Why this role matters

Fewer unplanned incidents, faster detection and diagnosis, and more interventions triggered by prediction rather than alarms.
- Improved PM compliance, MTTR, and spares fill rate.
- PUE/WUE gains and stranded capacity recovered.
- Cohesive analytics views across the data centre landscape.
- Fewer post-energisation defects and a shorter time from mechanical completion to customer-ready.
- Less redundant tooling and more critical assets with governed, quality-scored data.
- Control loops advanced toward autonomy with zero safety-envelope breaches.

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at
safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: VP, Subscription Product
jobs.text:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.
ABOUT THE ROLE
iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and VP, Subscription Product is the leader who sets its direction. You own the product vision, the differentiation thesis, and the AI and personalization philosophy.
You report to the Chief Subscription Officer. You partner with the CSO on where the vision product roadmap. You work as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Retention, Content, and Analytics leaders, who operate as first class members of the model.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Product vision and differentiation. Set and defend the product vision, the member experience vision, and the defensibility thesis. Make the final call on the AI and personalization philosophy.
Product prioritization/Roadmap. Set the quarterly percentage split across Core, Growth, and Partner work with the CSO investment lens and Engineering capacity reality. Set the platform and tech debt percentage, which Engineering defines and spends.
Product strategy. Decide product strategy across domains and review domain roadmaps, PRDs, and the single backlog (one queue, three lanes) for coherence.
Monetization innovation. Own the concept pipeline for new revenue ideas. Build the business case, make a clear recommendation, and drive the CSO to a decision on pricing, plans, packaging, and investment.
Innovation pipeline. Own future state concepts and the innovation pipeline, in consultation with Design, Engineering, and Analytics.
Product leadership. Lead and develop the Core Product Leader, Growth Product Leader, and Partner Product Leader. Hold each accountable for outcomes: engagement for Core, funnel for Growth, and partner experiences for Partner.
HOW YOU DECIDE
Decides - Product vision, member experience vision, AI and personalization philosophy, differentiation thesis, innovation pipeline, product strategy, and the quarterly capacity split.
Consulted on - Pricing, plans and packaging, investment decisions, domain roadmaps, retention strategy, content strategy, and acquisition strategy.
Informed on - Commercial partner negotiations, partner sales, paid acquisition, and brand and campaigns.
Does not own - The subscription P&L, pricing, or commercial deals, Architecture and delivery, The retention number, The experiment gate,
OPERATING RHYTHM
Quarterly planning: set the capacity split with the CSO and Engineering, with Analytics arriving with the insights agenda.
Ongoing: review domain roadmaps and resolve cross domain conflicts, then communicate decisions directly and in public.
Regular readouts to the CSO and executive team on product outcomes, bets, and tradeoffs.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.
Best in class engagement and retention results.
Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.
Building the #1 app in Fitness
Three domain leaders who own their slices and escalate only when they should.
WHAT YOU BRING
12 or more years in product, with 5 or more years leading product leaders at a consumer subscription, mobile, or connected fitness company.
Proven record of setting product vision and turning it into a prioritized portfolio with real tradeoffs.
Deep fluency in subscription economics: conversion, retention, LTV, CAC, and pricing and packaging.
Hands on experience shaping an AI and personalization strategy for consumers.
Comfort making direct decisions and holding the tiebreaker without losing partnership with Design, Engineering, and Marketing.
Experience running experimentation programs with an analytics gate.
Executive presence and the ability to present to the CEO and board.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven products.
Experience with partner ecosystems, integrations, and platform products.
Experience scaling a product organization through a reorganization or operating model change.
DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.
Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. Current list of states where iFIT may consider hiring: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.
Subject to applicable state laws, your employment at iFIT is "at-will". At-will employment means that you and the company each have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any cause or for no cause at all.
Pay Range:
$200,000—$225,000 USD
iFIT does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ancestry, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.
This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.
The Position
We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.
Key Accountabilities
Leadership and Operations:
Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.
Solution Engineering:
Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.
Customer Support Operations:
Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.
Who You Are
Skills/Knowledge:
Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.
Requirements:
BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team
Preferred Skills:
SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.
Join Us
We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.
We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.
In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.
Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!
At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:
•All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
• We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
• We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
• Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.
Learn more about how to spot recruitment scams and protect yourself - FBI warning:
Claritas Rx is committed to transparency, integrity, and a safe hiring experience for every candidate. Learn more

jobs.title: VP AI Engineering - Enterprise
jobs.text:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
Certified as a Great Place to Work®
Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance
VP AI Engineering - Enterprise
PRIMARY PURPOSE: The Vice President, Generative (Gen) AI Engineering Enterprise, provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and accountability for the enterprise data and AI engineering ecosystem that enables the organization’s most advanced analytics, data science, and generative AI initiatives. This role owns the vision, governance, and execution model for the enterprise data supply chain that powers machine learning platforms, feature stores, and production‑grade generative AI capabilities.
As a senior leader, the Vice President establishes and scales the engineering strategy required to transform legacy and modern data assets into trusted, AI‑ready enterprise capabilities. The role ensures that data and AI engineering investments are aligned to business outcomes, regulatory expectations, and long‑term architectural sustainability across on‑premise and multi‑cloud environments, including Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Defines and leads the enterprise strategy for data and generative AI engineering, establishing standards, roadmaps, and operating models that support analytics, machine learning, and AI at scale.
Provides executive oversight for the design, delivery, and operation of enterprise ETL/ELT platforms that integrate legacy on‑premise systems (including mainframe, SQL Server, and DB2) with modern cloud data and AI platforms.
Establishes governance and accountability for feature stores, analytically optimized datasets, and AI‑ready data products to ensure reproducibility, regulatory compliance, and production reliability.
Sets direction for generative AI enablement, including enterprise approaches for vectorization, embeddings, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and secure consumption of structured and unstructured data.
Owns the enterprise Snowflake strategy, including architectural patterns, performance standards, cost governance, and integration with cloud‑based AI services across AWS and Azure.
Leads cross‑functional collaboration with Technology, Security, Infrastructure, Legal, Risk, and Compliance leaders to ensure data and AI engineering practices meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Establishes executive‑level operating metrics and financial discipline to ensure data and AI engineering investments deliver measurable business value and return on investment.
Provides leadership and direction to engineering leaders and teams, setting priorities, removing organizational barriers, and ensuring consistent execution across portfolios and initiatives.
Serves as a senior advisor to executive leadership on data, AI, and generative AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities, translating technical complexity into business‑level insights and decisions.
Drives organizational readiness by shaping talent strategy, capability development, and succession planning for data and AI engineering roles across the enterprise.
Job Responsibilities
Lead AI engineering for enterprise functions including HR, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and other corporate functions.
Identify and deliver high-value LLM, agentic AI, workflow automation, and knowledge-assistant use cases.
Build reusable AI capabilities, agents, APIs, connectors, and workflow integrations rather than isolated point solutions.
Own the enterprise administration and operational management of ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude.
Manage user access, licenses, roles, permissions, workspaces, and enterprise configuration for these platforms.
Establish and manage approved connectors and integrations to enterprise data and applications.
Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and AI Governance to define appropriate access controls and data-use guardrails.
Establish standards for enterprise use of GPTs, agents, projects, connectors, and other platform capabilities.
Monitor adoption, utilization, license consumption, token/API usage, and overall platform effectiveness.
Partner closely with Finance and Procurement to manage AI platform spend, forecasting, chargeback/showback, license optimization, and vendor commitments.
Develop cost-management practices to identify unused licenses, excessive consumption, duplicated capabilities, and opportunities for optimization.
Own relationships with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other relevant enterprise AI technology providers.
Evaluate new platform capabilities and determine when they should be enabled, restricted, piloted, or adopted broadly.
Ensure enterprise AI tools align with Sedgwick's broader AI architecture and do not create unmanaged technology or data silos.
Establish operational dashboards for adoption, usage, cost, risk, and business value.

As a senior leader, the Vice President establishes and scales the engineering strategy required to transform legacy and modern data assets into trusted, AI‑ready enterprise capabilities. items: Defines and leads the enterprise strategy for data and generative AI engineering, establishing standards, roadmaps, and operating models that support analytics, machine learning, and AI at scale.

Provides executive oversight for the design, delivery, and operation of enterprise ETL/ELT platforms that integrate legacy on‑premise systems (including mainframe, SQL Server, and DB2) with modern cloud data and AI platforms.
Establishes governance and accountability for feature stores, analytically optimized datasets, and AI‑ready data products to ensure reproducibility, regulatory compliance, and production reliability.

Sets direction for generative AI enablement, including enterprise approaches for vectorization, embeddings, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and secure consumption of structured and unstructured data.
Owns the enterprise Snowflake strategy, including architectural patterns, performance standards, cost governance, and integration with cloud‑based AI services across AWS and Azure.

Leads cross‑functional collaboration with Technology, Security, Infrastructure, Legal, Risk, and Compliance leaders to ensure data and AI engineering practices meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Establishes executive‑level operating metrics and financial discipline to ensure data and AI engineering investments deliver measurable business value and return on investment.
Provides leadership and direction to engineering leaders and teams, setting priorities, removing organizational barriers, and ensuring consistent execution across portfolios and initiatives.
Serves as a senior advisor to executive leadership on data, AI, and generative AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities, translating technical complexity into business‑level insights and decisions.

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution
Requirements
Non-Negotiable
Deep, production-level experience with n8n automation systems
Strong full-stack development skills (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases)
Proven experience leading engineers while remaining hands-on
Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code in development workflows
Strong working experience with Clay for data enrichment, signal detection, or GTM automation
Experience building and scaling AI/LLM systems in production
Strong systems architecture thinking (scalability, reliability, fault tolerance)
Executive-level mindset with the ability to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Preferred Experience
Agency or services background with multi-client automation systems
Experience building SaaS or productized internal tools
Familiarity with tools like Airtable, HubSpot, Slack APIs, and outbound infrastructure
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.)
Benefits
💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams
🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services
🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network
🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement
💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals
