jobs.title: AVP, Data Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.
The Assistant Vice President, Data Solutions Engineering will be responsible for building operational data pipelines and delivering fully documented datasets that account for data integrations. This role is engaged and aligned with our business partners to understand their needs and build data engineering solutions to address these needs. The role will report to the VP, Data Solutions Engineering.
This role will be based remotely.
What You Will Do:
Deliver well-architected data solutions in partnership with data platform engineers, data governance, data science, and data analytics/visualization peers.
Partner with business teams to design data solutions with the ability to mentor early career data engineers.
Lead build-out and deployment of data pipelines.
Ensure reliability, scalability and governance of data pipelines.
What You Will Have:
Bachelor's degree in Math, Computer Science or Engineering.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, Cloud, data operations.
Domain knowledge of Actuarial, Investment and Finance within Insurance/Reinsurance industry is a plus.
Minimum experience of seven years in a growing data engineering role, with at least five years in programming (Python) and SQL.
Robust knowledge of data lakes, data governance and modern data quality techniques.
Excellent analytical, problem solving and conceptual skills.
Strong verbal and written skills.
The base salary range for this role is listed below and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, all employees are eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.
Base Salary Range
$160,000—$180,000 USD
At Fortitude Re, our strength has always come from our people. Our success is deeply rooted in our ability to embrace the unique attributes, perspectives and experiences of every individual within our company. Fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging where everyone—regardless of background, race, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity—feels valued and respected is a foundation of our culture.
We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer and evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, diversity of thought and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
To all recruitment agencies: Unless you have been requested to work on this position, or other positions with Fortitude Re, please do not forward any resumes to Fortitude Re employees. Fortitude Re is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
Check us out on YouTube: About Fortitude Re (youtube.com)
By submitting your application, you agree that Fortitude Re may collect your personal data for recruiting purposes. For more on how we handle your personal data, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice. Concerned about recruitment fraud? Learn how to verify Fortitude Re's recruitment process: Recruitment Fraud Notice

jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Strategic Solution Engineering (Central)
jobs.text:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?
JFrog is seeking a dynamic and visionary leader to join as the Regional Vice President of Strategic Solution Engineering. In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of expanding JFrog’s presence within key accounts, driving the adoption of our cutting-edge DevOps, DevSecOps, and MLOps solutions, and ensuring the success of our most strategic customers.
As Regional Vice President (RVP), you’ll lead a high-performing team of technical professionals, working with JFrog’s most strategic customers, forming strong customer relationships, delivering exceptional technical proofs of concept (POCs) and pre-sales guidance while acting as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders. Reporting directly to the VP, Strategics and Field CTO, you’ll align regional strategies with corporate objectives, ensuring revenue growth, customer happiness, strategy alignment, and market leadership.
As a RVP of Strategic Solution Engineering in JFrog you will...
Develop and execute strategies to drive customer happiness and revenue growth within strategic accounts.
Align team efforts with market trends, corporate goals, and competitive insights to enhance regional impact.
Lead and inspire a high-performing team of technical professionals, ensuring exceptional customer outcomes.
Partner with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to align strategies and optimize processes.
Engage with executive stakeholders, positioning JFrog as a strategic partner while addressing complex challenges.
Stay ahead of DevOps, DevSecOps and MLOps trends, refining strategies to address customer needs effectively.
To be an RVP of Strategic Solutions in JFrog you need...
10+ years of experience in enterprise software/SaaS, including 5+ years managing technical or solution-oriented teams.
Proven ability to drive seven- and eight-figure deals using methodologies like MEDDPICC and value-based selling.
Deep expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, and pre-sales activities such as needs analysis and product demonstrations.
Proven track record of driving high-value deals, developing strategic account plans, and achieving corporate objectives.
Exceptional analytical and communication skills, data driven, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
Willingness to travel to engage with customers and support team success.
Passionately drives agility and proactive approach, ensuring seamless alignment with stakeholders, customer goals, and JFrog's mission.
WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…
At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package. This position has a base salary range between $192,000 to $215,000. Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU). In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!
JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Scientific Data
jobs.text:
About the Role
Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve >250 R&D institutions, including most of the top global biotech & pharma companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.
The Director, Scientific Data will own the integrity, structure, and evolution of Drug Hunter’s scientific data across our knowledge platform and scientific databases. You will lead the scientific data team within our Technical organization and be the bridge between our scientists and our engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary internal subject-matter expert for cheminformatics and scientific data, with sufficient breadth across bioinformatics and drug discovery data to guide data decisions spanning chemistry and biology.
Own the scientific strategy for how Drug Hunter acquires, represents, integrates, normalizes, and maintains scientific data, partnering with Engineering on the architecture and systems that operationalize that strategy and Science on both automated and manual data curation processes.
Define how chemical entities are represented, registered, standardized, and resolved across sources, and establish curation standards, controlled vocabularies, QA rules, and tooling that allows data curation to take place at scale
Define approaches for extracting structured scientific information from unstructured content, including chemical structures, text, and tables from literature and patents, and establish how extracted information should be linked to canonical entities.
Own the scientific semantics, entity resolution, and ontology strategy that unifies compound synonyms, target and gene nomenclature, disease terms, organizations, assays, and other scientific concepts across sources, including approaches for handling ambiguity and conflicting source assertions.
Evaluate scientific data sources across chemistry, biology, DMPK, drug, and clinical domains, assessing their coverage, scientific quality, overlap, limitations, licensing considerations, and update characteristics, and determine how they should contribute to Drug Hunter's data.
Establish standards for scientific data quality, provenance, validation, completeness, and freshness, and ensure the Data team has effective processes for identifying and resolving data-quality issues.
Partner closely with Science to translate scientific expertise and curation decisions into consistent, maintainable data models, standards, and processes.
Partner with Engineering to define data models and technical approaches that accurately represent complex scientific information and support the Drug Hunter platform, jointly evaluating architectural decisions and trade-offs where data and application systems intersect.
Partner with Product Management to translate scientific and technical requirements into project specifications for the data team and communicate the trade-offs the technical decisions carry.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for scientific datasets, chem- and bio-informatics capabilities, and data tooling, partnering with Engineering where decisions involve shared technical infrastructure or application architecture.
Lead the Data team in translating scientific data priorities into executable projects, remaining sufficiently involved in day-to-day work to understand progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and workload.
Provide scientific and technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data team, creating, hiring, and managing roles as needed.
Requirements
PhD in cheminformatics, bioinformatics, computational biology, structural biology, or a related quantitative life-science field.
10+ years working with scientific data in drug discovery, biotech, or life science data/informatics companies, including 3+ years leading people or a data function
Working cheminformatics literacy (molecular representations, structure standardization, substructure/similarity search concepts, RDKit or similar tools)
Fluency in bioinformatics, with a deep working knowledge of biological databases and ontologies, target and pathway biology, and gene/protein identifier mapping
Strong data modeling skills and hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with data pipelines and modern data tooling
Understanding of the drug discovery process from target to clinic, and ability to converse fluently with medicinal chemsits and biologists
Clear communicator who can move seamlessly between scientific details and engineering/product trade-offs
Benefits
Drug Hunter provides industry-leading benefits, including the following:
Competitive salary, variable compensation, and equity
Broad range of medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees and their dependents, including generous coverage for a platinum PPO healthcare plan
Short-term disability and long-term disability insurance
Cancer and critical illness coverage
Up to 14 weeks paid parental leave (after 1 yr tenure) and childcare FSA plan
401(k) + employer match
Home office set up stipend for fully remote employees
Learning and development support
Generous and flexible vacation and leave policies

jobs.title: Firm-wide Data Governance - Data Quality and Data Contracts - Vice President
jobs.text:
You will drive the execution of data governance across large-scale initiatives. This role sits at the center of improving data quality, strengthening controls, and enabling teams to manage data effectively. You will influence outcomes by ensuring data is governed with consistency and accountability.
As a Data Quality Governance Lead in the Firmwide Data Governance Function, you will lead the design and implementation of comprehensive data governance frameworks that ensure data integrity, quality, and compliance across the organization. Your role is pivotal in shaping the strategic direction of data management practices, influencing operational and business decisions that extend beyond immediate outcomes. You will leverage your deep expertise in regulatory compliance and data quality to mitigate risks and safeguard our reputation. By fostering collaboration across diverse teams, you will drive the adoption of best practices and innovative solutions, ensuring our data assets are responsibly managed and aligned with business goals. Your leadership will empower teams to navigate complex data challenges, enhancing our operational efficiency and supporting sustainable growth.
Job responsibilities
Develop and enforce data quality governance policies and standards to ensure compliance with data quality standards
Lead the design and implementation of data quality controls and data contracts for firm's most important data
Establish governance strategy, operating model, and ownership
Oversee adoption and implementation of data quality controls and data contracts for critical data elements along the lineage
Partner with CDOs, Data Owners, product, and technology teams to implement and enhance tooling solutions
Lead governance forums and cross-functional engagement to data quality and data contracts implementation across the bank for scoped activities.
Resolve complex data issues by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions
Drive the adoption of change management initiatives, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in data governance practices
Build knowledge of how business areas, architecture, applications, data platforms, and infrastructure integrate to accomplish business goals
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
8 years of experience or equivalent expertise in designing and implementing data governance frameworks and policies
Experience in data, analytics, or product roles supporting data governance outcomes
Hands on experience in driving data quality transformation programs including data quality controls, data contracts, and lineage
Experience implementing enterprise Data Quality controls and monitoring frameworks
Experience with industry tools like Collibra, Snowflake, Databricks
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional and multi-disciplinary teams
Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and project management skills

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
About Onfleet
Onfleet is the last-mile delivery platform behind millions of deliveries every month for thousands of businesses around the world. We enable shippers to manage deliveries across their private fleet, carriers, and couriers. We make it easy for dispatchers to plan and run their operations, drivers to execute deliveries, and recipients to get real-time tracking and notifications. Our customers span grocery, prepared meals, pharmacy, flowers, furniture, and more.
The Role
We're looking for a Vice President of Product to lead Product at Onfleet, owning how our strategy gets translated into roadmaps and how roadmaps turn into shipped, adopted products. Your job is to sharpen our strategy where needed and define how the Onfleet product suite evolves as we scale up in a fast-growing market. This is a hands-on leadership seat where you'll stay close to the details and roll up your sleeves when the team needs it.
You'll report to our CEO and lead Product Management, Design, and User Research. You’ll also work closely with Engineering, QA, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience. As our senior-most product leader, you'll sit on our Strategic Leadership Team and represent Product in company planning.
What You'll Do
Own the product roadmap that delivers on our strategy, and update both as our market and target customers change.
Prioritize aggressively by committing to a few well-scoped bets per quarter and saying no to other competing initiatives.
Build deep knowledge of the last-mile delivery industry and our core users: shippers, carriers and couriers, dispatchers, drivers, and recipients.
Lead quarterly and annual planning with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and partner with them to set company goals that tie product work to business outcomes.
Own how we gather, prioritize, and close the loop on product feedback from customers, Sales, CX, and other internal teams.
Coordinate work across squads so dependencies and risks surface early, and keep one roadmap view the whole company can see.
Connect product success metrics to company metrics, and build a team habit of defining success before launch and acting on what adoption data shows.
Represent Product internally and with our board of directors, customer advisory boards, and key customers.
Foster a collaborative team culture and think ahead about team structure, process, and tooling.
Coach the team and define clear growth paths for each member.
What You'll Bring
You have 10+ years in B2B SaaS product roles, including 5+ years leading product teams and 3+ years as Director of Product or above.
You've run Product at a Series B+ company generating tens of millions of dollars in ARR.
You've led a product through a move upmarket into enterprise.
You've directly hired, managed, and developed Product Managers, Designers, and User Researchers.
You have significant UX and design experience, and you champion it across the company. You've overseen teams that run usability tests, user interviews, and experiments.
You've partnered with Engineering as equals: scoping work together before committing, keeping scope stable once work starts, and shipping in small iterations.
You've run market research to size opportunities in a customer base and adjacent markets.
You make roadmap calls by weighing customer evidence, usage data, strategy, and business impact, and you explain the trade-offs clearly.
You're analytical, using data to make decisions and hold yourself and your team to the numbers.
You've built or managed a Product Operations function, with working fluency in tools like Jira, Productboard, and Amplitude.
You communicate clearly in writing and in person.
You're highly organized and focused on outcomes.
Nice To Have
Experience in last-mile logistics or delivery.
What We Offer
Remote-first work environment with quarterly domestic travel
Generous employee stock options
Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
401(k)
Flexible PTO
Onfleet Is an Equal Opportunity Employer
Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.
We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.
We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product Management
jobs.text:
About xCures
The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.
xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.
xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.
Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.
We are building for the lives people want to live.
Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact:
xCures is hiring a product leader who turns open questions into dated decisions. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own how xCures decides what to build and how it shows the build was worth it. You will lead the product management team across our customer segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Product strategy. Define and own the multi-year product strategy, and keep it tied to the company’s growth goals
Roadmap ownership. Own the product roadmap across our customer segments. Set direction, sequence the work, and carry the trade-offs
Decision making. Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs
Team leadership. Hire, develop, and lead a team of product managers. Set the performance bar and create a path for people to grow
Product operating model. Own and scale the process from discovery through launch, including requirements standards, prioritization, and launch readiness
Cross-functional execution. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to ship committed work on committed dates
Measurement and outcomes. Define the success metric for each launch before it ships, and report against it afterward
Portfolio lifecycle and expansion. Own the path from early concept to production, and decide what earns continued investment and what retires. Lead expansion into new markets and segments

blocks.text: About xCures

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.

xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.
We are building for the lives people want to live.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US
We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.
About Foundant
At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.
We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.
Where You’ll Work:
As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
Own the product management function across Foundant's portfolio of SaaS products, serving customers across the US, Canada, the EU, Australia, and the UK.
Lead the Product Managers, Product Owners, and Product Designers aligned to each product line, setting direction and raising the bar for how the portfolio is built and run.
Build out the organizational competency, process maturity and tooling.
Instrument active listening, structured data and signals, and operational metrics across the portfolio.
Partner with the CTO, CEO, and Chief Strategy Officer to shape portfolio-level strategy and investment prioritie, across both organic and inorganic initiatives.
Partner closely with engineering leadership on execution of product initiatives and roadmap objectives.
Partner with leaders in the Sales and Marketing and Customer Success organizations to ensure downstream GTM execution that drives product releases to realization of value.
Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
10+ years of experience in product management, including experience building and leading product management organizations at scale.
Proven experience leading Product Management, Product Ownership, and Product Design functions together within SaaS organizations.
Experience operating a multi-product, multi-region SaaS portfolio, ideally spanning international markets such as the US, Canada, the UK, the EU, and/or Australia.
Demonstrated experience selecting, implementing, and scaling product management process/methodology, tooling and infrastructure to support organizational maturity.
MBA preferred
Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:
Strategic Thinking
Translates Foundant's North Star into a coherent portfolio strategy across five SaaS products and five global markets, partnering with the CTO, CEO, and Chief Strategy Officer to shape organic and inorganic investment decisions that move the whole portfolio forward together.
Performance Advancement
Builds the operating backbone of the product management function — active listening, structured signals, and portfolio-level metrics — creating the visibility needed to catch problems early and double down on what's actually working for the people we serve.
Decision-Making
Weighs data, market signals, and cross-functional input to make and defend prioritization and investment calls across a five-product portfolio, staying transparent with executive peers about trade-offs rather than papering over them.
Staff Development
Builds bench strength across the Product Management, Product Ownership, and Product Design leaders at each product line, coaching them to raise both craft and business impact.
Change Management
Leads the organization through the process, tooling, and operating-model changes required to mature the product management function, bringing teams along with clear reasoning rather than top-down mandates.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!
Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.
Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

jobs.title: Vice President Product Development, Literacy
jobs.text:
We are seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking educational publishing executive to drive our Product Development efforts for K–12 Literacy, including Supplemental, Assessment, and Intervention solutions. In this role, you'll use your experience guiding development teams to manage our comprehensive literacy portfolio. What You’ll Do You will provide overall product development leadership for our Literacy portfolio, which includes K–12 Literacy, Supplemental, Assessment & Intervention. With support from the Senior Vice-President of Product Development, you’ll collaborate with Product Management/Marketing, Creative Design/UX, and Product Technology to develop innovative product models that meet the needs of today’s teachers and students. You will drive product strategy and oversee planning, budgeting, and development for all literacy projects. You will lead a dedicated editorial team through all stages of product development, ensuring that projects are completed on time, on budget, and aligned with the original product vision. You will manage relationships with program authors, key internal personnel, and external partners, including consultants, reviewers, and vendors. Your Experience
You have 12+ years of experience in curriculum development and/or instructional development of instructional materials with an educational publisher
You love to lead and have experience effectively managing others.
You have a bachelor’s degree in English, Reading, Literacy, Elementary or Secondary Education, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
You have previous teaching experience and knowledge about how children learn.
You enjoy challenges and a dynamic, fast-paced work environment.
You thrive on fruitful collaboration and building consensus among a variety of stakeholders.
You are passionate about improving student outcomes and developing quality content.
You are willing to travel occasionally as projects require.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
The VP, Product Management role will lead the product strategy for several of eMoney's foundational platform capabilities, including data aggregation, APIs, strategic integrations and the evolution of our platform for an AI-native future. This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of product, technology, data and AI. This role will lead a team responsible for products and capabilities that enable eMoney's platform to connect to financial data sources, enterprise customers, strategic partners and increasingly to AI applications and agents. A key priority will be helping eMoney determine how our platform should safely and strategically expose data and planning capabilities to AI agents, including emerging technologies such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), while protecting eMoney's differentiated planning intelligence and intellectual property. This role is an opportunity to shape a foundational component of eMoney's AI strategy and help establish the platform as a trusted source of financial data and planning intelligence within the emerging AI ecosystem.
Job Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Leadership
Bring deep product leadership experience across enterprise platforms, APIs, data products and integrations, combined with a strong understanding of emerging AI technologies and agentic architectures.
• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for eMoney's Platform, Data, APIs and AI capabilities.
• Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing team of Product Managers and product leaders.
• Partner closely with executive leadership to identify opportunities to strengthen eMoney's platform differentiation and competitive position.
• Establish clear product metrics and accountability for business, customer and platform outcomes.
• This role will work with Technology Leadership to determine how these requirements are technically implemented, while maintaining Product accountability for what capabilities should be exposed and under what conditions.
Data Aggregation & Data Products
Lead product strategy for eMoney's data aggregation capabilities and related customer experiences.
• Partner with Technology and Data leadership to ensure the platform is increasingly prepared for AI-driven use cases.
• Identify opportunities to leverage eMoney's data foundation as a strategic differentiator.
AI Platform & Agentic AI
Define eMoney's product strategy for AI platform connectivity and agentic experiences.
• Establish the product strategy and requirements for MCP and other emerging AI connectivity standards.
• Ensure APIs evolve from traditional application integrations toward an architecture capable of supporting AI applications and agent integrations.
• Establish clear product requirements for authentication, authorization, entitlements, data access, auditability and enterprise governance.
• Define appropriate boundaries between customer-accessible data and eMoney's proprietary planning intelligence.
• Ensure AI connectivity supports eMoney's broader Always-On Planning strategy.
• Partner with AI Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal and Compliance leaders to establish appropriate AI governance.
Requirements
12+ years of progressive Product Management experience, with significant experience leading enterprise fintech products.
• Proven experience leading product organizations at the VP or equivalent senior leadership level.
• Deep experience with platform products, APIs, data products, and enterprise integrations.
• Experience defining product strategy for complex technology platforms used by large enterprise customers.
• Strong understanding of modern cloud architectures, APIs, data platforms and enterprise
integration patterns.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with CTO, Engineering and Architecture leaders.
• Experience translating complex technology capabilities into clear customer and business value.
AI / Emerging Technology Experience
Strong understanding of generative AI, AI platforms and emerging agentic architectures.
• Experience defining products or platforms that incorporate AI, intelligent workflows or AI agents.
• Understanding of AI tool/function calling, agent orchestration, APIs and emerging AI connectivity standards such as MCP.
• Ability to assess emerging technologies and translate them into practical product strategies.
• Understanding of the data, security, governance and intellectual-property implications of exposing enterprise capabilities to AI systems.
Skills
The role will be expected to operate effectively at both the strategic executive level and the detailed product-definition level.
• Strong executive communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
• Experience managing and developing senior Product leaders and building high-performing product organizations.
The salary range for this position is $227,000 - $282,000; commensurate salary to be determined based on skills, professional background and expertise. This position is also eligible, pursuant to applicable eMoney policies, for the annual bonus program, retirement contributions, health insurance, sick leave, parental leave and paid time off.
At eMoney, we’re powering what’s possible in financial planning. Our mission is to help people talk about money and make more informed financial decisions. Through our comprehensive financial planning solutions, we help advisors bring clarity to complex decisions and deliver more personalized guidance.
Today, eMoney supports more than 138,000 financial professionals who guide the financial lives of over 7 million end clients. That reach gives every member of our team the opportunity to contribute to work that makes a meaningful, lasting impact.
We’re equally committed to powering what’s possible for our people. We foster an inclusive, people-first culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and employees are supported in doing their best work.
eMoney is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Having built a strong lending business serving SMEs across multiple markets, the company is now expanding its product portfolio while embedding AI across the organization to improve how financial services are delivered.
This role exists because Product has become a strategic priority. Today, product ownership sits between Engineering and a junior Product Owner focused on execution — there's no dedicated leader driving strategy, prioritization, or long-term innovation. The Head of Product will be Abaco's first dedicated Product leader, partnering directly with the executive team to build the Product function from the ground up: owning the roadmap across multiple countries and lending products, establishing a data-driven product culture, and shaping the company's AI strategy.
Success looks like a scalable product organization, faster and better product decisions, successful launches of new lending products, and a business that can grow significantly without adding operational complexity.
Product Strategy & Roadmap: own the long-term product vision across multiple products and markets, define priorities based on customer insights and data, and build a scalable strategy aligned with Abaco's growth objectives.
Product Development: lead end-to-end development of new lending products (declining-balance loans, working capital solutions, micro-factoring), translate business opportunities into clear requirements for Engineering, and manage the product backlog.
Cross-functional Leadership: partner closely with Engineering, Data, Risk, Pricing, Operations, Legal, and Collections; build alignment across stakeholders; present product strategy and business cases to senior leadership with financial and commercial credibility.
Product Operations & Analytics: establish product KPIs, success metrics, and experimentation frameworks; collaborate with Data on collection, reporting, and insights; build scalable processes for faster launching and iteration.
AI & Digital Transformation: help define how AI shows up in customer-facing experiences and internal workflows, support the shift toward conversational channels like WhatsApp, and identify automation opportunities across CX, efficiency, and decision-making.
Requirements
Non-negotiables: 8+ years in Product Management, ideally in fintech, lending, embedded finance, or credit; bilingual; demonstrated experience building products or product orgs from scratch; strong commercial acumen balancing customer needs, business goals, and technical execution; close collaboration with Engineering throughout the product lifecycle; highly analytical, data-driven decision-making; comfortable in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments.
Strong plus: B2B lending, SME financial services, or regulated financial institutions; founder or early-stage startup experience; SQL proficiency; experience embedding AI into digital products or business processes; background in small, high-performing product teams.
Nice to have: experience across multiple countries/international markets; familiarity with conversational products or WhatsApp-based CX; exposure to risk, underwriting, or financial operations.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Data
jobs.text:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.
The Opportunity
At Praxis, we’re building the commercial capabilities to bring transformative therapies to patients with CNS disorders—and we’re looking for builders who dare for more.
As Director, Commercial Data, you will own the strategy and build the trusted, connected, and AI-ready data foundation that powers smarter decisions, accelerates execution, and enables our commercial organization to scale through launch and beyond.
You will work at the intersection of Commercial, Data & Analytics, and IT to turn business priorities into high-impact data solutions. You will challenge conventional approaches, establish clear data governance and accountability, and ensure our teams have access to reliable, actionable insights when they need them. With a builder’s mindset and a bias for action, you will identify opportunities to leverage analytics, automation, and AI to elevate customer engagement, strengthen commercial performance, and ultimately help us deliver more for patients.
Primary Responsibilities
Build and continuously advance a trusted commercial data environment across customer, product, payer, patient, engagement, and other critical commercial data domains.
Establish the business requirements, standards, ownership, and operating model needed to ensure commercial data is connected, well-defined, high quality, accessible, and ready to support analytics and AI.
Advance commercial data readiness to support emerging AI capabilities.
Partner with business, analytics, product, and technology teams to identify high-value opportunities, define the data and business context required, and develop reusable capabilities that scale across commercial functions rather than isolated solutions.
Establish and lead a commercial data governance framework that ensures data is trusted, consistent, and fit for purpose across reporting, analytics, automation, and AI. Define clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, common definitions, hierarchies, metrics, metadata, and business rules.
Proactively monitor data quality, resolve issues at their root cause, and establish accountability for maintaining trusted data as the business scales.
Partner across Commercial, Data & Analytics, and IT to identify and prioritize opportunities where data, analytics, automation, and AI can improve decision-making and commercial execution.
Translate business priorities into actionable capabilities, establish clear ownership and success measures, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners to drive adoption, measurable business impact, and scalable ways of working.
Qualifications and Key Success Factors
8+ years of relevant experience in commercial data, analytics, commercial operations, data strategy, or related roles within pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences organizations.
Experience supporting pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial operations, ideally including a product launch or significant commercial expansion.
Demonstrated ability to translate commercial priorities into a data strategy, capability roadmap, and investment recommendations, ideally in a launch or rapidly growing organization.
Experience establishing data governance, ownership, quality standards, and operating processes that improve trust in and use of data.
Practical understanding of AI and automation, with the ability to assess use cases, define business requirements, and evaluate value, feasibility, and responsible use.
Ability to partner effectively with IT, data engineering, analytics, and commercial systems teams, with sufficient technical fluency to guide business decisions and delivery priorities.
Strong communication and changing leadership skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders, managing external partners, and driving adoption in a fast-moving environment.
The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$213,500—$243,000 USD
Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let’s achieve the impossible together!
Company Overview
Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to
does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.

jobs.title: Director of Product Operations
jobs.text:
Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized Connected TV advertising. Our business is growing rapidly and we're in the midst of transforming from a services agency to a product-led business with our new native platform, Convoy. The platform is live with external partners and we're expanding its reach — this role will help us build the operational backbone that lets our product team scale as we grow.
We are a small, remote-first team of high-performing professionals with diverse backgrounds located across many time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia. We prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation but come together as a team to solve hard problems.
The Role
You'll manage and develop our product team, partnering with lead product managers and executive leadership to translate product strategy into a sequenced roadmap and clear priorities for each squad. Lead product managers and leadership will identify strategic opportunities and set product direction; you'll translate that direction into team priorities, capacity decisions, and operating rhythms. Your squad-leading PMs will remain responsible for understanding their customers, validating solutions, and delivering measurable outcomes. You'll continuously improve how the product team plans, delivers, communicates, and handles support and escalations as the organization scales.
Responsibilities
People Leadership
Hire, coach, and develop the product management team against a clear leveling framework
Partner with product leadership and lead product managers to translate priorities into team capacity and ownership
Product Operations
Build and run the planning and delivery cadence that keeps the team's work aligned to company priorities and gives the rest of the organization reliable visibility into what's shipping and when
Establish consistent standards for specs, QA, definition of done, releases, and outcome tracking
Define and maintain a consistent approach to tracking expected and actual outcomes at the team and feature level, using those insights to improve future product decisions
Lead how production issues, escalations, and urgent requests are routed and resolved across product, engineering, and the teams that surface them
Continuously improve the systems the product team uses for planning, delivery, support, and communication, using better processes, tooling, and automation to reduce friction and coordination as the organization scales
Operate as a player-coach: step in hands-on where needed while building the team's judgment and capability
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with lead product managers to represent product in company-wide planning and communication
Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, GTM, customer success, and company leadership
What success looks like:
One year in, the product organization runs more predictably because of this person, and it shows up everywhere downstream: product managers, engineering, and the broader company all feel it.
Every squad and feature has a clear before-and-after: what outcome we expected, what actually happened, and product managers can point to their own impact using that data
Product managers on the team are growing, doing better work, and can see the difference their work makes
Production issues and escalations get resolved through a clear process instead of interrupting whoever happens to be closest, and product managers spend less time on it than they did a year ago
Releases require less last-minute coordination, and shared standards around specs, QA, and definition of done make delivery consistent across the team
The planning cadence gives the rest of the company reliable visibility into what's shipping and when, and other teams trust product's timelines more than they used to
As the team scales, its operating practices remain lightweight—providing greater clarity and consistency without slowing product managers down or pulling them away from customers and product work
Requirements
8+ years in product management or product operations, including 4+ yrs of experience directly managing a team of product managers
Experience building or improving how a product organization plans, delivers, and tracks outcomes, ideally at a fast-growing company
Comfortable owning a support or escalation process alongside planning work; this role is judged on how smoothly issues get handled, not only on whether the roadmap ships on time
A track record hiring, coaching, and leveling product managers
Strong analytical instincts; comfortable working directly with data and dashboards rather than only requesting them
Excellent cross-functional communication skills; able to represent product credibly with engineering, go-to-market, and company leadership
Experience in ad tech or complex B2B workflow products is a plus, not required
Benefits
Comprehensive healthcare including medical, vision & dental benefits covered at 100% for employees and 50% for dependents
We're fully remote and offer a remote working stipend
Flexible PTO — take what you need, when you need
Coffee or Tea Subscription
Monthly 3 day weekend
Revive Media provides the wage it reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for all remote roles and as otherwise required by applicable law. Total compensation including a quarterly bonus typically ranges from $190k - $205k. Actual compensation may vary within the listed range based on a wide array of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience, and specific geographic location. The expected base pay for this role is $175k.
Revive Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We assess all qualified candidates on the basis of skill, experience and talent.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer / Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role
Navable is hiring a senior, hands-on Lead Engineer / Head of Engineering to own the technical foundation of the company.
This is a foundational leadership role for an experienced full-stack engineer who wants real ownership across architecture, execution, AI strategy, and team building — with a clear path to leading Navable’s long-term engineering organization.
You will work directly with the Founder & CEO to:
Scale and harden our core platform
Architect systems built for financial accuracy, auditability, and security
Execute on a roadmap of AI-powered products embedded directly into fund operations workflows
Establish engineering standards and hire our early in-house team
In the near term, this role is deeply hands-on. You will write production code, own architectural decisions, manage external engineering resources, and establish engineering standards. Over time, you will hire and lead a growing in-house team.
While this is a remote role, candidates must be based in the U.S., with a strong preference for someone in the greater New York area.
What You’ll Own
Architecture & Platform
Own system architecture and technical roadmap
Evolve our carry and compensation engine to support increasingly complex firm structures
Ensure scalability, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability
AI Product Execution
Lead development of AI-based features that enhance workflows, automation, and decision support
Translate real customer pain points into practical, production-ready AI solutions
Establish the foundation for applied AI across the Navable platform
Hands-On Development
Write high-quality production code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure
Lead technical refactors and improve developer velocity
Security & Compliance
Design secure systems appropriate for institutional financial clients
Support SOC 2 and enterprise security requirements
Engineering Leadership
Manage current external engineering resources
Define hiring needs and build Navable’s in-house engineering team
Establish strong engineering culture and standards
Who You Are
Senior full-stack engineer with early-stage startup experience
Have owned architecture through periods of growth
Comfortable across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure
Experienced building systems that handle sensitive financial or regulated data
Excited about applying AI in structured, high-value enterprise workflows
Thrive in high-ownership, ambiguous environments
Want to build and lead an enduring engineering organization
Compensation
Competitive base salary
Meaningful equity ownership
Flexible PTO
This is an opportunity to define the technical and AI foundation of a company building infrastructure for the alternative asset ecosystem.

jobs.title: VP of Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
This is a remote position.
A Crypto wallet security infrastructure provider are looking for a VP of Solutions Engineering
They develop the most secure wallet-as-a-service infrastructure in Web3 : an API-first wallet management system, ideal for applications and organizations seeking to provide secure access to all blockchains through a single integration). APIs and SDKs were designed for wallet programmability and efficient implementations, enabling fast deployments, smart automation flows, as well as granular sets of permissions and policies via secure authentication credentials. They are on the way to become the leading wallet infrastructure for the multi-trillion-dollar digital asset industry.
The company is SOC-2 certified, employs 30 people across 6 countries and has raised over $20M since creation with prestigious investors. Their solution is used and trusted by major international corporations.
As the VP of Solutions Engineering you will help financial institutions and enterprises adopt the company's platform with confidence and ease.
This high-impact role is both strategic and hands-on:
You’ll design integrations for complex legacy systems, guide clients through deployment, and offer end-to-end technical support.
You’ll pair deep technical expertise with strong client-facing skills, serving as an advisor to CTOs, architects, and engineering teams at banks, fintechs, and enterprises.
You’ll design tailored solutions, deliver technical proposals, and drive adoption via troubleshooting, clear docs, and tight collaboration with engineering, security, and product.
You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering and customer success, equally comfortable whiteboarding ideas, writing code examples, and jumping on late calls to help a customer.
MISSIONS
Guide financial institutions through safe and seamless onboarding to the company's platform.
Architect secure, scalable deployment pathways that fit into legacy and modern systems.
Provide hands-on support: troubleshoot, fix, and build solutions alongside client teams.
Collaborate with sales to design technical proposals, demos, and RFP responses.
Maintain and improve technical docs and developer guides to industry standards.
Gather client feedback, analyze competitors, and turn insights into product tweaks.
Represent the company at conferences, workshops, and meetings as a technical thought leader.
Profil
10+ years in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise integration, with leadership experience.
Proven track record helping financial institutions deploy mission-critical systems.
Proficient in TypeScript (or similar languages) with strong API experience (REST).
Deep knowledge of cloud-native systems (AWS essential; GCP/IBM/Thales a plus), microservices, and serverless architectures.
Skilled in troubleshooting technical issues and delivering under pressure.
Strong understanding of enterprise security compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS)
Excellent communicator, able to bridge technical and business threads with clients.
Excellent doc and demo skills; able to clarify matters for tech and non-tech teams.
Knowledge of blockchain, digital assets, and financial workflows strongly preferred.
Certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect) a plus; multilingual fluency also valued.
Informations contractuelles
Contract : Permanent role (Hybrid remote) in Nigeria or South Africa. remote first, office optional
Salary: 160,000–240,000 USD.
Equity: 100-200 stock options (0.1-0.4%) vested over 4 years with a one-year cliff.
Work essentials: MacBook Pro, iPhone, AirPods, screens, headsets, AirPods.
Training and coursework in Crypto, Blockchain, Security, code, Coding languages and other topics are paid for on-demand to encourage personal and professional growth.
Benefits: healthcare and life insurance, retirement plan, sponsored transportation, gym, lunch card, home office equipment, and other perks.
Recruitment process :
Video call with COO/CTO (30mn).
Cognitive and personality tests (45mn).
Coding test in a language of your choice
Focus interview (30mn x 3) : Code Review - Architecture review -Pre-sales fundamentals - Culture check fit
Final interview with Management (30mn)

jobs.text:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
Certified as a Great Place to Work®
Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance
Director, Product Management – Enterprise Data Platform
Primary Purpose
The Director, Product Management - Data Systems leads product strategy for our enterprise data foundation, including the Snowflake-based platform and supporting data systems that power OmniAnalyst, OmniInsights, and our broader data product ecosystem. Reporting to the Vice President of Data Product Management, this role defines the capabilities, governance, and roadmap needed to deliver scalable, secure, and trusted data products across the enterprise.
As the product leader for the data platform, this individual serves as the primary intake and prioritization point for platform requests, aligns stakeholders across business and technology teams, and ensures the platform delivers business value while maintaining long-term scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
Essential Responsibilities
Define Platform Capabilities
Defines the capabilities required of the enterprise data foundation, including governed data sharing, access controls, entity resolution, semantic models, shared definitions, and data quality standards.
Partners with Data Architecture and Data Engineering to design scalable, secure, and well-governed platform capabilities aligned with enterprise standards.
Champions modern data architecture practices, including data mesh and layered (medallion) architectures, to drive consistency and reusability across the enterprise.
Establishes standards for semantic context, metadata, governance, and data design to ensure data is consistently understood by business users, analytics tools, and AI applications.
Set Vision & Roadmap for Data Systems
Defines and owns the vision and multi-year roadmap for the enterprise data foundation, beginning with the Snowflake platform and evolving as business needs grow.
Partners with Data Architecture leadership, business stakeholders, and internal data consumers to align platform investments with enterprise priorities.
Collaborates with product leaders supporting OmniAnalyst, OmniInsights, and other data products to ensure platform capabilities meet downstream product needs.
Establishes and monitors platform success measures, including data quality, availability, performance, adoption, operational efficiency, and cost optimization.
Applies Product Operating Model principles to platform intake, prioritization, backlog management, and outcome measurement.
Intake, Prioritization & Platform Governance
Owns the intake and prioritization process for enterprise data platform initiatives, maintaining a transparent framework for evaluating business requests.
Balances business value, urgency, risk, dependencies, effort, and cost when prioritizing platform investments and managing tradeoffs.
Maintains a strategic backlog and facilitates stakeholder alignment through recurring prioritization forums and governance discussions.
Identifies demand trends and opportunities for reusable platform capabilities that improve efficiency and scalability.
Drive Platform Delivery
Partners with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Governance, and platform administration teams to deliver roadmap commitments and platform enhancements.
Translates business requirements into technical product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data models, pipelines, access patterns, and platform services.
Leverages SQL and strong technical fluency to validate delivered solutions and ensure business requirements are met.
Partners with Governance and FinOps teams to manage platform consumption, forecast costs, and promote cost-effective platform growth.
Ensures the platform supports analytics, data science, and AI workloads through strong data quality, lineage, governance, semantic context, and performance management.
Establishes performance metrics, reporting, and documentation standards that support platform adoption, reliability, and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
Builds alignment across business, operations, technology, governance, security, privacy, and compliance stakeholders.
Ensures appropriate platform controls are implemented and maintained, including role-based access, masking policies, data classification, retention, lineage, and auditability.
Communicates platform strategy, releases, priorities, and performance through executive reporting, documentation, and stakeholder engagement.
Acts as a trusted advisor on data platform capabilities, governance requirements, and strategic opportunities.
Maintains awareness of emerging Snowflake capabilities and modern data architecture trends to inform platform strategy.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field required.
Advanced degree a plus.
Snowflake certification (e.g., SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced Architect) preferred.
Experience
Ten (10) or more years of experience in product management, data platform, data engineering, or data architecture roles, including at least five (5) years in technical product management for data platforms.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake, either as a technical practitioner or product owner of a Snowflake-based platform.
Strong experience with modern data architecture concepts including data warehousing, data mesh, dimensional modeling, layered (medallion) architecture, semantic modeling, and ELT pipelines.
Demonstrated success shaping data platform capabilities, influencing engineering direction, and partnering across business and technology teams.
Experience leading intake and prioritization processes for shared enterprise platforms serving multiple business units.
Experience supporting analytics, data science, and AI-enabled use cases preferred.
Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, metadata management, entity resolution, master data management, or governed data-sharing solutions preferred.
Experience working in regulated industries preferred.
Skills & Knowledge
Strong knowledge of enterprise data platform architecture, storage concepts, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
Expertise in data modeling, semantic modeling, metadata management, lineage, and data catalog concepts.
Strong SQL proficiency with the ability to independently validate data solutions and review technical designs.
Familiarity with Snowflake governance and administration concepts including RBAC, secure data sharing, access controls, and consumption management.
Strong prioritization, stakeholder management, communication, and executive influencing skills.
Understanding of how data quality, governance, and semantic context impact analytics and AI outcomes.
Ability to lead through influence in highly matrixed environments while balancing business priorities, technical constraints, and long-term platform health.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and Product Operating Model practices.
As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is (107,667.00 - 150,734.00 USD Annual). A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits.
Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Vice President, AI Product & Engineering
jobs.text:
About You
You have clear and proven attribution of commercial success and business outcomes in self-serve SMB products (i.e. products similiar to Patch's promoted events and featured business listings: self-serve, low price point, recurring).
You are fluent in Clay Christensen's JTBD framework.
You have 5+ years of leading leaders in technical and product roles in entrepreneurial environments.
You have technical credibility: 10+ years of experience as an engineer and/or managing engineering teams, and the ability to reason directly about architecture, data, feasibility, and trade-offs.
You are hands-on: You prototype, inspect the data, talk with customers and work through details with the team; you do not delegate the substance of product leadership.
You lead with curiosity, candor, self-awareness, low ego, and a sense of humor.
What We Offer / Why Patch
Patch -- the largest, and one of the few thriving local media businesses -- has been on the cutting edge of AI since 2022. We have approximately 15,000 communities with AI newsletters that have a 94+ NPS. Our moderation for 160M active users (and many other parts of the business) are AI-native.
Our work connecting people with their communities matters. We are Patchy: we have fun and take our mission seriously but not ourselves.
Even if you are a world-class leader, you will become a better leader at Patch through our leadership standards. All applicants for the role will go through them.
Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Ancillary benefits
401(k)
Unlimited discretionary time off (DTO)
10 paid holidays a year
Paid parental leave
Product and Technology Environment
Patch’s products span consumer web and mobile, email, publishing, user-generated content, payments, data, search and advertising integrations.
The technology environment includes JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Drupal/PHP, AWS, Heroku, Pantheon, GCP/BigQuery/GA4, Stripe, Auth0/Okta, Typesense/OpenSearch, GitHub/Jira and modern AI tools.
You need not master the stack, but you must be technically fluent and able to earn the trust of engineers.
What You Will Lead
Commercial success for platform products, leading with with force, courage, and velocity. If you are doing something common in media, it is not bold enough.
Helping sales make more money, especially through applying our AI work with large brands (separate from platform products)
Finding ways to make our journalists' careers more rewarding financially and operationally.
Working at Patch
Patch is remote-first, with employees and contractors across countries and time zones. The ideal candidate feels a real connection to our mission: keeping people informed about their communities and helping local businesses and event marketers get the word out to the audiences that matter most.
Patch Media is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our commitment to equality extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and general treatment.
