jobs.title: Chief Product and Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Who we are
Athos Commerce is the only all-in-one intelligent discovery platform that connects shoppers to the right products across whatever channel they are shopping: a brand's own site, marketplaces, social, comparison shopping engines, and AI platforms.
More than 2,700 brands, including Adidas, Burberry, Clarins, and Marks & Spencer, rely on our AI-powered search, merchandising, personalization, and product feed management to help shoppers find the right product faster, reduce manual work for merchandisers, and drive higher conversion and average order value.
Who You Are
You are a strategic, commercially minded product and technology executive who combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of customer needs and business outcomes. You have a proven ability to lead both Product and Engineering organizations, build scalable technology platforms, and translate market insights into successful products.
You are a hands-on leader who thrives in complex environments, makes thoughtful investment decisions, and balances innovation with operational excellence. You are comfortable leading organizational transformation, integrating technology platforms, and developing high-performing global teams.
You bring strong executive presence, sound technical judgment, and a collaborative leadership style. You enjoy engaging directly with customers and partners, challenging conventional approaches, and leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and organizational effectiveness.
What You'll Do?
As Chief Product and Technology Officer, reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the product and technology strategy for Athos Commerce, translating commercial objectives into a clear product direction, strategic investment decisions, and consistent execution. You will oversee Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Platform Operations, Product Design, Data, and Information Security while leading the next stage of integration across our established commerce platforms. Working closely with customers, agency partners, and executive leadership, you will drive product innovation, improve customer experiences, and ensure our technology remains secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. This is a hands-on executive role where you will balance long-term strategic priorities with delivering meaningful improvements to customers across our platforms.
How You Will Succeed
Define Product and Technology Strategy: Establish a unified product and technology vision aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth objectives, including the strategic application of AI and emerging commerce channels.
Lead Product Strategy and Execution: Oversee customer discovery, product roadmaps, lifecycle management, and investment prioritization, using customer evidence, commercial potential, and engineering capacity to guide decisions.
Drive Platform Integration and Modernization: Lead the continued integration of Athos Commerce's established platforms while maintaining product delivery, improving technical architecture, and managing technical debt.
Improve Customer Experience and Self-Service: Make Athos products faster to implement and easier for merchants and agency partners to configure independently, reducing reliance on engineering resources and improving time to value.
Build a High-Performing Engineering Organization: Lead global engineering teams to deliver high-quality software improvements predictably while maintaining strong development practices, accountability, and execution.
Ensure Platform Reliability and Security: Oversee architecture, cloud infrastructure, platform operations, security, and compliance to maintain reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology.
Strengthen Customer and Commercial Partnerships: Engage directly with merchants, agency partners, and prospects while partnering with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance on product positioning, pricing, launches, and strategic customer commitments.
Develop and Scale Global Leadership Teams: Recruit, mentor, and develop senior Product and Technology leaders, establish clear ownership and accountability, and foster a collaborative culture across distributed teams.
Drive AI Innovation and Adoption: Identify opportunities to bring AI and machine learning capabilities to market while embedding AI into Product and Engineering workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes.
Own Financial Planning and Technology Governance: Manage Product and Technology budgets, workforce planning, vendor decisions, technology investments, and risk management while communicating priorities, performance, and material risks to executive leadership and the board.
What We're Looking for
Significant senior leadership experience within a software or SaaS organization, with direct responsibility across both Product and Engineering functions.
Proven track record of developing and executing product and technology strategies that deliver measurable customer value and commercial results.
Direct experience building ecommerce search, product discovery, merchandising, or personalization products; marketing technology experience is a plus.
Strong technical judgment across software architecture, development practices, cloud infrastructure, platform reliability, scalability, and information security.
Experience leading complex platform integrations, technology modernization initiatives, or organizational transformation while maintaining ongoing product delivery.
Practical experience bringing AI and machine learning capabilities to market and integrating AI into Product and Engineering workflows.
Strong commercial understanding of SaaS business models, including recurring revenue, customer retention, margins, profitability, and cost to serve.
Demonstrated success building, scaling, and developing senior Product and Engineering leadership teams.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple countries, regions, and time zones.
Ability to make and communicate complex tradeoffs between business growth, customer commitments, delivery capacity, and long-term platform sustainability.
Strong financial and operational management experience, including departmental budgets, workforce planning, and strategic technology investments.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to engage customers, agency partners, technical teams, executive leadership, and board members.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across commercial and technical functions to drive shared business objectives.
Benefits
Open PTO
Company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
Medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA)
Company-paid Short Term and Long Term Disability coverage
Company-paid Life and AD&D coverage
Voluntary benefits, including critical illness, accident insurance, legal services, and pet insurance
401(k) plan with employer match
Flexible work environment. Work from one of our offices, hybrid, or remote.
Athos Commerce is an equal-opportunity employer and proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We strongly believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential in cultivating an inclusive culture and building an innovative, successful organization. All qualified applicants are considered for employment, without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. If you require accommodation during the application process, please don't hesitate to contact us.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management (MDR)
jobs.text:
Vice President, Product Management (MDR)
Rapid7 is looking for a Vice President, Product Management to own the strategy, vision, and execution of our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) product portfolio. This is a rare opportunity to shape how thousands of organizations experience cybersecurity as a managed service, defining what great looks like at the intersection of human expertise and cutting-edge technology.
About the Team
Rapid7's MDR product team partners closely with our SOC, engineering, and go-to-market functions to shape the service experience, define platform capabilities, and continuously raise the bar on global managed security service delivery.
About the Role
As a Vice President, Product Management (MDR), your primary responsibility will be to set the product direction for Rapid7's managed security service while balancing customer needs, analyst capabilities, and strategic business goals. Specifically, your focus will be to:
Define and drive the MDR product strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with Rapid7's broader detection and response vision
Partner closely with SOC leadership to deeply understand analyst workflows, operational pain points, and necessary platform capabilities
Lead and develop a high-performing team of product managers, fostering accountability and continuous learning
Translate customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence into differentiated product decisions that drive retention and expansion
Collaborate with engineering to define and deliver a platform roadmap that gives MDR analysts speed, context, and automation
Serve as a senior customer-facing voice for the MDR product by engaging with strategic accounts and building trust through transparency
Define and track product OKRs and success metrics to continuously improve the service experience and business outcomes
Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and customer success to ensure product positioning, launch readiness, and customer adoption
The skills and qualities you'll bring include
Bring 12+ years of product management experience, with significant time spent leading product for managed services, SaaS platforms, or security products
Possess a deep understanding of the cybersecurity landscape, particularly in detection and response, MDR, SOC operations, or incident response
Demonstrate a proven track record of leading and scaling product teams in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment
Drive multi-year product vision through strategic doing while staying grounded in near-term execution and time-bound milestones
Establish clear accountability and ownership across teams to deliver value for managed service customers
Make efficient decisions that resolve complex product challenges and maintain operational momentum across functions
Communicate complex product strategies clearly to executive and customer audiences to foster commitment
Build global cross-functional networks across engineering, services, sales, and executive leadership to drive aligned business outcomes
Embrace challenging conversations constructively to find common ground across cross-functional stakeholder groups
Apply self-awareness to adapt leadership style to varying group dynamics across technical and business teams
Demonstrate an eager mindset toward navigating change by driving product evolution in a fast-moving market
Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.
We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.
About Rapid7
At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.
Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.
Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.
The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:
United States: $259,300.00 - 350,800.00 USD Annual
Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: VP Product Innovation, Modern Campus
jobs.text:
About Modern Campus
Modern Campus empowers institutions to move with confidence across the modern learner journey. Our platform spans web content management, curriculum and catalog management, student engagement and lifelong learning — giving more than 1,700 colleges and universities the infrastructure they need to support the entire learner-to-earner lifecycle and deliver personalized, scalable experiences.
We partner with the education community to create new pathways for learning and opportunity, reimagining how institutions serve the modern learner and shape the future of education.
Our purpose — our north star — is to empower institutions to confidently serve and support the modern learner.
This mission and purpose come to life through how we show up every day:
We exist to create empowerment through education.
We lead with honesty and empathy.
We shape the future through innovation.
We become trusted partners.
We make the complex feel possible.
Position Summary
Modern Campus is seeking a visionary and execution-oriented Vice President, Product Innovation to identify, validate, build, and scale new product opportunities while transforming how we develop products through AI-enabled and agentic practices.
This leader will serve as the company's innovation catalyst, balancing customer discovery, strategic product incubation, and organizational transformation. The Vice President, Product Innovation will lead the creation of new offerings that expand our portfolio while establishing scalable, AI-native product development capabilities that accelerate speed, quality, and customer value across the organization.
The role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to drive growth through both new products and new ways of building products.
What You'll Do
Product Innovation & New Venture Development
Identify, validate, and launch innovative software products that address emerging challenges and opportunities in higher education.
Lead customer discovery, market research, and rapid experimentation to assess new market opportunities.
Build and test MVPs, prototypes, and pilot programs to validate customer demand and commercial viability.
Define business models, pricing strategies, and go-to-market approaches for new offerings.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to successfully transition validated concepts into scalable businesses.
Develop and manage an innovation portfolio that balances incremental improvements with transformative growth opportunities.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and innovation across the product organization.
AI-Enabled Product Development Leadership
Define and champion Modern Campus's vision for AI-enabled and agentic product development.
Establish best practices for leveraging AI across the product lifecycle, including customer research, discovery, requirements gathering, prototyping, documentation, testing, experimentation, and product operations.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve how product teams operate and deliver value.
Develop repeatable frameworks, playbooks, governance models, and adoption strategies for responsible AI implementation.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders to embed AI-native practices into day-to-day product development workflows.
Measure and continuously improve the impact of AI-enabled practices on customer outcomes, delivery speed, and organizational effectiveness.
Promote a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and responsible AI adoption across the company.
Executive Leadership & Collaboration
Influence company strategy through innovation insights, customer feedback, and emerging market opportunities.
Communicate vision, strategy, business cases, and outcomes effectively to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Build alignment across departments to accelerate innovation initiatives and organizational transformation.
Serve as a thought leader on AI, product innovation, and emerging technology trends.
What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
Proven experience leading software products from concept through customer validation, commercial launch, and post-launch scaling.
Experience building and managing innovation portfolios, product incubators, or venture-style product development initiatives.
Demonstrated success delivering revenue-generating software products, including business model development, pricing strategy, and go-to-market execution.
Deep understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and their application to software product development.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate product development and decision-making.
Strong executive presence and communication skills with the ability to influence strategy and organizational change.
Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving environments.
10+ years of progressive product leadership experience within a software organization.
Experience leading cross-functional teams, major product launches, and strategic initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
MBA or advanced business degree.
Experience in higher education, education technology, SaaS, or other complex B2B software markets.
Experience scaling AI-enabled product organizations.
Track record of launching net-new businesses, platforms, or product categories.
Success in This Role
Within the first 12–24 months, successful outcomes may include:
Launching three or more new product experiments into market.
Creating a repeatable and measurable innovation pipeline from idea to commercialization.
Generating meaningful new revenue streams from newly launched offerings.
Increasing product team effectiveness through AI-enabled workflows and agentic development practices.
Improving speed-to-market and customer value realization across the product portfolio.
Establishing Modern Campus as a leader in AI-enabled product innovation within higher education technology.
Why Join Modern Campus?
At Modern Campus, we're transforming how higher education institutions engage learners throughout the entire student lifecycle. We believe innovation happens when talented people are empowered to experiment, challenge assumptions, and create solutions that make a meaningful impact.
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape both what we build and how we build it, driving the future of product innovation and AI-enabled development across the organization.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
At Modern Campus, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace strengthens relevance, resilience, and long-term success. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and identities to apply.
Modern Campus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. If you require accommodation during any stage of the interview process, please let our recruiting team know.
* Our salary ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hires for the position within the US and Canada. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Data Products
jobs.text:
WME is looking for a Head of Data & Data Products to build the next generation of our data capability.
WME sits at the center of entertainment, representing leading artists, creators, athletes, brands, and intellectual property around the world. Every day, our teams generate and work with an extraordinary amount of information about relationships, opportunities, deals, audiences, markets, and outcomes.
We believe that data can become a meaningful competitive advantage for WME — not simply by producing more reports, but by making our collective knowledge easier to access, understand, and act on.
This role will lead that evolution.
You will own WME's data product strategy, self-service analytics, shared business definitions, domain intelligence, and the business roadmap for predictive and decision-support capabilities. You will also help us rethink how the third-party data we license can become a reusable capability across our products and businesses.
The goal is straightforward: turn WME's data into products and intelligence that help our people make better decisions, identify opportunities, serve clients, and grow the business.
What You'll Do:
Build WME's Data Product Strategy
Define and lead a data product roadmap tied to real business decisions and opportunities.
Turn important datasets into trusted, reusable products rather than inputs to individual reports.
Identify where recurring analytical needs should become self-service capabilities and where expert analysis remains the better answer.
Define the users, business meaning, quality expectations, access requirements, and success measures for major data products.
Measure adoption and business impact, and continuously improve what we build.
Make Trusted Data Easier to Use
Modernize WME's self-service analytics and reporting capabilities.
Make common business questions easier to answer without requiring an analyst for every request.
Give users the context they need to understand what a metric means, where it came from, how current it is, and when it should be used.
Establish shared definitions for critical business concepts and improve consistency across teams and systems.
Reduce duplicated and bespoke reporting through reusable datasets, metrics, and analytical products.
Turn Data Into Intelligence
Identify where WME's proprietary data can reveal opportunities, patterns, and insights that aren't visible through external market data alone.
Build domain intelligence capabilities that combine deep understanding of our businesses with strong analytical judgment.
Own the business roadmap for capabilities such as matching, predictive pricing, demand forecasting, relationship intelligence, recommendations, opportunity detection, and anomaly detection.
Determine when sophisticated modeling is warranted — and when a simpler analytical approach will produce a better result.
Define success in business terms such as revenue, conversion, pricing, productivity, targeting, and client outcomes.
Make More of Our External Data
WME licenses valuable data across entertainment, audiences, media, touring, brands, and other markets.
You will:
Develop the product strategy for making those sources more reusable across WME.
Partner with research, engineering, procurement, and business teams to identify the sources that create the most value.
Help move external data from isolated reports into reusable datasets and capabilities.
Measure utilization and value to inform which sources we retain, expand, replace, or retire.
Explore opportunities to combine proprietary and external data in ways that create differentiated capabilities for WME and our clients.
Build the Function
Build and lead a focused team with strong analytical, business, and product judgment.
Develop domain expertise around the areas where WME has the greatest opportunity to create value from data.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Research, Operations, Cybersecurity, and business leaders across WME.
Establish clear standards for data quality, definitions, governance, measurement, and responsible use.
Create leverage through strong systems, shared capabilities, automation, and partnerships rather than simply adding headcount.
How You'll Work
This is not a traditional reporting leadership role.
You will spend significant time understanding how WME's businesses work, how decisions get made, and where better information could change an outcome.
You'll move between strategy and execution: defining a multi-year direction while helping teams solve practical problems today.
You'll work closely with our Product and Engineering organization. Engineering owns the technical data platform, including data engineering, pipelines, APIs, infrastructure, and production ML. You will own the business and product side of the data strategy: what we should build, why it matters, how it should be understood, and whether it is creating value.
You'll also partner with specialist teams across WME, including Finance and WME Insights, rather than trying to centralize every form of analysis into one organization.
What We're Looking For
Significant experience leading a data, analytics, data product, or applied intelligence function.
A track record of turning data into products or capabilities that people actually use.
Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish an interesting analytical problem from a valuable business problem.
Experience building self-service analytics or data products without sacrificing context, quality, or governance.
Strong analytical fluency and comfort challenging assumptions, evaluating evidence, and communicating uncertainty.
Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science/ML, and senior business leaders.
Technical fluency across modern data platforms, warehouses/lakes, APIs, BI, data quality, metadata, access controls, and predictive modeling concepts.
Experience working with third-party data providers and finding ways to reuse licensed data across products and workflows.
Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate complex analytical or technical ideas into clear business decisions.
Comfort operating in a complex organization where valuable knowledge is distributed across people, systems, and teams.
Experience in media, entertainment, sports, marketplaces, talent businesses, financial data, recommendation systems, or client-facing data products is a plus.
The Mindset We're Looking For
Data is a product. A dataset creates value when people can find it, understand it, trust it, and use it repeatedly.
Start with the decision. The goal isn't more sophisticated analysis. It's better decisions and better outcomes.
Be ambitious and practical. You can see the path toward predictive intelligence while still improving what people need today.
Stay curious about the business. You want to understand how agents and business teams actually work, not just the data they produce.
Build for leverage. You look for reusable capabilities, automation, and strong partnerships before solving a problem with additional headcount.
Measure what matters. Success is adoption, better decisions, commercial impact, and client outcomes — not the number of dashboards, models, or datasets produced.
What Success Looks Like
Over time, you'll help WME move from a world where data is often something people request to one where trusted information and intelligence are available where decisions happen.
Common questions become self-service. Important business concepts have shared definitions. Proprietary and third-party data can be reused across products and workflows. Predictive capabilities move out of experiments and into everyday work. Our specialist teams spend more time on high-value thinking and less time servicing repeatable requests.
Most importantly, WME gets better at using what it collectively knows to identify opportunities and advocate for our clients.

jobs.title: Director, Mobile Engineering
jobs.text:
Join the Rest Revolution
The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.
So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.
More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.
We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.
The Opportunity
Hatch is looking for a Mobile Engineering Director to own mobile engineering across our entire product portfolio consisting of 4 teams: Adult, Kids, Foundations, and Growth. You'll manage our mobile engineering managers, set architecture and technical direction across teams, foster a culture of product-focused engineering, and make sure the org has the resourcing, escalation paths, and cross-team coordination it needs to ship. Engineering Managers own day-to-day delivery, and you own the accountability, direction, and connective tissue that keeps mobile engineering coherent across a broad and growing product line.
What You'll Do
Within 1 month:
Take over management of the mobile engineering managers, and start building the relationships and 1:1 cadence to support them
Establish yourself as the owner of the weekly Mobile Strategy meeting
Get oriented across all four teams - Adult, Kids, Foundations, and Growth - and understand current resourcing, roadmap, and delivery status in each team
Understand existing AI strategy and opportunities on the mobile team
Begin building relationships with Product and Design partners across the pillars, and start to foster a product engineering mindset across the team
Within 3 months:
Own resourcing, escalation, and overall direction for mobile delivery and architecture
Take team-level accountability for cross-platform (iOS and Android) strategy, and for individual mobile delivery across the org
Oversee direction for software quality in partnership with QA
Start shaping architecture governance and the architectural review process, including how staff/principal technical leverage is applied across teams
Own hiring pipeline direction, including interviewing and hiring decisions for open mobile roles
Bring a mobile capacity view into roadmap planning
Begin to set direction for AI adoption and tooling efficiency across the mobile org
Establish strong working relationships and operating rhythms with Product and Design partners across the pillars, and build a product engineering culture across the team
After 6 months:
Lead architecture governance and the ADR process end to end, including calling the bets that affect roadmap or resourcing
Set Mobile Health direction and strategy
Define the approach to AI adoption and tooling efficiency across the mobile org
Own staff development and feedback across the mobile org, including promotion decisions and escalations, and actively develop current and future engineering leads
Champion recognition and culture for the mobile team, and build project management / product-engineering capability across teams
As capacity allows, pick up select mobile IC work off the critical path to stay current
Establish a robust cross-functional operating model for Mobile: how the organization plans, prioritizes, and coordinates with Product, Design, Analytics, and other key stakeholders
What You'll Bring
The Essentials
Substantial experience leading mobile engineering organizations, including managing engineering managers
A track record of setting technical direction and architecture governance across multiple concurrent product lines or teams
Comfort operating through delegation - you set direction and hold accountability without needing to be hands-on in every workstream
Strong cross-functional communication skills, including experience representing engineering to Product and Design partners, as well as executive stakeholders
Experience building hiring pipelines and developing engineering leads
The Mindset We Love
A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity and competing priorities across a broad remit
A product engineering mindset: we’re building out the best possible experience for our users, and we expect engineers to play an active role from ideation through implementation
Collaborative spirit: you make everyone around you better
Clear communication: you can explain complex, cross-team tradeoffs simply
Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch
We’re a certified Great Place to Work
We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility
The Perks & Benefits That Matter
100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)
Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here
401(k) match with no vesting schedule
16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)
Financial support for family planning
Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement
Friends and family discounts on Hatch products
Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands
About Hatch
Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.
Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences
Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package
We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?
We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.
E-Verify
Hatch participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
Privacy Notice
By submitting a job application at Hatch, you agree to our privacy notice, located here

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role
Wpromote is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead the engineering organization responsible for Polaris, our client CRM and marketing intelligence platform. Polaris supports client and integration management, normalized marketing data, reporting, measurement, forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, and client insights through internal and client-facing products.
This leader is accountable for engineering strategy, people, architecture, delivery, quality, reliability, security, and financial stewardship. The role sits on the Product Development Leadership team and partners closely with Product, UX, Data Science, Security, Finance, agency leaders, clients, and technology vendors. It requires executive judgment and strong technical depth. The VP must be able to lead through managers and senior engineers while remaining capable of stepping into architecture decisions, critical incidents, and unfamiliar technical problems when the business needs it.
You will scale the engineering organization, its leadership structure, and its development practices as Polaris grows in scope and complexity, as well as continue to push adoption of AI across software development and build the shared platform capabilities, tooling, and infrastructure that allow teams to ship faster while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, and security.
We offer:
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $230,000 - $285,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams
Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.
You Will Be
Leading, coaching, and holding accountable engineering managers and individual contributors across our application stack, data pipelines, quality engineering, and cloud platform.
Build technical leaders that reduces single points of failure and allows the organization to scale without depending on individual heroics.
Set and reinforce a high bar for technical judgment, delivery ownership, collaboration, documentation, operational discipline, and customer impact.
Own engineering capacity planning, staffing allocations, and the engineering operating budget. Manage cloud, data, AI, tooling, and software vendor spend.
Partner with Product, UX, Data Science, and the Chief Product Officer to shape the Polaris roadmap, sequence investments, expose dependencies, and make clear tradeoffs among customer value, speed, reliability, cost, and technical health.
Translate agency, client, and market needs into a coherent technology strategy across Polaris IQ, shared data products, and measurement applications.
Maintain an actionable architecture roadmap that supports product growth while retiring fragile systems, duplicated capabilities, and unnecessary operational cost.
Define and manage an engineering scorecard that tracks delivery speed and quality. Continue moving delivery toward more frequent deployments through automated testing, CI/CD, observability, release automation, and fast feedback loops.
Set and execute the engineering AI strategy. Evaluate coding agents, model providers, agent runtimes, and automation opportunities based on measurable value, security, reliability, usability, and total cost.
Own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python and Django services, React applications, PostgreSQL, Airflow, BigQuery, dbt, GKE, Cloud Run, Terraform, GitOps, Argo CD, and GitHub Actions.
Ensure data pipelines and systems deliver accurate, timely, and observable data across advertising, analytics, commerce, and client data sources.
Own service-level objectives, incident management, corrective actions, capacity planning, and risk reduction for application, platform, and data workloads.
Act as the final engineering escalation for critical incidents and high-risk architecture decisions, while ensuring durable runbooks, monitoring, and delegated ownership exist afterward.
Partner with Security and Legal on secure architecture, identity and access management, secrets, vendor risk, data governance, incident response, client assurance, and compliance obligations.
You Must Have
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering managers and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
A record of building healthy teams, developing leaders, raising accountability, and delivering complex products in close partnership with Product, UX, Data Science, Security, and business stakeholders.
Deep architectural judgment across modern SaaS applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, distributed systems, CI/CD, observability, and security. Direct experience with GCP and the Polaris stack is valuable, but equivalent depth in comparable technologies is acceptable.
Experience improving developer productivity and delivery performance through platform capabilities, automation, testing, operational standards, and reporting on DevEx KPIs.
Practical experience adopting AI-assisted development or agentic workflows, with the judgment to balance speed against security, quality, cost, and maintainability.
Demonstrated ownership of cloud and software budgets, vendor relationships, capacity planning, and technical contract decisions.
Calm, decisive leadership and the ability to move between executive communication and hands-on technical investigation when necessary.

Wpromote is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead the engineering organization responsible for Polaris, our client CRM and marketing intelligence platform. Polaris supports client and integration management, normalized marketing data, reporting, measurement, forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, and client insights through internal and client-facing products.

This leader is accountable for engineering strategy, people, architecture, delivery, quality, reliability, security, and financial stewardship. You will scale the engineering organization, its leadership structure, and its development practices as Polaris grows in scope and complexity, as well as continue to push adoption of AI across software development and build the shared platform capabilities, tooling, and infrastructure that allow teams to ship faster while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, and security.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
About Riot Platforms
Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.
Who we are
At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.
We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.
About the role
Riot is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Solutions Engineering to lead technical pre-sales and solution design for our data center customers. Partnering closely with Sales, this role owns the technical evaluation stage on priority AI and Hyperscale opportunities, translating complex customer requirements into scalable, standards-based solutions, proposals, and cost estimates. As a member of the team, you will develop and put in place the templates, tools, and processes the function runs on. You will work with Sales, Operations, Design, Construction, Finance, and Supplier partners to make sure what we sell can be delivered, driving strong customer outcomes and contract value.
This position will be a Remote position with travel expected.
What you'll do
Serve as the technical lead on priority hyperscale and enterprise opportunities, translating customer business and IT infrastructure requirements into data center solutions
Lead solution requirement sessions with clients and vendors, delivering technical proposals, architectural overviews, and facility tours
Support Sales in positioning solutions and reviewing technical exhibits and lease terms, ensuring commitments align with what our sites can deliver
Conduct detailed assessments of power, cooling, network, and space requirements for customer deployments
Develop and review cost estimates, bills of materials, and scopes of work for large-scale infrastructure deployments
Establish standard templates, processes, and design review practices for the team
Own technical content for RFP/RFI responses and support QBRs and periodic business reviews
Represent Riot at customer sites, OEM facilities, trade conferences, and industry events
What you'll bring
8+ years of technical experience in data center, cloud, or mission-critical infrastructure, AI and Hyperscale experience preferred
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent technical experience (e.g., Navy Nuclear or other military technical programs)
Proven track record winning complex technical deals as a hands-on solutions engineer, sales engineer, or design lead
Deep knowledge of data center systems, including power, cooling (including liquid cooling for high-density AI/HPC), cabling, network architecture, and compliance (e.g., Uptime Tier, ASHRAE standards)
Ability to build and defend cost models, bills of materials, and scopes of work
Strong communication skills with technical teams and executive stakeholders, including customer C-level leaders
Compensation and Benefits
Competitive Salary: $180,000 - $210,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.
Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Director - Transmission Engineering (Overhead) - Remote
jobs.text:
Position Summary
Director, Transmission Engineering (Overhead) –– (Remote)
We have an opportunity for a talented & ambitious Engineer with Transmission Engineering experience with background and working experience of transmission and distribution lines Project Management, and P&L Leadership experience to join us as a Director of (OH) Transmission Engineering
At NV5, our Transmission Line teams play a critical role in delivering safe, reliable, and efficient power to communities and regions. We provide engineering solutions for the design, construction, maintenance, and modernization of high-voltage transmission infrastructure—the backbone of the electric grid. From new line development and system upgrades to critical maintenance projects, our teams apply rigorous standards of safety, quality, and performance while leveraging proven practices and innovative technologies to deliver sustainable, cost-effective solutions for our clients.
The Director of Transmission Engineering is a senior leadership position responsible for directing the planning, design, and execution of transmission line projects. This role leads multidisciplinary engineering and technical teams, ensures compliance with applicable safety, regulatory, and quality requirements, and aligns project delivery with NV5’s strategic objectives. The Director collaborates across business groups and with clients, stakeholders, and industry partners to advance innovation, improve efficiency, and promote operational excellence.
Why NV5?
At NV5, we understand the aging electrical grid faces significant challenges. The need for resiliency to withstand harsher weather while meeting increasing demands for power and power delivery are challenges, we face every day.
Navigating through permitting and regulation has increased design complexity and time to design and build desperately needed new and revitalized transmission assets.
By harnessing our expertise and providing cutting-edge solutions, NV5 steps in as a leader, to enhance transmission system capacity, fortify against fire and storm risks, and elevate the reliability of electrical service for utility customers. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, and conduct inspections on construction projects.
NV5’s integrated service capabilities deliver efficiency, consistency, attention to detail, and safe project execution. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in engineering, safety, quality, procurement, QA/QC, right-of-way, scheduling, environmental planning, permitting, and land management to achieve successful outcomes for our clients.
Responsibilities
Act as the engineer of record and client point of contact for power delivery projects.
Lead a team of 6-10 direct reports and an extended team of 30-40 resources which include engineers, designers, and drafters.
Assist in marketing, promotion and business development efforts retain and add new national clients.
Prepare, review, and P.E. seal technical calculation reports and construction documents meeting client and NV5 requirements.
Assist in the routing and design of transmission lines using industry-standard tools.
Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project success.
Manage multiple projects and provide engineering QA/QC
Travel to client sites as needed.
Assist with development of construction packages.
Oversee the planning, design, and execution of transmission projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and regulatory requirements.
Develop project budgets, schedules, and resource plans, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Manage risks and resolve issues that may impact project scope, quality, and delivery.
Provide technical guidance and expertise in the design and optimization of transmission systems.
Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and regulatory changes, and integrate best practices into the engineering processes.
Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards in all engineering activities.
Contribute to the development of the company's strategic plans and objectives, particularly in the areas of transmission infrastructure.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and technologies that can enhance the company's competitive position.
Collaborate with other departments within Power Delivery and also Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.
Represent the company at industry forums, conferences, and regulatory meetings, advocating for the company's interests and promoting its capabilities.
Requirements
Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited university.
Experience with understanding and managing project financials and overall P&L of the team
Experience leading a team to produce quality transmission construction ready designs.
Knowledge and Proficiency with PLS CADD, PLS Pole, MFAD, PLS-Tower a plus
12+ years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage electrical projects.
PE license is a must. PE license in CA is a plus.
Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, including ANSI, ASTM, ACI, AISC, NEC, NESC, and others.
#INDHP
Benefits
NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.
Competitive Salary
Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Company paid Life & AD&D
Company paid Disability
401K Plan
Paid Holidays
Paid Time Off
Company Overview
NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: to shape and strengthen the physical world.
Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as one team across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.
At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
The Vice President of Product will lead the strategy, development, commercialization, and ongoing management of HURC's product portfolio, with primary ownership of Coder Select. This executive will be responsible for building and scaling a technology-enabled healthcare solution that combines innovative platform capabilities, qualified coding talent, and managed coding services to meet the evolving needs of hospitals and healthcare organizations.
This role requires a strategic and commercially minded product leader with a strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle operations, medical coding, technology solutions, and product development. The VP of Product will work cross-functionally with executive leadership, IT, Coding, Operations, and Sales to establish product direction, drive execution, accelerate market adoption, and deliver measurable business results.
Key Responsibilities
Own the overall product strategy, vision, and roadmap for Coder Select.
Establish product priorities, objectives, and measurable performance goals aligned with HURC's growth strategy.
Identify opportunities to expand product capabilities, service offerings, and market reach.
Evaluate industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies to maintain a differentiated market position.
Translate business and client needs into actionable product strategies.
Lead the product lifecycle from concept and development through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Partner with IT and technology resources to define product requirements, functionality, integrations, and enhancements.
Oversee platform usability, functionality, workflow design, and the overall customer experience.
Identify opportunities for automation, AI, and technology-enabled efficiencies.
Establish product development priorities and ensure timely execution of the product roadmap.
Commercialization & Business Growth
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including product positioning, pricing, packaging, and market differentiation.
Partner with Sales and Business Development to support client acquisition, presentations, demonstrations, and contract opportunities.
Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and introduce additional product capabilities.
Establish strategies to increase product adoption, utilization, and recurring revenue.
Monitor market demand and competitive positioning to identify new business opportunities.
Operational & Service Delivery Oversight
Ensure Coder Select effectively integrates technology, coding talent, and managed service delivery.
Partner with Coding and Operations leadership to establish workflows, service standards, quality expectations, and performance metrics.
Monitor product performance, client satisfaction, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Develop scalable delivery models that support domestic and international coding resources.
Identify and resolve product or operational gaps that impact the client experience or profitability.
Financial & Performance Management
Establish and monitor product KPIs, financial targets, and performance dashboards.
Maintain accountability for product revenue, profitability, and growth objectives.
Evaluate product investment opportunities, resource requirements, and return on investment.
Develop strategies to improve margins, operational efficiency, and long-term product sustainability.
Executive Leadership & Collaboration
Serve as the executive owner and internal champion of Coder Select.
Lead cross-functional product initiatives and establish accountability across participating departments.
Collaborate with executive leadership to align product strategy with HURC's broader business objectives.
Provide regular reporting on product performance, development milestones, financial results, and growth opportunities.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Technology, or a related field; MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in healthcare product management, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management, or healthcare services leadership.
Demonstrated experience developing, launching, and scaling technology-enabled healthcare products or service offerings.
Strong understanding of medical coding, HIM, hospital revenue cycle operations, and healthcare workforce models.
Experience managing product roadmaps, technology development, integrations, and commercialization strategies.

jobs.title: Director, Real World Data Strategy
jobs.text:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Position Summary:
At BMS, the Director, Real-World Data Strategy sits at the intersection of business strategy, data intelligence, and AI-driven innovation, serving as a key member of the enterprise Real-World Data (RWD) Strategy team. This is a business-first role powered by data and accelerated by artificial intelligence. The Director is responsible for translating BMS's most pressing business and R&D priorities into sharp, actionable RWD strategies, and for leading the team's adoption and application of AI to reshape how the organization identifies, evaluates, acquires, and deploys real-world data assets to drive evidence generation, competitive differentiation, and patient impact.
This role is expected to be the AI innovation driver on the enterprise RWD Strategy team, someone who brings a high AI IQ, actively identifies where AI unlocks new strategic value, and sets the standard for how AI thinking is embedded in the team's work and in service of BMS customers and partners.
As part of an enterprise-wide team, this Director will serve as a connector between the external RWD and AI landscape and BMS's internal needs, ensuring that every data and technology investment is grounded in clear business value and strategic alignment. Success in this role requires deep domain expertise, AI fluency and curiosity, executive presence, rigorous analytical thinking, and a relentless focus on outcomes for the business.
Key Responsibilities:
AI Leadership & Innovation:
Serve as the team's AI innovation lead, setting direction for how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics are integrated into RWD strategy, data evaluation, market intelligence, and evidence generation.
Proactively identify, evaluate, and champion AI-enabled data opportunities and emerging technologies that enhance RWD exploration, dataset assessment, and strategic decision-making at scale.
Translate the rapidly evolving AI and data science landscape into practical, high-impact applications aligned with BMS R&D priorities and pipeline needs.
Model AI-forward thinking across the team and for customers, building shared literacy, frameworks, and best practices that elevate the team's collective AI capability.
Align novel AI-driven research ideas with available RWD assets to accelerate exploratory use cases, enabling faster, smarter data-driven decisions across the enterprise.
Business-Driven Strategy & Prioritization:
Champion and communicate a forward-looking RWD exploration strategy that is anchored in BMS business priorities, translating R&D needs, pipeline goals, and evidence gaps into targeted data investment and exploration decisions.
Synthesize inputs from RWD users, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners to define and evolve strategic priorities, ensuring every data initiative is tied to measurable business value.
Develop and present clear, executive-ready business cases for RWD investments, acquisitions, and licensing decisions, balancing strategic ambition with budget realities and portfolio needs.
Data Landscaping & Opportunity Identification:
Monitor and interpret the global RWD ecosystem, including emerging datasets, vendors, technologies, AI platforms, partnerships, and market trends, through a business lens, connecting evolving research questions and R&D needs with differentiated data sources and novel use cases.
Lead rigorous evaluation and piloting of priority RWD sources, assessing fitness, quality, coverage, differentiation, and applicability, and translating findings into clear investment or adoption recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Establish scalable assessment frameworks, dashboards, and methodologies that enable consistent, repeatable evaluation and prioritization of RWD opportunities across the enterprise portfolio.
Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration:
Drive high-visibility engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams through a hub model of ongoing consultations, ensuring transparent, interactive strategy development processes that build trust and alignment.
Collaborate across Strategy, Acquisition, Data Product, Governance, Customer Success, and R&D stakeholder groups to convert exploration insights into actionable data, investment, partnership, and portfolio decisions.
Serve as a thought leader across the enterprise RWD Strategy team, contributing to shared capabilities, best practices, and strategic frameworks, with particular emphasis on AI integration, that elevate the team's collective impact.
Partner & Vendor Development:
Identify, assess, and engage RWD data providers and external partners to evaluate differentiated partnership opportunities that address emerging or unmet data needs, including AI-powered data and analytics platforms.
Lead assessment of RWD partners for comprehensive data development capabilities, ensuring partnerships create clear, lasting strategic advantage for BMS.
Qualifications:
Education:
Advanced degree in health research, life sciences, data science, quantitative sciences, or a related field. PhD preferred but not required.
Experience:
10+ years of relevant experience in real-world healthcare data, data strategy, market intelligence, life sciences, or consulting, with a demonstrated track record of translating complex business and scientific problems into data-driven strategies and outcomes.
Demonstrated experience applying AI and advanced analytics in an RWD, life sciences, or data strategy context, including familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or AI-enabled data tools.
Proven ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior leaders in a complex, matrixed life sciences organization.
Deep expertise in RWD sources, data evaluation approaches, research and analytic applications, and the evolving external RWD ecosystem.
Significant experience engaging with RWD vendors and data partners, including negotiating and shaping strategic relationships.
Skills & Competencies:
AI fluency and innovation mindset: Ability to identify, evaluate, and operationalize AI-driven opportunities that create tangible value for RWD strategy and enterprise customers. Expected to be a visible AI champion within the team.
Business acumen: Strong ability to frame data and AI opportunities in terms of business value, pipeline impact, and investment return.
Strategic thinking and executive communication: Ability to synthesize complex data, AI, and market intelligence into concise, compelling recommendations that influence senior decision-making.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience building evaluation frameworks and investment cases.
Familiarity with analytic platforms, federated environments, and AI/data science approaches relevant to RWD access and exploration.
Knowledge of RWD compliance requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.), including emerging considerations for AI use in healthcare data contexts.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with comfort operating in a fast-changing, cross-functional enterprise environment.
We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
Compensation Overview:
Remote - United States - US: $197,800 - $239,681
The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. We determine starting pay thoughtfully – carefully considering the nature of the role, required skills, work location, schedule and the knowledge and experience you bring. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance.
Benefits:
Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability).
U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year.
Non-exempt employees, RayzeBio employees, and employees located in Puerto Rico receive 160 hours of paid vacation annually for new hires (subject to manager approval), 11 paid company holidays, and 3 optional holidays.
Depending on eligibility, employees may also have access to additional time-off benefits, including paid sick leave, up to two paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, and leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, or military needs. Eligible employees also enjoy an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

jobs.text:
Overview
Gray AES is looking to add a Director, Electrical Engineering-MEP to our office in Atlanta,GA, Birmingham,AL, Charlotte,NC, Cincinnati,OH, Dallas,TX, Lexington, KY, or Remote
Responsibilities
Why Gray AES?
Gray is a family-owned, fully integrated global service provider specializing in engineering, design, construction, digital, equipment manufacturing, and real estate services. Deeply rooted in EAC services, Gray serves both domestic and international customers across our core markets: Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, Automotive, Distribution, Mission Critical, and Commercial. At Gray, our purpose is to make a positive difference in people's lives and build a better future.
Gray AES, the design arm of Gray, is a top-ranked firm offering architecture and engineering services across the globe. Made up of multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, and project managers, these collaborative teams work every day to provide unique, customized solutions for our customers.
It’s the spirit of our people – the passion, commitment, and a great team environment – that makes our company a great place to work.
Who we want…
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or mechanical engineering technology
Professional Engineering (PE) License required.
15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
Advanced proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, BIM, and other relevant design and modeling software.
Advanced proficiency with electrical design tools (e.g., SKM Power Tools, ETAP, or similar).
Proven track record of mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Demonstrated success in leading complex, multidisciplinary projects and managing client relationships.
Strong business acumen with experience in budgeting, proposal development, client engagement, and strategic planning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to foster collaboration across departments.
Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Self-directed leader capable of driving initiatives from concept through execution.
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
Qualifications
What we expect… (Essential Functions)
Provide strategic leadership for the electrical engineering discipline, aligning team capabilities with business goals and market demands.
Oversee the technical execution, quality assurance, and delivery of electrical engineering services across all project phases.
Lead and mentor engineering managers, senior engineers, and design staff, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver integrated design solutions, coordinating with architectural, structural, mechanical, and automation teams.
Drive process optimization, including QA/QC standards, technology adoption, and documentation workflows.Support business development efforts, including proposal strategy, client presentations, and relationship management.
Lead resource planning, hiring strategy, and succession planning for the electrical engineering team.
Ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and quality standards across all engineering activities.
Other strategic duties as assigned.
Physical Demands & Work EnvironmentThe physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.Periodic overnight travel to visit jobsites where the ability to traverse undeveloped terrain may be required.
While performing the duties of this position, the team member is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands, reach with hands or arms and talk or hear. They may occasionally be required to climb or balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
Specific vision abilities required include close vision.
Generally, normal office environment where noise level is moderate and temperature/humidity is controlled. Overtime may be required.
Supervisory ResponsibilitiesThis position may supervise the roles of Manager, Electrical Engineering, Principal Engineer, or Senior Engineers.
EEO DisclaimerGray is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes everyone to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering at VC-backed motorsport startup
jobs.text:
who we are
Track Titan is building the operating system for motorsport – every racer's "personal career mode", from their first casual lap to the pro ranks. Over 300,000 sim racers use our AI coaching to get measurably faster – recording more than 1M km of racing telemetry daily while doing so, one of the most unique datasets in sports tech – and our ambitions stretch far beyond sim racing. We’re a team of pro-level racers who have also been senior employees in startups of all scales that have raised hundreds of millions of dollars. Together as Track Titan, we raised a $5M seed in late 2025, co-led by Partech and Game Changers Ventures, and we're the only company backed by tier-one VCs going deep on racing – which lets us make the big bets that nobody else in this space can. Now we're building the team to execute on those bets.
your mission
To build and lead the engineering org creating the best product in motorsport – one that ships quickly, predictably, and at a quality the whole team is proud of.
As our Head of Engineering, you'll own the people, delivery, and process side of engineering, across product engineering and ML. We're at the point where engineering leadership becomes a craft in its own right, and we're investing in it accordingly. You'll partner closely with the CTPO, who owns product and AI direction, to build the engineering org itself: the standards, the systems, and the culture.
This is a role for someone who is as passionate about speed, quality, team culture and operational excellence as most engineers are about the tech itself. The best teams are demanding and happy: people do their best work when expectations are high, ownership is real, and momentum is visible. We're not looking for someone to keep a machine running. We're looking for someone who is excited to build and fine-tune the machine in the first place.
Why this role, why now
We ship across web, desktop, and mobile, our ML work is moving from research into the product, and our ambitions are growing faster than the team. Our ways of working need to match: delivery that is predictable and visible, process that creates speed, and big ML bets that reach users in iterative steps along the way. We believe the fastest teams do fewer things, better – with high talent density and real ownership.
