jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.
Role
As Director of Product you own Orcrist’s entire product portfolio - Orcrist’s OIP and Civitas’ Sentinel, and lead the product organisation. You decide what Orcrist builds and in which order: what becomes platform and what stays customer-specific, which customer problem is solved next, and how we measure that it has been solved. Our promise is demonstrable the effectiveness of our software, and making that promise deliverable is the core of this role. You work directly with Engineers, our Government Development-Team and our customers and report to the COO of Orcrist.
What you’ll do
Own product strategy and the portfolio roadmap across all product lines – including the decision about what becomes shared platform and what remains customer-specific engineering.
Build and lead the product organisation: hire and develop Product Managers for the product lines and align them on common standards for discovery, prioritisation and delivery.
Make product effectiveness and customer activity & usage a measurable product goal: define metrics, measurement logic and the subsequent tasks that are triggered by that.
Own discovery with our Government Development team and our customers, and translate their requirements into product decisions rather than collecting feature requests.
Decide prioritisation across competing customer, tender and platform demands, and defend those decisions to customers, the team and the management.
Plan deliverable releases together with Engineering and QA, holding the balance between speed, quality and platform capability.
Assess market, competitive and technology developments in the defence and simulation space and feed them into product strategy.
About you
8+ years of product management experience with complex technical products, preferably in the Analytics or SAAS-space, including several years leading Product Managers or a product organisation.
Proven track record of delivering products from discovery through to customer rollout – with nameable outcomes, not just roadmaps.
Experience with B2B or B2G products in long, formal procurement cycles and with demanding enterprise or public sector customers.
Experience holding platform decisions against customer-specific exceptions – and explaining the commercial consequence of both paths.
Ability to decide with incomplete information, take ownership, and work in an environment without mature processes.
Excellent communication skills in German and English across various hierarchy levels.
Willingness to travel to customers (approx. 10-20%).
Authorization to work in Germany
Nice-to-haves
Experience in defence, GovTech, data fusion; own military or law enforcement background an advantage.
Experience with data analytics platforms.
Experience with on-premise, offline or air-gapped products and their consequences for product decisions.
Experience building a product organisation in a startup or scale-up.
What we offer
Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.
Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.
Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.
30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.
Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.
Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
About the Job:
LaunchDarkly is the runtime control plane for the AI software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC). Thousands of engineering organizations, including more than a quarter of the Fortune 500, use LaunchDarkly to ship, measure, and control every change that reaches production, whether it is written by people or by AI. Feature management built the company. The next chapter is bigger: as the cost of writing code falls and the volume of change outpaces human review, the constraint is moving from writing software to controlling it. LaunchDarkly is building the critical infrastructure for the AI-SDLC. Customers build their own software factories. We build the rails they run on.
We are hiring the leader of Product Management for LaunchDarkly. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the product management organization end to end: the people, operating system, roadmap commitments, and commercial outcomes across every product pillar. You will sit at the technology leadership table as the Product Management peer to the heads of Engineering and Product Design.
The CPO sets the company’s product vision and strategic direction. You will build and run the product organization that turns that direction into a coherent portfolio, shipped outcomes, customer adoption, and revenue growth. This is a hands-on operating role for a product leader who knows how to build the machine, make the tradeoffs, and finish the work.
Responsibilities:
Lead cross-functional product leadership. Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, establish shared commitments, and ensure LaunchDarkly presents one coherent product strategy to customers and the market.
Build and lead the product management organization. Design the organization intentionally, allocate resources effectively, maintain a high talent bar, build succession plans, and establish clear ownership for every product surface a customer or sales representative may ask about.
Own the product operating system. Establish the cadence that turns strategy into shipped software and met goals, including quarterly commitments, leadership reviews, squad-level inspection, launch briefs, new product introduction (NPI), and the product-to-field handoff. Make execution predictable enough that the executive team does not have to ask whether something shipped.
Drive roadmap delivery across every product pillar. Lead execution across Enterprise, Foundation, Observability, Experimentation, Agent Control, Automation, and the platform beneath them. Build a culture of doing what we say we are going to do.
Create portfolio discipline without slowing the company down. Ensure new bets enter the portfolio through explicit decisions rather than hallway conversations, while preserving the flexibility to respond to market changes. Marketing dates should be commitments the product organization can confidently support.
Drive finishing. A product is not done when version one ships; it is done when the team has iterated based on learning. A launch is not done when it ships; it is done when the field is amplifying it. A process is not done when it is written; it is done when it creates leverage for the team.
Own packaging execution and commercial outcomes. Lead how pricing and packaging land in the product and in the field so every representative can sell the full platform and every pillar contributes to its commercial goals.
Stay close to customers and the field. Spend time with the largest customers and most demanding evaluators, translate what you learn into product decisions, and build a process that brings customer and field insight into the roadmap at scale.
Use AI to increase product and engineering leverage. Help the organization adopt AI-assisted development and product practices in ways that increase delivery speed while maintaining quality and judgment.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year:
The organization is complete. The leadership model is in place, product lines have the right pillar leadership, spans and layers are intentional, decision rights are clear, succession risks are understood, and the organization can continue to scale.
Delivery increases every quarter. Shipped output per team rises quarter over quarter as AI-assisted development compounds, with quality holding.
The operating system runs without the CPO driving it. Reviews, check-ins, launch briefs, and NPI happen on cadence and at a consistent bar.
The portfolio is staffed. Every initiative in flight has an explicit staffing decision and plan behind it.
The numbers move. Activation, attach, activity, and expansion targets for each pillar respond to the organization’s inputs.
The team is stronger than you found it. Product managers have more leverage, complementary strengths are valued over a uniform mold, and every hire raises the bar.
About You:
You are direct, decisive, and high-agency. You identify a problem, propose a fix, and act unless someone tells you not to.
You are a relentless simplifier, not a caretaker. When you find friction, your instinct is to remove process rather than add it. You know how to run a company of this size like a small company that ships.
You are a builder of people and move quickly on people problems. Product leaders who have worked for you say you made them better and would work for you again. You raise the bar clearly, promote based on evidence, and do not allow known performance problems to persist.
You are comfortable challenging a strategy and turning it into a sequenced portfolio. You can tell the story of an idea you pushed back on, how you used evidence to make the call, and how you maintained the relationship.
You write clearly and make decisions. You use written argument to create alignment, expect strong writing from your team, and end meetings with a decision.
You are customer-oriented and commercially grounded. You can move from a conversation with a developer or data scientist to a discussion with an executive buyer or sales leader without losing the thread.
Qualifications:
Minimum of 15+ years of experience in Product Management, including 7+ years leading Product Managers and product leaders across a multi-product B2B platform.
Experience leading Product Management at the VP, SVP, or equivalent level across a multi-product B2B platform.
Experience leading a product management organization of 20 or more product managers at a company with approximately $100M to $500M in revenue.
A track record of building and developing a product organization, rather than simply inheriting one.
Demonstrated ability to turn company strategy into a reliable operating system that delivers roadmap commitments and measurable business outcomes.
Experience working with a founder or visionary executive and converting a high volume of ideas into a sequenced, resourced portfolio.
Experience building products for engineering organizations and selling to CTOs, platform leaders, and data science teams.
Strong commercial fluency, including experience owning or materially influencing pricing, packaging, attach, expansion, and go-to-market execution.
Experience balancing enterprise and self-serve motions, including an understanding of what drives a large enterprise expansion and what creates value for a developer on a free plan.
Practical experience using AI agents in your own work and applying AI-native approaches to product management or software development. You should have clear opinions about how AI changes product management, supported by things you have shipped.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions with incomplete information, and improve delivery speed without compromising product quality.
Pay:
Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level E1:
Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $424,000 - $583,000**
Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $381,600 - $524,700*
Zone 3: All other US locations - $360,400 - $495,550*
All Zones Inclusive of 25% Bonus Target
LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.
*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.
About LaunchDarkly:
Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.
The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:
Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability
At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. blocks.text: About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is the runtime control plane for the AI software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC). Thousands of engineering organizations, including more than a quarter of the Fortune 500, use LaunchDarkly to ship, measure, and control every change that reaches production, whether it is written by people or by AI. Feature management built the company. The next chapter is bigger: as the cost of writing code falls and the volume of change outpaces human review, the constraint is moving from writing software to controlling it. LaunchDarkly is building the critical infrastructure for the AI-SDLC. Customers build their own software factories. We build the rails they run on.

We are hiring the leader of Product Management for LaunchDarkly. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the product management organization end to end: the people, operating system, roadmap commitments, and commercial outcomes across every product pillar. You will sit at the technology leadership table as the Product Management peer to the heads of Engineering and Product Design.

The CPO sets the company’s product vision and strategic direction. You will build and run the product organization that turns that direction into a coherent portfolio, shipped outcomes, customer adoption, and revenue growth. This is a hands-on operating role for a product leader who knows how to build the machine, make the tradeoffs, and finish the work.
Responsibilities:

items: Lead cross-functional product leadership. Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, establish shared commitments, and ensure LaunchDarkly presents one coherent product strategy to customers and the market.

Build and lead the product management organization. Design the organization intentionally, allocate resources effectively, maintain a high talent bar, build succession plans, and establish clear ownership for every product surface a customer or sales representative may ask about.

Own the product operating system. Establish the cadence that turns strategy into shipped software and met goals, including quarterly commitments, leadership reviews, squad-level inspection, launch briefs, new product introduction (NPI), and the product-to-field handoff. Make execution predictable enough that the executive team does not have to ask whether something shipped.

Drive roadmap delivery across every product pillar. Lead execution across Enterprise, Foundation, Observability, Experimentation, Agent Control, Automation, and the platform beneath them. Build a culture of doing what we say we are going to do.

Create portfolio discipline without slowing the company down. Ensure new bets enter the portfolio through explicit decisions rather than hallway conversations, while preserving the flexibility to respond to market changes. Marketing dates should be commitments the product organization can confidently support.

Drive finishing. A product is not done when version one ships; it is done when the team has iterated based on learning. A launch is not done when it ships; it is done when the field is amplifying it. A process is not done when it is written; it is done when it creates leverage for the team.

Own packaging execution and commercial outcomes. Lead how pricing and packaging land in the product and in the field so every representative can sell the full platform and every pillar contributes to its commercial goals.

Stay close to customers and the field. Spend time with the largest customers and most demanding evaluators, translate what you learn into product decisions, and build a process that brings customer and field insight into the roadmap at scale.

Use AI to increase product and engineering leverage. Help the organization adopt AI-assisted development and product practices in ways that increase delivery speed while maintaining quality and judgment.

blocks.text: What Success Looks Like in Your First Year:

items: The organization is complete. The leadership model is in place, product lines have the right pillar leadership, spans and layers are intentional, decision rights are clear, succession risks are understood, and the organization can continue to scale.
Delivery increases every quarter. Shipped output per team rises quarter over quarter as AI-assisted development compounds, with quality holding.
The operating system runs without the CPO driving it. Reviews, check-ins, launch briefs, and NPI happen on cadence and at a consistent bar.
The portfolio is staffed. Every initiative in flight has an explicit staffing decision and plan behind it.
The numbers move. Activation, attach, activity, and expansion targets for each pillar respond to the organization’s inputs.
The team is stronger than you found it. Product managers have more leverage, complementary strengths are valued over a uniform mold, and every hire raises the bar.

blocks.text: About You:

items: You are direct, decisive, and high-agency. You identify a problem, propose a fix, and act unless someone tells you not to.

You are a relentless simplifier, not a caretaker. When you find friction, your instinct is to remove process rather than add it. You know how to run a company of this size like a small company that ships.

You are a builder of people and move quickly on people problems. Product leaders who have worked for you say you made them better and would work for you again. You raise the bar clearly, promote based on evidence, and do not allow known performance problems to persist.

You are comfortable challenging a strategy and turning it into a sequenced portfolio. You can tell the story of an idea you pushed back on, how you used evidence to make the call, and how you maintained the relationship.
You write clearly and make decisions. You use written argument to create alignment, expect strong writing from your team, and end meetings with a decision.

You are customer-oriented and commercially grounded. You can move from a conversation with a developer or data scientist to a discussion with an executive buyer or sales leader without losing the thread.

blocks.text: Qualifications:

items: Minimum of 15+ years of experience in Product Management, including 7+ years leading Product Managers and product leaders across a multi-product B2B platform.
Experience leading Product Management at the VP, SVP, or equivalent level across a multi-product B2B platform.
Experience leading a product management organization of 20 or more product managers at a company with approximately $100M to $500M in revenue.
A track record of building and developing a product organization, rather than simply inheriting one.
Demonstrated ability to turn company strategy into a reliable operating system that delivers roadmap commitments and measurable business outcomes.
Experience working with a founder or visionary executive and converting a high volume of ideas into a sequenced, resourced portfolio.
Experience building products for engineering organizations and selling to CTOs, platform leaders, and data science teams.
Strong commercial fluency, including experience owning or materially influencing pricing, packaging, attach, expansion, and go-to-market execution.
Experience balancing enterprise and self-serve motions, including an understanding of what drives a large enterprise expansion and what creates value for a developer on a free plan.

Practical experience using AI agents in your own work and applying AI-native approaches to product management or software development. You should have clear opinions about how AI changes product management, supported by things you have shipped.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions with incomplete information, and improve delivery speed without compromising product quality.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.
The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

items: Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

jobs.title: Head of Product - Trust & Compliance (f/m/x) - remote
jobs.text:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.
Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.
If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).
At refurbed, we make refurbished products a trusted alternative to buying new. We’re looking for a Head of Product – Trust & Compliance to lead the product teams that help customers buy with confidence, receive what they expect, and get effective support when something goes wrong.
The Role:
You will own the product vision, strategy, and team development for an area spanning Delivery & Returns, Customer Success, and Compliance. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will develop Product Managers and the design capabilities within your area, working closely with Engineering, Analytics, Customer Service, Operations, Finance, and Legal. You will connect customer needs, operational processes, and business requirements into a clear strategy and measurable priorities.
Your goal is to make trust part of how the marketplace works: reliable customer journeys, effective issue resolution, and scalable systems that support responsible growth. You will help teams move beyond individual requests to solve the underlying problems, improve customer outcomes, and reduce avoidable operational work.
WHO YOU ARE:
Significant product management experience, typically +8 years, including +2 years of directly managing and developing Product Managers and leading across multiple squads.
A track record of creating clear product direction in complex areas involving customer-facing experiences, internal systems, and operational processes.
Experience delivering measurable improvements in one or more relevant domains: post-purchase journeys, customer service, delivery and returns, payments, risk, or compliance-related products.
Strong people leadership: you can coach experienced ICs, give direct feedback, address performance gaps, and delegate meaningful ownership.
Strong product and UX judgment, with the ability to help teams turn complex requirements into simple, usable experiences.
Analytical fluency and the ability to connect customer outcomes, operational performance, and business impact.
Technical fluency: you can reason with Engineering about integrations, data quality, dependencies, failure modes, and the trade-offs between building and buying.
Strong stakeholder management and clear communication, including when priorities conflict or a requirement is non-negotiable.
Motivation to contribute to sustainable consumption and comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment.
Location & eligibility: This role is open to candidates based in Europe (including UK) only with a valid right to work.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Set the direction: turn company strategy into a clear product strategy for Trust & Compliance, with explicit priorities, trade-offs, and measurable outcomes across squads.
Lead and develop people: coach Product Managers and designers, raise the bar for product judgment and execution, and build clear ownership so teams can work independently.
Improve the experience after purchase: help customers navigate delivery, returns, refunds, and support with greater clarity and less effort.
Build scalable service capabilities: partner with Customer Service and Operations to prevent recurring problems, improve self-service, and make internal tools and workflows more effective.
Embed compliance into product development: work with Legal and relevant specialists to turn requirements into practical customer experiences, reliable controls, and maintainable systems.
Balance customer and business outcomes: make informed trade-offs between customer trust, service quality, cost to serve, risk, and delivery speed.
Create cross-functional alignment: clarify responsibilities and dependencies across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other product areas.
Strengthen discovery and learning: combine customer and seller research, operational feedback, product data, and experiments to identify the most valuable problems.
HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED:
Marketplace or e-commerce experience.
Experience partnering with Legal, Finance, or risk specialists.
We value strong product leadership and the ability to learn a domain over expertise in every part of this scope.
WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:
Our Culture and Values:
Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!
We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.
You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!
No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!
Personal & Professional Development:
You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.
We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.
We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.
Flexibility:
We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊
We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.
You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops
…and much more! See for further insights!

jobs.title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation
jobs.text:
Job Title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation
Reports To:Chief Technology Officer
Location: Remote – US
Job Type: Full-Time, Regular Position
Company Overview:
Asymchem, Inc., is part of Asymchem Laboratories Co. Ltd., founded in 1995 as a global integrated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing drug R&D and manufacturing for leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Our mission is to drive smarter, greener, and more cost-effective manufacturing to support clinical research and commercialization. Asymchem currently operates R&D and manufacturing facilities in China, the U.S., and the U.K., offering solutions ranging from early clinical stage to commercial stage, including R&D, cGMP production of advanced intermediates, APIs, formulations, and clinical research services. Asymchem Group, headquartered in Tianjin, P.R. China, is a publicly traded company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 002821.SZ/6821.HK).
Asymchem Company Information and Social Media
Job Overview:
The Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation advance Asymchem’s chemical engineering capabilities to support the next generation of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Building on Asymchem’s existing technical strengths, this leader will work with teams across the organization to advance process engineering, expand continuous manufacturing, and accelerate progress toward more automated, data-driven operations. The role will extend successful technologies and practices across client programs and global sites. Working closely with the Chief Technology Officer and existing technical and operational leaders, this VP will shape technology priorities, develop talent, and guide investments that connect scientific innovation with manufacturing execution. The opportunity is to influence Asymchem’s technology direction while delivering measurable progress in engineering capability and manufacturing performance.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Partner with technical and operational leaders to continuously improve engineering capabilities, technical practices, and cross-site collaboration. Translate shared priorities into a roadmap with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
Support the development of engineering talent across the US, Europe, and China. Mentor technical leaders, share effective methods, and contribute to recruitment aligned with evolving business needs.
Strengthen process understanding, measurement, modeling, and control to enable reliable automation. Connect laboratory development with manufacturing requirements from the outset.
Partner with manufacturing, automation, and digital teams to develop and validate approaches that integrate PAT, process models, and data-driven decisions. Apply AI where it offers demonstrable process value.
Prioritize opportunities for automated and continuous processing, demonstrate their value, and lead the engineering work required for adoption in manufacturing.
Advance capabilities in reaction engineering, continuous processing, crystallization, solid-form and particle engineering, and separation and isolation. Select technologies against process needs, safety, robustness, and economics.
Translate successful approaches into platforms that can be reused across client programs. Extend relevant capabilities from small molecules to peptides, oligonucleotides, and emerging modalities.
Guide critical engineering decisions through scale-up, technology transfer, and commercialization. Work with process chemistry, analytical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams to resolve complex process challenges.
Engage clients on technical strategy and due diligence. Translate engineering capabilities into credible development and manufacturing solutions that strengthen client confidence and business opportunities.
Partner with the CTO and functional leaders to identify opportunities for technology advancement, shape long-term priorities, and guide investment in people, equipment, and external partnerships.
Evaluate emerging technologies with scientific rigor and implementation discipline. Build academic and industry collaborations, develop future technical leaders, and represent Asymchem in senior technical discussions.
Experience Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities (KSAs):
PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Substantial pharmaceutical development, engineering, or manufacturing experience, typically 15+ years, with increasing leadership responsibility. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CDMO backgrounds are welcome.
Demonstrated success advancing engineering capabilities or technology platforms, developing talent, and translating technical progress into sustained operational results.
Strong chemical engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more relevant process technologies, and the breadth to lead specialists. A record of successful scale-up, technology transfer, or commercial implementation is essential.
A collaborative leader who develops talent, earns trust across functions, and advances technical priorities through shared ownership and disciplined implementation.
Credibility with clients, technical experts, and executives; sound process safety and quality judgment; and the ability to lead across functions, cultures, and locations.
Bilingual English and Mandarin a plus, but not required.
Experience implementing process automation, advanced controls, or continuous manufacturing is desirable.
Experience with peptides or oligonucleotides and external technology partnerships are desirable.
Domestic and International Travel as required. Approximately 40%
Benefits:
Day 1 Coverage for Medical, Vision (Co. Paid), and Dental Insurance
Paid Life Insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) & Long-Term Disability (LTD)
Paid Holidays, Vacation, Sick Time, and Maternity Leave
Matching 401K

jobs.title: Head of Product – POS & Commerce
jobs.text:
Head of Product – Point of Sale (POS)
Company: Epos Now
Location: UK
Department: Product
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
About Epos Now
Epos Now is a fast-growing, global technology business transforming how over 100,000 merchants operate, take payments and grow.
Operating across 10 international markets, including the UK, US and Australia, we provide an integrated commerce platform that helps businesses manage everything from payments and inventory to customer engagement and financial services.
We're entering an exciting phase of growth, investing heavily in our core POS platform, embedded financial services and AI-powered products to help merchants run smarter, more successful businesses.
The Opportunity
We're looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Head of Product – Point of Sale (POS) to take ownership of our core POS platform across Hospitality, Retail and Service.
This is one of the most influential product leadership opportunities within Epos Now. Our POS platform sits at the heart of everything we do, providing the foundation for integrated payments, financial services and our next generation of AI-powered capabilities.
This isn't simply about maintaining an established product. It's about shaping the future of commerce technology, driving innovation and creating new opportunities for growth.
The Role
As Head of Product, you'll own the vision, strategy and execution of our core POS product portfolio, leading product teams and working closely with engineering, design and commercial leadership.
You'll play a central role in evolving our platform, strengthening our competitive position and ensuring we continue to deliver exceptional products to merchants around the world.
Key Responsibilities
Define and deliver the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Hospitality, Retail and Service.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers.
Drive product innovation across POS, integrated payments, embedded finance and AI.
Own commercial product outcomes, including merchant adoption, retention and revenue growth.
Identify opportunities to improve the merchant experience and introduce new product capabilities.
Work closely with engineering, design, sales and marketing to deliver successful product launches.
Use customer insights, market intelligence and product data to inform strategic decisions.
Partner with senior leadership to shape Epos Now's wider product and commercial strategy.
Balance innovation and new product development with the continued evolution of an established international platform.
About You
We're looking for an experienced product leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on, commercially driven approach.
Essential Experience
Significant experience in product management, including leadership of Product Managers.
Background in Point of Sale (POS), commerce technology, payments, retail technology, hospitality technology or vertical SaaS.
Proven experience owning and delivering product strategies and roadmaps.
Strong commercial understanding, with experience influencing revenue, adoption or retention.
Experience building, improving and scaling software products.
Ability to work effectively with engineering, design and commercial teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with senior executives.
A data-driven approach to product development and decision-making.
Desirable Experience
Experience with integrated payments or embedded financial services.
Exposure to AI-powered product development.
Experience working across multiple international markets.
Background in a high-growth technology or SaaS business.
Experience delivering products for SME or merchant customers.
Why Join Epos Now?
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a business-critical product at the heart of an ambitious international technology company.
Scale and impact: Shape technology used by over 100,000 merchants internationally.
Real ownership: Lead the strategy and direction of our core POS product portfolio.
Innovation: Help bring AI, payments and embedded financial services into the next generation of commerce technology.
Leadership influence: Work closely with our senior leadership team and influence strategic decisions.
Growth opportunity: Join a business investing in its technology, products and international expansion.
Build for the future: Play a defining role in how Epos Now evolves from a POS provider into an intelligent, connected commerce platform.
Interested?
If you're an ambitious product leader with experience in POS, payments or commerce technology and want to make a genuine commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and help shape the future of commerce at Epos Now.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product Management
jobs.text:
Job Overview
We are seeking a multi-skilled Product Marketing & UX Project Manager to lead product strategy and project execution. This individual will be responsible for market positioning, user experience design, Agile/Waterfall project management, and writing epics/user stories to drive product success.
This role requires deep expertise in SaaS product management, digital experience design, and cross-functional team collaboration to bring NexGen Virtual Workplace to market and enhance customer engagement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Market Strategy & Positioning
Define go-to-market strategies for NexGen Virtual Workplace
Develop product positioning, messaging, and competitive analysis.
Work with marketing and sales teams to create value propositions and product launch plans.
Gather customer insights and market trends to refine the product roadmap.
2. UI/UX Design & User Research
Lead UX/UI strategy, ensuring seamless user experiences.
Conduct user research, usability testing, and feedback analysis.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and design specifications.
Collaborate with developers to ensure design feasibility and implementation.
3. Agile & Waterfall Project Management
Manage product development using Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
Write Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria in Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
Work with engineering, design, and business teams to prioritize and execute sprints.
Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and risk management strategies.
Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, backlog grooming, and sprint planning.
4. Cross-Functional Team Collaboration
Work closely with developers, designers, QA, marketing, and leadership teams.
Drive alignment between business needs, user expectations, and technical feasibility.
Ensure smooth communication between stakeholders and development teams.
5. Data-Driven Decision Making & Continuous Improvement
Analyze customer engagement, conversion rates, and usability metrics.
Use A/B testing and iterative design to improve product experience.
Implement feedback loops to refine product strategy and UX.
Required Skills & Qualifications
5+ years in product management, UX/UI design, and project management (SaaS experience preferred).
Expertise in Agile & Waterfall methodologies, including writing Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
Strong understanding of UX principles, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Figma, Adobe XD, or similar tools.
Experience launching SaaS products and conducting market research & positioning.
Ability to bridge the gap between business strategy, user needs, and technical development.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Analytical mindset with data-driven decision-making.
Nice-to-Have (Preferred Skills)
Experience with AI-driven UX/UI personalization.
Previous work in B2B SaaS or communication platforms.
Knowledge of customer journey mapping & behavioral analytics.
CcaaS/Contact Center experience a plus
Salary: $80,000 to $120,000

jobs.title: Director, Product Ownership – Commercial Products & Platforms
jobs.text:
Position Overview
Director, Product Ownership – Commercial Products & Platforms will be responsible for the product vision, roadmap, governance, backlog management, and stakeholder engagement model for Conduent's portfolio of Shared Commercial Products.
The role will act as the primary technology Product Owner for shared Commercial platforms and serve as the strategic partner to Commercial General Managers, Business Product Managers, Technology General Managers, Client Technology Managers (CITMs), Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and AI teams. In addition to direct product ownership responsibilities, this will be a people leadership role responsible for managing Product Owners supporting Commercial-wide platforms and ensuring product investments align with business priorities and technology strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Product Ownership & Strategy
Define and manage product vision, roadmap, release strategy, and long-term plans.
Establish success metrics and business outcomes.
Prioritize investments balancing customer needs, modernization, AI opportunities, operational requirements, and technical debt.
Drive adoption, innovation, and continuous improvement across the product portfolio.
Governance & Business Engagement
Establish governance councils and recurring business engagement forums.
Create a structured intake and prioritization process.
Facilitate decision-making and roadmap alignment across stakeholders.
Ensure visibility into priorities and delivery commitments.
Product Delivery & Technology Partnership
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, AI, and Operations teams.
Own backlog prioritization, release planning, and roadmap execution.
Translate business objectives into actionable product requirements.
Monitor delivery progress and business value realization.
Modernization & AI
Drive AI, automation, analytics, and modernization initiatives.
Promote reusable technology assets and shared platform capabilities.
Support strategic client pursuits, demonstrations, solutioning activities, and innovation workshops.
Advance Commercial transformation objectives through product-led innovation.
Required Experience
10+ years of experience in product ownership, technology strategy, backlog management or digital transformation, including experience leading the development of AI-enabled and cloud-first technologies.
Proven experience owning enterprise product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and delivery.
Experience translating business needs into scalable technology solutions and measurable outcomes.
Strong cross-functional experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and business teams.
Strong business acumen, executive communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in complex, matrixed organizations.
Preferred Experience
Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure-based technology environments.
Experience supporting client solutioning, demonstrations, strategic pursuits, or innovation workshops.
Experience developing reusable platforms or shared technology capabilities.
Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 plus applicable incentive compensation.

jobs.title: Partner – Head of Data Protection team – Senior Data Protection Solicitor
jobs.text:
Harper James is a growing, ambitious commercial law firm like no other. We are growing our commercial team and have exciting opportunity for an experienced data protection solicitor to lead and grow our data protection team.
This is an opportunity to combine specialist legal advice with people leadership and service development. You’ll help shape how we support clients, develop our team and build practical, scalable services for growing businesses.
About Harper James
Harper James is a modern, ambitious commercial law firm built to support entrepreneurial businesses with accessible, high-quality legal services. We combine legal expertise with a commercial mindset and an operating model designed for growth.
You’ll work with businesses of different sizes across a range of sectors, alongside colleagues in our commercial, technology, corporate and employment teams.
The opportunity
You’ll lead the development of our data protection practice, combining hands-on client work with responsibility for the team and its services.
Key responsibilities
Leading, supporting and developing colleagues, with clear expectations and constructive feedback
Helping grow the team as client demand and the service develop
Managing workloads and maintaining consistent, high-quality advice
Building client relationships and identifying opportunities to grow the practice
Leading on the development of DPO as a service, data protection health checks, shaping clear service scopes, pricing and delivery approaches
Standardising suitable processes, templates and guidance to improve consistency and efficiency
Using legal technology and automation responsibly, while maintaining appropriate oversight
Sharing knowledge and working across teams to give clients joined-up advice
You’ll have the opportunity to influence both what we offer and how we deliver it, making data protection support easier for clients to access and helping colleagues work effectively.
What we’re looking for
We are looking for an experienced senior data protection solicitor with 10+ years’ PQE and substantial experience advising businesses on UK and European data protection law.
You’ll also bring:
Experience managing and developing people, including supporting performance and having constructive conversations
A track record of leading matters and managing client relationships
A commercial approach to developing services and recognising client needs
Experience improving delivery through consistent processes, knowledge sharing or technology
Strong drafting and negotiation skills
The ability to turn complex legal and technical issues into clear, practical guidance
Your technical experience will include:
UK data protection compliance, governance and risk
Data subject rights requests and data protection impact assessments (DPIAs)
International data transfers, ePrivacy, cookies and direct marketing
Data processing and data-sharing agreements
Artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technology issues
Data breach response, incident management and engagement with regulators
The EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and wider international privacy developments
Special category and other sensitive data across different sectors
Data protection advice on technology, commercial, corporate and employment matters
You’ll be comfortable working with growing and innovative businesses. You’ll understand when clients need specialist advice and when a proportionate, repeatable service can meet their needs.
You’ll be confident using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint to organise work and collaborate. You’ll also be open to using AI tools and automation where they genuinely improve delivery.
Remote working
We offer fully remote working, with access to meeting space in Birmingham, Cambridge, London, Manchester, Oxford, Southampton, Cardiff and Sheffield.
Our remote set-up gives you flexibility over where you work, while keeping you connected to colleagues. We collaborate on client matters and internal projects, share ideas and make time to get to know each other.
You’ll help create that sense of connection within the data protection team, so colleagues feel trusted, supported and clear about their responsibilities.
What we offer
This is an opportunity to lead a specialist team and shape a growing service, while continuing to do varied, commercially focused legal work.
We offer:
A collaborative working environment where there’s no room for office politics
Competitive salary
33 days’ holiday, including public holidays, with the option to buy up to five additional days each year
Private healthcare
Death in service benefit
Access to our electric car scheme
Flexible working as part of a fully remote but connected team
No agencies, please

jobs.title: Vice President - Engineering
jobs.text:
R3 Lithium operates North America's first commercial-scale lithium carbonate recovery facility, located in Covington, Georgia. Using a lithium-first extraction process, the company recovers, refines, and returns lithium carbonate from recycled black mass into the battery supply chain for energy storage systems, defense applications, and electric vehicles. Founded in 2026 and privately held, R3 Lithium is headquartered at 9176 Industrial Drive NE, Covington, Georgia. For more information, visit
Position Overview:
The Vice President of Engineering is responsible for key value creation activities in the company. The candidate will have an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the future success of the company by providing outstanding managerial and technical leadership.
As the Vice President of Engineering, you will play a critical role in leading our engineering efforts, overseeing the design, development, and construction of our plants. You will ensure that our engineered materials meet the highest standards of quality and performance while driving strategic initiatives to facilitate our capacity expansion in North America. This role requires a leader with experience in materials and/or chemical engineering, has worked closely with R&D, with project management, with production management, and is a great cross-functional collaborator. This position will report directly to the CEO.
Key Responsibilities:
The Engineering VP will plan and direct all aspects of engineering activities and projects within the organization. The job entails establishing new policies and procedures, as well as ensuring all engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are in conformity with the organization and industry established policies and objectives.
The Engineering VP will utilize best practice engineering methods to provide expert technical guidance for engineering initiatives. The Engineering VP will incorporate all functions related to testing, repair, and maintenance of all equipment to be used in the organization.
Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the company’s goals, particularly focusing on production plant construction.
Project Management: Oversee all engineering projects, ensuring timely completion, adherence to budgets, and alignment with quality standards. Implement best practices in project management and engineering processes.
Team Development: Build and lead a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement. Mentor engineers and provide professional development opportunities.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, operations, and supply chain, to ensure alignment on project objectives and resource allocation.
Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance in the development of engineered materials, ensuring they meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in battery materials. Develop appropriate engineering standards, the company’s bill of process and bill of design.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations, particularly as we expand internationally.
Budget Management: Develop and manage the engineering budget, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and performance.
Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, investors, and regulatory bodies, to represent the engineering perspective and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or professional engineering, a plus.
20+ years of experience in engineering management, with a focus on battery materials or related industries a plus.
Big company and small company experience, a plus.
Experience translating science level R&D ideas to engineering design packages.
Proven track record of leading large-scale engineering projects, particularly in the construction of manufacturing facilities or mega plants.
Strong knowledge of materials development and testing processes, particularly in the context of battery technologies.
New product introduction experience, a plus
Product certification experience, a plus

jobs.title: Director - Product Management
jobs.text:
Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence
EarthDaily | U.S. Remote | Washington Metropolitan Area preferred | Full-Time
Reports to: VP Product
About EarthDaily
EarthDaily is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company delivering daily, scientifically calibrated, AI-
ready imagery of the planet through the EarthDaily Constellation. Capturing 22 spectral bands across nearly
all of Earth's landmass and maritime regions at the same time every day, EarthDaily powers broad-area
change detection, advanced analytics, and mission applications for governments and industries worldwide.
About the Role
The Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence, is the senior product leader responsible for
defining and driving EarthDaily's product strategy for defense and intelligence markets. The Director will
identify high-value mission problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable products that combine
EarthDaily's Earth observation data, analytics, AI/ML, contextual data, and workflow capabilities. This role is
highly outward-facing and will spend substantial time with government users, commercial customers,
acquisition stakeholders, Sales & Business Development, and industry partners to understand the market and
translate those insights into clear product priorities and requirements.
The role is part of EarthDaily's Analytics Product organization and works in close partnership with EarthDaily
Federal, Analytics line of business, and Engineering to develop defense and intelligence products for U.S.
Government and international defense agencies and customers. The Director owns the product problem,
customer outcome, product strategy, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, packaging, and commercial
product case. EarthDaily Federal and EarthDaily Analytics market teams along with Sales lead customer
relationships, capture, opportunity strategy, contracting, and revenue execution, while Engineering owns
technical design, delivery planning, sprint management, and implementation. The Director is expected to
move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, develop evidence-driven roadmaps that drive
revenue, stay close to customers and technical teams, and maintain a high level of responsiveness and
accountability.
Minimum Requirements
Location preferred: Washington Metropolitan Area (WMA).
• Senior or Director-level product management experience with demonstrated ownership of product
strategy, discovery, prioritization, and commercialization.
• Must be a U.S. Citizen.
• Must hold a minimum active Secret clearance; active TS/SCI strongly preferred.
• Must have strong knowledge of U.S. Government mission needs, budgets, spending cycles, acquisition
pathways, and commercial GEOINT/EO adoption, with experience in one or more of imagery, geospatial
analytics, AI/ML, or mission workflow solutions.
• Must be able to engage credibly with mission users, program offices, acquisition stakeholders, senior
government leaders, and technical teams and translate among those audiences.
What You'll Own
Defense product strategy: Set and continuously refine the product strategy, roadmap, and investment
priorities for EarthDaily's defense and intelligence portfolio, including Earth observation data, analytics,
AI/ML, contextual data, workflow solutions, and mission applications.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 2
Market and customer discovery: Maintain a continuous external discovery process with U.S. Government
users, buyers, mission owners, partners, and influencers to understand unmet needs, mission priorities,
buying behavior, competitive alternatives, and emerging demand.
• Mission-to-product translation: Translate customer problems and operational workflows into clear
product requirements, desired outcomes, priorities, and success measures that technical teams can act
on.
Productization and reuse: Identify common requirements across customers, programs, and mission areas
and translate them into scalable products, reusable capabilities, and configurable workflows. Distinguish
between strategic product investments, reusable customer-driven capabilities, and one-off custom
development.
• Prioritization and tradeoffs: Make clear recommendations on what EarthDaily should build, improve,
package, partner for, or explicitly not pursue based on customer value, market size, differentiation,
revenue potential, strategic fit, and technical feasibility.
• Commercialization and revenue enablement: Convert recurring customer and mission needs into
differentiated, scalable offerings that can be repeatedly sold and delivered. Work with EarthDaily Federal,
Growth, and Business Development to understand funded demand, inform opportunity shaping and
capture, and create product proof points that support commercialization and revenue growth.
• Pricing and packaging: Develop and evolve pricing, packaging, licensing, and value propositions for defense
and intelligence offerings based on customer willingness to pay, budget structures, acquisition pathways,
competitive dynamics, and product economics.
• Product positioning and external materials: Drive the product substance behind customer-facing
materials, product briefs, demos, presentations, proposal content, use cases, and sales enablement.
Ensure external claims accurately reflect current and planned capability.
• Customer validation: Establish disciplined feedback and validation loops with government end users and
buyers. Validate the problem, value proposition, workflow fit, usability, and willingness to pay before and
after major product investments.
• Cross-functional product leadership: Establish a working operating rhythm with Engineering in which
Product provides customer context, clear priorities, requirements, and desired outcomes while technical
teams own architecture, delivery planning, sprint execution, and implementation. Work closely with
Market and Sales leadership so customer and capture needs inform product decisions without turning
individual opportunities into one-off product direction.
• Competitive and market intelligence: Track relevant commercial EO, GEOINT, analytics, AI/ML, workflow,
and data-fusion competitors and substitutes. Translate market movement into implications for
EarthDaily's differentiation and product choices.
• Executive product leadership: Communicate product strategy, customer evidence, investment choices,
risks, and performance to senior leadership. Surface decisions early and drive alignment across Product,
Engineering, Analytics, Growth, Programs, Partnerships, and EarthDaily Federal leadership.
• Product performance: Define and track outcome-oriented product metrics, including customer validation,
adoption, usage, time-to-value, product reuse across customers and programs, pipeline influence,
revenue contribution, and other measures appropriate to the product lifecycle.
Leadership Expectations
Operate with urgency. Move fast without creating unnecessary process or waiting for perfect information.
• Be highly responsive to customers and internal teams. Product Management is an accountable,
collaborative leadership function, not a process gatekeeper.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 3
Be proactive. Identify customer, market, product, and execution issues before they become leadership
escalations.
Own the outcome. Do not stop at documenting requirements; stay engaged through validation,
commercialization, and customer adoption.
• Lead through influence. Build alignment across teams with different priorities while maintaining clear
product accountability and decision-making.
• Use evidence, not volume. Bring customer data, market signals, economics, and mission impact into
prioritization discussions.
What You Bring
10+ years of product management, product strategy, or closely related product leadership experience,
with meaningful experience at the Senior Product Manager, Group Product Manager, Principal, or
Director level.
• Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive, analytics, geospatial, ISR, AI/ML, or workflow products
from discovery through commercialization and adoption.
• Strong knowledge of U.S. Government defense and intelligence mission environments, with the ability to
understand user and operator workflows as well as government buying behavior.
• Experience working directly with customers and users to conduct product discovery, validate problems,
test concepts, and translate findings into product decisions.
• Strong commercial judgment, including experience with pricing, packaging, market segmentation, product
positioning, and revenue-oriented product decisions.
• Ability to convert complex technical and mission concepts into concise, prioritized product requirements
and executive-level recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create customer-facing product content
and represent the product in external meetings.
• Comfort operating in a matrixed organization where Product owns the market solution, product strategy,
product priorities, requirements, and outcomes; Market leads market selection, capture and revenue
execution; and Engineering owns technical design and delivery execution.
Nice to Have
Direct experience with GEOINT, remote sensing, commercial Electro-Optical imagery, spectral data, SAR,
or multi-source geospatial analytics.
• Prior work with USG IC agencies, COCOMs, Military Services, NRO, NGA, or other civil, defense/intelligence
mission organizations.
• Prior work leading non-U.S. defense products (e.g., Canada, Europe, Australia).
• Understanding of federal acquisition, appropriations, PPBE/budget cycles, OTAs, CSOs, IDIQs, data buys,
software licensing, and other common pathways for commercial technology adoption.
• Experience with product-led capture, market shaping, or building customer advocacy for emerging
commercial capabilities.
• Prior military, IC, or federal service with firsthand exposure to analyst, operator, or mission workflows.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
LeapXpert: Innovating the Future of Business Communication
At LeapXpert, we’ve built the infrastructure that turns enterprise communication into intelligence enterprises can act on.
As the leader in Governed Communication Intelligence, our platform enables employees to connect with clients on the consumer messaging channels they actually use, governs and captures every conversation as enterprise data, and converts that data into deployable intelligence for teams, AI agents, and the business decisions that matter. Governance is the foundation. Intelligence is the value.
Our mission: enable enterprises to build a governed communication infrastructure that makes trust structural, intelligence compound, and every client relationship more productive. We recently announced a $180M growth investment and are recognized as a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving for the second consecutive year. Hundreds of the world’s most demanding enterprises trust LeapXpert to power their most important client conversations every day.
This is just the beginning. We’re growing fast and looking for sharp, driven people to help us define and build the Governed Communication Intelligence category. At LeapXpert, you’ll work on high-impact projects, collaborate with ambitious teams across the globe, and help shape a platform that is rewriting how enterprises communicate, govern, and compete.
Apply now.
Why join us
Innovative Culture: Work at the cutting edge of business communication technology, with a product that’s changing the way Fortune 500 companies communicate.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly impact how millions of professionals connect and collaborate worldwide.
Global Team: Be part of a diverse, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and growth.
Growth Opportunities: With our rapid expansion, there are plenty of opportunities for professional growth and development.
Award-Winning Product: Join a company with a track record of success and recognition, including accolades like being named a Gartner Cool Vendor.
About the role
Title: Director of Platform Engineering
Function: Engineering
Report to: Head of Engineering
Location: Singapore (Remote)
As the Director of Platform Engineering at LeapXpert, you will own the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of our cloud infrastructure powering a globally distributed SaaS platform. You will lead a globally distributed team across APAC, EMEA, and US time zones, spanning DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Database Operations, and Incident Management.
You will drive operational excellence through modern practices including GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, and Policy as Code. Security and reliability are foundational to this role - you will embed security-first thinking into every layer of our infrastructure while building systems designed for resilience and high availability. This role requires a hands-on leader with an unwavering commitment to engineering excellence, who can balance strategic vision with deep technical expertise in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
This position is ideal for someone with proven experience operating large-scale cloud infrastructure for SaaS products and a passion for building high-performing platform teams.
What you’ll do
Infrastructure Strategy & Operations
Define and execute the platform engineering strategy across cloud infrastructure, ensuring alignment with business objectives and compliance requirements.
Oversee cloud infrastructure operations across a multi-cloud environment (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Lead infrastructure evolution initiatives to improve availability, reduce costs, and enhance platform scalability.
Drive infrastructure cost optimization through continuous analysis, rightsizing, and efficient resource utilization.
Engineering Practices & Tooling
Champion modern engineering practices including GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and Policy as Code across the organization.
Oversee Kubernetes platform operations, ensuring robust container orchestration and deployment pipelines.
Lead DevOps initiatives encompassing CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and engineering tooling.
Implement and maintain observability frameworks to ensure comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting.
Reliability & Incident Management
Establish and lead incident management processes, serving as a key coordination point between product development, security, and operations teams.
Drive resilience testing and chaos engineering practices to proactively identify and address system vulnerabilities.
Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets to maintain platform reliability and inform engineering priorities.
Lead post-incident reviews and ensure continuous improvement through actionable follow-ups.
Change Management & Release Coordination
Implement rigorous change management processes to minimize risk and ensure stable production environments.
Partner with product development teams to plan and coordinate rollouts, balancing velocity with reliability.
Establish and maintain release management standards and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, feature flags).
Team Leadership & Vendor Management
Lead and mentor a globally distributed team across DevOps, SRE, Database Operations, and Incident Management functions.
Manage relationships with cloud providers and service vendors, including coordination of incident reviews and service quality meetings.
Build a culture of operational excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing across time zones.
Compliance & Security Collaboration
Ensure infrastructure operations maintain compliance with SOC2 and ISO 27001 standards.
Support FedRAMP readiness initiatives in collaboration with security and compliance teams.
Partner with the security organization to implement infrastructure security controls and audit requirements.
Required Skills and Qualifications
15+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership position within a SaaS or high-growth technology environment.
Proven experience operating and optimizing cloud infrastructure at scale, with hands-on expertise managing cloud spend exceeding $1M annually.
Strong technical expertise in multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps workflows, and Policy as Code frameworks.
Demonstrated success leading infrastructure migrations, platform modernization, and large-scale technical projects.
Proven track record driving incident management programs, including on-call processes, escalation procedures, and post-incident reviews.
Strong experience implementing and managing change management processes in production SaaS environments.
Excellent communication skills with demonstrated ability to lead globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001) and their infrastructure implications.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
Hands-on experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing methodologies (e.g., Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, Litmus).
Experience supporting FedRAMP authorization or operating in regulated environments.
Strong attention to detail with a systematic approach to operational processes and documentation.
Experience with observability platforms and SRE practices (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets).
Cloud certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, CKA/CKAD).
Background in vendor management and contract negotiations with cloud providers and service partners.
Experience scaling platform teams in high-growth environments.
Our Values
Curiosity: We’re curious and future-focused.
One Team: We’re one team, in many colors.
Customer–Driven: We’re obsessed with the customer.
Integrity: We don’t compromise on the integrity.
Excellence: We exemplify excellence.
What you’ll get
Competitive compensation package
Remote-friendly work culture
Regional benefits (country-specific medical, wellness support)
Global exposure with a fast-growing international tech company
A team that values impact, transparency, and growth
Apply now to secure the future of communication with LeapXpert!
LeapXpert values diversity and inclusion as critical components of our culture and success. We believe a diverse team with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives fosters creativity, innovation, and mutual respect. We are committed to creating a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, or ability. We actively seek to recruit and retain talent from diverse communities and encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Please submit your resume for consideration.

jobs.title: Director, Product Operations
jobs.text:
The Director, Product Operations builds and runs the operating system for Lone Wolf's Product organization — the process, tooling, data, and communication that enable our Product leaders to focus on customer experiences and outcomes. This role reports to the SVP, Product & Strategy and partners with the leaders of our product lines, Engineering, Product Marketing, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success.
This is a hands-on leadership role: the Director will do the work from day one and build the function over time. They will modernize how Product works — including leading AI adoption across the team — and become the company's trusted source of product data and insight.
Role and Responsibilities:
The Director owns Product's portion of the software development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through launch readiness, and partners with Engineering to keep handoffs, capacity, and delivery visible. They run the cadence behind planning and our monthly Product Line Reviews, own the product team's tools and analytics, and make sure product signals flow cleanly between Product and the rest of the business.
What you will own:
Define and improve Product's part of the SDLC — discovery, PRDs, prioritization, and acceptance — and partner with Engineering on clean handoffs, shared definitions, and visibility into capacity and delivery.
Lead internal AI adoption across the Product team, rolling out AI-enabled workflows for research, requirements, analysis, and reporting, and measuring the productivity gains.
Facilitate the Product operating rhythm, including planning cycles, goals, and the data and materials behind monthly Product Line Reviews.
Partner with Product Marketing on go-to-market readiness — launch plans, release notes, and roadmap communication — so Sales and Customer Success are never surprised.
Partner with Operations to give the Enablement team the product knowledge, release information, and content the field needs.
Partner with all customer-facing teams to make sure feedback from customers, support, sales calls, and Deal Desk reaches the right Product leaders and informs prioritization.
Own product analytics — usage, adoption, retention, and product health — and deliver analysis and reporting on our products for other departments.
Own the Product tool stack, data hygiene, and playbook, automating manual reporting and keeping PMs across product lines working consistently.
Requirements:
8+ years in product operations, product management, technical program management, or product-focused consulting in B2B SaaS, including 3+ years at a senior or director level.
Experience building or rebuilding a product operations function in a growing SaaS business — and examples of what you built.
Fluency with AI tools and the ability to design, instrument, and improve workflows that use them.
Strong data skills: defining SaaS product metrics, building dashboards, and turning analysis into recommendations.
Experience with tools like Jira, Lovable, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gainsight, Salesforce, and Gong.
Vertical SaaS, PE-backed, or multi-product portfolio experience is a plus.
