jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Product — Transact is the business owner of Lone Wolf's Transact product line. Transact is our most-used product line and the transaction management platform agents, brokers, REALTOR® associations, and Multiple Listing Services rely on to get deals to the closing table. This role reports to the SVP, Product & Strategy and leads a team of Product Managers across the Transact modules.
This is a business-ownership role, not a feature-management role. Operating as the “Product CEO” for the line, the Senior Director owns the strategy, commercial results, and customer experience of the business, while driving the innovation required to remain the leader in an AI-enabled world.
The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Role and Responsibilities:
The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
What you will own:
Own the Transact P&L — revenue, bookings, retention, and margin — and report on it through a disciplined, no-surprises monthly Product Line Review.
Define and defend an outcome-based strategy and roadmap tied to Lone Wolf's financial goals, including clarity on what not to build.
Embed AI across the transaction workflow — replacing manual steps with conversational automation and digital workers that customers adopt.
Partner with peer Product leaders so handoffs between Transact and our other product lines are seamless and invisible to the customer.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of Product Managers who act as owners and innovators, not order-takers.
Maintain a real-time view of competitors and win/loss dynamics, and equip Sales and Marketing with field-ready battle cards and positioning.
Own key customer and partner relationships, turning feedback into prioritized action that protects and grows the base.
Requirments:
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of Product Managers in B2B or vertical SaaS.
Proven ownership of a product line's commercial results — P&L, bookings, or retention — with strong financial fluency.
Real estate technology, transaction management, or document and workflow software experience strongly preferred.
A track record of consolidating or modernizing products and migrating customers off legacy platforms while protecting retention.
Hands-on experience bringing AI and automation into production workflows with measurable adoption.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a single strategy.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering
jobs.text:
About PSD Citywide
Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?
PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.
Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged.
Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!
Job Description
Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and making a difference. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a VP, Engineering to fill an existing vacancy and join our IT Department in a fully remote role (though occasional travel will be required) based in Canada. If you’re passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping businesses maximize their potential, we want you to be a part of our team!
PSD Citywide is seeking a VP, Engineering to lead the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of our integrated SaaS platform serving municipalities and public sector organizations across North America.
Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the VP, Engineering, will translate the Company's technology and product strategy into effective engineering execution. The role leads Software Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA) / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, with day-to-day accountability for engineering operations, software delivery, technical standards, quality, infrastructure, talent, and continuous improvement.
The VP, Engineering will oversee the development, delivery, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based software solutions, including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Maintenance, GIS, Budgeting, and Permitting. The role will evolve the engineering operating model as the company scales, with particular focus on AI-enabled software development, quality engineering, automation, organizational effectiveness, and increasing the speed and reliability with which customer value is delivered.
What We Offer
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognize your skills and experience.
Wellness Coverage: Enjoy a comprehensive health and wellness benefits package that keeps you and your family secure and healthy.
Flexible Working: Work where you thrive! Enjoy remote work flexibility (specific regional options apply) while staying connected to our supportive team.
Work-Life Balance: Benefit from Flex Hours to manage your personal life and Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can fully recharge.
Unwind Early: Say hello to summer with our popular Summer Fridays—shorter work weeks to help you kick-start the weekend.
Culture & Community: Participate in fun social events (both virtual and in-person) and contribute to charity initiatives as part of our community focus.
Career Growth: Our Career Framework provides clear, structured paths for growth and ongoing learning, ensuring you reach your professional goals.
Job Duties & Responsibilities
Lead Software Engineering, QA / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, building a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative organization.
Oversee the design, development, enhancement, maintenance, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based SaaS platform.
Partner with the CTO, Product Management, Business Analysis, and business leaders to prioritize engineering initiatives, translate product and business priorities into executable engineering plans, and maintain clear accountability between product ownership and engineering delivery.
Develop and lead the Company's AI-enabled engineering strategy, taking direct ownership of the evaluation, adoption, governance, and effective use of AI tools and practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across software development, QA / Quality Engineering, and technical operations where appropriate, including design, coding, code review, documentation, debugging, testing, release processes, systems administration, monitoring, and operational workflows.
Establish, monitor, and communicate meaningful engineering performance metrics, including delivery predictability, development cycle time, team capacity, release frequency, software quality and escaped defects, test automation, platform reliability, operational performance, budget effectiveness, and measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering practices.
Lead the modernization of software quality practices, including increased test automation, AI-assisted test development, improved regression testing, CI/CD practices, release quality controls, and greater engineering ownership of software quality.
Lead the engineering technology strategy and architectural direction of PSD Citywide's SaaS platform, ensuring architecture, technical debt, scalability, performance, maintainability, and modernization support long-term product and business objectives.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and operating rhythms across Engineering teams and technical leaders, including delivery commitments, capacity planning, technical quality, risk identification, performance measurement, and timely escalation of issues affecting product commitments or customer outcomes.
Provide leadership and oversight for systems administration and infrastructure operations, including cloud environments, deployment infrastructure, platform reliability, monitoring, backup and recovery, operational resiliency, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product, Support, Advisory Services, Implementation, and other business functions to manage the upstream and downstream impacts of increased engineering capacity, automation, and delivery velocity and ensure engineering improvements translate into customer and business outcomes.
Develop and manage departmental budgets, financial plans, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, software licensing, and technology investments to ensure responsible financial stewardship and cost effectiveness.
Support business case development, effort estimation, and resource planning to ensure technology initiatives are appropriately scoped, prioritized, and budgeted.
Continuously evaluate and evolve the structure, skills, roles, leadership capacity, and operating model of the Engineering organization as the company scales and technology practices change; lead workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, recruitment, and performance management.
Ensure security, compliance, resiliency, and risk management are incorporated into engineering operations and software development practices, and establish appropriate AI governance covering customer data protection, source code confidentiality, intellectual property, vendor risk, responsible use, and cost management.
Other duties as required.
Qualifications
10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology operations, or software delivery leadership, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, technical leads, or multidisciplinary software development teams.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling a multidisciplinary engineering organization of comparable size and complexity, including developing technical leaders, establishing effective management structures, and evolving processes as the organization grows.
Demonstrated experience successfully leading an engineering organization through the adoption of AI-enabled software development practices, with direct leadership involvement in strategy, implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.
Demonstrated ability to measure and communicate the impact of AI-enabled engineering practices, including improvements in developer productivity, development cycle time, product delivery velocity, software quality, testing efficiency, release frequency, or organizational capacity.
Strong working knowledge and practical experience with contemporary AI-assisted software engineering tools and techniques, including the ability to evaluate their capabilities, limitations, security implications, and appropriate use across development and quality engineering workflows.
Demonstrated experience leading or overseeing QA / Quality Engineering functions, including test automation, regression testing, release quality, and integration of quality practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Experience managing significant departmental budgets, financial planning, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, and technology investments.
Experience operating in a private-equity-backed or similarly metrics-driven environment, including supporting executive and Board-level reporting, performance reviews, and presentations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
Strong understanding of SaaS application development, cloud platforms, software architecture, APIs, and modern software delivery practices.
Experience leading the modernization and evolution of established SaaS platforms, including managing technical debt, architectural improvement, scalability, maintainability, and modernization alongside ongoing customer and product delivery commitments.
Demonstrated experience establishing and continuously improving modern software delivery practices, including iterative planning, capacity management, CI/CD, release management, engineering metrics, and appropriate use of Agile or Lean methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to balance technical priorities with business objectives, budget considerations, and customer requirements.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing, accountable engineering organizations, including developing managers and technical leaders, coaching and performance management, succession planning, talent development, and attracting and retaining strong technical talent.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues, risks, investment decisions, and trade-offs into clear business terms for executive, Board, and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience successfully leading distributed or remote technical teams, including maintaining strong communication, accountability, collaboration, and team culture across locations.
Experience in GovTech, municipal technology, enterprise SaaS, asset management, ERP, or public sector software is considered an asset.
What Success Looks Like
A high-performing, accountable Engineering organization with strong technical and people leadership.
Improved delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, and release efficiency.
Material progress in test automation and modern QA / Quality Engineering practices.
Measurable, responsible adoption of AI that improves engineering productivity, product velocity, quality, and organizational capacity.
An engineering operating model, leadership structure, and skill base capable of supporting PSD Citywide's continued growth.
The Candidate Journey
Resume Review: Once you apply, an actual person will review your resume and we are committed to getting back to you with a response.
Phone Interview: PSD’s People and Culture team will connect with you to learn about your experience and discuss the role further. They’ll also give you an understanding of what the interview process involves, along with an estimated timeline.
Virtual Interview: Depending on the position, there will be one or two interviews with the Hiring Team that will include questions related to your skills, work experience, values and goals. We provide the opportunity to meet with a wide range of staff members so you can learn more about life at PSD Citywide.
Offer/Feedback: The Hiring Team will debrief and make a decision within a few days of your final interview. If successful, your Recruiter will present you with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter via email. If the timing was not right for this particular opportunity, we will connect with you and provide feedback.
PSD Citywide is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility.
We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
PSD Citywide may use Google Gemini to assist with recruitment note taking during the hiring process. While we incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. All AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.
We're looking for a VP of Engineering to lead and scale Oddball's engineering practice across our federal digital modernization portfolio — someone who brings proven practices from commercial and product-focused organizations and knows how to adapt them to the realities of federal delivery.
What you'll be doing:
Set and drive technical standards, best practices, and engineering consistency across 100+ engineers spanning multiple federal programs — including how teams adopt and build with agentic AI tools
Own engineering talent decisions — identifying and promoting top performers, developing those with growth potential, and maintaining a high bar across the organization
Partner with Program Managers, Tech Leads and VPs to ensure programs are delivering high-quality, technically sound solutions
Roll up your sleeves when it matters — dig into architecture, solve a hard technical problem, or prototype an idea to move it forward
Build and own the engineering career ladder — defining skill levels, growth paths, mentorship structures, certifications, continuing education and promotion criteria
Coach and support Tech Leads in both technical and managerial dimensions
Drive technical strategy across the portfolio, identifying opportunities to improve performance, tooling, and delivery
Stay current on emerging technology including AI/ML, cloud platform engineering, and developer productivity — and turn it into practical advantages for our clients
Contribute to growth and capture efforts — solutioning, proposal reviews, and technical viability assessments
Provide thought leadership internally and externally, representing Oddball's engineering capabilities to clients and at industry events
What you’ll bring:
Deep experience leading engineering organizations with meaningful time in a federal contracting environment
Commercial, product, or industry experience outside government is strongly preferred — and a clear sense of how to bring those lessons into federal delivery
Hands-on technical credibility — you spend most of your time guiding and enabling, but you can still go deep when the situation calls for it
Track record of building technical culture, career development programs, and high-performing engineering teams
Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevSecOps, and cloud modernization in federal contexts
A collaborative leadership style — you build alignment and empower teams rather than dictate a single way of working
Experience building partnerships and driving technical change with government clients
Exceptional communication skills — you can translate complex technical concepts for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
Requirements:
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. In alignment with federal contract requirements, certain roles may also require U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and a security clearance.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree
Benefits:
Fully remote
Annual stipend
Comprehensive Benefits Package
Company Match 401(k) plan
Flexible PTO, Paid Holidays
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities:

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)

jobs.title: Director, Data & Standards
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.
Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.
Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.
At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.
If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!
Position Overview
The Director, Data & Standards leads API’s data analyst team and owns the standards, governance, and quality practices that make our data trustworthy and usable across the organization. The role also carries forward key parts of API’s AI Enablement program: running AI experiments and pilots, driving adoption of enterprise AI tools, and using AI to improve how the data team works and the insights it delivers. You will balance hands-on AI and analytics work with leadership of the team, setting direction, developing people, and raising the bar on how API defines, measures, and uses data. This is a remote position.
What You’ll Do
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Team leadership and analytics oversight
Lead, coach, and develop a team of data analysts, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, and career growth.
Set priorities and manage the team’s workload across Engineering, Client Delivery, and Corporate stakeholders.
Review analyst work for accuracy, clarity, and business relevance, and ensure reporting and analysis are timely and decision-ready.
Build a culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning, including AI fluency across the team.
Data standards and governance
Define and maintain enterprise data standards, including metric definitions, naming conventions, documentation, and a shared data dictionary.
Establish data quality monitoring, validation processes, and issue-resolution workflows, and drive remediation with data owners.
Partner with IT, Engineering, and Security on data access, lifecycle management, and compliance requirements.
Serve as the authority on “one version of the truth” for key operational and commercial metrics.
AI experimentation and pilots
Run intake, hypothesis design, metric definition, and outcome documentation for data and AI experiments across the organization.
Lead go/no-go reviews and graduation-to-production decisions for AI pilots, owning validation evidence, vendor coordination, and integration readiness.
Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy and reliability, and set quality standards for AI-generated analysis.
AI adoption and enablement
Partner to drive training, communications, and enablement for Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot, moving seat utilization from license to behavior.
Produce the monthly AI scorecard: experiments launched, seats utilized, automation rates, FTE-equivalent savings, and experiments graduated.
Co-lead AI Sandbox operations with Engineering, including use-case intake, prioritization, and graduation criteria.
Work with IT and internal stakeholders to identify gaps, surface high-value use cases, and improve return on AI spend.
Vendor and budget management
Manage relationships with data and AI tooling vendors and track spend against the approved plan, flagging variances.
What You'll Bring
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, or a related field.
Working personal fluency with Claude (mandatory) and other enterprise AI tooling (Microsoft Copilot or equivalent), with demonstrated ability to design and document hypothesis-driven experiments.
Experience defining data standards, metrics, or governance practices in a cross-functional environment.
Strong SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce executive- and board-quality materials.
Comfort operating in ambiguity within a small, fast-moving team.
Preferred Qualifications
Technical background in computer science, engineering, data, or comparable hands-on experience with software, automation, or AI systems.
Experience with data warehousing, data modeling, and data quality tooling.
Exposure to voice AI, document automation, or contact-center modernization.
Prior experience in a PE-portfolio company or other high-growth, lean environment.
Experience in travel, transportation, or logistics.
Education
Bachelor’s degree required. Technical or quantitative field (computer science, engineering, economics, mathematics, data science) preferred. Advanced degree welcome but not required.
Compensation
The good faith compensation is $120,000 - $140,000, USD.
Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.
Other Duties
Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.
The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).
Work Environment
This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
AAP/EEO Statement
Accommodations Plus International is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, arrest record, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.
Privacy Statement
API may use the contact information you provide to communicate about this role, including via text message. See our [Privacy Policy] for details. By clicking "Apply" you agree to Rippling's Terms of Service/User Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Senior Engineering Director
College Board– Technology
Location:This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have theoptionof being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employeesare required tooccasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.
Type: This is a full-time position
AboutTechnologyat College Board
We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year,operatingatsignificantscale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways:blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery,operatingas an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.
About the Team
TheCore Assessment Platformis a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving shared platform capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions at scale. The work spans a range of assessment contexts, from routine evaluation to more complex, high-stakes environments, where accuracy, consistency, and trust are essential. Teams collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and operations to build reliable capabilities that can be reused and adapted over time.What makes this group special is its focus oncontinuous learning, experimentation, and steady improvement, with success driven by thoughtful collaboration, iteration, and careful decision-making in environments where reliability and quality matter.
About the Opportunity
As the Senior Engineering Director, you will provide senior organizational and technical leadership within the Core Assessment Platforms group, with responsibility for multiple teams led by experienced engineering managers. This roleoperatesat the platform level, shaping multi-team roadmaps and aligning execution across highly interconnected systems. Working closely with peer directors, principal and staff engineers, and cross-functional partners, the Senior Engineering Director ensures teams deliver meaningful progress while keeping long-term platform goals front and center. The role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to guide complex decisions across teams with competing needs.You’llhelpidentifyand prioritize near-term improvements that unlock momentum or reduce risk, while ensuring those wins reinforce longer-term architectural and strategicobjectives. Success is measured by the coherence of the platform over time, the strength of collaboration across teams, and the durability of both the technical foundations and the leadership bench you help build.
In this role, you will:
Provide Technical Leadership to the Team(45%)
Provide senior technical leadership for a defined area of the Core Assessment Platforms, ensuring alignment across multiple highly interconnected systems.
GuideEngineeringManagers, Principal and Staff Engineers in evaluating solution options, making architectural tradeoffs, and managing technical risk and debt across teams.
Identifyand prioritize near-term technical improvements that unlock momentum or reduce risk, while reinforcing longer-term platform strategy and architectural coherence.
Establish and uphold shared engineering standards for system design, reliability, security, and operational excellence within your platform area.
Serve as an escalation point for complex, cross-team technicaldecisionsand platform-level risks, applying strong technical judgment.
Stay informed on relevant technologies and platform practices, using that insight to guide platform evolution.
Build ahighly engaged,and high-performing team(30%)
Lead multiple engineering teams through experienced Engineering Managers, building consistent leadership practices and strong collaboration across teams.
Partner with Engineering Managers to ensure teams are appropriately staffed, aligned, and able to deliver sustainably.
Foster a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement across interdependent teams.
Actively support diversity, equity, and inclusion through hiring, talent development, and inclusive leadership practices.
Mentor Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, helping build a durable leadership bench and clear growth paths.
Interface with business partners and technology colleagues(25%)
Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, and peer Technology leaders to shape and align multi-team roadmaps.
Develop a strong understanding ofassessmentbusiness needs and platform consumers to inform technical priorities and sequencing.
Balance competing demands across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating tradeoffs whilemaintainingplatform cohesion.
Communicate complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations effectively to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
Ensure delivery progress across teams is coordinated, visible, and aligned with both near-term outcomes and long-term platform health.

jobs.title: Vice President of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.
Magna Legal Services is seeking a Vice President of Software Engineering to lead the teams responsible for building, operating, and evolving the software platforms that support our legal-services businesses. This leader will oversee software engineering people, processes, and execution across Magna's full suite of product offerings, shared platform capabilities, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.
Reporting directly to Magna's Chief Technology Officer, the Vice President of Software Engineering will translate business and product priorities into disciplined engineering plans, strengthen delivery and operational performance, and build an organization capable of scaling across multiple products and lines of business. Direct reports will include engineering managers, QA, DevOps/SRE, and architecture leads. The role will partner closely with the CTO, Product, Marketing, Operations, and go-to-market leaders.
This is a hands-on executive leadership role for someone who can operate at both the organizational and technical levels, deeply engaged in design reviews, technical tradeoffs, and incident resolution rather than day-to-day coding: developing leaders, improving delivery systems, guiding complex software initiatives, and ensuring that teams consistently produce secure, reliable, maintainable software. The CTO will continue to lead enterprise technical vision and architectural direction; the Vice President of Software Engineering will ensure that direction is translated into effective team structures, sound execution, and measurable results. This is a remote position within the United States.
This is a remote position within the United States. The Vice President of Software Engineering must be able to travel to Magna’s Philadelphia-area offices approximately 10% of the time. Travel may occasionally be scheduled on short notice or occur in consecutive weeks based on business needs. Candidates with convenient access to Philadelphia are preferred.
Primary Responsibilities
Engineering Leadership and Organization Development
Lead Magna's software engineering organization across multiple products and lines of business.
Develop and coach engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and individual contributors, establishing clear accountability and high performance at every level.
Assess and evolve organizational structure, team capacity, role clarity, and leadership coverage as the portfolio grows.
Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, career development, the engineering budget, and vendor and contractor relationships for software engineering.
Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and direct, respectful communication.
Balance durable product alignment with the ability to shift talent across shared components, high-priority initiatives, and changing business needs.
Delivery and Operational Excellence
Translate company, product, and business-line priorities into clear engineering roadmaps, staffing plans, and execution commitments.
Establish a consistent operating cadence for planning, prioritization, estimation, delivery, release management, and executive reporting.
Improve the predictability, speed, and transparency of software delivery while maintaining appropriate quality and risk controls.
Proactively identify dependencies, resource constraints, delivery risks, and organizational blockers, and drive them to resolution.
Define and monitor meaningful engineering measures related to delivery, quality, reliability, security, and team health.
Ensure teams own software throughout its lifecycle, from problem definition and design through deployment, monitoring, support, incident response, and ongoing improvement.
Software Quality and Technical Execution
Guide the pragmatic modernization of legacy applications while protecting business continuity and customer experience.
Lead the technical integration of acquired businesses and platforms into Magna's shared capabilities.
Raise standards for software design, code quality, automated testing, observability, documentation, maintainability, and production readiness.
Strengthen engineering practices across APIs, cloud services, distributed systems, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and secure software development.
Ensure software meets the security, privacy, and compliance obligations that come with handling protected health information, personal data, and privileged legal material, including [HIPAA, SOC 2, and client security audits – confirm].
Ensure teams make practical technology choices that fit the needs of each product while supporting appropriate reuse, interoperability, and shared platform capabilities.
Maintain enough technical depth to evaluate tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, support incident resolution, and earn credibility with senior engineers and architects.
Cross-Functional and Executive Partnership
Partner with Product and Design to create achievable roadmaps, clarify requirements, and balance customer value, technical health, and delivery capacity.
Work closely with business, operations, and go-to-market leaders to translate legal services workflows and client needs into scalable software capabilities.
Communicate plans, tradeoffs, risks, progress, and outcomes clearly to executive and nontechnical stakeholders.
Create effective feedback loops between engineering teams and the internal users, clients, and business stakeholders who depend on Magna's products.
AI-Enabled Engineering and Product Development
Advance the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, quality, documentation, testing, and knowledge sharing.
Partner with Product, the CTO, and technical leaders to evaluate and deliver practical AI and large-language-model capabilities within Magna's products and workflows, such as transcript summarization, deposition indexing, and medical record review.
Establish appropriate engineering discipline around AI-enabled features, including evaluation, security, privacy, reliability, human oversight, and ongoing monitoring.
Encourage thoughtful experimentation while ensuring AI investments remain connected to measurable customer and business outcomes.
What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months
A predictable planning and release cadence, with delivery commitments met and reported transparently to executive leadership.
A clear organizational design with strong leadership coverage across products and shared platforms.
Measurable progress on Recordtrak and Maggie without disruption to clients.
At least one AI-enabled capability in production with defined evaluation, monitoring, and human oversight.
Required Qualifications
12+ years of progressive software-engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multiple teams or product areas.
Demonstrated success building and leading high performing software engineering organizations, including managing managers.
Track record of delivering complex, business-critical software while improving execution discipline, quality, and predictability.
Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, distributed systems, CI/CD, observability, security, and production operations.
Experience modernizing legacy systems incrementally while continuing to meet active business and customer commitments.
Ability to lead effectively across a varied technology portfolio. Magna's core platforms are built primarily on Microsoft technologies (C#, .NET, Azure); working knowledge of this stack and of modern web, cloud, and data technologies is expected.
Strong organizational judgment, including the ability to make sound decisions about team design, capacity, prioritization, and technical investment.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical, operational, and commercial audiences.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with senior architects and principal-level technical experts while maintaining clear decision rights and accountability.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Preferred Qualifications
Experience delivering AI- or machine-learning-enabled products or meaningfully integrating AI into the software-development lifecycle.
Experience building software subject to HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar regulatory and client security requirements.
Experience in a multi-product, multi-business-line, professional service, legal services, private-equity-backed, or acquisition-oriented environment, including integrating acquired technology platforms and teams.
Leadership Profile
The successful candidate will be:
Business-minded: Connects engineering work to customer outcomes, operational needs, and company priorities.
Execution-oriented: Creates clarity, establishes accountability, and follows through on commitments.
Technically credible: Understands complex systems and tradeoffs without becoming a bottleneck or displacing technical owners.
People-centered: Develops leaders, creates healthy teams, and gives clear and actionable feedback.
Pragmatic: Balances modernization, speed, quality, and risk based on business context.
Collaborative: Works effectively across functions and business lines and communicates with candor and respect.
Adaptable: Leads confidently through changing priorities, evolving technologies, and organizational growth.
Magna Legal Services provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
About Us:
Pacvue is the leading Commerce Operating System, unifying retail media, commerce management, and advanced measurement across 100+ global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Instacart. Through Pacvue and Helium 10, our enterprise and SMB platforms, we empower over 70,000 brands, agencies, and sellers with AI-driven insights and technology to win in today’s rapidly evolving commerce landscape.
At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.
About the role:
We are seeking a Director of Product Management to drive execution across Helium 10’s product portfolio and to lead the product managers who deliver it. This role runs the discovery and delivery of our innovation agenda beyond the Amazon marketplace seller — into direct-to-consumer and multi-channel commerce, Walmart and TikTok, and AI-native experiences. This director will be responsible for turning agreed priorities into a sequenced, resourced roadmap and for making sure the team ships it on time and at quality.
Innovation is central to this role, and it is hands-on work. The Director of Product Management will run our new-product pipeline: validating, building, and launching the bets that open new revenue lines and new audiences. That means running structured discovery with sellers and brands, prototyping and testing quickly, defining what success looks like before we build, and retiring ideas that don’t earn their place. This leader will bring rigor to how we evaluate emerging opportunities — AI agents, autonomous workflows, and adjacent channels — and work with go-to-market teams to land them with customers.
Innovation into direct-to-consumer expansion is a core focus. As brands diversify across Shopify and their own storefronts, Google, and social commerce, our portfolio has to follow them. This director will lead the discovery, requirements, and delivery of the features that serve a DTC-first brand, and partner closely with product marketing, growth marketing, and sales to bring those products to market.
This is a hands-on, execution-first role. Sets strategy and direction for the function while also driving execution hands-on. You will run weekly operating cadences, review specs and requirements, unblock your team daily, and stay close enough to the detail to catch problems before they reach a release. The role is based in the United States and requires regular, direct contact with customers: discovery interviews, advisory sessions, and time in the field with brands and agencies. Deep familiarity with marketplace e-commerce, direct-to-consumer e-commerce, and SaaS product-led growth environments is strongly preferred.
This role reports to the VP of Product Strategy & Ops and manages the product management function globally, leading both the U.S. product management team and the China-based product management team. lteads the global product management function through a mixed structure — managing the U.S. product managers directly, and leading the China product management team through its manager. Sets direction and shared standards for both; delegates day-to-day execution oversight in China to that manager, while staying closely involved in the U.S. team's execution.Comfort leading and developing a team across time zones and cultures is essential.
Responsibilities:
Roadmap Development: Translate agreed priorities into a sequenced, multi-quarter roadmap and drive it to delivery. Run the planning process end to end, make explicit trade-offs between core platform work and new-growth bets, and keep commitments and dates honest.Priorities are revisited annually, but the trade-offs made here shape the business for years beyond the current planning cycle.
Innovation Delivery: Run the pipeline of net-new product opportunities — from problem identification through validation, prototype, pilot, and launch. Apply a repeatable framework for evaluating bets (market size, customer evidence, technical feasibility, time to value) and the discipline to kill the ones that don’t clear the bar.
Direct-to-Consumer & Multi-Channel Expansion: Deliver the products that take Helium 10 beyond the Amazon seller — Shopify and owned storefronts, Google, Walmart, and social commerce. Review the requirements, feature priorities, and release sequencing for the DTC and omnichannel brand.
AI-Native Product Development: Identify where AI agents, generative creative, and LLM-driven workflows create real customer value rather than novelty, and build them into the roadmap with clear adoption and quality measures.
Customer Discovery: Personally lead and scale customer discovery with sellers, brands, and agencies. Build the cadence, instrumentation, and synthesis practices that keep the team’s decisions grounded in evidence instead of opinion.
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of market developments, platform changes, and the competitive landscape across marketplace and DTC tooling. Translate that intelligence into product decisions and executive-level point of view.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with engineering, design, data, and QA — organizations this role influences rather than owns — to ensure roadmap commitments ship on time and at quality. Create clarity on ownership and decision rights so work moves quickly without escalation.
Commercialization Partnership: Work with product marketing, growth, and sales on positioning, pricing, packaging, and launch readiness. Ensure every release has a defined target persona, a clear value proposition, and a plan for adoption.
Business Impact: Define success metrics for every initiative and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not outputs. Use analytics tools such as Amplitude, Tableau, and SQL to measure adoption, retention, and revenue impact, and communicate results, learnings, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
Hands-On Team Leadership: Manage the day-to-day work of the product management team across the U.S. and China — running standups and reviews, setting weekly priorities, reviewing specs and PRDs, and stepping in directly when a project is at risk.
Team Development: Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product management team across the U.S. and China, setting clear expectations, priorities, and career development paths. Establish common standards for discovery, documentation, and prioritization so both teams operate as one function. Foster a culture of customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Skills & Qualifications:
12+ years in product management, including 5+ years of senior leadership experience, with experience managing both individual contributors and managers across a global function10+ years in product management, including at least 3 years directly managing product managers in a SaaS, e-commerce, or data platform company.

blocks.text: About Us:

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Operating System, unifying retail media, commerce management, and advanced measurement across 100+ global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Instacart. Through Pacvue and Helium 10, our enterprise and SMB platforms, we empower over 70,000 brands, agencies, and sellers with AI-driven insights and technology to win in today’s rapidly evolving commerce landscape.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.
About the role:

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to drive execution across Helium 10’s product portfolio and to lead the product managers who deliver it. This role runs the discovery and delivery of our innovation agenda beyond the Amazon marketplace seller — into direct-to-consumer and multi-channel commerce, Walmart and TikTok, and AI-native experiences. This director will be responsible for turning agreed priorities into a sequenced, resourced roadmap and for making sure the team ships it on time and at quality.

Innovation is central to this role, and it is hands-on work. The Director of Product Management will run our new-product pipeline: validating, building, and launching the bets that open new revenue lines and new audiences. That means running structured discovery with sellers and brands, prototyping and testing quickly, defining what success looks like before we build, and retiring ideas that don’t earn their place. This leader will bring rigor to how we evaluate emerging opportunities — AI agents, autonomous workflows, and adjacent channels — and work with go-to-market teams to land them with customers.

Innovation into direct-to-consumer expansion is a core focus. As brands diversify across Shopify and their own storefronts, Google, and social commerce, our portfolio has to follow them. This director will lead the discovery, requirements, and delivery of the features that serve a DTC-first brand, and partner closely with product marketing, growth marketing, and sales to bring those products to market.

This is a hands-on, execution-first role. Sets strategy and direction for the function while also driving execution hands-on. You will run weekly operating cadences, review specs and requirements, unblock your team daily, and stay close enough to the detail to catch problems before they reach a release. The role is based in the United States and requires regular, direct contact with customers: discovery interviews, advisory sessions, and time in the field with brands and agencies. Deep familiarity with marketplace e-commerce, direct-to-consumer e-commerce, and SaaS product-led growth environments is strongly preferred.

This role reports to the VP of Product Strategy & Ops and manages the product management function globally, leading both the U.S. product management team and the China-based product management team. lteads the global product management function through a mixed structure — managing the U.S. product managers directly, and leading the China product management team through its manager. Sets direction and shared standards for both; delegates day-to-day execution oversight in China to that manager, while staying closely involved in the U.S. team's execution.Comfort leading and developing a team across time zones and cultures is essential.
Responsibilities:

items: Roadmap Development: Translate agreed priorities into a sequenced, multi-quarter roadmap and drive it to delivery. Run the planning process end to end, make explicit trade-offs between core platform work and new-growth bets, and keep commitments and dates honest.Priorities are revisited annually, but the trade-offs made here shape the business for years beyond the current planning cycle.

Innovation Delivery: Run the pipeline of net-new product opportunities — from problem identification through validation, prototype, pilot, and launch. Apply a repeatable framework for evaluating bets (market size, customer evidence, technical feasibility, time to value) and the discipline to kill the ones that don’t clear the bar.

Direct-to-Consumer & Multi-Channel Expansion: Deliver the products that take Helium 10 beyond the Amazon seller — Shopify and owned storefronts, Google, Walmart, and social commerce. Review the requirements, feature priorities, and release sequencing for the DTC and omnichannel brand.

AI-Native Product Development: Identify where AI agents, generative creative, and LLM-driven workflows create real customer value rather than novelty, and build them into the roadmap with clear adoption and quality measures.

Customer Discovery: Personally lead and scale customer discovery with sellers, brands, and agencies. Build the cadence, instrumentation, and synthesis practices that keep the team’s decisions grounded in evidence instead of opinion.

Market & Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of market developments, platform changes, and the competitive landscape across marketplace and DTC tooling. Translate that intelligence into product decisions and executive-level point of view.

Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with engineering, design, data, and QA — organizations this role influences rather than owns — to ensure roadmap commitments ship on time and at quality. Create clarity on ownership and decision rights so work moves quickly without escalation.

Commercialization Partnership: Work with product marketing, growth, and sales on positioning, pricing, packaging, and launch readiness. Ensure every release has a defined target persona, a clear value proposition, and a plan for adoption.

Business Impact: Define success metrics for every initiative and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not outputs. Use analytics tools such as Amplitude, Tableau, and SQL to measure adoption, retention, and revenue impact, and communicate results, learnings, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.

Hands-On Team Leadership: Manage the day-to-day work of the product management team across the U.S. and China — running standups and reviews, setting weekly priorities, reviewing specs and PRDs, and stepping in directly when a project is at risk.

Team Development: Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product management team across the U.S. and China, setting clear expectations, priorities, and career development paths. Establish common standards for discovery, documentation, and prioritization so both teams operate as one function. Foster a culture of customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.
A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.
The next InCommand is a new solution, built on a new technology stack, designed from the ground up for the way modern data centers, including high-density and AI infrastructure, are operated. It will be delivered as a cloud service and be deployable in customers' own environments, built API-first, and developed with an agent-assisted engineering practice in which coding agents work from specifications under human review. Our own facilities are the first customer, so everything we build is proven in real, live operations before anyone else sees it.
Someone has to decide what that product is: what it does, what it leaves behind, what comes first, and what the industry will pay for. As Head of Product that is your call, and the engineers and coding agents who build it work from what you write. You start with a rare advantage: a decade of operational knowledge about what the product has to do, and the people who use it every day sitting down the hall. You partner closely with Architecture, Integrations and Developer Platform, and you build the product function from there.
Key Accountabilities
Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the new InCommand, from the first capabilities we prove on our own facilities to a product the industry adopts.
Own the living functional specification repository that engineers and coding agents build from, and the acceptance criteria that define what "done" means for every capability.
Decide, capability by capability, what the new product does, what it does differently and what it leaves behind, using real usage data and the judgment of the operators who run data centers every day.
Define the AI-first side of the product: insights, recommendations and an assistant that operators can trust, with the provenance and control critical infrastructure demands.
Partner with Architecture, bringing operator and customer needs as requirements for the data model and the API, and with Product Marketing so the product is documented in a form the industry can adopt.
Shape packaging and pricing for a modular product delivered as a cloud service and in customers' own environments.
Work daily with our operations engineers as the voice of the customer, and grow the product function as the product grows.
Required Skills
8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform or infrastructure product: roadmap, specifications and pricing.
Experience building a product from scratch: defining what it is and what it is not, and making hard scoping decisions early with incomplete information.
A record of writing precise specifications and acceptance criteria that engineering teams, and now coding agents, can build from without guesswork.
Experience with operations-heavy users (operations centers, field or facilities teams, industrial environments) and turning their tacit process into explicit requirements.
Familiarity with AI-driven product capabilities (insights, recommendations, assistants) and what makes them trustworthy to users; hands-on use of AI tools in your own work.
Packaging and pricing experience for modular enterprise software.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to make a product case to executives and to engineers alike.
Preferred Skills
Knowledge of or experience with DCIM products: the data they manage, how data-center operators use them and how they are bought.
Product experience with observability, monitoring or other high-volume telemetry products, and a feel for telemetry economics: cost-to-serve, data value and packaging.
Having defined and shipped an AI assistant or AI-driven insight capability: evaluation, trust, provenance, retrieval over operational data.
Having worked as the product counterpart of a platform architect on an API-first product, turning customer needs into requirements the architecture team builds against.
Experience with specification-driven or AI-assisted development practices, where coding agents are first-class participants in how a product gets built.
Serverfarm is committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace and offers paid time off, paid holidays, 401k and FULL coverage medical, dental and vision. Our compensation philosophy rewards employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s goals and strategic initiatives.
The listed salary range for this position is an estimate based on the competitive job market. Final compensation will be based on your own individual skills, experience, and location.

They are not intended to serve as an exhaustive list of all possible responsibilities and duties. We encourage you to apply even if your experience isn't an exact match to the job description.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Treasury Prime
Treasury Prime is the operating layer for modern banking. We run the largest bank network for embedded finance, connecting 20+ banks with the fintechs they power through modern APIs. We’re a small, senior, fully remote team (Clojure, React, Postgres, AWS, and a growing set of AI agents) with a culture built on mutual respect, collaboration, and ownership. We’re backed by Y Combinator, QED Investors, Nyca Partners, Deciens Capital, SaaStr Fund, Susa Ventures, and others.
The Role
We're hiring a Vice President of Engineering to lead software engineering, DevOps, and data, and to serve on our executive team reporting to the CEO. You'll own how we build, ship, and run the platform banks and fintechs depend on every day.
This is a leadership role first. You're technical and can go deep on architecture and tradeoffs with your team, but your job is building a strong team, setting clear direction, and keeping engineering closely tied to customers and the rest of the business. You lead through influence, earn trust across functions, and bring people along when priorities or practices need to change.
AI is changing what a small engineering team can build and how it adds value. You'll work with our CEO and VP of Product to shape our AI direction, challenge it where the evidence says so, and turn it into work the team can deliver.
In Your First Year
Earn the trust of the engineering team, and support and develop our engineering manager
Put in place the operating rhythms and standards the team needs, and build depth in DevOps and on-call so the load is sustainable
Partner with our Automation & Operations team on a long-term ownership model for security, IT, and DevOps
Become a trusted voice with our bank, fintech and product partners
Set the team, our technology, and the business up to scale, with AI expanding how much a small team can build and ship
What You'll Do
Lead the team: Coach and grow engineers, DevOps, data, and our engineering manager. Build a culture of ownership and pride in craft, and give direct, caring feedback. Make sure critical knowledge and on-call never rest on one person.
Set direction: Connect engineering strategy to company goals and customer outcomes. Evolve how the team plans, prioritizes, and ships, and raise quality and predictability without adding unnecessary process.
Keep customers at the center: Make sure the team understands the customer's problem before it builds, through call reviews, implementation work, and time with the people who talk to customers every day. Treat Revenue, Client Services, and Implementations as teammates: when they need help landing or supporting a customer, the team's first answer is how we can help, and you make capacity tradeoffs. Help the team see that customer focus means solving the customer's real problem, not building every request.
Build with AI: Treat AI as a way to change how we scale, not just a productivity add-on. Find places where AI can take on whole pieces of work in complex, regulated financial workflows, and measure success by results customers and partner banks can trust. Choose models and tools on cost and performance, revisit what's been built as the technology changes, and be willing to rebuild or retire what no longer makes sense. Lead by example, using AI in your own work so it becomes a natural part of how the team builds.
Work across the company: Contribute to company strategy as an exec team member and partner with our VP of Product as a true peer: challenge direction with data, then commit and lead the team through it. Make engineering a trusted partner to Revenue, Client Services, Implementations, Compliance, and Operations, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain business terms.
Run a secure, regulated platform: Guide architecture, own reliability and incident response, and own engineering's part in SOC 2, PCI, and bank partner security reviews. Make sure AI systems get security review that matches the responsibility they're given.
What You Bring
7+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years leading engineering organizations through managers
Head of engineering experience (VP, Head of, or similar) with a seat on an executive or senior leadership team
A strong technical foundation in backend systems, APIs, and distributed architecture, plus experience leading DevOps or infrastructure and data teams (we run on AWS)
A track record of building teams people want to join and stay on, and leading them through constant change and innovation
Hands-on experience leading a team through AI adoption, with a clear view of where AI helps, where it doesn't, and how to change the way a team uses it
Comfort engaging with a founder-CEO's vision: debating it, pushing back with evidence, and turning it into something a team can build
Strong cross-functional partnerships, especially with sales and customer success, and a track record of putting engineers close to customers and using customer evidence to change what the team builds
Experience in a regulated or security-sensitive industry such as fintech, payments, or banking
Comfort in a small, fast-moving company where leaders are both strategic and hands-on
While these are not hard requirements, the best candidates will meet many of them.
Bonus Points
Banking as a Service, core banking, payments, or ledger experience
Clojure or other functional programming languages
Leading engineering at a B2B company under 100 people through the growing pains that come with scaling a business
Building or running a security program
Shipping LLM-based or agentic products
We look forward to hearing from you!
US Pay Range
$275,000—$320,000 USD
Canada Pay Range
$205,000—$240,000 CAD
Treasury Prime hires in the United States and Canada only. Applications from candidates residing outside these countries cannot be processed at this time.
Treasury Prime is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process, please get in touch with and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. Our team will respond to your email promptly.

jobs.title: Head of Global Engineering Steriles Operations
jobs.text:
McDermott Laboratories Limited
Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.
We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.
Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference, and here’s how the Head of Global Engineering Steriles Operations role will make an impact:
Provide strategic leadership for engineering, facilities, utilities, projects and capacity expansion across the Steriles (Injectables and respiratory) network. Ensure compliant, reliable and cost-effective operations while supporting growth, operational excellence, audit readiness, and people development. A balanced combination between mastering capital management, and manufacturing operations reliability transformations is a key requirement.
Key responsibilities for this role include:
Lead engineering, facilities, utilities and capital project activities across all sterile manufacturing locations.
Top 1 prioritity will be Quality and Safety assurance across all the engineering related activities, for internal and for external collaborators
Drive Lean/Operational Excellence and Digital transformation agenda across the engineering function with a clear goal to optimize performance of our assets (e.g.: OEE) and optimize expenses
Ensure compliance with GMP, statutory, regulatory, safety and environmental requirements.
Drive standardization of engineering practices, utilities and technical standards across sites.
Manage CAPEX and engineering OPEX budgets and optimize resource utilization.
Lead capacity expansion, plant upgrades, automation and operational improvement initiatives.
Maintain audit readiness and support regulatory inspections.
Partner with Quality, Manufacturing and Projects teams to improve plant performance.
Mentor and develop engineering teams through coaching, training and succession planning. Developing a strong network of Engineering leaders across the site through active career development and rotation across sites.
The minimum qualifications for this role are:
Deep knowledge of sterile pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, engineering systems and project management.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management and strategic planning capabilities.
Knowledge of current sterile pharmaceutical technologies, including isolator filling lines, device assembly lines and plant management best practices
Bachelor of Science and Engineering with specialization in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering or related field.
Experience in people and process management within the pharmaceutical industry.
Significant experience in injectables manufacturing environments is required.
At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.
At Viatris, we offercompetitivesalaries, benefitsandan inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
