jobs.title: Data Governance Director
jobs.text:
At EMC, we’re all about working together to make an impact. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, contribute, and gain experience that matters. We strive to be caring leaders, close partners, and responsive experts—always supporting each other to do our best work. Join us, and let’s improve lives together.
**This position is eligible to work from home anywhere in the United States with preference given to those living in the Des Moines, Iowa metro area. This role would also need to work hours based on Central Time Zone**
This role leads EMC’s enterprise Data Governance program and is accountable for the strategy, operating model, capabilities, technical direction, and organizational adoption required to improve the value, quality, protection, accessibility, and responsible use of enterprise data. Partners with senior business, technology, analytics, risk, compliance, and Digital Product Management leaders to integrate governance into enterprise priorities, strengthen data ownership and accountability, and deliver measurable business and risk-management outcomes.
Essential Functions:
Defines the enterprise Data Governance strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with business and technology strategies, ensuring governance supports EMC’s business model, enterprise priorities, and evolving data needs.
Establishes strategic direction and capability expectations for data stewardship, business metadata management, data quality management, master and reference data management, governance operations, and governance technology platforms.
Aligns investment and capability priorities based on business objectives, regulatory and risk-management needs, and enterprise data and technology strategies.
Directs execution of the Data Governance strategy through portfolio planning, prioritization, resource alignment, and management of internal and external delivery resources.
Oversees governance programs, initiatives, consulting partners, contractors, and third-party service providers to ensure delivery aligns with approved objectives, commitments, and enterprise priorities.
Establishes outcome, adoption, quality, and capability-maturity measures; monitors performance; manages enterprise-level risks, issues, and dependencies; and initiates corrective action when delivery does not meet established expectations.
Bridges business and technology priorities by building consensus across competing interests and aligning senior leaders around governance objectives, operating model changes, and accountability expectations.
Partners with business, technology, and product management leaders to clarify decision rights, establish shared ownership, and integrate governance requirements into enterprise initiatives.
Exercises decision authority for Data Governance-led initiatives and facilitates resolution or escalation of material conflicts, exceptions, and decisions that require broader enterprise alignment or authority.
Leads the development, enterprise approval, implementation, and continuous improvement of data governance policies, standards, controls, and frameworks in partnership with business and functional leaders.
Champions data ownership and accountability, and leads organizational change to address systemic barriers, strengthen program maturity, and sustain adoption across the enterprise.
Leads and develops the Data Governance team through workforce planning, clear performance expectations, coaching, succession planning, and talent development.
Establishes team objectives and ways of working aligned with strategic priorities, promotes accountability and continuous improvement, and builds the skills and capacity needed to deliver and sustain the enterprise Data Governance program.
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's degree in business, information management, computer science, analytics, finance, insurance, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
Ten years of progressively responsible experience in data governance, information management, business analytics, data management, or related disciplines
Five or more years of leadership experience managing teams, enterprise programs, or cross-functional initiatives
Property and casualty insurance industry experience preferred
Experience working within Agile product delivery environments and partnering with Digital Product Management organizations preferred
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Expert knowledge of data governance frameworks, operating models, policies, and standards
Advanced knowledge of data management practices, including metadata, data quality, stewardship, and master and reference data management
Strong knowledge of property and casualty insurance operations, business processes, products, and data domains
Knowledge of data-related regulatory requirements, privacy principles, information protection, and emerging industry trends
Strong knowledge of data governance technologies and their application to enterprise data management
Advanced strategic planning, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Strong ability to translate enterprise strategy into actionable governance roadmaps and operating models
Advanced ability to lead organizational change and drive adoption of governance practices
Excellent ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional stakeholders, and resolve competing priorities
Superior verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex governance and technical concepts to diverse audiences
Our employment practices are in accordance with the laws that prohibit discrimination due to race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, active military status, citizenship status, marital status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.
All of our locations are tobacco free including in company vehicles.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About Mission Underwriting Services
At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.
What We Offer:
Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
Medical, Dental, Vision
401K, 401K Match
Life and Disability Benefits
Unaccrued Paid Time Off
11 Paid Holidays
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program
Educational Assistance Program
Employee Referral Program
Paid Parental Leave
Purpose:
We are a commercial insurance Program Administrator focused on building and scaling specialty Insurance Programs. As part of our next stage of growth, we are transitioning from reliance on third-party software and SaaS vendors toward developing and owning more of the technology that powers our business.
We are building a technology organization that combines deep insurance expertise with modern software development, data, automation, and artificial intelligence. Our goal is to create differentiated platforms and tools that improve underwriting, distribution, operations, program launch speed, portfolio management, and the overall experience of our brokers, carriers, and internal teams.
We are seeking an entrepreneurial and highly experienced Head of Product to lead the creation of our product organization and technology product strategy.
This person will be responsible for identifying the highest-value opportunities for technology, AI, data, and automation across the enterprise, translating those opportunities into a prioritized product roadmap, and building the teams and operating model required to execute it.
The Head of Product will work closely with the CEO, executive leadership, underwriting, claims, actuarial, operations, distribution, finance, legal, compliance, and engineering. The role will initially be both strategic and hands-on, requiring someone who can establish the product vision while also driving early product decisions, hiring, prioritization, and delivery.
The ideal candidate has experience in AI-enabled software development, enterprise or B2B product management, and building high-performing product teams. Experience in property and casualty insurance is strongly preferred.
This is an opportunity to build a product and technology organization at the foundation of a growing insurance company. The person in this role will have meaningful influence over the company’s future operating model, technology architecture, AI capabilities, customer experience, and competitive position.
The Head of Product will not simply manage an existing product portfolio. This individual will help define what the company becomes: a modern insurance Program Administrator with the technology, data, and AI capabilities to build and scale Programs more effectively than traditional market participants.
Essential Duties/Functions:
Product Strategy and Vision
Develop and lead the company’s overall internally built product strategy, as well as AI software strategy.
Establish a clear product vision aligned with the company’s business strategy and long-term competitive objectives.
Identify opportunities to replace, improve, or integrate third-party systems through internally developed technology.
Create a multi year product roadmap designed to implement agentic AI across all MGA's in the portfolio, through a combination of in house technology and vendors
Define the principles, governance, and decision-making processes that will guide product development.
Help determine which capabilities should be built internally, purchased, integrated, or developed through strategic partnerships and oversee operation of those related to AI.
Insurance and Business-Process Transformation
Develop a deep understanding of how our Programs are originated, designed, launched, underwritten, distributed, administered, and managed.
Partner with business leaders to identify the most important technology opportunities across the insurance lifecycle.
Develop tools and platforms that support underwriting workflows, submission management, appetite and eligibility decisions, pricing, portfolio oversight, broker engagement, reporting, and program administration.
Identify ways AI can improve decision-making, productivity, knowledge management, risk selection, service, and operational efficiency.
Artificial Intelligence and Data
Establish a practical and commercially focused AI product strategy.
Identify and prioritize high-value use cases for generative AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and decision-support tools.
Develop appropriate standards for data quality, model governance, security, privacy, explainability, and human oversight.
Work with engineering, data, underwriting, actuarial, legal, compliance, and risk leaders to move AI initiatives from experimentation into production.
Product Organization and Team Building
Build and lead a high-performing product organization, initially hiring key product leaders and individual contributors.
Define the appropriate product organization structure, including product management, product design, user research, data product management, and product operations.
Identify talented employees in existing departments who may be well suited for product roles and create effective pathways for their transition.
Executive and External Leadership
Serve as the senior executive voice for product strategy and technology-enabled business transformation.
Regularly communicate product priorities, progress, risks, and tradeoffs to the CEO, executive team, and Board as appropriate.
Help shape the company’s broader technology strategy in partnership with the Chief Technology Officer
During the first year, the Head of Product is expected to:
Assess the company’s existing systems, vendor relationships, data capabilities, workflows, and technology gaps.
Develop and secure alignment around a company-wide product and AI strategy.
Establish a prioritized product roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes.
Define the future product organization and begin hiring key team members.
Identify and launch a limited number of high-impact technology or AI initiatives.
Create the product management operating model and core development processes.
Establish clear criteria for build-versus-buy decisions.
Build strong working relationships with business leaders and transferred employees.
Demonstrate measurable progress in speed, efficiency, underwriting capability, distribution effectiveness, user experience, or program-launch capacity.
Required Qualifications:
Significant experience leading product management for software, technology, AI, data, or digital platforms.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling product organizations and teams.
Experience taking products from concept through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
Experience with artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, analytics, or intelligent automation.
Experience translating complex business problems into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
Experience operating in a complex, regulated, or highly data-driven industry.
Strong executive communication, influencing, decision-making, and organizational leadership skills.
Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to operate strategically and tactically.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in property and casualty insurance, including underwriting, program administration, distribution, claims, actuarial, or insurance operations.
Experience with MGAs, Program Administrators, carriers, reinsurers, or insurance platforms.
Experience building products for commercial insurance or other complex B2B markets.
Experience building products subject to regulatory, privacy, security, model-risk, or compliance requirements.
Experience managing product teams during a period of rapid growth or organizational transformation.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
The successful candidate will be:
A builder who enjoys creating teams, processes, and products from an early stage.
Commercially minded and able to connect technology investments to business results.
Comfortable working in an environment where priorities evolve and not every answer is known in advance.
Credible with both technical professionals and insurance executives.
Curious about how insurance works and motivated by the opportunity to improve it.
Decisive, analytical, collaborative, and highly accountable.
Capable of balancing long-term platform development with near-term business needs.
Focused on practical AI adoption, not simply experimentation or industry hype.
An excellent communicator who can create alignment across departments.
Energized by the opportunity to help shape the future of the company.
The Head of Product will report to the Chief Executive Officer and will work closely with the executive leadership team and leaders across underwriting, distribution, operations, actuarial, claims, finance, legal, compliance, engineering, and data.
Working Conditions:
Requires a quiet work environment with regular sitting at a computer for extended periods of time.
Occasional walking and standing, and lifting of up to 10 lbs.
Regular use of hands and fingers.
Frequent talking or hearing.
Vision requirements: Close, distance, color, peripheral, focus and depth perception.
Additional Information
This is a remote position. Planned, in-office activities may be required on occasion (typically 2-4x per year).
You must live in the United States and be authorized to work in the United States without requirement of employmentsponsorship/visa.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Angling
jobs.text:
ABOUT onX
We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.
We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.
Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.
We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.
Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.
ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY
onX is seeking a Head of Product to own the next stage of growth for Angling. You will lead a high-growth consumer product on the exponential path to scale. You will set a compelling long-term vision for how we serve all 50M North American anglers and will own turning that vision into experiences that help them discover where to fish, prepare for outings, and make better decisions on the water.
Partnering with the General Manager (GM) and Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will build the team and product capabilities to turn that ambition into results. You will start with one PM reporting to you, and as the business scales you will attract and develop talent and build a world-class product organization. This is also a hands-on role: you will directly lead a meaningful product area while increasing the impact and independence of the PMs you coach.
The ideal candidate has a record of leading a consumer product through rapid growth and developing strong product teams. You combine a passion for knowing the customer with high-level business acumen. You have a strong ability to articulate a long-term vision that inspires action. Experience entering new geographic markets or customer segments, from evaluating the opportunity through launch and sustained growth.
Experience with consumer subscriptions, mapping, geospatial data, content products, or products used in the physical world.
Experience bringing products or teams together while maintaining customer value and delivery continuity.
Interest in fishing and a willingness to spend time learning directly from anglers.

You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $180,153 and $225,191 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

jobs.title: Vice President, Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
OneSpan is seeking a Global Vice President of Solution Engineering to lead and evolve the presales organization supporting our Cybersecurity business. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and serving on the Revenue leadership team, this executive will be accountable for how OneSpan wins the technical decision, improves sales effectiveness, and scales solution engineering across regions.
You will build a high-performing, globally aligned organization that combines deep cybersecurity expertise with commercial judgment and a customer-outcome orientation. Your mandate includes designing the global SE operating model, developing talent, raising the quality of technical discovery and validation, and making resource investments that improve win rates, conversion, and deal velocity.
You will be a senior technical and strategic advisor to customers and an influential partner to Sales, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success. Success requires fluency across OneSpan’s Security portfolio—including authentication, digital identity, fraud prevention, and mobile application security—and the ability to position hardware, software, SaaS, and integrated solutions in complex enterprise environments.
What You’ll Do
Lead and Transform the Global SE Organization
Design and execute a single global SE operating model, with clear regional alignment, coverage and specialist models, rules of engagement, escalation paths, and decision rights.
Lead, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of Solution Engineers and Solution Architects; build a leadership bench, succession plans, and a culture of accountability and technical excellence.
Own capacity and investment planning, including AE-to-SE coverage, skills mix, specialist deployment, geographic allocation, and prioritization of strategic opportunities.
Build consistent performance expectations, career architecture, talent assessment, development plans, and promotion standards in partnership with People and Revenue Operations.
Partner with the CRO and regional sales leadership to align SE resources to go-to-market priorities while preserving consistent global standards.
Drive Technical Wins and Revenue Outcomes
Own the global presales strategy and execution plan supporting Security new-logo acquisition, competitive displacement, expansion, and growth across direct and partner-led routes to market.
Increase technical win rates and sales productivity by strengthening discovery, qualification, solution design, demonstrations, competitive differentiation, and customer value articulation.
Establish governance for proofs of concept, pilots, and technical evaluations, including entry/exit criteria, success measures, resource commitments, and conversion to commercial outcomes.
Be an active member of the CRO leadership team, contributing to pipeline inspection, strategic deal reviews, account planning, forecasting insight, and execution priorities.
Define and inspect an actionable SE scorecard, including technical win rate, POC-to-win conversion, technical evaluation duration, resource utilization/capacity, and deal progression; partner with Revenue Operations on data definitions.
Serve as the executive escalation point for high-stakes technical pursuits, critical competitive situations, and strategically important customer engagements.
Be a Strategic Customer and Market Leader
Engage CISOs, CIOs, fraud and identity leaders, architects, and digital channel executives as a credible advisor who connects security requirements with measurable business outcomes.
Sponsor executive briefings, architecture workshops, and complex technical evaluations for key global accounts and regulated-industry buyers.
Guide teams in navigating customer requirements spanning authentication, fraud prevention, digital identity, application security, integrations, deployment architecture, and relevant regulatory expectations.
Translate field and customer insight into clear competitive intelligence, product feedback, and strategic recommendations.
Connect the Revenue and Product Ecosystem
Build a structured voice-of-customer feedback loop with Product Management and Engineering, distinguishing critical deal blockers from broader roadmap opportunities.
Partner with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement on differentiated solution narratives, competitive plays, demos, and practical technical sales training.
Collaborate with Partnerships and Alliances on partner technical readiness, joint architectures, enablement, and complex ecosystem opportunities.
Coordinate with Customer Success and Professional Services to validate solution feasibility, manage handoffs, and identify opportunities for adoption and expansion.
Industrialize the Technical Sales Engine
Own the quality, scalability, and reliability of demos, POC platforms, reference architectures, technical collateral, and reusable field assets.
Standardize responses to RFPs, RFIs, security reviews, and technical diligence; apply automation and AI where appropriate to improve quality and turnaround time.
Build continuous portfolio and competitive enablement across SEs, sales teams, and partners, with measurable readiness and certification outcomes.
Represent OneSpan at selected customer, partner, industry, and analyst forums.
What You Bring
15+ years in enterprise cybersecurity or software presales, solution engineering, or technical consulting, including substantial experience leading regional or global SE organizations.
Demonstrated success building, scaling, or transforming a globally distributed SE function—not simply operating an established team.
Clear evidence of improving technical win rates, POC conversion, sales efficiency, or other measurable revenue outcomes through SE leadership.
Deep working knowledge of at least one core area of authentication, identity and access management, fraud prevention, digital identity, or mobile application security, with credibility across adjacent domains.
Experience selling complex enterprise solutions into financial services, government, or other regulated industries; comfort across hardware, software, SaaS, and hybrid deployments is strongly preferred.
Ability to engage credibly with C-level buyers while challenging and guiding architects, developers, security teams, and other technical stakeholders.
Practical architectural fluency in APIs, SDKs, integrations, cloud/on-premises environments, and enterprise security design; capable of leading solution decisions without needing to be the deepest individual specialist.
Strong commercial acumen and executive partnership skills, including disciplined resource allocation, deal strategy, pipeline analytics, and collaboration with global sales leaders.
Experience enabling system integrators, resellers, and technology partners; ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization.
Excellent communication and leadership skills in English; additional languages are valued.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree is a plus.
What Success Looks Like
In your first year, you will have established a clear global SE operating model and performance baseline; strengthened the leadership bench and technical readiness of the organization; implemented repeatable technical evaluation and deal-support standards; and demonstrated measurable improvements in technical conversion, presales efficiency, and the quality of collaboration with regional Sales and cross-functional teams.
Salary: $250,000 - $300,000 (depending on experience and qualifications) plus commission

jobs.text:
About Inroads:
Inroads applies data, analytics, technology, research, and content development to co-create services and programs that are personalized, relevant, and engaging for the communities who rely on them. Our deep understanding of digital services, policy implementation, and ways communities consume information allows us to seamlessly integrate with organizations and public sector teams to revolutionize the ways they deliver complex services at scale.
About the role:
The Associate Director, Analytics Engineering will help build and scale our Analytics Engineering function. In this leadership role, you will mentor team members, establish data quality standards across programs, and refine engineering methodologies to enhance client delivery. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in conducting code reviews, developing robust data quality testing protocols, and championing best practices to drive operational excellence for our clients.
In this position you will:
Design, implement, and maintain repeatable data quality testing methodologies and automated validation frameworks for analytics engineering team members to execute across all client programs.
Partner with Engineering and Program leadership to help stand up, scale, and mature the Analytics Engineering function by defining core processes, documentation standards, and delivery frameworks.
Provide ongoing technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to analytics engineering team members to foster continuous growth and ensure delivery excellence.
Perform hands-on data work for critical projects and programs, stepping in to support delivery teams in executing client deliverables.
Monitor data pipelines and warehouse architectures to ensure high accuracy, reliability, and compliance across diverse datasets.
Design, refine, and champion analytics engineering best practices and workflows to optimize overall client delivery.
Conduct regular code reviews and enforce best practices for code maintainability, performance, and scalability.
Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Analytics Engineering, guiding both internal teams and external stakeholders.
Other responsibilities and duties as assigned.

8+ years in data or analytics engineering, with proven expertise in data modeling, transformation frameworks, and modern warehouse architectures (consulting or public sector experience a plus)
Experience coaching or mentoring technical team members, including conducting thorough code reviews and enforcing best practices
Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining data quality testing methodologies and automated validation frameworks
Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Ability and willingness to jump into hands-on data work to support project execution and meet complex client deliverables
Strong background in establishing engineering workflows, documentation standards, and scalable practices to elevate client delivery

jobs.title: Head of ML & MLOps Engineering - Fintech Engineering (f/m/n)
jobs.text:
The mission
Build a state-of-the-art ML platform and the discipline around it.
Models with a price tag. Every model has a business case and a measurable monetary outcome.
Credit and decisioning models built with rigorous validation, champion/challenger testing and explainability.
A production ML platform. Serving, monitoring, reproducibility and retraining are engineered, not improvised.
Responsible AI, built in. Model risk, bias and explainability checks, with an independent sign-off gate before anything reaches production.
Agent-first systems. Agents are production components with orchestration, guardrails, evals and observability.
◆ Models on governed data. You build on a point-in-time-correct feature store, not around it.
This is a business function. Every model carries monetary value, and you will run the function that way: compute budget, headcount and return on investment.
What you'll own
The agentic standard for ML. You run agentic model iteration and agentic model monitoring and observability, bound to the feature store. You own the reliability, cost and latency of agent loops and graphs in production, and you hire against the bar.
The ML & MLOps team, from your first hire onward.
Model-development standards and the validation methodology that stands up to model-risk and regulatory scrutiny.
The ML platform behind decisioning services.
A clear ownership line between feature production (data engineering) and model consumption, set together with the Head of Data Engineering and the Director.
You are
A leader who loves data and loves building systems around it.
Hands-on when needed, especially with AI on board. You understand the model, the pipeline and the serving layer.
Experienced across the full ML lifecycle: development, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
Experienced in architecting agentic systems for ML: orchestration, guardrails, evals in CI, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, agent observability.
Experienced in building and leading ML teams in regulated settings.
Experienced in credit-scoring or underwriting modelling, or comparable high-stakes ML.
Skilled in model-risk management and responsible-AI governance.
Experienced in building and leading a team from zero.
Fluent in English (B2+).
Bonus
CCD2 and consumer-credit regulation · DORA/ICT risk · IFRS 9 implications for model outputs · fraud-detection ML · Databricks/Spark.
What you will work with
The ML platform (serving, monitoring, and retraining), the feature store, the agent evaluation and observability layer, and cross-functional partners in Data Engineering and Credit Risk.
Why this one
Seat at the table on a core leadership team.
Build it right the first time. No legacy ML estate.
Models that matter. Your work decides real money, not a dashboard.
Real pace. A lean, AI-native organisation.
Build ML that makes money and stands up to a regulator.
We are building a scale-up inside InPost, and AI will flow through it. You would join the core Data & AI leadership team and build the ML and MLOps function from zero, with the InPost executive team backing it. Our word is extreme ownership: you own a model from first idea to its profit and loss impact.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Location: Remote (US)
About the Role
Turno is growing from a turnover tool into a multi-product platform for hosts, property managers and the service providers who keep their rentals running. As Head of Product, you'll decide what that platform should look like and lead the team that builds it. You'll make the calls on what we build and connect each one to a business metric. It's a hands-on role: you'll write specs, review work and talk to hosts and service providers yourself.
What You'll Do
Set product direction
Own the product vision. Define what Turno's platform should look like over the next 12–24 months for hosts, property managers and service providers, and get the leadership team behind it.
Bring ideas. Spot what we're missing and tell us what we need before we ask.
Decide what not to build. Turn the vision into one prioritized roadmap, and decide what we stop or don't start.
Own business outcomes
Be measured on results. Own the product metrics that drive Turno's business, like retention, marketplace growth and revenue, and set the KPIs that connect product work to them.
Explain tradeoffs. Walk anyone at Turno through the tradeoff between a long-term product investment and this quarter's number.
Balance the marketplace. Make tradeoffs that keep both sides healthy. A win for hosts that hurts service provider retention (or the reverse) is not a win.
Grow with partners. Shape how we build with platform partners and integrations, and how hosts and service providers come onto Turno.
Lead and grow the product team
Lead the product team. Lead product management and design. You set the direction and the standard; PMs own their product areas within it.
Coach and give feedback. Set goals for each PM, review their work, run product critiques, and set clear expectations and growth paths.
Hire well. Attract strong product talent and shape how the team grows.
Work across the company
Partner on launches and growth. Work with Marketing and Customer Experience on launches, adoption and how we explain new features to customers.
Partner closely with Engineering. Work through architecture and technical tradeoffs with engineers, and explain them to the leadership team in plain terms.
Set the operating rhythm. Set up planning and review cadences, and make sure everyone knows why the roadmap is what it is.
Stay hands-on
Write, prototype and join customer calls. Use AI in your own work, and lead how we build AI into the product, including agents that handle operational work for hosts and service providers.
What You'll Bring
You make the call. You form a view of where the product should go, then use data and research to test it. When the evidence says you're wrong, you change course.
You start from the customer. Your strategy comes from time spent with customers on both sides of a marketplace.
You're commercial. You think in business outcomes and are comfortable being measured by them. You've owned a business metric such as revenue or retention.
You've led product in marketplaces or B2B SaaS. You have 10+ years in product, including 3+ years leading PM teams.
You grow people. You’ve developed PMs into stronger leaders and built talent-dense teams.
You're hands-on and technical. You still write, prototype and dig into data, and you have the technical depth to earn engineers' trust. You use AI to get more done with a lean team.
You explain things simply. You can walk engineers or the founders through a complex tradeoff in a few minutes.
Nice to have
Experience in short-term rentals, proptech, home services or gig-workforce platforms
Built for multi-sided or partner ecosystems, including bringing businesses or service providers onto a platform
Scheduling, payments or large platform partnerships
Led a product from a single product to a multi-product platform
Led globally distributed teams, including in Latin America

jobs.title: VP Product
jobs.text:
About Current AI
Current AI
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.
If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.
Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.
Role Overview
Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.
As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.
What you will be working on
AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:
Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.
Your first six months
Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha
How we will measure success
Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.
What you’ll do
The VP Product will be responsible for the following:
Product Strategy & Vision
Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the CEO and Board before roadmaps are finalized.
Set the product policies, including the content policy for our products, the criteria for the models and suppliers we serve, and how we measure quality in each language.
Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
Run the Product Sprint process, including the backlog, sprint planning & Weekly update, being ready to do some hands-on building when needed
Internal & External Alignment
Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.
Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.
Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.
Team & Organizational Leadership
Lead and empower product team and engineering leadership, directly overseeing the Head of Engineering and product teams to foster a high-performing, accountable builder culture.
Plan resourcing and hiring collaboratively, proposing product and engineering resource plans and budgets for regular review with executive leadership.
Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives
Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.
Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment
Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.
Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.
What we’re looking for
Essential Qualifications
12-15+ years of experience in product leadership roles, including AI systems and managing cross-functional product and engineering organizations
Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
Executive maturity: proactive communicator to the CEO, skilled in executive coordination, and comfortable navigating complex public-private stakeholder environments
Hands-on knowledge of LLM systems (evaluation, serving, safety)
Nice-to-haves
Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
French proficiency is a strong plus
Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.
Character traits
We’re looking for people who:
Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.
How to apply
Please submit your resume through the button on the top right and answer the prompted questions in no more than [500] words in total:
Equal opportunity commitment
Current AI is committed to ensuring equal access to employment and preventing all forms of discrimination. All applications will be reviewed fairly, without regard to origin, sex, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religious beliefs, views held, or any other criteria unrelated to professional qualifications. Selection will be based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.
Current AI does not accept unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies with whom we do not have a signed agreement. Current AI will not be liable for any fees or commissions in the event that a candidate submitted in this manner is subsequently hired.
Salary: Paris: 140,000 € - 180,000 € depending on experience. Our offers are adjusted based on location.

Current AI

is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.

If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.

Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.
Role Overview

Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.

As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.
What you will be working on
AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:

items: Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.

blocks.text: Your first six months

items: Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha

blocks.text: How we will measure success

items: Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.

blocks.text: What you’ll do
The VP Product will be responsible for the following:
Product Strategy & Vision

items: Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the CEO and Board before roadmaps are finalized.
Set the product policies, including the content policy for our products, the criteria for the models and suppliers we serve, and how we measure quality in each language.
Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
Run the Product Sprint process, including the backlog, sprint planning & Weekly update, being ready to do some hands-on building when needed

blocks.text: Internal & External Alignment

items: Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.

Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.

Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.

blocks.text: Team & Organizational Leadership

items: Lead and empower product team and engineering leadership, directly overseeing the Head of Engineering and product teams to foster a high-performing, accountable builder culture.
Plan resourcing and hiring collaboratively, proposing product and engineering resource plans and budgets for regular review with executive leadership.

blocks.text: Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives

items: Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.

blocks.text: Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment

items: Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.

Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.

blocks.text: What we’re looking for
Essential Qualifications

items: 12-15+ years of experience in product leadership roles, including AI systems and managing cross-functional product and engineering organizations
Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
Executive maturity: proactive communicator to the CEO, skilled in executive coordination, and comfortable navigating complex public-private stakeholder environments
Hands-on knowledge of LLM systems (evaluation, serving, safety)

blocks.text: Nice-to-haves

items: Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
French proficiency is a strong plus
Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.

blocks.text: Character traits
We’re looking for people who:

items: Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering - ICM
jobs.text:
About CaptivateIQ
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance.
We started with incentive compensation management and are now expanding our platform to solve broader enterprise performance management challenges. Recognized by analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and G2 and backed by investors including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we help high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe drive revenue performance with flexibility and insight.
We’re building a category-defining platform at the intersection of finance, sales, operations, and AI. We’re looking for ambitious builders to help shape what comes next.
About the Role
As Senior Director of Engineering for Incentive Compensation Management (ICM), you’ll lead the engineering organization behind our flagship product that customers rely on to pay their teams accurately and motivate performance. You’ll lead managers across multiple teams and set the technical direction for making ICM AI-native without compromising the accuracy and trust our customers depend on.
This role combines product thinking, technical leadership, and organization building. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, GTM, and executive leadership to turn ambiguous opportunities into scalable products, and you’ll shape the engineering culture and structure that delivers them.
The Problems You’ll Solve
Making ICM AI-native. Decide where AI creates real customer value in plan design, calculation, and payout workflows, and build the quality and evaluation practices that make those features trustworthy.
Scaling a system where correctness is non-negotiable. Customers pay real people based on our calculations. You’ll balance speed of delivery with reliability, performance, and data integrity at enterprise scale.
Evolving the organization with the product. You’ll develop managers, clarify ownership, and adapt structure and process as the product matures.
What You'll Do
Set the strategy
Own the engineering strategy for ICM, aligned with company priorities, customer needs, and long-term platform direction
Identify new opportunities and guide product evolution, including the thoughtful application of AI to create differentiated customer workflows
Lead the organization
Recruit, grow, and inspire engineering managers and senior technical leaders
Build a culture of ownership, velocity, and continuous improvement
Design team structures and processes that evolve with product maturity
Raise the technical bar
Guide architecture decisions that balance speed, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
Stay close enough to the work to spot risks, challenge assumptions, and raise quality across the organization. You don’t need to write production code, but you do need to earn the respect of the engineers who do.
Drive execution
Create alignment and clear priorities across Engineering, Product, Design, and GTM
Make thoughtful tradeoffs and help teams move quickly while holding a high quality bar
What You'll Bring
15+ years of software engineering experience, including 6+ years leading managers and multi-team engineering organizations
A track record of building and scaling high-performing teams
Experience owning products end to end and scaling existing systems
Hands-on experience shipping AI/ML-powered product features, ideally LLM-based, including how you measure and maintain their quality. Experience applying AI to improve how engineering teams work is a plus.
Strong technical instincts across product architecture, infrastructure, reliability, and developer experience
A close partnership with Product and Design, and a focus on customer outcomes beyond engineering
The ability to create clarity for teams in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with executive leadership
Nice to have: Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, finance or compensation systems, or other domains where calculation accuracy and auditability matter.
Why You'll Love This Role
You’ll own a flagship product in a category CaptivateIQ helped define and drive the next generation of AI-native capabilities
You’ll operate with significant ownership and influence across product and engineering strategy
You’ll work alongside deeply collaborative product, design, and engineering leaders
You’ll join a high-growth company with strong product-market fit and ambitious expansion plans
You’ll have the opportunity to shape not only products, but the engineering culture and organization that builds them
Benefits
Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.
Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.
Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.
Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.
Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.
Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.
Notice to Prospective Candidates
Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.
We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:
Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.
Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.
Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.
Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.
Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.
Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.
Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours support, ensuring timely resolution of critical issues and maintaining system uptime.
CaptivateIQ participates in E-Verify, web-based system that allows enrolled employers to confirm the eligibility of their employees to work in the United States

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Location: Remote
Why now?
AI is changing the economics of building software. As small teams become dramatically more productive, the defining constraint shifts from “what can we build?” to “what is worth building?”
Jungle Scout has spent more than a decade building proprietary intelligence on Amazon commerce. Over the past year, we've transformed how we bring that intelligence to life: our engineering teams have embraced AI-native development, increased their pace dramatically, and brought MCP capabilities and agents to hundreds of customers. One Fortune 500 customer told us our product had advanced more than any other vendor they work with.
That progress opens a much bigger opportunity. Instead of giving brands information to analyze, we are building intelligent agents that understand their businesses, identify opportunities, recommend actions, and help them grow - on Amazon and beyond.
We're looking for a Head of Product to turn that ambition into products customers depend on.
The role
We believe the future of product leadership looks different.
The greatest leverage will come not from coordinating execution, but from identifying the right problems, making bold choices, and developing exceptional product judgment across the organization.
At Jungle Scout, small engineering teams own customer problems end-to-end—from understanding the problem to designing, shipping, measuring outcomes, and iterating. You'll own which problems deserve our investment, the product direction we pursue, and the success of the portfolio as a whole.
You won't sit between customers and engineers or build layers of process. You'll bring the customer insight, product judgment, and ambitious direction that make autonomous teams more effective.
You'll report to our CTO as a close strategic partner, with real authority over product strategy and priorities. We expect you to bring your own ideas, challenge ours, and make consequential decisions independently. You'll work closely with engineering, design, data science, and commercial leadership.
What you'll do
Discover consequential customer problems. Build relationships with customers, understand their workflows and economics, and identify opportunities at the intersection of unmet needs, our proprietary data, and emerging AI capabilities.
Make ambitious, disciplined bets. Develop product strategy, choose where to invest, define success, and test assumptions quickly. Know when to double down, redirect, or stop.
Own product portfolio success. Look beyond launches to adoption, repeated use, customer outcomes, retention, and expansion. Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to turn new capabilities into realized value.
Raise the bar for product quality and judgment. Champion simplicity, usefulness, and trust. Challenge teams to think bigger, while helping engineers and data scientists make excellent product decisions without becoming an approval bottleneck.
Lead hands-on and communicate clearly. Use AI to investigate datasets, explore customer problems, prototype ideas, and evaluate new capabilities. Move easily from a working experiment to a strategic customer conversation or executive presentation.
Who you are
A proven product builder who has identified important opportunities, made hard tradeoffs, and delivered products with measurable customer and commercial impact.
Deeply customer-oriented, with the curiosity to understand how businesses actually operate and the judgment to see beyond feature requests.
Technically fluent and genuinely AI-native. You use AI extensively to research, analyze, experiment, and prototype. You're comfortable working directly with data, understand the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems, and can engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical product decisions.
Commercially minded, with an understanding of enterprise adoption, monetization, retention, and growth.
A multiplier of strong teams. You create clarity without bureaucracy, strengthen others' judgment, and challenge senior leaders constructively.
Amazon or broader ecommerce experience is strongly preferred. Experience building B2B software, data, analytics, or AI products is also highly relevant. We're more interested in what you've built and the quality of your judgment than the size of the product organization you've managed.
How we use AI in hiring: We use AI tools to aid in our recruiting process. A person makes every hiring decision. To request a review without AI or an accommodation, contact

jobs.title: Product Director,  Intelligent Gateway
jobs.text:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.
At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.
We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 3 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 19 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.
Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.
We are seeking a Director, Product Management who lead like owners – strategic, hands-on product leaders who can take ambiguous, complex platform problems and turn them into capabilities at scale. You will lead discovery, define strategy, and drive roadmaps that strengthen our scalable product platform, spanning platform consolidation, API/developer experience, workflow automation, security, and data-powered insights, so Availity delivers an end-to-end platform, not disconnected point solution.
As a Director, Product Management, you will be a key member of the leadership team driving the evolution of Availity products. You will lead and develop a team of product managers, shape the product vision and strategy for your portfolio, set clear product goals and KPIs, and oversee the execution of product roadmaps that align with customer needs, market demands, and business objectives. You will partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Implementation, Sales, and Marketing to accelerate delivery, drive adoption, and deliver innovative solutions that improve healthcare workflows. This position offers a unique opportunity to help close the provider-payer gap while contributing to a growing, industry-leading platform and supporting growth across Availity.
Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.
Location: Remote, US
Why you want to work on this team:
If you are energized by leading products that are the backbone for millions of users a day, striving to make healthcare better for all.
Passionate about building and leading high-performing product teams in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where you’ll lead and innovate alongside talented teams.
Seeking a high-impact leadership role where you can shape strategy and contribute to the growth of an industry-leading platform during a period of significant growth and evolution here at Availity.
To be qualified for this position you:
Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred (MBA, MS, or equivalent).
Minimum of 10 years of product management experience delivering technology-driven products or platforms, including experience in a leadership role demonstrating the ability to lead high-performing teams, influence stakeholders, and drive product strategy.
Strong understanding of how healthcare, payers, and providers operate, with the ability to connect product decisions to revenue, cost, and market position. Experience within the healthcare technology space is highly preferred.
Proven experience launching and scaling new tech products in technology, financial services, healthcare technology, or top-tier consulting, working on enterprise products.
Proven track record of delivering strong platform capabilities that enable multiple downstream products, teams, and customers – such as APIs, data platforms, or workflow platforms – rather than one-off solutions.
Demonstrated ability to establish operational rigor, scalable processes, planning discipline, and execution frameworks across a product organization.
Strong product judgment and craft – able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, frame ambiguous problems, make principled trade-offs, and drive decisions grounded in customer, business, and technical reality.
Expertise in developing and executing long-term product roadmaps, aligning product strategies with business goals, and prioritizing based on impact and value.
Deep partnership experience with engineering, design, and data, with enough technical fluency to influence architecture, sequencing, and scalability decisions.
Experience measuring success through customer adoption, leverage, and long-term business impact, not just feature delivery.
Strong understanding of agile frameworks, lean principles, and product development cycles to deliver products efficiently while maintaining high quality.
Experience leading teams through change and operating comfortably in highly ambiguous environments where the “right answer” must be discovered, not assigned.
Outstanding learning agility – ability to go from zero to deep understanding quickly.

blocks.text: Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 3 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 19 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

We are seeking a Director, Product Management who lead like owners – strategic, hands-on product leaders who can take ambiguous, complex platform problems and turn them into capabilities at scale.
