jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Job Description:
Job Title - Head of Data
Location – Remote, commutable to London office as and when required
Type – Permanent, Full-time 37.5 hours
About Velonetic
Velonetic helps keep the London insurance market moving. With more than 100 years of market heritage, we combine specialist insurance expertise, proven processes and technology to make complex insurance operations simpler, faster and more reliable.
As we continue to evolve, data will play a critical role in improving performance, enabling innovation and supporting the responsible use of AI and automation.
Job Overview
We’re looking for an experienced Head of Data to lead our enterprise data strategy and help turn data into a trusted, accessible and valuable business asset.
Working across the business, Technology, Architecture and control functions, you’ll set the direction for data, improve quality and ownership, strengthen governance and ensure our data foundations support reporting, analytics, transformation and AI.
What you’ll do
Define and deliver Velonetic’s enterprise data strategy and roadmap.
Establish clear data ownership, governance and stewardship.
Improve data quality, lineage, metadata and traceability.
Shape our data architecture and platform roadmap alongside Technology.
Enable trusted reporting, analytics, automation and responsible AI.
Strengthen data risk, GDPR and regulatory compliance.
Influence senior leaders and build a strong, organisation-wide data culture.
What we’re looking for
You’ll be an established data leader with:
Senior experience across data strategy, governance, management, architecture or analytics.
A strong track record in data quality, ownership, stewardship and governance.
Experience influencing Executive and Board-level stakeholders.
Knowledge of modern data platforms, analytics and AI-readiness.
Strong understanding of data risk, privacy and regulatory requirements.
Ideally, experience within insurance, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Investment In Training and Development
We offer a comprehensive range of training and career development opportunities, a structured induction programme, tailored job training as well as mentoring and support for relevant sponsored professional qualifications. We’re developing an environment where people can grow and harness their careers and skills to be the best that they can be to focus on the long term.
Our Culture
Here at Velonetic we support with care and compassion. We are constantly evolving our initiatives around equality, diversity, and inclusion to ensure that everyone feels equally involved and supported in the workplace no matter of who they are or what they do. We are proud of the culture we are creating to ensure that our commitment is ongoing and have a diverse mix of employees working within an inclusive environment and culture to create a high performing workforce led by talented leaders. We aspire to be recognised for our innovative and modern thinking approach.
Employee Benefits
As part of our competitive remuneration package, flexible benefits are available. There is an option to “flex up and down” on specific benefits, for example buy or sell annual leave, Private Medical Benefit, Dental and Travel Insurance.
You will also have access to ‘Perks at Work’, a discount store to purchase gift cards at reduced rates and get discounts on holidays, restaurants, activities, groceries and more.
DXC Recruitment Team will be engaging with all candidate applications on behalf of Velonetic. DXC will be managing the recruitment throughout the onboarding process.
At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available here.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Digital Product Management
jobs.text:
The Opportunity:
The Senior Director, Digital Product Management is accountable for how product management is performed across VWR’s digital organization, including the vision, standards, operating model, governance, and talent systems that enable a scalable, high-performing discipline. This leader oversees the practice and its leaders rather than a single product area, translating enterprise and digital strategy into a multi-year direction for product management while shaping portfolio investment, capacity, and delivery priorities. As the organization matures, the role may extend into adjacent experience disciplines, including UX / Design, to ensure a coherent, customer-centered approach to end-to-end digital product delivery.
How you will thrive and create an impact
Own and evolve the vision, philosophy, and operating model for the Product Management practice, including how digital products are discovered, prioritized, delivered, and measured.
Set and steward product standards, methodologies, governance, and tooling; improve consistency and quality across teams as the organization scales.
Translate enterprise and digital strategy into a multi-year direction for the product discipline, aligning practice investment, organizational capacity, and priorities to business needs.
Represent product management at the executive level and partner with Engineering, Data, Commercial, and business leaders to shape digital strategy, portfolio investment, and roadmaps.
Lead the discipline’s contribution to measurable commercial, customer, and operational outcomes; establish performance measures and communicate trade-offs to executive leadership.
Own the talent and capability architecture for product management, including job families, leveling frameworks, career paths, hiring standards, talent calibration, succession planning, and leadership development.
Lead and develop Directors of Product Management and, as scope expands, UX / Design leaders; build a strong leadership bench and set clear cultural, performance, and ethical expectations.
Build, structure, and resource the product and experience organization in partnership with the Chief Digital Officer and the HR team.
Extend practice leadership across UX / Design and cross-functional delivery to enable an integrated, end-to-end approach to digital product development.
Advance product and UX maturity by benchmarking against industry practices, implementing modern operating models, including AI-enabled ways of working, and leading the organizational change required for adoption.
Champion customer-centricity, outcome orientation, and data-informed decision-making across the discipline.
What we're looking for
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
12–15+ years of progressive product management experience, including substantial experience leading product leaders and managing managers or directors.
Demonstrated success building, scaling, and maturing a product practice or organization, including its operating model, standards, governance, and talent frameworks.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional digital initiatives and influencing senior executives.
Proven ability to connect product practice maturity and investment to measurable business and customer outcomes.
Experience leading or closely partnering with UX / Design and other experience disciplines; comfort operating across a combined product and experience remit preferred.
B2B, eCommerce, and/or distribution industry experience preferred.
Experience implementing modern product operating models and AI-enabled ways of working preferred.
Experience designing job architectures, leveling frameworks, and career paths for a professional discipline preferred, in partnership with HR.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Enterprise-level product management expertise, including product discovery, prioritization, delivery, measurement, governance, and portfolio planning.
Strategic leadership and executive influence, with the ability to translate business strategy into a practical product and experience vision.
Strong organizational design and talent leadership capabilities, including workforce planning, leadership development, calibration, and succession planning.
Ability to lead through influence across Engineering, Data, Commercial, UX / Design, People, and business teams in a complex matrixed environment.
Deep understanding of customer-centered design, product and UX maturity, outcome-based planning, and data-informed decision-making.
Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate investments, balance tradeoffs, and connect organizational capabilities to measurable results.
Exceptional communication, change leadership, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to establish high standards, build alignment, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and ethical leadership.
Disclaimer:
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
Why Avantor?
Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.
The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

jobs.title: Director of Solution Engineering
jobs.text:
About Entegrata
Entegrata helps law firms turn data into decision-grade insights. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Indianapolis, we are a venture-backed SaaS company delivering a turnkey, Azure-based data lakehouse platform purpose-built for law firms. Our platform consolidates siloed legal, operational, and financial data into a single governed source of truth, with AI-powered analytics on top. Our mission is to become the data platform of choice for the top law firms in the world.
The Role
We're hiring a Director of Solution Engineering to be the technical backbone of our sales process, the subject matter expert on the Entegrata platform who guides firms through evaluation, architecture, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Sales throughout the cycle: leading demonstrations, running technical deep dives and infrastructure overviews, and responding to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires. You'll report to our VP of Sales and operate as a senior individual contributor building the solution engineering function from the ground up.
You'll help define how solution engineering works at Entegrata, and lay the groundwork to grow the function as we scale. This is a hands-on role suited to someone with a proven ability to execute who is ready to take the next step into a leadership role, someone who knows what great looks like and is ready for the opportunity to build a function from the ground up.
What You'll Own
Product demonstrations. Lead compelling, technically credible demos of the Entegrata platform tailored to each prospect's environment, data landscape, and priorities. Maintain the primary demo environment, to ensure use cases and examples are representative and engaging.
Technical deep dives & infrastructure overviews. Lead in-depth technical sessions with prospects' IT, security, and data teams, walking through platform architecture, infrastructure design, and integration approach in the detail needed to move a technical evaluation forward.
RFPs & RFIs. Own the technical response to RFPs and RFIs, translating platform capabilities into clear, accurate, compelling answers.
Security questionnaires. Partner with our security and engineering teams to complete security questionnaires and support prospects' due diligence and vendor risk reviews.
Sales-to-Customer Success handoff. Own a clean, well-documented handoff from sales to implementation, carrying technical context, firm-specific requirements, and open questions forward so nothing is lost in transition.
What You'll Partner On
Field sales enablement. Partner directly with the sales team, sitting alongside sales through active evaluations to help prospects navigate their demo requirements, technical questions, security concerns, and evaluation milestones in real time.
Customer success & post-sale support. Partner with Customer Success and Implementation Engineering and stay engaged with select customers post-sale where deep platform expertise is needed to support a successful launch.
Product & engineering. Work closely with product and engineering to stay abreast of features, functions, limitations and roadmap, while also ensuring prospect feedback and technical requirements make it into the platform development cycle.
Function building. Partner with executive and sales leadership to establish the tools, playbooks, and processes for solution engineering at Entegrata as the team grows.
Must-Have Qualifications
Sales engineering experience. 5+ years in a sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical pre-sales role, ideally at an enterprise SaaS or data platform company.
Modern data platforms. Hands-on experience with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric.
Cloud & data architecture. Comfort working across cloud architecture, data pipelines, and integration concepts; Azure experience a plus.
Customer-facing communication. Track record of leading technical demos and discussions with both business and technical stakeholders, up to the C-suite.
RFPs & security questionnaires. Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and completing security questionnaires (e.g., SIG, CAIQ) in an enterprise sales context.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Legal industry or professional services experience.
Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric certification.
Experience building a sales engineering or solution engineering function from scratch at an early-stage company.
Compensation and Benefits
Competitive salary, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, unlimited PTO and company holidays, professional development support, and flexible remote work.
Equal Opportunity
Entegrata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Job Description
As a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies, we are passionate about bringing great science to life. We help scientists, resarchers, and clinicians address some of the world’s most important challenges across life science research, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food, environmental testing, and related markets.
Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we develop advanced instruments, software, consumables, and services that enable customers to generate reliable scientific results and improve scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. Our global organization combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer impact. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that empowers employees and fosters innovation.
The Role
Agilent is seeking an experienced Director of Software Engineering to lead software engineering teams responsible for build out of a unified software platform. This leader will build and develop high-performing engineering organizations, deliver high-quality commercial software, establish strong technical and architectural practices, and improve execution across the product lifecycle.
The role requires deep software engineering experience, strong technical judgment, people leadership, life-sciences domain expertise, and the ability to operate across a global, multi-business organization. The successful candidate will partner closely with Product Management, R&D, Systems Engineering, Architecture, Quality, and business leadership to translate customer and market needs into software strategies and roadmaps, while helping teams adopt AI-enabled and automated engineering practices where they improve productivity, quality, and speed.
Key Responsibilities
Own software engineering execution across the complete product lifecycle, from concept through development, verification, release, sustaining engineering, and lifecycle management.
Partner with Product Management and R&D leadership to translate customer needs and business priorities into executable software strategies and roadmaps.
Establish predictable planning, development, and release processes while balancing new-product development, platform investment, technical debt, sustaining engineering, and regulatory commitments.
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing software engineering organization responsible for analytical products as part of a larger portfolio.
Provide leadership across software domains that may include instrument and embedded software, desktop applications, enterprise informatics, cloud services, APIs, and data platforms.
Develop engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and individual contributors; attract and retain strong software engineering talent.
Manage dependencies across software, firmware, hardware, systems engineering, automation, and scientific workflows; provide senior leadership clear visibility into risks, tradeoffs, and investment needs.
Lead globally distributed teams and create an operating model that enables teams across regions to work as one integrated engineering organization.
Ensure software development practices meet the quality and regulatory expectations of life-science, diagnostic, pharmaceutical, and other regulated customer environments.
Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to strengthen lifecycle practices, design controls, verification and validation, documentation, traceability, and audit readiness.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related technical discipline required.
Master's degree or equivalent advanced technical education preferred.
Minimum of 5 years experience formally or informally leading people, projects and/or programs
Skills and Competencies
Deep software engineering and architecture credibility with strong systems thinking and technical problem-solving capability.
Proven ability to lead and develop engineering organizations and other engineering leaders.
Ability to balance technical quality, speed, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and business priorities.
Strong understanding of software quality, cybersecurity, reliability, and regulated development.
Strong product and customer orientation, change-leadership capability, executive communication, and stakeholder management.
Ability to influence across a distributed, multi-business organization and openness to new technologies and engineering approaches.
Additional Details
This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 17, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $184,800.00 - $346,500.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. Agilent Technologies, Inc., is committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive in the workplace where everyone is welcome, and strives to support candidates with disabilities. jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally. Our XCaaS platform, the 8x8 Experience Communications Platform, brings voice, video, chat, contact center and communications APIs together in one cloud platform, so organizations can deliver better employee and customer experiences. Millions of people rely on it every day, and reliability is at the center of what we deliver.
Our engineering teams own their services in production. We are now building a central Site Reliability Engineering team with a platform-wide view. It will define how we measure reliability, build the tools and standards that help every team run their services well, and engineer shared points of failure out of the platform before they affect customers. We are looking for the Director who will build and lead it.
What will you do?
You will build 8x8's central SRE function from the ground up and lead a team across US and EU time zones. Your team will set service level objectives for our most important customer flows, improve observability and work with engineering teams to ensure the platform has the capacity and redundancy it needs. You will own the platform's dependency map and shared-infrastructure inventory, set the operational standards every service is held to, and prove through regular testing that failover works. Engineering teams keep ownership of their services. Your team covers the parts of the platform that no single team owns and raises the reliability bar for everyone.
Responsibilities
Build and lead a global SRE team across US and EU time zones, including its charter, operating model, hiring and career development.
Define the reliability strategy and multi-year roadmap for the 8x8 platform, aligned with business and customer priorities.
Establish SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for critical customer journeys, and use them to guide engineering priorities and balance release velocity with stability.
Set platform-wide standards for observability, including monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting, with a focus on actionable, customer-impacting signals.
Drive the reduction of operational toil through automation, self-service tooling, and infrastructure and configuration as code.
Partner with platform and CI/CD teams to build reliability into the software delivery lifecycle, including progressive rollouts and automated rollback.
Own capacity planning and performance engineering for shared infrastructure and high-traffic services.
Maintain a comprehensive view of service dependencies and shared infrastructure, and lead the identification and remediation of single points of failure.
Lead resilience and disaster recovery programs, including regular failover testing across data centers and game days for critical components.
Establish production readiness standards and reviews for new services and high-risk infrastructure changes.
Partner with the incident management team to strengthen incident response processes, and participate in high-severity incidents to provide platform-wide technical expertise and help restore service quickly.
Champion a blameless postmortem culture and ensure that lessons learned and corrective actions are carried through to completion.
Serve as a trusted reliability partner to engineering, product and executive leadership, and report on platform reliability and progress against goals.
Qualifications
Required
10+ years in site reliability, infrastructure, platform or production engineering, including 5+ years leading SRE or infrastructure teams.
Has built or scaled an SRE or reliability function, with measurable results such as improved availability, SLO adoption or reduced toil.
Strong SRE practice: SLIs and SLOs, error budgets, observability, toil reduction, capacity planning, production readiness reviews and blameless postmortems.
Experience with incident management practices and with participating in high-severity incident response in large-scale production environments.
Deep infrastructure knowledge: networking, load balancers and high-availability pairs, DNS, firewalls and NAT, virtualization, and public cloud (AWS preferred).
Experience running services across both company-operated data centers and public cloud, including multi-site failover and disaster recovery.
A software engineering background: can write automation and tooling, read code and debug distributed applications.
Comfortable with Linux, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (for example Terraform or Ansible), Kafka or similar messaging systems, and relational databases at scale.
Hands-on experience with observability tools (for example Prometheus, Grafana).
Can set standards and get commitments from engineering teams that do not report to you.
Clear communication, and the ability to explain reliability to executives in business terms.
Preferred
Experience with real-time communications: VoIP, SIP, WebRTC
Experience with enterprise load balancers and network devices such as F5, Citrix ADC or Fortinet.
Chaos engineering or game-day programs.
Service catalogs and dependency mapping (for example Backstage).
Experience leading teams across multiple countries and time zones.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
The compensation range reflects the Company’s good faith belief at the time of posting. 8x8 has different base pay ranges for different work locations within the United States, which allows us to pay employees competitively and consistently in different geographic markets. The range above reflects the potential base pay across the U.S. for this role; the applicable base pay range will depend on what ultimately is determined to be the candidate’s primary work location. Further, individual base pay depends on various factors, in addition to primary work location, such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience, knowledge, success, education and skills. jobs.title: AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology & Knowledge Graph
jobs.text:
AVP Data Engineering - GE05AE
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
The AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology & Knowledge Graph is an executive-facing leadership role accountable for defining, building, and driving enterprise adoption of the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, and knowledge graph. This leader establishes the governed business meaning, context, and relationships that power trusted analytics, AI, agentic experiences, and decision automation across Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty.
Operating at the intersection of commercial P&C insurance, business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, the role translates complex insurance domain knowledge—submissions, quotes, accounts, policies, coverages, exposures, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance—into production-ready semantic assets consumable by people, data products, LLMs, and agents.
The AVP serves as the senior technical and domain authority for semantic and AI-ready data in Business Insurance, leads and leverage team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, and business data analysts, and partners directly with the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty to align the ontology roadmap to growth, underwriting profitability, operational efficiency, and innovation outcomes.
Must be eligible to work in the US without company sponsorship.
Primary Job Responsibilities
Executive Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as the primary data and semantic advisor to the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty, translating ontology and knowledge graph capabilities into business outcomes, investment cases, and decisions.
Present strategy, roadmap, execution progress, value realized, risks, and decision asks to executive leadership, steering committees, and ELT forums in clear, plain business language.
Build executive sponsorship and drive adoption of a shared Business Insurance vocabulary across underwriting, distribution, product, claims, actuarial, finance, and operations.
Influence enterprise technology, data, platform, and AI strategy in partnership with Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI COE, and Applied AI teams.
Negotiate priorities, resolve semantic and ownership conflicts across lines of business, and broker alignment on enterprise definitions.
Act as an external and internal thought leader on ontology, knowledge graphs, agentic analytics, and AI-native data engineering in insurance.
Ontology Strategy, Build & Adoption
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, context graph, and knowledge graph.
Lead the design and execution of an enterprise-scale semantic layer that standardizes business meaning and enables trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases.
Define and operationalize ontologies modeling core commercial insurance concepts and relationships: customers, business profiles, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, exposures, risks and locations, claims, producers, and portfolio performance.
Establish canonical vocabularies, metric definitions, business rules, and taxonomies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured data sources and across all three markets.
Define and enforce standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, versioning, and ontology reuse across delivery teams.
Drive adoption by embedding semantic models into data products, analytics, AI pipelines, APIs, and activation layers; measure and report adoption and business value.
Move capabilities from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise production, prioritizing high-value use cases such as submission triage, risk appetite, clearance, pricing and underwriting insights, portfolio management, and cross-sell.
AI & Data Engineering
Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics, ensuring LLMs and agents consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships.
Lead implementation of AI data pipelines integrating structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., submissions, loss runs, schedules, broker correspondence) to support AI and agentic solutions.
Operationalize ontologies through knowledge graphs, metadata services, data APIs, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and production data platforms in partnership with AI Data Architects and Engineers.
Design and oversee scalable real-time and batch data pipelines for efficient ingestion, processing, and delivery.
Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, reliability, security, and lifecycle management.
Ensure explainability by making AI and analytical outputs traceable to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data.
Champion AI-augmented productivity across the data lifecycle, including AI-generated pipelines, automated data quality, DataOps, and AI-assisted ontology engineering.
Evaluate emerging technologies in agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and data engineering; lead proofs of value and pilots to accelerate speed to market.
Governance, Team & Financial Leadership
Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards; establish semantic ownership and change control with business data owners.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, business data analysts, and release train engineers, including onshore and offshore talent.
Manage the portfolio budget, vendor partners, and financials; deliver measurable return on investment.
Operate within Scaled Agile and portfolio/value stream frameworks, partnering closely with product owners and cross-functional delivery teams.
Evangelize agentic data engineering and semantic practices through communities of practice, reference patterns, playbooks, and enablement materials.
Commercial P&C Domain Knowledge (Required)
Deep understanding of the commercial P&C value chain: distribution and producer management, submission intake, clearance, risk appetite, underwriting, rating and pricing, quote and bind, policy administration, endorsements, renewals, billing, claims, and reinsurance.
Working knowledge of commercial lines and products such as Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Business Owner's Policy, Umbrella/Excess, Management and Professional Liability, and specialty lines.
Understanding of how Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty differ in distribution model, underwriting approach, account complexity, and data needs.
Familiarity with core insurance concepts and measures: exposures and rating bases (payroll, sales, TIV, vehicles), class codes (NAICS/SIC), insured locations, account rounding, hit/quote/bind ratios, written and earned premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, retention, and rate change.
Familiarity with industry data standards and reference models such as ACORD, ISO, and NCCI.
Skills & Experience
Leadership & Communication
Exceptional executive presence with proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and persuasively to C-suite, line-of-business heads, and board-level audiences.
Strong executive influence, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; track record of building cross-functional coalitions and driving enterprise-wide adoption without direct authority.
Proven ability to frame investment cases, value metrics, and decisions for senior leadership.
Ability to lead in a lean, agile, fast-paced environment using Scaled Agile principles.
Semantic, Ontology & Knowledge Graph
Deep expertise in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale.
Hands-on mastery of RDF, OWL 2, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards; familiarity with labeled property graphs and query languages such as Cypher or GQL.
Experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs on platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Spanner Graph.
Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks.
Strong understanding of context-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, semantic interoperability, and AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability.
Data & AI Engineering
Mastery of data engineering and architecture, including lakehouses, data integration, data domains, data products, data APIs, real-time streaming, and conversational BI.
Experience implementing scalable AI-driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A).
Technical expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM optimization, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI, Postgres, OpenSearch, Pinecone).
Hands-on experience with multi-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake.
Strong grounding in data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, privacy, and security.
Education, Experience, Certifications and Licenses
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
12+ years in data engineering, data architecture, and large-scale data ecosystems, including 8+ years of hands-on semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph work.
7+ years in senior leadership roles managing complex data and AI portfolios, with direct engagement with executive and line-of-business leadership.
5+ years in commercial Property & Casualty insurance; experience across Small Business, Middle Market, or Specialty strongly preferred.
Industry designations such as CPCU, AINS, or AU are a plus.
Compensation
The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:
$182,000 - $273,000
Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About BusRight
Districts run their bus operations on BusRight every school day. We’ve found product-market fit, and the business is growing. What we build next determines whether we stay a useful tool or become the platform K-12 transportation runs on. Our next Head of Product owns that outcome.
You’ll report to the CPO and own product and design end to end: strategy, roadmap, team and execution. You’ll be hands-on, setting direction, making calls and shipping, while you build the team around you.
What Success Looks Like
You know BusRight’s users, market and product deeply.
The product strategy is sharper and clearer, built on what exists and backed by evidence.
You’ve shipped bets you owned from framing through delivery, and they moved customer and business outcomes.
Product drives BusRight. The right team is in place, and every function builds from its direction.
Customer value is measured and reported across BusRight’s products and services, and that evidence drives roadmap and commercial decisions.
The CPO, CEO and Engineering treat you as a trusted thought partner on where the product goes next.
What You Will Do
Work with the founders to define and pressure-test where BusRight wins.
Translate strategy into a living roadmap where every priority and commitment is tied to the value it delivers.
Own the product lifecycle from discovery through launch and outcome measurement.
Own product analytics, defining how BusRight measures adoption and usage and partnering with CS and Commercial to put those measures to work.
Report on the value customers get from BusRight’s products and services, and use it to guide roadmap and commercial decisions.
Make the hard calls on what not to build, and what to give up on when it isn’t working.
Partner with Engineering to ship reliably at scale without losing speed.
Stay in direct contact with users and customers. This role doesn't delegate learning.
Represent product in board conversations, partner discussions, and recruiting
Hire, develop and retain a world-class product and design team as we scale.
Hold the product team to a high bar of rigor, craft and accountability to outcomes, not output.
Build a product-led culture across BusRight, where every team understands customer value and brings evidence to its decisions.
What We Are Looking For
Leadership experience: 3–5 years in product leadership, with meaningful time at early-stage or high-growth companies.
Product-market fit: found it rather than inherited it. In the room while the answer was still unclear, made bets, got some wrong, cracked it, and can tell that story in detail.
Consumer product experience: a feel for what makes people love a product and come back to it. EdTech is a plus, not a requirement.
Product and design ownership: has led product design as well as product management.
Team building: a track record of hiring and developing strong PMs at early-stage companies.
Metrics-oriented: frames problems in numbers, sets clear success measures and knows when the data is strong enough to act on.
Technical depth: works through trade-offs with engineers. Coding is a plus, not a requirement.
AI-native: uses AI to research, analyze, prototype and validate, knows where it belongs in the product, and sets the standard for how the team uses it.
Ownership mindset: sees what needs doing and does it without being asked.

jobs.title: Director Engineering
jobs.text:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technology?
Do you want an opportunity to lead an amazing team of managers and engineers?
Join our Akamai Platform IAM team!
The Platform IAM team is part of Akamai's Cloud Technology Group. We design and operate customer-facing platforms enabling customers to configure and control their delivery, security, and cloud assets. This team owns the IAM tool sets for Akamai's customers using the Akamai Control Center website and the Cloud Manager website. We ensure customers have what they need to configure users for quality, safety, and performance.
Partner with the best
As the Director of Engineering, you will be in a high-impact, global leadership role responsible for steering the engineering strategy, architecture, and execution of Akamai's IAM platform. This leader will scale a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization to deliver massive-scale, feature-rich, and performant IAM systems.
As the Director of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Managing mentoring, and growing a large, multidisciplinary global team of managers, software engineers, and architects
Driving the technical roadmap for the IAM platform, ensuring the platform is highly scalable, resilient, and optimized for global, low-latency AuthZ
Overseeing the end-to-end software development lifecycle to ensure all code meets our high standards for quality, safety and performance.
Partnering closely with other teams to translate business vision into concrete technical milestones,
Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:
Have 15 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or its equivalent
Have extensive experience leading large, distributed software engineering teams with a track record of delivering innovative software products
Possess a deep understanding of the IAM ecosystem
Have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven track record of aligning remote, global teams
About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management
jobs.text:
Overview
Consilio is building Aurora, a data management and AI layer positioned above the eDiscovery review platform layer, designed to give clients and internal teams a unified, intelligent control plane across the matter lifecycle. This role owns the end-to-end product-level vision, strategy, and execution for the Aurora product family - the Aurora core platform (including integrations and reporting), ECI, and the Review product - and is the single point of accountability for translating Consilio's Aurora strategy into a coherent, sequenced, and commercially successful roadmap.This is a foundational leadership role in a product organization that is actively professionalizing its product management discipline. The VP will report to the Chief Product Officer, sit on the product leadership team, and will be expected to bring structure, rigor, and product craft to a portfolio that is strategically central to Consilio's transition from a commoditized hosting and services business toward a differentiated, platform-led data and AI offering.
Responsibilities
What You'll Own
Product Strategy & Vision• Define and continuously refine the multi-year product vision and strategy for Aurora, ECI, and Review, aligned to Consilio's broader Aurora platform thesis and CIFX/AI capability framework.• Own the sequencing logic across the portfolio - determining what gets built when, and why - balancing platform/data-layer investment against near-term product and revenue needs.• Represent the voice of the market (clients, prospects, competitors, and internal commercial teams) in shaping where Aurora goes next.
Roadmap & Execution• Build, maintain, and communicate a credible, prioritized roadmap across the Aurora core platform, integrations and reporting capabilities, ECI, and Review.• Partner with engineering, design, and data/AI leadership to translate strategy into well-specified requirements and shippable increments; hold the line on quality, fidelity, and reliability standards for AI-driven capabilities.• Establish and run the operating cadence (planning, prioritization, release management, and reporting) for the Aurora product family.• Directly manage and develop a team of Product Managers and/or Technical Product Owners aligned to each product area; define clear role boundaries between PM and TPO so that requirements ownership, operational execution, and go-to-market activation are unambiguous.
Integrations & Reporting• Own the strategy and roadmap for Aurora's integration layer - connectivity to review platforms, upstream/downstream systems, and partner ecosystems - as a core differentiator of the platform positioning.• Define the reporting and analytics product capability, ensuring it delivers defensible, trustworthy outputs (including AI-generated or citation-based outputs) that meet enterprise-grade fidelity and reliability bars.
ECI• Own product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for ECI, including its integration into the broader Aurora narrative and technical architecture.
Review Product• Own product strategy and roadmap for the Review product, ensuring it remains competitive modern peer review platforms while reinforcing Aurora's positioning as the data and AI layer above them.
Commercial & Cross-Functional Partnership• Partner closely with Sales, Client Services, and marquee-account teams to support onboarding, adoption, and expansion of Aurora with strategic customers.• Work with Product Marketing and Launch Excellence on positioning, narrative, and programmatic activation for the Aurora family, distinct from and complementary to core PM requirements ownership.• Contribute to Consilio's build-vs-buy-vs-partner thinking, including evaluation of potential M&A or partnership opportunities that accelerate the Aurora roadmap.• Represent Aurora product strategy to executive leadership as needed.
What Success Looks Like in the First Year• A published, credible Aurora product roadmap (platform, integrations/reporting, ECI, Review) that leadership, engineering, and commercial teams are aligned behind.• A functioning, appropriately staffed PM organization for the Aurora family with clear PM / TPO / Product Marketing boundaries in place.• Demonstrable improvement in the user experience of natively incorporated AI-driven product capabilities (e.g., agentic document analysis) against defined quality standards.• A clear, well-socialized point of view on integrations and reporting as a strategic differentiator, reflected in the roadmap and in client-facing narrative.
Qualifications
Required• 12+ years in product management, with 5-7+ years in a senior/head-of-product leadership role owning a multi-product portfolio.• Demonstrated experience building and scaling product management teams and operating models (e.g., pod-based, platform, or matrixed structures) inside organizations with maturing product practices.• Domain fluency in unstructured data analysis platforms, legal technology, eDiscovery, data management, or adjacent enterprise data/AI platforms; comfort with concepts like managed review workflows, data connectors/integrations, and reporting/analytics products.• Track record shipping AI-enabled product capabilities and holding them to enterprise-grade quality, accuracy, and reliability standards.• Strong technical requirements-writing ability; comfortable as the primary author of detailed product requirements and the internal evangelist for the roadmap.• Experience operating in a private equity-backed or otherwise growth/margin-disciplined environment.• Excellent executive communication skills, with experience presenting roadmap, strategy, and business cases to C-suite and board-level audiences.
Preferred•Direct experience with eDiscovery or ALSP platforms (e.g., Relativity, DISCO, Everlaw) or with data security/datamanagement platforms.•Experience integrating or evaluating M&A targets as part of a platform product strategy.•Experience standing up or refining a product craft development framework (market knowledge, market needstranslation, internal activation, external activation, or similar) for a product organization.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Productivity and Operations
jobs.text:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?
Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.
In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.
We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.
We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.
About the Role
We're looking for a Director of Engineering Productivity & Operations to lead how our engineering organisation builds, delivers and operates the Maia platform. You'll own the strategy and execution behind our engineering productivity agenda, including the evolution of our software development lifecycle towards an increasingly agentic model, alongside the operational disciplines that keep engineering efficient: metrics, reporting, cloud and tooling spend, and vendor management. Working closely with engineering leaders across the business and with Finance, you'll lead a team spanning developer experience, release engineering and CloudOps, and have real scope to shape the role and make it your own.
What you will be doing
Setting and leading the engineering productivity strategy, driving the move towards an agentic software delivery model across planning, coding, testing, review and deployment.
Owning the roadmap for shared engineering platforms and delivery capabilities, including CI/CD, release automation, observability and the developer experience.
Running the engineering operating rhythm and a trusted metrics framework, giving leadership clear visibility of delivery, quality, reliability and cost.
Leading engineering FinOps and cloud cost optimisation, working with your CloudOps analysts to build forecasting, accountability and sustainable savings.
Managing the engineering tooling portfolio end to end, including vendor evaluation, contract negotiation and renewals, in partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal and Security.
What we are looking for
Significant engineering leadership experience in SaaS, cloud platform, DevOps, developer experience, SRE or engineering productivity organisations.
A practical understanding of AI-assisted and agentic software development, ideally having led a team that builds AI agents or tooling for engineers, or a genuine drive to learn it fast.
Experience running engineering operations, with a track record of measuring productivity through outcomes rather than activity.
Hands-on experience with cloud cost management, vendor and contract management, and technical procurement.
Excellent communication and sound commercial judgement, with the ability to influence engineering, finance and executive stakeholders.
At Matillion, we are committed to providing competitive salaries in line with market standards. Our estimated compensation range for this position is £141,200 to £211,800, but the final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.
More about Matillion
We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:
Company Equity
30 days holiday + bank holiday
5 days paid volunteering leave
Private Health Insurance
Life Insurance
Pension
Access to mental health support
Your Safety
Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to to verify open roles or reach us at .
Want to know more?
Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
Cannot find anything suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at .
Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.
Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management (R14361)
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead strategy, growth, and execution across key digital products and member experiences. You’ll help shape how Oportun serves members throughout their financial journey while building products that create meaningful customer value and support sustainable business growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set product direction, develop roadmaps, lead discovery, guide cross-functional execution, and coach product managers while staying close to customers, data, and product performance. Success requires strong strategic judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term vision and detailed execution.
At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.
What You'll Do
Your day-to-day
You’ll define product vision, strategy, and priorities that connect member needs with Oportun’s business objectives.
You’ll own and evolve a portfolio of digital products and experiences, balancing growth, engagement, retention, customer value, and business performance.
You’ll build outcome-focused roadmaps and make clear investment decisions across existing products, new capabilities, and emerging opportunities.
You’ll develop a deep understanding of member behavior, friction points, and unmet needs through research, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort performance, and experimentation.
You’ll lead product initiatives from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale.
You’ll establish clear hypotheses, success measures, and performance metrics and use results to guide future product decisions.
You’ll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to resolve trade-offs and deliver strong member experiences.
You’ll balance customer experience, growth, product economics, risk, regulatory requirements, and operational complexity when making product decisions.
You’ll coach and develop product managers, set clear expectations, and strengthen product judgment, ownership, and accountability across the team.
You’ll communicate product strategy, priorities, performance, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
You’ll bring ideas for how we can improve our products, processes, and ways of working, proactively, not just when asked.
You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and team productivity.
You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster
Who You Are
The right fit looks like this
You’re a strategic and hands-on product leader who combines strong customer judgment with data, business acumen, and disciplined execution. You know how to build products that customers value while making thoughtful trade-offs across growth, economics, risk, and operational complexity.
You’re comfortable leading through ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and creating clarity across teams. You communicate directly, build strong partnerships, and stay close enough to the work to understand what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.
You’re also a strong people leader. You know how to coach product managers, raise the quality of product thinking, and create accountability for measurable outcomes.
You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.
What You Bring
Skills & experience
Required
8+ years of product management experience, with increasing responsibility for product strategy, roadmap ownership, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
Significant experience building and growing consumer digital products.
Proven experience owning engagement, retention, growth, monetization, or other meaningful product-performance outcomes.
3+ years of experience directly managing and developing product managers.
Strong track record leading cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.
Experience setting product strategy and translating it into focused, executable roadmaps.
Strong product judgment and a high standard for simple, intuitive, and customer-centered experiences.
Strong analytical skills, including experience with funnel analysis, cohort performance, product economics, experimentation, and performance measurement.
Experience evolving established products while balancing current customer needs with new strategic priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and trade-offs.
Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments with competing priorities and significant ambiguity.
Nice to Have
Experience in fintech, financial services, lending, banking, payments, savings, budgeting, investing, or financial wellness.
Experience building consumer mobile products or other high-engagement digital experiences.
Experience with subscription, recurring-use, or habit-forming consumer products.
Experience serving customers managing complex or variable financial needs.
Experience working in a regulated environment and incorporating Risk, Legal, and Compliance requirements into product experiences.
Experience leading products through periods of growth, transformation, or significant strategic change.
Experience using AI tools to improve product research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, or team productivity.
Our AI Mindset
We build with AI. We lead with judgment.
AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.
We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.
In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.
Why Oportun
What's in it for you
Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.
Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:
US Benefits:
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
401(k) including company match
Flexible PTO and Parental Leave
Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance
Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers

blocks.text: Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead strategy, growth, and execution across key digital products and member experiences. You’ll help shape how Oportun serves members throughout their financial journey while building products that create meaningful customer value and support sustainable business growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set product direction, develop roadmaps, lead discovery, guide cross-functional execution, and coach product managers while staying close to customers, data, and product performance. Success requires strong strategic judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term vision and detailed execution.
At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.
What You'll Do
Your day-to-day

items: You’ll define product vision, strategy, and priorities that connect member needs with Oportun’s business objectives.
You’ll own and evolve a portfolio of digital products and experiences, balancing growth, engagement, retention, customer value, and business performance.
You’ll build outcome-focused roadmaps and make clear investment decisions across existing products, new capabilities, and emerging opportunities.
You’ll develop a deep understanding of member behavior, friction points, and unmet needs through research, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort performance, and experimentation.
You’ll lead product initiatives from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale.
You’ll establish clear hypotheses, success measures, and performance metrics and use results to guide future product decisions.
You’ll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to resolve trade-offs and deliver strong member experiences.
You’ll balance customer experience, growth, product economics, risk, regulatory requirements, and operational complexity when making product decisions.
You’ll coach and develop product managers, set clear expectations, and strengthen product judgment, ownership, and accountability across the team.
You’ll communicate product strategy, priorities, performance, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
You’ll bring ideas for how we can improve our products, processes, and ways of working, proactively, not just when asked.
You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and team productivity.
You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

jobs.title: VP, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
The VP, Software Engineering is responsible for realizing product vision across one or more of Optimizely's core product lines or broad cross-cutting horizontals — with a sharp focus on how AI shapes how we build, operate, and continuously improve. They are trusted, respected engineering leaders who drive personnel management, program management, engineering operations, technical excellence, and strategy development across their focus area.
This role sits at the center of Optimizely's AI-forward engineering culture. The VP champions the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — from code generation and automated testing to intelligent code review and developer tooling — ensuring engineering teams work smarter and ship faster. They also own the internal operating model for Engineering: how we run, how we measure ourselves, and how we get better over time.
They balance technical depth with a bias toward execution, process, and delivery. They are strong collaborators who build cross-organizational consensus, negotiate priorities, share information openly, and drive broad initiatives to meet commitments. They act as leaders and active participants in company-wide efforts that deliver business value and drive continuous improvement, and serve as exemplars of Optimizely's values.
Job Responsibilities
AI-Assisted Development and Tooling
Champions the adoption of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) across engineering teams, establishing clear standards, enablement programs, and measurable impact metrics.
Drives the evaluation, rollout, and governance of AI-assisted development practices — including code generation, automated code review, test generation, and documentation — ensuring responsible and effective use at scale.
Partners with product and platform teams to identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate delivery quality, developer experience, or operational efficiency.
Stays current on the evolving AI development tooling landscape and shapes Optimizely's internal point of view on what to adopt, build, or avoid.
Engineering Operations and Internal Improvement
Owns the operating model for Engineering: how teams are structured, how delivery is measured, how health is monitored, and how we improve cycle-over-cycle.
Defines and drives engineering-wide metrics (delivery velocity, quality, incident response, system reliability) and builds the feedback loops that turn data into action.
Leads cross-team retrospectives, post-mortems, and process reviews that result in durable operational improvements — not just one-off fixes.
Drives internal engineering improvement initiatives: developer experience programs, productivity tooling, onboarding quality, and knowledge-sharing systems.
Partners with the CTO to continuously improve the engineering team's overall structure, organization, and delivery of results.
Leadership, Strategy, and Delivery
Directs delivery, operational, and/or people management for one or more product verticals and/or broad platform horizontals.
Fosters an environment that treats sound architecture, high-quality implementations, and secure systems as first-class product requirements.
Understands the business and operational context of our products and develops strategy to improve how we build and deliver software.
Collaborates in organizational and technical decision-making, with contributions that weigh growth, cost, margin, time-to-market, quality, and future readiness.
Coaches, mentors, and supports experienced engineering leaders, helping them become self-sufficient and solve their own challenges.
Leads engineering retention, recruiting, employer branding, and organizational strategy in a growth environment.
Participates as an amplifier of holistic organizational initiatives and company-wide direction.
Drives value initiatives that extend beyond Engineering to benefit the broader business.
Demonstrated history of implementing and managing significant software development programs.
Hands-on experience adopting and scaling AI coding and developer productivity tools within an engineering organization.
Familiarity with the AI development tooling landscape — including LLM-powered assistants, automated testing/review tools, and prompt engineering practices for software workflows.
5+ years of prior career experience as a software engineer.
12+ years of experience in engineering management.
Proven track record running or significantly improving engineering operations: metrics programs, operating cadences, process design, and internal tooling.
Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, organizational design, and driving execution at scale.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science or engineering preferred) or equivalent work experience
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.
From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.
10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.
But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.
If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.
Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

jobs.title: Director of Client Engineering - Trading Platform (Europe, Remote)
jobs.text:
About GoCharting
GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.
The Role
You will be accountable for what GoCharting's web terminal, mobile apps and website ship, when they ship and how reliably they work. The role is full-time and remote from Europe, reports to the Chief Executive Officer, and leads a team across India and Europe, with working hours that overlap the Chennai team. This is an immediate need. It is a leadership role: you direct the team and review its work rather than carry a feature queue. Client engineering needs one accountable owner for delivery, standards and staffing, and you are that owner. At 3 to 6 months, releases should ship on the dates committed and pass a release gate that you own, and you should have the senior engineers and the QA lead in place.
What you'll do
Own delivery — commit dates for the terminal, mobile apps and website with the Head of Product, and answer for hitting them
Set and enforce engineering standards — branching, code review, CI/CD and the release gate, applied the same way to every engineer; the QA lead reports to you
Build the team — hire, develop and structure engineering managers, a staff engineer, terminal and mobile engineers and the QA lead
Raise technical quality — make the architecture decisions for the web terminal and mobile apps, and review the hardest designs yourself
Manage managers — set goals, review performance and coach the engineering managers who report to you
Report on delivery and quality — publish a regular view of delivery dates, defects and release health to the executive team
What we're looking for
Must-haves:
12+ years in software engineering on production web or mobile products
Has led an engineering organization of 10 or more engineers
Has managed engineering managers, not only individual contributors
Has owned release and quality standards for a production product: branching, code review, CI/CD and a release gate
Has led engineering for a trading, brokerage, fintech or market-data product (any one counts)
Based in Europe, in a UK or EU time zone, with at least 4 hours of working-day overlap with 09:00–18:00 IST
Nice-to-haves:
Real-time or data-dense web applications, such as charting or WebSocket-driven UIs (adds the ability to judge terminal architecture)
Mobile app delivery to the App Store and Google Play (adds oversight of mobile releases)
Leading teams split across India and Europe or the US (adds ease with our time zones)
Setting up QA automation and release gating from scratch (adds speed on the release gate)
A charting SDK or developer-facing library (adds depth on the charting platform)
Logistics
Location Remote - Europe (UK and EU time zones), at least 4 hours of overlap with 09:00–18:00 IST
Employment type Full-time
Entity GoCharting Inc
Reports to Chief Executive Officer
Start date ASAP
