jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
Vice President of Engineering
OUR COMPANY
SimX is a fast-growing company that has brought virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors and save lives.
Over the last decade, demand for our product has exploded; we are now used by 10 of the nation’s top 15 hospitals, including world-renowned institutions like the Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Pennsylvania, our product is used around the world, and our technology is deployed across more than 50 US Military installations. We are looking for a mission-driven engineering leader to help us continue this momentum and achieve our mission to save lives around the world through better, faster, and more accessible simulation training.
THE MISSION
Reporting directly to the CEO, the Vice President of Engineering will be the executive leader of our engineering organization. Your mission is to further develop the maturity of our engineering organization, foster a culture of engineering excellence in a time of unprecedented change to engineering practices, and accelerate the delivery of our life-saving VR products. You will guide the evolution of our technical platform, ensuring it is robust, scalable, extensible, and capable of supporting our rapid growth as we scale toward $50M+ in ARR and beyond.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Engineering Leadership & Vision
Partner with the CEO, CTO, and executive team to define and execute the technical and engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with our mission, product strategy, and market expansion goals.
Architect a long-term engineering strategy that balances rapid feature delivery with scalable, secure, and maintainable infrastructure.
Define, track, and report engineering KPIs that give the executive team and Madison Industries leadership clear visibility into delivery, quality, and team health.
Adapt the engineering organization to the rapidly advancing frontier of engineering processes, including the ubiquitous use of AI tooling, in order to maximize the performance of the team.
Team Building & Organizational Scaling
Recruit, mentor, and develop a world-class, distributed engineering team, scaling the organization to support a business 10x its current size.
Establish robust engineering management practices, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
Manage the company’s Engineering division, including direct reports at the Director level and technical leads and individual contributors through the reporting chain, and own its organizational design.
Develop a strong engineering leadership bench (managers and technical leads) and ensure they are capable of independently owning major engineering areas as the organization grows.
Engineering Execution and Effectiveness
Own the end-to-end software development lifecycle, driving disciplined agile practices that deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Clinical Education teams to ensure engineering outputs consistently meet the rigorous standards required for professional healthcare training.
Drive operational excellence by ensuring adoption and continuous improvement of best practices (e.g., optimizing CI/CD pipelines, automating testing, reducing technical debt), as well as integrating new approaches (e.g., AI-driven testing, automated code reviews, etc.) when appropriate.
Architecture, Quality, & Security
Oversee the design and evolution of our platform architecture, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability across global education, hospital and military deployments.
Complete the platform’s transition to a fully composable architecture of well-separated, extensible components that can be combined to serve any scenario, product, or market.
Standardize how platform components are designed, described, and documented (consistent interface contracts and rich, machine-readable metadata) to ensure that scenarios and products can be composed through tooling.
Establish engineering standards that ensure software is secure, reliable, maintainable, and observable throughout the software development lifecycle.
Lead continuing efforts to support our enterprise customers via an engineering focus on security and compliance (e.g., SOC 2 and other relevant certifications, secure software development lifecycle, and broad adoption of best practices).
Own engineering metrics related to software quality, platform reliability, security posture, technical debt, and performance.
Establish engineering ownership for production reliability, including monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
QUALIFICATIONS
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role (VP, Senior Director, or equivalent) in a high-growth environment.
Proven experience scaling a SaaS, gaming, or EdTech company’s engineering organization through significant growth phases (e.g., $10M to $50M+ ARR); experience specifically at a B2B company selling to enterprise customers preferred.
Deep technical expertise in modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering tooling and practices.
Experience leading engineering organizations through navigating regulatory requirements and security and compliance initiatives such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar, and including integrating secure development practices into the software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated success in recruiting, managing, and retaining high-performing, distributed engineering teams.
U.S. Citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. SimX is unable to sponsor visas at this time.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a PE or VC-backed environment.
Previous experience in the healthcare, simulation, gaming, or medical technology industries.
Hands-on experience with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine and VR/AR hardware ecosystems.
Experience building and managing distributed teams in a remote-first environment.
Experience leading component-based platforms, including standardized component models and interface contracts, consistency and reuse across a large library of parts, and self-describing systems (schemas, metadata, documentation) that authoring tools and non-technical users can build on without engineering involvement.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Target salary range: $255,000 - $285,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus a 15% annual performance bonus based on business performance targets.
Equity Appreciation Rights (EARs), which let you share directly in the value created as the company grows.
• Remote work environment.
SimX covers 99% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums for medical, dental, and vision.
• 401(k) with employer matching.
Company laptop, home office credit, and internet reimbursement.
• Unlimited PTO.
SimX is an equal opportunity employer. Our goal is to have a workforce that represents the full diversity of the health professionals that we aim to train and the patients whose care we want to improve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. SimX is committed to making reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.
The hiring department will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate.
SimX may use AI tools to help organize and summarize application materials. These tools support our hiring team; they do not make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a person, and all decisions about advancing candidates are made by our hiring team. OUR COMPANY

SimX is a fast-growing company that has brought virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors and save lives.

Over the last decade, demand for our product has exploded; we are now used by 10 of the nation’s top 15 hospitals, including world-renowned institutions like the Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Pennsylvania, our product is used around the world, and our technology is deployed across more than 50 US Military installations. We are looking for a mission-driven engineering leader to help us continue this momentum and achieve our mission to save lives around the world through better, faster, and more accessible simulation training.
THE MISSION

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Vice President of Engineering will be the executive leader of our engineering organization. Your mission is to further develop the maturity of our engineering organization, foster a culture of engineering excellence in a time of unprecedented change to engineering practices, and accelerate the delivery of our life-saving VR products. You will guide the evolution of our technical platform, ensuring it is robust, scalable, extensible, and capable of supporting our rapid growth as we scale toward $50M+ in ARR and beyond.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Engineering Leadership & Vision

items: Partner with the CEO, CTO, and executive team to define and execute the technical and engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with our mission, product strategy, and market expansion goals.
Architect a long-term engineering strategy that balances rapid feature delivery with scalable, secure, and maintainable infrastructure.
Define, track, and report engineering KPIs that give the executive team and Madison Industries leadership clear visibility into delivery, quality, and team health.
Adapt the engineering organization to the rapidly advancing frontier of engineering processes, including the ubiquitous use of AI tooling, in order to maximize the performance of the team.

blocks.text: Team Building & Organizational Scaling

items: Recruit, mentor, and develop a world-class, distributed engineering team, scaling the organization to support a business 10x its current size.
Establish robust engineering management practices, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.

Manage the company’s Engineering division, including direct reports at the Director level and technical leads and individual contributors through the reporting chain, and own its organizational design.
Develop a strong engineering leadership bench (managers and technical leads) and ensure they are capable of independently owning major engineering areas as the organization grows.

blocks.text: Engineering Execution and Effectiveness

items: Own the end-to-end software development lifecycle, driving disciplined agile practices that deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Clinical Education teams to ensure engineering outputs consistently meet the rigorous standards required for professional healthcare training.

Drive operational excellence by ensuring adoption and continuous improvement of best practices (e.g., optimizing CI/CD pipelines, automating testing, reducing technical debt), as well as integrating new approaches (e.g., AI-driven testing, automated code reviews, etc.) when appropriate.

blocks.text: Architecture, Quality, & Security

items: Oversee the design and evolution of our platform architecture, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability across global education, hospital and military deployments.
Complete the platform’s transition to a fully composable architecture of well-separated, extensible components that can be combined to serve any scenario, product, or market.

Standardize how platform components are designed, described, and documented (consistent interface contracts and rich, machine-readable metadata) to ensure that scenarios and products can be composed through tooling.
Establish engineering standards that ensure software is secure, reliable, maintainable, and observable throughout the software development lifecycle.

Lead continuing efforts to support our enterprise customers via an engineering focus on security and compliance (e.g., SOC 2 and other relevant certifications, secure software development lifecycle, and broad adoption of best practices).
Own engineering metrics related to software quality, platform reliability, security posture, technical debt, and performance.
Establish engineering ownership for production reliability, including monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

blocks.text: QUALIFICATIONS
Minimum Requirements

items: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role (VP, Senior Director, or equivalent) in a high-growth environment.

Proven experience scaling a SaaS, gaming, or EdTech company’s engineering organization through significant growth phases (e.g., $10M to $50M+ ARR); experience specifically at a B2B company selling to enterprise customers preferred.
Deep technical expertise in modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering tooling and practices.

Experience leading engineering organizations through navigating regulatory requirements and security and compliance initiatives such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar, and including integrating secure development practices into the software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated success in recruiting, managing, and retaining high-performing, distributed engineering teams.
U.S. Citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. SimX is unable to sponsor visas at this time.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience in a PE or VC-backed environment.
Previous experience in the healthcare, simulation, gaming, or medical technology industries.
Hands-on experience with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine and VR/AR hardware ecosystems.
Experience building and managing distributed teams in a remote-first environment.

Experience leading component-based platforms, including standardized component models and interface contracts, consistency and reuse across a large library of parts, and self-describing systems (schemas, metadata, documentation) that authoring tools and non-technical users can build on without engineering involvement.

blocks.text: COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

items: Target salary range: $255,000 - $285,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus a 15% annual performance bonus based on business performance targets.
Equity Appreciation Rights (EARs), which let you share directly in the value created as the company grows.

items: SimX covers 99% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums for medical, dental, and vision.

blocks.text: • 401(k) with employer matching.

items: Company laptop, home office credit, and internet reimbursement.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. SimX is committed to making reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

The hiring department will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate.

Every application is reviewed by a person, and all decisions about advancing candidates are made by our hiring team. jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
ABOUT TERRA DOTTA:
Terra Dotta is a global software company that provides more than 700 organizations with software that allows them to manage international education programs. Terra Dotta offers an exciting workplace dealing with organizations worldwide and working with staff who have worked, lived, and studied around the globe. We foster internationalization for incoming and outgoing teams, faculty, and students, increase travelers’ safety and reduce organization liability.
OUR VISION:
Transforming the future through global connections today.
OUR MISSION:
Develop innovative solutions that delight and empower international educators by expanding their global impact, fostering life-changing cultural exchanges, and preparing students to flourish in a global community.
Career Path
This role offers a clear path to Chief Technology Officer for the right leader. Advancement is earned through consistent delivery, sound technical judgment, and measurable business impact. As results build, the role grows in authority and in visibility with our customers, our investors, and the Board.
In your first 6 months, you will learn how our lifecycle works in practice and set baseline metrics. By the end of year one we expect a predictable roadmap, measured gains from AI, and cloud spend within budget. Those results are the foundation for the CTO conversation.
Position Overview
The Vice President of Engineering leads 21 engineers across five product lines and reports to the COO, with regular access to the CEO and the Board. We are looking for an operator: a leader who has run engineering and infrastructure at scale, who knows what good delivery looks like from the inside, and who builds the management systems that keep a team predictable without needing your constant presence.
You will step into an organization with a formal software development lifecycle already in place across Product, Engineering, and QA. It gives you a strong foundation, clear checkpoints, and reliable data from day one. Your first priority is to run engineering within it and deliver on our commitments. From there you will have the authority and the support to shape it, introduce new approaches, and change how we build.
You will own infrastructure strategy, cloud cost, and vendor relationships, working with the infrastructure lead who runs daily operations and treating that team's results as your own. You will partner with our Chief Architect so that architecture and infrastructure are ready before every product launch, and work side by side with our Product Managers so that requirements are clear and complete before development begins.
A proven, modern approach to engineering is a requirement. You will lead how the team uses AI, not as an experiment but as a standard operating practice across design, development, testing, and release, with measurable gains in speed, quality, and cost and honest reporting on where it pays off and where it does not.
Responsibilities
Operations and delivery. Build the systems, cadence, and performance visibility that make engineering predictable. Deliver on time & on budget & use delivery data to keep improving the lifecycle with Product & QA.
Product and architecture partnership. Work with Product Managers so requirements are clear before work is committed, and with the Chief Architect so architecture and infrastructure are ready before every major release.
Infrastructure, cost, and budget. Own infrastructure strategy, cloud spend, vendors, and the R&D budget, with clear cost targets and defensible tradeoffs.
Quality and security. Expand automated testing, CI/CD, and observability, run root cause analysis after incidents, and lead SOC 2 and HECVAT reviews and enterprise security terms.
AI and modern engineering. Standardize AI across the lifecycle with measurable targets and honest reporting and contribute to our broader AI and data platform direction.
People. Hire, develop, & retain strong managers & engineers across distributed teams (on & offshore).
Customers and reporting. Join customer escalations when needed, and give the COO, CEO, and Board transparent, data driven reporting on delivery, reliability, cost, and budget.
Qualifications
10 or more years in software engineering, with 5 or more leading engineering managers at VP or senior director scope in B2B SaaS
Experience running and operating technology at scale, not just building it, with reliability, uptime, and incident response among your primary accountabilities
A record of building management systems that keep teams predictable without you, and of managing by numbers such as cycle time, defect escape rate, and on time release rate
Documented results from AI adoption in an engineering team, including where it fell short
Deep AWS experience and cloud cost reductions you can show in numbers, with experience owning DevOps and SaaS Operations or treating its outcomes as your own
Close work with Product leaders on requirements, and with Legal and Sales on security terms, including SOC 2 and enterprise contract negotiation
Experience in a private equity backed or metrics driven environment with R&D budgeting
Composure during issues, a customer first approach, & a low ego style. You speak up & push back with data
Preferred
Led a legacy to new platform migration with live customers (ColdFusion a plus)
Familiarity with enterprise data platform design and AI enabled integrations
Higher education or other vertical B2B SaaS experience
What makes us a great place to work?
Unlimited paid time off, 13 paid holidays, and unlimited wellness (sick) time off.
Medical, dental, and vision benefits (Blue Cross Blue Shield) - medical benefits start on day one!
Company-paid life insurance, short-term & long-term disability.
12 weeks paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paid paternity leave.
Automatic enrollment into our 401k on day one (Fidelity).
Access to physical and mental wellness programs.
Financial literacy training with Fidelity.
Exceptional colleagues with a passion for global education!

jobs.title: Head of Data - Engineering
jobs.text:
Remote - occasional trips to the London office
About Mojo Mortgages
We're not your average mortgage brokerage. We're a fast-moving, ever-evolving fintech on a mission to disrupt the industry. With a buzzing, high-energy environment, we're constantly pushing boundaries to deliver smarter solutions and better outcomes for our customers. Change is constant here, and so is our drive to work faster, think bigger, and raise the bar.
We’re part of RVU, a group of online brands that include: Confused.com, Uswitch, Tempcover, and money.co.uk.
Mojo Mortgages is building the UK's most intelligent mortgage broker, combining human expertise with AI across the full customer journey. Data is the foundation everything sits on.
This is a place for top performers. People who thrive under pressure, embrace challenge, and want to be part of building something exceptional. At the heart of everything we do are our behaviours: Care personally, challenge directly, put people first, keep exploring, love what you do, and always be accountable. If that sounds like you, we want you on the journey with us.
Role Overview
As Head of Data, you’ll lead & coach our data team and be the face of data across the business. You’ll report directly to the VP of Engineering and partner with them to shape and own the data roadmap. You’ll work with leaders across the business to turn their priorities into actionable data projects that deliver insight and drive decisions.
Over the next 12-18 months you’ll lead key initiatives such as a unified customer view, domain-aligned data products and real-time analytics and reporting. This is a hands-on role where you’ll stay close to delivery, guiding technical design, unblocking your team, and leading high-leverage analyses while focusing on developing the team around you.
What you'll be doing
Lead and develop the team
Coach and mentor a team of 5 composed of analysts and engineers, building clear career paths and objectives
Set the team’s standards and ways of working; how work is prioritised, reviewed, documented and delivered
Build a culture of high performance, continuous improvement and innovation within the team
Be the face of data in the business
Present data strategy, progress and insight to cross-functional leaders through regular reviews, turning complex data topics into clear recommendations
Partner with our senior leaders to translate commercial priorities into a clear, prioritised data backlog
Collaborate with teams across the business to understand their priorities, shape requests into well-defined data work and manage trade-offs openly
Communicate clearly how data projects contribute to the wider business objectives
Build data literacy and trust, so business decisions are made based on shared, reliable data
Work closely with our Salesforce team to ensure a holistic view of data governance across systems
Shape and deliver the data roadmap
Shape and own the data roadmap with the VP of Engineering, aligned to our wider technical strategy and business objectives
Design and contribute to the single source of truth for critical business entities and implement processes that ensure the rest of the business builds on solid data foundations
Develop data products that allow self-service data access in a controlled manner
Be hands-on with analysis for key business decisions, from defining metrics to presenting findings
Own data quality and governance in an FCA-regulated environment, where accurate audit trails are a regulatory requirement
What we're looking for
Excellent people management skills with the ability to coach and mentor analysts and data engineers
Excellent communication skills and confident in presenting to and working with various stakeholders across the business, both technical and non-technical
Experience in a data leadership role, with a background in analytics, analytics engineering or a related data discipline
A proven track record of leading data projects in a fast-paced environment ruthlessly prioritising competing business demands and structuring team workflows
Hands-on experience in SQL and BigQuery with strong data modelling skills
Hands-on experience working with frontier LLMs
Ability to balance hands-on execution with longer-term strategic planning
It Would Be Great If You Had
A fintech or regulated financial services background
Experience with real-time or event-driven architectures
Exposure to machine learning
What we offer
Remote-first working with the option to work anywhere in the world for up to 22 days per year
25 days holiday plus bank holidays (up to 28 days with length of service)
Half-day holiday for your birthday and a day off for moving house
Pension via People’s Pension
Wellness programme from Able Futures and subsidised private medical insurance
Critical illness cover and death in service
Enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay
Compassionate leave and long-service awards
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
If this sounds like the role for you, apply now and be a part of our journey to revolutionise the mortgage industry at Mojo Mortgages.

jobs.title: Sr. Vice President - Head of Value Engineering
jobs.text:
The SVP, Head of Value Engineering turns the Sapiens AIP and SaaS proposition into a financial case a CEO, CFO or COO of an insurance carrier will sign. The role owns the value methodology, the business case models and the people who build them, and it carries that case from first conversation through contract to proven realization.
The role adopts the lifecycle model used by Value Advisory teams in the Enterprise Software industry, adapted for insurance. The idea is to run value as one journey: benchmark and diagnose before the deal, build the business case, then track realization after go-live, supported by platforms for benchmarking, business cases and TCO. The team combines external benchmark data with a customer's own process data to size and prioritize opportunities.
Discover: executive interviews and workshops; benchmark the carrier's KPIs against peers to find the value drivers.
Quantify: build the ROI and TCO case, with the carrier's own numbers and agreed assumptions.
Commit: anchor the case in the proposal, contract and program governance.
Realize: with Customer Success, track delivery of benefits after go-live against the original case.
Amplify: convert proven results into references, renewals and expansion.
Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer
Location: Europe or USA, with regular travel to clients and regional sales teams.
Team: Regional Value Engineers and Business Value Advisors, plus a small team for models, benchmarks and tooling.
Key Partners: Sales leadership, Industry Practice Heads, Product, Finance, Customer Success and Marketing
Job Responsibilities
Financial case for the C-level buyer
Convert the AIP and SaaS proposition into CFO-grade business cases: ROI, NPV, payback, TCO versus legacy and on-premise, and the shift from capex to opex.
Quantify value across expense ratio, speed to market, straight-through processing, claims and servicing efficiency, retention and growth, and risk and compliance.
Lead executive interviews and value workshops with CEOs, CFOs, COOs and CIOs of insurers; hold the case up under finance and procurement scrutiny.
Methodology, models and benchmarks
Own the Sapiens value framework, model library and assumptions governance, so every case is consistent, auditable and defensible.
Build an insurance benchmark and KPI baseline library by line of business and region, and decide the tooling for modeling and tracking.
Pursuit and deal support
Embed value engineering in qualification, proposal and negotiation for strategic pursuits; align pricing, packaging and commercial structure to the value case.
Partner with Industry Practice Heads, Presales and Sales leadership on pursuit strategy and executive sponsorship.
Value realization
With Customer Success and Delivery, define value milestones, track realized benefits post-go-live, and use the results to support renewal and expansion.
Convert proven outcomes into quantified references, case studies and analyst proof points.
Leadership and enablement
Build and lead a regional team of Value Engineers and Business Value Advisors; train the field on value-based selling and discovery.
Give Product and Finance structured feedback on value drivers, pricing and packaging.
Job Requirements
15+ years in value advisory, strategy or management consulting, enterprise software sales or insurance technology, including 5+ years leading value engineering or business-case teams.
Proven record, building business cases and financial models that CFOs have accepted for multi-year SaaS and platform investments.
Strong finance acumen: ROI, NPV, TCO, cash-flow phasing, and subscription and cloud-transition economics.
Insurance domain knowledge across Life, Annuity and P&C operating models; credibility with insurer C-suites.
Experience with benchmarking, value-management tooling and post-sale value realization.
Executive presence and facilitation skills; able to influence Sales, Product and Finance without direct authority.
Bachelor's degree in business, finance or engineering required; MBA or equivalent preferred.

jobs.title: Head of Lending Product
jobs.text:
About FairMoney
FairMoney is building a digital financial platform for emerging markets. We started with digital consumer lending, and credit remains a core business. We serve different customer segments with secured and unsecured credit products that vary in loan size, tenor, pricing and risk profile. Nigeria is our largest market, and we’re expanding across other emerging markets.
About the role
As Head of Lending Product, you’ll own Lending Product end to end. You’ll set the strategy, lead the product management team and be accountable for the customer experience and business outcomes. Your mandate is to grow consumer lending profitably while improving how well our credit products fit customers’ needs, protecting portfolio quality and increasing long-term customer value.
What you’ll own
Lending strategy and portfolio. Decide which customer segments, products and capabilities to prioritise across QuickLoan, Consumer Loan, RCL/FlexiCredit, Asset Finance and adjacent credit products. Keep QuickLoan as the product that serves customers at scale. Use revolving credit and loans for salaried customers to deepen relationships where those products meet borrowers’ needs. Define eligibility, which product to offer next, when customers can qualify for another product, and how pricing, limits and repayment terms should evolve.
Profitable, risk-adjusted growth. Partner with Credit Risk, Data Science and Finance on disbursements, pricing and portfolio quality. Grow contribution after accounting for credit losses, funding costs and servicing costs.
The full lending lifecycle. Own the customer journey from application, decisioning and offers through disbursement, repayment, servicing and delinquency. Work with the teams that build and operate these journeys to improve both the main flows and what happens when something goes wrong.
Customer insight and experimentation. Stay close to borrowers through direct research and use funnel data, decline reasons, repayment behaviour, collections outcomes and customer support feedback to identify problems. Run experiments with clear success measures and use the results to decide what to scale, change or stop.
Product team leadership. Lead and develop the lending product managers. Give each PM clear ownership of outcomes, make explicit prioritisation decisions and align Engineering, Credit Risk, Data Science, Growth and Collections. Resolve dependencies, build capabilities that can be reused across lending products and stop work that delivers little value.
What you’ll own
Lending strategy and portfolio. Decide which customer segments, products and capabilities to prioritise across QuickLoan, Consumer Loan, RCL/FlexiCredit, Asset Finance and adjacent credit products. Keep QuickLoan as the product that serves customers at scale. Use revolving credit and loans for salaried customers to deepen relationships where those products meet borrowers’ needs. Define eligibility, which product to offer next, when customers can qualify for another product, and how pricing, limits and repayment terms should evolve.

Run experiments with clear success measures and use the results to decide what to scale, change or stop.
Product team leadership. Lead and develop the lending product managers. Give each PM clear ownership of outcomes, make explicit prioritisation decisions and align Engineering, Credit Risk, Data Science, Growth and Collections. Resolve dependencies, build capabilities that can be reused across lending products and stop work that delivers little value.
How you’ll use AI
Work with Engineering to revisit delivery timelines and change how you scope, sequence and staff work so teams can ship and learn faster.
Use AI directly as a product manager. Build prototypes and working flows, analyse data, draft specifications, develop test cases and create internal tools where appropriate. Help your PMs do the same.
Define with Engineering where AI fits across discovery, prototyping, coding, QA, release and iteration, and who is accountable for reviewing the work and making decisions at each stage.
Measure what changes against your pre-AI baseline. Track delivery cycle time, output, team size, defects and how quickly you learn from an experiment or release.
Turn practices that improve results into shared tools, playbooks and standards across the team.
What success looks like
Profitable lending growth. Disbursements and contribution grow, portfolio quality stays within agreed limits, and profitability improves after credit losses, funding and servicing costs.
Deeper customer relationships. Retention, repeat borrowing and customer lifetime value improve. Borrowers progress to products, limits and repayment plans that fit their needs and ability to repay.
A product team that delivers. PMs own measurable outcomes, teams resolve dependencies quickly, experiments inform decisions and shared capabilities support more of the lending portfolio.
Market immersion
Nigeria is our largest market. You’ll spend regular time in-market with customers and frontline teams. If you’re based outside Nigeria, you’ll need a plan for monthly travel.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.
What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.
For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.
Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.
The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:
Own end-to-end delivery across 4–5 cross-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.
Requirements
Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…
To think like a product owner, not a ticket-deliverer — you understand unit economics, funnels and growth mechanics, and the commercial impact of what your teams ship.
Experience personally establishing engineering rigor: architecture decision records, technical proposals and standardised ways of working that teams actually adopted.
Practical experience embedding AI tooling into the day-to-day engineering lifecycle — and a clear view on how to measure the impact and protect code quality.
To have led multiple squads through Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers in a high-growth scale-up or high-transaction marketplace or SaaS business, while staying close to the work.
At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.
It will also help you to have…
Experience with two-sided marketplaces or booking platforms.
Exposure to growth engineering or growth experimentation.
B2B SaaS experience at scale.
Benefits
We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.
How AI helps us find great people
Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application - it won't affect your chances in any way.
Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:
We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.
Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning
jobs.text:
About us
Qureight’s mission is to accelerate clinical trials and ensure breakthroughs in lung and heart disease reach patients without delay. Our AI-powered data and imaging curation platform enables the analysis of clinical imaging and other healthcare data, helping our customers bring treatments to market, faster.
We’re looking for talented people who want their work to matter. With offices in Cambridge and London, you’ll join our multidisciplinary team of clinicians, scientists, and engineers. What unites us is our open culture, continuous learning mindset, and a shared mission to help biopharma run faster, smarter trials.
About the role
Qureight develops AI-powered quantitative imaging tools that help researchers and pharmaceutical partners understand lung disease and measure treatment effects. Our Machine Learning team is advancing two closely connected areas: foundation-model research on large-scale medical imaging data, and applied ML research and development of clinically useful models, including segmentation and quantification methods that generate quantitative CT biomarkers for active clinical-trial programmes.
We are looking for an experienced Head of Machine Learning to lead, develop and support this growing team. The role combines proven people leadership with a strong ML research and technical track record, including taking models into production: creating clarity of purpose, helping experienced scientists do their best work, nurturing emerging leaders, and building an environment where ambitious research and reliable delivery reinforce one another.
The successful candidate will bring substantive contributions to ML methods, models or their deployment alongside proven experience leading scientists and engineers. They will work with the CSO, Principal ML Scientists and the wider team to shape scientific direction, priorities and standards across foundation-model and applied ML programmes, partnering with Engineering and Platform to take research prototypes into dependable production use. They will remain engaged in research and technical review, provide scientific mentoring, communicate trade-offs openly and empower colleagues to take ownership rather than prescribe solutions unnecessarily.
What you will do
Provide credible scientific and technical leadership
Guide and critically review technical approaches to self-supervised learning, representation learning, large-scale vision models, generative modelling, classification, segmentation and quantitative imaging models. Engage directly with experiments and code where this adds value, while respecting the team’s scientific ownership.
Set and maintain standards for experimental design, meaningful benchmarks, cross-dataset model-performance validation, reproducibility and critical interpretation of results, supported by clear experiment records, code review and research documentation.
Agree responsible use of AI-assisted coding and review tools, including LLMs, with Engineering, retaining human review and existing confidentiality, security and quality requirements.
Encourage publication-quality innovation across foundation-model and applied ML programmes where existing methods fall short, while ensuring that work addresses clinically relevant questions. Contribute to the ML intellectual property portfolio with the CSO and relevant colleagues.
Help researchers translate promising foundation-model capabilities and applied ML innovations into useful downstream applications, in close collaboration with applied ML and Data Science colleagues.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing ML team
Line manage senior ML staff, including Principal Scientists; provide regular developmental one-to-ones, constructive feedback, performance reviews and meaningful career pathways.
Support Principal Scientists in their scientific and leadership development, including constructive technical challenge, mentoring and people-management capability; delegate ownership and decision-making at the appropriate level.
Build a culture of trust, scientific rigour, openness and mutual respect in which people can challenge ideas, raise concerns early and contribute to decisions that affect their work.
Plan hiring, succession, capacity and team development in partnership with the ML team and People & Organisation.
Set shared direction and manage a balanced scientific portfolio
Work with the CSO and ML team to establish clear priorities, realistic milestones, roles and decision rights across foundation-model research and applied ML.
Balance exploratory research across both programmes with model development, performance evaluation, software validation, production deployment and clinical-trial delivery commitments; make resource and priority trade-offs explicit.
Revisit boundaries between foundation-model and applied activities as new models are specialised and deployed, encouraging shared expertise and avoiding unnecessary silos.
Create transparent planning and communication practices that provide accountability while preserving appropriate autonomy in scientific methods.
Lead model delivery into products and clinical trials (partnering with Data Science and Engineering)
Lead the ML team’s contribution from prototype through production deployment, working with ML Engineering, Platform and Product. Agree ownership of model testing, release, monitoring, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Work as a peer partner with the Head of Data Science on shared priorities, cross-team planning and strategic decisions where imaging models feed trial and research analyses. Agree biomarker requirements, validation evidence, versioning and release of model outputs for analysis, with clinical colleagues as appropriate.
Oversee model-performance evaluation and software validation as distinct, complementary activities. Agree traceability, documentation and change-control responsibilities with ML Engineering, Quality and Regulatory colleagues, including the evidence needed for release under the applicable quality system.
Represent the ML programme clearly to senior leadership, scientists, clients and collaborators, including limitations, risks, client value and realistic effort and delivery expectations; contribute these assessments to proposals.
Partner with Platform and colleagues responsible for data operations to establish dependable dataset management, versioning, provenance and quality-control practices that support reproducible research and model delivery.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
At Senra Systems, we believe that the future of manufacturing lies not in automation, but in configuration.
We supercharge electrical wire harness manufacturing through software configuration, transforming skilled assembly tasks into high-throughput production lines. We enable customers to design what they want, when they want it and deliver harness builds at record-breaking speed.
The Head of Engineering leads Senra Systems' Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering teams and sets the engineering vision, standards, and execution behind every wire harness and cable assembly we build for our aerospace customers. This leader builds on Senra's established practices to formalize, standardize, and continuously improve our engineering processes, documentation, and team structure as the company grows. Working closely with the Head of Production and the Head of Manufacturing Excellence & Training, this role designs and scales the processes that drive consistent, high-quality production. This role is central to delivering the quality, reliability, and on-time performance aerospace programs demand, and to positioning Senra as a trusted name in aerospace interconnect manufacturing.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Lead and scale the Engineering organization, owning manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, new product introduction (NPI), and sustaining engineering across all programs.
• Assess existing processes, documentation, and team structure, then define and standardize them into a clear engineering system, including work instructions, routings, BOMs, drawing standards, ECN/ECO change control, and document control.
• Own the NPI process from customer drawings through first article inspection (AS9102) and production release, so new programs launch on time and at quality.
• Partner closely with the Head of Production and the Head of Manufacturing Excellence & Training to design, implement, and scale manufacturing processes, making sure engineering standards, work instructions, and process changes translate into consistent execution on the floor and effective operator training.
• Drive manufacturing excellence through line design, capacity planning, labor standards, time studies, tooling and equipment strategy, and Lean and continuous improvement practices.
• Make sure engineering practices meet IPC/WHMA-A-620, AS9100, and customer-specific requirements, and partner with Quality on audits, root cause analysis (8D, PFMEA, control plans), and corrective action.
• Collaborate with executive leadership, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Sales to support accurate quoting, smooth launches, and consistent production.
• Serve as a trusted technical partner to aerospace customers on design reviews, DFM feedback, and engineering changes.
• Performs other duties as assigned.
Supervisory Responsibilities
• Directly supervises the Manufacturing Engineering and Industrial Engineering teams, with responsibility for hiring, training, performance management, coaching, and career development. Oversees engineering support for the full production floor and may manage engineering leads or supervisors as the department grows.
Required Qualifications
Education and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
• [10+] years of engineering experience in wire harness, cable assembly, or electromechanical manufacturing.
• [5+] years leading manufacturing and/or industrial engineering teams.
• Hands-on experience with NPI, first article inspection, and production launch in aerospace, defense, or another highly regulated industry.
• Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or other protected individual as defined by 22 CFR 120.62) due to access to ITAR-controlled technical data.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Deep knowledge of harness manufacturing processes, including cut/strip, crimp and termination, routing and formboard design, overmolding, and electrical testing.
• Strong working knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620 and AS9100 quality systems.
• Proven ability to bring structure and standardization to a growing organization, turning informal practices into documented, repeatable systems.
• Ability to recruit, coach, and develop engineers and to lead teams through growth and organizational change.
• Sound judgment balancing quality, manufacturability, cost, schedule, and customer requirements.
• Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and influence executive stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
• IPC-A-620 CIS/CIT certification.
• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt.
• Experience at a fast-growing or mid-sized aerospace or defense supplier.
• Experience with harness design tools (e.g., [Zuken E3, Capital, SolidWorks Electrical]), ERP/MES systems, and automated test equipment (e.g., Cirris, DIT-MCO).
• Experience leading multiple NPIs while supporting sustaining engineering and rate production at the same time.
• Experience introducing automation or new process technology on a harness production floor.
Compensation:
Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.
Salary Range: $250,000-300,000
This is an onsite role at our office in Cypress, CA
Benefits:
Unmatched opportunities to drive impact on a friendly and mission-driven team
Own a piece of the pie with equity participation!
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and long-term disability coverage
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Spending Account (DSA) for health-related expenses
20 vacation days per year and 12 company holidays for rest and relaxation
a 401(k) plan to set yourself up for retirement
Choose a record you love, and we’ll add it to our growing vinyl collection!
$50/month DoorDash credit – lunch is on us!
Up to $100/month reimbursement for gym memberships
Fully stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages
Regular team-building events, lunches, and the occasional breakfast burrito!
Bright, open office with communal spaces for collaboration and free parking
Conveniently located near the metro, major freeways and local dining spots
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Contact us at jobs@senrasystems.us or visit our website https://senrasystems.us.
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.
Pay range
$250,000—$300,000 USD

This role is for one of Weekday’s clients
Location: Remote India
Experience: 20+ years
Relevant Experience: 12–15+ years in Brand, Design, Product Design, or Creative Leadership
Employment Type: Full-time

Travel: Approximately 20%, primarily to the company headquarters in Hyderabad and for industry events as required.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Vice President – Design & Brand to establish, lead, and scale the organisation’s Design & Brand function as a strategic business capability.
This is an executive-level leadership role with end-to-end responsibility for defining the organisation’s brand positioning, design philosophy, product experience strategy, and creative direction. The individual will translate the organisation’s business vision and technological capabilities into a distinctive global brand identity, compelling product experiences, and consistent stakeholder engagement.
Working closely with the CEO and executive leadership team, the VP will influence business and product priorities, strengthen market differentiation, and position design as a key driver of innovation, customer confidence, and business growth.
The role will involve building and leading a high-performing in-house design team while managing external creative agencies and specialist partners across UX/UI, content, video, print, and production. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and overseeing creative execution, quality standards, and operational delivery.

jobs.title: Head of Product, PAYO Digital Bank - Stablecoin
jobs.text:
About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
Role summary
PAYO Digital Bank, N.A. (PDB), Payoneer's national trust bank subsidiary, is seeking a strategic, execution-focused Head of Product to own the product vision and roadmap for the bank's core offering: stablecoin issuance and redemption, customer onboarding, on/off-ramp experiences, built on the bank's core ledger and custody infrastructure.
This is a high-impact, high-visibility role reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer of PDB. The ideal candidate is a seasoned product leader with regulated payments or banking experience who is comfortable building zero-to-one in an environment where compliance is a design input, not an afterthought. You will hold a roadmap to a regulatory clock, run disciplined launch gates, partner ruthlessly with engineering on execution, and represent product decisions to OCC examiners with confidence.
Candidates must be based in New York, NY OR Miami, FL | Full-time
What you'll do
Product Vision & Roadmap: Define and own the end-to-end product vision for PAYO-USD issuance, redemption, and payment flows, sequenced against the bank's regulatory milestones from pre-opening exam readiness through controlled pilot to general availability.
Engineering Partnership & Execution: Act as the ultimate unblocker for the engineering team. Drive ruthless prioritization, define clear acceptance criteria, and manage technical trade-offs to ensure on-time delivery without compromising compliance.
Compliance-Embedded Design: Partner with Compliance to embed KYC, sanctions screening, and transaction monitoring controls directly into product flows. Document user journeys to a standard suitable for strict regulatory examination.
Launch Governance: Design the controlled pilot, including transaction volume caps, staged merchant onboarding, and clearly defined launch criteria. Enforce feature freeze discipline ahead of user acceptance testing.
Vendor & Platform Requirements: Own product requirements for the bank's core banking, custody, screening, and oracle infrastructure partners, driving integration decisions alongside Engineering.
Transparency & Trust: Shape product requirements supporting proof-of-reserve attestation so stablecoin holders can seamlessly verify 1:1 backing.
Stakeholder Leadership: Represent product decisions to the board, management committees, and OCC examiners as required.
Who you are
Product Leadership: 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years in payments, banking, or digital assets.
Regulated Environment Experience: Direct experience shipping products inside a regulated financial institution, ideally under OCC, Federal Reserve, or state banking supervision.
Zero-to-One Track Record: Demonstrated success taking a complex product from concept to launch, navigating technical dependencies, pilot design, and staged rollouts.
Stablecoin Mechanics: Working knowledge of mint/burn flows, reserve backing, redemption rights, and on-chain/off-chain reconciliation.
Compliance by Design: Demonstrated ability to build compliance requirements into the core product architecture rather than bolting them on afterward.
Regulator-Ready Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; comfortable producing documentation reviewed by regulators and external auditors, and presenting to examiners.
Not a must but a great advantage:
GENIUS Act Familiarity: Understanding of the Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuer framework.
SMB & Cross-Border: Experience serving SMB or cross-border payments customer bases.
In accordance with New York City Law, below is the annual base salary range for this position. Actual annual base salary is based on, but not limited to: experience, education, professional licenses, location and business needs. The position is eligible for health insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, 401k plan, paid-time off, and sick (and where applicable safe) leave. This position is also eligible for a discretionary year-end bonus.
The annual base salary range for this position is
$220,000—$320,000 USD
The Payoneer Ways of Working
Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.
Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.
Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.
Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

Modern technology resolves the historical power limitations of the concept, enabling stable, steady-state confinement and paving the way for scalable fusion power.
We’re looking for a technical co-founder to the venture. This role presents an extraordinary opportunity to translate core scientific objectives into robust, operable, and scalable fusion hardware, while steering a high-impact commercial venture onto the global stage. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months.

jobs.title: VP Engineering, Virtual Networking Control Systems, OCI
jobs.text:
This position is responsible for leading the Development and Operations of Virtual Networking Control Plane Services of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Specific responsibilities include:
Own, lead, and drive VP responsibilities including Engineering, Operations, building the right team to own the industry’s best cloud network.
• Co-own the product vision and roadmap for Virtual Network products of OCI. Influence product strategy and roadmap/direction.
• Foster and maintain strong/positive relationships across other groups and teams within Oracle, including dependencies such as Compute, Storage, Security, and Database.
• Review, plan, and lead new services, features, and programs critical to Oracle Cloud, our customers, and partners.
• Identify and build key strategic partnerships with other technology partners and companies across the industry.
• Ensure successful delivery based on team, division, and company priorities.
• Stay abreast of the latest innovations in the cloud technology space and apply them as appropriate to Oracle's service offerings.
• Lead by example, setting a clear culture of teamwork, high expectations, success, and customer focus.
• Manage, mentor and coach a team, helping them grow their skills and maximize their impact. Coach and lead the team to create rock-solid solutions, offerings, and remarkable products.
• Support/advocate/grow the role of software within networking – driving automation and monitoring that does awesome things.
• Demonstrated leadership and people management skills. Strong communication skills, analytical skills, thorough understanding of software engineering.
What you’ll bring
Leadership Scope: Lead a 100+ member organization spanning Virtual Network Control Plane and Distribution Services.
Domain Expertise: Deep expertise in virtual networking (CDN, Proxies, DNS, Load Balancers) and Compute.
Scale & Architecture: Proven track record designing and operating largescale, highly available, distributed network systems.
Operational Excellence: Strong ownership of ops – uptime, incident reduction , MTTR improvements, and reliability engineering practices.

Improve delivery processes, vendor accountability, documentation, and technology cost effectiveness.

Partner with internal Data Engineering and IT teams to integrate new solutions with existing systems and infrastructure.
Leverage AWS, Redshift, APIs, SQL, and enterprise data platforms to enable automation and intelligent applications.
Guide practical architecture, security, reliability, monitoring, and maintainability decisions.
Evaluate technology tools and investments based on scalability, business impact, and ROI.

8+ years in software engineering, technology development, solutions architecture, or related technical roles.
Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications, agents, automation, and software integrations.
Strong Python, API, SQL, and modern software development skills; familiarity with LLMs, RAG, and AI agent frameworks.
Experience managing external software development vendors, technical delivery, and complex stakeholder requirements.
Ability to convert business needs into technical specifications and production-ready solutions.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, databases, enterprise integrations, and software architecture.
Excellent communication skills with executive leaders, customers, vendors, and nontechnical teams.

Fleet management, logistics, transportation, or field-service software experience.
AWS, Redshift, enterprise data warehouses, and distributed development teams.
Experience coordinating enterprise customer integrations and technical product enhancements.
Evidence of measurable operational or financial ROI from deployed AI solutions.

First 90 Days
Establish working relationships with key customer technical stakeholders and external development partners.
Understand Fleet IQ architecture, open requests, delivery processes, and technical risks.
Implement a clear intake, prioritization, and delivery process for technical requests.
Develop and demonstrate an initial AI solution with measurable business value.
First 6–12 Months
Deliver prioritized Fleet IQ enhancements and integrations with reliable timelines and clear ownership.
Improve external development accountability, quality, and release execution.
Deploy multiple production-ready AI solutions across core business functions.
Demonstrate measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and operational performance.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Order
jobs.text:
Brief info about Vinted
Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:
Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.
Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.
Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.
Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.
Information about the position
Vinted is Europe's largest online C2C marketplace for second-hand fashion. Every purchase starts a journey: a seller prepares a parcel, a carrier moves it across Europe, and a buyer waits for it. Sometimes something goes wrong along the way. The Order domain owns everything that happens after a member pays: shipment preparation, the parcel's journey, problems and disputes, and refunds and compensation.
Our ambition is simple to say and hard to do: members should be certain about every order, and when something goes wrong it should be resolved fast and fairly, ideally without anyone having to contact support. As Director of Product, Order, you will lead this. You will set the product strategy for the post-purchase experience and lead a product organisation of five teams. Order is one of the most interconnected domains at Vinted, so you will also drive outcomes that depend on logistics, member support and payments partners.
In this position, you'll
Set the Order strategy: Own the multi-year vision and roadmap for the post-purchase experience. Turn certainty and fast, fair resolution into product priorities that members notice and that keep them coming back.
Own the trade-offs: Balance member experience, support and compensation costs, fairness between buyers and sellers, and consumer-protection expectations across many markets.
Lead across boundaries: Many of Order's outcomes start with logistics (Vinted Go), member support, payments or trust. Align roadmaps with these partners and win priority for the things Order does not own.
Modernise the foundation: Work with engineering leadership to move Order's core flows out of the monolith without stalling delivery, and make the case for platform work that has no direct euro value.
Lead and grow the team: Directly lead the Product Managers in the domain, raise the bar on product craft, and shape team structure as scope and scale grow. Stay hands-on in the product you are responsible for.
About you
Multi-team product leader: You have experience leading multiple product teams and/or managing other Product Managers in a scaled consumer marketplace, e-commerce, delivery or fintech business at scale.
Strong product and operations experience: You understand the challenges across the post-purchase journey, from fulfilment and logistics to payments, refunds, customer support and disputes. You know that many of the toughest problems happen at the intersection of the product, the carrier and the support team.
Commercial and systems thinker: You can turn cost lines (support, compensation, shipping labels) into product bets and size them. You know when an assumed link, such as cost reduction driving retention, still needs proving. You are comfortable deciding with incomplete information.
Hands-on and data-fluent: You are comfortable setting goals, defining hypotheses, designing experiments and deciding what success looks like. You work directly with data and use it to understand what is working, where to invest further and when it's time to change direction.
Credible technical partner: You can engage engineering leaders on architecture and platform trade-offs and own the sequencing that follows. You are also curious about how AI can help solve problems and accelerate progress towards business goals.
Work perks
The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

blocks.text: Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.
Information about the position

Vinted is Europe's largest online C2C marketplace for second-hand fashion. Every purchase starts a journey: a seller prepares a parcel, a carrier moves it across Europe, and a buyer waits for it. Sometimes something goes wrong along the way. The Order domain owns everything that happens after a member pays: shipment preparation, the parcel's journey, problems and disputes, and refunds and compensation.

Our ambition is simple to say and hard to do: members should be certain about every order, and when something goes wrong it should be resolved fast and fairly, ideally without anyone having to contact support. As Director of Product, Order, you will lead this. You will set the product strategy for the post-purchase experience and lead a product organisation of five teams. Order is one of the most interconnected domains at Vinted, so you will also drive outcomes that depend on logistics, member support and payments partners.
In this position, you'll

items: Set the Order strategy: Own the multi-year vision and roadmap for the post-purchase experience. Turn certainty and fast, fair resolution into product priorities that members notice and that keep them coming back.
Own the trade-offs: Balance member experience, support and compensation costs, fairness between buyers and sellers, and consumer-protection expectations across many markets.

Lead across boundaries: Many of Order's outcomes start with logistics (Vinted Go), member support, payments or trust. Align roadmaps with these partners and win priority for the things Order does not own.
Modernise the foundation: Work with engineering leadership to move Order's core flows out of the monolith without stalling delivery, and make the case for platform work that has no direct euro value.

Lead and grow the team: Directly lead the Product Managers in the domain, raise the bar on product craft, and shape team structure as scope and scale grow. Stay hands-on in the product you are responsible for.

blocks.text: About you

items: Multi-team product leader: You have experience leading multiple product teams and/or managing other Product Managers in a scaled consumer marketplace, e-commerce, delivery or fintech business at scale.

Strong product and operations experience: You understand the challenges across the post-purchase journey, from fulfilment and logistics to payments, refunds, customer support and disputes. You know that many of the toughest problems happen at the intersection of the product, the carrier and the support team.

Commercial and systems thinker: You can turn cost lines (support, compensation, shipping labels) into product bets and size them. You know when an assumed link, such as cost reduction driving retention, still needs proving. You are comfortable deciding with incomplete information.

Hands-on and data-fluent: You are comfortable setting goals, defining hypotheses, designing experiments and deciding what success looks like. You work directly with data and use it to understand what is working, where to invest further and when it's time to change direction.

Credible technical partner: You can engage engineering leaders on architecture and platform trade-offs and own the sequencing that follows. You are also curious about how AI can help solve problems and accelerate progress towards business goals.
