About the Role
The primary goal of the Director is to establish, nurture, and lead a high-performing engineering team that integrates seamlessly with the wider organization to deliver exceptional work and ensure client satisfaction.
The Director is responsible for balancing the needs of the Client & Program, People, and Company & Craft, while providing strategic direction and leadership across the Foundry.
Scope of Influence
The Director's influence extends across .Monks, their Foundry, and the Staff, Manager, Senior Manager, and Associate Director levels.
Key Responsibilities
Client & Program
Client Success: Provide strategic oversight of client relationships across multiple programs. Build strong partnerships with executive client stakeholders to drive long-term satisfaction and retention. Act as the ultimate escalation point for critical Foundry-related issues. Leverage industry trends, historical data, and client feedback to anticipate needs, identify recurring challenges, and drive improvements.
Delivery Excellence: Define and drive account strategy and vision, establishing a clear direction and a high standard for delivery quality. Champion the adoption of innovative technologies and methodologies to improve delivery effectiveness. Collaborate with peers to align delivery strategies and promote consistency and the sharing of best practices.
Account Growth: Contribute to the development of new service offerings to strengthen the company's market position. Partner with Marketing and Sales to drive account growth initiatives. Take ownership of major pitches and proposals, ensuring alignment with broader business objectives.
People
People Development: Establish and maintain high-performance standards through clear expectations, mentoring, and coaching. Lead learning and development initiatives that strengthen team capabilities, expand knowledge, and encourage the adoption of new technologies. Identify and nurture future leaders and high-potential talent. Oversee succession planning to support long-term organizational growth and resilience.
Culture: Lead by example in upholding and promoting company values. Actively reinforce the company's culture through coaching, engagement, and team initiatives. Identify trends that may indicate cultural challenges and drive appropriate improvements.
Building High-Performing Teams: Take ownership of building and continuously evolving the Foundry. Design effective cross-functional teams by identifying the skills and capabilities required to meet project needs. Foster inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team environments. Encourage autonomous and self-sufficient leadership teams. Build communities of practice that support continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and innovation. Establish scalable and flexible organizational structures that can adapt to changing business needs and emerging technologies.
Company & Craft
Company Strategy: Ensure alignment between the team and Formula.Monks' broader goals and strategic priorities. Define and lead forward-looking initiatives that create an impact across the organization. Manage budgets for internal initiatives, ensuring resources are used effectively and deliver strategic value. Take an active role in driving company growth.
Company Processes: Ensure compliance with company policies while contributing to the continuous improvement of operational processes. Refine Foundry best practices and identify opportunities to improve efficiency. Apply sound judgment when evaluating processes, recognizing where flexibility, automation, or simpler approaches can deliver better outcomes. Drive the adoption and sharing of impactful processes across teams.
Information Exchange: Communicate company strategy and key decisions effectively to the team. Keep the leadership team informed of significant risks and developments. Establish mechanisms that encourage collaboration across Foundries and eliminate information silos. Own internal communication to ensure clarity and transparency. Create an open environment where team members can raise questions, share concerns, and provide feedback. Lead external evangelism and thought leadership initiatives.
Talent Management: Forecast and plan future staffing needs to ensure the organization is equipped to meet current and long-term demands. Optimize the allocation of billable and non-billable resources in line with project requirements and business objectives. Keep job descriptions updated to reflect evolving role expectations. Actively support the onboarding of new leaders and continuously improve the leadership onboarding experience. Define and execute retention strategies to reduce employee turnover.
Competencies
Refer to the Foundry Competencies Matrix (TBD).
Qualifications
6+ years of experience in leadership and people management roles.
Experience building and shipping technical products with complex scope.
Excellent consulting, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Strong mentoring, coaching, and team-building experience.
Reporting Structure
People at the Director level report to Senior Directors and above.

About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Sandboxes
jobs.text:
About Docker
Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.
_______________________________________________________________________
The Role
The Products Team at Docker is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead our core Sandboxes platform. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap and execution for Docker’s sandboxes, taking this area from high-level concept design to delivery and adoption. You will manage a team of 2-3 product managers, coaching them and setting the bar for how we build. You will help shape the future of a key area of Docker, partnering with Engineering, Design, Security, and Go-to-Market leaders, and working closely with developers inside and outside of Docker, our customers, and our partners to expand our open ecosystem offering and provide value. As the company and ecosystem grow, you will build a team and a culture eager to continuously build, measure, and learn.
To thrive in this role, you’ll need a track record of leading product teams, along with deep experience working with developers and technical knowledge of developer tools. You’ll need to know how to work with the developer community and understand the lifecycle of software development, the software supply chain, and how AI agents are safely orchestrated and deployed with sandboxes. You’ll need a relentless drive to try new things, and an eye for detail. Your long-term success will depend on your ability to set and own the product strategy and roadmap, develop great product managers, collaborate with the developer community, and scale our services. Most importantly, you’ll need to be okay with taking ownership of big objectives with big goals, leading through cross-functional teams, and maintaining a bias for action.
_______________________________________________________________________
Responsibilities
You own the product line for Docker’s sandboxes: the long-term vision, the strategy, the roadmap, the revenue, and the results.
You lead and manage a team of 2-3 product managers. You coach them, set clear expectations and a high bar for product quality, and create the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.
You believe in and can articulate succinctly our customers and their pain points. You empathize with and understand the world they live in and the constraints they work through, and you make sure your team does too.
You will engage deeply with developers and find amazing solutions that solve today’s problems while optimizing for tomorrow’s vision, including how AI agents are safely run and orchestrated.
You enjoy building products that are easy to adopt and use. You have a keen design sensibility, and you hold your team to a standard of always looking for ways to improve usability.
You are comfortable with ambiguity and will guide product definition, prioritization, and scope across your team, in concert with Engineering, Design, Security, and Go-to-Market leaders.
You translate company strategy into a clear product direction and communicate it with clarity and conviction to partners and your own team.
You present your thinking, plans, and progress to Docker’s executive leadership team, making a clear case for where to invest and why, and you incorporate their feedback into the strategy.
_______________________________________________________________________
Qualifications
You have 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years managing and developing product managers.
You have deep empathy for the needs of developers and are obsessed with talking to your users.
You have created and deployed AI agents at scale and dealt with all the challenges and pain points of such tasks.
You have experience building B2B, SaaS, or have a background in Public Cloud.
You have experience working with tools in the software supply chain and/or software security.
You can set a multi-year product vision and strategy, then break it down into small, release-able, user-valuable features that your team can deliver.
You can explain complex ideas simply and communicate across diverse stakeholders, including presenting to executive leadership.
You have effective written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
You can analyze data, both qualitative and quantitative, to inform decision making, and you coach your team to do the same.
You have a collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence with fast-moving, distributed, cross-functional teams.
You have experience running products at various stages of maturity, from legacy to greenfield.
You are a coach/player. We are small and need all hands on deck. Everyone gets their hands dirty
Visa sponsorship: Not available for this role.
_______________________________________________________________________
Compensation & Equity
All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.
Canada: CA$381,472 - CA$429,156 base
United States: $280,000 - $315,000 base
______________________________________________________________________
Posting Information
Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.
______________________________________________________________________
Perks & Benefits
Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

blocks.text: About Docker

Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.
The Role

The Products Team at Docker is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead our core Sandboxes platform. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap and execution for Docker’s sandboxes, taking this area from high-level concept design to delivery and adoption. You will manage a team of 2-3 product managers, coaching them and setting the bar for how we build. You will help shape the future of a key area of Docker, partnering with Engineering, Design, Security, and Go-to-Market leaders, and working closely with developers inside and outside of Docker, our customers, and our partners to expand our open ecosystem offering and provide value. As the company and ecosystem grow, you will build a team and a culture eager to continuously build, measure, and learn.

To thrive in this role, you’ll need a track record of leading product teams, along with deep experience working with developers and technical knowledge of developer tools. You’ll need to know how to work with the developer community and understand the lifecycle of software development, the software supply chain, and how AI agents are safely orchestrated and deployed with sandboxes. You’ll need a relentless drive to try new things, and an eye for detail. Your long-term success will depend on your ability to set and own the product strategy and roadmap, develop great product managers, collaborate with the developer community, and scale our services. Most importantly, you’ll need to be okay with taking ownership of big objectives with big goals, leading through cross-functional teams, and maintaining a bias for action.
Responsibilities
You own the product line for Docker’s sandboxes: the long-term vision, the strategy, the roadmap, the revenue, and the results.
You lead and manage a team of 2-3 product managers. You coach them, set clear expectations and a high bar for product quality, and create the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.

You believe in and can articulate succinctly our customers and their pain points. You empathize with and understand the world they live in and the constraints they work through, and you make sure your team does too.
You will engage deeply with developers and find amazing solutions that solve today’s problems while optimizing for tomorrow’s vision, including how AI agents are safely run and orchestrated.
You enjoy building products that are easy to adopt and use. You have a keen design sensibility, and you hold your team to a standard of always looking for ways to improve usability.
You are comfortable with ambiguity and will guide product definition, prioritization, and scope across your team, in concert with Engineering, Design, Security, and Go-to-Market leaders.
You translate company strategy into a clear product direction and communicate it with clarity and conviction to partners and your own team.
You present your thinking, plans, and progress to Docker’s executive leadership team, making a clear case for where to invest and why, and you incorporate their feedback into the strategy.
Qualifications
You have 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years managing and developing product managers.
You have deep empathy for the needs of developers and are obsessed with talking to your users.
You have created and deployed AI agents at scale and dealt with all the challenges and pain points of such tasks.
You have experience building B2B, SaaS, or have a background in Public Cloud.
You have experience working with tools in the software supply chain and/or software security.
You can set a multi-year product vision and strategy, then break it down into small, release-able, user-valuable features that your team can deliver.
You can explain complex ideas simply and communicate across diverse stakeholders, including presenting to executive leadership.
You have effective written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
You can analyze data, both qualitative and quantitative, to inform decision making, and you coach your team to do the same.
You have a collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence with fast-moving, distributed, cross-functional teams.
You have experience running products at various stages of maturity, from legacy to greenfield.
You are a coach/player. We are small and need all hands on deck. Everyone gets their hands dirty

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - Financial Services
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
Our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) embed with customer engineering teams to build production-grade AI coding workflows and leave behind engineering practices that customers can sustain. As Regional Director, you will lead the team serving banks, insurers, asset managers, and other financial institutions globally, owning the quality of engagements from technical discovery through delivery and handoff. Success means production workflows that customers adopt, measurable progress against agreed outcomes, and customer engineers able to operate and sustain the work after handoff.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Strategists, reporting to the Global Head of FDE. Own hiring, coaching, performance management, staffing, and career development, and hold the team to a clear bar for engineering quality and delivery.
Own technical scoping: work backwards from customer outcomes, run discovery and architecture reviews, and turn ambiguous problems into time-boxed engagements with defined scope, acceptance criteria, milestones, risks, and change control.
Validate integration, infrastructure, and data constraints early, including retention, entitlements, PII, and other sensitive customer-data requirements, and hold the production engineering bar across engagements: code and architecture review, secure integration, evaluation of model behavior and workflow quality, observability, and failure handling.
Own delivery through deployment and operational handoff, making sure customer teams have the documentation, operating practices, and ownership to sustain the work, and partner with Sales and Legal so proposals, statements of work, and commitments match technical feasibility and team capacity.
Serve as technical owner and executive sponsor on the highest-priority engagements, guiding customers through procurement, third-party risk, security, compliance, and model-risk reviews, and working across engineering, business, and risk stakeholders to resolve tradeoffs.
Run a detailed feedback loop with Product and Engineering, turning recurring constraints and successful implementations into product feedback, reusable delivery patterns, and reference architectures, and enable GSI and consulting partners to the same standards as the in-house team.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience directly managing engineers who build and ship production software, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and setting technical standards.
Professional software development experience in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with the judgment to review code, assess architectures, and diagnose integration and production issues.
Experience building, deploying, and operating AI-powered workflows in production, including evaluating model behavior, debugging failures, and establishing appropriate observability and security controls.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
A track record of owning technical engagements from discovery and scoping through production delivery, customer adoption, and operational handoff.
Experience delivering inside regulated enterprises and serving as the technical owner through security, compliance, and vendor-risk review, with the ability to distinguish customer requirements from product capabilities and identify when specialist judgment is needed.
Experience delivering software and AI coding workflows in financial services, working with engineering, security, risk, and business stakeholders.
Familiarity with MSA and SOW mechanics, multi-quarter engagement cycles, and prerequisite legal and procurement reviews, partnering with Sales and Legal to establish feasible delivery commitments.
Experience translating applicable data-handling and model-risk requirements into engineering constraints, documentation, evaluation, and operational practices.
Experience presenting technical scope, delivery tradeoffs, and customer outcomes to executive and engineering audiences.
Experience enabling GSI or consulting partners to deliver technical engagements and building reusable approaches across customer teams.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Traveling to customer sites is required for this role.
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
The annual compensation range for this role is $288,360 - $432,000.
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Data Science Lead / VP
jobs.text:
DawnSecurity is building a next-generation cybersecurity platform. At its core is a hard applied-research problem, and this role owns it: leading our Data Science and Data Engineering team, directing algorithm research, building the models behind the platform, and driving the company's intellectual property.
What makes this role different
This is not a "train a classifier on labeled data" role. The core challenges are:
Learning without labels. The events that matter most are too rare to train on. Models must be built from structure, statistics, and synthetically generated signal rather than labeled examples.
Probabilistic modeling over graphs. The problem domain is inherently relational — entities, hierarchies, and connections — and the models must reason over that structure, not just over flat feature vectors.
Adversarially robust learning. An adversary can influence the data our models learn from. Robustness to manipulation and governed model updates are first-class design constraints.
Explainability as a requirement. Every score must decompose into a sentence a domain expert can act on. Opaque models that outperform explainable ones by a margin still lose here.
LLMs as components, not oracles. We use LLMs inside pipelines with statistical quality gates and human-in-the-loop escalation — knowing when not to trust model output is the skill.
Core Responsibilities
Research & Modeling Leadership
Own the research agenda: from hypothesis through prototype, empirical validation, shadow-mode deployment, and production.
Design probabilistic and statistical models for sparse, high-cardinality event data — scoring, smoothing, calibration, drift detection.
Lead graph-based modeling: entity resolution across heterogeneous sources, inference over large graphs, relationship discovery with tiered confidence.
Combine statistical models with rule- and constraint-based reasoning where the two must agree.
Define the evaluation discipline: synthetic data, shadow-mode comparisons, calibration audits, and precision targets tied to user trust.
IP Creation & Protection
Drive patentable inventions from the research roadmap: identify novel mechanisms, validate them empirically, and work with patent counsel on claims.
Distinguish what to file, what to publish, and what to keep as trade secret — and sequence research disclosures accordingly.
Engineering & Operational Excellence
Architect the sandbox-to-production path: streaming and batch pipelines, feature stores, model serving with low-latency inference at high event throughput.
Establish MLOps: versioning of code, data, and models; automated validation; monitoring that triggers governed retraining.
Balance startup velocity against platform sustainability; keep compute costs proportionate to value.
Team & Cross-Functional Leadership
Hire, grow, and retain a small, senior DS/DE team in a competitive market.
Translate algorithmic tradeoffs into risk/reward language for founders, board, and customers.
Partner with product and platform engineering so research lands as product, on a startup cadence.

jobs.title: Head of Information Technology
jobs.text:
Goliath is a fast-growing toys and games company, and this is the first time our IT team gets its own leader. You'll build the team, own the roadmap and steer IT through acquisitions, new factories and new countries. We're looking for a strong people manager who likes keeping complex projects on track.
Why this role matters
Goliath has around 350 people in 15 offices and sells in more than 100 countries, with brands such as Pressman, Crazy Aaron's and Lucky Duck Games. The IT team has grown with the company but has always reported straight to the CFO. You'll report to the CFO and lead a team of seven.
What you'll achieve in your first year
• Get to know the team, the business and our partners, and set clear priorities.
• Put a single overview of all IT projects in place, with clear planning, owners and budgets.
• Deliver the IT side of key initiatives, such as a new Crazy Aaron's factory, acquisitions and a new entity in Mexico.
• Build a security rhythm: regular audits and penetration tests, with findings followed through.
• Present an IT roadmap and budget that management backs.
What you'll do
• Lead, coach and develop seven people across system administration, Business Central and business reporting.
• Keep the overview of every IT project in the group, manage risks and dependencies, and report clearly to management.
• Manage the IT budget, licenses and contracts, and hold our Microsoft partner and security providers to account.
• Own information security, business continuity and GDPR compliance, working with Legal.
• Turn what Finance, Sales, Supply Chain and Marketing need into practical solutions.

jobs.title: Head of Ad Tech Development
jobs.text:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company and a proud Great Place to Work® Certified employer in the US.
As the Head of Ad Tech Strategy & Development in our NYC Office, you’ll play a vital role in driving commercial growth by identifying, developing, and scaling new business opportunities across the advertising technology ecosystem. This role focuses on creating new and non-traditional revenue opportunities that complement Taboola’s core sales business through innovative commercial models, product commercialization, market expansion, strategic partnerships, and emerging technology initiatives.
This role is responsible for architecting Taboola’s ad tech partnership and technology strategy as we expand beyond the open web. You’ll bring a deep understanding of the ecosystem’s ‘plumbing’ and relationships across supply, demand and technology players, shaping how Taboola builds its tech stack for future growth and turning that strategy into live partnerships that drive revenue, market share and long-term sustainability. You’ll be tasked with originating, structuring, negotiating, and launching new business opportunities—from initial concept through execution—that generate incremental revenue and strengthen Taboola’s competitive position.
The role reports to the VP of Global Sales Strategy and will manage and mentor an existing global team of partnerships managers, working closely with companies in the ecosystem and with internal product teams. This role will be expected to lead through and manage change across teams to align with overall strategy.
To thrive in this role, you'll need:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in Business Development, Commercial Strategy, Growth, Strategic Partnerships, or Strategic Sales within the digital advertising industry.
5+ years of experience within the advertising technology ecosystem with particular familiarity with CTV, measurement and data partnerships
Proven track record of originating, negotiating, and closing complex commercial opportunities that drive measurable business growth.
Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, advertising technology platforms, identity solutions, data products, and the evolving privacy and AI landscape.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute commercial strategies and bring new products, services, partnerships, or business models to market; end-to-end execution
Strong financial, analytical, negotiation, and strategic thinking skills; exceptional commercial acumen
Exceptional executive communication, relationship management, and influencing skills across senior business leaders and internal stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in an evolving and highly entrepreneurial environment.
Strong proficiency with AI tools in day-to-day work
Bonus points if you have:
Experience at a leading AdTech, MarTech, media technology, publisher, or commerce media company.
Experience working with media agencies
Existing executive network across holding companies, agencies, advertisers, publishers, technology providers, and the broader AdTech ecosystem.
Experience commercializing new products, launching new revenue streams, or expanding into adjacent markets.
Experience working with AI, agentic technologies, automation, or emerging media buying and selling platforms.
International business development experience.
MBA or advanced business degree.
How you’ll make an impact:
Ad Tech Strategy & Development
Develop and execute a business development strategy focused on identifying and scaling new commercial opportunities that complement Taboola’s core sales business.
Prospect, identify, and qualify new business opportunities through industry relationships, customer engagement, market research, conferences, referrals, and outbound outreach.
Build and maintain a robust pipeline of commercial opportunities, prioritizing initiatives based on revenue potential, customer demand, market opportunity, and strategic fit.
Identify new revenue streams, commercial models, customer segments, and monetization opportunities across the digital advertising ecosystem.
Lead the full business development lifecycle—from opportunity identification and discovery through business case development, commercial negotiations, contract execution, implementation, and launch.
Structure, negotiate, and execute complex commercial agreements, including technology licensing, data partnerships, reseller agreements, revenue-sharing models, and other revenue-generating commercial arrangements.
Develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and ROI analyses to support investment decisions and executive approvals.
Build repeatable playbooks for evaluating, approving and launching partnerships so each new opportunity isn’t approached from scratch
Evaluate adjacent markets, emerging technologies, and evolving customer needs to identify scalable growth opportunities.
Develop innovative commercial offerings by combining existing products, technologies, and services to address unmet customer needs.
Serve as the primary commercial lead throughout the negotiation process, building trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and prospective customers.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to ensure successful commercialization and launch of new business initiatives.
Monitor pipeline performance, forecasting, conversion metrics, and revenue contribution, providing regular updates and recommendations to executive leadership.
Technology & Data Partnerships
Leverage existing and develop new executive relationships across holding companies, agencies, data, measurement, brand safety and technology partners while developing strategic partnerships where they strengthen Taboola’s long-term growth strategy.
Identify, negotiate, and execute transformational partnerships that expand market reach, accelerate innovation, and strengthen Taboola’s competitive position.
Represent Taboola in executive partner engagements, strategic negotiations, industry forums, and key external events.
Develop partnership strategies that generate measurable commercial value, unlock new revenue opportunities, and strengthen Taboola’s long-term ecosystem.
Identify opportunities to expand the value of existing relationships through new commercial models, products, capabilities, and joint initiatives.
Establish executive-level relationships with key industry stakeholders and serve as a senior commercial representative for Taboola.
Agentic Ecosystem Development
Define and execute Taboola’s partnership strategy across the emerging AI and agentic advertising ecosystem.
Develop and execute strategic partnerships across emerging buy-side and sell-side agent platforms, agency technologies, and ecosystem partners that expand platform reach, accelerate adoption, and create new commercial opportunities.
Identify emerging technologies and business models that could reshape media buying, selling, optimization, and measurement.
Position Taboola as a preferred participant within next-generation media buying and selling workflows by building a differentiated ecosystem of strategic partners.
Develop commercial frameworks that accelerate ecosystem adoption, unlock long-term revenue opportunities, and strengthen Taboola’s leadership position in the evolving AI advertising landscape.
Represent Taboola in emerging AI and agentic advertising forums and help shape industry conversations around the future of digital advertising.
Market Intelligence
Maintain deep expertise and relationships in the digital advertising ecosystem, including:
Programmatic Advertising
DSPs, SSPs, and Ad Exchanges
Retail Media
Connected TV (CTV)
Identity and Privacy Solutions
Measurement and Attribution
Artificial Intelligence and Agentic Advertising
Monitor competitive activity, market trends, customer needs, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Personalization & Marketplace
jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
About the Role
Pinterest is becoming a performance-first ads platform, moving beyond its roots as a predominantly brand and social destination. Ads Quality sits at the center of that change. Personalization (Ranking) and Marketplace (Delivery) decide which ad each Pinner sees, where it shows, and what it earns. They balance three outcomes over the long term: Pinner satisfaction, advertiser return, and Pinterest revenue.
Success requires solving some of the hardest problems in ads marketplaces. These include measuring and improving ad relevance at scale, delivering ROAS that wins performance budgets, and building a yield system that balances first-party demand with high-quality monetization of every ad slot.
We’re looking for a Director of Product Management who has done this before: someone who has built and scaled ads ranking, delivery, or marketplace systems and turned them into measurable business results. Reporting to the VP of Product Management, Ads Quality, you’ll own the multi-year strategy and rebuild the Ads Quality product organization. You’ll lead a team of five PMs, scaling to 10–12 across two pods, and partner with an engineering organization of nearly 200.
What You’ll Do
Set the product strategy. Define the multi-year technical and business strategy for ads personalization and marketplace. Identify and size new opportunities, and turn strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, success metrics, and decision gates.
Own the value equation. Improve Pinner Value through better ad relevance and personalization, Advertiser Value as measured by ROAS, and revenue per mille (RPM), all with a lifetime-value lens. Define how relevance and satisfaction are measured.
Own delivery end to end. Drive discovery through launch and scale for new products and platform capabilities. Set architecture and quality standards, unblock critical technical and operating risks, and make sure the team has reliable measurement, experimentation, and operational readiness.
Build the team. Assess and reshape the current team. Hire senior product leaders for the Personalization and Marketplace pods, and coach managers and senior ICs. Establish clear ownership and operating rhythms, and build a culture of urgency, rigor, and customer focus.
Lead cross-functionally. Align Product, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Measurement, Ad Formats, Buying Platform, Ads Integrity, and Consumer teams around a shared plan. Make trade-offs explicit, drive decisions through ambiguity, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes to executive leadership.
Your Year One Priorities:
Accelerate Pinterest’s shift to a performance-oriented ads platform.
Prove ROAS delivery through new bidding types, much better personalization, and stronger conversion performance.
Deliver a more sophisticated, efficient, and transparent yield system that balances first-party demand with high-quality monetization of every ad slot.
What We’re Looking For
12+ years of product management experience, including senior leadership roles building and scaling ads products.
Proven track record of improving ads performance and revenue outcomes through ranking, delivery, or marketplace systems.
Deep expertise in at least one of the team’s core technical areas:
Personalization and relevance: ML-driven recommendation and ads delivery systems, including relevance measurement, or
Marketplace and ranking: auctions, bidding, pricing, and yield optimization at scale.
Fluency in balancing multi-sided marketplace outcomes (user, advertiser, platform) and making long-term trade-offs.
Excellent collaboration skills. You excel at finding common ground with partners who have different objectives to create shared goals.
Strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable driving advertiser ROAS and revenue outcomes, not just product metrics.
Background in marketplaces, ecommerce, or social/ads platforms strongly preferred.
Experience assessing, restructuring, and scaling product organizations, including hiring senior PM leaders.
Executive presence, with experience communicating strategy, trade-offs, and risk directly to senior leadership.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
In-Office Requirement Statement:
We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from our Palo Alto, San Francisco, Seattle, or Los Angeles offices.
Relocation Statement:
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
#LI-HYBRID
Our Commitment to Inclusion:
Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.
By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
FDNA is a pioneer in AI-powered phenotyping and precision health, dedicated to expediting the diagnosis and care management of rare genetic and developmental disorders. Used across more than 10,000 medical centers in over 130 countries, our ecosystem and products bridges the gap between concerned parents, healthcare providers, and life sciences organization.
About the Role
We are seeking a strategic, execution-driven Head of Product based in Latin America to own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and delivery across FDNA’s clinical, patient-facing, and interoperability product lines. Reporting directly to the executive leadership team (working closely with our Chief Product & Technology Officer, Chief Medical Officer, and AI Research leads), you will translate cutting-edge multimodal AI capabilities into intuitive, compliant, and clinically impactful products tailored primarily for the US healthcare ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Lifecycle Ownership: Define and execute the multi-product roadmap across Face2Gene, Family Health Checker, and FDNA’s Provider/Pharma Data Clearinghouse, balancing clinician utility, patient engagement, and B2B/life sciences monetization.
US Clinical Workflow & EHR Integration: Architect seamless product experiences that fit naturally into US pediatric, genetic, and primary care clinical workflows, driving HL7/FHIR-based EHR integrations, digital intake, and specialist referral pathways.
Regulatory & Compliance Governance: Partner with Legal, Clinical, and Security teams to ensure all product features strictly adhere to HIPAA privacy/security mandates, de-identification protocols, and FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) / Clinical Decision Support (CDS) regulatory boundaries.
AI-to-Product Translation: Collaborate closely with AI/ML engineering and medical genetics teams to productize novel multimodal models (facial analysis, video, audio, and clinical notes) while maintaining high standards for clinical transparency, bias mitigation, and explainability.
Cross-Functional & Nearshore Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale a distributed product management and UX/UI design function across time zones, fostering tight alignment between LATAM-based teams, US-based commercial/clinical stakeholders, and global R&D centers.
Customer & Market Discovery: Conduct continuous discovery with US health systems, pediatric specialists, genetic counselors, patient advocacy groups, and pharma/CRO partners to validate product-market fit and measure clinical and commercial outcomes.

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.
This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.
This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.
GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.
Join our team
GoDaddy is in the middle of a significant product transformation. Roughly two-thirds of our product development work now involves artificial intelligence, and the questions our product teams need answered have changed fundamentally. We're no longer just evaluating interfaces. But the dynamic human-AI systems: whether they're useful, trustworthy, recoverable, and understood by the customers who depend on them.
We are seeking a Director UX Research for the Product Experience group to join our team! Partnering directly with collaborators across business functions, your mandate is twofold. Set and uphold the research standard for user experience professionals conducting generative and iterative research. Support partner teams doing small-batch testing. Additionally, personally lead strategic and AI evaluation work that demands dedicated research depth.
This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a research queue. It's for a leader who sees research as both a customer intelligence capability and a product quality system and who knows how to operate both at the speed modern product development demands. GoDaddy's UX designers are capable practitioners who handle a significant volume of discovery and evaluative research. The research team's value is highest where that work can't go: complex AI experience evaluation, cross-product synthesis, foundational understanding of customer behavior, and the strategic questions that require dedicated depth!
What you'll get to do...
Research Strategy and Prioritization
Define a research agenda that sits ahead of product roadmaps, not behind them — identifying the questions that need to be answered before key product and architectural decisions are made
Partner with Product, Build, and senior Engineering management to align research priorities against product risk, customer impact, and AI complexity
Distinguish between what the research team should own directly and what the broader UX community can handle with the right support
Help GoDaddy continue to mature in how it uses AI to test, validate, and accelerate insight generation — developing a point of view on where AI-assisted methods are appropriate and where human judgment remains essential
Represent research as a key influence on product direction, not a validation step after building
AI Evaluation and Emerging Experience Research
Lead research into the human dimensions of GoDaddy's AI products: how customers understand, trust, accurately address, adapt to, and recover from experiences involving artificial intelligence
Partner on evaluation frameworks for agentic and AI-assisted features — contributing methodological expertise on trust, control, edge cases, and live-product monitoring — before and after launch
Bring leadership to research questions that don't have established playbooks: prompt and workflow analysis, human-in-the-loop testing, behavioral data interpretation in AI contexts
Stay current on AI-experience research methods and bring that knowledge into the team and the wider build group
Standards, Enablement, and Research Craft
Set the research quality bar for the entire Product UX organization. This includes UX designers conducting generative and iterative research, as well as partner teams running their own small-batch testing.
Refine existing frameworks, guardrails, and playbooks so that designers and partner teams can run clean discovery: when directional research is enough, when it isn't, how to synthesize and share findings, so they compound across the org
Lead all aspects of the continued development of UX designers running research — building research craft, raising quality standards, and driving the integration of AI research tools and methodologies into how the broader design organization works
Ensure shared infrastructure remains current and usable: repositories, taxonomies, participant panels, consent and data governance standards, AI-assisted workflows
Team Leadership and Development
Lead, mentor, and develop a research team that includes both existing researchers and new hires
Build toward complementary strengths across the team: generative and assessment-focused research, quantitative and mixed-methods capability, AI evaluation proficiency, and research operations
Mentor UX researchers directly on craft, career development, and the evolving demands of researching technology-enhanced product experiences
Build a culture where rigor and velocity are treated as compatible, not competing, where "directional and fast" and "deep and strategic" are both valued depending on the decision at stake
Cross-Functional and Organizational Influence
Operate as a peer to the Design, Product, and Engineering leaders — shaping product strategy, not just informing it
Partner with different departments to ensure research is connected to commercial priorities, not siloed within the build organization
Build organizational confidence that product decisions are grounded in real customer understanding, particularly as AI capabilities expand faster than product intuition can track
Your experience should include...
10+ years of UX or user research experience, with demonstrated proficiency in mixed-methods approaches
4+ years leading research teams, with direct responsibility for hiring, mentoring, and performance development
Meaningful experience researching AI-driven, technically complex, or developer-facing products
Track record of refining and operationalizing research standards, frameworks, or enablement tools that extended research quality beyond the immediate research team
Experience operating as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering leadership, not just delivering studies but shaping direction
Experience partnering with various departments beyond just a build or product organization
You might also have...
Experience in enterprise SaaS, SMB products, or multi-product platforms where research prioritization across a large portfolio was a core challenge
Familiarity with research operations at scale: participant recruiting infrastructure, insight repositories, governance frameworks
Proficiency working with behavioral data, product analytics, or telemetry alongside qualitative findings
Background in human-computer interaction, cognitive psychology, behavioral science, or related fields
We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.
About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.
At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.
We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.
GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.
Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.
Colorado Residents: In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.
Compensation & Benefits:
What We Offer:
Working at GoDaddy offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, parental and wellness leave, healthcare, retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
This role is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan, paid sick time, paid flexible time off, paid parental leave, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, AD&D insurance, mental health or EAP programs, remote or hybrid work options, paid holidays, paid Wellness days, tuition assistance, adoption, surrogacy, and fertility benefits, dependent daycare and backup care benefits, Employee stock purchase plan, financial education and advice; and other benefits in accordance with GoDaddy’s benefit plans and applicable law.
Actual compensation and benefits eligibility will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
Compensation:
The estimated pay ranges for this role are listed below. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for other forms of compensation, which may include a corporate bonus and/or equity awards, subject to the terms of applicable plans and individual eligibility.
Bay Area (Santa Clara, San Francisco) and Los Angeles:
$203,000—$304,000 USD
Austin, D.C. Metro, CA (non-Bay Area), HI, IL, MA, NH, OR, VA, WA:
$175,000—$262,000 USD
New York City Metro, Kirkland/Seattle:
$185,600—$278,400 USD
All other US locations not previously listed:
$156,000—$234,000 USD

jobs.title: Director, GraphAware Engineering
jobs.text:
About Neo4j:
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
Our Vision:
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
Director, GraphAware Engineering
The role
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Hume engineering: about 25 engineers in five product-aligned teams, plus the DevOps team, working across Europe.
Hume is a graph-powered intelligence analysis platform. Analysts in law enforcement, customs, financial crime and national security use it to find the connections that matter in their cases.
You will report to the Senior Director for GraphAware Products, who leads both product and engineering. You will work as a peer of the Director of Product Management.
You have two core responsibilities, and they matter equally. The first is the people: grow the engineering team in size, skills and knowledge, by hiring well and by coaching engineers into stronger engineers, tech leads and future leaders. The second is the system that lets those teams decide autonomously and deliver well: clear team ownership, sound decisions, predictable releases, secure practices and effective AI-assisted development. The two reinforce each other: a good system helps people grow faster, and people who grow keep improving the system. Engineering should not depend on a few individuals to resolve every architecture, release or staffing question, and that includes you.
This is a leadership role. You will not write production code day to day. You need enough technical depth to earn senior engineers' respect, ask the right questions in a design review and diagnose a production incident. Then you hand the decision back to the people who own it.
What you will own
Teams and people. Lead, coach and grow the team leads and tech leads. Build management and senior technical career paths, hiring within the team, and plan succession so no area depends on one person.
Delivery. Own engineering's organisation-wide commitments. Put in place planning, checkpoints and tracking that the teams run themselves, so risks and dependencies surface early.
Release quality. Treat everything we ship as the product: installation packages, Helm charts, Docker Compose, configuration and documentation, tested on every deployment environment we support, including on-premises and restricted environments. Own the definition of done, code-review discipline and vulnerability mitigation within agreed targets.
Secure engineering. Work with our Security & Compliance colleagues, who run the ISO 27001 programme, and make sure engineering practice meets it.
Technical ownership. Be accountable for Hume's overall technical excellence: architecture, code quality, performance and security. Challenge and shape the major technical decisions together with the tech leads, and set how decisions are made, challenged and recorded. Delegate design to tech leads and principal engineers, and evolve the architecture so most changes need only one team. Set clear guidance on where AI-assisted development helps and where it doesn't.
DevOps. Lead the DevOps team and own its priorities, balancing the teams' requests against platform improvements.
How you will work
You care about the problem we solve. Product owns what we build and why; engineering owns how and whether it is feasible. You care about the why as well. You understand how an investigation runs and what an analyst needs, and you join customer conversations to hear it first-hand. You bring trade-offs and alternatives to the Director of Product Management early, before commitments are made, so product and engineering plan as one.
You are part of the Science & Technology team, as well as engineering's leader. You bring engineering's view into its decisions early and openly, and you challenge them, including your manager's. Once a decision is made, you own it with your teams and explain the reasoning behind it. You build trust in both directions: engineers know their view is heard, and the leadership team can rely on engineering's commitments.
You communicate clearly, in writing first. You write updates people can act on, and decisions are recorded where everyone can read them. You explain difficult decisions plainly to engineers, to Neo4j colleagues and to customers. You bring decisions, not only questions.
You own engineering's response to customers and the field. In practice that means three things. Customer escalations and production issues get a named owner, a response and follow-through to the fix. Deployment and support questions from field engineers and customers are answered within agreed targets. And the release dates and scope the field shares with customers are ones engineering has committed to, agreed with the product team. You are the escalation point when something is stuck.
What you need to bring
Experience leading an engineering organisation of about 20 or more people across several teams, through tech leads or engineering managers, accountable for both delivery and people.
A strong background as a senior engineer and tech lead in backend, data or platform systems. You can review architecture across a JVM backend, a modern web front end, AI/LLM components and CI/CD.
Experience reorganising engineering teams around product domains, using Team Topologies, strategic Domain-Driven Design or similar, and bringing people with you through the change.
A track record of improving delivery, quality and release practices for a complex product that customers deploy themselves.
Clear written and spoken communication in English, and experience leading distributed teams across countries.
Nice to have
Graph databases (especially Neo4j), knowledge graphs or GraphRAG.
Building LLM-based or data-intensive products in production, and leading teams through adopting AI-assisted development.
Products for law enforcement, government or other security-sensitive customers.
Leading engineering through an acquisition or integration into a larger company.
What this role is not
Not the sole architect or a full-time coder: design belongs to the tech leads, and you make sure it is challenged and written down.
Not the product owner: you shape what we build through partnership with the Director of Product Management, not by deciding it.
Location
Based in Italy, Czechia, Spain, the Netherlands or the UK, working remotely with teams across Europe. Occasional travel for team gatherings, Neo4j and customers.
Italy only: The gross annual salary (RAL) range for this role when based in Italy is €90.000-€110.000. Salary is set individually for each candidate, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria such as experience, skills and scope of responsibility. Contract under the collective bargaining agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria). This information applies to Italy only. For other countries, please speak with the recruiter.
Why Join Neo4j?
Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.
Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.
Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.
One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.
Neo4j Values:
Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:
(we)-[:VALUE]->(relationships)
(we)-[:FOCUS_ON]->(userSuccess)
(we)-[:THRIVE_IN]->(:Culture {type: [‘Open’, ‘Inclusive’]})
(we)-[:ASSUME]->(:Intent {direction:’Positive’})
(we)-[:WELCOME]->(:Discussions {nature: ‘IntellectuallyHonest’})
(we)-[:DELIVER_ON]->(ourCommitments)
Neo4j is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. Please read the privacy notice regarding Neo4j's recruitment process to understand how we will handle the personal data that you provide.
More information at www.neo4j.com.

A strong background as a senior engineer and tech lead in backend, data or platform systems. You can review architecture across a JVM backend, a modern web front end, AI/LLM components and CI/CD.
Experience reorganising engineering teams around product domains, using Team Topologies, strategic Domain-Driven Design or similar, and bringing people with you through the change.
A track record of improving delivery, quality and release practices for a complex product that customers deploy themselves.
Clear written and spoken communication in English, and experience leading distributed teams across countries.

blocks.text: Nice to have

items: Graph databases (especially Neo4j), knowledge graphs or GraphRAG.
Building LLM-based or data-intensive products in production, and leading teams through adopting AI-assisted development.
Products for law enforcement, government or other security-sensitive customers.
Leading engineering through an acquisition or integration into a larger company.

blocks.text: What this role is not

items: Not the sole architect or a full-time coder: design belongs to the tech leads, and you make sure it is challenged and written down.
Not the product owner: you shape what we build through partnership with the Director of Product Management, not by deciding it.

items: Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.

jobs.title: Director of Security Operations and Engineering
jobs.text:
A Little About Us
EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com
The Role:
You'll lead Security Operations and Security Engineering at EDB, reporting to the CISO as a trusted member of the security leadership team. You own how we detect, respond, and (increasingly) prevent. That means the people, the platforms, and the playbooks behind threat detection, incident response, and the engineering that makes them scale.
You'll be a peer to the leaders across security, including Governance, Risk & Compliance and Application Security & Vulnerability Management, and you'll help shape the direction of the broader InfoSec organization. You'll also partner closely with peer leaders in IT and Product, because most of the controls we define live in their systems, pipelines, and roadmaps. This is a scaling role. The business is growing fast, and so is everything security has to cover: more products, more cloud, more acquired companies and environments to bring up to a common standard. You'll decide what to build, what to automate, and where to add people, so the program grows ahead of the risk instead of behind it. As EDB grows, so will the scope and opportunity of the role.
One leader owns both Security Operations and Security Engineering on purpose: the best incident is the one that never happens. What we learn from detection and response feeds directly into the engineering of preventive controls, so we move from detecting bad things to making them impossible, and from manual triage to automation and agents that give analysts leverage. If you want to build that, and grow a program and a team as the company grows, this is the seat.
What your impact will be:
Incident response end to end, from intake and severity model through after-action and improvement, including partnership with Legal on investigations
Detection engineering, threat hunting, and the SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and cloud security platforms that support them
Security Engineering strategy and delivery, with the goal of preventing incidents rather than responding to them: preventive controls, least privilege, and identity assurance across employees, contractors, and build systems
The insider threat program, built with HR, Legal, and IT
Automation and agentic AI that extends analyst capacity (the analyst always owns the decision)
Security integration of acquired companies and new environments into EDB's standards
Close partnership with IT and Product leadership to build preventive controls into the platforms, pipelines, and products they own, plus security input to third-party risk and device posture with GRC
Scaling the program: the org design, operating rhythms, roadmap, budget, and vendor strategy that let coverage grow with the business without growing linearly with headcount
What you will bring:
5+ years of management experience leading security teams
7+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, detection, or security engineering
A track record of scaling a security function through rapid growth (hiring, automation, and operating discipline), not just running one
Strategic thinking that goes beyond the immediate scope of the role
The ability to translate technical risk into business impact for executives, legal, customers, and your IT and Product counterparts
Comfort in a global, remote-first environment with flexible schedules and on-call responsibilities
What will give you an edge:
Hands-on scripting or automation experience (Python, Go, etc.)
Experience applying AI or agent-based automation to security workflows
Cloud security experience and background in M&A security integration
Experience building an insider threat or identity assurance program
EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.
We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!
EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.
EDB does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. EDB and its affiliates are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other similar payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written signed agreement between EDB and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
#LI-Remote
