jobs.title: Director of Product, AML & Digital Asset Compliance
jobs.text:
About the Company
Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.
CertiK has spent years building security, risk, monitoring, and blockchain expertise across thousands of digital asset companies and institutional customers. As digital assets increasingly become part of mainstream financial infrastructure, security, financial crime risk, and regulatory compliance are converging. We believe there is an opportunity to build a new generation of institutional digital asset risk and compliance products at that intersection. This role will have significant influence over what that product becomes. We are looking for someone who wants to build it.
About the Role
CertiK is building the next generation of risk and compliance products for financial institutions and digital asset businesses. We are looking for a product leader to own this product area from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery, go to market, adoption, and expansion. This is not an internal compliance role. You are here to build the products that compliance, AML, financial crime, and risk teams use. You will work directly with financial institutions, exchanges, VASPs, fintechs, and other digital asset businesses to understand how their compliance teams operate, identify the problems that matter most, and turn those problems into scalable products. The product space may include areas such as blockchain and entity risk, transaction and wallet monitoring, sanctions and KYT, risk scoring, investigation and case management workflows, continuous monitoring, and compliance evidence and reporting. A core part of your job will be deciding which problems CertiK should solve first and which ones we should not. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, Business Development, and company leadership to build this product line.
Responsibilities
Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for CertiK's AML and digital asset compliance products.
Spend significant time with customers and prospective customers, including CCOs, MLROs, AML teams, investigators, and risk leaders, to deeply understand their workflows and unmet needs.
Identify repeatable market problems behind individual customer requests and determine which problems should become scalable products.
Translate customer and market insights into product concepts, prototypes, requirements, and clear engineering priorities.
Drive products from discovery through design, development, launch, adoption, and iteration.
Define the key workflows, risk models, decision systems, and user experiences required by institutional compliance teams.
Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to make appropriate product and technical trade offs.
Partner with Business Development and customer facing teams during strategic sales cycles, including discovery, product demonstrations, pilots, and design partnerships.
Work with Compliance and regulatory experts to translate evolving AML, sanctions, and digital asset requirements into scalable product capabilities.
Measure success through customer adoption, product usage, enterprise wins, expansion, and other measurable business outcomes.
Requirements
Significant product management experience building B2B software in fintech, regtech, financial services, risk, compliance, or digital assets.
A track record of owning meaningful products or product areas from discovery through launch and adoption.
Deep understanding of AML, financial crime, transaction monitoring, sanctions, KYC/KYB, investigations, or related compliance workflows.
Experience building or working closely with products such as transaction monitoring, blockchain analytics, wallet screening, risk engines, case management, investigation platforms, or compliance workflow systems.
Strong customer discovery skills. You can speak credibly with senior compliance leaders and frontline analysts, understand both what they say and what they actually need, and translate those insights into product decisions.
Strong product judgment. You know the difference between a one off customer request and a repeatable market need, and you are comfortable making hard prioritization decisions.
Commercial instincts. You understand that a successful enterprise product must not only work, customers must adopt it, pay for it, and expand their usage.
Ability to operate in an ambiguous, early stage product environment and personally drive work forward rather than simply coordinate across teams.
Bonus Points
Experience building AML or compliance products at a blockchain analytics, fintech, regtech, exchange, bank, or financial infrastructure company.
Experience with blockchain analytics, KYT, wallet screening, on chain investigations, or digital asset risk.
Previous experience as an AML practitioner, compliance officer, MLRO, investigator, or financial crime professional.
Experience working with regulated financial institutions and understanding how compliance products are evaluated, procured, implemented, and operated.
Experience with regulatory examinations, VASP licensing, or financial crime remediation.
CAMS or another relevant professional qualification.
Relationships with compliance and risk leaders across banks, fintechs, exchanges, VASPs, regulators, or law enforcement.
Compensation
Additional Information
The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $150,000 to $220,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
The Mission
We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren’t just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.
Our customers are deciding how APIs, LLM traffic, and AI agents will be connected and governed across their companies, and the technical story has to be right every time. As Senior Director of Solutions Engineering, you lead the organization that makes it so.
The Role: Strategy & Scale
We are looking for a visionary, operationally rigorous, and developmental Senior Director of Solutions Engineering to lead our pre-sales Solutions Engineering organization in the Americas. You are a leader of leaders: Solutions Engineering Managers report to you, and you lead the organization through them. You will set the technical go-to-market strategy for the team and partner with the VP of Americas Sales, CRO and sales leadership to drive pipeline, technical win rate, and revenue. At Kong, we are masters of our craft. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.
If you have built and scaled a world-class SE organization, and you want to define how the biggest companies in the world adopt API and AI connectivity, you’ve found your next home.
What You Will Achieve
Own the SE Strategy: Define the Solutions Engineering coverage model, specialization, and ratios that align technical resources to segments, territories, and the pipeline.
Lead Leaders: Hire, coach, and develop Solutions Engineering Managers, and build a bench of future leaders ready for their next role at Kong.
Win Together with Sales: Partner with the CRO, VP Americas, Regional Vice Presidents, and Regional Directors on pipeline, forecast, and strategic deals, and build your own relationships with CTOs, CISOs, Chief Architects, and other executives at the Global 2000.
Lead the AI Conversation: Ensure the organization leads Kong’s API Management and AI governance motion, from API and AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to demonstrations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.
Scale Enablement: Build onboarding, certification, and repeatable technical assets that make every Solutions Engineer effective faster, and drive thought leadership through blogs, webinars, and industry events such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, and API & AI Summit.
Shape the Product: Be the field’s strongest voice to product and engineering, turning customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the roadmap.
Operate with Rigor: Own headcount planning, hiring, performance, and the metrics that matter, such as POC conversion and technical win rate.
What You Bring to the Journey
A Track Record of Excellence: 12+ years of solutions engineering, software engineering, or technical sales leadership experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company, including 5+ years leading managers or other leaders of Solutions Engineers.
Leadership Depth: You have hired, developed, and promoted SE leaders, and you can name the ones you’ve built.
Sales Partnership: You have a record of working side by side with sales leadership to improve technical win rate, pipeline quality, and forecast accuracy on complex, enterprise-level deals.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering (m/f/d)
jobs.text:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.
What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.
For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.
Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.
The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:
Own end-to-end delivery across 4–5 cross-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
Samsara's Data Science, ML, and Data Platform team brings together data science, production ML, data engineering, and data platform to turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable products. These products help customers run safer, more efficient physical operations. As Head of Data Science, ML, and Data Platform, you will lead about 30 people through experienced managers and senior technical leaders, and report to the SVP of Engineering. You will decide where agents, foundation models, classical ML, and statistical methods belong at Samsara, and you will turn what you learn into how the whole organization works.
In this role, you will:
Define an AI-native strategy and rethink the roadmap from first principles as capabilities change. Choose what to build, buy, stop, and scale.
Partner with Product and Engineering to take intelligence from experiment to deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement in customer experiences.
Build a trusted data foundation by making certified metrics, discoverable metadata, and traceable outputs available to people and agents across the organization, within clear permissions.
Own production and economic outcomes, including reliability, latency, inference and infrastructure cost, and human oversight. Make evaluation a core capability, with failure modes, uncertainty, and regressions visible during development.
Build a leadership team of managers and senior individual contributors and develop them. Hire people who combine scientific rigor, engineering ability, and a drive to keep learning.
Lead the use of AI across the team. Raise the pace and technical ambition of every team through everyday use of AI-assisted development, and move recurring data science work, from data discovery to evaluation and monitoring, into reusable tools, agents, and workflows. Decide when greater autonomy is justified and when a simpler, more constrained system serves users better.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team
Minimum requirements for the role:
Hands-on experience with modern AI: you have prototyped or contributed to work with foundation models, agents, or AI-assisted development, and can discuss the design decisions and limits
Experience leading delivery of AI/ML beyond demonstrations and pilots, with evidence of adoption, quality, and customer or operational impact
Technical judgment across the AI system: model selection, retrieval, tool use, data access, evaluation, and deployment, including knowing when a deterministic workflow beats an agent
Strong foundations in statistical reasoning, measurement, and model evaluation
Experience leading scientists and engineers through managers, holding a high technical bar outside your own specialty, and changing how teams work
An ideal candidate also has:
Experience with agentic analytics: building investigation workflows over enterprise data
Experience creating evaluations for multi-step systems, including tool correctness, grounded answers, and task completion
Experience with product intelligence: combining structured operational data, predictive models, and foundation models in customer-facing products, with feedback loops from production use and human review
Experience running large-scale data or ML platforms with demanding reliability, cost, and governance requirements
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary
$200,200—$357,500 USD
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.text:
RDQ428R2
At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems by partnering with the ISVs that drive innovation across every line of business. We enable our partners to bring deep intelligence into the critical workflows their customers rely on every day, from delivering real-time CRM behavioral insights to optimizing complex supply chains impacted by global events. jobs.title: Head of Product Strategy & Pricing
jobs.text:
The Elevator Pitch
Evolv Technology is looking for a Head of Product Strategy & Pricing, a senior leader who will work at the center of Product, Finance, Sales, and Marketing to build on our product portfolio and accelerate revenue growth. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the commercial strategy behind the portfolio: how we price and package it, how it stands apart from competitors, and which markets and verticals we enter next.
You will get deep into the mechanics of how we monetize, including value metrics, willingness-to-pay research, discount governance, billing and CPQ architecture, and the unit economics of expansion, and translate that work into decisions that move Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Average Revenue Per User (ARPU), and margin.
You will partner directly with the CPO and Product leadership on the roadmap and work with Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, and launches, operating with the analytical depth to make and defend decisions about pricing, markets, and partnerships.
The Work:
Portfolio Strategy & Competitive Differentiation
Define where each product and capability plays, how it differs from competitors, and how the portfolio fits together
Bring market sizing, willingness-to-pay insight, and competitive context into roadmap planning with the CPO and senior leadership
Maintain a current view of competitor pricing, packaging, and discounting, refreshed on a regular cadence, and use it to inform pricing decisions and Sales talk tracks
Collaborate with Product Marketing to turn differentiation strategy into positioning, messaging, and launch plans
Pricing, Packaging & Monetization
Own the monetization targets for Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Average Revenue Per User (ARPU), and gross margin, and report progress against them to the CPO and senior leadership on a regular cadence
Define and evolve tiers, feature gating, and bundling across different sales channels
Identify and own the value metrics that anchor pricing to the value customers receive
Design and run quantitative and qualitative willingness-to-pay research, including conjoint analysis, churn and win/loss post-mortems, and structured pricing experiments, to validate value metrics and pricing decisions
Partner with Product Managers early in definition so every roadmap initiative has a path to revenue before launch, including target customer, pricing approach, and packaging
Build forecasting models with Finance/RevOps that predict the impact of pricing and packaging decisions on ARR, gross margin, churn, and expansion revenue
Commercial Enablement & Execution
Establish discounting frameworks, discount governance, and rate cards that protect margin and ACV
Partner with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to equip Sales with the tools and talk tracks to negotiate value with confidence
Own end-to-end execution of pricing updates across billing architecture, CPQ, CRM, and customer contract templates, coordinating with Finance/RevOps and Sales Operations to deliver changes on schedule
Bring evidence-backed recommendations on pricing, packaging, discounting, and market entry to senior leadership, and drive each decision through to execution
Market Expansion & Partnerships
Recommend where, when, and how we enter new markets, with stage gates tied to return on investment
Identify, size, and prioritize adjacent verticals, assessing product fit, competitive intensity, go-to-market approach, and investment required
Identify capability gaps and recommend build or partner paths to close them
Lead negotiation and close of partnership, licensing, and acquisition deals that expand the product portfolio, should we decide to pursue that path, working with the CPO, Finance, and Legal and evaluating each against return-on-investment stage gates
What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team?
You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer and partner closely with Product leadership, Product Marketing, Finance, and Sales. Decision-making is collaborative, with opportunities to recommend and implement solutions and to bring evidence-backed recommendations on pricing, packaging, and market entry to senior leadership. The team culture is built on trust, collaboration, ongoing development, kindness, authenticity, courage, drive, and fun.
Where is the role located?
This role is based out of Evolv’s HQ in Waltham, Massachusetts, with flexibility for remote work twice per week. Domestic travel is expected to customer sites up to 20% of the time.
Compensation and Transparency Statement
The base salary range for this full-time position is $203,000- $283,000. In addition to base salary, this role offers a competitive target bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and equity, in alignment with applicable state laws. Our compensation ranges are determined based on factors such as role, level, location, market benchmarks, and internal equity. The posted range represents the good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role across U.S. locations. Actual compensation within the range will be based on the candidate’s skills, experience, education, and geographic location.
In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws—including those in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, and others—we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request.
During the hiring process, your recruiter will share:
The specific salary range for your preferred location
A general overview of our benefits and equity offerings
Insights into how compensation decisions are made, including factors that influence starting pay
We are committed to fair pay practices, and we regularly review our compensation programs to ensure they are competitive, equitable, and aligned with our values.

jobs.text:
Position Summary:
Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, focused on changing the management of disease in reproductive health, oncology, and organ transplantation. Signatera is a personalized, tumor-informed test for molecular residual disease (MRD) assessment and surveillance monitoring in patients previously diagnosed with cancer.
The Associate Director / Director of Product Management, Signatera Heme will own the product strategy and roadmap for Signatera in hematologic malignancies, starting with multiple myeloma and lymphomas. This person will work in a highly matrixed environment with the Foresight BU, R&D, Lab Operations, Software Engineering, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Business Development, and Regulatory. The role combines product management, market entry as a laboratory developed test (LDT), evidence generation, analytics, and clinical trial product support, including trials run under IUO and IVD pathways.
Primary Responsibilities:
Develop and execute the Signatera product roadmap for hematologic malignancies, beginning with multiple myeloma and lymphomas (for example, DLBCL, follicular, mantle cell, and Hodgkin lymphoma) and extending to additional heme indications.
Lead market entry planning for Signatera in heme as a laboratory developed test (LDT), including clinical validation requirements, CLIA and state requirements, market access/reimbursement and payer considerations, and launch readiness with Lab Operations, Regulatory, Medical, commercial and Marketing.
Define product requirements for blood-based malignancies with R&D, Lab Operations, and Software Engineering, including assay, sample type, workflow, and reporting needs.
Lead product support for clinical trials using Signatera in heme, including IUO use in studies with pharma and academic partners, and the path toward IVD and regulated use.
Partner with Regulatory, Clinical, and Business Development on trial start-up, study requirements, and pharma and companion diagnostic opportunities.
Build product performance metrics and dashboards. Analyze test volume, adoption, ordering patterns, turnaround time, and retention. Use the results to prioritize improvements.
Partner with Medical Affairs and Clinical on evidence generation strategy and execution. Areas of collaboration include identifying clinical gaps, designing studies, working with investigators and trial partners, and planning publications and congress presentations.
Guide product development for Signatera Genome in heme, including whole genome sequencing technology, phased variants, and structural variants. Work with R&D and Bioinformatics to define how these features improve tumor tracking and MRD sensitivity in heme malignancies.
Conduct Voice of Customer interviews, market research, and competitive and market intelligence in hematologic oncology.
Engage with key opinion leaders, advisory boards, and congresses (for example, ASH, EHA, and ASCO). Gather insights to guide product decisions.
Work with Marketing on product positioning, launch plans, pricing, and key collateral.
Build business cases and financial models to support product initiatives.
Present strategy, progress, and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, statistics, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) preferred.
5+ years (7+ preferred) of experience in product management, product marketing, or market analytics at a diagnostics, biotech, or pharmaceutical company.
Hematologic oncology experience is strongly preferred, especially multiple myeloma and lymphoma.
Working knowledge of oncology molecular testing, next-generation sequencing (NGS), and biomarkers, including NGS bioinformatic workflows (e.g., variant calling, filtering, and interpretation) and genomic data analysis. MRD experience preferred.
Experience with data analysis. SQL, Snowflake, or similar tools preferred.
Familiarity with a high complexity molecular laboratory, including cfDNA or plasma workflows, is a plus.
In depth knowledge of whole genome sequencing and variant types, including structural variants, single nucleotide variants, and phased variants, is preferred.
Experience with clinical trials. Experience in IUO and IVD regulated environments is required.
Experience bringing a molecular test to market as an LDT, including clinical validation and laboratory requirements.
Experience designing or supporting clinical evidence generation, such as clinical validation studies, retrospective studies, or prospective trials.
Prior KOL engagement and external customer facing experience preferred.
30-40% travel for advisory boards, congresses, and customer meetings.
Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities:
Technical
Understanding of MRD in multiple myeloma and lymphomas, including how blood-based MRD testing fits withing current bone marrow and imaging-based MRD assessment paradigms.
Understanding of how somatic variants are detected in whole genome sequencing and how they support MRD tracking in heme tumors.
Understanding of LDT market entry requirements and the evidence needed for clinical adoption and payer coverage.
Ability to translate customer and clinical needs into clear product requirements.
Strong analytical skills. Able to build metrics, interpret data, and present findings.
Basic financial modeling skills.
Proficiency with MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Behavioral
Ability to lead without authority and influence cross-functional teams.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to function effectively in a highly matrixed cross functional environment.
Ability to explain complex topics simply (biomarkers, multiple indications, regulatory pathways).
Strong customer focus, including building relationships with thought leaders.
Strong organization and time management. Able to manage several projects at once and meet tight deadlines.
Flexibility between fast development and quality standards.
Clear written and verbal communication with senior leadership.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT
Duties are typically performed in a [remote home office / hybrid office] setting. This position requires the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone and computer, and read printed material. Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends) at times. While the position may be based anywhere in the United States, availability during Pacific time hours is required and site based presence in San Carlos CA, Boulder CO, or Austin TX is preferred.
Travel required for this position: 30-40% (advisory boards, congresses, customer meetings).
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$180,300—$230,900 USD

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.
The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.
WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

jobs.title: Director Of Product, Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain
jobs.text:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
Toast’s Customer onboarding, hardware orders and inventory flows run on business systems that our Supply Chain, Finance, Care, and Onboarding teams rely on every day. As Director of Product – Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain Systems, you will own the vision, roadmap, and outcomes for those systems as part of the Business Technology & Transformation (BTT) organization. You will lead a team of product managers and BSAs while acting as a strategic product partner to leaders in Supply Chain, Finance, Accounting, Care, Onboarding, and Customer Success Operations. You’ll also work hand in hand with upstream and downstream BTT teams and R&D, so data and processes flow cleanly end to end across Salesforce, NetSuite, and the platforms between them and deliver scalable, high-impact solutions that support Toast’s exponential growth.
A day in the life (Responsibilities)
Strategy & Leadership
Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain systems, tied to company strategy and the priorities of Supply Chain, Finance, Care, and Onboarding leaders.
Build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of product managers and analysts including hiring, career development, and clear accountability for outcomes.
Partner with senior Supply Chain, Finance, Care, Onboarding, and Technology leadership to translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
Work with upstream and downstream BTT teams and R&D to align roadmaps, manage cross-team dependencies, and agree on who owns data and integrations across systems.
Establish the team’s product operating model: how work is in-taken, prioritized, planned, and communicated, using outcome-based goals (e.g., OKRs).
Drive strategy to build scalable processes that power and support exponential growth in hardware, supply chain, and customer support operations.
Product Ownership
Own the hardware order experience from order to fulfilment, inventory-related supply chain systems, 3PLs, Onboarding systems, and key master data infrastructure.
Maintain and manage the project funnel, driving prioritization across multiple functional streams spanning operational improvements and strategic initiatives.
Own and deliver outcomes for high-impact strategic initiatives from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and measured business results.
Drive enhancements, integrations, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and user experience across Salesforce, Netsuite and related platforms.
Ensure successful adoption: releases are communicated, users are trained, and usage is tracked.
Implementation & Optimization
Lead evaluation and implementation of new supply chain, hardware, and customer support technologies and tools, including Salesforce, NetSuite and platform integrations across business and engineering systems; making clear build vs. buy vs. configure recommendations.
Oversee integrations across enterprise platforms (Finance, Accounting, Care, Onboarding, data warehouse, and related systems).
Organize ambiguous ideas and targets into detailed functional requirements, providing point-of-view feedback on prioritization and criticality based on deep business understanding.
Lead delivery of large implementations, migrations, and enhancements, managing scope, risk, and cross-team dependencies from design through rollout.
Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a trusted advisor to Supply Chain, Finance, Accounting, Care, Onboarding, and Customer Success Operations leaders; bringing a clear point of view on priorities, trade-offs, and what’s technically feasible.
Build strong working relationships with engineering, R&D, and BTT partners to resolve cross-team dependencies and keep delivery moving.
Communicate roadmap, progress, and risks clearly to executives and stakeholders at the right level of detail, in both business and technical terms.
Translate business requirements into clear, actionable functional and technical specifications, and facilitate timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders.
Gather regular feedback from the people who use these systems (Care agents, Onboarding consultants, Supply Chain and Finance users) and use it to guide improvements.
Performance & Risk Management
Establish KPIs to track system adoption, stability, efficiency, and business results achieved through solution implementation (for example, order accuracy, on-time hardware delivery, inventory discrepancy rate, and time to onboard).
Proactively identify and manage risks in hardware, supply chain, Onboarding and customer support systems with clear mitigation plans and escalation paths.
Apply root cause analysis and systems design methodologies to resolve inventory discrepancies, hardware delivery failures, and process gaps, using a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)
10+ years of experience in Product Management, Business systems, or Supply Chain/Enterprise Systems, including system implementation, platform integration, and transformation.
5+ years in leadership roles with proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, TMS/3PLs and Order Management systems required.
Demonstrated skill in systems analysis, including root cause analysis and process modeling/systems design methodologies.
Proven experience driving large-scale supply chain, hardware, or enterprise system implementations, migrations, or enhancements.
Proficient in how applications share data and communicate; expert in how data flows across systems, with the ability to articulate simple and accurate solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build relationships with key executives.
Preferred Skills
Experience with customer support platforms (Salesforce Service Cloud, Amazon Connect, etc.) preferred.
Experience in high-growth, global companies.
Experience with vendor management, contract negotiation, and budget ownership for enterprise platforms.
Experience with 3PL/logistics partners, returns (RMA) or asset management.
Familiarity with emerging technologies in supply chain and hardware operations (AI/ML, automation, analytics tools).
Track record of success presenting to senior executives.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Success Profile
Strategic leader who sets a clear vision and roadmap for Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain systems, and delivers measurable business results.
Trusted partner to Supply Chain, Finance, Care, and Onboarding leadership; and to upstream and downstream BTT teams.
A leader who builds and develops a high-performing product team with strong delivery habits.
Change agent who drives operational transformation across hardware, supply chain, and customer support systems.
Passion for building scalable, efficient, and future-ready systems.
A results-driven owner who measures success by business outcomes (accuracy, delivery, adoption, efficiency), not features shipped.
AI at Toast
At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.
The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.
Zone A
$230,000—$368,000 USD
Zone B
$200,000—$320,000 USD
Zone C
$180,000—$288,000 USD
How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process
Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring
Our Approach to Hybrid Working
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast
People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success
At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
Apply today!
Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

jobs.title: Director, Global People Analytics
jobs.text:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
We're hiring a Director of People Analytics to turn trusted people data into the business decisions Toast makes about its workforce, and to strengthen the business impact of Toast's People programs.
Toast has built a strong analytics foundation over the past several years: a cloud data warehouse, self-service dashboards, an AI-enabled insights product, an employee listening program, and data science that has already shaped business decisions. The next stage is moving from standardized to strategic: making People Analytics the partner business leaders rely on for their most important talent decisions.
You'll lead a team across data engineering, analytics, data science and employee listening, based in the US and India. You'll report to the leader of Talent Infrastructure and work closely with Business Leaders, People Leadership, Finance, IT and our AI and data partners.
Our purpose: answer the people questions that cut across Toast's data, and make sure those answers change a decision.
A day in the life (Responsibilities)
Strategy and leadership: Set and communicate the vision, North Star and roadmap for People Analytics, with buy-in from People and business leaders. Own People data strategy and reporting strategy, including metric definitions, governance and data trust. Partner with Toast's AI and data teams so People data powers AI-enabled insights safely and responsibly.
Business partnership and impact: Build lasting partnerships with leaders, across Toast's major business areas and the People team. Turn analysis into clear stories and recommendations that leaders act on, and build that skill across the team. Design and run program impact measurement with Finance, from adoption through business outcomes and return on investment. Make sure new People programs above a set cost or reach launch with a measurement plan.
Team and operations: Lead, develop and retain a distributed team across data engineering, analytics, data science and employee listening. Run a scalable service model: self-service first, clear intake, and prioritization by business value.
Executive visibility: Prepare governance-grade workforce analysis for senior leadership and board committees.
Cross-functional collaboration: Manage partnerships with privacy, legal, People technology and data engineering teams.
What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)
10+ years in people analytics, workforce analytics or business analytics, including 4+ years leading teams of analysts, engineers or data scientists.
Business credibility. A track record of analysis that changed a senior business leader's decision, not only People team leaders' decisions.
Storytelling and translation. You turn complex findings into a clear recommendation an executive can act on in 10 minutes, and you coach others to do the same.
Data strategy ownership. You've set metric definitions and governance, and made a contested number, such as headcount, official across the People team and Finance.
Program impact measurement. You've measured and improved the business impact of People programs with a Finance partner, and you know when a pilot or comparison group is needed and when an approximation is enough.
Portfolio discipline. You've reset stakeholder expectations, said no to lower-value work and shifted a team from reactive requests to strategic priorities.
Steady, energizing leadership. You've led a team through change, built a strong bench, and put your team in front of executives rather than presenting everything yourself.
Enough technical depth to make good decisions about data architecture, modern data stacks such as Snowflake, and analytics tooling.

jobs.title: Director, Product
jobs.text:
At Teamworks, we build the operating system for elite sports organizations, from D1 college football programs to professional franchises across the NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL. Our Coaching and Personnel products sit at the heart of how teams identify, develop, and manage talent, and right now we're at an inflection point. Several acquisitions have put us in position to build something no one else in this market can: a unified, AI-first platform that connects coaching workflows, talent acquisition, and on-field performance analytics into a single operating layer for elite sports.
We’re hiring a Director of Product to own this product line. This person will lead a team of PMs and product leaders across our Football and Hockey products, own the roadmap for Coaching, Player Personnel, Recruiting, and AI in those two sports, and be a driver of innovation across our customers, partners, and leagues.
The Role
Own the product strategy and roadmap across coaching, scouting and recruiting products, across Football and Hockey. You’ll be responsible for driving coherence across a portfolio built through both organic development and acquisition
Define a cohesive, opinionated AI strategy that travels across your products. Identify the shared workflows (opponent scouting, self-scouting, talent evaluation, recruiting operations, free agency and the transfer portal, contract and scholarship decisioning) where AI agents create the most leverage, and turn that thesis into a multi-quarter roadmap
Lead and develop a team of product managers operating across multiple sports markets and geographies
Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, data science, product marketing, GTM, and finance to move fast and ship product that wins in market
Stay relentlessly close to customers: front offices, coaches, coordinators, GMs, scouting directors, and league operators
Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and the PFF, SportLogiq, Zelus, and platform data teams to convert data products and proprietary models into deliberate calls on which capabilities are platform-level versus product-specific.
Find the workflows that look the same in front offices and the workflows where the two markets genuinely diverge, building a portfolio approach that maximizes shared platform leverage without forcing one sport's mental model onto another
Be accountable to revenue targets for the category, partnering with GTM to win league-wide deals and expand across football and hockey leagues and into international markets
What I'm Looking For
What You Must Bring
A track record of shipping and iterating across a multi-product portfolio: not just owning one product, but driving strategy and execution across several simultaneously. This is core to the role and non-negotiable
AI proficiency and the ability to build via a modern ADLC: a strong, current point of view on where agentic AI experiences win and where traditional SaaS workflows still serve users better, and the technical fluency to partner with engineering and data science to design and ship them.
Sports fluency: a deep understanding of how sports operate, enabling you to sit down with a GM, coach, or personnel director and credibly speak their language. This can come from many places: a genuine passion for sports that includes following the ins and outs of a given league, time spent in a front office, or experience competing as an athlete at a high level
Demonstrated experience leading PMs and product leaders through complex, multi-market environments (including through periods of organizational change like acquisitions or rapid growth), OR operating as a General Manager of a new business unit with full ownership of strategy, roadmap, GTM, and P&L outcomes
8+ years in product management or software development within B2B SaaS, sports technology, vertical AI, or comparable industries
The communication and stakeholder management skills to operate credibly at the executive level, with customers and league partners, and with technical and GTM teams, all in the same week
Even Better If
You've built and sold product directly to professional sports teams and understand the buying dynamics at that level
You have subject matter expertise in football or hockey, whether from coaching, scouting, front office, analytics, or product work in those markets
You've shipped AI-native features (not just AI-adjacent, but workflows where the AI is the product), with direct experience working with proprietary data sets and the models built on top of them, including the tradeoffs between in-house ML, third-party foundation models, and hybrid approaches
You have experience working in recently acquired or integrating product portfolios, with a bias toward action and clarity in ambiguous environments
Why This Role
There is not a better seat in sports technology right now. Teamworks has the data, the team, and the customer relationships to become the definitive AI platform for elite sports organizations, and this role sits at the center of that build. 100% of the NFL, NHL, and Division I college athletic departments are all Teamworks customers. If you want to work directly these front offices while shaping a the future of a product category that doesn't exist yet in its full form, this is the role for you.
This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time.
Please submit your application through this posting only. We're unable to review applications or resumes sent via email, LinkedIn, or other channels.
To all recruitment agencies: Teamworks does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Teamworks employees or any other organization location. Teamworks is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
About Teamworks
We're the Operating System for Sports™, powering 7,000+ organizations worldwide, from collegiate programs to every major pro league. Founded in 2006, we've evolved from a messaging tool for college football into the leading sports tech platform, with 600+ global teammates building the future of sports tech. Our solutions span Personnel, Coaching, Performance, Operations, and Intelligence - helping teams recruit smarter, train better, stay compliant, and win.
Teamworks is an equal opportunity employer - if you live our core values every day and are honest, hardworking, humble, committed, innovative, and an all-around exceptional person, you'll thrive at Teamworks. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and take affirmative action to not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, and training. Teamworks is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email talent@teamworks.com.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Product
jobs.text:
About Act
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.
Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.
About the Role
You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.
We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.
What You Will Be Doing
Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.
Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.
Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.
Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.
Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.
Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
What You Will Need
Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.
Comfortable working across different business functions.
Strong ownership and execution skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.
How We Work
The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.
We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.
Interview Process
If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.
Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.
We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.title: (Senior) Director, Process Engineering - Metal Deposition
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Role Overview
ASM is the materials discovery company at the forefront of developing advanced deposition technologies enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices. We are looking for an exceptional Process Engineering leader to lead our Metal Deposition organization and drive the development, qualification, and commercialization of advanced metal deposition processes.
This is a highly visible technical leadership role combining deep expertise in metal deposition with people leadership, customer engagement, and product execution. You will lead a team of process engineers working at the intersection of materials science, device integration, equipment technology, and advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
The role will have a particular focus on ALD and CVD metal deposition across advanced semiconductor device applications.
What You Will Do
Lead and develop a high-performing Metal Deposition Process Engineering organization, including engineers, technical experts, and people managers.
Set the technical direction for metal deposition process development in partnership with product, engineering, and technology leadership.
Drive the development and optimization of advanced ALD/CVD metal and metal nitride processes for semiconductor applications.
Translate customer technology requirements and complex technical challenges into differentiated process solutions and development priorities.
Lead process development from early-stage innovation through customer demonstrations, qualification, product introduction, and high-volume manufacturing.
Partner closely with hardware, software, product management, product marketing, manufacturing, field engineering, and customer account teams to accelerate technology development.
Develop strong relationships with leading semiconductor customers and engage directly on future technology requirements, process challenges, and qualifications.
Drive technical problem solving across process, chemistry, hardware, and device integration.
Build organizational capability by recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional process engineering talent.
Promote innovation and intellectual property generation across materials, processes, and integration concepts.
Deliver programs against performance, schedule, cost, quality, and customer commitments.
What We Are Looking For
Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline; PhD strongly preferred.
10+ years of semiconductor process development experience, ideally within semiconductor capital equipment or advanced device manufacturing.
Deep technical expertise in metal and/or metal nitride deposition, with significant experience in ALD, PEALD, CVD, or related thin-film deposition technologies.
Strong understanding of FEOL and/or BEOL device integration, ideally encompassing work-function metals, gate stacks, electrodes, barriers, liners, contacts, or advanced interconnect applications.
Demonstrated experience taking advanced semiconductor processes from development through customer qualification and production.
Strong understanding of the relationship between precursor chemistry, reactor/hardware design, process conditions, film properties, and electrical/device performance.
Proven experience leading and developing multidisciplinary process engineering teams, including senior technical talent and engineering managers.
Strong customer orientation, with experience engaging directly with leading semiconductor manufacturers on technically complex development programs.
Track record of delivering challenging technology programs in a fast-moving R&D environment.
What Sets You Apart
Recognized expertise in ALD metal deposition and metal integration.
Experience supporting advanced logic, memory, interconnect, or next-generation device architectures.
Strong publication or semiconductor patent record.
Experience developing and transitioning new deposition processes into production-worthy solutions.
Ability to operate equally effectively at the technical, organizational, and customer level.
ASM Leadership Profile
You are a technically credible leader who can challenge and inspire world-class scientists and engineers. You combine strategic thinking with strong execution and are comfortable moving from conversations about device roadmaps and materials science to organizational priorities and customer commitments.
You build strong teams, create accountability, remove roadblocks, and thrive in an environment where the technology is complex and expectations are high.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering
jobs.text:
FEQ426R193
We are looking for a Director, Field Engineering in London to join our world-class hypergrowth organisation. In this role, you will lead two different teams of first-line managers and pre-sales Solutions Architects. The Growth team incubates early stage accounts across industries before they move into Enterprise industry teams. The Invested Solution Architects are deployed into strategic opportunities in accounts across UK & Ireland in support of existing account teams, building out the minimum viable product that our Forward Deployed Engineering or Partners would take to production.
Your experience in partnering with Sales organisations will help to grow consumption, whilst coaching new sales and pre-sales team members to work together and raise the bar to best in class. You will guide your team and be involved with opportunities to enhance your team's effectiveness. You must be an expert at communicating complex, business value-focused solutions; supporting complex sales cycles; and building relationships with key stakeholders in large corporations. You will report to the AVP, Field Engineering UK&I.
The impact you will have:
Manage first-line leaders across a total organisation of 25-30 people, with each of the two teams consisting of technical pre-sales Solutions Architects.
Lead two teams, requiring the ability to seamlessly support multiple roles and distinct sales motions simultaneously
Act as a deeply technical leader for the Growth SA team, engaging directly with clients and high-volume accounts to drive technical solutions and business value
Direct the Invested SA team to invest strategically based on targets, deploying squads aligned to specific opportunities
Drive the strategic expansion of our fungible team model alongside regional leadership
Build a collaborative culture within a rapid-growth team
Embody and promote Databricks' customer-obsessed, teamwork and diverse culture
Support increased return on investment of Solutions Architect involvement in sales cycles
Create trust-based relationships with customers for the long term and understand category-specific landscapes and trends, reporting on the forces that shift the strategic direction of accounts
Promote a solution and value-based selling field-engineering organisation
Display an understanding of business needs and revenue potential for accounts in the assigned region
Build Databricks' brand in UK&I in partnership with the Marketing and Sales team
What we look for:
5+ years of second-line leadership experience, manager of managers with teams of 20+ individuals
Proven capability in supporting multiple teams and distinct go-to-market motions concurrently.
Deeply technical expertise, with the ability to work directly with clients on technical implementations for the Growth SA business
Relevant high-growth enterprise software pre-sales success with senior-level tenure at a reputable software company, with experience of the EMEA region
Ability to elevate the engagement with a track record of driving large transactions and high growth customers
Proven leadership ability to influence, develop, and empower your team to achieve objectives with a team approach
Proven track record of transformational success and delivery of customer value
Track record of building strong ecosystems of lucrative customer relationships and cross-functional partnerships (Sales, Engineering, Marketing)
Experience in managing complex strategic accounts
Knowledgeable in and passionate about data-driven decisions, AI, and Cloud software models.
Great at instituting processes for technical field members to improve efficiency
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
Benefits
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.
