jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.text:
Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.
Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.
Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.
We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.
The opportunity
As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.
You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.
What you’ll do
Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.
Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.
Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.
Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.
Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.
Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.
Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.
Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.
Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.
Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.
Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.
Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.
What success looks like
We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:
Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.
Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.
The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.
Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.
Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.
What we’re looking for
Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.
A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.
Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.
Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.
A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.
The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.
A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.
Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.
Salary: $200,000 - $260,000k/yr + variable
Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.
We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.
Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

jobs.title: Director, Global Product Management
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Job's mission
As a Director of Global Product Management, you will drive the strategic roadmap for ASM’s advanced packaging equipment portfolio, shaping the future of semiconductor innovation. This role leads global product strategies across Hybrid Bonding, Thermocompression Bonding, CoWoS, TSV, and wafer-level processes, aligning technology capabilities with market inflection points. You will partner with executive leadership and tier-1 customers to deliver breakthrough solutions and achieve aggressive growth targets.
What you will be working on
Deliver revenue growth, gross margin, and market share objectives for advanced packaging equipment.
Develop and present multi-year product roadmaps to executive leadership, aligning technology with market trends.
Define and execute customer penetration strategies at strategic accounts.
Lead cross-functional teams (R&D, engineering, marketing, sales, operations) to ensure on-time, on-spec product releases following the semiconductor equipment PLC process.
Negotiate and structure strategic agreements with key customers and ecosystem partners.
Serve as the voice of the customer internally; translate technical requirements into actionable product specifications.
Drive competitive positioning, win/loss analysis, and pricing strategy.
What we are looking for
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field.
Minimum 10 years of experience in the semiconductor capital equipment industry.
Prior role as Key Product Unit (KPU) or Deputy KPU Head with full P&L responsibility.
Proven track record of presenting product roadmaps and strategies to C-level executives.
Deep technical expertise in advanced packaging processes, including Hybrid Bonding, Thermocompression Bonding, CoWoS/InFO/TSV, wafer-level deposition (PVD, PECVD, ALD, ECP), and surface preparation.
Experience managing semiconductor equipment product release cycles (PLC) from concept to high-volume manufacturing.
Demonstrated success in customer engagement at tier-1 accounts.
What sets you apart
Global mindset with experience managing cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills and executive presence.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London / UK Remote | 💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits ✨
⭐ Our Design team
We’re a team of 115+ Product Designers, User Researchers, and Brand Designers led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.
We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.
Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. There’s significant opportunity to shape the product, influence the organisation, and leave a lasting mark on millions of customers.
🔎 About the role
We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead design across Payments, one of Monzo’s most important and fast-evolving multi-market business areas.
You’ll partner closely with senior leaders across Product and Engineering to shape strategy, set direction, and drive exceptional execution across your area. You’ll play a key role in influencing the direction of both the product and the broader customer experience.
You’ll lead and grow a team of Product Designers, helping them do the best work of their careers while strengthening design thinking, collaboration, and craft across Monzo. As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.
Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.
Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.
Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.
Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.
Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...
You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.
You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.
You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.
You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.
You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.
You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.
You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design.
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor your visa
📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ Flexible working hours and trust-based work culture
📚 £1,000 annual learning budget for books, training, and conferences
🏡 Full remote setup support, including equipment and workspace essentials
➕ Plus lots more!
This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!
We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.
We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.
#LI-TR1
#LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Data Director, EU
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available
About our Data Discipline
We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.
Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.
Our EU team ⭐
Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo.
Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.
You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.
Shaping product and commercial strategy:
You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.
Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:
You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.
Changing how decisions get made:
You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.
Building and leading a high-performing team:
You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!
You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.
You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.
You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.
You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.
You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.
You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.
🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
30 minute recruiter call
45 minute call with the hiring manager
4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Payments
A meet and greet with a member of EU Executive Committee
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.
What’s in it for you:
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options and benefits
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team
📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.
➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.
#LI-JH1 #LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone

At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

jobs.title: Data Director, Payments
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits
About our Data Discipline
We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.
Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.
Our Payments team ⭐
At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.
The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.
You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform.
To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness
Your day-to-day
Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline
Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking
Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth
Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers
Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions
Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.
You should apply if:
What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business
You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement.
You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes
You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent
You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics
You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions
The Interview Process
After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!
Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.
Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com
How we work 💻:
Locations & Flexible Working :
Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.
We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨
Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.
Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.
At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.
You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨
Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.
You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.
This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.
Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.
Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
AI and agentic product
Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Portfolio and operating model
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.
Team and accountability
Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.
In the first week, expect to:
Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.
In the first three months, expect to:
Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.
In the first year, expect to:
Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Compensation
Additional Information

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.
You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.
You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.
You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.
This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.
AI and agentic engineering
Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Team, resourcing, and accountability
Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.
Platform and execution
Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.
In the first week, expect to:
Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.
In the first three months, expect to:
Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.
In the first year, expect to:
Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Director, Solutions Engineering CEE works with the CEE Leadership and will lead our team of Solution Engineers who are the go-to Solution Specialists assisting the sales team in generating growth all over the region. This team values collaboration, flexibility and has a strong emphasis on continued learning and development. You will lead the technical pre-sales operations and achieve revenue generation, customer growth and individuals/teams/organizational goals.
We’re looking for a new Director of CEE Solutions Engineering who will operate as a second line leader covering all segments (Commercial, Enterprise and Strategic). You will also lead from the front and keep Okta a destination organization.
As a Director of CEE Solutions Engineering you would…
Manage, recruit, develop and mentor pre-sales staff, from IC to senior Managers in the region
Build effective relationships with cross functional leaders in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and more.
Partner with HR, Finance and Operations to look at skills gaps, workforce planning and budget alignment.
Partner with Recruitment to build best in class hiring plans and go to market strategies. Interview, assess, conduct case studies and navigate offers to secure the best talent for Okta.
Collaborate with your Manager peers around best practice, market trends, employee internal moves and the overall functions strategy to support the team as they scale.
Still remain hands on and be able to support your team with technical questions.
Act as an ambassador for your team with the Product functions to deliver feedback from the field.
We are looking for experience…
Managing high performing pre-sales teams
Act as a strategic change agent - cultivating a resilient, high-performance culture across CEE by leading teams through growth, driving accountability, and championing continuous learning.
Sales Methodologies like MEDDPICCC
Recruiting in a high growth environment.
In a pre-sales / Solution Engineering / Sales Engineering role that is a blend of technical detail and value selling
Knowledge / Experience selling Security, Identity technologies and Infrastructure technologies.
Proven success working with/selling into SMB, but also large, strategic customers.
Proven experience leading second-line management teams, inclusive of creation of development plans and execution, reduced attrition results and initiatives, a clear history of promotions and success, performance management, etc.
Fluency in German and English required.
Nice to have:
Technical skills gained in the security or identity space, such as IAM, CIAM, VPN, MDM, Active Directory, LDAP.
Knowledge around AI
Knowledge around the Okta platform and competitor product offerings
Okta’s Top 5 Core Leadership Competencies are part of the deeply ingrained principles that guide all of our company’s actions. They also align strongly to our cultural cornerstones, our Okta values: love our customers, empower our people, never stop innovating, act with integrity, and maintain transparency.
It’s our expectation that our managers and leaders embody these core competencies:
Builds Effective Teams: Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.
Demonstrates Self-Awareness (EQ): Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.
Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
Drives Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Strategic Mindset: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.
What we offer:
Workplace Model (Hybrid): 2 days per week in our Munich office (Salvatorplatz 3, 80333 München), with the flexibility to work from home on the remaining days. This requirement applies directly to everyone on the team based in Munich. Regular travel across CEE is required.
Generous stock in the company
Car allowance
Exceptional onboarding program for all new employees, plus continued learning and development through Okta University and specific accreditations.
Team off-sites, events and networking opportunities.
The opportunity to lead a premier regional engineering organization at a $3B+ profitable category leader defining the future of Workforce, Customer, and AI Identity.

jobs.text:
Dispel builds network isolation and access infrastructure for critical industries, where a breach or unexpected downtime is an operational failure with real-world consequences. Our customers include critical infrastructure operators, defense contractors, and industrial enterprises that demand zero-trust security, strict compliance, and rock-solid availability.
The Director of Engineering – Platform owns the foundation upon which everything at Dispel runs. This role leads the engineering teams and technical leaders responsible for cloud environments, hybrid and edge deployments, infrastructure-as-code, network architecture, observability, release infrastructure, and cloud cost efficiency.

They must also maintain deep technical awareness of the stack and be willing to step in directly when needed through prototyping, architectural spiking, deep debugging, or incident analysis.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
As VP of Engineering, you will be responsible for building, scaling, and operating a high-performing software engineering organization capable of reliably delivering Neural Concept’s ambitious product and technology roadmap.
You will turn product vision into software reality, while ensuring our teams and culture scale sustainably — in quality, velocity, and people development.
What you will do
Own engineering execution and delivery
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across product and platform initiatives
Translate product and technical strategy into realistic plans, milestones, and commitments
Identify risks early and manage trade-offs transparently
Structure the engineering organization
Evolve team structures, ownership boundaries, and collaboration models as we scale
Build and coach engineering managers and tech leads
Continuously adapt the organization to match company growth
Build strong and modern engineering processes
Establish lightweight, effective development processes that scale without bureaucracy
Leverage the best of AI technologies to amplify our impact while maintaining small, agile teams
Define and track the right engineering metrics
Guarantee technical quality, reliability, and security in practice
Partner with the CTO to uphold architectural principles and long-term technical health
Drive pragmatic approaches to technical debt, qulity testing, and operational excellence
Collaborate with GTM and deployment teams to guarantee smooth, secure deployments across diverse customer scaling scenarios
Collaborate closely with leadership and customers
Work together with Product, Research, Deployment, and Leadership
Represent engineering in cross-functional and customer-facing discussions
Act as a key partner to the CTO, providing clear signals on execution, risk, and org health
Who you are
You are a senior engineering leader who combines strong technical judgment with operational excellence and a deep understanding of how organizations scale. You are product-minded, pragmatic, think in systems and understand how outcomes derive from how people work together.
Proven experience leading software engineering organizations at scale
Experience scaling teams, at least x2 and 50+ engineers
Experience managing managers and tech leads
A track record of managing delivery in fast-growing, low-process environments
Strong technical credibility
Broad understanding of modern software architecture, infrastructure, and security
Deep understanding about modern AI technology for software engineering
Ability to engage deeply with engineers on design, trade-offs, and reliability
Comfort operating in AI- and data-intensive product environments
Product mindset and pragmatism
Ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term sustainability
User-first and product minded
Calm decision-making under pressure
Outcomes-focused, and not perfectionist
A people-first leadership mindset
High empathy and strong communication skills
Commitment to growing others and building healthy teams
Drive and ownership
Willingness to take responsibility and make hard calls
Track record of inspiring others and building confidence in high-uncertainty environments
What You Get
Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.
Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.
Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.
Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.
Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.
Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Technology (m/w/d) | AI-first | Hospitality Tech
jobs.text:
Serviced Apartments wachsen oft schneller als die Teams, die sie betreiben. Jedes neue Haus bringt mehr Personal, mehr Abstimmung und mehr Abhängigkeit von Buchungsplattformen mit sich. STAYERY betreibt rund 12 Häuser und eröffnet 2027 drei bis fünf weitere. Die Expansion nach Basel und Wien ist gesichert. Das Ziel: wachsen, ohne proportional Personal aufzubauen, und die eigene Website zum stärksten Buchungskanal machen.
Als Head of Product & Technology (m/w/d) machst du STAYERY zum digitalsten Aparthotel-Produkt im Markt. Die Produktfunktion wurde in den letzten drei Jahren aufgebaut. Du übernimmst ein eingespieltes Team und eine dokumentierte Übergabe und gehst den nächsten Schritt: eine AI-first Roadmap für Guest Journey und Operations.
Du entwickelst die Produkt- und Tech-Strategie, priorisierst nach Business Impact und entscheidest über Build or Buy. Du steuerst Agenturen, Freelancer und den eigenen Engineer, etwa zur Hälfte extern und zur Hälfte intern, und baust selbst Prototypen und Automatisierungen. Du berichtest an die Vice President Growth & Data, Mitglied des Management Teams, und arbeitest eng mit Operations, Marketing, Commercial und Guest Experience zusammen.
Tasks
Strategie und Roadmap: AI-first Produkt- und Tech-Strategie entwickeln und in eine Roadmap übersetzen, mit Business Case je Initiative (Stunden, FTE pro Apartment, Umsatzwirkung)
Guest Journey und Conversion: Website und Buchungsstrecke zum stärksten Buchungskanal entwickeln, Tracking ausbauen, mit A/B-Tests arbeiten, Ranking und Conversion auf OTAs verbessern
Direktbuchung und Retention: Wiederbucher von OTAs auf die Direktbuchung lenken und Gastprofile ausbauen
AI und Automatisierung: interne KI-Plattform aufbauen, bestehende Anwendungen wie den Website-Chatbot verantworten, gemeinsam mit Operations Wachstum über Prozesse und Automatisierung tragen
Build or Buy: Verantwortung für Tech-Stack und Tool-Kosten, Tool Ownership für das PMS, Entscheidungen auf Basis von Business Cases
Hands-on: Workflows und Prototypen selbst bauen, etwa mit n8n, Lovable oder Claude Code
Führung: disziplinarische Führung von zwei Product Managern, einem Fullstack Engineer und einem Werkstudenten.
Neueröffnungen: die komplette Guest Journey in neuen Häusern vor Ort testen

jobs.title: Head of Content Design
jobs.text:
Asana is looking for a Head of Content Design to lead and grow our content design practice across the company. You'll manage a team of content designers working across our portfolio of products: Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command. You'll set the standard for how Asana speaks to customers on every surface, from a settings page to a conversation with an AI Teammate. In this player-coach role, you'll lead the practice, develop senior practitioners, and take on some of the highest-stakes writing projects yourself while collaborating with the Asana Design leadership team to shape both what we make and how we make it.
We design the future of teamwork. Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.
Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We're a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds (product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting). We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centred design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.
We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Lead, coach, and grow a team of content designers by setting clear expectations, developing their craft and careers, and building a team with a clear mission and measurable outcomes.
Own the end-to-end quality of content across Asana's portfolio of products, including Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command.
Define and evolve Asana’s product voice, terminology, and content standards, building scalable systems—such as guidelines, patterns, design-system content, and tooling—that empower every product team.
Establish Asana’s AI voice by defining the voice and tone for AI Teammates and agents, developing conversation design patterns, and distilling characteristics that make humans and agents feel like one team.
Partner with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Research, and Product Marketing leaders to integrate content strategy into roadmap decisions and make content design a visible, measurable part of how Asana ships.
Collaborate with Marketing and Brand Creative to ensure a cohesive voice and tone across the entire customer journey.
Lead high-impact content design initiatives, including flagship launches, AI and conversational experiences, cross-product naming, and information architecture.
Partner with Research and Data Science to validate content decisions through experiments and user studies, advocating for content improvements backed by evidence.
Shape how the broader Asana Design organization operates as a member of its leadership team, including evolving design and content workflows alongside AI-assisted product development.
About you
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
10+ years of experience designing content for digital products, including 4+ years managing content designers or UX writers and developing senior and lead-level practitioners.
Proven track record of running a day-to-day content design practice—setting priorities across multiple teams, driving consistency, shipping products, and advocating for content design best practices cross-functionally.
Demonstrated ability to build influence with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders so content design is embedded early in decision-making rather than treated as a final review step.
Hands-on expertise in UX writing and content strategy for web and mobile products, covering microcopy, nomenclature, information architecture, accessibility, user education, and launch content.
Experience designing content for conversational or AI-powered experiences, paired with a clear point of view on how products should communicate when systems generate language.
Experience creating, governing, and scaling voice and tone guidelines and content systems—including AI content tooling—that cross-functional teams actively adopt.
Proficiency in leveraging both quantitative and qualitative research to inform, make, and defend content decisions.
Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executives and cross-functional leadership.
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
What we’ll offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $180,000-$205,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
📍Hybrid role based in London
Role Overview 🚀
We're looking for a Head of Data Science to own and lead data science at Uncapped. You will set the direction for how we use data, machine learning and AI across lending, forecasting and growth, ship production models that drive lending decisions, and manage and develop a team of data scientists.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write code and build models yourself, while raising the bar for the team and making the case for data science across the business. The role reports to the Chief Lending Officer and works closely with credit, underwriting, product, sales, engineering and the leadership team.
You will inherit a working stack and a live model portfolio: credit scorecards, a transaction categorisation model, revenue forecasting for our financing products, and an auto-rejection model for underwriting. Your job is to run it, improve it, and decide what comes next.
About Uncapped 👫
Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a fintech company focused on providing working capital to SMEs in North America and Europe.
We leverage multiple data sources to make credit decisions faster, safer and more conveniently. We are working with the largest platforms in the world, including Amazon and Walmart, and strive to be the best alternative-lender globally.
What you will do ✍️
Your impact will be focused on three core pillars: Leadership & Strategy, Models in Production, and People & Team.
Lead & Set Direction: Own the data science roadmap and tie it to company OKRs. Spot the opportunities yourself — a gap in the funnel, a new data source, a decision still made by hand — gather context from the business, and turn them into funded proposals. Decide what to build, what to stop, and what to say no to.
AI Agents & Automation: Build AI agents and frameworks that support, augment, or even replace manual understanding and review across the business.
Forecasting & Financing Products: Own revenue and cashflow forecasting for our revenue-based and merchant cash advance products. Build robust backtesting and evaluation so forecasts can be trusted in lending decisions.
Counterparty Recognition & Classification: Build and maintain transformer-based architectures for counterparty recognition and classification.
Growth & Propensity: Build models that drive commercial outcomes, such as refinancing propensity and targeting, working with sales and product to put them to use.
Platform & Engineering: Own the data science stack. Push models to production in a way the team can self-serve, and keep pipelines reliable and reproducible.
Manage & Grow the Team: Line-manage and develop junior data scientists. Give them problems rather than solutions, challenge their proposals before build, and stretch them with research-grade work. Run planning with weekly sprints, clear definitions of done, and epics linked to company OKRs.
Be the Voice of Data Science: Explain model decisions to underwriting and leadership, and ensure models meet regulatory requirements for automated credit decisions.
