jobs.title: Director, Incident & Availability Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role
Availability and resilience are core to keeping Chime reliable for millions of members who count on us for their everyday financial lives. The Incident & Availability Engineering organization is responsible for the systems, tooling, and culture that keep Chime up, resilient to outages, and fast to recover when incidents occur. We're looking for a Director to lead this org and define what comes next: an intelligent, automated platform where AI and ML aid in real-time incident triage, root cause analysis, and automated mitigation. If you have experience building scalable availability, reliability, and incident response systems and want to lead this critical pillar of Chime's technical infrastructure, we'd love to talk.
In this role, you can expect to
Lead the Incident Operations and Availability Engineering teams, inclusive of tech lead managers (TLMs) and senior engineers across Incident Management, Availability Tooling, Resilience Engineering, and Observability. You'll report to the VP of Platform Engineering.
Set the multi-year vision and roadmap. Unify incident management, alerting, chaos engineering, and availability tracking into an intuitive, seamless reliability platform.
Drive a culture of ownership and accountability, both inside the larger Platform Engineering team as well across all Product Engineering functions.
Partner closely with Product Engineering, Security, Core Infrastructure, and Data teams. Co-own reliability SLAs/SLOs, drive cross-functional alignment on availability goals, and cultivate a blameless engineering culture.
Empower engineering teams to ship reliably. Build tools and practices that make service health, error budgets, and incident readiness transparent and low-friction for product and infrastructure teams.
Hire, coach and grow strong tech lead managers who stay hands-on technically while leading their teams. Build an inclusive, high-ownership team people want to join and stay on.
Ensure operational readiness, disaster recovery, and compliance. Partner with Risk and Security leaders to conduct game days, disaster scenarios, and maintain audit-ready incident governance.
To thrive in this role, you have
10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years leading teams and at least 2 years leading tech lead managers or engineering managers in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure, or Availability domains.
A track record of building SRE, incident response, observability, or availability platforms operating at high scale.
Experience leveraging ML or LLM-based tooling for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, or automated remediation, along with a firm understanding of governance and safe execution in production environments.
Deep expertise in incident response lifecycle, disaster recovery, chaos engineering, and driving SLO/SLA frameworks across large engineering organizations.
Strong distributed systems, high availability architecture, and telemetry/observability background (tracing, metrics, logs, event processing).
Clear executive communication skills during high-stakes incidents and a proven ability to lead cross-functional post-mortems and reliability initiatives.
Bonus: experience in fintech, high-availability financial services, or managing mission-critical 24/7/365 infrastructure.
#LI-Onsite #LI-WW1
Below is the base salary offered for this role and level of experience. Full-time employees may also be eligible for bonus(es), competitive equity, and benefits. For commissioned roles, the base salary listed in this job description does not include incentive/variable pay. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
Wage Notice
$253,000—$350,000 USD
A little about us
At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
Because if we don't—who will?
*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.
What we offer for our full-time, regular employees
🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress
We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.
To learn more about how Chime collects and uses your personal information during the application process, please see the Chime Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Strength in Trust
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
The Challenge
OneTrust is hiring a Director of Product Management to lead our AI Platform. You will be accountable for getting customers to turn AI on, use it heavily, and create business value from that usage. AI is built into the OneTrust platform. The question that matters most is how much customers use it once it’s on. You will own that answer, and lead three product teams: infrastructure, quality and trust, and agent building and reasoning. This is a strategic role, and a hands-on one. You will prototype directly with modern AI development and design tools. When a team is stuck, you can open the tools and show them what great looks like.
Your Mission
You are accountable for three outcomes, judged together: engagement, adoption, and revenue.
Engagement (first priority): Increase AI usage per customer that has access to AI and has turned it on.
Adoption: Move customers from having access to AI to turning it on, working with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.
Revenue: AI-attributed revenue within existing solution sales, a shared goal with Sales and Finance.
Set strategy and roadmap across infrastructure, quality and trust, and agent building and reasoning, and make the tradeoffs between them.
Design AI capabilities to scale across the OneTrust platform and partner ecosystem.
Work with Product Marketing, Sales, Sales Engineering, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Finance on roadmap and go-to-market.
Build and lead a team of product managers and product leaders with clear accountability and high standards.
Run customer listening, including the Customer Advisory Board and voice-of-customer programs, so the roadmap follows real usage.
Represent the AI platform externally with customers, analysts, and partners.
Who You Are
You build, not just manage. You have grown usage of an enterprise platform or AI product, not just launched it. You can set multi-year strategy and also work through hard product problems with a team. You think in platforms, not point solutions, and you know how to lead in a complex enterprise where trust and scale matter.
Your Experience Includes
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus
10+ years in enterprise software product management, including 5+ years leading product managers or product leaders
Built and launched an AI product or capability that customers use, with usage numbers and engagement results you can point to
Track record of growing usage and engagement of a platform or AI product
Strong commercial instincts, including shaping product strategy based on market opportunity, customer economics, and revenue levers
Solid technical grounding in AI platforms, including infrastructure, agent building, and evaluation, enough to work credibly with engineering leaders
Able to prototype with modern AI development and design tools, showing direction by building rather than through slides
Sound prioritization and investment decisions across multiple teams
Partnered with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Finance
Influence with executives, internally and externally
Clear, persuasive communicator
Able to build structure and momentum where none exists yet
For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, and Washington-based candidates: the annual base pay range for this role is listed below. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors, including location, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education and/or training. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, equity, and/or commissions, as well as benefits.
Salary Range
$227,100—$302,800 USD
Where we Work
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
Benefits
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
Resources
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram
Your Data
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
Our Commitment to You
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
The Challenge
OneTrust is hiring a Director of Product Management to lead our AI Platform. You will be accountable for getting customers to turn AI on, use it heavily, and create business value from that usage. AI is built into the OneTrust platform. The question that matters most is how much customers use it once it’s on. You will own that answer, and lead three product teams: infrastructure, quality and trust, and agent building and reasoning. This is a strategic role, and a hands-on one. You will prototype directly with modern AI development and design tools. When a team is stuck, you can open the tools and show them what great looks like.
Your Mission
You are accountable for three outcomes, judged together: engagement, adoption, and revenue.
Engagement (first priority): Increase AI usage per customer that has access to AI and has turned it on.
Adoption: Move customers from having access to AI to turning it on, working with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.
Revenue: AI-attributed revenue within existing solution sales, a shared goal with Sales and Finance.
Set strategy and roadmap across infrastructure, quality and trust, and agent building and reasoning, and make the tradeoffs between them.
Design AI capabilities to scale across the OneTrust platform and partner ecosystem.
Work with Product Marketing, Sales, Sales Engineering, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Finance on roadmap and go-to-market.
Build and lead a team of product managers and product leaders with clear accountability and high standards.
Run customer listening, including the Customer Advisory Board and voice-of-customer programs, so the roadmap follows real usage.
Represent the AI platform externally with customers, analysts, and partners.
Who You Are
You build, not just manage. You have grown usage of an enterprise platform or AI product, not just launched it. You can set multi-year strategy and also work through hard product problems with a team. You think in platforms, not point solutions, and you know how to lead in a complex enterprise where trust and scale matter.
Your Experience Includes
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus
10+ years in enterprise software product management, including 5+ years leading product managers or product leaders
Built and launched an AI product or capability that customers use, with usage numbers and engagement results you can point to
Track record of growing usage and engagement of a platform or AI product
Strong commercial instincts, including shaping product strategy based on market opportunity, customer economics, and revenue levers
Solid technical grounding in AI platforms, including infrastructure, agent building, and evaluation, enough to work credibly with engineering leaders
Able to prototype with modern AI development and design tools, showing direction by building rather than through slides
Sound prioritization and investment decisions across multiple teams
Partnered with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Finance
Influence with executives, internally and externally
Clear, persuasive communicator
Able to build structure and momentum where none exists yet
For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, and Washington-based candidates: the annual base pay range for this role is listed below. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors, including location, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education and/or training. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, equity, and/or commissions, as well as benefits.
Salary Range
$194,100—$258,800 USD
Where we Work
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
Benefits
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
Resources
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram
Your Data
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
Our Commitment to You
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design - Systems & Infrastructure
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
We're looking for a Design Leader to oversee multiple Systems and Infrastructure teams as the company transforms and expands. This is a rare opportunity to become the steward of the system behind how Figma designs and builds Figma: the foundations, tokens and variables, component libraries, tooling, governance, and shared infrastructure that help our teams create with quality and coherence at scale. The work will shape every Figma product and, through them, the experience of millions of people.
This is a Director-level leadership role with meaningful scope. You'll lead designers across multiple Design workstreams, set direction through a complex transformation, and partner deeply with Design, Product, and Engineering to turn strong foundations into greater quality, speed, and leverage across Figma. If you believe the best systems create coherence without limiting the autonomy teams need to do exceptional work, this is the role for you.
This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
What you’ll do at Figma:
Lead and grow designers across Figma's internal Design Systems foundations, tokens and variables, component libraries, internal tooling, governance, and adoption
Set a clear vision and quality bar for how Figma's shared design foundations evolve, translating the company's transformation into coherent, durable foundations for the product suite
Partner with cross-functional leaders on strategy, resourcing, technical direction, adoption, and execution across a complex organization
Bring clarity and momentum to ambiguous, cross-functional work, balancing system coherence with the autonomy product teams need to solve distinct problems well
Evolve the Design Systems operating model, including governance, contribution paths, critiques and reviews, documentation, feedback loops, and adoption practices
Hire, coach, retain, and develop an exceptional team, helping designers grow their craft, judgment, and leadership throughout the team
Represent the Design Systems perspective in broader organizational decisions and ensure Figma's design infrastructure evolves with its expanding product suite
We'd love to hear from you if you have:
5+ years of product design management experience, including direct people leadership across multiple workstreams and a demonstrated history of hiring, coaching, retaining, and developing designers
Technical fluency with design foundations, tokens and variables, component libraries, internal tooling, and system architecture, plus direct experience applying or leading AI-enabled Design Systems workflows
Experience evolving an internal design system at scale, earning trust across a sizable product organization, and leading the change required to drive meaningful adoption
Deep, hands-on Figma expertise, high agency, end-to-end ownership, and a track record of creating clarity and momentum through organizational change
Experience connecting coded component systems with design libraries and design-to-code workflows
While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:
Building token pipelines and maintaining reliable synchronization between design foundations and code
Creating internal tooling and automation that improves system maintenance, contribution, and adoption
A track record of building shared platform or infrastructure services that other teams depend on
Experience leading large-scale system migrations or design-infrastructure transformations across a multi-product organization
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure
Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.
Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.
Annual Base Salary Range:
$290,000—$376,000 USD
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.
Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:
Holding interviews in an accessible location
Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
Changing the mode or format of interviews
To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.
By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.
Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:
Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.
Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

jobs.title: Director- Engineering. (Hospitality) SN7
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Cluster Director of Engineering is a key member of the cluster leadership team, responsible for
overseeing all engineering, maintenance, facilities management, technical services, and asset
protection functions across multiple hotels within the portfolio.
This role combines strategic leadership, technical expertise, and project management capabilities to
support hotels with different technical requirements. The Cluster Director of Engineering will play a
critical role throughout the pre-opening, opening, and operational phases, ensuring successful
project handovers, operational readiness, regulatory compliance, maintenance excellence, and longterm
asset preservation.
The successful candidate will lead engineering teams across the cluster, oversee technical operations
and capital projects, and work closely with ownership, consultants, and contractors to ensure the
hotels are delivered, maintained, and operated to the highest standards of safety, reliability,
efficiency, and sustainability.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead all engineering, maintenance, and facilities management operations across the hotel
cluster, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all assets.
• Develop and execute engineering strategies that support hotel business objectives, brand
requirements, owner priorities, and long-term asset value enhancement.
• Lead the engineering transition from project delivery to hotel operations, including testing &
commissioning, inspections, snagging, defect management, and operational handover.
• Participate in design reviews and technical workshops to ensure projects are delivered in
accordance with operational requirements and engineering best practices.
• Review and validate engineering-related OS&E requirements, maintenance equipment,
workshop tools, spare parts inventories, and procurement plans to ensure operational
readiness and cost effectiveness.
• Prepare, manage, and control Engineering Pre-Opening Budgets (POB), ensuring all
engineering readiness activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.
• Develop and implement preventative and predictive maintenance programmes for all
building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire & life safety systems, vertical
transportation, kitchen equipment, and utilities infrastructure.
• Oversee capital expenditure projects, asset lifecycle planning, refurbishment works, and
replacement programs across the cluster.
• Drive operational efficiencies through preventive maintenance, energy management
initiatives, contract optimization, and engineering best practices.
Champion sustainability, energy conservation, water management, and ESG initiatives across
all properties.
• Ensure full compliance with all regulatory, environmental, health & safety, and life safety
requirements.
• Establish emergency preparedness plans, crisis response procedures, and business continuity
measures for all hotels.
• Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams through coaching, training,
succession planning, and performance management.
• Establish strong working relationships with ownership, project teams, consultants,
contractors, and local authorities to ensure successful project delivery and ongoing asset
stewardship.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics - Consumer Growth
jobs.text:
About the Team
The Analytics team is looking for a leader to spearhead Consumer Growth within the Analytics team. This role is important for DoorDash to continue to drive improvements for our active users and will have a direct impact on DoorDash’s overall growth. You will lead a team of managers and individual contributors and work cross-functionally with strategy and operations, product management, analytics, and senior leadership to drive our business forward.
About the Role
As the Director of Consumer Growth Analytics, you’ll use your quantitative background to lead other data scientists and dive into large datasets to guide decision-making. We solve many exciting challenges including login and new user experience, customer acquisition, customer activation and retention and experimentation. If you have a growth mindset and enjoy building teams to test & learn how to optimize consumer growth, we’re looking for someone like you!
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead a team that creates quantitative analysis to provide insights that help the business and product leaders improve product experience, reduce user friction, and drive growth
Develop data-driven frameworks which inform strategy to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention
Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using SQL, R, Python, or other scripting and statistical tools
Create company projects by identifying essential metrics and building executive-facing dashboards to track progress
Work with our Product, Operations, Engineering, and Machine Learning teams to drive consumer growth
Present in meetings and business reviews with our executive team and founders
Build a world-class Growth Analytics team that includes hiring new leaders and coaching individual contributors on how to use more advanced methods and drive greater impact
Synthesize insights and connect the dots with teams across DoorDash (e.g., Marketing, New Verticals, Logistics, Support, etc) to identify net-new growth levers
Drive efficiencies and innovation through the implementation of AI / agentic solutions into Analytics workflows
We're excited about you because you have…
A degree in Math, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
10+ years of experience in data analytics or related quantitative role
Experience building and leading high-performing teamsExperience working with user segmentation, cohort analyses, measurement and experimentation, product funnel optimization, algorithmic decision systems, etc
Expertise in Analytics tools, ETL, A/B Testing, and statistical analysis (e.g. hypothesis testing, experimentation, regressions) with statistical packages, such as Matlab, R, SAS or Python
Proficiency in one or more analytics and visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Mode, Tableau)
Applied experience leveraging LLM-based AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, etc) to Analytics / Data Science workflows
Experience with Consumer-facing apps and/or websites, ideally including experience driving growth outcomes through insights and analysis
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way
The determination to initiate and lead projects
Strong communication skills
Compensation
The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.
To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.
See below for paid time off details:
For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$255,000—$375,000 USD
About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.
Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.
How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.
Data Retention, Privacy & Bias Audit: Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/ax-privacy-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden-ai.com/metaview/application-review.

jobs.title: AI and Data Director, APAC
jobs.text:
Performance & Technology – AI & Data | Partner | Asia Pacific
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it matters most. In Asia Pacific, our AI & Data Partner will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping and scaling our regional offering, driving growth across priority markets including Greater China, Southeast Asia, and ANZ.
This role is suited for a senior leader with strong entrepreneurial mindset, deep client relationships, and a proven ability to originate and deliver high-impact, technology-enabled transformations.
What you’ll do
AI Transformation
Artificial Intelligence is creating one of the largest business transformations of our generation. While many organizations are experimenting with AI, relatively few have succeeded in turning it into measurable business value.
At AlixPartners, we help clients move beyond experimentation.
We combine strategy, transformation and execution to help organization's identify high-impact AI opportunities, redesign operating models, prototype solutions, deploy AI at scale and create sustainable business outcomes.
Our AI Transformation team brings together experienced consultants, AI specialists and industry experts to help organizations rethink how they operate, make decisions and create value. Working with colleagues across our global network, we support clients across APAC in functions including operations, finance, procurement, supply chain, commercial excellence and corporate strategy.
Our ambition is to build a team of consultants who combine outstanding business judgement with modern AI capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape our AI Transformation capabilities across APAC and influence how AI consulting evolves within AlixPartners.
What We Offer
Impactful, hands-on and pragmatic—at AlixPartners, your career is driven by performance, initiative and the value you create.
Working in small, highly experienced teams, you will collaborate directly with CEOs, executive committees, Boards and private equity investors on some of their most strategic and time-critical challenges.
Our consultants do more than develop recommendations. They work alongside clients to design solutions, prototype rapidly, deploy at scale and measure the impact created.
One week you may be helping a CEO define an enterprise AI strategy. The next, you may be building an AI-enabled solution to automate a critical business process, improve decision-making or transform the way an organization operates.
This unique combination of strategy, execution and technology is what differentiates AlixPartners.
Through our One-Firm approach, you will collaborate with experts across industries, functions and geographies, gaining exposure to diverse APAC markets and global client challenges.
Your Role - Director
As a Director in our APAC AI Transformation team, you will lead senior client relationships, originate and shape major AI transformation opportunities, oversee delivery and help build our regional practice, team and market presence.
Your responsibilities will include:
AI Strategy & Transformation
Set enterprise AI transformation strategies, investment agendas and multi-year implementation roadmaps.
Identify and shape high-value AI opportunities with CEOs, Boards and executive leadership teams across APAC.
Design AI-enabled operating models, governance frameworks and enterprise transformation programmes.
Advise executives on AI investment, responsible adoption, security, risk and value creation.
Sponsor organizational change and guide clients through complex AI transformation decisions.
Build & Prototype
Provide hands-on technical and commercial leadership for GenAI solutions built using APIs from leading Large Language Models.
Oversee the development and enterprise deployment of AI agents, including integration, orchestration, monitoring and controls.
Guide scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation and knowledge architectures using vector databases and secure enterprise data.
Set standards for intelligent workflows, AI governance, responsible AI, privacy and security.
Translate strategic business challenges into differentiated AI propositions and executable programmes.
Deliver Business Impact
Oversee the delivery of high-impact AI transformations and ensure senior client satisfaction.
Drive enterprise adoption, organizational change and sustained client capability.
Hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes, value realization and solution performance.
Guide executive decisions across business value, technical feasibility, risk and investment.
Ensure solutions are responsible, secure, scalable and aligned with client strategy.
Build the Practice
As a senior leader in our growing APAC AI Transformation practice, you will also:
originate and develop major client opportunities and long-term relationships;
shape differentiated offerings, methodologies and intellectual property;
lead proposals, commercial negotiations and business development;
recruit, mentor and develop high-performing consultants and AI specialists;
build AlixPartners' market leadership and ecosystem across APAC.
This description is not intended to provide an exhaustive list of responsibilities.
What you’ll need
We are looking for a senior AI transformation leader who combines commercial instincts, executive advisory skills, hands-on technical credibility and a strong record of building businesses and teams.
The successful candidate will be comfortable originating work, leading complex engagements and operating across diverse APAC markets and cultures.
Relevant backgrounds may include senior roles in leading IT consulting firms, commercial AI solution businesses within technology companies, specialised AI firms, or enterprise technology, digital, product and AI leadership teams.
around 15 years of experience with outstanding executive judgement, commercial leadership and structured problem solving;
hands-on professional experience and deep credibility in Generative AI solutions, Machine Learning, Data Modelling/analysis
experience overseeing the development and deployment of enterprise AI agents;
a strong record of taking AI solutions from concept to scaled production and measurable value;
exceptional executive communication, relationship-building and people leadership skills;
the ability to connect strategy, operations, data, technology and commercialization;
an entrepreneurial mindset and a demonstrated ability to build practices, offerings or teams.
Technical Experience
The following capabilities are essential:
Hands-on experience and leadership credibility in enterprise GenAI solutions using LLM APIs, MLOps, cloud architectures etc. training or self-learning alone is not sufficient.
Experience overseeing the development and deployment of AI agents in enterprise environments, including integration, orchestration, monitoring and controls.
Demonstrated experience taking AI solutions from prototype or proof of concept into scaled production and commercialization.
Experience developing or commercializing AI products, AI-enabled devices or robotics is advantageous.
Experience with RAG, vector databases, AI governance, responsible AI and security is advantageous.
Technical credibility must come from real professional delivery, deployment and commercialization, not solely training, certification or personal experimentation.
Consulting experience is a plus, but is not required where the candidate brings strong enterprise AI commercialization, senior client relationships and business-building capability.
Fluency in English is required; Asian language capability (e.g., Mandarin) is a strong advantage.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Asia Pacific.
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties, or responsibilities.
The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.
The benefit type and level differ per location.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

jobs.title: Product Director - Finance / Governance Risk Compliance Domain
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
Enterprise Efficiency builds the internal products and platforms that power how our company operates across People, Finance, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Legal, Procurement, and related functions.
We are looking for a Product Director to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and team for this portfolio. You will combine enterprise domain expertise, product judgment, and organizational leadership to identify operational problems, redesign workflows, and deliver measurable improvements through enterprise systems, automation, and AI.
You will build a product organization that owns the full journey from problem discovery and process design through delivery, adoption, and business impact. Partnering with functional leaders and engineering, you will connect individual initiatives into a coherent enterprise product strategy.
What You’ll Be Doing
Turn domain expertise into enterprise products. Understand your function’s processes, policies, controls, and user needs. Translate them into internal products that simplify daily work and support business operations at scale.
Own product strategy and roadmap for your domain. Partner with functional leaders to prioritize system foundations and efficiency opportunities. Make clear investment and build-versus-buy decisions aligned with business goals.
Redesign end-to-end workflows. Identify bottlenecks, remove unnecessary steps, and reduce manual handoffs and spreadsheet work. Define clear business rules, approvals, exceptions, and ownership from initiation through completion.
Connect domain systems and data. Partner with engineering to integrate core systems and internal tools, improve data consistency, and deliver connected user experiences with appropriate permissions and auditability.
Drive efficiency through automation and AI. Identify, test, and scale capabilities that reduce repetitive work and improve decision quality, enabling your function to handle growing demand without proportional increases in manual effort.
Lead delivery, adoption, and business outcomes. Align engineering, design, and functional owners from discovery through rollout and continuous improvement. Measure results through cycle time, manual effort, accuracy, adoption, and control effectiveness.
What We Look For In You
7+ years of experience in product management or closely related enterprise product roles, including experience leading product managers and managing a portfolio across teams.
A track record of taking enterprise products from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Deep functional expertise in at least one of the following domains, with experience leading initiatives across adjacent functions:
Finance: FP&A, procurement-to-pay, record-to-report, accounting operations, or financial controls.

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.text:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.
About the Job
We are looking for an experienced Product Director to lead our core payment portfolios, encompassing Payments Acceptance (Cards & LPMs) and Payouts. In this role, you will define the long-term product vision, set the strategic roadmap, and drive the evolution of our B2B payments infrastructure. We are seeking a visionary product leader who has a deep understanding of the payments industry, knows what best-in-class looks like, and can elevate our product offerings to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions across multiple regions.
What you’ll do in this role:
Define and own the long-term product strategy and comprehensive roadmaps for large-scale payment portfolios, focusing on future growth and innovation.
Drive product performance and take ownership of key commercial and technical metrics, including authorization/success rates, total payment volume (TPV), cost of acceptance, and margin optimization.
Build and scale robust B2B payment products and infrastructure across multiple regions and complex regulatory jurisdictions.
Partner closely with engineering teams, utilizing your technical background to guide how payment systems, connections, and integrations work together seamlessly.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of Product Managers and Senior Product Managers, fostering a culture of strategic thinking paired with hands-on product ownership.
What you’ll need in this role:
8+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of leading product teams and owning end-to-end strategy.
Deep knowledge of card acquiring and/or local payment methods, specifically gained from working at a Payment Service Provider (PSP) or a dedicated payments technology company.
Demonstrated experience building and managing large B2B payment portfolios rather than just individual features.
Highly metrics-minded and analytical, with direct experience managing payments economics and performance indicators.
Technical fluency necessary to understand and navigate complex payment architectures and integrations.
Preferred: Experience with payouts/disbursements, Southeast Asia or emerging market payment methods (e-wallets, QR, etc.), multi-acquirer routing, and fraud/risk management.

jobs.title: Director Of Engineering - Intelligence Platform & Applications
jobs.text:
About Truveta
Truveta transforms healthcare into intelligence. Built with and owned by US health systems united by a mission of Saving Lives with Data, Truveta powers breakthrough discoveries, auditable data fit for regulatory submissions, and AI that improves patient care.
At Truveta, we are building something that has never existed before, bringing together healthcare, science, and technology to tackle some of the most important challenges in human health. Our mission calls us to think big, move with urgency, and build with purpose. We are looking for exceptional people who are energized by hard problems, inspired by the opportunity to improve health, and committed to building a company and culture where talented people can do their best work.
Our team is a special combination of software, health, and big data experience. We are building a talented team of passionate, mission-oriented, and innovative thinkers.
Who We Need
Join Truveta's Intelligence organization and lead a team of engineers building the next wave of healthcare AI. Your team will build adaptive agentic systems that keep learning, reason over complex data and real customer use cases, and drive real-world impact in healthcare. Guided by Truveta's mission of Saving Lives with Data, you'll help turn health data into intelligence that clinicians and researchers can use to make proactive, data-driven decisions.
We're looking for an Intelligence Pod Lead at the Truveta India Development Center (IDC): a hands-on technical leader with depth in applied agentic AI and large-scale engineering, a solid grounding in machine learning fundamentals, and a record of helping the engineers around them do their best work. You'll set your pod's technical direction, own what it delivers from start to finish, and still write code and make the key architecture calls. You'll grow a high-performing team that ships scalable, self-improving AI agents and the platform systems that support them. These systems will learn from large and varied healthcare data and deliver useful insights through automation and reasoning.
Location: Hyderabad, India.
This Opportunity
Patients, clinicians, medical researchers and healthcare decision makers deserve the same large-scale innovation and AI that has already transformed how people work, create and communicate in many other fields. As an Intelligence Pod Lead, you'll turn ambitious AI ideas into reliable production systems that improve research and development, business strategy, operations and care delivery across healthcare.
You'll own a focused problem space end to end: defining the technical roadmap, breaking down ambiguous problems, guiding design and evaluation, and making sure your team delivers measurable results. You'll be a force multiplier. Your judgment, mentoring and technical leadership will raise the bar for your pod and for the wider Intelligence organization.
If you want purposeful work and the chance to influence how AI supports learning, decision-making and discovery in healthcare, this role lets you lead and keep growing. You'll work in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where your leadership directly shapes how healthcare becomes more connected, intelligent and impactful.
What You'll Do
Lead the team's technical direction. Define and own the technical vision, architecture and engineering roadmap for your pod's area, such as agentic workflows, knowledge curation and retrieval, structured reasoning and automated evaluation. Make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation, performance, cost and reliability.
Architect agentic AI systems. Design multi-agent workflows with frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI that combine reasoning, planning, memory and tool use. Apply strong context engineering, agent harnesses and deterministic guardrails so long-running agents stay reliable. Use interoperability protocols such as MCP, A2A and Agent Skills to build goal-driven systems that work smoothly with other agents and services, and use observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith to drive continuous improvement.
Drive knowledge curation and retrieval strategy. Oversee the design of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, knowledge graphs built from unstructured documents, embedding strategies and vector stores (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search) that ground reasoning in trusted healthcare data.
Build and develop the team. Hire, mentor and coach engineers, set a high bar for engineering quality, and build a culture of ownership and fast, thoughtful iteration. Partner closely with product, data and engineering counterparts across time zones.
Champion responsible AI. Make sure your team's systems reflect ethical AI principles and meet privacy, security and regulatory expectations for healthcare data, so healthcare intelligence advances responsibly at scale. Build in agent security (defenses against prompt injection and tool poisoning, sandboxing, and agent identity with least-privilege access) and human-in-the-loop safeguards against automation bias in clinical settings.
Keep learning and help the team learn. Stay ahead of new AI architectures, agentic frameworks and approaches to reasoning and retrieval. Bring curiosity, humility and a bias toward iteration, and help the team adopt new ideas thoughtfully.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience building and deploying scalable, production-ready ML systems in a collaborative engineering environment.
2+ years in a technical lead or similar role, including setting technical direction and mentoring engineers.
A track record of taking complex ML or AI systems from concept to production with measurable impact.
Deep, hands-on proficiency with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and a working understanding of interoperability protocols such as MCP, A2A and Agent Skills.
Experience building production agent harnesses with guardrails and context engineering.
Experience designing and operating semantic search systems with knowledge graphs and/or RAG, vector databases and embeddings (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search or similar).
Strong expertise in agentic evaluation, including designing metrics, evaluators or reward models for continuous improvement, and evaluating agents at the agent and trajectory level.
Strong software engineering fundamentals, with expert proficiency in Python and experience designing scalable systems in modern cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP).
Excellent communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners and leadership, and working effectively across time zones and geographies.
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related technical field.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with healthcare, life sciences or other regulated data (e.g., EHR, claims, clinical text), including privacy and compliance considerations.
Experience running ML experiments and training at scale, including distributed training, GPU optimization and inference serving.
Experience with MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD for models, observability, drift monitoring and production evaluation loops.
Publications, open-source contributions or patents in applied ML, NLP or agentic systems.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Refold AI
Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.
We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.
Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.
About this role
We want a builder who still lives in the code, not an architect who lives in meetings. You've done the seed-to-Series-B/C journey once; you know exactly what breaks at each stage of scale, and you want to do it again with your hands on the keyboard. You've worked deeply on B2B SaaS and enterprise-scale problems, so you understand the depth of what our customers need and how to build around it. You'll own engineering end-to-end: the platform and agent infra, the team, and the bar. This is the person who turns a young, hungry team into a world-class one.
What you'll do
Own the technical direction for our platform and agent infra, and stay hands-on: scope, build, and make the hard calls yourself
Scale the engineering org from where it is today with the growth of the firm, hiring and grooming a world-class team along the way
Ship fast without breaking enterprise trust: reliability, security, and depth are non-negotiable for our B2B SaaS customers
Set the engineering bar, culture, and rituals, and defend them as we grow
Partner with founders and GTM to translate enterprise problems into shipped product
What we're looking for
10-12 years building software, with real depth in the implementation and development of infrastructure for AI agents
You've experienced the scaling journey firsthand—at a global company or at a high-growth startup (Series A, Series B, or Series C+).
Proven B2B SaaS and enterprise-scale experience: you understand the depth of problems and know how to navigate them
A leader who moves really fast and has managed teams of 20-30, with a track record of building and grooming top engineering talent
Bonus points
You've founded a company before
You've built agent or LLM systems in production, not just prototypes
You've owned security and reliability for enterprise customers
You've hired into a Bangalore-based engineering org
How we work
Ship weekly: We move fast and ship often.
Bold ideas welcome: Creativity and out-of-the-box thinking, celebrated.
High ownership, low ego: A young, talented team steering the ship together.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Assistant Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Hotel Name: M Social Sunnyvale
Location: Onsite – Sunnyvale, CA
Salary Range: $85,000.00 - $90,000.00
Join the Team at M Social Sunnyvale
At M Social Sunnyvale, we don’t just welcome guests—we create moments, spark connections, and bring energy to every interaction. Designed for the young at heart, M Social delivers a bold and vibrant hospitality experience.
About M Social Sunnyvale
As the first ground-up M Social in the U.S., this innovative property features 263 rooms, a dynamic courtyard, and the signature Beast & Butterflies social hub. Located in Silicon Valley, the hotel blends technology, design, and social connectivity to create a unique guest experience.
As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotel is backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence—driven by a passion for hospitality, an entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a progressive, solutions-oriented approach."
At Millennium, we are guided by our core values:
Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
Entrepreneurial – Taking ownership and acting with agility
Innovation & Progressive – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
Solutions & Results Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results
These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our teams.
About the Role:
As our Assistant Director of Engineering, you will support the Director of Engineering in overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and upkeep of the hotel’s building, equipment, systems, and facilities. You will play a key role in ensuring the property operates safely, efficiently, and consistently while maintaining the high standards expected at M Social Sunnyvale.
This role is ideal for an experienced engineering professional with strong leadership skills, technical knowledge, and a hands-on approach to hotel maintenance. You will work closely with Engineering, Housekeeping, Front Office, Food & Beverage, Security, and other hotel departments to quickly address maintenance needs and support an exceptional guest experience.
Your Impact – Engineering & Guest Experience
You will play a key role in maintaining a safe, comfortable, and well-functioning hotel environment for both guests and team members. Your leadership, technical expertise, and attention to detail will contribute to the reliability of hotel systems, preventative maintenance efforts, operational efficiency, and overall guest satisfaction.
What You'll Be Doing
Engineering Operations
Support the Director of Engineering in overseeing the daily operations of the Engineering Department
Assist with the maintenance and operation of the hotel’s building systems, equipment, and facilities
Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house areas, and mechanical spaces
Respond to maintenance requests and ensure work orders are completed accurately and in a timely manner
Prioritize urgent maintenance issues and coordinate appropriate response
Assist with troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other building systems
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment conditions
Support the Engineering Department in maintaining a clean, organized, and professional work environment
Preventative Maintenance
Assist in developing and maintaining preventative maintenance schedules for hotel equipment and systems
Ensure routine inspections and preventative maintenance tasks are completed according to established schedules
Identify potential equipment or facility issues before they impact guests or hotel operations
Monitor the condition and performance of mechanical equipment and building systems
Recommend repairs, replacements, or improvements when necessary
Assist with maintaining equipment manuals, maintenance records, and service documentation
Team Leadership & Development
Assist in supervising, training, and developing Engineering team members
Provide direction and support to Engineering staff during daily operations
Assign and prioritize work orders based on operational needs
Monitor the quality and completion of work performed by Engineering team members
Foster a collaborative, accountable, and service-focused department
Support scheduling and staffing needs within the Engineering Department
Lead by example and promote a positive team environment
Guest & Hotel Support
Respond promptly to guest and operational maintenance requests
Work closely with Front Office and other departments to address guest room and public area concerns
Communicate maintenance-related issues and updates to hotel leadership
Assist with resolving guest concerns related to room conditions, temperature, plumbing, electrical systems, and other facility issues
Support hotel operations during high-volume periods, emergencies, and special events
Maintain a strong focus on guest comfort, safety, and overall experience
Safety & Compliance
Ensure Engineering operations follow all applicable safety regulations, company policies, and hotel procedures
Conduct and document required safety inspections and maintenance checks
Identify and report potential safety hazards promptly
Support compliance with fire and life safety requirements
Assist with emergency response procedures and building-related emergencies
Ensure proper use, storage, and maintenance of tools, equipment, and chemicals
Maintain compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations
Coordinate with outside contractors and service providers when specialized repairs or inspections are required
Energy & Facility Management
Monitor hotel utility systems and identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency
Assist with monitoring HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, water, and other building systems
Support initiatives designed to reduce energy consumption and operating costs
Help maintain efficient operation of hotel facilities while minimizing disruption to guests
Communicate equipment issues and recommended improvements to the Director of Engineering
