jobs.title: VP, Head of Product - Advertising
jobs.text:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.
Spotify has the opportunity to build one of the world's most distinctive advertising businesses at the intersection of audio, video, display, and creator culture, powered by deep audience insights and a global platform reaching hundreds of millions of people.
We're looking for a VP, Head of Product, Advertising to help define what advertising on Spotify becomes. Building on the transformation of our advertising platform, you'll shape the next generation of advertising products and experiences, how brands connect with audiences, and unlock new opportunities for growth. You'll balance strengthening and scaling our core platform with creating entirely new products, capabilities, and business opportunities that differentiate Spotify in the market.
Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you'll be a member of the global Advertising leadership team within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You'll set the strategic direction for our advertising product portfolio, lead a global Product and Design organization, and partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, and Partnerships to translate Spotify's unique position in content, culture, and technology into compelling advertiser experiences and sustainable business growth.

jobs.title: Sr. Technology Partner Director, Security & Observability ISV Partnerships
jobs.text:
RDQ428R3
At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high-value challenges that are central to their own missions.
Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA to a global organization with over 8,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 move valuable private companies.
About the role:
As the Head of Security & Observability ISV Partnerships, you will be responsible for recruiting, developing, and scaling a global partner ecosystem that makes Databricks the best place to run data-and-AI-intensive security and observability workloads. You will own strategy and execution with top ISVs across cybersecurity (identity, endpoint, governance, compliance, data protection, threat detection) and observability (logging, monitoring, APM, telemetry) — building integrations, co-creating joint GTM plays, and helping our field and customers realize the value of combining Databricks with leading security and observability partners.
We are looking for someone who has “seen the movie” on what works and what doesn’t at one or more hyperscalers and, ideally, has also worked at a leading cybersecurity or observability ISV. The role demands both technical and GTM acumen — able to work with Product and Engineering teams on integrations across identity, governance, logging, and monitoring, as well as with Sales and Marketing teams on go-to-market execution. It is a fast-paced, cross-functional role requiring strong communication, prioritization, and presentation skills, and the ability to quickly context-switch between product, engineering, and field conversations. Success will require deep subject matter expertise in large-scale technology ecosystems, coupled with a scrappy, entrepreneurial spirit to build high-quality programs that establish Databricks as the best place to run security and observability workloads for years to come.
The impact you’ll have:
Define and execute Databricks’ security and observability ISV partnership strategy, including segmentation, prioritization, and success metrics.
Own executive and working-level relationships with top security and observability ISVs to drive integrations and joint field execution.
Partner with Product and Security/Trust teams to design, validate, and launch integrations that enhance governance, compliance, security, and observability for Databricks customers.
Build joint value propositions and scalable GTM motions with ISVs that resonate with CISOs, compliance officers, observability leaders, and data practitioners.
Partner with Sales leadership to design and land co-sell plays, enablement, and incentives that bring joint solutions to market.
Drive co-marketing initiatives and category-level campaigns with Marketing to generate joint demand.
Represent Databricks externally with partners, customers, and industry forums.
Advocate internally for partner and customer needs, influencing product roadmap and GTM strategy.
What we look for:
10+ years in product partnerships, business development, or partner management, including 7+ years focused on security, observability, or cloud ecosystems.
Proven success launching ISV integrations and GTM motions in security and/or observability with hyperscalers, with a track record of delivering measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue.
Deep understanding and network across cybersecurity and observability ecosystems — identity, governance, compliance, threat detection, data protection, logging, monitoring, and APM, and ability to develop joint value propositions that resonate with technical and business decision-makers alike.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills — able to influence Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Security/Trust teams.
Experience navigating co-opetition dynamics and sensitive partner relationships.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills — able to build crisp narratives for executive and C-level audiences.
Grit, humility, and the ability to operate in a high-growth, founder-led environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
**Most of all, we look for relentless problem solvers and will consider candidates with non-traditional backgrounds.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.text:
We are the global fitness powerhouse behind F45 Training, FS8, and VAURA Pilates. Spanning over 1,500 locations in more than 55 countries, we are on a mission to redefine the wellness industry by delivering high-energy, results-driven studio experiences to communities worldwide.
At FIT House of Brands, we live our brand. We are a collective of natural team players with big ideas, united by a passion for creating the world’s greatest workouts. Whether we are supporting our massive global franchise network or innovating on the studio floor, our commitment to community is at the core of everything we do. If you’re ready to crush your goals, elevate the member experience, and build a career that moves the world, you’ve found your fit.
As our VP of Technology, you will lead technology, product, engineering, data, and IT/security across all brands and markets. You will set the technology strategy and roadmap while staying close to execution, including architecture and vendor decisions, budget, and delivery of priority initiatives. Your north star is technology that makes franchisees more profitable and members more engaged.
What You’ll Do
Strategy and Leadership

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What's the opportunity?
We’re seeking a transformational Solutions Engineering leader to lead our Mid Market and Enterprise SE teams in North America. You’ll be a pivotal figure in helping Intercom scale its AI-driven support platform to some of the world’s most well-known brands. This role will shape how we engage with large, complex organizations, defining our go-to-market, building a world-class team, and delivering tangible customer outcomes through innovation and credibility.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a Solutions Engineering team focused on winning complex deals, creating vertical-specific solution architectures, and building repeatable playbooks. We believe in leaders who are open to be a player and a coach, regardless of seniority. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, and Services to deliver customer transformation through Intercom’s AI-first platform – be it through strategic guidance as a senior leader on the team, or securing deals with your own technical credibility where needed.
What will I be doing?
Define and evolve the strategic vision and go-to-market (GTM) approach for the Solutions Engineering function.
Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing SE team across global regions and core verticals.
Operate as a player-coach, actively engaging in strategic deals while developing team capabilities.
Support complex, six-figure sales cycles with technical guidance, architecture, demos, and product evaluation support, as well as sales expertise.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor and executive point of contact for large customers.
Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D to shape verticalized GTM motions and solution strategy.
Champion a customer-obsessed culture across the pre-sales journey – from outbound to implementation.
Lead discovery, design, and delivery of tailored technical solutions, including PoCs and business value assessments.
Build reusable, scalable solution frameworks, and industry-specific technical assets.
Advocate for customer needs and insights internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
Represent Intercom and the SE function externally through executive meetings and strategic events.
Foster strong relationships with C-level stakeholders, translating AI product capabilities into tangible business impact.
What skills do I need?
5+ years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer/Architect, or related individual contributor role.
Having 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales teams, with a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing high-performing teams.
Ideally, experience selling AI, data, or highly technical products; or at the very least, deep curiosity and utilization of AI on your day-to-day.
Comfortable with ambiguity in environments with an ability to stay focused and thrive under pressure while working with customers to solve their most challenging issues.
Have a humble attitude, and a passion to help others, with a willingness to learn whatever it takes to support the team and help our customers thrive.
A track record of consistently delivering revenue numbers, producing accurate forecasts, while maintaining a focus on team development and growth
Excellent communication and presentation skills
The OTE salary range for candidates within the Greater Chicago Area is $295,650-$353,140. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
#LI-Hybrid
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Policies
Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.
We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Partner Director, NTT Data Global
jobs.text:
About the Team
OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work cross-functionally across Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success to translate strategic partnerships into measurable outcomes for customers.
Global systems integrators and technology services partners help enterprises move from AI strategy to production deployment. This role will lead OpenAI’s global partnership with NTT DATA, bringing together its consulting, technology services, systems integration, and delivery capabilities with OpenAI’s products and platform. You will build the strategy, executive alignment, and operating model needed to turn the partnership into repeatable customer and commercial impact across regions and industries.
About the Role
We are hiring a Partner Director, Global NTT Data to serve as the single accountable owner of OpenAI’s strategic relationship with NTT Data globally. You will define the partnership strategy and joint business plan, build trusted executive relationships, and activate NTT Data’s regional, industry, sales, technical, and delivery organizations to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role with responsibility for the health, performance, and long-term expansion of the partnership. You will move between senior executive engagement, joint account and opportunity strategy, solution development, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. You will align global priorities with regional execution and help customers move from initial AI strategy through secure implementation, production adoption, and expansion.
The ideal candidate has led a global alliance with NTT Data or a comparable systems integrator, delivered measurable pipeline and customer outcomes, and built operating models that connect executive commitments to field behavior and successful deployments. You will bring commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align complex organizations while remaining accountable for results.
In this role, you will:
Own the global NTT Data partnership, including alliance strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery quality, and multi-year expansion.
Develop and execute a joint business plan with clear priorities, investments, decision rights, regional responsibilities, milestones, and measures of success.
Serve as OpenAI’s senior counterpart to NTT Data’s global and regional leadership. Build relationships across industry practices, consulting, sales, technology, alliance, and delivery teams to set priorities and resolve escalations.
Translate global partnership strategy into coordinated regional execution, working with OpenAI partner sales and account teams to establish clear ownership and consistent field engagement.
Lead joint account mapping, opportunity qualification, and strategic customer pursuits, aligning OpenAI and NTT Data teams around differentiated customer value and measurable commercial outcomes.
Shape joint solutions and industry-specific transformation offerings that combine OpenAI capabilities with NTT Data’s consulting, integration, application, data, cloud, and managed services expertise.
Engage with senior customer executives alongside NTT Data leaders to connect AI strategy, business priorities, implementation plans, and long-term value realization.
Create repeatable co-sell and delivery motions covering seller engagement, technical discovery, solution validation, delivery handoffs, production readiness, and customer expansion.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Security, Legal, Finance, and Customer Success to remove technical, contractual, compliance, and operational blockers across priority engagements.
Build partner capability through field enablement, technical readiness, reusable solution patterns, and clear expectations for implementation quality and customer success.
Establish executive governance, business reviews, pipeline inspection, forecasting, performance reporting, and escalation mechanisms that create accountability across both organizations.
Define and monitor partnership KPIs, including qualified pipeline, conversion, revenue, production adoption, customer value, partner readiness, delivery quality, and return on OpenAI investment.
Prioritize OpenAI resources across joint opportunities based on strategic alignment, commercial potential, customer impact, delivery readiness, and repeatability.
Work with relevant teams to establish clear standards for security, responsible AI deployment, intellectual property, and quality across joint engagements and co-developed assets.
Represent OpenAI in senior partner, customer, and industry engagements, and help build the team capacity and operating model needed to scale the global alliance over time.
You might thrive in this role if you have:
Significant experience leading strategic alliances, global systems integrator partnerships, ecosystem sales, business development, or enterprise GTM programs in AI, cloud, data, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
Deep familiarity with NTT DATA or a comparable global technology services organization, including its organizational structure, commercial incentives, regional decision-making, and enterprise delivery model.
Proven ownership of global, multi-year strategic partnerships with executive accountability and measurable pipeline, revenue, adoption, deployment, or customer outcomes.
Experience designing and scaling joint operating models across large, matrixed organizations, including governance, account planning, resource allocation, enablement, delivery handoffs, and escalation.
Demonstrated success shaping and advancing complex enterprise transformation opportunities, engaging senior executives, and navigating procurement, security, legal, and implementation requirements.
Strong executive presence and the ability to earn trust with global partner leaders and customer executives while remaining close to commercial and operating details.
Commercial judgment and experience qualifying opportunities, managing forecasts, prioritizing investments, and making clear tradeoffs across regions, industries, and customer segments.
Technical fluency across enterprise AI, data, cloud and hybrid environments, integration, security, governance, and modern application architectures.
Experience translating technology capabilities into differentiated industry solutions and repeatable partner-led customer engagements.
Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to align Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and external partner teams without direct authority.
Prior people leadership experience, with the ability to coach others, develop talent, and build team capacity as the partnership scales.
Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions and cultures.
A builder mindset, high ownership, low ego, and comfort creating structure and momentum in an evolving environment while maintaining a consistent focus on customer value and responsible AI adoption.
What success looks like:
OpenAI and NTT Data have a clear global partnership strategy, differentiated joint value proposition, executive governance model, and measurable business plan.
Global and regional teams operate with clear responsibilities, shared priorities, and consistent co-sell and delivery motions.
The partnership generates qualified pipeline and converts priority opportunities into secure production deployments with demonstrable customer value.
Joint solutions and industry offerings become repeatable across accounts and regions, supported by growing partner sales and delivery readiness.
OpenAI resources are directed toward the highest-impact opportunities, and the alliance delivers sustained customer adoption and commercial growth.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What's the opportunity?
We’re seeking a transformational Solutions Engineering leader to lead our Mid Market and Enterprise SE teams in North America. You’ll be a pivotal figure in helping Intercom scale its AI-driven support platform to some of the world’s most well-known brands. This role will shape how we engage with large, complex organizations, defining our go-to-market, building a world-class team, and delivering tangible customer outcomes through innovation and credibility.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a Solutions Engineering team focused on winning complex deals, creating vertical-specific solution architectures, and building repeatable playbooks. We believe in leaders who are open to be a player and a coach, regardless of seniority. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, and Services to deliver customer transformation through Intercom’s AI-first platform – be it through strategic guidance as a senior leader on the team, or securing deals with your own technical credibility where needed.
What will I be doing?
Define and evolve the strategic vision and go-to-market (GTM) approach for the Solutions Engineering function.
Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing SE team across global regions and core verticals.
Operate as a player-coach, actively engaging in strategic deals while developing team capabilities.
Support complex, six-figure sales cycles with technical guidance, architecture, demos, and product evaluation support, as well as sales expertise.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor and executive point of contact for large customers.
Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D to shape verticalized GTM motions and solution strategy.
Champion a customer-obsessed culture across the pre-sales journey – from outbound to implementation.
Lead discovery, design, and delivery of tailored technical solutions, including PoCs and business value assessments.
Build reusable, scalable solution frameworks, and industry-specific technical assets.
Advocate for customer needs and insights internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
Represent Intercom and the SE function externally through executive meetings and strategic events.
Foster strong relationships with C-level stakeholders, translating AI product capabilities into tangible business impact.
What skills do I need?
5+ years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer/Architect, or related individual contributor role.
Having 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales teams, with a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing high-performing teams.
Ideally, experience selling AI, data, or highly technical products; or at the very least, deep curiosity and utilization of AI on your day-to-day.
Comfortable with ambiguity in environments with an ability to stay focused and thrive under pressure while working with customers to solve their most challenging issues.
Have a humble attitude, and a passion to help others, with a willingness to learn whatever it takes to support the team and help our customers thrive.
A track record of consistently delivering revenue numbers, producing accurate forecasts, while maintaining a focus on team development and growth
Excellent communication and presentation skills
The OTE salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area or NYC is $328,500-$392,375. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
#LI-Hybrid
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Policies
Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.
We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management- MFT
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Why This Role Matters
At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is real, urgent, and growing. MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) is a security-first MFT platform trusted by customers in finance, life sciences, government, and critical infrastructure to move sensitive files safely across IT and OT environments. We are now ready to take MFT to the next level and win against established MFT vendors. As a member of OPSWAT’s product leadership team, you will help set company-level product strategy, influence investment decisions across the portfolio, and be accountable for
the business performance of MFT. This Senior Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of MFT, including a next-generation MFT Gateway and a lightweight automation offering, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. It is also a chance to redefine what product management looks like in the AI era. We are not looking for someone who talks about AI. We want a leader who already uses it every day to work faster and smarter, and who can build a team of PMs that does the same. If you are energized by building, innovating, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.
What You Will Be Doing
As Senior Director of Product Management, MFT, you will be the executive owner of MFT’s product strategy,
business performance, and growth trajectory. You will:
Set and own the MFT product vision and roadmap, including the MFT Gateway, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
Drive MFT’s position in regulated and high-assurance markets (e.g., GxP, financial services, federal, OT), including compliance, audit, and integrity requirements.
Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, competitive displacements, and customer adoption.
Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with close partnership with our engineering team in Hungary and Romania.
Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring MFT delivers reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
Own MFT business results, including revenue, pricing, packaging, and investment priorities.
Shape company-level product strategy as part of the product leadership team, presenting to the CEO and executive team.
Represent MFT as its executive voice with strategic customers, partners, analysts, and at industry events.
Build an AI-Native Product Function
You will set the standard for how product management works at OPSWAT, using AI as a core part of how the
team operates:
Use AI to compress the path from customer signal to shipped feature: synthesizing customer calls, support tickets, win/loss data, and competitive intel into clear insights in hours, not weeks.
Use AI tools to draft PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release notes, freeing PMs to spend
more time with customers and engineers.
Prototype workflows and UI concepts with AI to validate ideas with customers before engineering commits.
Build AI-assisted competitive and market analysis so the team always knows where MFT wins and why.
Identify where AI belongs inside the product itself, from intelligent automation and anomaly detection to policy recommendations and natural-language administration.
Define practical guardrails for using AI safely in a security company, protecting customer data and IP.
Grow and Lead a Team of PMs
You will build and develop a high-performing product team as MFT grows:
Hire, coach, and grow product managers across regions, raising the bar on product judgment, customer empathy, and execution.
Create a clear career path and a culture of ownership, where PMs own outcomes, not just backlogs.
Establish lightweight, repeatable product processes for discovery, prioritization, and launch that scale with
the business.
Make every PM on the team AI-fluent through hands-on enablement, shared playbooks, and leading by
example.Develop future product leaders who can take on new product lines as OPSWAT grows.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:
A clear, compelling MFT roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
Competitive wins displacing legacy MFT solutions in strategic accounts.
Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
Delivery of the MFT Gateway and automation offerings that position MFT for long-term growth.
An AI-native product team with measurably faster discovery, documentation, and release cycles.
A growing, engaged team of PMs with clear ownership and visible development.
AI-powered capabilities in the MFT roadmap that customers value and competitors lack.
A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
Recognition as a trusted executive voice for MFT inside OPSWAT and across the market.
Who You Are
You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You bring:
Proven experience owning enterprise or security products at scale, including business outcomes such as revenue, pricing, and packaging.
Deep, hands-on experience using AI in your daily product work, and a clear point of view on how AI changes the PM role. Be ready to show us how you use it.
Experience building AI-powered features into enterprise products.
A track record of hiring, coaching, and growing product managers into strong leaders.
Strong understanding of MFT, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS), identity and access (SSO, OAuth, mTLS), or adjacent security domains.
Familiarity with the competitive MFT landscape and the compliance needs of regulated industries.
A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Europe.
Executive presence, with clear, confident communication and the ability to influence peers, executives, and customers at the C-level.
Experience operating as part of an executive or senior leadership team, making portfolio-level tradeoffs.
A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of PMs. Senior Director or Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.
Why OPSWAT?
OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow. In this role, you will:
Own a revenue-generating product with a large market and meaningful runway.
Shape the future of security-first MFT and MFT Gateway innovation.
Build and lead your own team, and define what an AI-native product organization looks like.
Work with smart, committed teams across the globe, at a company that rewards using AI to move faster.
Join the executive product leadership team, with a direct influence on company strategy.
If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

Deep, hands-on experience using AI in your daily product work, and a clear point of view on how AI changes the PM role. Be ready to show us how you use it.
Experience building AI-powered features into enterprise products.
A track record of hiring, coaching, and growing product managers into strong leaders.
Strong understanding of MFT, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS), identity and access (SSO, OAuth, mTLS), or adjacent security domains.

Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.

jobs.text:
The Head of Data Engineering oversees the Cloud and Big Data platforms, driving development and ensuring high availability of data service across the group. It is also responsible owner for leading, designing and implementing data-related transformation initiatives.
Main Accountabilities
Leads the Data Engineering department in providing a reliable Big Data & Cloud platform for use within DNA and across the group.
Drives strategic implementations in platforms, and software, enabling the Data Science Department and Reporting Hub Department to deliver their initiatives and BAU requirements.
Oversees and manages the security of the platforms and is responsible for audits and regulatory topics within the ecosystem

Accountable for optimizing data engineering queries for their team in order to achieve cost efficiencies on cloud consumption costs

jobs.text:
VP Engineering
Overview and purpose of the role
The purpose of this role is to:
Ensure that products are delivered according to roadmaps, meet design requirements, are manufacturable and consistently achieve positive experiences with customers
Management and leadership of the Engineering team
Hiring new talent
Maintain compliance with quality standards
Contribute to the Company’s strategy
Responsibilities
Leadership and management of the Engineering Team
Contribute to company strategy and priorities as a member of the executive team.
Lead, mentor and develop Engineering, recruiting the talent and building the capabilities needed to deliver business goals.
Set clear objectives, responsibilities and delivery commitments, supporting technical specialists to succeed
Product development and manufacturing
Own engineering delivery across the product lifecycle, from R&D handover and platform development through qualification, manufacturing introduction and ongoing support.
Build realistic programme plans, define work packages and dependencies, allocate resources and manage change, escalating risks and delivery issues early.
Work with Sales and Field Applications to translate customer requirements into achievable engineering commitments and support design wins.
Ensure products meet performance, quality, reliability and applicable industrial, medical and automotive qualification requirements.
Deliver manufacturing test solutions that meet cost, yield and capacity targets.
Work with Operations, Quality and manufacturing partners to select suppliers and transfer products from pilot production to volume manufacture.
Identify opportunities to improve Flusso’s products and platforms.
Engineering capability
Establish proportionate engineering processes, standards and lifecycle practices that improve quality, repeatability and delivery efficiency.
Ensure teams have the equipment, software tools and facilities needed to deliver high-quality work.
Maintain safe, organised and well-maintained test laboratories, including compliant waste management.
Support compliance with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements and drive continual improvement.
Business support activities
Manage engineering budgets and capacity in line with business priorities.
Build effective relationships across Engineering, Sales, Field Applications, Operations, Quality and external partners.
Support key customer and supplier engagements, business development and marketing activities.
Pursue relevant government-funded R&D initiatives and technology partnerships.
Communicate engineering priorities, programme progress, risks and resource needs clearly to staff, the executive team and the Board.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Cards
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM:
Cards is one of the largest revenue lines at Tide. The domain owns everything that happens on the card: issuing and processing across the UK, EU and India, each with its own processors, card schemes and regulators.
This includes prepaid, debit, multi-currency and team cards, alongside products such as Apple Pay and Google Pay tokenisation, 3DS, card controls and settlement.
The teams are cross-functional, working closely with product, design, commercial and operations. Engineering comprises three teams, with engineers based in Bulgaria, Lithuania and India.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will lead the engineering organisation across the UK, EU and India, shaping the next phase of the Cards platform.
With the core platform transformation largely complete, your focus will be on:
Product and member experience: Partnering with Product and Design to improve card experiences, including tokenisation, payment journeys, team controls and reducing false declines.
AI-led engineering: Embedding AI coding agents across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed and quality.
Platform and commercial ownership: Completing the transition from our legacy processor, strengthening partner relationships and driving improvements in cost efficiency and unit economics.
You will set the technical direction, develop engineering leadership and ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable and commercially sustainable.
As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will:
Lead and develop engineering managers and senior engineers across distributed teams.
Define the technical strategy and architecture for the Cards domain.
Drive reliability, scalability and cost efficiency across card issuing and processing.
Embed AI-assisted and agentic development practices across engineering teams.
Partner with Product, Design and Commercial teams to prioritise and deliver the roadmap.
Own technical relationships with card processors and schemes, including integrations and certifications.
Strengthen engineering capabilities, particularly at Staff and senior IC levels.
Collaborate with other engineering leaders across Payments on shared infrastructure.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and a track record of leading large, distributed engineering organisations.
Experience and background
Experience leading engineering managers and large engineering teams.
Strong experience in cards, payments or banking, with a deep understanding of card issuing, processing and card scheme operations. Experience on either the issuer or processor side is a strong plus.
Experience building and operating distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.
Proven ability to improve engineering delivery, productivity and quality.
Experience partnering with Product, Commercial and Finance leaders on business outcomes and unit economics.
Experience managing third-party technology providers and strategic partnerships.
Technical expertise
Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native systems.
Experience with relational databases, distributed systems and large-scale transaction processing.
Ability to challenge architectural decisions and engage in technical and production-level discussions.
Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and their application across the software development lifecycle.
Leadership
Ability to set technical direction and drive execution through engineering leaders.
Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
A strong focus on developing engineering talent and building high-performing teams.
OUR TECH STACK:
Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for asynchronous and event-driven messaging. Observability is Coralogix. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Product Operations
jobs.text:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.
Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.
As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.
We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.
Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction
Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.
This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.
Location
Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Product Operations to build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations function.
In this role, you will define how our Product organization plans, operates, launches, and measures its work. You will evolve our Product Operations capabilities from a small team into a well-staffed, strategic organization that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and the founding team to help the company execute more effectively.
You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing a team of Product Operations Managers, defining the company’s Product operating system and quality standards, and building the systems and processes that enable great product execution at scale.
This is a player-coach leadership role that requires exceptional operational judgment, strong product instincts, and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced startup environment.
What You’ll Do
Build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations organization, evolving it into a strategic partner embedded across the business.
Hire and develop a team of Product Operations Managers to support stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Customer Success, Operations, and more.
Define PermitFlow’s Product operating system, including planning processes, PRD standards, launch processes, product metrics, customer feedback systems, and cross-functional collaboration models.
Do hands-on Product Operations work yourself, particularly on the systems and programs that set the quality bar for the rest of the team.
Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.
Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.
Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.
Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.
What We’re Looking For
We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.
8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or B2B SaaS product leadership. Experience supporting complex workflow products with data-heavy systems and cross-functional stakeholders.
3+ years of experience leading and managing teams, ideally in a high-growth startup or technology company.
Proven experience building Product Operations teams and functions from early-stage to scale.
Exceptional operational judgment across planning, prioritization, product development, launches, measurement, and cross-functional execution. Systems thinking, not just strong project management.
Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.
Active AI fluency, with AI tools integrated into your daily operating workflow. Strong opinions on how AI is changing the way Product Operations teams work and a track record of evolving your own process accordingly.
Strong experience standing up Product operating processes, including planning rituals, PRD quality standards, launch readiness, product reviews, customer feedback systems, and product metrics.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership and hold your own in strategic and technical conversations.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.
What We Offer
Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

blocks.text: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.
Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction
Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.
This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.
Location
Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Product Operations to build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations function.

In this role, you will define how our Product organization plans, operates, launches, and measures its work. You will evolve our Product Operations capabilities from a small team into a well-staffed, strategic organization that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and the founding team to help the company execute more effectively.

You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing a team of Product Operations Managers, defining the company’s Product operating system and quality standards, and building the systems and processes that enable great product execution at scale.

This is a player-coach leadership role that requires exceptional operational judgment, strong product instincts, and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced startup environment.
What You’ll Do
Build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations organization, evolving it into a strategic partner embedded across the business.
Hire and develop a team of Product Operations Managers to support stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Customer Success, Operations, and more.
Define PermitFlow’s Product operating system, including planning processes, PRD standards, launch processes, product metrics, customer feedback systems, and cross-functional collaboration models.
Do hands-on Product Operations work yourself, particularly on the systems and programs that set the quality bar for the rest of the team.
Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.
Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.
Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.
Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.
What We’re Looking For

We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.

8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or B2B SaaS product leadership. Experience supporting complex workflow products with data-heavy systems and cross-functional stakeholders.

Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.

jobs.title: Head of Product Indonesia
jobs.text:
Head of Product
The Opportunity
We are seeking for an experienced and forward-thinking Head of Product to lead its digital product strategy and transformation initiatives.
This is a exciting opportunity for a commercially minded product leader who can drive the development of digital features, platforms, and tools that enhance customer experiences, streamline business operations, and enable scalable growth.
The successful candidate will lead the Product team, taking ownership of the product roadmap, driving cross-functional execution, and translating business needs into innovative, impactful digital solutions.
We are looking for someone who combines strong product leadership, technical understanding, strategic thinking, and hands-on execution, with a proven track record of building and scaling digital products.
What You Will Do
Product Strategy & Digital Transformation
Define and own the overall digital product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning product initiatives with business priorities and long-term growth objectives.
Lead the development and enhancement of digital features, internal platforms, customer-facing tools, and workflow automation solutions.
Identify opportunities to digitalise and optimise existing business processes, improving operational efficiency, productivity, and customer experience.
Translate complex business challenges into scalable, technology-driven product solutions.
Digital Product Development & Execution
Oversee the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery, ideation, and requirements gathering through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Drive the development of digital tools and features that improve business workflows, user engagement, and operational effectiveness.
Partner closely with Technology, Design, Data, Operations, and Commercial teams to ensure successful product delivery.
Prioritise product initiatives based on business impact, customer needs, technical feasibility, and available resources.
Establish clear product success metrics, including adoption, engagement, efficiency improvements, and measurable business outcomes.
Ensure digital products are scalable, intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user and business requirements.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for digitalisation initiatives and product enhancements.
Build a high-performing product organisation with clear ownership, accountability, and strong execution capabilities.
Collaborate with senior leadership to shape digital transformation priorities and secure alignment on strategic initiatives.
Act as the key bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring product solutions effectively address operational and commercial needs.
Drive a product-led culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.
Product Performance & Continuous Improvement
Establish product performance frameworks to track adoption, usability, operational efficiency, and return on investment.
Leverage user feedback, product analytics, and business insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Drive continuous optimisation of digital features and tools to enhance user experience and business performance.
Champion automation, system integration, and process standardisation to support organisational scalability.
What Success Looks Like
A clear and executable digital product strategy aligned with business growth and transformation priorities.
Successful delivery and adoption of digital features and tools that improve operational efficiency and user experience.
A high-performing Digitalisation Product team with strong ownership, collaboration, and delivery standards.
Measurable improvements in business productivity, product adoption, process automation, and digital capabilities.
Strong alignment between business objectives, product development, and technology execution.
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to take on a strategic leadership role within a growing technology organisation, where you will have the autonomy to shape the digital product landscape and lead meaningful transformation initiatives.
You will work closely with senior stakeholders, build and lead a capable product team, and play a pivotal role in developing digital solutions that drive business growth and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Field Engineering
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
REGIONAL DIRECTOR, FIELD ENGINEERING
We're hiring a Regional Director, Field Engineering to build and lead a high impact pre-sales Field Engineering team supporting our fastest growing enterprise accounts. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for ensuring our technical pre-sales motion scales with quality, speed, and credibility. As the Regional Director, Field Engineering, you'll manage and develop Field Engineers who partner closely with AEs to run technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept. You'll also stay close to customers and deals yourself, coaching in real time, unblocking complex evaluations, and ensuring SpaceXSI is positioned as the best AI-native development platform on the market.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead, coach, and scale a team of Field Engineers supporting enterprise opportunities; partner closely with Sales leadership and AEs to drive high quality technical discovery, demos, and POCs
Establish best practices for evaluations, proof-of-concept execution, and technical deal strategy
Serve as an escalation point for complex customer evaluations and high-stakes enterprise deals
Hire, onboard, and develop top-tier Field Engineering talent; set clear expectations and career paths
Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insights back to Product and Engineering
Ensure tight handoffs with post-sales teams to support successful customer onboarding and adoption; maintain deep knowledge of SpaceXSI's product, roadmap, and competitive landscape
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
3+ years experience leading Field Engineers, Solutions Architects, or Pre-Sales teams in enterprise software
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Pre-sales leadership for AI/ML platforms, LLM APIs, developer tools, or cloud products sold to engineering, IT and business line leaders
Familiarity with software development lifecycles and enterprise AI: AI coding tools, AI agents, and LLM APIs
Proven ability to partner effectively with Sales while maintaining technical integrity and customer trust
Comfortable operating in customer-facing, high-pressure deal environments and guiding teams through complexity
Strong communication skills and executive presence, and able to engage developers, architects, and CTOs
A builder mindset: you thrive in fast-moving, startup environments and enjoy creating structure where little exists
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Must be willing to travel to customer sites as needed
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
The expected annual base salary range for this role is $245,000 - $280,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
