Build and lead a high-impact Forward Deployed Engineering team of up to 20 engineers, combining AI engineering, solution architecture, industry/domain expertise, and client-facing technical credibility.
Define the Forward Deployed Engineering operating model, including engagement rules, delivery standards, escalation paths, handoff models, and interfaces with product, engineering, sales, industry, and delivery teams.
Deploy FDE teams into priority client and industry opportunities to shape AI solution hypotheses, prototypes, MVPs, pilots, and production deployments.
Partner closely with the Executive, AI Solutions Product Leader to translate field learning into product roadmap recommendations, reusable platform capabilities, and productization opportunities.
Work with Product Engineering to move validated field solutions into scalable, secure, enterprise-ready product capabilities.
Support strategic pursuits and executive client conversations by providing technical credibility, solution clarity, demos, prototypes, and deployment plans.
Establish reusable deployment patterns, reference architectures, templates, integration assets, and solution playbooks to reduce bespoke delivery and improve speed to value.
Promote a 70% standardized / 30% configurable model for AI Service-as-Software offerings to improve repeatability, scalability, and margin potential.
Recommend FDE deployment priorities based on client demand, strategic value, product learning potential, technical feasibility, and commercial relevance.
Track field impact through metrics such as deployment quality, time to prototype, time to client value, reusable patterns created, productization candidates identified, client feedback, deployment repeatability, and team health.

15+ years of experience in engineering, field engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, AI/data products, product engineering, or technical delivery leadership.

Technical quality, reliability, and enterprise readiness of field-deployed solutions.
Health, retention, and development of the FDE team.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.text:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About The Role
Samsara’s mission is to improve industrial efficiency, safety, and quality at a massive scale, through the use of sensors and software. Our suite of IoT products and software platform brings the benefits of sensor data to traditional industries like transportation, food and beverage distribution, construction, state and local government, and K-12 education. We help our customers transport food, medicine, and other goods safely across the country, monitor deliveries for unsafe conditions, and help fleet managers improve the efficiency of their operations.
Samsara’s Product Design team is responsible for crafting user-friendly features, workflows, and interfaces that our customers use every day to run their operations. This involves talking to customers, working with engineers and product managers to understand problems, rapidly designing and iterating on mocks and user flows, and communicating ideas effectively to stakeholders. We also build design systems that underpin all our products to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.
We’re looking for an experienced product design director who will build out an already high-caliber group of designers and help shape the product experience for all our customers.
This is a remote position based in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
In this role, you will:
Lead, grow, coach and mentor a team of design managers
Engage with customers to deeply understand their operations and people
Ship high-quality designs based on these customer needs
Collaborate with partners to define opportunities and deliver a best-in-class experiences
Define and drive the product design strategy across product areas
Create and refine tools, systems and processes that improve team health and output
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team
Minimum requirements for the role:
4-6 years (or more) of product design management experience
Strong portfolio that showcases ability to lead teams that ship elegant solutions to complex problems
An ideal candidate also has:
Track record of shipping step-changes to the UX that drive customer and business impact
A history of hiring, growing and retaining great talent
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to ship high quality experiences
Experience identifying and instituting changes that improve employee experiences
Expertise in providing feedback that accelerates career growth and improves product quality
A desire to improve yourself, the team, and product experiences
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary
$235,600—$294,500 USD
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Director, Data & Business Systems
jobs.text:
About Graza
Graza makes always fresh, never blended, extra virgin olive oil in fun-to-use squeeze bottles. In the past two years, we’ve gone from a fast-growing brand to a national business, with products on the shelves of Whole Foods, Target, Walmart, Kroger, Safeway/Albertsons, and many others.
We’ve also expanded beyond olive oil into mayo and chips, with more innovation ahead. We operate across retail, club, DTC, and international markets, and the complexity of the business is growing quickly.
That creates an exciting problem: we need to build the systems, data infrastructure, and processes that allow Graza to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.
The Role
We’re looking for our first dedicated Director of Data & Business Systems
This is not a traditional data engineering role. And it’s not a traditional IT or business systems role. You’ll sit at the intersection of data, technology, and how the business actually works.
You’ll help us understand how information flows through Graza—from customer orders and inventory, through purchasing, production, logistics, finance, and ultimately into the reporting the leadership team uses to run the company.
You’ll identify where we rely on spreadsheets, manual work, duplicate data entry, disconnected systems, or inconsistent definitions. You’ll determine whether the answer is a process change, better use of an existing system, an integration, automation, or something new.
At the same time, you’ll own the evolution of our Snowflake data environment and turn it into a reliable foundation for reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
You’ll report to the VP of Finance and work directly with the leadership team. This is a highly visible role with broad ownership and significant room to shape the function.
What You’ll Do
Build the data foundation.
Own the architecture and roadmap for our Snowflake environment. Design the underlying data model, ingestion and transformation pipelines, and reliable datasets that become the foundation for company reporting. Build the tools and outputs that allow the business to answer questions without recreating analysis in spreadsheets every week.
Understand how the business works.
Map critical business processes and data flows across Finance, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and other functions. Understand where data originates, where it changes, which system owns it, and where things break down. Establish clear systems of record for customers, products, orders, inventory, revenue, COGS, and other critical business domains.
Make Graza's systems work together.
Evaluate our existing technology landscape and determine where we should integrate, configure, replace, consolidate, or build. Own the architecture behind key integrations between accounting, ERP, e-commerce, inventory, supply chain, logistics, retail, and other platforms.
Eliminate unnecessary manual work.
Find the processes that consume people's time because "that's how we've always done it." Quantify the problem, redesign the process, and automate where it makes sense. We want fewer spreadsheets that require someone to remember to update them and more durable systems that work correctly by design.

Graza makes always fresh, never blended, extra virgin olive oil in fun-to-use squeeze bottles. In the past two years, we’ve gone from a fast-growing brand to a national business, with products on the shelves of Whole Foods, Target, Walmart, Kroger, Safeway/Albertsons, and many others.

We’ve also expanded beyond olive oil into mayo and chips, with more innovation ahead. We operate across retail, club, DTC, and international markets, and the complexity of the business is growing quickly.
That creates an exciting problem: we need to build the systems, data infrastructure, and processes that allow Graza to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.
The Role
We’re looking for our first dedicated Director of Data & Business Systems
This is not a traditional data engineering role. And it’s not a traditional IT or business systems role. You’ll sit at the intersection of data, technology, and how the business actually works.

You’ll identify where we rely on spreadsheets, manual work, duplicate data entry, disconnected systems, or inconsistent definitions. You’ll determine whether the answer is a process change, better use of an existing system, an integration, automation, or something new.
At the same time, you’ll own the evolution of our Snowflake data environment and turn it into a reliable foundation for reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
You’ll report to the VP of Finance and work directly with the leadership team. This is a highly visible role with broad ownership and significant room to shape the function.

Establish clear systems of record for customers, products, orders, inventory, revenue, COGS, and other critical business domains.
Make Graza's systems work together.

Evaluate our existing technology landscape and determine where we should integrate, configure, replace, consolidate, or build. Own the architecture behind key integrations between accounting, ERP, e-commerce, inventory, supply chain, logistics, retail, and other platforms.

jobs.title: VP, Product and Growth, Go.Compare
jobs.text:
Who we are
We create trusted, expert content that helps millions of people discover more about the things they love, need and care about. From technology, gaming and entertainment to fashion, lifestyle, sport, finance and beyond, our specialist brands connect people with their passions every day.
Across websites, magazines, newsletters, social channels and events, we bring expert content to audiences around the world. We combine our deep specialist knowledge with innovative technology and data to create engaging experiences, build valuable communities and help people make better-informed decisions.
Behind it all are our people - passionate experts, creators, innovators and problem-solvers who are shaping the future of media.
The Team You’ll Join
As a proud part of Future's brand portfolio, Go.Compare is a passionate price comparison site finding customers savvy insurance deals. Based in our Cardiff office, we pride ourselves on being a fun and fair place to work. You'll join a team of experts partnering with trusted organisations and the Welsh Rugby Union. It's an exciting opportunity to help millions make informed financial choices.
Description
As the VP, Product and Growth, you will direct our product vision, user acquisition, and growth strategy. Operating from our Cardiff office, you'll lead cross-functional teams spanning Product Management, UX Design, and Conversion Rate Optimisation. You'll partner with executive peers across Technology, Commercial Trading, and Brand Marketing to deliver scalable digital experiences. By combining customer insights, experimentation, and data analytics, you'll optimize conversion funnels and accelerate sustainable business growth.
What you'll do
You will report to the SVP of Go.Compare
Direct the overall product vision, growth strategy, and digital customer journeys across all Go.Compare verticals.
Oversee product management, UX design, conversion optimisation, and digital acquisition teams.
Partner with technology and commercial leaders to deliver high-performing comparison tools and seamless user experiences.
Establish data-driven experimentation frameworks to test, iterate, and optimize funnel conversion rates.
Leverage customer research, analytics, and market trends to identify new product features and growth opportunities.
Guide cross-functional teams to align product releases with commercial trading and strategic revenue goals.
What you’ll bring
Executive product leadership experience in price comparison, digital marketplaces, fintech, or high-volume e-commerce.
Proven track record scaling digital products, driving customer acquisition, and optimising conversion funnels.
Strong expertise in data analytics, user research, A/B testing, and growth experimentation frameworks.
Strategic mindset with the ability to turn complex customer data into clear product roadmaps.
Experience guiding, inspiring, and developing cross-functional product, design, and marketing teams.
Excellent communication skills to align executive stakeholders, engineering teams, and commercial partners
Minimum Requirements
Executive background directing digital product strategy, conversion growth, or product management in a digital environment.
Ability to operate from our Cardiff office under a hybrid model.
What we offer
Uncapped leave
Enhanced parental leave
Discounted rates with Dental care and Private Medical care
When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus
Refer a friend scheme - with payment following the successful hire.
Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programmes
Opportunity to purchase shares in Future, with our Share Incentive Plan
Salary sacrifice Pension scheme up to 5% match
Free drinks and snacks in our offices
The expected range for this role is £120,000 - £140,000
This is a hybrid role, working 2 to 3 days per week from our Cardiff Office.
Internal job family level Professional 2
Inclusion and Diversity at Future
At Future, we’re working to attract, retain and foster diverse talent, educating our colleagues in the importance of diversity, and review our internal processes so that they remain as free from bias as possible. We recognise that, in order to reach diverse communities through our content, we must first ensure ours is a culture in which diversity can thrive.
Find out more about Our Future, Our Responsibility on our website.
If you need any reasonable adjustments, please let us know, and we'll be happy to support you.

jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An Overview of this Role
As Director, Data Science, you'll lead GitLab's Product, Sales, and Finance Data Science teams and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You have two mandates:
Make Data Science a driver of growth. Connect the team's work to GitLab's biggest priorities: supporting product innovation, making sure what we launch is improved and scaled with data, improving product adoption through our GTM motions, and growing the consumption business. Make sure the work changes decisions at the executive level.
Set the bar for great data science. Define what makes a great Data Scientist at GitLab, from business partnership to technical rigor, and develop managers who build teams where everyone shows up to that standard.
You lead through your managers with an overall team size of 12 including data scientists and analysts, ensuring direction with the team across the data organization, and staying close enough to the work to pressure-test the analyses and models that matter most.
What you’ll do
Build trusted relationships with executives across Product, Finance, and GTM, and act as their thought partner, shaping the questions the business should be asking, not just answering them
Own investment and prioritization across teams: decide where Data Science spends its time, and make trade-offs visible to senior leaders
Lead high-impact, cross-functional programs, such as driving new product adoption and growing our consumption business, from strategy through measurable business impact
Coach and mentor managers and senior ICs to grow as leaders, building succession and a bench of future leaders
Hold a high talent bar, and make sure every teammate grows into a trusted thought partner in their area
Set org-wide standards for metric definition, causal inference, and predictive modeling, and the role of AI in each
Build a high-trust culture of urgency, accountability, and open communication, and act on engagement and feedback across teams
Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and other data teams across the company to solve data opportunities together, aligned on a shared data and AI roadmap
What you’ll bring
12+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, including 6+ years leading teams and 3+ years managing managers in B2B SaaS or tech
Track record of building and scaling a data science or analytics organization that executives treat as a strategic partner
Strong business acumen across product and go-to-market, with experience connecting data work to revenue and growth outcomes
Executive presence: communicates complex findings and trade-offs clearly to the C-suite, and coaches managers to do the same
Deep expertise in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, with enough technical depth in SQL, Python, and ML to guide and pressure-test the team's work
Clear point of view on how AI is reshaping data science and analytics, and experience leading teams through that shift
Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model and coach GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values
Nice to Have
Experience with developer tools, DevSecOps, or product-led growth products
Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models
Experience merging or restructuring data science and analytics teams
Thought leadership in data science or analytics, internally and externally
Advanced degree in a quantitative field
About the Team
Data Science at GitLab brings Data Science and Analytics together into one function. Our Data Scientists are business partners first, pairing strong business judgment with analytical rigor and statistical expertise. We help leaders decide where to invest, measure what worked, and understand how customers get value from GitLab.
The opportunity is growing fast. AI is driving growth in GitLab's consumption business, creating new ways for data to drive growth. As routine reporting becomes self-serve, the team focuses on the hard problems: experimentation, causal inference, production models, and recommendations leaders act on.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$209,600—$314,400 USD

jobs.text:
Role Description
This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of data science, data engineering, finance, and AI. As Director, Data Science & Data Engineering for Finance, you will lead a small, high-impact team that enables Finance to make better decisions through trusted data, robust analytical systems, applied modeling, and increasingly AI-powered capabilities.
You will manage two direct reports: a data scientist and a data engineer. Together, the team supports the financial organization across recurring business operations, driver-model maintenance, knowledge coordination, analytical insights, and the development and operationalization of AI and machine-learning use cases. The role requires enough technical depth to guide both disciplines, while maintaining a clear focus on business outcomes, reliability, and team growth.
You will partner closely with Finance leadership, Engineering, Data, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish priorities, improve the quality and accessibility of financial data, and shape a forward-looking roadmap. You will be expected to move the team beyond request-driven execution: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities, clarifying the problems worth solving, and creating the operating mechanisms needed to deliver durable impact.
This is an opportunity to shape how Finance uses data and AI at a time when the underlying technologies, operating models, and expectations are changing quickly. The successful candidate will bring a growth mindset, a strong background in either data science or data engineering, and the ability to lead effectively across both disciplines.
Responsibilities
Manage and grow a multidisciplinary team: Lead, coach, and develop a data scientist and a data engineer, creating clear expectations, meaningful development plans, effective delegation, and a strong culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Set the team’s strategy and priorities: Translate Finance and company goals into a focused portfolio of work. Prioritize ruthlessly across strategic initiatives, recurring operational responsibilities, model maintenance, knowledge coordination, and technical debt.
Provide technical leadership across data science and data engineering: Guide problem framing, analytical and modeling approaches, data architecture, pipeline quality, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. You do not need to be the deepest expert in both disciplines, but you must be able to ask the right questions, recognize trade-offs, and raise the technical bar.
Advance AI and modeling capabilities: Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to Finance workflows. Establish appropriate standards for experimentation, evaluation, interpretability, human oversight, privacy, and ongoing monitoring.
Build trusted data foundations: Partner with data engineering and Finance stakeholders to improve source-of-truth datasets, data quality, lineage, observability, documentation, and reliability. Ensure that recurring reporting, driver models, and downstream analyses are based on accurate and well-governed data.
Own analytical and modeling outcomes: Ensure the team develops, maintains, evaluates, and improves models and analyses that support financial planning, forecasting, business-driver understanding, and decision-making. Connect technical work to measurable business outcomes rather than treating model delivery as the finish line.
Create scalable operating mechanisms: Establish lightweight processes for intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, model and pipeline reviews, incident response, documentation, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder communication. Reduce dependency on individual heroics and make the team’s work easier to understand and extend.
Influence Finance and senior stakeholders: Communicate complex data, model, and engineering considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Present implications, recommendations, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables timely decisions.
Partner across functions: Work effectively with Finance leaders, analysts, data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, product partners, and executives. Seek diverse perspectives, lead productive debate, and align stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.
Improve the team’s scope and effectiveness: Look continuously for ways to eliminate low-value work, automate recurring tasks, improve service levels, and increase the team’s strategic contribution. When the current operating model is insufficient, make the case for change and lead the team through it
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Significant experience applying data science, machine learning, analytics, data engineering, or a combination of these disciplines to business problems.
Experience directly managing and developing technical professionals, ideally including both data scientists and data engineers or closely adjacent roles.
A strong professional foundation in either data science or data engineering, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across the other discipline.
Experience leading a portfolio of projects from problem definition through delivery, adoption, measurement, and ongoing operation.
Experience with data quality, data pipelines, analytical datasets, model development or maintenance, experimentation or evaluation, and production or operational support.
Demonstrated ability to use data and technology to influence business decisions and deliver measurable impact.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, uncertainty, and trade-offs to Finance and executive audiences.
Demonstrated growth mindset: actively seeks feedback, learns new technologies and domains, adapts to changing conditions, and creates an environment where the team does the same.
Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting Finance, financial planning and analysis, forecasting, corporate strategy, accounting, or other business functions with high standards for accuracy and control.
Experience building or scaling AI/ML capabilities, including generative AI, predictive modeling, model evaluation, workflow automation, or AI-assisted decision support.
Experience managing a hybrid or multidisciplinary team spanning data science, analytics, data engineering, or software engineering.
Experience building 0-to-1 capabilities, establishing new operating models, or transforming a team from reactive execution to proactive partnership.
Experience with data governance, observability, model risk management, responsible AI, or other practices that support reliable and auditable business decisions.
Experience working in a technology company or other complex, data-rich environment.
Durable Skills
AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:
Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.
To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
Compensation
US Zone 1
This role is not available in Zone 1
US Zone 2
$228,400—$309,000 USD
US Zone 3
$203,000—$274,600 USD

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Platforms
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An Overview of This Role
As Director of Product, SaaS Platforms, you'll own the product direction and business outcomes for GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) environments: GitLab.com, our multi-tenant platform, and GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant offering. You'll connect reliability, scalability, and operability with the commercial decisions that make these platforms sustainable businesses.
Your scope spans both platforms, not a single feature roadmap. On GitLab.com, you'll guide growth through better customer isolation and additional cells, alongside rate limits, usage limits, and monetization. On GitLab Dedicated, you'll help scale it to hundreds of customers through automation, customer self-service, and closer alignment with GitLab's latest releases. You'll balance customer needs with operating costs and gross margin.
This director-level role starts as an individual contributor. It's remote and open to candidates based in the United States or Canada, with no specific time zone preference.
What You'll Do
Set the product strategy and roadmap across GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated, connecting platform capabilities to customer and business outcomes.
Drive improvements in platform reliability, scalability, and operability, including better separation between customers and expansion of GitLab.com's cell-based architecture.
Define GitLab.com's rate limits, usage limits, and related monetization approach.
Scale GitLab Dedicated through maintenance-window automation and other operational improvements, while controlling costs and improving gross margin.
Expand customer self-service through Switchboard, giving customers tools to monitor, observe, and operate their Dedicated tenants.
Guide capabilities such as customer-initiated disaster recovery and geographic redundancy, and enable earlier access to beta features on GitLab Dedicated.
Reduce the delay between GitLab releases and their availability on Dedicated.
Own the business side of the portfolio as well as the technical product direction, developing profit and loss (P&L) ownership for both platforms and helping establish GitLab.com as a P&L business.
What You'll Bring
Experience leading a product portfolio at director level or with comparable scope, setting direction across multiple related products rather than a single roadmap.
Technical product experience with cloud platforms, infrastructure, or SaaS environments, including the tradeoffs involved in reliability, scalability, and operations.
The ability to connect product decisions to commercial outcomes, including monetization, operating costs, and gross margin.
Experience translating complex platform challenges into product priorities and working across teams to deliver them.
The ability to lead through product direction and influence in a director-level individual contributor role.
Direct ownership of a product P&L is particularly valuable. Experience in an organization actively adopting artificial intelligence (AI) would also be helpful.
About the Team
The SaaS platform portfolio brings together GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated. The work spans shared-platform growth, single-tenant operations, and the tools customers use to manage their environments. The challenge is to improve the customer experience and platform capabilities while building a scalable, financially sustainable operating model for each offering.
At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform brings together development, security, and operations, helping teams collaborate throughout software delivery.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
United States Salary Range
$203,200—$345,600 USD
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Engineering Director- AI Products
jobs.text:
Actionstep is a pioneer in the development and sale of software-as-a-service (SaaS) products, specializing in the delivery of Legal Practice Management software. We are a fast growing, dynamic business with a global customer base of more than 30,000 and a team of over 300 in the USA, Australia, UK, Canada, New Zealand and LATAM.
The Actionstep Engineering team contributes to developing, maintaining, and running Actionstep through the delivery of industry leading technology, operations, and analysis. Actionstep Engineering consists of squads of cross-discipline software engineers, analysts and product experts who work collaboratively to enhance Actionstep software for our customers.
How we build
Every team at Actionstep builds with AI as part of the development lifecycle. Engineers and product managers decide what gets built, write the specs, and review and own what ships, while AI agents do much of the building and testing. We treat the harness, i.e. the tooling, context and review checkpoints our teams build with, as a product in its own right. We measure delivery on one scoreboard that reads throughput beside quality, so speed never gets counted without quality next to it.
Our platform runs on TypeScript services, React micro-frontends and a shared design system, on AWS across multiple regions.
Our Product Development teams work across North America, the UK and Asia-Pacific. Each team works within one time-zone band, so its members share a working day. This role leads teams in both North America and Asia-Pacific.
Engineering Director – AI Products
AI Products owns the AI features built into our products along with the AI, data and workflow capabilities that the power our platform, such as agents, open APIs and MCP, search, analytics and workflow automation.
You lead several teams through their engineering managers, and work alongside a product lead and product managers for each area.
Location -- Denver, Colorado (hybrid).
In this role, you will:
Lead through managers -- you set direction, standards and priorities for a group of teams, and grow the managers who run them.
Ship AI to production -- you work with product to turn the AI roadmap into features firms use every day, with permissions, privacy and audit built in.
Build shared platform capabilities -- you make sure agents, APIs, search, data and workflow work reliably for every Actionstep product.
Run AI responsibly and efficiently -- you build evaluation, observability and cost discipline into how AI features are designed and run.
Raise the bar on how we build -- you bring every team in the group onto our AI development lifecycle and make delivery predictable.
Lead across time zones -- you run a group split between North America and Asia-Pacific, which means some early or late calls.
Other Responsibilities:
Undertaking any other reasonable duties as required

jobs.text:
About Mozn
MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.
We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.
If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.
About the role
We are looking for a VP of Forward Deployed Engineering to build and lead the team that takes MOZN's AI into production inside our clients' organizations. Our forward-deployed engineers and data scientists work embedded with government and enterprise clients across Saudi Arabia, from the first problem definition to a system that people use every day. Not a handoff. Not a slide deck.
You will lead a multidisciplinary organization of engineers and data scientists, own delivery outcomes across our most important engagements, and turn what we learn in the field into repeatable playbooks and platform improvements. The role suits a leader who has run customer-facing solutions, delivery or engineering teams, stays close to the technical work, and is comfortable in the room with senior client stakeholders.
What you'll do
Leadership & Organization
Build, lead and scale a multidisciplinary forward-deployed organization spanning software engineering, data science and AI.
Hire, develop and retain exceptional engineers, data scientists and technical leaders; set clear expectations, career paths and a high bar for quality.
Define the operating model: how teams are staffed on engagements, how work is prioritized, and how delivery is measured.
Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and accountability for client outcomes.
Delivery & Client Outcomes
Own the end-to-end delivery of AI solutions across government and enterprise engagements, from problem framing and solution design through production deployment and adoption.
Ensure solutions reach production and are used: define success metrics with clients and hold the team to them.
Lead escalations, unblock delivery risks and make sound trade-offs between scope, quality and timelines.
Partner with Sales and Presales to shape engagements, scope solutions realistically and ensure a smooth transition from presales to delivery.
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating business and mission priorities into practical AI solutions.
Navigate client procurement, security, data-governance and approval processes on the path to production.
Represent MOZN's delivery capability in executive discussions, workshops and steering committees.
Technical Direction & Standards
Set technical standards for architecture, integration, security and quality across deployments, including on-premise, private cloud and restricted environments.
Stay close to the technical work: review architectures and solution designs, and step in on the hardest problems.
Ensure deployed AI systems are secure, reliable, monitored and maintainable after go-live.
Playbooks & Product Feedback
Turn field experience into repeatable deployment playbooks, reusable components and accelerators.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to feed client needs back into the MOZN AI Platform and roadmap.
Track delivery performance and report regularly to senior leadership on outcomes, risks and capacity.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; a Master's degree is a plus.
8-12+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, professional services, technical delivery or software engineering, with significant experience in a leadership role.
Proven track record of building and leading technical delivery teams of engineers and/or data scientists that delivered solutions into client organizations.
Demonstrated ownership of complex technology deployments from solution design through production go-live and adoption, ideally including AI, machine learning or data platforms.
Strong technical foundation across software architecture, systems integration, data and AI/ML, with the credibility to review designs and guide engineers on hard problems.
Experience delivering for government, public sector, defense or other highly regulated clients, including working through procurement, security and compliance requirements.
Experience deploying solutions in on-premise, private cloud or restricted environments.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior client leaders.
Professional fluency in Arabic and English.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Deployment Strategist, Applied AI or similar customer-embedded engineering role.
Experience building a team, practice or function from scratch, or founding or scaling a technology company.
Hands-on experience with generative AI and LLM-based solutions in production, including RAG, agents and evaluation.
Experience working closely with Product and Engineering to turn field delivery into reusable platform capabilities.
Familiarity with Saudi data, cybersecurity and AI governance requirements.
Benefits
You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space.
You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.
The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI.
We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

jobs.title: Delivery Director (Data & AI)
jobs.text:
We are seeking a Delivery Director with a strong technical background and strategic mindset to lead high-performing teams in the technology consulting space. This person will be responsible for project delivery, acting as a trusted technical and consulting partner to national and international clients.
The role combines technical leadership, project and people management, being the owner of client relationships.
Key responsibilities:
Lead the successful delivery of large-scale technology projects, ensuring quality, profitability, and client satisfaction.
Own delivery performance, including project margins, forecasting accuracy, resource planning, and operational KPIs.
Supervise and coordinate teams of 10–20 professionals, including managers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
Ensure excellence in project delivery across Data and AI (Python, Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, etc.).
Support in the definition and presentation of client proposals, acting as the main technical and business point of contact.
Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and continuous improvement.
Manage client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and strategic alignment.
Drive farming initiatives: identify new opportunities, craft innovative proposals, and foster sustainable account growth.

jobs.title: SVP, Data Science & AI Product Enablement
jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About Data Science and AI Product Enablement
Data Science and AI Product Enablement brings together Monks' advanced analytics and AI product capabilities in North America. The function pairs market-leading data science — predictive modeling, marketing mix modeling, attribution, incrementality testing, and optimization — with the engineering, product, and solution consulting needed to turn that intelligence into AI-powered products, automation, and agentic workflows.
It is a core engine of Monks' full-service product roadmap and its AI transformation agenda for brands.
The Role
The SVP, Data Science and AI Product Enablement will lead the strategy, growth, and delivery of Monks' data science and AI product practice across North America.
This leader will own the vision for how advanced analytics and AI become scalable products and client solutions — from discovery and solution design through build, deployment, and adoption — and will be accountable for the commercial performance, talent, and market reputation of the practice.
As a senior executive, the SVP will partner with Media, Creative, Strategy, Growth, and Technology Services leadership to embed data science and AI across the full-service offering, shape the integrated product roadmap, and position Monks as the agency partner of choice for AI transformation in marketing.
Location: New York preferred; candidates based in Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Denver will also be considered.
Salary Range: $225,000–$275,000 USD annually
Key Responsibilities
Practice Leadership & P&L Ownership
Own the P&L for the Data Science and AI Product Enablement practice, including revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, and investment decisions.
Establish the operating rhythm, business plan, and resourcing model needed to scale the practice profitably.
Growth & New Business
Drive revenue growth across existing clients and new business opportunities.
Lead and support senior-level pitches, shape AI and data science propositions, and partner with Growth teams to convert market demand into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
Client Leadership & Executive Sponsorship
Serve as the senior executive sponsor for strategic clients, including CMOs, CDOs, and CIOs.
Lead critical client engagements, including AI transformation roadmaps, quarterly business reviews, escalations, and renewal decisions.
Build strong, referenceable, multi-capability client relationships.
Delivery Economics & Commercial Models
Set standards for scoping, pricing, and delivery quality across the practice.
Develop value-based, product-led, and subscription commercial models, leveraging AI-accelerated delivery to improve margins and cost-to-serve.
Partner with Finance and Resource Management on capacity planning and investment decisions.
Organizational Leadership
Lead, scale, and develop a multidisciplinary organization of data scientists, AI and full-stack engineers, solution consultants, and product leaders.
Build a strong leadership bench, design effective team structures, and foster an inclusive, high-performance culture.
Data Science & AI Strategy
Define the vision and roadmap for data science and AI across the North America practice, aligned with Monks' global Data and Media strategy.
Lead the evolution of the advanced analytics portfolio, including predictive modeling, marketing mix modeling, attribution, incrementality, optimization, and causal inference, and its integration with generative and agentic AI.
Establish methodological standards and quality controls to ensure models and AI systems are rigorous, explainable, and trusted by clients.
Champion responsible AI practices, including governance, evaluation, data privacy, and compliance with client and regulatory requirements.
AI Product Development & Enablement
Own the AI product roadmap for the practice and its integration into Monks' broader full-service product roadmap.
Lead the development of reusable AI and data science products, accelerators, and platforms that deliver measurable business value.
Build a forward-deployed delivery model that takes solutions from client discovery and prototyping through production deployment and adoption.
Define product requirements, prioritization, and success metrics in partnership with Engineering, Technology Services, and client teams.
Drive adoption of AI products across client engagements and internal workflows, with clear measures of business impact.
Cross-Functional Integration
Partner with Media, Creative, Content, Strategy, and Growth leadership to embed data science and AI into integrated client offerings.
Shape how analytics and AI products support media planning, creative optimization, content performance, and measurement.
Serve as a senior leader in agency-wide AI transformation initiatives and internal capability building.
Partnerships & Ecosystem
Lead senior relationships with platform and technology partners such as Google, Meta, Amazon, Adobe, Microsoft, Anthropic, and OpenAI.
Develop co-innovation, co-development, and go-to-market initiatives that strengthen Monks' offerings.
Evaluate build, buy, and partner decisions for AI tooling, models, and data infrastructure.
Thought Leadership & Innovation
Represent Monks externally as a recognized voice in marketing science, AI products, and AI transformation through conferences, publications, and industry engagements.
Stay ahead of emerging developments in AI, machine learning, agentic systems, and marketing technology, translating innovation into practice strategy.
Foster a culture of experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous innovation, with a clear path from pilot to scalable product.
Required Qualifications
15+ years of experience in data science, marketing analytics, AI, or data product leadership within an agency, consultancy, holding company, marketing technology company, or large-scale in-house organization.
Proven P&L ownership of a data, analytics, or AI practice, with a track record of profitable growth.
Experience leading the development and commercialization of data science or AI products, from strategy through launch and adoption.
Demonstrated success building and leading large, multidisciplinary teams spanning data science, engineering, product, and consulting.
Executive-level client leadership experience, including C-suite sponsorship and growth of strategic accounts into multi-capability engagements.
Deep understanding of advanced analytics methodologies, including predictive modeling, marketing mix modeling, attribution, incrementality, and causal inference.
Strong technical understanding of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and production deployment.
Commercial fluency in statements of work (SOWs), value-based pricing, product and subscription models, and procurement negotiations.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to executive, technical, and creative audiences.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a credible leader with internal executive leadership and global stakeholders.
Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
Quantifiable track record of scaling practices or portfolios, with demonstrated revenue growth and margin improvement.
Experience launching AI or data products at enterprise or industry scale, with measurable client adoption and business impact.
Experience building forward-deployed engineering or solution consulting functions.
Senior-level partnerships with major technology platforms and AI model providers, including co-development or joint go-to-market initiatives.
Experience leading enterprise AI transformation programs for major brands.
Industry expertise

About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Well, hello there 👋
Castify (Creators of Screencastify) is a leading technology company dedicated to improving communication and learning outcomes with video. We have established ourselves as a leader in the K-12 education sector in the United States and we are critical in helping scale a teacher and improve student outcomes. We are also actively expanding into new and exciting markets outside of K-12 including bringing our tested solution into companies and organizations. Castify is used by over 15M people today and is seeking a VP of Engineering to join our Squad!
About this role
We are evolving from a widely-used screen recorder into an AI-first learning and collaboration platform, and we’re looking for a hands-on VP of Engineering to join our leadership team and help shape what’s next. As we expand into new markets and invest in product-led growth, you'll lead a small high-performing engineering team, set technical direction, drive AI initiatives, and partner closely with Product to deliver our vision. This is an opportunity for an experienced SaaS engineering leader who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment, combines strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, and knows how to leverage a lean team and AI to drive business growth.
What you'll do:
Lead a small high-performing Engineering team across multiple product areas and platforms.
Set technical direction and partner closely with Product leadership to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and deliver on business goals.
Champion AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Shape our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Drive engineering excellence through scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Partnerships - Tech, Finance, Auto
jobs.text:
Who We Are
The Vox Media Group consists of New York Magazine, the Vox Media Podcast Network, and Vox.com. Reaching a monthly audience of tens of millions across audio, video, digital, print and social platforms, our media brands and talent spark conversations and shape culture, covering everything from politics, technology, and business to food, travel, fashion, sports, entertainment, and more.
As a Senior Director, Partnerships, you will be a senior revenue contributor responsible for expanding high-value relationships and driving new business growth across New York Magazine, the Vox Media Podcast Network, and Vox.com. You will serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior brand marketers and agencies, delivering innovative editorial, podcast and talent solutions that connect brands with highly engaged, intellectually curious communities at scale.
Leveraging Vox Media Group's premium properties to build partnerships that drive measurable business outcomes, this role demands a consultative mindset, strong relationship-building skills, the ability to influence at senior levels of marketing organizations, and a relentless drive to grow revenue in a fast-paced, ambitious environment.
What You'll Do
Lead Strategic Growth: Develop and execute a long-term revenue strategy to expand business with existing and new clients across the Vox Media Group, with an emphasis on New York Magazine portfolio of digital brands.
Cultivate Executive-Level Relationships: Build and deepen relationships with senior decision-makers at major companies and their agencies — CMOs, VPs of Marketing, Heads of Demand Generation and Brand — positioning Vox Media as a go-to strategic partner for investment spanning audio, video, digital, social, talent and experiential.
Proactive Market Engagement: Identify industry trends, evolving buyer behaviors, and client challenges within the categories including (but not limited to) B2B and Consumer Technology, Financial Services and Automotive, proactively delivering cross-platform editorial, podcast and talent solutions before RFPs are issued.
Consultative Sales Leadership: Translate client objectives into high-impact campaigns using our podcasts, editorial brands, host talent, video, social and live event capabilities.
Revenue Accountability: Own forecasting, pipeline development, and quarterly and annual sales targets, with full accountability for results and strategic account planning.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with editorial, marketing, creative, production and operations teams to deliver custom, culturally resonant proposals that reflect how B2B and Consumer Technology, Financial Services and Automotive brands communicate with their audiences.
Brand Advocacy: Represent Vox Media Group at key industry events, conferences, and client forums to expand our presence and thought leadership.
Who You Are
Proven Media Seller: 10+ years of digital media sales experience with a demonstrated track record of success in the B2B and/or Consumer Technology, Financial Services, and/or Automotive categories. This is a NYC based role.
Strategic Dealmaker: Skilled in complex, consultative sales to senior marketing executives and agency leadership, with experience securing large-scale, integrated partnerships.
Advocate for Premium Content: Deep understanding of the power of editorially-driven, culturally impactful media brands (like New York Magazine) and influential talent (Vox Media Podcast Network), and of how to leverage that power to benefit advertising partners.
Visionary & Entrepreneurial: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and client needs before they surface.
Influential Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade at the highest levels of a client organization. Ability to think critically, connect advertiser needs to the right solution and communicate the value proposition with clarity and confidence.
Data-Informed Strategist: Comfortable leveraging performance data, audience insights, and category trends to craft compelling, measurable solutions that justify and grow media investment.
In this role, you are not just selling media — you are shaping how brands connect with audiences through premium content, trusted voices, and unique scale. As a Senior Director, Partnerships, your ability to see around corners, anticipate client needs, and deliver category-defining ideas will directly influence New York Magazine and Vox Media Group’s position as a leading force in the premium content landscape.
Where You’ll Work
This job is located in New York City and requires in-office presence with additional in-person expectations for client and agency meetings in and outside of NYC.
Total Compensation
In addition to the base salary listed, this role is bonus eligible.
PAY TRANSPARENCY
The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.
Pay Range
$130,000—$160,000 USD
OUR DEI COMMITMENT
Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.
Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. Vox Media will also consider all qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable Fair Chance laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations as part of the application process to candidates with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team (recruitment@voxmedia.com).
WHAT COMES NEXT
Our recruiting team will go through applications in a timely manner. Please note that our recruiting team will only contact you from @voxmedia.com email addresses, never via text message. Read more about how our recruiting team operates, and how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud, here.

jobs.title: Head of Data Platform and Governance
jobs.text:
e are looking for a strategic and hands-on Head of Data Platform and Governance to lead the organizations data management, governance, and reporting initiatives. This role is pivotal in establishing a robust data foundation that enables accurate insights, informed decision-making, and a strong data-driven culture across the company.
The ideal candidate will oversee the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise-wide data systemsensuring data quality, consistency, and compliancewhile leading a team of data professionals focused on building one trusted source of truth.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development, testing, and optimization of data pipelines, database schemas, and common data models.
Manage issue resolution and escalations related to data quality, access, and reporting.
Define and implement a comprehensive Data Governance framework, including policies, processes, and data standards.
Oversee the architecture, integrity, and performance of data platforms to support business analytics and reporting.
Drive the execution of data programs and initiatives, ensuring delivery against roadmap timelines and KPIs.
Champion a data-driven culture, promoting ownership and literacy across the organization.
Ensure compliance with data protection and security standards.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to align data capabilities with business goals.
Support business units with timely and accurate data extraction and reporting needs.
Key Performance Indicators
Data accuracy and quality
SLA adherence for data and reporting requests
Data platform security and compliance
Timely delivery of data-related initiatives (vs. planned timelines and budgets)
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
At least 10 years of experience in IT, data analysis, or data management, with 5+ years in a leadership role.
Proven experience leading data governance, data management, or analytics teams.
Strong technical background in data modeling, database design, and data warehouse platforms.
Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and project management skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive performance outcomes.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
About Data & Technology Solutions
WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data and technology organisation. We build the platforms, products, and engineering capabilities that power marketing transformation at scale.
WPP Open is our AI-powered platform for marketing. It connects people, data, tools, and AI into a single ecosystem, enabling teams to deliver better outcomes faster, more efficiently, and at global scale.
Our teams of engineers, product leaders, and operators work across multiple domains to build systems that power planning, execution, and delivery for some of the world’s largest brands.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for a senior product-minded engineering leader to drive delivery and execution for our commerce product area and to lead the application of AI into our SDLC.
You will be core part of our product development process and help to inform roadmap and will lead your team in translating product priorities into reliable, high‑quality engineering outcomes. Additionally, you will lead the application and adaptation of AI-driven development practices, ensuring systems operate effectively in real‑world, production environments. This role requires strong systems thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex integrations in a rapidly developing environment.
Work in this area spans both core commerce marketing systems and the data flows and pipelines required to interact with these systems, requiring a blend of data-aware system design, application engineering, and integration engineering.
You are:
A product-focused engineering leader with strong technical credibility and demonstrated ability in influencing and driving the roadmap.
Comfortable operating in integration-heavy, business-critical systems
Significant experience in programme design and systems architecture.
Demonstrated portfolio incorporating AI driven development into the end-to-end SDLC.
Data & metrics-driven, able to manage complexity across multiple teams, platforms and external partners.
Focused on outcomes tied to business performance.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Engineering Leadership & Team Development
Lead engineering delivery across teams building commerce marketing capabilities.
Establish and develop team mentorship paths aiming to incorporate agents into day-to-day work.
Accountable for the career growth and development of senior engineers and their teams across craft, delivery and business outcomes.
Stakeholder Alignment & XFN Collaboration
Act as the primary engineering partner to Product, Design, Commercial, and Delivery stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into actionable engineering outcomes and technical product direction.
Drive alignment with engineering leads and XFNs from partner teams to deliver integrated roadmaps.
End-to-End Accountability
Take ownership across the full software development lifecycle — from discovery through to release and post-production maintenance.
Ensure systems are reliable, performant, and capable of operating under real-world conditions.
WHAT YOU WILL NEED
12+ years of software engineering experience
Proven experience delivering complex, operational systems at scale
Strong experience with APIs, distributed systems, and integrations
Experience working with systems that integrate with external platforms or partner ecosystems
Strong understanding of system performance, latency, and production reliability
Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled product features into production, including integrating LLMs and generative AI services
Strong experience with modern cloud data warehouse and lakehouse platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift)
Solid understanding of data modelling, ELT/ETL pipelines, and orchestration tooling (e.g. dbt, Airflow), including data quality, lineage, and governance
Deep experience architecting and operating systems on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP)
Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, containers and Kubernetes, serverless, and event-driven design
Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD, observability, cloud security and IAM, and cloud cost optimisation (FinOps)
Demonstrated ability to lead delivery in multi-team, dependency-heavy environments
Strong stakeholder management across Product, Delivery, and Engineering
If you are ready to lead engineering delivery at scale, working across complex systems and driving real business outcomes, we encourage you to apply.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week.
