jobs.title: Director, Digital Shelf (Walmart Retail Analytics & Platform Solutions)
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
About the role
The Director, Digital Shelf (Walmart Retail Analytics & Platform Solutions) is a client-facing leader who uncovers why client items are winning or losing on Walmart's digital shelf and turns those findings into clear, prioritized action plans. Using both data and practical judgment, this leader identifies opportunities and gaps across a client's catalog and recommends the actions needed to improve discoverability, conversion, availability, and sales across Walmart's omnichannel ecosystem.
This role is VML's go-to expert on Walmart Supplier One, with Walmart Scintilla (formerly Walmart Luminate) and Retail Link as key supporting tools. It is both strategic and tactical: the Director explains why performance changed, connecting item setup, content quality, catalog and inventory health, and shopper data to pinpoint root causes, and then makes the item-level changes needed to fix them. They partner with internal and client teams to make sure every insight leads to a clear owner and a measurable result.
This role also supports Walmart merchant readiness for client teams, shaping the insights behind joint business plans, line reviews, and business reviews, and helps build the playbooks and frameworks that make Digital Shelf analysis repeatable across VML's Commerce Connections practice.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Supplier One, Walmart Systems & Root Cause Analysis
Serve as VML's lead expert in Walmart Supplier One, making hands-on, item-level changes (item setup, content, attributes, and catalog fixes) and monitoring content quality scores, in-stock rates, OTIF, inventory health, and buy-box performance to resolve issues affecting items at shelf.
Use Walmart Scintilla (Channel Performance, Shopper Behavior, and Customer Perception) and Retail Link (DSS) to add sales and shopper context to Supplier One findings.
Lead Digital Shelf root cause analysis for client catalogs and items, combining data (sales, traffic, conversion, in-stock, search rank, and content scores) with qualitative review (content and imagery, ratings and reviews, and competitive positioning) to explain why items are over- or under-performing.
Analyze omnichannel sales, fulfillment (Pickup, Delivery, Shipping), shopper trends, and pricing or promotional impact to identify what is driving share gains or losses and size the opportunity.
Use AI-enabled tools, including Marty for Scintilla and WPP Open, to spot issues such as out-of-stock risk earlier and act before they impact sales.
Client Leadership & Walmart Retailer Strategy
Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, clearly communicating catalog- and item-level opportunities, gaps, and recommended actions.
Build scorecards and insight-driven narratives for Walmart joint business planning (JBP), line reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that help clients strengthen merchant relationships.
Turn complex retail data and platform changes into clear action plans with defined owners, expected impact, and success measures, and carry out item-level changes directly where needed.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Discoverability & Connections, Analytics, Strategy, Product, Technology, and Delivery teams so insights turn into coordinated execution.
Convert Supplier One and Scintilla findings into clear briefs for content optimization, catalog health, and supply chain improvements, and track the resulting impact.
Share Walmart insights and platform changes across Commerce Connections so teams can anticipate and respond to shifts.
Platform Enablement & Team Development
Develop and maintain Supplier One and Scintilla best practices, standard operating procedures, and root cause frameworks that standardize how VML resolves issues at shelf.
Lead internal training and platform guides that build team fluency in Walmart data and Digital Shelf operations.
Identify new Walmart platform and data opportunities that expand VML's commerce offering.
Improve analytical efficiency, accuracy, and workflows across client engagements.
Mentor team members in Supplier One, Scintilla, root cause analysis, and insight storytelling.
Model and foster a collaborative team culture grounded in Curiosity, Candor, and Connection.
Who you are
Walmart Supplier One Expert: Brings deep, hands-on Supplier One expertise, supported by strong working knowledge of Walmart Scintilla and Retail Link, and is the go-to resource for clients and internal teams.
Hands-On Executor: Comfortable rolling up their sleeves to make item-level changes in Supplier One and see each fix through to results at shelf.
Root Cause Diagnostician: Moves beyond what happened to why, identifying the true drivers of item performance across content, availability, pricing, and search.
Insight-to-Action Leader: Turns insights into clear, prioritized recommendations, communicates them with confidence, and follows through to measurable results.
Collaborative Partner: Works with Digital Shelf, Strategy, Content, Operations, Technology, Analytics, and Client teams around shared priorities.
Capability Builder: Creates playbooks, frameworks, and platform knowledge that strengthen Commerce Connections and improve client outcomes.
Continuous Learner: Stays current on Supplier One enhancements, Scintilla releases, and AI tools such as Marty for Scintilla and WPP Open.
What you bring
Experience
8+ years of experience in retail analytics, Digital Shelf management, Walmart platform operations, CPG category management, eCommerce, or agency commerce roles, including experience leading client engagements.
Deep, hands-on expertise in Walmart Supplier One, including making item-level changes (item setup, content, and catalog updates), with working knowledge of Walmart Scintilla (formerly Walmart Luminate) and Retail Link (DSS).
Proven track record of root cause analysis across sales, inventory, shopper, and content data, turning findings into recommendations that drove measurable results.
Experience supporting Walmart retailer engagements, including Line Reviews, Joint Business Planning (JBP), and Digital Shelf optimization, with exposure to client and merchant stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams, and to mentor team members.
Strong communication skills, with experience presenting insights and recommendations to client leadership in a clear, action-oriented way.
Skills
Walmart Supplier One, including item setup, content updates, and catalog maintenance
Walmart Scintilla (formerly Luminate) and Retail Link (DSS)
Root cause analysis for catalog and item performance
Walmart merchant storytelling (JBP and Line Reviews)
Client communication and presentation skills
Cross-functional collaboration, mentorship, and project execution
AI productivity and analytics tools

jobs.title: VP of Learning Design
jobs.text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
Read our blog to learn more.
About the role...
Learning is at the heart of Duolingo’s product, and AI is opening new ways to create, personalize, and evaluate learning experiences. We’re looking for a VP of Learning Design to lead our 40+ person Learning Experience (LX) organization day to day and help make every lesson more effective, motivating, and memorable for hundreds of millions of learners.
Reporting to the VP of Learning Experience, you’ll help shape how Duolingo teaches, with your primary focus on building a strong organization and developing its people. You’ll lead through directors and other senior leaders, strengthen the team’s learning design and product capabilities, and ensure LX delivers strong results in partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data across language, math, music, and chess.
This role is based in our New York or Pittsburgh office.
🧠 You will...
Help millions of people learn more effectively, identifying opportunities to improve how Duolingo teaches and guiding LX leaders to turn those opportunities into better learning experiences.
Build a high-performing LX organization and leadership team, owning organizational design, hiring, leadership development, performance management, succession planning, and team health.
Ensure LX delivers on its commitments, allocating resources to the highest-impact work, holding leaders accountable for results, and helping them resolve obstacles.
Strengthen product capabilities across LX, helping leaders coach their teams to make sound product decisions, write clear specs and roadmaps, present effectively at Product Review, and use AI to ship small experiments independently.
Represent LX in key cross-functional forums, build strong partnerships, and help its leaders influence product decisions and resolve cross-team challenges.
✅ You have...
Experience leading a multidisciplinary organization through directors and other senior leaders in a fast-moving, product-led environment.
A passion for people leadership, with a track record of developing strong leaders, empowering teams to take ownership, and delivering results through others.
Meaningful grounding in learning design, learning science, or a related discipline, with the judgment to coach experts and connect learning principles to product decisions.
Experience shaping consumer products through the teams you lead, including using AI to accelerate product development or content generation.
Excellent executive communication and judgment, with the ability to make difficult tradeoffs, influence senior leaders across functions, and lead through ambiguity and change.
Ability to work from or relocate to New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA on a hybrid (4+1) schedule.
⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...
Experience building AI-powered learning experiences or systems for generating and evaluating learning content at scale.
Experience at a founder-led or rapidly scaling consumer technology company.
Significant experience using Duolingo, and opinions about how to make it better.
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!
Salary Range:
$330,000—$550,000 USD
Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.
Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.
Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Executive Director - ICT Operations (Technology Lead) Sports BU SPA2
jobs.text:
The Executive Director – Technology Lead is a foundational executive role responsible for defining, governing, and delivering end-to-end sports technology strategy across all Sports Business Unit assets, from early planning and concept design through construction, commissioning, and structured transition into operations under the Asset Management organization.
In line with the current SBU TOM, the role does not assume responsibility for day-to-day asset operations once venues are handed over to the Asset Management team. Instead, it ensures that sports venues are designed, delivered, and documented with full lifecycle integrity, and that the technology intent, architectural decisions, and integration logic are effectively transferred, supported, and retained as organizational knowledge.
The role establishes SBU as the custodian of technology design intent and institutional memory, enabling Asset Management and operators to run assets efficiently, evolve them safely, and avoid long-term technical debt. This continuity reflects global best practice, recognizing that technology-led assets require ongoing involvement of the original design authority to support optimization, upgrades, servicing strategies, and future-proofing—without blurring operational accountability.
Through this approach, the role ensures Qiddiya’s sports assets remain globally competitive, future-ready, and fully integrated with the wider Qiddiya city technology ecosystem across their entire lifecycle.
1. Sports Technology Strategy & Governance
Define together with Qiddiya Tech and Asset Management the SBU Technology Strategy aligned with the Sports BU Target Operating Model and the Qiddiya Technology Mandate & Operating Model (QTMOM).
Represent SBU at executive level within the Qiddiya-wide Technology Board ( as per QTMOM )and related governance forums.
Establish clear decision rights, standards, and lifecycle ownership for technologies across all assets.
2. Planning, Design & Delivery Leadership
Act as executive technology authority across Stage Gates for all sports assets (stadiums, arenas, academies, training centers, public sport facilities).
Ensure technology requirements are embedded early in master planning, concept design, and detailed design, avoiding retrofits and value leakage.
Oversee complex technology scopes including digital infrastructure, smart venues, broadcast, fan experience, performance tech, data platforms, and cyber security.
3. Complex Sports Asset Enablement
Lead technology delivery for multi-asset sports ecosystems, not standalone venues — including integrated sports districts, mixed-use developments, and city-scale environments.
Ensure seamless integration with mobility, smart city platforms, digital identity, payments, and city operations.
4. Industry-Leading Technology Partnerships & Commercial Value
Co-create and lead an industry-leading Sports Technology Partnership Program in close collaboration with Qiddiya Strategy and Commercial teams.
Structure long-term partnerships (OEMs, integrators, telcos, cloud, media, data, performance tech) generating hundreds of millions to potentially billions SAR in:

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About CarbonChain
The fight against Climate Change is evolving rapidly. Climate tech is changing. The first wave was reporting. The next is treating carbon the way companies treat money: as a way to decide what to buy, who to sell to, and which incentives to claim.
Around the world, carbon is becoming a condition of trade. Border taxes, free allocations, green premiums, cheaper capital. It looks a lot like the post-war rebuild: governments put capital and tax incentives on the table, and the companies that could keep the books moved first. The missing piece then was bookkeeping. The missing piece now is the same, carbon accounting.
CarbonChain is that bookkeeping. We turn messy, real-world supply-chain data into numbers a trader, a sustainability lead, or a CFO will actually use.
We want people who are agents of change, who feel the impact of climate change and know there is no way around it to create a better future for every being.
People who know the customer is the truth of how a company thrives. People who treat data as the fuel for how fast society can change. People who use AI to accelerate the cause for good by working through an AI lens first to automate repetitive tasks and analyse data. Finally, people who enjoy working with people.
Our Product
We help the world's largest commodity producers and traders measure and cut emissions, with verified primary data where we can get it and defensible defaults where we cannot. The platform turns operational and supplier files into decision-grade carbon and compliance insight: sourcing, CBAM, product and corporate footprints, reporting customers and regulators will stand behind.
We organise carbon accounting around the user in four contexts at once:
Immediate: the tools in front of them
Internal: how they work with colleagues
External: how they work with suppliers and customers
Societal: how they work with society, governments, and disclosing bodies
The data we hold is only useful if it makes all four of those jobs easier.
Head of Engineering
About the Role
We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to lead our engineering team through its next stage of growth. Reporting to CEO, you’ll own how we build: our technical direction, architecture, quality standards, delivery process, and, most importantly, the team itself.
This is a leadership role rather than a hands-on coding one. Your impact will come through the decisions you steer, the standards you set, and the engineers you hire and grow. You’ll still need deep technical credibility to challenge designs, weigh trade-offs, and earn the trust of engineers and customers alike.
As a startup, we move fast and make pragmatic decisions. You’ll balance speed with quality in a domain where data accuracy, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. You’ll also act as the voice of technology across the business and with our customers, and help shape how CarbonChain uses AI, both in engineering and across the company.
What You’ll Do
Own technical strategy and decision-making: set the direction for our platform, make and document key technical decisions, and keep engineering aligned with company goals as they evolve
Steer architectural decisions across our system, from ingestion pipelines and provenance tracking to CBAM data sharing workflows, so that what we build is scalable, reliable, and audit-ready
Build, coach, and nurture the team through hiring, onboarding, regular 1:1s, career development, and performance management, creating an environment where engineers do their best work and want to stay
Own quality across engineering by defining our QA strategy, testing approach, and code review practices. You won’t review every PR, but you’ll make sure reviews are consistent, effective, and uphold our standards
Build and maintain an engineering process playbook covering how we plan, scope, ship, handle incidents, and learn from retrospectives, and mature it as the team grows without adding unnecessary bureaucracy
Make sure priorities are well maintained and balanced by working with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and the Carbon Team to agree trade-offs between new features, technical debt, reliability, and customer commitments
Lead AI adoption in the engineering team, through AI-assisted development, tooling, and workflows, and across the wider business, identifying high-value opportunities and setting sensible guardrails given the sensitivity of customer data
Act as the face of technology at CarbonChain: join client calls where needed, explain our architecture and data handling to enterprise customers, and support security and procurement conversations
Partner with the leadership team on headcount planning, engineering budget, tooling, and infrastructure costs
Champion a culture of ownership, pragmatism, and customer focus, staying comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities while keeping the long-term picture in mind
What We’re Looking For
Extensive experience in software engineering, including significant exposure leading engineering teams, ideally at a scaling startup or SaaS company
A strong technical foundation in modern web applications and distributed systems, with enough fluency in Python, TypeScript, cloud architecture, IaC/Terraform, and CI/CD to steer decisions confidently without writing production code yourself
A proven track record of hiring, coaching, and retaining engineers, and of building healthy, high-performing team cultures
Experience introducing and maturing engineering processes such as delivery planning, QA, code review, and incident management in a growing team
Sound, pragmatic judgement on trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
Strong collaboration skills: you work closely with the Founders, Product and Commercial teams to shape priorities, advise on feasibility, and make decisions together
Excellent communication skills, including explaining complex technical topics to non-technical colleagues and being credible and confident in front of enterprise customers
Hands-on experience driving AI adoption in engineering teams, and curiosity about how AI can improve the wider business
Bonus: experience with data-intensive systems, particularly where data quality, lineage, or auditability matter
Bonus: understanding of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001
Bonus: experience in climate tech or sustainability
How We Work
As a hybrid co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the UK and US. This role would be located 3d/week in our London LABS Camden office space. You will need the right to work in the UK.
What we offer
Meaningful impact and accelerated growth
This is a rare opportunity to work on technology that directly addresses the climate crisis while shaping the future of a fast-growing company. You'll take the lead on engineering strategy, roadmap and team evolution.
You'll tackle diverse challenges, work across the full stack of problems (technical and otherwise), and own meaningful projects from start to finish. If you want to learn quickly, take on real responsibility, and see the direct results of your work, this is the place to do it.
Competitive salary and benefits:
28 days annual leave
£500 home office setup allowance
£2,000 annual learning allowance
Private healthcare
Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options
Generous parental leave policy
Weekly team lunches in the office
Office gym, and cycle to work scheme
Remote work contribution of £1,000 towards expenses for working abroad
Equal Opportunity Employer
CarbonChain is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.
If you think your skills and experience match what we're looking for and you'd like to join next Climate Tech adventure, please get in touch.
You can find out more about interviewing at CarbonChain at carbonchain.com/careers/interview-process.
CarbonChain values diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.
If you think your skills and experience match what we’re looking for and you’d like to join the next Climate Tech industry unicorn, please get in touch!
You can find out more about interviewing at CarbonChain at https://www.carbonchain.com/careers/interview-process.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Asian Timezones
jobs.text:
Company Overview
hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.
Job Overview
We are a discretionary crypto trading firm where traders and researchers make high-conviction decisions using proprietary data, tools, and workflows. Our edge depends not only on the quality of our people, but also on the internal systems that help them investigate markets, test ideas, understand risk, and act quickly with confidence.
This is a founding Head of Product role. Today, product work is handled across trading, research, and engineering. Your mandate is to build the product function from the ground up: discovery, prioritization, requirements, roadmap ownership, product quality, adoption, and eventually the team.
At our firm, “product” means internal, proprietary systems built for our own traders, researchers, and engineering teams. We do not build retail products, and we do not serve external customers. Your users are expert practitioners inside the firm. Your job is to understand their workflows deeply, identify the highest-leverage problems, and ensure engineering builds the right systems to solve them.
You will start hands-on. You will sit with traders and researchers, understand real decisions and investigations, write the early requirements yourself, and establish the standards for how product work should be done. As the scope grows, you will hire and lead a small product team while staying close enough to the trading and research to retain a first-hand understanding of the problems we are solving.
Responsibilities
1. Product Function and Operating Model
Build the product discipline for the firm. Define how we discover problems, capture requirements, write specifications, review trade-offs, measure adoption, and close the feedback loop with users.
2. Internal Product Roadmap
Own the roadmap for internal trading and research systems in partnership with the CIO, engineering, trading, and research leadership. Balance immediate practitioner pain points with longer-term platform foundations, including data quality, provenance, tooling reliability, and system scalability.
3. Practitioner Discovery
Work directly with traders and researchers to understand real workflows: how they investigate opportunities, evaluate data, form hypotheses, monitor positions, assess risk, and make decisions. Your job is to understand the underlying decision process and identify what system capability would create the most leverage.
4. Requirements and Product Quality
Translate ambiguous practitioner needs into clear, evidence-backed requirements that engineering can build from. Requirements should capture the business context, user workflow, data assumptions, expected behavior, edge cases, success measures, and relevant trade-offs.
The goal is not simply to reduce questions from engineering. The goal is to reduce avoidable ambiguity, surface trade-offs early, and ensure the team is building the right thing for the right reason.
5. Trust, Explainability, and Source Transparency
Ensure our internal systems are built for trust. Traders and researchers should be able to understand where a number came from, what assumptions sit behind a calculation, why a signal changed, and when human judgment is required.
Data lineage, source transparency, explainable calculations, and human-in-the-loop decision-making should be default product principles.
6. Stakeholder Alignment
Act as the connective tissue between trading, research, engineering, and management. You will surface trade-offs clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and help the firm make better prioritization decisions.
7. Team Building
Start as the sole product leader, then build the team as the work scales. Hire and develop product managers, set the bar for discovery and specification quality, and create a product culture suited to a high-performance trading environment.
What you'll do
Spend significant time with traders and researchers to understand real decisions, workflows, investigations, datasets, and pain points.
Distinguish stated feature requests from underlying practitioner needs.
Translate trading and research workflows into product opportunities, clear requirements, and buildable product decisions.
Write clear product requirements for internal systems, workflows, data products, analytics, and decision-support tools.
Partner closely with engineering to shape feasible, scalable solutions and surface technical trade-offs early.
Prioritize product work based on expected trading, research, operational, or risk impact.
Define success measures for product work, including faster research cycles, better data quality, reduced manual work, improved decision confidence, risk reduction, stronger adoption, or, where measurable, PnL contribution.
Defend foundational work — such as data quality, lineage, reliability, and platform architecture — when it is more important than a visible front-end feature.
Evaluate external data providers and tooling vendors where relevant, including API quality, coverage, latency, reliability, cost, and integration complexity.
Establish product rituals, documentation standards, and feedback loops.
Advise the CIO on product priorities, practitioner needs, product-engineering trade-offs, and sequencing.
Hire and lead a small product team once the scope requires it.

TJM Labs builds AI-driven automation that strips away the repetitive, error-prone tasks slowing pharmacies down so teams can focus on patient care. Our bots handle prescription intake, fax processing, insurance workflows and more, helping pharmacies scale efficiently without adding headcount.
TJM Labs is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is technically credible, execution-focused, and takes ownership of results. You will develop a team of engineering managers and partner with senior leadership to turn company priorities into shipped outcomes.
What You'll Do
Lead, mentor, and grow engineering managers across multiple teams
Set clear expectations for delivery, quality, and team health
Own engineering execution, including planning, delivery predictability, and cross-team coordination
Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, and production issues
Define and track engineering effectiveness metrics, and improve how our teams build and ship, including through AI-assisted development
Partner with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to align priorities
Join customer conversations on complex integrations and technical escalations when needed

jobs.title: Director - Engineering, Forward-Deployed Engineering and Customer Outcomes
jobs.text:
Customer Success at Innovaccer
Our mission is to turn our customers into tech-savvy superheroes, ensuring they achieve success using our platform to meet their organization’s business goals. If you're passionate about helping customers realize the value they seek with technology, then our customer success team is the right place for you.
About the Role
As the Director of Engineering, FDE and Customer Outcomes, you will lead an elite organization of multiple cross-functional engineering teams, each dedicated to a portfolio of tier-one healthcare customers. You are ultimately accountable for the technical delivery, enterprise configuration, and operational success of our AI-driven platform within complex healthcare ecosystems.
Each team under your leadership operates with high autonomy, directly owning their customer delivery plans, data quality standards, and clinical/business outcomes. You will mentor engineering managers and technical leads across a global footprint to architect robust data ingestion pipelines, configure complex enterprise software, and deploy production-grade, compliant AI agents into live healthcare environments.
A Day in the Life
Global Team Leadership & Delivery Ownership
● Scale and Govern Multiple Teams: Hire, mentor, and scale multiple customer-facing engineering teams across regions, optimizing global resource allocation across health systems, payers, and life sciences clients.
● Delivery Plan Accountability: Empower autonomous teams to own, track, and execute comprehensive implementation delivery plans, navigating critical paths from discovery to live production.
● Customer Outcome Management: Focus engineering execution on direct business and clinical metrics (reducing administrative burden, improving workflow efficiency) to drive customer retention and high NPS/CSAT.
● Quality Assurance & Standards: Establish baseline organizational standards for data integrity, product quality, architectural reviews, and formal customer sign-off criteria.
Data Ingestion & Data Quality
● Clinical Data Ingestion: Guide teams in building high-throughput pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured datasets (EHR notes, lab results, imaging metadata, claims) via HL7, FHIR, and DICOM.
● Data Quality & Normalization: Standardize validation frameworks to sanitize, deduplicate, and normalize raw, heterogeneous healthcare data for downstream AI/ML consumption.
● Deterministic Guardrails: Implement automated data-quality testing and schema enforcement protocols to intercept data corruption or format mismatches pre-ingestion, ensuring absolute clinical data integrity.
Product Configuration & Enterprise Implementation
● Enterprise Customization: Oversee platform configuration, tailoring core software capabilities to match specific clinical workflows and varied healthcare operational taxonomies.
● Seamless Integration: Lead native platform deployments into complex enterprise ecosystems, integrating directly with production EHR systems and native provider workflows.
● Solution Architecture: Design scalable pre-sales and post-sales technical solution architectures that align customer requirements with platform capabilities.
Build & Deploy AI Agents
● AI Agent Engineering: Oversee the forward-deployed development, local integration, optimization, and fine-tuning of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents utilizing advanced LLM orchestration frameworks.
● Clinical Safety & Benchmarking: Enforce a high rollout bar which includes deployment-level guardrails, and real-time monitoring and ensure safe outputs.

jobs.title: Director of Operations (Product, Engineering & Technical Solutions)
jobs.text:
Alloy is where you belong!
Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.
Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong.
See how we've been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.
Check out our investors and read more about us here.
About the team
Product, Engineering, and Technical Solutions (PETS) make up two-thirds of Alloy and own the products and capabilities that drive outcomes for our clients. As Alloy grows, we keep rethinking how we operate: delivering first-of-their-kind client solutions, building scale and consistency in our core, and leveling up our platform. PETS Operations sits at the center of that work. The team keeps every group focused on high-impact problems, cuts toil out of how we work, and runs the rituals that keep PETS aligned. Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week. Directors and above attend the office four times a week.
What you'll do
Own how two-thirds of Alloy operates. You'll set the operations strategy for PETS, sit on Alloy's senior leadership team, report to our Chief Product & Operating Officer, and lead a team of Operations Managers and an Applied AI Engineer.
Set the operations strategy for Product, Engineering, and Technical Solutions. Choose the priorities, say what we will not do, and hold the organization accountable for delivering.
Build the measurement that shows where effort goes across PETS, starting with cost to serve by client segment, and turn it into decisions and points of view for the executive team and board.
Cut the overhead of running PETS so Alloy grows without scaling headcount linearly. Set automation goals and make the build-vs-buy calls on the tooling that gets us there.
Redesign core processes, from triage and feature requests to delivery, launches, and product feedback loops, to raise client satisfaction and remove internal overhead.
Run PETS operating cadences, including quarterly roadmap planning, annual planning, and All Hands, and decide which ones to keep, change, or cut.
Own the systems PETS runs on, including contracting, budget, and setup in partnership with IT.
Lead, coach, and grow a small team of Operations Managers and an Applied AI Engineer into a group that gets more done together than apart.
What we're looking for
Must-haves:
Experience leading operations for Product, Engineering, and/or Technical Solutions teams at a high-growth startup.
A track record of setting strategy and priorities for an operations function and driving change through teams you don't manage, all the way to adoption. You are comfortable pushing on senior leaders, including the executive team.
Measurement built from no baseline, such as cost to serve, capacity or effort models, or unit economics for solutions and engineering teams, and used to change real decisions.
Fluency in how engineering teams work. You engage credibly with Engineering leaders on SDLC, triage, and process. You do not need to be a former engineer.
Experience leading and developing a high-performing team, with real investment in each person's career growth.
Based in New York and able to work from our Union Square HQ four days a week.
Nice-to-haves:
Led build-vs-buy decisions on automation or internal tooling, and partnered on the build when that was the right call.
Redesigned an operating cadence, including cutting one that was not creating value.
Prepared points of view and materials for executives and a board.
Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!
This position has a salary range of $200,000 – $240,000.
Benefits and Perks
We invest in your health, your financial future, and your growth. Here's what you can expect:
Medical, dental, and vision coverage from the first of the month after you join, including $0 employee-only premium options, plus FSA options and an Alloy-funded HSA with our high-deductible plan
Healia: if your spouse or partner has health insurance through their employer, Alloy may cover up to 100% of your family's costs on their plan
Alloy-paid One Medical membership, Spring Health therapy and coaching, Superpower advanced lab testing, and ClassPass credits
Stock options for every full-time employee
401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of pay, vested immediately, plus a mega backdoor Roth option
Free, unlimited 1:1 financial planning through Addition Wealth
Unlimited PTO plus company holidays
16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for eligible birthing, non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents
Annual learning and development stipend, plus a home office stipend to set up your workspace
Hybrid work environment: most team members work from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan, Tuesday through Thursday, with in-office expectations that vary by role. Catered lunches from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events bring energy to the office. On Mondays and Fridays, many employees work remotely, while some take advantage of the quieter office.
How to Apply
Apply right here! You've found the application!
Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We're committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.
All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an alloy.com email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you're ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.

jobs.title: Product Director, Consumer Channels
jobs.text:
Does this position interest you? You should apply –even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.
A Brief Overview
Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.
We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.
What you will do
Lead the consumer product portfolio
• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.
Performs other duties as assigned

But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.
A Brief Overview

Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.

We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.

Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.
What you will do
Lead the consumer product portfolio
• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.

jobs.title: Head of IT Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
Asana is hiring a Head of IT Systems Engineering to lead the team that powers how every Asana employee works. Reporting to the Head of IT, this San Francisco-based leader owns the strategy, architecture, and operations behind our SaaS productivity applications, corporate endpoints, identity, and user lifecycle, setting the standards and roadmap that keep every employee secure and productive. You will also influence the way Asana evaluates, adopts, and governs the tools and platforms our employees rely on. You will be responsible for the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, who deliver this work. This role has one manager level report.
You ask good questions, are confident in not knowing everything, and would rather build with others than go it alone. You are crisp and detail oriented, but comfortable working outside the boundaries when the situation calls for it. You bring a proven record of success, a passion for technology, and, like us, you value hard work and fun in equal measure.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Develop the multi-year vision, roadmap, and architecture for Systems Engineering, aligned with Asana’s business priorities and Asana’s broader AI strategy
Accelerate an Agentified Asana, helping teams across Asana embrace our tools and reduce the friction of manual work.
Partner with leaders across Asana to build and maintain an efficient and effective portfolio of SaaS tools to enable all Asanas to do their best work.
Lead, develop, and grow the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, including hiring, performance management, succession planning, and career development
Own the strategy and operation of corporate endpoint management, SaaS application management, identity, and the full user lifecycle
Drive IT’s AI strategy, from evaluating and governing platforms such as Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI to building AI agents and automation for onboarding, access requests, support, and compliance workflows
Partner with Security, Legal, and Privacy to set AI usage policies, data access controls, and vendor risk standards, including identity-based access and data loss prevention for AI tools and integrations
Set client platform standards and drive excellence in system performance, patching, and configuration compliance
Partner with IT Support, IT Infrastructure, and Security leadership to resolve issues, reduce risk, and improve the employee experience
Represent Systems Engineering to senior stakeholders, communicating priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly
About you
10+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years directly leading teams of systems engineers and software engineers in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment
Proven ownership of purchasing, inventory management, and budgeting at scale
Strong, hands-on knowledge of current IAM practices and cloud-based identity, SSO, SAML, and SCIM
Experience with hosted cloud applications, including Okta, Google Workspace, Asana, Figma, and Slack
Experience establishing governance for emerging technology, including AI usage policy, data protection, and vendor risk review
Track record of setting strategy and roadmaps, then delegating effectively while staying close enough to the details to coach and unblockExperience with configuration management and automation tools such as JAMF, Intune, Puppet, and Munki
Working knowledge of scripting and API integration (REST, OAuth, Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent)
Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, and OpenAI, including deployment, administration, and integration through APIs, connectors, and MCP servers
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
How you work
A strong mix of problem solving and a positive, service-oriented attitude
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
Curiosity and a bias toward experimenting with AI in your own work, and the ability to lead a team through rapid change
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
What we’ll offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $218,000 - $256,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

jobs.title: Director, Product Sourcing
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Position Summary
The Director, Product Sourcing is responsible for developing and executing global sourcing strategies that support new product introduction (NPI), product lifecycle management, supplier development, and supply continuity across a complex semiconductor equipment portfolio. This leader partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, and Business Unit teams to drive innovation, mitigate risk, improve supplier performance, and enable scalable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute global product sourcing and category strategies aligned with business objectives, technology roadmaps, and operational priorities.
Lead sourcing activities across the product lifecycle, from concept and NPI through production ramp and end-of-life management.
Drive supplier selection, qualification, development, and performance management to optimize quality, delivery, cost, innovation, and risk.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with strategic suppliers and lead complex commercial negotiations and long-term agreements.
Partner with Engineering to support design-for-supply-chain initiatives, supplier technology alignment, component standardization, and value engineering opportunities.
Lead cross-functional efforts to ensure material readiness, supply continuity, and successful execution of NPI and engineering change initiatives.
Develop strategies that strengthen supply chain resilience, mitigate risk, and address capacity, quality, and availability challenges.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global sourcing organization while fostering collaboration across key business functions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational performance, supplier effectiveness, and total cost of ownership.
Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering Management, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering strongly preferred.
12+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, operations, or engineering leadership within semiconductor, semiconductor capital equipment, or other advanced technology manufacturing environments.
5+ years of experience leading sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or engineering teams.
Proven experience supporting complex NPI programs, product lifecycle management, and global supplier networks.
Strong background in category management, supplier strategy, contract negotiations, and cross-functional leadership.
Demonstrated success influencing executive stakeholders and driving business results in a global environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Semiconductor capital equipment industry experience.
Product or equipment engineering background.
Experience leading global sourcing organizations.
Advanced knowledge of supplier quality, commodity management, and supply chain risk mitigation.
Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP systems.
APICS/ASCM, CPSM, Lean Six Sigma, or related certifications.
Leadership Profile
The ideal candidate is a strategic, results-oriented leader with strong business acumen, technical credibility, and executive presence. They excel at building supplier partnerships, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and developing sourcing strategies that enable growth, innovation, and operational excellence.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions & Engineering
jobs.text:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US
Role Overview
Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader with strong experience in adtech, martech, media technology, or commercially relevant customer data environments. This person will guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. The role combines data-platform and solution architecture, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership—bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.
As department head, this person will lead the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure. Snowflake is central to the environment, but the role requires working knowledge of the broader modern data ecosystem, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, cloud infrastructure, analytics, governance, and activation tools.
On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable adtech and data solutions, support pre-sales technical strategy, and determine when a client need should be addressed through a custom solution, a repeatable capability, or a scalable data product.
This is a working leadership role for a strong data-platform technologist with commercial instincts. The person will set direction and manage the function while remaining close enough to the technology and client work to evaluate architecture, troubleshoot complex issues, shape solutions, and translate technical concepts into clear, natural language for clients and internal stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering
• Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
• Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
• Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, data quality, documentation, and data-product performance
• Drive the continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and the surrounding data ecosystem, making sound decisions across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, cloud, analytics, and activation tools
• Own and evolve the data-platform and data-product roadmap, balancing infrastructure reliability, client needs, commercial opportunities, technical debt, and longer-term platform investments
• Provide clear recommendations to company leadership on platform investments, staffing needs, delivery risks, technical priorities, and opportunities to expand or productize Statara’s capabilities
Solution Architecture & Strategy
• Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through architecture, high-level design, validation, and delivery planning
• Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
• Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases, including when to convert custom work into repeatable capabilities or data products
Client & Pre-Sales Support
• Partner with Business Development to qualify and shape opportunities, clarify technical requirements, assess feasibility, and support proposals, demonstrations, and solution walkthroughs
• Participate in client and executive conversations as a technical resource, translating complex adtech and data concepts into clear business language, practical recommendations, and measurable value
• Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities
Feasibility & Validation
• Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
• Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
• Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence
• Establish practical standards for data governance, security, documentation, observability, and quality that are appropriate to Statara’s size and client commitments
Cross-Functional Alignment
• Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Business Development to align solution designs with platform capabilities, client expectations, commercial potential, and delivery realities
• Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
• Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams, ensuring that proposed solutions are both technically credible and commercially useful
What Success Looks Like
• The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear priorities, strong execution, practical management, and alignment to company objectives
• Snowflake and the surrounding data ecosystem are reliable, well-maintained, and evolving through sound platform and tooling decisions
• Adtech and data opportunities are qualified and scoped accurately, with strong technical grounding, commercial relevance, and clear client-facing explanations
• Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
• Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
• Company leadership receives clear, practical recommendations on platform investment, staffing, risk, and productization opportunities
• Custom solutions increasingly become repeatable capabilities or scalable data products where the market opportunity and delivery model support it

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Job Title: Head of Engineering
Location: Cumbernauld
Contract and working pattern: On site, permanent
Are you ready to Be Your Best Barr None?
Lets Grow!!!
We are all about Being Your Best Barr None and having a career with real Moments that Matter!
Employing around 950 people across the UK, we are proud to be a responsible business that takes care of our people, values diversity, gives something back to our communities and works to minimise our environmental impact.
For 150 years AG Barr has been building great brands and is home to some of the nations favourite flavours.
At our core is IRN-BRU, launched in 1901 and still going strong today, the vibrant RUBICON fruit based brand, Boost making every moment better with a caffeine kick, hydration hit or tasty treat, and FUNKIN where real fruit means authentic taste.
We also have a number of exciting owned brands within our portfolio including MOMA, which crafts quality oats into great tasting oat drinks and porridges.
There's never been a better time to join us!
What we’re looking for…
As a Head of Engineering, you will champion world-class manufacturing performance at our flagship site, combining strategic vision with a visible, sleeves-rolled-up approach on the factory floor!
Reporting directly to the Site Director and sitting on the Site Leadership Team, you will set the engineering agenda, drive multi-million-pound capital projects, and pioneer continuous improvement across high-speed packaging lines. Just as importantly, you are a grounded leader who stays close to the action—ready to step down onto the line shoulder-to-shoulder with your technicians during critical overhauls or complex faults. If you are an empowering, technically astute leader who can command the boardroom while earning genuine respect on the shop floor, we want to hear from you.
Your responsibilities will include…
Strategic Leadership & Budget Ownership: Partner with the Site Director to set engineering strategy and execute the site budget, balancing cost control with high-availability manufacturing goals.
Asset Reliability & Proactive Maintenance: Drive plant uptime, MTBF, and OEE by evolving PPM routines, overhaul planning, and modernising engineering stores and inventory control.
Hands-On Floor Support & Technical Mentorship: Maintain an active presence on the line, stepping in alongside shift teams to resolve complex breakdowns, guide line-side troubleshooting, and model operational excellence.
Capital Project Delivery: Lead end-to-end Capex programmes from business case justification and equipment procurement through to on-site installation and successful commissioning.
Cross-Functional CI & Efficiency: Collaborate daily with Production Managers to embed TPM and Lean methodologies, reduce changeover times, and eliminate recurring operational bottlenecks.
Culture, Coaching & Matrix Leadership: Inspire and develop both core site engineers and shift-based teams, fostering an inclusive, high-accountability environment focused on technical growth.
Safety, Quality & Regulatory Compliance: Act as site champion for Quality, Safety, and Environment (QSE), managing statutory compliance, contractor safe systems of work, and site utility resilience.
What you’ll bring...
The successful candidate will have;
Extensive engineering management experience leading teams within a high-speed FMCG or Food & Beverage manufacturing environment.
Proven ability to balance strategic management with a hands-on, line-side presence when technical escalations and critical overhauls require direct support.
Deep technical expertise in high-speed packaging equipment, automated bottling/canning lines, and modern asset reliability/PPM systems.
Track record of scoping, managing, and delivering multi-million-pound capital projects safely, on budget, and on schedule.
Proven leadership capability to mentor shift technicians, influence cross-functional operations, and drive a culture of continuous improvement.
NEBOSH qualification (Certificate or Diploma) with comprehensive knowledge of machinery safety and contractor management regulations.
And it would also be great if you can demonstrate:
A degree in an engineering discipline alongside hands-on proficiency with CMMS platforms (e.g., Mainsaver) and AutoCad.
Formal accreditation or practical mastery in Lean/TPM methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, SMED, 5S, root-cause 8D analysis).
Prior experience managing site infrastructure, facilities, and utilities (effluent, steam, compressed air, refrigeration) within an ISO-accredited plant (9001, 14001).
What we offer…
We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive culture where your voice can be heard. Our skilled, loyal and committed people are critical to the future success of AG Barr which is why we are continually investing in our employees to develop their talent.
We look after our employees by offering a competitive salary and benefits package which includes;
Competitive salary, benchmarked to market
Annual bonus linked to business and individual performance
Defined contribution Pension with employer contribution
Up to 34 days holiday (depending on shift pattern)
Flexible holiday trading
Flexible cash pot to spend on benefits
Healthcare Cash Plan
Flexible benefits e.g. discounts & cashbacks, gym memberships, technology purchases etc
Life assurance
Save as you earn scheme
Staff sales discount
Free AG Barr products throughout your working day and staff sales
Ongoing professional development and access to Learning and Development programmes and content
And much more!
To find out more about what it is like to work for AG Barr, please visit our careers platform here.
We are an equal opportunities employer and happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments that may be needed for successful candidates with a disability, health or mental health condition.
While we have highlighted our ideal requirements for this role, we are realistic that the successful candidate probably won't meet every single requirement in this advert, but we are big advocates of people growing in role. So even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to submit an application - you may be just what we are looking for! Apply now!
Speculative CVs from agencies will not be accepted.
Please note, we may close vacancies early where we receive significant numbers of applications, so apply now!
