jobs.title: Director, Brand Design
jobs.text:
About Betterment
Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings, and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors, as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We're headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).
About the Role
Betterment is entering its next phase of growth, and we’re looking for a Director of Brand Design to raise the ambition and craft of our brand everywhere it shows up.
This role is for someone who obsesses over the kerning in a web nav as much as over the motion piece that moves people. You have exceptional taste, a sense of curiosity to learn new things, and a strong point of view. You’ll be the brand’s primary design voice and the final word on our brand design system, knowing when to hold the line and when to evolve. You will make the brand feel like one brand across advertising, web, motion and sales collateral, for both our Retail and B2B businesses.
You’ll stay hands-on. You’ll lead concepting and art direction on our biggest initiatives and shape them from the first idea. You’ll polish the work that matters most and jump in wherever the craft needs you. You’ll also lead and develop a small team of designers, setting the bar for their work and trusting them to own execution in their areas. Stakeholders will come to you for creative direction, not just review.
Reporting to the VP, Brand Creative, you’ll partner closely with our Director of Copy and our Director of Brand Operations.
This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.
New York City: $175,000-$205,000
This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.
A Day in the Life
Act as the arbiter of our brand design system and standards; challenge the system when it starts to feel stagnant and keep a constant eye on how our visual identity needs to evolve.
Review and shape creative briefs before work begins, ensuring projects start with clear direction and objectives.
Hold the overall craft bar across advertising, web, motion, and collateral. Lead concepting and art direction on key initiatives, personally refining work at critical moments, and catching any execution misses or inconsistencies.
Manage and develop a team of senior designers: set clear goals, deliver regular and constructive feedback, and push design execution from good to great.
Build and pitch proposals for new design initiatives.
Work closely with marketing and sales stakeholders on assignments to understand goals and what success looks like.
Create a team culture where designers feel empowered to take creative risks, raise dissenting opinions, and learn from projects that don't land perfectly the first time.
Represent your team's work and point of view to senior leadership, translating creative decisions into business context.
Participate in hiring: lead portfolio review interviews, evaluate candidates, and help scale the team as it grows.
Source and direct vendors and agencies to supplement our work.
What We're Looking For
10+ years of brand/design experience, including experience leading or managing designers.
A strong, well-defined point of view on brand design systems, with experience evolving an identity system over time rather than just applying one.
Proven ability to translate business strategy, objectives, and growth goals into a clear creative point of view and compelling work, while shaping creative briefs and providing direction before execution begins
Experience managing and developing designers at varying levels of seniority, including supporting both craft-focused and people-leadership growth paths.
A strong track record of partnering cross-functionally with copy and brand voice, marketing, operations, and external agencies to keep creative work on-brand and on schedule.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to represent your team’s work and decisions to senior and executive stakeholders.
A portfolio that demonstrates range and craft across advertising, web, motion, and sales materials.
Bonus points if you have experience:
Working in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated industry, given the compliance and disclosure requirements that shape our creative work.
Join a team built on these core values
We change lives
Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.
We set audacious goals
We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
We value all perspectives
When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
We simplify financial services
We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being:
We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.
What happens next
We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.
In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.
On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.
We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.
Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Come join us!
We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: VP, Systems Engineering NAR (Virtual, Texas, United States, 78701)
jobs.text:
In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.
At Ruckus, our mission is to deliver purpose-driven networks across vertical markets, that drive human experiences where we learn, live, work, and play. With core values focused on innovation and customer success, RUCKUS has an unbeaten track record of redefining what’s possible in connectivity and network performance with our portfolio of AI-powered access points, multigigabit switching, and Cloud and Edge services.
We’re looking for a dynamic, customer-focused technology leader to drive innovation and impact as our VP of Systems Engineering NAR (North America Region) at RUCKUS. In this role, you’ll lead a team of SE professionals, shaping strategy, fostering trust, and ensuring every customer interaction delivers real business value.
“How You'll help us to connect the world:”
As the VP of Systems Engineering, NAR you will lead a geographically distributed team of Systems Engineers and Managers supporting customers and channel partners across the region.
This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for driving technical sales success through partner enablement, customer engagement, and team development in a diverse and high-growth market. You will work closely with regional sales leadership, distributors, and partners to expand RUCKUS adoption and ensure strong technical alignment across countries.You will attract, recruit, and develop talented SEs and support the team’s efforts to successfully position, influence and grow the RUCKUS product portfolio to net new and existing installed base customers and channel partners
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of Systems Engineers across the NAR region
Develop and execute a strategic SE business plan to drive growth.
Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing SE team.
Partner with regional sales leadership to achieve revenue targets, pipeline growth, and market expansion
Guide pre-sales activities including solution design, demos, POCs, and RFx responses
Review and strengthen technical account plans and regional go-to-market strategies
Act as a technical escalation point for complex, multi-country deployments and customer situations
Build executive-level relationships with partners, distributors, and customers as a trusted advisor
Align cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing) to enhance customer experience.
Influence product roadmaps with field insights and market demands.
Optimize operational budgets and scale global SE initiatives.
Core Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
15+ years of pre-sales or systems engineering experience in at least one area of networking (Wi-Fi, switching, routing)
7+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams
Hands-on experience with enterprise networking solutions, including wireless and switching
Proven ability to operate across complex and matrixed organizations
Exceptional presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to persuade and influence C-level stakeholders.
Proven ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive revenue growth.
Strong leadership in talent development, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration.
Exceptional presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to persuade and influence C-level stakeholders.
Candidates can be located in any state across the U.S.
Requirements: “You will excite us if you have:”
3+ years of experience in a second-level technical management capacity, including oversight of escalations, team leadership, and operational support
A proficient understanding of pre-sales engineering including new customer acquisition strategies, technical influencing, objecting handling, how to develop technical and business skillsets of your team, program and case management, hardware and software networking solutions in IT infrastructures, channel partner engagements for growth, and critical account management
Strong understanding and experience with mid to large enterprise business models and technical requirements for verticals that include MDU, K-12, SLED, higher education, hospitality, manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, large public venues and others
Advanced understanding of customer business drivers and how to map these to customer requirements and network environments, migrations, and network refresh decision making strategies including identification of improvement areas in network design
Multi-tasker with strong ability to manage under pressure to address deadlines, program manage development of deliverables, and logistical champion when supporting multiple projects and events
Working knowledge or understanding of networking technical skills; specifically, 802.11 Wi-Fi technology evolution releases (Wi-Fi 5, 6, 7), best practices design and assessment, wireless troubleshooting, RF tools used for pre and post site surveys, wireless network optimization, IP routing and switching WAN/LAN design, setup and configuration, Layer 4-7 application services, security authentication methods and products, SASE, SD-WAN, RADIUS, AD, Virtualization environments/deployments, VM installations, (any of VM Ware, KVM, Hyper-V, GCE, Azure, AWS), secure device/user onboarding solutions, etc.
General knowledge of the following areas of specialization: Cloud services (SaaS); VLAN; network segmentation, personal identity networking, security (SASE); SD-WAN; wireless controller architectures; indoor and outdoor wireless deployments; general routing and switching
Strong program management experience, technical relationship building, verbal and written communications skills, presenting and thought leadership, and commanding a room of executive level decision makers
Our salary ranges consider a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to benchmarking by independent third-party consultants, skill sets, years of experience, training, education, geography, and other business needs. Depending on experience, the range can be higher for candidates with exceptional experience and a demonstrated history of successful performance. Expected Total Target Compensation for this role is $250,000 - $370,000. The candidate will be rewarded with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and accidental death insurance, a 401(k) plan, and participation in the Company’s Incentive Plan. Candidates starting with the Company will be eligible for eleven paid holidays in a full calendar year, two weeks of paid vacation (prorated based on start date), as well as other leave options.
What Happens After You Apply:
Learn how to prepare yourself for the next steps in our hiring process by visiting
Why Join Us?
Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.
RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.
If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.
Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Global Product Owner / Global Head of Entity Management
jobs.text:
At GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Entity Management (EMT) owns the EMT product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics. Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, and reputation of EMT worldwide.
This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for EMT in the market — client-facing, trusted by prospects and key accounts, and the partner of choice for Revenue and Sales in winning and expanding business. As the ultimate subject-matter expert for EMT, you stay close to market trends and customer demands and translate them into how the service is designed, packaged, priced, and delivered.
You lead the EMT function globally through the Global Process Manager (GPM), the Regional Product Owners (RPOs), and the Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You build the delivery organisation to meet both market opportunity and client expectation, set and defend global standards as the foundation for scalable and sustainable delivery, and act as an inspiring leader for the teams who deliver EMT every day.
Roles & Responsibilities
Commercial Leadership & Growth
• Act as the senior, client-facing product authority for EMT: anchoring strategic client engagements, pitches, high-stakes decisions, and escalations.
• Partner with Revenue and Sales as the expert in the room — qualifying opportunities, shaping scope and pricing, and helping convert and expand accounts.
• Define and evolve the commercial logic — packaging, bundling, premiums, and guardrails — so EMT can be sold and delivered profitably at scale.
• Own the reputation of the EMT product in the market.
Product Strategy & Standards
• Own the global scope, service definitions, and standards for EMT — what is in, what is out, and how it is delivered.
• Set global execution standards, SLAs, and compliance expectations across all regions and delivery models.
• Drive consistency of delivery across regions while enabling them to flex within agreed guardrails.
Market Insight & Service Design
• Act as the ultimate subject-matter expert for EMT, maintaining a deep, current view of market trends, competitor moves, and evolving customer demands.
• Translate market and client insight into the design of the service and the delivery organisation, so the function is structured to meet both demand and expectation.
• Shape the product roadmap and delivery-model choices (in-house, outsourced, automated) to capture growth opportunities.
Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
• Set the global EMT operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.
• Direct the Global Process Manager (GPM) on process design, standardisation, controls, and scalability — turning product intent into repeatable, executable delivery.
• Support the enterprise AI direction and drive its adoption within EMT to enable scale and quality.
Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability
• Own product-level cost-to-serve for EMT, driving efficiency, productivity, and long-term economic sustainability.
• Make deliberate trade-offs across scope design, automation, sourcing, and delivery-model choices to keep delivery economics healthy as the product scales.
• Diagnose cost pressures, identify root causes, and lead corrective action, supported by Finance on modelling and analysis.
Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership
• Lead all Regional Product Owners (RPOs) for EMT as their global head, holding them and the Outsourcing Control leads accountable for regional delivery outcomes and economics.
• Provide the framework within which regional autonomy — in-house versus outsourced mix, capacity, and hiring proposals — is exercised, and arbitrate cross-regional or peer-function disagreements when escalated.
• Lead, mentor, and develop the GPM, RPOs, and OC leads; build product, commercial, and delivery capability across the global EMT team.
Scope & Commercial Governance
• Propose and own changes to product scope, service tiers, and commercial logic, routing them through the agreed approval framework for impact assessment and implementation readiness.

This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. • Set the global EMT operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.

jobs.title: Workplace - Design Project Director (Urban Core) (REQ743)
jobs.text:
The Workplace Design Project Lead is responsible for leading the successful design, planning and delivery of the Workplace Interiors of the Qiddiya corporate headquarters which are being integrated into new base buildings. This includes managing the workplace project from early concept and business case development through developing comprehensive briefs, design, procurement, construction, and operational handover.
The proposed Qiddiya Headquarters will be a world-class Grade A+, future-ready workplace ecosystem spanning approximately 120,000 sqm and accommodating approximately 9,000 people. Designed to enhance human performance, foster innovation, and set a benchmark for sustainable workplace design, the campus will provide a flexible and resilient environment that evolves with the organization’s needs.
This role will ensure alignment between the corporate headquarters workplace and other QIC workplace projects, ensuring they support the company’s strategic objectives, governance requirements, and employee needs. The positionwill also represent the Qiddiya corporate workplace across senior leadership forums and act as a key liaison across internal departments.
The role will require working closely with the Base Building Development Directors to ensure workplace requirements are integrated into the base building design, infrastructure, and delivery strategy from the earliest design stages. This includes coordinating key interfaces such as spatial planning, building services, vertical transportation, access, security, technology, sustainability, and operational requirements so the headquarters workplace is seamlessly embedded within the broader development and capable of supporting QIC’s long-term business and employee needs.
The successful candidate will bring a depth of experience in the design management of large-scale corporate workplace projects, with proven capability leading front-end design phases from workplace strategy, briefing and concept development through to design coordination and approvals. They will combine strong technical understanding of workplace planning and fit-out design with strategic project leadership, ensuring design outcomes are aligned with business objectives, employee needs and delivery requirements. Exceptional stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead consultants, internal client teams and senior decision-makers through complex workplace design processes are imperative for the role.
Key Responsibilities
1. Project Leadership & Delivery
· Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of the company’s corporate headquarters workplace, ensuring alignment with workplace strategy, program, budget, quality, compliance requirements, and employee needs, while aligning to the consistency across other Qiddiya Investment Company workplace projects in line with the company’s strategic objectives and governance requirements.
· Work closely with internal stakeholders including the Office Development team who are delivering the base buildings, Corporate Workplace Team, HR, IT, Smart Buildings Team, DMO, ESG, and Corporate Governance to ensure the workplace reflects current and future needs.
· Manage external consultants, project management consultants, workplace design teams, quantity surveyors, and contractors on behalf of the company as client.
Coordinate all phases of workplace delivery, with particular emphasis on front-end design management, including workplace strategy, feasibility, briefing, concept design, design development, approvals, procurement, construction, fit-out, commissioning, and transition to occupancy.
· Work closely with Workplace Delivery teams to ensure construction procurement, phasing, quality and compliance are achieved in all workplace projects.
2. Strategic Vision & Internal Alignment
· Translate the company’s strategic goals, brand identity, and public mission into workplace design and delivery outcomes.
· Lead internal engagement to shape the headquarters as a high-performing, flexible, inclusive and sustainable workplace.
· Promote alignment between the physical workspace and the organization’s operating model, functional briefing, technology roadmap, and corporate culture.
· Support leadership in driving positive organisational change associated with the move.
3. Governance & Public Accountability
· Ensure robust reporting and project governance in line with organisational frameworks.
· Prepare and present business cases, board papers, risk reports, and budget updates for executive stakeholders.
· Ensure procurement activities meet probity, equity, and value-for-money principles in line with corporate guidelines.
· Demonstrate stewardship of funds through strong cost control, transparency, and risk management.
4. Stakeholder Engagement
· Engage with executive leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure project goals are well-communicated and supported.
· Coordinate user engagement, change management, and communication strategies to prepare the organisation for transition.
· Act as an internal point of contact and trusted advisor to the internal client team throughout the project lifecycle.
Qualifications & Experience
Education
· Tertiary qualifications in Project Management, Construction Management, Architectural or related fields are imperative.
· Professional certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or construction management are desirable.
Preferred Work Experience
Minimum 15+ years’ experience leading the design and delivery of complex corporate workplace interiors, including large-scale headquarters or campus-style workplace projects.
Proven track record leading medium-to-large commercial workplace projects through front-end design phases, including workplace strategy, briefing, concept design, design development, consultant coordination, and stakeholder approvals.
Experience in the design and delivery of integrated workplace fit-out projects would also be beneficial.
Understanding of ESG ratings and sustainability standards for commercial office development and workplace interiors, including LEED, Green Star, BREEAM, WELL, or equivalent frameworks.
Ability to take ownership and responsibility for all aspects of workplace projects, including preparation of project and design briefs, consultant procurement, design management, contractor procurement, delivery oversight, handover, and operational readiness.
Strong stakeholder management skills at all levels, including internal departments, client groups, consultants, contractors, and senior leadership.
GCC experience is desirable but not essential.
Technical Acumen
· Strong understanding of workplace strategy, workplace planning, and fit-out delivery.
· Skilled in project budgeting, procurement, program management, risk, and value engineering.
· Familiarity with government or public-sector procurement processes and contract management.
· Understanding and experience in delivering sustainability standards (e.g., Green Star, WELL) and accessibility compliance (e.g., DDA).
Strategic & Business Skills
· Demonstrated ability to translate organizational strategy into capital project outcomes.
· Skilled in writing and presenting business cases, executive reporting, and value-for-money assessments.
· Capable of balancing multiple internal priorities while delivering complex capital programs.
· High level of integrity and accountability in managing project budgets.
Leadership & Soft Skills
· Collaborative Leadership: Ability to lead through influence, build consensus, and foster alignment across departments.
· Strong Communicator: Skilled at engaging diverse internal audiences, from executives to staff groups.
· Change Leadership: Capable of guiding organizational change related to workplace transformation.
· Problem Solver: Analytical, pragmatic, and solutions-focused in managing challenges and decision points.
· Empathy & Inclusion: A people-centric leader who promotes a safe, inclusive, and high-performing workplace.
· Resilience & Adaptability: Maintains focus and calm under pressure, navigating ambiguity with professionalism.
Working Conditions
· Primarily Riyadh / Qiddiya City based with regular attendance at project sites, consultant offices, and workshops.
· May require travel within the GCC region and other international destinations (subject to project requirements).
Requires flexibility to engage cross-functional teams and consultants across various stages of planning and implementation, including consultants and stakeholders who may be based outside the region.

Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
.
Freelance Associate Director, Marketing Effectiveness & Intelligence
Role Overview
We are seeking a Freelance Associate Director, Marketing Effectiveness & Intelligence to lead marketing performance management and measurement for the a major Auto client business. This person will be a key client-facing partner, helping both the client and the integrated agency team understand how marketing campaigns and efforts are performing, what is driving results, and where action is needed.
The role requires someone who can connect brand, media, digital engagement, campaign, and business performance into a coherent story and translate complex information into clear recommendations for clients and senior stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as a day-to-day client partner on marketing effectiveness, measurement, and performance.
Synthesize results across campaigns and channels into a clear view of overall marketing performance and business implications.
Identify emerging trends, performance opportunities, and areas requiring deeper investigation.
Translate analysis into concise, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
Connect media and campaign metrics with brand performance, consideration, digital engagement, sales, and market-share indicators.
Use and interpret key measurement platforms and data sources including Dynata, YouGov, MarketCast, and BERA.
Partner across VML, WPP Media, and other integrated agency teams to create a holistic view of performance.
Guide analysts and channel teams in moving from reporting metrics to identifying insights and actions.
Ensure measurement frameworks, KPIs, and reporting are consistent and aligned to client objectives.
Qualifications
6–10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, effectiveness, measurement, or related disciplines.
Strong client leadership, communication, and presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to connect marketing activity to brand and business performance.
Experience synthesizing data across media, campaign, brand, digital, and business sources.
Ability to turn complex analysis into a clear “so what” and “now what.”
Strong cross-functional leadership across analytics, media, strategy, account, and client teams.
Automotive or similarly complex consumer marketing experience is a plus.
The core profile we are looking for is a trusted marketing performance partner to the client, rather than someone focused primarily on producing analytics deliverables.
The compensation for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package. jobs.title: Director, Analytics, DashOS
jobs.text:
About the Team
DashOS is DoorDash’s platform for helping restaurants grow. It connects Marketplace, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, and marketing (including SevenRooms) so restaurants can recognize the same guest across every channel, personalize how they bring them back, and use AI to automate manual work, all alongside the systems they already use.
Our portfolio spans 0→1 bets, early-stage products, and rapidly scaling offerings, so our work sits at the intersection of product innovation, commercialization, and long-term platform strategy. The analytics and data science team helps define the right metrics, guide product and go-to-market investments, and turn new product ideas into durable outcomes for restaurants and for DoorDash.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Data Science to lead a broad and high-impact portfolio supporting DashOS. In this role, you will shape how we measure success, guide product and commercial strategy, and build the data foundations that help teams move quickly and make better decisions across products at different stages of maturity. Success in this role means building a high-performing team, raising the quality and speed of decision-making, and helping DoorDash identify and scale the highest-ROI opportunities across the portfolio. You will report into a Senior Director on our Merchant Analytics team in our Analytics organization.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead and grow a team of data science and analytics leaders and practitioners across a portfolio that spans 0→1 products, products still being shaped and commercialized, and businesses already scaling quickly.
Own the analytical direction for the portfolio, including experimentation, KPI design, forecasting, decision support, funnel analytics, and foundational measurement.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy & Operations, and Go-to-Market leaders to influence roadmap, commercialization, and investment decisions.
Build the operating system for decision-making by improving instrumentation, creating single sources of truth, and connecting short-term execution with long-term business outcomes.
Operate with broad scope and high autonomy in a startup-like environment while benefiting from the support and talent density of a scaled analytics organization.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant experience leading senior teams and developing managers.
You have strong product and business analytics judgment, with a track record of defining metrics, building decision frameworks, and influencing strategy in ambiguous environments.
You have deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, and you are comfortable making decisions in settings with imperfect data, evolving products, and small or noisy samples.
You bring hands-on technical fluency in SQL and statistical analysis, and you can go deep enough to raise the technical bar for the team while operating effectively at a leadership level.
You have experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and business leaders, and can translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that drive action
Compensation

blocks.text: About the Team

DashOS is DoorDash’s platform for helping restaurants grow. It connects Marketplace, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, and marketing (including SevenRooms) so restaurants can recognize the same guest across every channel, personalize how they bring them back, and use AI to automate manual work, all alongside the systems they already use.

Our portfolio spans 0→1 bets, early-stage products, and rapidly scaling offerings, so our work sits at the intersection of product innovation, commercialization, and long-term platform strategy. The analytics and data science team helps define the right metrics, guide product and go-to-market investments, and turn new product ideas into durable outcomes for restaurants and for DoorDash.
About the Role

We’re looking for a Director of Data Science to lead a broad and high-impact portfolio supporting DashOS. In this role, you will shape how we measure success, guide product and commercial strategy, and build the data foundations that help teams move quickly and make better decisions across products at different stages of maturity. Success in this role means building a high-performing team, raising the quality and speed of decision-making, and helping DoorDash identify and scale the highest-ROI opportunities across the portfolio. You will report into a Senior Director on our Merchant Analytics team in our Analytics organization.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

items: Lead and grow a team of data science and analytics leaders and practitioners across a portfolio that spans 0→1 products, products still being shaped and commercialized, and businesses already scaling quickly.
Own the analytical direction for the portfolio, including experimentation, KPI design, forecasting, decision support, funnel analytics, and foundational measurement.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy & Operations, and Go-to-Market leaders to influence roadmap, commercialization, and investment decisions.
Build the operating system for decision-making by improving instrumentation, creating single sources of truth, and connecting short-term execution with long-term business outcomes.
Operate with broad scope and high autonomy in a startup-like environment while benefiting from the support and talent density of a scaled analytics organization.

blocks.text: We’re excited about you because…

items: You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant experience leading senior teams and developing managers.
You have strong product and business analytics judgment, with a track record of defining metrics, building decision frameworks, and influencing strategy in ambiguous environments.
You have deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, and you are comfortable making decisions in settings with imperfect data, evolving products, and small or noisy samples.
You bring hands-on technical fluency in SQL and statistical analysis, and you can go deep enough to raise the technical bar for the team while operating effectively at a leadership level.
You have experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and business leaders, and can translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that drive action

jobs.title: [US DC] Associate Director, Production Technology
jobs.text:
Associate Director, Production Technology
The head of Fulfillment Technology & Support is responsible for the strategic direction, operational performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of the technology ecosystem supporting HelloFresh’s North American fulfillment network. This role bridges operations, engineering, IT, automation, and digital transformation to ensure fulfillment systems enable safe, reliable, efficient, and scalable operations.
The leader oversees the performance and integration of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Warehouse Execution Systems (WES), Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), material handling equipment, robotics, and supporting supply chain technologies. The position ensures that technology investments translate into measurable improvements in throughput, productivity, order accuracy, service levels, labor efficiency, and cost to serve.
Working in close partnership with Operations, Engineering, Product, IT, and external technology providers, the Head of Fulfillment Technology & Support establishes a proactive support model, drives technology standardization, and develops a scalable roadmap that supports HelloFresh’s continued growth, operational resilience, and customer experience objectives.
This role will require up to 50% travel
Key Responsibilities:
You Will…
Develop and execute a multi-year fulfillment technology strategy that supports HelloFresh’s North American supply chain, growth objectives, and operational excellence.
Establish an integrated technology roadmap spanning WMS, WES, WCS, robotics, automation, controls, system integrations, and operational support capabilities.
Optimize end-to-end fulfillment execution by improving coordination between enterprise applications, warehouse systems, automation platforms, and material handling equipment.
Partner with Operations, Automation, Engineering, and IT to deploy and optimize scalable automation solutions that improve throughput, flexibility, labor efficiency, and asset utilization.
Establish a standardized, proactive technology support model focused on system availability, predictive monitoring, rapid incident resolution, and long-term reliability.
Drive measurable operational improvements through performance analytics, root-cause elimination, process optimization, and technology-enabled continuous improvement.
Lead technology delivery for new fulfillment center launches, system implementations, automation deployments, and network transformation programs, ensuring technical readiness and operational adoption.
Build and develop a high-performing fulfillment technology organization while strengthening cross-functional partnerships, standardizing best practices, and delivering reliable, scalable solutions that protect customer commitments, product freshness, inventory traceability, and on-time fulfillment.
You Are…
A strategic technology leader with deep expertise in fulfillment technology, warehouse systems, automation, robotics, and supply chain execution.
A visionary who develops and executes multi-year technology strategies aligned with business growth, operational excellence, and network scalability.
An experienced leader who understands the interconnected roles of WMS, WES, WCS, enterprise applications, automation controls, and material handling systems.
A business-minded technology partner who translates complex technical challenges into measurable operational improvements and financial returns.
A champion of standardization, scalable architecture, and reusable technology solutions across multi-site fulfillment networks.
A collaborative leader who builds strong partnerships across Operations, IT, Automation and Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Finance, and external vendors.
A continuous improvement advocate focused on system reliability, labor productivity, throughput, order accuracy, and fulfillment cost.
A people-focused leader who fosters accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and a culture of continuous learning.
You Have…
A proven ability to develop technology roadmaps and prioritize investments based on business value, operational requirements, risk, and return on investment.
Extensive knowledge of warehouse management, execution, and control systems, including integrations with ERP, order management, inventory, transportation, and reporting platforms.
Experience integrating automation technologies, robotics, conveyor systems, sortation, automated storage and retrieval systems, and intelligent orchestration platforms.
A strong understanding of system architecture, integration standards, configuration management, testing, deployment, cybersecurity, and technology lifecycle management.
Experience establishing scalable technology support models, service-level agreements, incident management processes, escalation protocols, and root-cause analysis practices.
A track record of leading complex technology implementations, fulfillment center launches, facility expansions, automation upgrades, and network transformation initiatives.
The ability to translate system performance into measurable business outcomes through KPIs, dashboards, operational reviews, and continuous improvement programs.
Experience developing high-performing technical teams, managing vendor relationships, and leading cross-functional initiatives in complex, high-volume operational environments.
You’ll get…
Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities
Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for an Engineering Director to own the technology platform behind the GoMining ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep engineering expertise with strong product and business thinking.
You will own the Platform end-to-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.
The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.
This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.
We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade-offs between long-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.
Responsibilities
Platform Strategy & Architecture
Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business-critical.
Balance long-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.
Reliability & Engineering Excellence
Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident-management practices.
Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
Lead post-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.
Maintain a high engineering bar without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Core Platform Capabilities
Own shared authentication, authorization, registration, and 2FA infrastructure.
Develop common account controls, user restrictions, and security mechanisms.
Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.
Develop shared analytics and event infrastructure.
Support common infrastructure across web and native applications.
Partner with Product, Design, Security, and engineering teams on cross-company capabilities.
Product & Business Impact
Platform at GoMining is not an isolated infrastructure function.
You will work directly with product leaders, General Managers, and C-level stakeholders to understand where technology can unlock growth and where platform limitations are holding the business back.
Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.
Balance competing priorities across multiple product teams.
Make clear trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
Measure Platform not only through technical metrics, but through how effectively it accelerates the company.
Engineering Leadership
Lead and develop the Platform engineering organization.
Own team structure, hiring, performance, priorities, and execution.
Build a culture of strong engineering ownership and accountability.
Stay close enough to architecture and technology to challenge decisions and make informed trade-offs.
Develop strong technical leaders within the team.
Raise the technical and execution bar across the organization.
AI-First Engineering
Actively use AI tools and agents in your own work.
Introduce AI-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, QA, analytics, and operations.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work.
Use AI to increase engineering velocity and quality.
Build a team where AI becomes part of the engineering operating model.

We are looking for a high-impact Vice President of Engineering / Senior Engineering Director to lead strategic engineering initiatives across OKX’s core products. You will guide engineering leaders and teams working across multiple disciplines, helping them deliver secure, reliable, and scalable experiences for users worldwide.
This role will set technical direction, strengthen collaboration across engineering and product functions, and improve how teams plan, build, and operate critical systems. You will help ensure that architecture, execution, and operational priorities support the company’s product strategy and growth.
What You'll Be Doing
Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence
Engineering Alignment & Delivery: Improve coordination across engineering teams and functions, clarify ownership and decision-making, and help teams deliver product priorities with fewer bottlenecks.
Organizational Design & Scale: Continuously refine engineering workflows, team structures, and operating rhythms to support business growth, team autonomy, and cross-functional collaboration.
Talent & Leadership Development: Mentor, manage, and scale engineering managers and senior leaders; establish high standards for engineering craftsmanship, career growth, and technical accountability.
Technical Direction & Architecture
Technical Direction: Guide architecture and engineering decisions across complex product environments, ensuring teams balance scalability, security, performance, and user needs.
Engineering Standards & Reliability: Champion industry-leading engineering practices across software design, code health, automated testing, continuous deployment, and system observability.
System Resilience: Ensure systems maintain high availability, security posture, and resilience in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Product Partnership & Execution
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with Product Management, Design, Operations, and Security leaders to translate company strategy into clear, executable technical roadmaps.
Execution & Velocity: Establish clear milestones, identify and resolve execution risks, and implement metrics to maintain predictable, high-cadence product releases.

Executive Leadership Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multi-tiered engineering teams (50+ engineers) at the Director or VP level within high-scale product companies.
Technical Breadth: A strong background leading engineering in large-scale product environments, with the ability to engage with diverse technical disciplines, assess architectural trade-offs, and guide experienced engineering leaders.
Delivery Track Record: Demonstrated success driving complex, multi-team engineering programs to launch in fast-evolving, high-growth tech environments.
Domain Adaptability: Experience in high-availability, low-latency, or mission-critical domains (such as FinTech, SaaS, payments, consumer tech, or Web3).
Communication & Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build consensus across business, product, and deeply technical teams.

Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.text:
About Docker
Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.
_______________________________________________________________________
The Role
We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead the team behind existing and new products in the Docker portfolio, spanning our GUIs and the CLI. You'll manage the designers and raise the quality of what they ship, and you'll stay close enough to the work to build and critique it yourself, from the first prototype to the details of spacing, states, and copy.
You'll work alongside our principal designers, our Director of UX Research, design engineers, engineering leaders, and product leaders to turn technically complex systems into experiences that feel clear to the person using them.
You will report to the SVP of Design. This role is remote, with working hours that overlap US and Europe time zones.
_______________________________________________________________________
What you will do
Lead and grow the product design team.
Set the craft bar expected at each level and hold it through critique and your own work.
Partner with engineering and product from the start of a project, so design and engineering ship together.
Give designers ownership of important problems, with the context and trust to make good calls.
Shape how the team works with AI tools: human judgment leads, and the tools speed up the work.
Work with design engineering and the design system team so the shared system helps teams move faster without limiting new ideas.
_______________________________________________________________________
About you
You lead people:
You have led a product design team of comparable size through change, and you have grown designers from mid-level through senior and staff.
You have partnered closely with design engineers and engineering leaders, and you can engage with the technical decisions that shape the experience.
You state a clear point of view to engineering and product leaders and stay open to challenge and better ideas.
You build:
You still make things. You can prototype, critique a flow at the level of spacing, states, motion, and copy, and show us work from the last year. We will ask to see it.
You use AI tools in your daily work and can show how you use them, including when you step in because the output isn't good enough.
You have designed technically complex products and can turn underlying systems into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.
Bonus if you
Have led design for AI-powered or agent products, including experiences beyond a graphical interface.
Have designed for both developer-led adoption and complex enterprise customers.
Can prototype in front-end code, such as React or TypeScript.
Visa sponsorship: Not available for this role.
_______________________________________________________________________
Compensation & Equity
All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.
United States: $206,500 – $295,000 base
______________________________________________________________________
Posting Information
Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.
______________________________________________________________________
Perks & Benefits
Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.
Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.
Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.
Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.
Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.
#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Director, Product
jobs.company: Accelerated Digital Media - an OuterBox company
jobs.text:
Description
The Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings. This role defines how our products work together as one consolidated, scalable system, makes sure each one delivers clear value to the people it was built for, and turns the capability of our development team into products that set OuterBox apart. The Director leads the Product Managers, sets product priorities and standards in partnership with the Director of Technology, holds the team to effective execution, and reports on how well our products perform for the service organization and our clients.
Job Responsibilities:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Set the Product Vision: Define and own the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer, internal and external. Describe how our systems, applications, and AI work in concert, and keep that vision current as our services, our clients, and the technology change.
Own the Product Portfolio & Architecture: Keep the portfolio consolidated and coherent. Decide what we build, combine, retire, or buy so every product has a clear purpose, a defined user, and a place in the larger system. Partner with the Director of Technology so product architecture and technical architecture scale together.
Build Products for Our Delivery Teams: Direct the applications that help our staff deliver marketing services faster, more consistently, and more intelligently. Make sure each tool is designed around the people who use it and proves its value in their daily work.
Lead Direct-to-Market Products: Own product strategy for client-facing offerings such as LOOP Analytics and the products that follow. Identify market opportunities that grow out of our internal capability, shape them into offerings, and hold products that carry OuterBox's external reputation to the highest standard.
Lead the Product Management Team: Lead, coach, and develop the Product Managers. Set the operating cadence and hold a consistent standard of product thinking, user empathy, and design quality.
Turn Development Talent into Great Products: Give the development team clear direction, well-defined problems, and build-ready requirements. Own the PRD and acceptance-criteria standards, guide development and testing timelines, and keep the roadmap focused on the work with the most impact.
Drive Effective Execution: Direct the intake, feedback, prioritization, pilot, and rollout programs the Product Managers run. Set the criteria that move a product from pilot to production, and make sure what ships is adopted.
Measure & Report Product Effectiveness: Define the KPIs for each product and report on how well our products perform for the service organization, our clients, and the business. Translate adoption, usage, delivery improvement, and displaced-software-spend data into clear business impact.
Evaluate Emerging Technology: Track developments in AI, automation, and product practice. Run structured trials and recommend adoption or rejection with a clear rationale.
Additional duties, as assigned.
Requirements
6+ years in product management or product leadership, with 2+ years leading product managers or product teams.
A track record of setting product vision and strategy across a portfolio of related products, consolidating overlapping tools into a coherent, scalable platform, and taking new products to market.
Experience shipping both internal tools and external, client-facing software products, including AI, automation, and data-driven applications built in partnership with a development team.
Data orientation: able to define product KPIs, direct dashboards, and translate usage and adoption data into business impact.
Working knowledge of how digital marketing agencies deliver services
Fluency in product process, including PRDs and acceptance criteria, prioritization, and pilot and rollout programs, with credible participation in architecture and build decisions alongside technology leadership.
Hands-on experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or equivalent).
Strong product design and user-experience judgment, grounded in user research, feedback programs, and adoption measurement (interviews, NPS, surveys).
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, AI-accelerated environment, with working familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) and cloud-native platforms (Google Cloud Platform).
Benefits
Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.
Boxer Benefits
Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.
Health Insurance
401(k) & Retirement Savings
Generous Paid Time Off
Flexible Scheduling
Remote-First Culture
Professional Development
Employee Referral Program
And more!
Salary Description: $140,000 - $160,000
Our Company Values
Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.
At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.
Growth At OuterBox
We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.
Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.
Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.
Physical Demands
Primarily involves sitting at a desk and using a computer for extended periods of time.
Light physical activity is also required, such as carrying equipment or setting up for presentations.
Requires a high level of mental focus and the ability to work under pressure.
Good manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and the ability to use a computer for extended periods are required.
Utilizes required organization-provided tools, such as project management systems, artificial intelligence (AI) applications, reporting and analytics programs, and other business software, as directed by management in the regular course of business. Use of such tools ensures accuracy, accountability, and continuity across projects, supports collaboration among team members, and allows the organization to maintain visibility into work product and progress.
Work Authorization/Requirements
Must be located in the USA.
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.
Affirmative Action/EEO Statement
Our company is an equal-opportunity employer committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.
OuterBox may use AI-assisted tools to support the hiring process. Human review is involved in all employment decisions.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Product and Privacy
jobs.text:
At Podium, we build an AI Workforce that helps local businesses turn every conversation into revenue. More than 60,000 businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics trust Podium to drive growth 24/7, from capturing new leads to re-engaging past customers.
Two and a half years ago, we made a deliberate shift from building software for local businesses to building AI Employees that work for them. Every local business struggles to answer every call, lead, and follow-up. Our AI Operating System and AI Workforce fill that gap. We’ve crossed $150M in AI ARR, deployed more than 20,000 AI Employees, and helped customers generate over $13B in revenue.
Inc. Magazine named Podium the Best AI Implementation, OpenAI highlighted us for building AI Agents that drive revenue, and G2 ranked us the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations.
Podium is AI-native in every sense. We build AI for our customers, we build AI tools for ourselves, and we use AI in every role across the company.
We hire exceptional people, hold them to high standards, and give them room to make an impact. We look for people who are all-in on AI and eager to stay on the cutting edge, both in what we build for customers and in how they operate day to day. If you’re hungry for growth, aligned with our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won’t find a better place to accelerate your career.
Podium builds AI products that help local businesses engage customers, convert leads, book appointments, and manage customer relationships across Healthcare, Automotive, and Home Services. We are looking for an experienced product and privacy lawyer at the Director level to help shape how we build and deploy AI across our core verticals. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work directly with the teams building our products, own practical privacy and AI governance programs, and be a critical member of a small legal team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, significant ownership, and direct influence on product decisions.
What you will be doing:
Regularly meet with internal teams (e.g. Product, Engineering and AI teams) to understand strategies, roadmaps, and initiatives, and advise throughout the product lifecycle, from early design and development through launch, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
Provide legal advice and counsel on a variety of product compliance matters, including AI, privacy, data rights, intellectual property, and consumer protection, and structure, negotiate, and advise on transactions with AI providers, data partners, and integration partners, including product terms, data processing agreements, and business associate agreements.
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Security, and the rest of the Legal team to ensure our products and services comply with applicable regulations in existing markets and industries and also help guide our expansion, with particular focus on AI products in Healthcare, Automotive, and Home Services.
Provide legal and regulatory guidance on the design and modification of products, proactively identify associated risks and recommend mitigation strategies, review product user experiences to ensure legal compliance and proper disclosures, and help translate guidance into product requirements that the Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Legal teams can implement.
Advise legal and business/product organizations on privacy issues and practical privacy considerations, and own the development and implementation of scalable product, privacy, and AI review process, including impact assessments, launch criteria, playbooks, and escalation paths.
Identify applicable regulatory or legal privacy and AI risks associated with existing and new laws, conduct gap assessments, and advise on appropriate controls, risk mitigation options, and compliance strategies. Translate evolving requirements into prioritized product and operational changes.
Manage cross-functional privacy-related projects, including but not limited to data mapping, permitted data uses, retention and deletion, and tracking technologies.
Partner with Security on incident response and privacy aspects of compliance and diligence reviews.
Build and operationalize AI governance for customer-facing agents and internal AI use. Advise on data sourcing and rights for model fine tuning, evaluation, and improvement; third-party model terms; output ownership; and safeguards against inaccurate outputs.
Counsel on AI agents, including permissions, customer configurations, AI disclosures, human oversight and escalation, auditability, and the allocation of responsibility among Podium, model providers, integration partners, and customers.
Guide healthcare product development, including HIPAA privacy and security, BAA obligations, sensitive health data, and EMR integrations. Advise on access controls, and patient communications.
Advise on automotive and home services workflows, including, as applicable, Field Services Management or CRM and dealer management integrations, lead sourcing and re-engagement, appointment booking, service scheduling, and representations about pricing, financing, and services. Assess GLBA, FCRA, payments and other sector requirements where relevant to the feature and data involved.
Advise on voice, messaging, and marketing compliance, including TCPA, telemarketing and do-not-call rules, consent and opt-out design, call recording and transcription, and AI-generated voice. Review product claims and customer guidance so they accurately describe capabilities, limitations, and customer responsibilities.
Provide fintech and payments counseling on Podium Payments, including consumer disclosures, fraud and chargebacks, applicable financial services and payment network requirements. Partner with Product and Finance to allocate compliance responsibilities among Podium, customers, and financial partners.
What you should have:
J.D. with strong academic credentials and demonstrated record of success as a lawyer and member of local State Bar or eligible to register as Registered In-House Counsel.
8+ years of experience, including at least 5+ years of in-house experience, preferably at a high-growth technology company.
Experience counseling product teams on compliance with regulatory frameworks applicable to the U.S. and global telecommunications.
Experience counseling product teams on compliance with regulations in other industries and markets, such as Healthcare, Automotive, or Home Services, is also highly desirable.
Experience advising clients on risk mitigation across technology product platforms, particularly with respect to AI, payments and messaging/telecommunications technologies.
Required privacy certification, such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT.
Specific experience working with, and knowledge of, privacy laws applicable to businesses, such as CCPA, CPRA, GDPR, TCPA, as well as other U.S. state and federal privacy and data security and global data protection laws.
Capacity to think strategically to identify issues and develop long-term solutions.
Ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously and manage major projects to successful completion.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a strong customer-focused orientation.
Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and facilitation skills, as well as the ability to navigate within a corporate environment and work with a variety of stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools thoughtfully in legal work, verify their outputs, protect confidential information, and improve the speed and quality of legal counseling.
BENEFITS
Open and transparent culture
Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
Paid parental leave
Fertility benefits
Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends
Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits
401k Plan
Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel
A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered
Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees
Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.
