jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Tide Credit Services
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM
Tide Credit Services (TCS) puts credit in SMEs’ hands when they need it. We build Tide’s on demand lending products—including Credit Flex, Instant Loan, and Credit Score Insights—so members get fast, flexible funding inside the account they already run their business from.
We are scaling our flagship products globally across the UK, Europe, and India. This is high-velocity, high-impact work: you’ll architect and drive a fully automated, lightning-fast lending engine designed to deliver capital on demand, securely and seamlessly. Partnering with a brilliant and growing cross-functional team of 28 across engineering, product, design, data, and operations, you'll build a robust, scalable platform powering the future of SME credit.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering for Tide Credit Services (TCS, transactional credit), you’ll own the technology behind how Tide lends to SMEs. That covers Credit Flex, Instant Loan and the platform underneath them.
It’s a senior, hands-on leadership role with real say over architecture, engineering strategy and delivery. You’ll lead Engineering Managers and senior engineers, and set the bar for technical excellence.
As Head of Engineering you will:
Set the architectural direction for Tide’s credit platform: scalable, resilient, compliant, and built to launch in new markets quickly.
Lead the design and delivery of lending products that are fast, reliable and safe for members to use.
Work with Product, Risk, Compliance and the business to turn the credit roadmap into shipped outcomes.
Own integrations with third-party providers, including credit data, payments and funding partners, and make them seamless.
Stay close to the code. Get involved in architecture, design and the hard engineering calls.
Champion engineering fundamentals (system design, security, quality) and AI-native ways of working.
Mentor engineers and Engineering Managers, building a culture of ownership and learning.
Shape Tide’s wider technical strategy as we scale Tide Credit Services globally.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a highly technical, strategic engineering leader. Background in the credit domain (lending, credit decisioning, loan servicing or repayments) is preferable, and wider fintech experience is also valued. Neither is a prerequisite if you bring strong engineering leadership, breadth of technical knowledge and the ability to get up to speed fast.
10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
Deep experience designing and running microservices, event-driven and distributed systems that are scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant and loosely coupled.
Track record of embedding AI tooling and LLMs into how engineering teams build, review and ship, with measurable gains in velocity and quality.
Experience building in regulated environments, where compliance is a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
Experience launching and scaling products across multiple jurisdictions, with differing regulation, partners and customer needs.
Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one stack. Experience with ours isn’t essential, but the ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
Ability to translate business goals into a clear technical roadmap and explain the rationale behind technical decisions.
Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.
OUR TECH STACK
Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €91,600 to €114,500 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
Remote first
25 days of paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Private Health Insurance
Mental Health Support Platform
FitPass
Family and friendly leave (according to statutory)
Personal L&D budget
Share Options
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Technology - Enterprise Architecture - Senior Vice President
jobs.text:
Performance & Technology | Technology - Enterprise Architecture | Senior Vice President | London
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
Our Technology Advisory team provides independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and enhancing business performance. We leverage extensive expertise to deliver rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Defining and planning target architectures and roadmaps aligned to business objectives and plans including Data, Application/Integration and Technical/ Infrastructure architecture
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Platform/systems/infrastructure assessments, re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management, interim leadership roles, and project turnaround.
Central to our expertise is the technology strategy, organisation, applications and infrastructure which underpins any successful end-to-end transformation. We are looking for someone who has experience in Enterprise Architecture and how to define and design target state solutions, transition strategies and roadmaps, capability needs and the associated risks. This should ideally be coupled with prior consulting experience.
At AlixPartners, you will work closely with our clients to address strategic, operational, and technological challenges. Your skill in bridging the gap between technology and business will be crucial for delivering measurable results and driving business value.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need
Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Previous practical experience as an Enterprise Architect, with proven experience in designing enterprise-wide technology solutions working with business and technology teams
A good understanding of software delivery, infrastructure, operations and governance.
Experience conducting rapid digital diagnostics and maturity assessments to assess technological capabilities and identifying maturity gaps.
Ability to define pragmatic steps and roadmaps to drive business value.
Experience of architecting target states and complex solutions in a variety of environments, using different methodologies, frameworks, tools and software
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and remain up to date in the latest trends, tools and impacts of Technology on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisatio
The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.
The benefit type and level differ per location.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
Join the Revolution in Car Finance 🚗💥
At Carmoola, we’re changing the way people get on the road – making it faster, fairer, and entirely built around the customer. We’ve started with car finance, reimagining it from the ground up with a seamless, digital experience that puts drivers in control.
Since launch, we’ve raised over £540m from top-tier investors (including QED), helped over 31,000 customers get behind the wheel – and we’re scaling fast.
To take things to the next level, we're looking for a technical, AI-native Head of Data Science to build and deploy the models that let us lend faster, safely, at scale.
Your Mission
You'll take the reins on building and owning Carmoola's data science strategy – from designing and deploying the AI to assess risk across our application flow, to using Open Banking to provide frictionless, accurate affordability assessments. You'll have a huge amount of autonomy and responsibility from day one, and the opportunity to define what AI-native risk and affordability at Carmoola really means.
This is a high-impact role for someone who is as comfortable writing and shipping production code as presenting to leadership, thinks commercially about the cost of friction, and knows how to build something from scratch. You won't hand requirements to another team – you'll set the strategy, build the models and agents yourself, deploy them into live decisioning and prove their impact on real losses.
What You'll Be Doing
Own our risk prediction strategy - Set the direction across data science methods, data sources and platforms. Decide what we build versus buy, and balance loss prevention against friction for customers and dealers.
Lead delivery across the business - Own the data science roadmap. Shape requirements with Product and Engineering, work with Credit, Ops and Collections to make models fit how the business really runs, and keep delivery moving from idea to live impact.
Develop the models underneath - Build Gradient Boosting Machines to predict risk, Open Banking categorisation models, plus look for other uses of data science techniques to meet our goals.
Ship it to production - Own deployment end to end, from tested, version-controlled code and CI/CD to safe releases and live monitoring for drift and performance, with clear governance and human oversight wherever customers are affected.
Turn data into decisions - Deliver analytics and MI that show how your models are winning, and report against risk appetite to senior leadership and the board.

jobs.title: Director of Data Architect
jobs.text:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
Our Values
Best Life
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
Growth Mindset
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
One Team
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
What You’ll Do
Define and communicate ABC’s data architecture strategy, roadmap, and standards.
Lead the architectural evolution from batch and latency-driven processing toward real-time data.
Partner with executive, product, and engineering leaders to connect data architecture decisions to business and customer outcomes.
Identify practical opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity, data generation, quality, and decision-making.
Lead, coach, and develop a global team of four to five senior data architects.
Establish consistent design review practices across the Data and Reporting organization.
Guide architecture decisions related to data quality, governance, security, compliance, scalability, and reliability.
Partner with Product leaders early in the planning process to shape data and reporting capabilities.
Explain complex technical strategies clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Build alignment across teams and influence decisions beyond your direct reporting relationships.
What You’ll Need
10+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related discipline, including experience leading senior technical professionals.
Demonstrated experience moving data platforms from batch processing toward real-time or near-real-time architectures.
Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and lakehouse architecture.
Experience with AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog is highly valued.
Strong foundations in data modeling, data warehousing, data governance, and distributed data systems.
Working knowledge of SQL and Python sufficient to review designs and engage credibly with engineers.
Practical experience using AI in your own work, along with sound judgment about where AI creates meaningful value.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to make technical strategy clear to executive leaders and design decisions clear to engineers.
Demonstrated ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying solely on formal authority.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
And It’s Great to Have
Experience in fitness, wellness, SaaS, payments, or another subscription-based business.
Experience building customer-facing analytics or reporting products.
Experience with Databricks SQL, Power BI, or comparable analytics platforms.
Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
What Success Looks Like
ABC’s data architecture strategy is clear, credible, and supported by executive leadership.
The first real-time capabilities are live, with a practical roadmap for continued transformation.
Data and Reporting teams work against shared architecture, quality, governance, and design standards.
AI is embedded into the team’s everyday approach to building and improving data capabilities.
Product and engineering leaders involve the architecture team early in strategic decisions.
Your team is highly capable, well-developed, and trusted across the organization.
Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -
$173,000 - 198,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:
Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!
At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION:
ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com
About ABC Fitness
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Closing date: 23 November 2026
Salary scale: £71,595 - £90,000 per annum
Help Shape the Future of Britain's Railway
Rail Delivery Group (RDG) partners with Britain’s train operators to put customers at the heart of everything we do, delivering essential services and dedicated experts who keep the nation’s railway running efficiently.
From journey information, reservations and Railcards to improving performance, safety and accessibility, we drive the services and people that keep the railway moving. Anyone who has travelled by train or booked a journey for friends or family, will have used our services. We are integral to the running of the railway and play a crucial part at every stage of the customer journey – making sure we are delivering a better railway for all our customers, now and in the future.
As we embark on a new era for rail, we are now looking for a Head of Engineering to join us. If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to play a role in the future of Britain's railway, we'd love to hear from you!
What is the purpose of this job?
The post holder is accountable to the Director of Industry Operations and the Rolling Stock Strategy Director, DFTO.
The role:
· provides leadership to the RDG Engineering, ERTMS and Digital Systems Team
· works as part of the DFTO Rolling Stock team
· takes the lead on designing and establishing DFTO’s and GBR’s Fleet Engineering capability and structure.
In addition, the role acts as the Professional Head for RDG railway engineering support activities. The objective is to ensure effective centralised support for RDG, DFTO and industry partners and stakeholder businesses in support of their delivery of a safe, punctual and efficient railway.
This role will help to support the design of organisational rolling stock engineering capability ahead of the formation of Great British Railways (GBR).
What can I expect to do in this job?
1. To act as the Professional Head for the RDG engineering support activities.
2. To assist, advise, alert, advocate and act on behalf of the senior engineering community in GB rail.
3. Working as part of a matrix team between RDG Industry Operations and the DFTO Rolling Stock Strategy team, provide technical leadership and support to develop and promote RDG, DFTO and GBR policy for all Engineering matters, including GB Rail Interoperability, Safety, Standards, Performance, Digital Signalling & Communications, Rolling Stock Strategy & Related Supply Chain etc and to give support to GBR strategic initiatives in the same areas.
4. To influence the future strategic direction of technical leadership for the GB and European rail industry.
5. To ensure the efficient and cost-effective delivery of engineering support-related benefits to RDG/DFTO, GBR and industry partners and stakeholders.
6. To support the development and roll-out of digital signalling technology working closely with Network Rail, RoSCos and suppliers whilst ensuring operator views and experience shape and inform future plans.
7. To provide strategic direction and line management of the RDG Industry Operations Engineering and ERTMS & Digital Systems team and DFTO teams (where applicable) including, but not limited to, carrying out annual appraisals, objective setting and review, agreement of leave.
8. To act as the nominated partner in support of the senior Engineering leadership forum and other senior technical forums facilitated by RDG and DFTO.
9. To prepare and manage all elements of the RDG engineering budget and support DFTO budgeting arrangements as required.
10. To be accountable for the technical input and on-going development of the Railway Engineering Graduate Scheme (REGS) both today and in the context of wider GBR-related graduate/non-graduate engineering training programmes.
Who will my key contacts be?
Internal to the rail industry
· RDG & DFTO colleagues – exchanging information
· DFTO Rolling Stock Strategy Director
· Train Operator Engineering Directors
· GB passenger and freight operator and their trade associations executive and senior teams – exchanging information and networking
· Network Rail Senior Teams & Specialists – exchanging information and influencing
· Railway Safety and Standards Board (RSSB) Executives & senior personnel – exchanging information and influencing
· Rolling Stock Leasing Companies Executives and senior personnel – influencing
· Fleet & related supply chain MDs & Executives - influencing
· European TOC Personnel – influencing and exchanging information
· European Representative Bodies (CER and UIC) – influencing, negotiating and exchanging information
External to the rail industry
· Senior officials in government departments including the Department for Transport, Transport Scotland and Transport for Wales – influencing and exchanging information
· Office of Road and Rail Senior Personnel – influencing and exchanging information
· Rail Supply Group, Railway Industry Association, Rail Alliance and GB suppliers – networking
· Railway Consultancies – exchanging information
· Wider GB & European Suppliers - networking
· British Standards Institute, CEN/CENELEC, ISO/IEC Personnel – networking
· Professional Institutions - networking

jobs.title: Senior Director of Design, Search & Feeds
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
We’re looking for a Senior Director of Design to lead the experience strategy for Reddit’s Search & Feeds experiences. Reporting to our Head of Design, you’ll lead a design team shaping how people find relevant conversations, discover communities, and build connections to the topics they care about. Your impact will extend across Reddit, connecting discovery to the experiences that turn initial interest into ongoing participation.
This role combines product vision, design leadership, and a high bar for craft. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science across Reddit to make discovery more useful, intuitive, and distinctly Reddit driving growth and retention by helping people connect with communities that matter to them.
What you’ll do
Set the design vision for Search & Feeds. Define a cohesive experience strategy across search, feed experiences, recommendations, and community discovery, connecting near-term improvements to a longer-term vision.
Lead and develop the team. Coach design leaders and individual contributors, build clear ownership, and create an environment where people can do ambitious work and grow.
Shape product direction. Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and guide investment decisions grounded in user needs and business goals.
Raise the bar for quality. Drive thoughtful interaction design, clear information architecture, accessible experiences, and strong execution from early concepts through launch.
Make relevance understandable. Help people understand and influence what they see, bringing clarity and user control to ranking, personalization, and recommendations.
Design for different discovery needs. Support people seeking a specific answer, exploring a new interest, or returning to communities they already value.
Connect discovery to community health. Consider how search and feeds affect participation, conversation quality, and the communities that make Reddit valuable.
Establish how success is measured. Use research, experimentation, and behavioral data to evaluate usefulness, satisfaction, and the quality of discovery alongside engagement.
Influence across Reddit. Communicate a clear point of view, build alignment across teams, and contribute to the broader design organization’s standards and practices.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading design for complex consumer products at scale, with meaningful work in search, discovery, feeds, recommendations, or related experiences.
A track record of building and developing design teams, including managing managers and supporting individual contributors.
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and compelling experiences.
Deep expertise in interaction design and information architecture, with a portfolio demonstrating both design quality and measurable user impact.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Product, Research, and Data Science on experiences shaped by ranking and personalization systems.
The ability to balance user needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and the health of a broader product ecosystem.
Clear communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve competing priorities, and make decisions with incomplete information.
An appreciation for community-driven products and the different ways people seek information, participate, and build trust online.
Pay Transparency:
This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.
The base salary range for this position is:
$317,000—$443,800 USD
In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.
During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. blocks.text: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Design to lead the experience strategy for Reddit’s Search & Feeds experiences. Reporting to our Head of Design, you’ll lead a design team shaping how people find relevant conversations, discover communities, and build connections to the topics they care about. Your impact will extend across Reddit, connecting discovery to the experiences that turn initial interest into ongoing participation.

This role combines product vision, design leadership, and a high bar for craft. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science across Reddit to make discovery more useful, intuitive, and distinctly Reddit driving growth and retention by helping people connect with communities that matter to them.
What you’ll do

items: Set the design vision for Search & Feeds. Define a cohesive experience strategy across search, feed experiences, recommendations, and community discovery, connecting near-term improvements to a longer-term vision.
Lead and develop the team. Coach design leaders and individual contributors, build clear ownership, and create an environment where people can do ambitious work and grow.
Shape product direction. Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and guide investment decisions grounded in user needs and business goals.
Raise the bar for quality. Drive thoughtful interaction design, clear information architecture, accessible experiences, and strong execution from early concepts through launch.
Make relevance understandable. Help people understand and influence what they see, bringing clarity and user control to ranking, personalization, and recommendations.
Design for different discovery needs. Support people seeking a specific answer, exploring a new interest, or returning to communities they already value.
Connect discovery to community health. Consider how search and feeds affect participation, conversation quality, and the communities that make Reddit valuable.
Establish how success is measured. Use research, experimentation, and behavioral data to evaluate usefulness, satisfaction, and the quality of discovery alongside engagement.
Influence across Reddit. Communicate a clear point of view, build alignment across teams, and contribute to the broader design organization’s standards and practices.

blocks.text: What you’ll bring

items: Experience leading design for complex consumer products at scale, with meaningful work in search, discovery, feeds, recommendations, or related experiences.
A track record of building and developing design teams, including managing managers and supporting individual contributors.
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and compelling experiences.
Deep expertise in interaction design and information architecture, with a portfolio demonstrating both design quality and measurable user impact.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Product, Research, and Data Science on experiences shaped by ranking and personalization systems.
The ability to balance user needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and the health of a broader product ecosystem.
Clear communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve competing priorities, and make decisions with incomplete information.
An appreciation for community-driven products and the different ways people seek information, participate, and build trust online.

jobs.title: Director, Product-Media & Creative Activation
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
Who we are:
We create data products and technology that make advertising work better for people.
WPP Open is WPP’s intelligent marketing operating system, fuelling growth for the world’s most admired brands. Purpose-built for an era that demands a modern approach to data management, usage, and brand growth, we deliver modular products and interconnected capabilities across the marketing lifecycle.
Operating globally across WPP, we empower marketers and agencies to drive sustainable, data-enabled growth through connected technology and intelligent automation.
Who we are looking for:
As Director of Product Management – Media & Creative Activation & Optimization, you will lead a core capability area within Unified Activation in WPP Open, focused on executing and optimizing media and creative performance at scale.
This is a genuine product-building role. You will take activation and optimization problems from concept and rapid prototype through production, go-to-market, adoption, and measurable operational impact. You will have significant autonomy to shape product vision, roadmap, and priorities, working at pace to turn complex activation challenges into scalable, automated products.
This is a senior IC product leadership role. You own a capability area end-to-end — setting direction, managing the roadmap, and driving delivery across multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement.
You own campaign optimization across media and creative — from structured optimization (budget, bidding, targeting, DCO, in-flight creative performance across walled gardens and open platforms) to unstructured, agent-driven troubleshooting and optimization workflows. You also own the cross-product governance layer that keeps activation consistent from intake through live execution.
Unified Activation connects creative production, pre-launch quality assurance, campaign setup and activation, and cross-platform monitoring and optimization into one workspace from creative handoff to live campaign execution, with full governance and traceability across platforms.
Unified Activation Capabilities
This capability area spans the full path from creative handoff to live, optimized delivery covering creative readiness, campaign activation, campaign optimization for media and creative, and the governance that keeps work consistent across platforms.
Creative management. Creative briefs, schedules, and variants become activation-ready requirements. Assets are organized with quality metadata and status visibility. AI-assisted checks catch format, duration, safe-zone, and related issues before launch, while performance insights and quality signals inform creative decisions. The outcome is faster, more reliable creative handoff.
Campaign activation. Media plans become structured, launch-ready campaigns targeting, budgets, bidding, and naming rules included. Approved creative reaches buying environments with automated tagging, mapping, and pre-launch integrity checks. The outcome is scalable, faster activation with fewer broken paths.
Campaign optimization. Spanning media and creative. Algorithmic optimization uses ML models to optimize budgets, bids, and targeting parameters for cross-platform uplift while campaigns are live. Monitoring covers portfolio-level campaign health, delivery pacing, and KPI performance across platforms. Agentic optimization handles unstructured troubleshooting and optimization turning delivery signals into recommendations and governed actions when problems are open-ended rather than rule-bound. Dynamic Creative Optimization sits within this same area, measuring and improving how creative performs once live across walled gardens, buying platforms, ad servers, and other activation environments.
Cross-module governance. Shared taxonomies, advertiser and platform best-practice guardrails across intake, activation, and in-flight execution. Governed connectivity into major ad platforms using so access stays persistent, auditable, and free of direct token exposure.
What you'll be doing:
Own the product vision, strategy, and execution roadmap for Optimization & Governance within the Unified Activation platform in WPP Open.
Own campaign optimization across media and creative algorithmic ML optimization of budgets, bids, and targeting; portfolio-level monitoring of campaign health, delivery, and KPI performance; and agentic optimization for unstructured troubleshooting and open-ended performance improvement.
Own Dynamic Creative Optimization measuring, governing, and improving creative performance while campaigns are live across walled gardens, buying platforms, ad servers, and other activation environments.
Own governance for the capability area taxonomies, advertiser compliance rules, and best-practice guardrails across creative and media activation workflows, including in-flight execution.
Define and deliver agentic activation and optimization workflows that automate creative distribution, dynamic taxonomy generation & platform guardrails.
Partner with Product Ownership, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, resilient integrations across major media buying platforms, ad servers, and WPP Open services.
Translate complex business problems from WPP agencies and global brand clients into concrete product requirements, functional specifications, and prioritized backlogs.
Own direction and priorities across multidisciplinary delivery teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement.
Manage dependency and cross-functional alignment across WPP Open platform teams, ensuring cohesive delivery across governance, integration services, and shared data layers.
Partner with Support and Enablement teams to ensure capabilities are successfully launched, adopted, and embedded into agency workflows.
Establish clear success metrics, tracking product adoption, workflow time savings, error reduction, zero tracker leakage outcomes, and client performance / KPI-driven uplift across global markets.
What you'll need:
Essential
Deep expertise in at least one activation domain such as campaign activation, creative management, trafficking, optimization, or governance with the ability and appetite to broaden across the wider suite.
Evidence of building and operationalizing automation or product capabilities that solve real workflow or activation problems.
Evidence of taking solutions beyond concept or requirements into practical use, including driving adoption or measurable workflow improvement.
Hands-on experience using agentic and AI-assisted tools to prototype product concepts, explore technical systems, accelerate documentation, and communicate ideas.
Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement through influence rather than formal reporting lines.
Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex agency and client problems into clear product priorities.
Sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with engineering, architecture, and data teams and make informed product decisions.
Preferred
Formal product-management experience at Senior Product Manager or Director level.
Experience owning or delivering enterprise SaaS, AdTech, or MarTech products.
Experience managing or leading delivery across Engineering and Data Science teams.
Broader activation knowledge across creative, media, trafficking, governance, and campaign optimization including in-flight structured optimization, agentic troubleshooting, and dynamic / creative optimization workflows.
Experience with major advertising and activation platforms such as Google Ads, DV360, CM360, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, and relevant third-party activation technology (e.g. Grasp, Smartly, Concord, SKAI).
Experience developing ML/AI-driven optimization products, automated decision systems, or agentic workflows.
Technical experience with API-led integrations, relational data models, and SQL.
Experience working within agile product-delivery environments and frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, or Shape Up.
Day-to-day fluency with modern AI-assisted product workflows (e.g. rapid prototyping, codebase exploration, automated documentation).
Success Attributes
Strategic thinker: Capable of decomposing complex, fragmented media operations into unified, automated software products.
Builder mindset: Comfortable moving quickly from problem definition to prototype, production and adoption rather than stopping at strategy or requirements.
High autonomy: Able to establish direction, make informed product decisions and run with an area of ownership without requiring close management.
High ownership: Demonstrates resilience and operational discipline in managing cross-functional initiatives under shifting technical landscapes.
Natural collaborator: Builds strong partnerships across technical teams, agency practitioners, and executive leadership.
Curious and adaptable: Able to develop knowledge across the wider activation ecosystem as products, channels and technologies evolve.
Who you are:
You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?
#LI-Hybrid
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobs.title: AVP of Enterprise Architecture and Engineering Governance
jobs.text:
TJX Companies
At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.
Job Description:
What you’ll discover
Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities.
Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia, click here to learn more.
Challenging, collaborative, and team-based environment.
What you’ll do
The AVP of Enterprise Architecture (EA) and Engineering Governance leads a team of IT Architects and Engineers responsible for:
Guiding decision rights and establishing and optimizing the necessary processes, policies, and procedures to ensure successful execution of investment decisions aligned with the business strategy.
Offering implementation accelerators while driving quality within the platforms and portfolio teams.
This role focuses on EA process ownership, assurance to ensure compliance with agreed-upon viewpoints, principles, and standards – and promoting Engineering Quality principles and accelerators.
Key Responsibilities:
Own New Technology Assessment (NTA) process: Operationalize and Optimize how IT make risk-based investments decisions on technology (new technologies, renewal, new capabilities, expansions) in the shortest possible turnaround time.
Drive Application and Technology Portfolio Management Practice: Generate key insights from our tooling (e.g., LeanIX) and data to drive strategic management and ensure our functional and technical portfolios are rationalized, optimized, and enhancing overall IT performance.
Drive Adoption of Built-in Quality: Promote ways to increase adherence to Non-Functional requirements to reduce risks, increase compliance, and accelerate product maturity (e.g., NFR tools, Well-Architected Reviews).
Drive EA Assurance: Implement a formal process to review new and ongoing standards, ensuring compliance with defined guidance, policies, and principles.
Align EA Governance: Integrate EA governance with other IT and corporate governance processes to align strategy, investments, performance, resources, risk, and innovation.
Support Decision-Making: Democratize the EA governance process to support distributed and architecturally significant decisions at speed.
Lead Architecture Review Forums: Facilitate Architecture Review and decision forums to ensure coherent strategy execution.
Communicate and Reinforce Processes: Periodically communicate changes and reinforce processes within the IT organization to increase adherence.
Collaborate with Business of IT Solution Delivery: Work with the Business of IT solution delivery group to prioritize epics and features on EA tools to advance EA practice maturity, gather feedback on EA processes (e.g., NFRs), and optimize them (e.g., NTA due diligence groups)
Generate Insights: Analyze the global application and technology portfolio to inform senior leadership about trends and opportunities.
Assess EA Maturity: Evaluate overall EA maturity and identify continuous improvement opportunities to enhance the EA practice.
What you’ll need (Minimum Qualifications)
We seek creative, customer-focused individuals with technical expertise and a mindset for continuous improvement. We rethink how architecture delivers value by providing hands-on leadership and contributions while embracing agile principles.
Experience: 8-12 years of experience managing teams, experience in guiding teams in a product-oriented operating model.
Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of Cloud, Big Data, AI technologies, and their strategic application in business.
Leadership: Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor teams and enhance overall capabilities.
Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate the technical vision and strategy to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to build strong interpersonal relationships with teammates, leadership, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience working with technical teams, for example Product Development team and Infrastructure team.
Strong decision making and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications: Relevant certifications such as TOGAF or similar architectural frameworks, or ITIL.
Innovation: Demonstrated ability to leverage emerging technologies for business advantage.
Agile Mindset: Familiarity with SAFe or other Agile frameworks, and a strong belief in Lean-Agile principles.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically and align architectural plans with business goals.
Join us and Discover Different at TJX, click here to learn more.
As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.
Address:
73 Clarendon Road
Location:
EUR Home Office Watford GB

The AVP of Enterprise Architecture (EA) and Engineering Governance leads a team of IT Architects and Engineers responsible for:

items: Guiding decision rights and establishing and optimizing the necessary processes, policies, and procedures to ensure successful execution of investment decisions aligned with the business strategy.
Offering implementation accelerators while driving quality within the platforms and portfolio teams.

blocks.text: This role focuses on EA process ownership, assurance to ensure compliance with agreed-upon viewpoints, principles, and standards – and promoting Engineering Quality principles and accelerators.
Key Responsibilities:

items: Own New Technology Assessment (NTA) process: Operationalize and Optimize how IT make risk-based investments decisions on technology (new technologies, renewal, new capabilities, expansions) in the shortest possible turnaround time.

Drive Application and Technology Portfolio Management Practice: Generate key insights from our tooling (e.g., LeanIX) and data to drive strategic management and ensure our functional and technical portfolios are rationalized, optimized, and enhancing overall IT performance.

Drive Adoption of Built-in Quality: Promote ways to increase adherence to Non-Functional requirements to reduce risks, increase compliance, and accelerate product maturity (e.g., NFR tools, Well-Architected Reviews).
Drive EA Assurance: Implement a formal process to review new and ongoing standards, ensuring compliance with defined guidance, policies, and principles.
Align EA Governance: Integrate EA governance with other IT and corporate governance processes to align strategy, investments, performance, resources, risk, and innovation.
Support Decision-Making: Democratize the EA governance process to support distributed and architecturally significant decisions at speed.
Lead Architecture Review Forums: Facilitate Architecture Review and decision forums to ensure coherent strategy execution.
Communicate and Reinforce Processes: Periodically communicate changes and reinforce processes within the IT organization to increase adherence.

Collaborate with Business of IT Solution Delivery: Work with the Business of IT solution delivery group to prioritize epics and features on EA tools to advance EA practice maturity, gather feedback on EA processes (e.g., NFRs), and optimize them (e.g., NTA due diligence groups)
Generate Insights: Analyze the global application and technology portfolio to inform senior leadership about trends and opportunities.
Assess EA Maturity: Evaluate overall EA maturity and identify continuous improvement opportunities to enhance the EA practice.

Experience working with technical teams, for example Product Development team and Infrastructure team.
Strong decision making and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Community & Livestream
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX is building a vibrant in-app social community — spanning content, livestream, and creator ecosystems — that connects users, creators, and partners while driving trading engagement across the platform. You'll own the end-to-end Community & Live product, and contribute to north star goals including DAU, high quality creator ratio, and trading conversion within the community, underpinned by a robust safety & moderation stack.
What You’ll Be Doing
Community & Livesteam Product
Own the community and livestream product roadmap: content strategy, content curation, and content recommendation to improve discovery, engagement, and retention.
Drive user segmentation and interest discovery — build the frameworks and tooling to understand user cohorts and personalize content and community experiences at scale.
Define and improve community content quality standards; own the content/community ecosystem governance roadmap.
Creator & Fan Ecosystem
Build the creator and fan economy: creator incentive programs, tasks/missions, creator leveling systems, and tiered benefits that deepen streamer-fan and creator-fan relationships.
Build up creator lifecycle product capability, including discovery, engagement, onboard, grow, retain, and off-board phases.
Drive community's user education, product adoption, and trading conversion via innovative ways including internal advertising, fan economy mechanics, and trader leaderboards to achieve strong content- and trader-driven growth.
Community Monetization & Partnerships
Design and run community growth campaigns that convert community engagement into platform value (acquisition, activation, trading conversion).
Partner with marketing and growth teams to develop content strategies to capture and amplify opportunities from trendy events in the industry.
What We Look For In You
5+ years of experience as a product manager, with solid experience shipping social media, community, livestreaming, creator platforms, growth campaigns, or social products.
Hands-on with Trust & Safety or content moderation tooling.
Adequate understanding of the crypto industry, trading funnels, and risk/compliance constraints.
Able to think and communicate logically, data-sensitive, and able to accurately grasp customer mindsets; strong ability to identify and break down problems quickly.
Strong in execution, with good communication and project management skills; able to mobilize cross-functional resources to solve problems and deliver projects on time.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Founding Head of Engineering and AI of a Seed Stage Startup
jobs.text:
Founding Head of Engineering and AI
Total Life · Seed Stage · Equity Package · Full-Time · In Office (Vancouver) / Hybrid ok
About Total Life
Total Life is a national behavioral health telehealth platform built for adults later in life, the fastest-growing and most underserved population in American healthcare. We offer therapy in all 50 states plus Washington, DC, through a network of 200+ licensed clinicians. We have expanded into psychiatry, longevity, weight loss and cognitive care, and we bill Original Medicare Part B directly. We are in-network nationally with Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare and Humana, and with most Blue Cross Blue Shield and regional plans.
We are growing quickly. Total Life ranks in the top 10 of the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Canada) and #5 in healthcare on the Inc. 5000. We have also been named to the C100 and are a member of the AARP AgeTech Collaborative. We are now entering our next phase of hypergrowth, and we need a technical leader to build what comes next.
The Role
This is not a CTO role where you manage from a distance. We want a builder-leader who will write production code every week and also set the technical vision for the company. You will work directly with leadership, on the strategic roadmap. You will own the architecture, and you will build AI-first systems that change how older adults find, start and stay in care.
The role is high-profile, high-impact and hands-on. It suits someone who is all in, energized by an intense, fast-moving environment, and excited to build a category-defining company from the ground up.
What You'll Do
Build and ship. You will write, review and ship code across the stack. Over the past year we built our native systems, which gives us full control over patient engagement, agentic workflows and a multi-specialty care experience. You'll take that platform to its next level.
Lead AI-first product development. You will design and scale AI systems that run in real clinical and operational workflows. One example is Lily, our AI companion, which calls patients to schedule appointments, send medication reminders, run screenings and coach CBT exercises. You'll also build intelligent intake, automated eligibility and agentic back-office operations.
Co-own the strategic roadmap. You will partner with leadership turn company strategy into a technical roadmap. That includes build-vs-buy decisions, sequencing, platform bets and the long-term vision of Total Life as the infrastructure other behavioral health practices can run on.
Champion product design and customer experience. Our patients are older adults, and many are new to telehealth. You'll bring a sharp design eye to every patient, clinician and partner touchpoint, so that the product is simple, warm and accessible.
Engineer for growth and engagement. You will build the features and tools that drive acquisition, activation, retention and session completion. Examples include referral loops, partner dashboards, re-engagement flows, and in-platform experiences that keep patients connected to their care.
Integrate marketing technology. You will connect the platform to our growth engine, including attribution, CRM, messaging, conversion funnels and paid acquisition data, so that marketing and product run on one source of truth.
Own healthcare infrastructure. You will lead our work on payer and eligibility integrations (including CMS HETS 270/271), interoperability, senior-living integrations such as PointClickCare, and revenue cycle data flows.
Secure and scale the platform. You will keep HIPAA compliance, security, uptime and data integrity strong as our patient volume, states and service lines grow.
Build and lead the team. You will set the engineering culture, raise the bar for quality and speed, manage in-house and contract developers, and hire the team that will carry us through Series A and beyond.
To Apply
Send your resume along with a few sentences about something you've built that you're proud of, and why this role excites you. Links to GitHub, shipped products or portfolio work are encouraged.

jobs.title: Director, Geospatial & Data Analytics
jobs.text:
Scout Clean Energy is seeking a Director of Geospatial & Data Analytics to lead the company's geospatial and analytics capabilities in support of renewable energy development. This role will set strategy, establish standards, and build scalable capabilities that improve project decisions and advance Scout’s long term business objectives.
The Director will provide strategic leadership for the geospatial and analytical capabilities that support site selection, project development, engineering, and construction across Scout's renewable energy portfolio. This position will lead the expansion of the organization's capabilities through enterprise data systems workflow automation, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and support continued organizational growth.
The Director will partner closely with leaders across Development, Engineering, Resource Assessment, Environmental, Real Estate, Interconnection, Preconstruction, and Information Technology to identify opportunities where geospatial intelligence, data systems, automation, and analytics can improve project outcomes, enhance information accessibility, and create competitive advantages. This position will report to Scout’s Vice President of Technical Services and may be assigned other duties to support Scout’s growth as technical experts in renewable energy.
Primary Responsibilities
Renewable Energy Development
Provide strategic leadership for geospatial and analytical support of Scout's wind, solar and storage development activities.
Guide site selection, prospecting, and development risk assessment processes.
Support major investment decisions, acquisitions, due diligence efforts, and portfolio evaluations through data-driven analysis and decision-support tools.
Geospatial Intelligence & Business Enablement
Lead Scout's enterprise GIS, geospatial analytics, and spatial decision-support capabilities, advancing the vision, roadmap, and standards for geospatial intelligence across the organization.
Ensure geospatial insights effectively support prospecting, project development, engineering, and construction.
Oversee enterprise GIS architecture, geospatial data governance, applications, and analytical frameworks that support the full project lifecycle.
Drive innovation in geospatial technologies and analytical capabilities that create competitive advantages and improve project outcomes.
Data Systems & Information Management
Lead the development and governance of enterprise data systems, information management solutions, and digital platforms that improve the quality of business-critical information.
Oversee systems supporting geospatial data, engineering information, technical deliverables, project records, analytics, and organizational knowledge management.
Ensure effective integration and interoperability between GIS, engineering, project management, document management, and business intelligence platforms.
Establish data governance, architecture, and reporting standards that support long-term organizational growth and decision-making.
Automation, AI & Digital Transformation
Develop and execute strategies for automation, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation across development, engineering, preconstruction, and operational functions.
Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational capacity through workflow automation and AI-enabled solutions.
Partner with business leaders to redesign workflows and implement technologies that enhance quality, consistency, and productivity.
Establish governance, adoption, and performance measurement frameworks for emerging technologies and digital initiatives.
Strategy, Organizational Leadership & Growth
Define and execute the Geospatial & Data Analytics strategy, aligning team priorities, investments, and capabilities with Scout's business objectives.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Scale organizational capabilities through process improvement, automation, technology adoption, and strategic resource planning.
Establish performance metrics and communicate the business value and impact of the organization's work.
Resource & Technology Management
Manage budgets, technology investments, software platforms, data subscriptions, consultants, and strategic vendor relationships.
Develop resource and sourcing strategies that balance internal capabilities, external expertise, and technology solutions.
Ensure efficient delivery of services, allocation of resources, and continuous improvement of organizational processes and systems.
Leadership Expectations
As a Director at Scout Clean Energy, this role is expected to:
Establish vision and strategic direction for a critical business function.
Build organizational capabilities that scale with company growth.
Influence decisions across departments and leadership levels.
Drive operational excellence by aligning people, processes, systems, and technology to deliver reliable, scalable services across the organization.
Develop future leaders and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Maintain and advance Scout's position as a leader in renewable energy geospatial intelligence and GIS capabilities.
Translate emerging technologies and industry trends into practical business value.
Deliver measurable organizational outcomes through data-driven decision-making, automation, artificial intelligence, and innovation.
Lead the evolution of the Geospatial & Data Analytics organization into a broader center of excellence that establishes shared standards, scales proven solutions, and advances geospatial intelligence, data systems, analytics, automation, and digital solutions across Scout.
Serve as a strategic partner to executive leadership in defining how geospatial capabilities, data, and technology can accelerate Scout's long-term growth strategy.
