jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Early Childhood & Public Sector Solutions
jobs.text:
Mission Statement & Values:
Acelero, Inc. designs and delivers research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young children’s inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve. Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities.
Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young children's inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor all of the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve.
Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities.
Job Summary:
The Director of Product Management, Early Childhood & Public Sector is the product owner for Shine’s portfolio of solutions that help state, regional, and local government agencies strengthen early childhood systems. The portfolio includes infrastructure technology and AI-enabled solutions that support how public agencies organize information, coordinate services, make decisions, and improve outcomes for young children and families.
This role will turn promising solutions and project-based capabilities into clear, repeatable, and scalable products. The Director will own the product vision and roadmap for the portfolio, make product-level technical architecture, support build, buy, and partner decisions, manage development priorities and the backlog, and establish a transparent prioritization process. The role must balance a reusable product core with the distinct policy, workflow, data, and implementation needs of each public-sector customer.
This position will work closely with Public Systems sales and business unit leaders, early childhood subject matter experts, customers, technology and data partners, and external development teams. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, customer discovery skills, and commercial orientation, and is comfortable moving between product strategy and hands-on execution.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Product strategy and productization: Define the product vision, value proposition, target users, core capabilities, and roadmap for the Public Systems portfolio. Convert existing tools, prototypes, and delivery approaches into well-defined products with repeatable functionality, implementation models, documentation, and support requirements.
Roadmap, backlog, and prioritization: Own the portfolio roadmap and development backlog from discovery through release. Establish a disciplined, transparent process for evaluating and sequencing work based on customer value, commercial opportunity, strategic fit, technical risk, effort, scalability, and expected impact. Support establishing and applying consistent product development practices across the product team.
Technical architecture and platform decisions: Partner with IT and engineering to define requirements for architectural selection, ensuring alignment with enterprise security, API, and platform standards.Lead product-level architecture decisions, including platform approach, data model, integrations and APIs, configurable versus custom capabilities, and build, buy, or partner choices. Partner with IT, engineering, data, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are maintainable, interoperable, secure, accessible, and scalable.
AI product development: Translate high-value customer problems into responsible AI-enabled capabilities. Define requirements for human oversight, data use, transparency, quality, privacy, and ongoing performance monitoring, in alignment with organizational governance and applicable public-sector requirements.
Customer discovery and market insight: Build a continuous understanding of state, regional, and local agency needs through partnership with sales and implementation teams, workflow observation, and market research. Distinguish broadly shared needs from customer-specific requests and use those insights to shape the roadmap.
Commercial partnership: Work with Sales and Marketing to define product positioning, packaging, pricing inputs, demonstrations, and sales enablement. Support qualification and solution design for priority opportunities by assessing product fit, technical feasibility, implementation implications, and the path from an initial customer need to a scalable offering. Collaborate with Finance on pricing and discount strategy.
Prototyping and pre-sale validation: Conduct rapid prototyping, proof-of-concept development, and user testing when needed to validate demand, demonstrate value, reduce technical uncertainty, or support priority commercial opportunities before full development.
Product delivery and lifecycle ownership: Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint and release planning, quality expectations, launch readiness, release communication, and post-launch learning. Maintain clear decision records, documentation, and visibility into dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs.
Customer configuration and scalability: Define product guardrails and configuration patterns that address meaningful differences in customer policies, workflows, data environments, and operating models while limiting unsustainable one-off development. Identify when a customer request should become a core capability, configurable option, professional service, partner integration, or out-of-scope item.
Cross-functional implementation partnership: Partner with Public Systems delivery and implementation teams early in the sales and product lifecycle to ensure solutions are feasible, deployable, and supported. Create strong handoffs and feedback loops among Sales, Product, Customer Success, and technical partners.
Measurement and continuous improvement: Define product success measures, including adoption, usability, customer outcomes, reliability, implementation time, and reuse across customers. Define product unit economics, target gross margins, cost to serve, and commercial performance in alignment with Finance. Use evidence to improve the product and recommend investment, expansion, consolidation, or retirement decisions.
Vendor and partner management: Serve as the primary product counterpart to external engineering teams, technology vendors, and specialized partners. In partnership with Finance and IT, evaluate, select, and manage third-party development vendors within approved budget limits. Establish clear requirements, milestones, quality standards, governance, and accountability for delivery and ongoing maintenance.
Contribute to Acelero, Inc. community of practice by:
Cross-functional influence: Create alignment among senior leaders and teams with different priorities by making customer evidence, business rationale, technical constraints, and product tradeoffs explicit.
Operating discipline: Establish practical product management routines, tools, and decision rights that improve focus, speed, accountability, and transparency across the Public Systems product lifecycle.
Community of practice: Demonstrate leadership aligned with the company mission, core values, and commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging; communicate priorities and progress effectively; and promote shared purpose and collaboration.
Job Specifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to carry out each essential duty in a satisfactory manner. The job specifications listed are representative of the education and experience, the physical requirements, as well as the knowledge, skill and/or ability (KSAs) that are generally necessary for the role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Job Requirements & Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Product experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, product ownership, or technical product leadership, including ownership of complex digital products from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.
Hands-on product execution: Strong command of product discovery, roadmap development, backlog management, requirements and acceptance criteria, agile delivery, release planning, and product analytics. This is a “builder” role with nascent products and requires hands-on execution vs. managing a large team.
AI and data products: Experience developing AI-enabled, analytics, workflow, or decision-support products is strongly preferred, including familiarity with responsible AI, public sector regulatory compliance, enterprise data governance, privacy, transparency, and human-centered design.
Technical fluency: Demonstrated ability to make or lead product-level technical decisions involving software architecture, data models, APIs and integrations, cloud platforms, security and privacy, and vendor technology. The role does not require day-to-day software engineering, but it does require the ability to engage deeply with technical teams and evaluate trade-offs.
Customer and commercial orientation: Demonstrated success translating customer problems and market opportunities into products that customers adopt and fund. Experience supporting complex enterprise or public-sector sales, solution design, pilots, and commercialization is preferred.
Public systems context: Experience with government, govtech, edtech, health and human services, or another regulated and data-intensive environment is strongly preferred. Knowledge of early childhood systems, public benefits, education, or human services is a significant plus.
Leadership: Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed and lean environment, navigate ambiguity, make clear recommendations, and move effectively between strategic decisions and detailed product work. People management experience is helpful but not required.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate among customer, policy, business, design, delivery, and technical audiences and to communicate decisions and tradeoffs with clarity.
Additional Requirements:
Physical exam and background checks are required for this position.
Travel required locally or long-distance up to 20% of the time for work-related meetings and functions.
Must have a valid driver’s license and/or reliable transportation.
Physical Requirements:
Ability to sit most of the time with some bending and reaching.
Ability to stand, walk, and bend periodically.
Ability to engage in repetitive movement of wrists, hands, and fingers – typing and/or writing.
Ability to work frequently at close visual range (i.e. preparing and analyzing data and figures, accounting, transcription, computer terminal, extensive reading).
Ability to receive and respond to oral communication.
Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects.
Work Environment:
Work is generally performed in a remote environment.
Standard office equipment generally used includes:
Smartphone/Telephone
Personal Computer (monitor, keyboard, and mouse), Laptop, or Tablet
May be required to operate a motor vehicle during the course of duties.
When, Where, and How Much
When: Fall/Winter 2026
Where: Remote (25% Travel)
How Much: $110k-$140k/yr
Why You’ll Love Working With Us
At Shine Early Learning, our mission is bold: to eliminate the gap between children’s inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve.
As part of the Strategy & Growth team, you’ll help build the systems and infrastructure that make mission-aligned growth possible. Your work will directly support leaders making decisions that expand access, strengthen partnerships, and increase impact for children and families nationwide.
Robust benefits that support your total wellbeing, including:
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance with multiple plan options to fit your needs
Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions up to $800 annually
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care expenses
401(k) Retirement Plan with up to 4% company match and immediate vesting
Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance
Up to $500 per year in Professional Development Reimbursements
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling and mental wellness support
Wellness Programs, including virtual fitness, nutrition, and mindfulness classes
Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, ID Theft Protection, and Employee Discount Perks
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and healthy workplace.
We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and healthy workplace.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.
We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!
What we’re looking for
We’re seeking a Head of Product to join our Product team and own the full product vision across our growing AI platform, spanning accounts receivable, accounts payable, and analytics.

This role is available to candidates eligible to work in New York or Toronto, hybrid.
What you’ll do
Own the product roadmap across AR, AP, and analytics: understanding how these products intersect and where the gaps create friction for customers and engineering.
Manage and grow a team of product managers and product designers, overseeing product design scope across the organisation.
Work closely with PMs to sharpen PRDs and bring technical rigour to requirements, acting as the bridge between product and engineering when needed.
Define and own the future product vision for Alternative Payments, synthesising market signals, customer insight, and company strategy into a coherent roadmap.
Implement AI thoughtfully across the product organization, not just for workflow efficiency, but as a genuine product capability that creates value for partners.
Propose and establish best practices for how the product team operates: discovery, prioritization, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
What you’ll bring
10+ years of product experience, with meaningful time in financial technology (payments, lending, or money movement) or a vertical SaaS company with large payments revenue contribution.
Proven experience managing product managers and designers across a multi-product portfolio.
Technical enough to read a system design doc, challenge an engineering estimate, and help PMs write PRDs that engineering teams trust.
Fluency with AI as a product capability: you can articulate how you’ve implemented AI in a product org, not just team tooling, but as a product surface.
Conceptual depth with AI technology: familiarity with embeddings, RAG, and agent-based architectures at a level that earns engineering credibility.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to write clean strategy docs and run tight leadership reviews.
Nice to have
Experience managing design across an organization (product design + marketing design + sales collateral).
Prior experience transitioning product ownership from a founder — navigating that trust-building and handover process.
Track record of raising the technical floor in a PM team through coaching, process changes, or targeted hiring.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where the roadmap evolves quickly.
What We Offer
Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.
Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.
Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.
Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.
Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.
Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.
Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.
Want to see what we're actually building?
We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
Description
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.
We are seeking a VP of Product to lead our entire product & engineering organisation. This is one of the most expansive and demanding product leadership roles you will find in the market: the person in this role will own PM, Engineering, Design, Data, and PMM under a single umbrella — a scope typically reserved for C-suite executives at much larger companies.
The organisation you will lead includes 1 Director of Product, 8 PMs, 1 Director of UX & Design, 3 Designers, 1 Director of Data & Analytics, 6 data analysts, 1 data engineer, 1 Lead PMM, 1 VP of Engineering, and 30+ Engineers & QAs across two product tracks- Core Track and AI Clinic Track.
We have already shipped multiple AI initiatives:
AI Scribe that helps clinicians save time on writing progress notes
Chart Review AI that highlights deviations from clinical protocols
Agentic AI Receptionist that owns internal support processes
The role reports directly to the CEO.
We expect the person in this role to bring rare, genuine depth across product strategy, behavioural design, applied AI, data-driven decision making, and people leadership - and to operate effectively at both the executive and hands-on levels simultaneously.
Responsibilities
Define, refine, and execute the long-term AI-first product vision and strategy for MEDvidi
Lead, coach, and manage the full product & engineering organisation across both product tracks
Set and maintain a high bar for product quality and execution speed across all teams
Facilitate quarterly strategy and OKR planning at the executive level
Resolve cross-functional blockers and identify opportunities through direct day-to-day engagement with teams
Continuously improve product & engineering culture and processes
Collaborate with other department heads and the CEO on company-level initiatives
Requirements
10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple product teams
Experience leading cross-functional organisations that include design, data, and/or engineering - not just PM
Strong product sense: proven track record of both growing existing products and building new ones from 0 to 1
Hands-on experience building AI-first products, including practical knowledge of RAG systems, Agentic AI, and AI Evals
Ability to build an AI product prototype independently, without involving engineering
Experience with behavioural design - building product experiences that drive user behaviour, not just ship features
Executive-level communication skills: ability to bring clarity to complex, uncertain situations
Experience driving company-level strategy and quarterly OKR planning
Data-driven mindset: ability to diagnose issues with data using a segment → root cause → fix approach
Structured problem solving using issue trees, hypothesis trees, or equivalent frameworks
Culture fit: ownership, focus, radical transparency, evidence-based decisions
Advanced English (C1+) and fluent Russian
What we offer
High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
Time off: 22 paid vacation days annually, 5 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.
Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.
MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Product Team Leader, Lung Cancer
jobs.text:
Job Title: Vice President, Global Product Team Leader, Lung Cancer
Job Location: Remote (US)
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
Accountable for the asset strategy from proof of concept through global product launch and lifecycle management (LCM), in alignment with disease area and portfolio strategy. Lead the Global Product Team (GPT), a cross-functional team responsible for establishing, driving, and executing a global strategy for a single asset across its entire life cycle — from early clinical development to late-stage pivotal studies, then through commercial launch and market access, and finally into post-marketing commitments, asset growth and patent expiration.
Essential Function of the Job:
Lead the molecule integrated strategy throughout the product lifecycle to maximize value for BeOne Medicines and for the healthcare ecosystem.
Build and lead a high-performing Global Product Team, advocating for appropriate resourcing and ensuring line of sight across all relevant functions to deliver on the program vision and strategy.
Acts at an enterprise level to advocate for the asset in alignment with business priorities.
Ensures cross functional strategic input is embedded in the clinical development plans and regulatory strategy including trial design, endpoints, appropriate comparators, Target Product Profile (TPP) and regulatory pathway, to ensure commercial success and global market access.
Acts as a role model and ambassador for both internal and external stakeholder engagement in strategy development, communicating the science story and differentiation of the molecule.
Collaborates with GPT to development and delivery of the product Target Product Profile (TPP) in collaboration with the GPT (Global Product Team) and key internal stakeholders.
Leads integrated product development and commercialization plans which are aligned with business objectives and are differentiated from competition.
Communicates the development strategy at governance meetings to secure funding and endorsement of the strategy.
Holds self and team accountable for delivery of governance-approved business cases in collaboration with the global commercial franchise leader and functional management for alignment.
Effectively manages, mitigates risk, and then communicates risk and presents potential strategies to mitigate risk to senior leadership.
Works collaboratively with global and regional commercial teams to generate, evaluate, and deliver robust commercial strategies and plans. Defines the range of LCM investment options/business cases and makes recommendations on investment, to maximize the value of the Brand’s portfolio.
Provides leadership support of the multidisciplinary sub-teams whose work ladders up to the GPT and supports the product strategy.
Partners with Global Program Manager assigned to GPT to translate goals and strategy into actionable plans which deliver business value. Execute plans within established guard-rails, proactively managing risks and issues. Drive team effectiveness and alignment with program governance processes.
Responsible for maintaining high team effectiveness through collaboration, influence, coaching and mentoring of cross-functional team members.
Partners with other GPTs in developing disease area or franchise-wide strategies and maximizing synergies with BeOne assets.
Partners with Investor Relations and Corporate Communications to develop and actively manage the external messages for the analyst community in collaboration with clinical development lead.
Collaborates with Business Development and other relevant functions in discussions with external partners to maximize lifecycle opportunities.
Ensures appropriate Governance and Compliance and protects BeOne's Rights, Data, and Intellectual Property
Other Qualifications/Requirements:
Proven ability to demonstrate a flexible leadership style and communication to work effectively in a global, cross-functional matrix organization. Ability to work effectively in diverse cultures,
Demonstrated clinical research expertise in Oncology with a preference for direct expertise in Lung Cancer disease.
Experience in drug development and global commercialization across the product lifecycle.
Business acumen - understands unmet market needs; development of product strategies, provides clear path to win; demonstrated track record in driving innovation through to the global commercialization of assets.
Enterprise thinker with ability to sense the system and problem solve.
Demonstrated record of accomplishment engaging senior leadership, driving business outcomes in multi-disciplinary teams
Demonstrated ability to take decisions that positively impact the business.
Strategic and Decisive Leader - leadership skills that demonstrate energy, passion, courage, vision and demonstrated competence in thinking strategically, analytically, and innovatively. Able to analyze and provide solutions to complex challenges quickly and creatively. Proven experience as a successful decisive leader in a strategic multifunctional environment.
Experience with global, regulatory submissions and interacting with major health authorities; NDA (New Drug Application) and/or BLA (Biologics License Application) submission experience strongly desired.
Ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels of the organization.
Education/Experience Required:
Advanced degree /10+ years in drug development, product strategy & global commercialization, leading cross-functional teams
Global Competencies
When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.
Fosters Teamwork
Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
Self-Awareness
Acts Inclusively
Demonstrates Initiative
Entrepreneurial Mindset
Continuous Learning
Embraces Change
Results-Oriented
Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
Financial Excellence
Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $312,000.00 - $402,000.00 annually
BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, and any other applicable federal, state or local laws, applicants who require reasonable accommodation in the job application process may contact .

Please apply via Lifelancer platform to get connected to the application page and to find similar roles.

Acts as a role model and ambassador for both internal and external stakeholder engagement in strategy development, communicating the science story and differentiation of the molecule.
Collaborates with GPT to development and delivery of the product Target Product Profile (TPP) in collaboration with the GPT (Global Product Team) and key internal stakeholders.
Leads integrated product development and commercialization plans which are aligned with business objectives and are differentiated from competition.
Communicates the development strategy at governance meetings to secure funding and endorsement of the strategy.
Holds self and team accountable for delivery of governance-approved business cases in collaboration with the global commercial franchise leader and functional management for alignment.
Effectively manages, mitigates risk, and then communicates risk and presents potential strategies to mitigate risk to senior leadership.

Works collaboratively with global and regional commercial teams to generate, evaluate, and deliver robust commercial strategies and plans. Defines the range of LCM investment options/business cases and makes recommendations on investment, to maximize the value of the Brand’s portfolio.
Provides leadership support of the multidisciplinary sub-teams whose work ladders up to the GPT and supports the product strategy.

Partners with Global Program Manager assigned to GPT to translate goals and strategy into actionable plans which deliver business value. Execute plans within established guard-rails, proactively managing risks and issues. Drive team effectiveness and alignment with program governance processes.
Responsible for maintaining high team effectiveness through collaboration, influence, coaching and mentoring of cross-functional team members.
Partners with other GPTs in developing disease area or franchise-wide strategies and maximizing synergies with BeOne assets.
Partners with Investor Relations and Corporate Communications to develop and actively manage the external messages for the analyst community in collaboration with clinical development lead.
Collaborates with Business Development and other relevant functions in discussions with external partners to maximize lifecycle opportunities.
Ensures appropriate Governance and Compliance and protects BeOne's Rights, Data, and Intellectual Property

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About us
We are Valis - a company building an institutional AI operating layer for mid-market companies: shared company memory, workflow mining and agentic automation.
Why this role exists
We are hiring a CTO-level engineering leader. We need a strong person, able to own a major part of the technology from architecture through production, build their own team, and speak with clients at C-suite level.
What you will do
Platform architecture and engineering
- Own the architecture of the org brain and personal brain: data ingestion, knowledge storage, retrieval, agents, and integrations with Claude and other LLMs.
- Write code yourself where it matters most. This is a hands-on role, not only a management one.
- Design access control so each user sees only data from their own area. You will also own data retention and deletion, GDPR compliance, and multi-tenancy.
- Build MCP servers and connectors to company systems (Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, HRIS, DWH, ERP), and bring them to the point where clients can use them self-service.
Deployments
- Lead complex technical conversations
- Own the technical side of deployments
- Turn what works for one client into a product, so the same custom work is not repeated.
- Be the final technical escalation point for your area.
Infrastructure, data and cost
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Cloudflare), CI/CD, observability and security.
- The data stack: data warehouse (Redshift, MotherDuck/DuckDB), ETL, and large-scale migrations.
- Platform costs: token and inference spend, subscriptions, and vendor negotiations.
Team
- Hire people, develop them, and let them go when needed. Hire people stronger than yourself.
- Build an engineering culture where the team owns outcomes and needs little day-to-day management.
- Use AI agents such as Claude Code as your main working tool, and make them the team's main tool too, not an experiment.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Observability
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Every outcome on the Elastic platform starts with data getting in. Streams, Elastic’s telemetry pipeline, is the shared ingest layer for Observability, Security, and Search. It collects data from any source, processes and routes it, and stores it in Elasticsearch or the customer’s own object storage, all built on open standards like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. As Director of Product Management, you will own Streams end to end and lead the PM team behind it. Your job is to make Elastic the easiest platform to bring data to, for every solution and every customer.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the strategy and roadmap for data collection, ingestion, processing and routing, and the integrations framework.
Define and track KPIs focused on product and feature adoption
Partner with Observability, Security, and Search product leaders to provide a shared service everyone can leverage
Make getting data ingestion self-service, with time-to-first-data measured in minutes.
Lead a team of distributed product managers and enable them to deliver measurable outcomes.
Drive roadmap priorities by working with customers, internal teams, and the community
Work with engineers and designers to scope and define compelling features
Enable sales, marketing, and partners with clear messaging and positioning
What You Bring
10+ years in product management, including 4+ years leading PM teams in data infrastructure, observability, or data pipelines.
Deep technical fluency in telemetry ingest: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, log processing, routing, and agent management.
Experience shipping SaaS products with usage-based pricing, and building platform capabilities shared by several product lines.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with the Elastic Stack is a plus
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.
The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€130.900—€207.100 EUR

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Every outcome on the Elastic platform starts with data getting in. Streams, Elastic’s telemetry pipeline, is the shared ingest layer for Observability, Security, and Search. It collects data from any source, processes and routes it, and stores it in Elasticsearch or the customer’s own object storage, all built on open standards like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Outbound (Remote, US)
jobs.text:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role
The Senior Director of Product Management, Outbound translates Lumen’s product strategy into market-ready offerings that scale revenue, improve adoption, and differentiate Lumen in the enterprise and wholesale markets. This leader owns the outbound motion for a portfolio of network, cloud connectivity, and digital platform services, ensuring products are clearly positioned, launch-ready, and operationally executable for Sales, Partners, and Customers.
This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and commercial outcomes. You will work backward from customer and market requirements, shape portfolio direction with Product Management and Engineering, and drive alignment across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Operations, and Partners.
Effectiveness in this role requires strong product instincts, commercial judgment, and executive presence paired with the ability to operate in a complex, scaled enterprise environment. This role ensures Lumen doesn’t just build great products but wins in the market by bringing clarity, focus, and commercial intensity to how our offerings reach customers and sellers. It is a critical lever in turning strategy into long-term growth.
Location
This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.
The Main Responsibilities
Own the Outbound Product Strategy
Define and lead the outbound product strategy for assigned domains, from positioning through launch and lifecycle optimization.
Translate product capabilities into clear value propositions, differentiated messaging, and market‑ready offers.
Create and maintain product launch frameworks, including target segments, pricing logic, packaging, sales plays, and success metrics.
Drive Go‑to‑Market Execution
Lead multifunctional launch teams to bring new products and features to market quickly, with quality and discipline.
Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Marketing to ensure readiness across training, tools, content, and field execution.
Develop and sustain strategic sales motions, including executive selling scenarios, competitive strategy, and customer proof points.
Shape the Product Roadmap from the Market Back
Represent market, customer, and revenue insights concerning Product Management and Engineering planning cycles.
Size customer and market opportunities and develop business cases that target roadmap investments based on growth, profitability, and strategic fit.
Manage short‑term revenue opportunities with long‑term platform and portfolio evolution.
Operate as a Cross‑Functional Leader
Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Partners to ensure offers are technically sound, operationally viable, and financially solid.
Build alignment at the executive level by communicating tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Anticipate and resolve issues that could impair launch success, customer experience, or commercial performance.
Measure, Learn, and Optimize
Define success metrics for launches and ongoing performance such as adoption, attach, churn, margin, and revenue.
Use market data, customer feedback, and performance analytics to improve positioning, packaging, and sales execution.
Continuously improve how Lumen brings products to market—simplifying where possible, innovating where needed.
Leadership Scope
Senior leadership role with significant influence across Product, GTM, and Sales.
High visibility with executive stakeholders.
Expected to mentor and develop product leaders and outbound talent.
What We Look For in a Candidate
10+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or go‑to‑market leadership roles.
Demonstrated success launching and scaling complex technology products in B2B or enterprise environments.
Strong experience working with Sales organizations on commercialization, enablement, and revenue acceleration.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders through data, judgment, and clear storytelling.
Strategic thinker who can also execute with immediacy and carefulness.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills—equally effective with operators, sellers, and executives.
Highly analytical, with the ability to turn insight into action.
Comfortable operating amid ambiguity while driving clarity for others.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with network services, cloud connectivity, digital platforms, or infrastructure‑enabled services.
Familiarity with enterprise buying motions, multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, and partner ecosystems.
Experience developing pricing, packaging, and offer constructs at scale.
Compensation
This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As the Director of Dedicated Infrastructure Engineering & Platforms, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for GitLab Dedicated, GitLab's premium single-tenant SaaS offering for enterprise customers in regulated industries, and public sector.
You will lead a high-performing organization of managers and engineers who own the entire lifecycle of dedicated and cellular platforms, from orchestration, integrations, resilience, and incident response to switchboard APIs, public sector compliance, and enterprise customer migrations. Your mission is to scale GitLab Dedicated from its current trajectory toward an aggressive growth target, ensuring enterprise customers experience full platform capabilities with dedicated infrastructure, compliance certifications, and enterprise-grade SLAs in an isolated environment.
As a high-impact executive leader, you will define the strategy for single-tenant and public sector SaaS platforms, drive critical infrastructure investments, ensure FedRAMP/compliance operational readiness, and build the switchboard and migration capabilities that allow enterprise customers to seamlessly transition to and scale on Dedicated. You will succeed by cultivating a culture of operational excellence, closing key business and roadmap gaps, and leading distributed engineering teams to deliver high-availability, highly secure platform experiences.
What you'll do
Own the strategy and roadmap for GitLab Dedicated, and ensure the platform scales with customer growth and converges with GitLab's cellular architecture.
Partner with Product and executive leadership to deliver on growth targets, with a focus on platform reliability, faster customer onboarding, infrastructure cost efficiency, and self-service administration.
Lead the engineering teams that build and run the platform: tenant orchestration and integrations, resilience and incident response, the Switchboard control plane, public sector platforms and compliance, and enterprise migrations and import tooling. Uphold enterprise-grade SLAs across every tenant.
Deliver GitLab Dedicated for Government: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP operations and audit readiness, air-gapped isolation, and public sector feature delivery.
Make enterprise migrations to Dedicated predictable, repeatable, and low-disruption through self-service tooling and guided workflows.
Hire, coach, and scale engineering managers across distributed teams, and bring practical AI-enabled workflows into how the organization works.
Partner with Product, Security, and Customer Support to keep customer commitments, architecture, and investments aligned.
Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
What you'll bring
You have led engineering organizations that run enterprise single or multi tenant SaaS infrastructure and cloud platforms at scale.
You have measurably improved production reliability, reduced toil, or lowered infrastructure cost on a platform you owned.
You have deep expertise in cloud-native and cellular architectures, Infrastructure as Code, and modular services that deploy and scale independently across cloud environments.
You have delivered and operated enterprise offerings under strict compliance regimes such as FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud.
You have led organizational changes, including adopting AI enabled workflows that raise engineering system efficiencies.
You translate financial targets into engineering investments, headcount plans, and execution roadmaps.
You lead with ownership, speed with quality, and a focus on customer outcomes.
About the team
The Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms organization builds and runs GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant enterprise SaaS offering, for GitLab's most strategic enterprise and public sector accounts. It is organized into five focus areas:
Platform Orchestration & Integrations: orchestration, deployment, and environment automation for Dedicated tenants and cellular environments, plus integrations with external products.
Core Features, Resilience & Response: compliance and operations driven features, disaster recovery, automated failover, rate limiting, and incident response automation.
Switchboard & Control Plane: the APIs, tenant change automation, and operator and customer interfaces that make Dedicated self-service.
Public Sector Platforms & Compliance: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP compliance operations, air-gapped isolation, and Geo replication for GitLab Dedicated for Government.
Enterprise Migrations & Import Tooling: customer migration programs and playbooks, Geo-based migration tooling, Direct Transfer, and self-service guided import workflows.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Data & Artificial Intelligence)
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Product Management (Data & AI) is responsible for defining, driving, and delivering Fortrea's enterprise Data & AI product strategy, product portfolio, and multi-year product roadmap. This role serves as the senior product leader for Data & AI, accountable for ensuring that enterprise data products, analytics products, AI solutions, and emerging digital capabilities align with Fortrea's strategic objectives and long-term technology vision. The position owns the end-to-end product lifecycle, including product vision, roadmap development, investment prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.
The Senior Director, Product Management will lead a team of Product Managers and work closely with Engineering, Data, AI, Enterprise Architecture, Business Stakeholders, Program Management, Security, and Operations teams to ensure products are delivered successfully and produce measurable business outcomes. As a member of the Data & AI leadership team, this role is accountable for translating Fortrea's three-year Data & AI strategy into an executable and measurable product portfolio that delivers enterprise value, operational efficiency, innovation, and competitive advantage.
Summary of Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision
Develop and maintain the enterprise Data & AI product strategy aligned to Fortrea's business objectives and three-year technology roadmap.
Establish a clear product vision for enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging digital capabilities.
Define and maintain multi-year product roadmaps that balance business priorities, technical investments, innovation opportunities, and organizational capacity.
Partner with executive stakeholders to identify future product opportunities and strategic business needs.
Translate enterprise strategy into actionable product objectives, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Drive product innovation and identify opportunities to maximize the value of enterprise data and AI investments.
Data & AI Product Portfolio Leadership
Own the enterprise Data & AI product portfolio, including product lifecycle management, prioritization, governance, and performance management.
Establish portfolio management processes supporting product intake, evaluation, funding, prioritization, and roadmap planning.
Ensure alignment and integration across data, analytics, AI, reporting, governance, and platform-related products.
Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic product investments.
Define product success metrics and value realization frameworks across the portfolio.
Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and optimize investment decisions based on business outcomes and strategic priorities.
Product Delivery & Execution
Own successful delivery of enterprise data and AI products from concept through deployment and ongoing enhancement.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, and Program Management leaders to ensure successful delivery of product roadmaps.
Drive prioritization of product backlogs and delivery plans to maximize business value.
Remove obstacles impacting product execution and serve as an escalation point for strategic product issues.
Ensure products are delivered within approved scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations.
Oversee adoption, usage, performance, and ongoing evolution of deployed products.
Establish product governance and operating models supporting sustainable delivery and continuous improvement.
Business Partnership & Value Realization
Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Data & AI delivery teams.
Establish strong relationships with functional leaders to understand business objectives, challenges, and opportunities.
Ensure product investments align with measurable business outcomes and enterprise priorities.
Develop business cases supporting product investments and strategic initiatives.
Lead value realization reviews to demonstrate business impact and return on investment.
Drive customer-centric and business-driven product development practices.
People Leadership
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers, Product Owners, and product leadership professionals.
Establish the product management operating model and organizational structure for the Data & AI organization.
Provide coaching, mentoring, performance management, and career development opportunities for team members.
Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational capability development.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Develop product management capabilities and best practices across the broader Data & AI organization.
Financial & Investment Management
Develop and manage Data & AI product investment plans and strategic funding priorities.
Partner with Finance and Technology leadership on annual budget planning and investment governance.
Evaluate product investment opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk, cost, and strategic alignment.
Support build-versus-buy decisions and product investment recommendations.
Monitor product portfolio investment performance and value realization.
Ensure effective stewardship of product-related technology investments.
Stakeholder & Executive Leadership
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership regarding Data & AI product strategy, performance, and future investments.
Prepare and deliver executive-level product roadmaps, business reviews, investment recommendations, and performance updates.
Lead product governance forums, roadmap reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
Communicate product strategy and business value across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, Program Management, and Technology leaders to ensure alignment across all product initiatives.
Qualifications (Minimum Required):
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience and successful project outcomes in lieu of educational requirements.
Experience (Minimum Required):
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in Product Management, Technology Leadership, Data & Analytics, Digital Products, or related disciplines.
7+ years of experience leading enterprise product portfolios, product organizations, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated success developing and delivering multi-year product strategies and roadmaps.
Experience managing enterprise technology, data, analytics, or AI-related products.
Proven people leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, developing, and leading Product Managers.
Experience managing investment portfolios, business cases, budgeting, and strategic planning activities.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
Preferred Qualifications Include:
Master's Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline.
Experience leading Data, Analytics, AI, Machine Learning, Digital, or Platform Product organizations.
Familiarity with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, AI platforms, and enterprise analytics environments.
Experience operating within life sciences, healthcare, CRO, or other regulated industries.
Product Management certifications or Agile Product Management experience preferred.
Physical Demands / Work Environment:
Office/Home-Based:
Work Environment:
Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.
Physical Requirements:
Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
Light to moderate lifting and carrying, or moving of objects, including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
Regular and consistent attendance.
Varied hours may be required.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
StrideUp is leading a new era of values-driven finance. Ranked the 5th fastest growing fintech in the UK and Ireland in 2025, we have already deployed hundreds of millions in property finance, supporting people in achieving their financial goals.
What makes us different is how we combine purpose with performance. We began with home finance, creating an alternative trusted by the Muslim community and welcomed by anyone seeking fairer, more transparent products. This product-market fit has powered our growth, and is only the beginning. Our vision is bigger; to expand our offering and build a financial institution that opens doors for communities often left behind.
Joining StrideUp means being part of a high-performing, values-driven team at the most exciting point in our journey. We have proven success behind us and huge opportunity ahead, and now we are ready to build beyond. Are you?
StrideUp is backed by leading VC and private equity investors, having raised over £40m in corporate funding, and over £600m in institutional funding lines.
The Role
We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead StrideUp’s engineering function as we enter our next phase of growth. You will be our most senior technology leader, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the Executive Committee (ExCo).
This is a technical leadership role. You will lead and coach our engineers, own technical strategy, and stay close to the detail: architecture and design, engineering standards and best practices, tooling choices and code review. Above all, you will treat technology as a tool for solving business problems, keeping the team focused on what moves the business forward.
You will also own IT, cyber and information security, and represent technology to stakeholders including investors and regulators. These responsibilities may be reallocated over time as we scale.
You will champion smarter use of AI and automation to raise quality and speed, rather than simply adding headcount, and work closely with our Product Manager and Product Team.
What You'll Do
Engineering Ownership
Own platform architecture and strategic technical decisions, including build vs buy and technical debt
Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing and QA, CI/CD and incident management
Review code and designs, and choose the tools, patterns and best practices the team works to
Team Leadership
Line manage and coach our engineers, with regular 1:1s, clear objectives and a visible path for growth
Set the team structure and operating model, and lead hiring and retention as we scale
Develop future technical leaders, so the function does not depend on one person
Business Alignment & Delivery
Start with the business problem, and work with the CEO and Product Manager to turn commercial objectives into deliverable plans
Own the budget and annual OKRs, and deliver predictably so technology drives growth
Champion AI, automation and agentic tooling where they clearly raise quality and speed
Technology, Security & Risk
Own IT infrastructure, workplace technology, cybersecurity and information security, including vendors
Own technology risk, working with Compliance & Risk to meet regulatory obligations
ExCo Leadership
Sit on ExCo and contribute to company-wide strategy beyond technology
Explain technical decisions in plain language, linked to commercial outcomes
Be the senior voice on technology with senior stakeholders including investors, funders, auditors and regulators, including technical due diligence for fundraising
You Are
An exceptional engineer: you set a high technical bar through architecture, design, tooling choices and code review
A leader and coach who develops engineers and gets the best out of them
Commercially minded: you start with the business problem and treat engineering as the tool to solve it
An ExCo-level operator who can present ideas and explain trade-offs without jargon
Pragmatic and accountable: you make sound decisions under uncertainty, own outcomes and never compromise on security or compliance
Open to challenge and feedback, and comfortable building structure in a scale-up

jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
We are hiring a CTO for one of our UK software businesses: an established company with a long track record and a leading share of its market.
The business has deep customer loyalty and a hard technology problem. It runs a large, mission-critical on-premises estate and is developing a new cloud platform, and it now has the backing to rebuild for the next 20 years. This CTO will lead that rebuild.
This role has two modes. With the established team running the existing products, you lead through managers and team leads; daily production coding is not expected, but you must be able to review architecture and step in to steer major incidents. In the small, elite squad rebuilding the platform, you will be more hands-on.
You will own all technology in the business: product engineering, QA, DevOps and cloud, data, and infrastructure.
ABOUT TAG SOFTWARE GROUP:
TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.
Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.
Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology and helping your business reach the next level.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Run and stabilize the current estate
Lead a production team of 20+ engineers, testers, product and platform staff.
Set priorities, delivery cadence and metrics: velocity, quality, release predictability, cost per product line.
Keep a mission-critical on-premises estate secure, supported and compliant.
Run clear programme governance: every initiative has an owner, plan, budget and honest monthly reporting to the MD.
Own reliability: incident response, postmortems and support escalation, building a team that handles incidents without you.
Build the next-generation platform with a lean, AI-first team
Build a small, senior, AI-native engineering team using AI-assisted development.
Rebuild the core product as a best-in-class cloud platform that aims to be number one in the UK market.
Work hands-on inside the new-platform squad: set the architecture, write and review code if needed, and set the engineering standard.
Make AI development tools part of every engineer's daily work, across both the legacy and new teams.
Lead the move from on premises to cloud
Own the migration strategy for a large installed customer base, including sequencing, integration and data migration.
Keep NHS integrations, accreditations and clinical-safety obligations intact throughout.
Consolidate hosting and infrastructure and reduce the hardware and network footprint our customers carry.
Technical environment
On-premises platform: Mainly C++ , C# and Java; .NET Framework; Microsoft SQL Server; Windows Server; installed at each customer site
Cloud platform: multi-tenant SaaS on Microsoft Azure; C#, ASP.NET Core, React; Kubernetes (AKS); PostgreSQL,
Hardware: company-supplied terminals, handheld scanners and printers; dispensing-robot integrations; NHS HSCN network connectivity; field engineering and workshop

Run and stabilize the current estate

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
Atria is a membership-based preventive health care practice delivering cutting-edge primary and specialty care in New York, South Florida, Los Angeles (2026), and through 24/7 telemedicine globally.
Our multi-specialty team of 60+ top in-house physicians provides proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. We aim to optimize lifespan and healthspan through meticulous screening, leading-edge therapeutics, and tailored interventions designed to prevent disease and detect it at the earliest possible stages.
Each member's care is led by a dedicated Chief Medical Officer who collaborates with specialists in cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, women's health, endocrinology, integrative health, performance and movement, nutrition, and more.
Through our nonprofit Atria Research Institute and Public Health Institute, we also work to accelerate the translation of medical breakthroughs and expand access to preventive care for as many people as possible.
About this role:
You will lead Product Engineering, the three teams that build everything our members, clinicians and care teams use:
Member Experience: registration, the member portal and the mobile app
Clinical Experience: the patient dashboard, results and clinical AI
Care Delivery: scheduling, the care calendar and clinician task management
The role is hands-on: you will work fluently in the AI-assisted workflows our engineers use every day to generate, review, and deploy code.
Tech Stack
Languages: TypeScript
Backend: Node, Express
Frontend: React, Honeypot SDK
Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform
Database: MySQL (migrating to Postgres)
Tooling & Integrations: Github, Sentry, Okta, Mixpanel, Omni, third-party APIs
Key Responsibilities
Product & Delivery
Lead the Member Experience, Clinical Experience and Care Delivery squads, and own their delivery: plans, priorities and predictable shipping at a high quality bar.
Work with Product, Design and clinical leaders to turn unclear problems into clear technical plans and roadmaps.
Drive system design for the core product areas that keep the platform reliable, HIPAA-compliant, and speed up future work.
Stay hands-on: write, review and ship code using the AI-assisted workflows the team uses every day.
Quality, Observability & Analytics
Set testing and code-review standards across Product Engineering, including how AI-generated code is reviewed and governed.
Make sure features ship with consistent observability (Mixpanel, Datadog, Sentry)
Run post-incident reviews and follow through on the fixes they turn up.
Teamwork, Mentorship & Culture
Hire, coach and manage the performance of engineers and tech leads in NYC and on the distributed team.
Set and uphold engineering standards: coding conventions, architecture patterns and documentation.
Build a practical, product-focused culture that balances high standards with fast, iterative delivery.

jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
About the role
We are currently hiring a Field CTO to join our Strategic Field Organization at a Principal Solutions Architect level to be based in Australia or Singapore. This role reports into our Global Head, Field CTOs. The Strategic Field Organization is a team of Principal Solutions Architects that supports global strategic prospects and customers. This team collaborates with the regional account teams to work together on large engagements that require a high degree of strategic planning - such as DevSecOps transformation, solution recommendations, and advisory for our customer's senior technical leadership.
Field Solutions Architects (SA) are the trusted advisors to GitLab prospects and customers during the presales motion. We demonstrate how the GitLab platform and GitLab Professional Services address common and unique business requirements. Our Solution Architect team adds value to GitLab's customers by providing subject matter expertise and industry experience throughout the sales process and collaborating internally with the product.
Our Field SA's also engage proactively with existing GitLab customers to provide thought-leadership, engage in innovative solutions, collaborate around evangelism activities around unique customer requirements (i.e. meetups and presentations) and continuously seek market feedback to improve the GitLab platform.
What you'll do
Create and maintain relationships with customer executives that contribute to large Net ARR deals and customer success
Provide executive-level, thought leadership on strategic opportunities (i.e., new logo and growth)
Curate and manage field feedback, while collaborating with the product team on roadmap and issue prioritization
Scale and grow regional-level expertise within the field (SAE/AE,SA,CSM) through contributions to enablement and content
Act as a prospect / customer advocate on DevSecOps transformation initiatives
Build and maintain select subject matter expertise related to GitLab targeted technology sectors through industry monitoring and participation in external working groups, committees and development projects
Keep up to date on GitLab-relevant emerging methodologies and technologies and leverage that knowledge to drive solution strategy and influence product strategy
What you'll bring
Significant experience as a CTO/ Principal Solution Architect with architecture of enterprise software development workflow
Experience delivering information/Cyber Security and compliance related solutions and assessments
Experience with software development tools, practices, and methodologies
Strong verbal and written skills with a strong ability to articulate and communicate strategies to all levels in an organization (i.e., executive to staff engineer)
Ability and willingness to learn and use GitLab as an integral part of the role
Ability to travel and comply with the company’s travel policy

Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave
Home office support
