jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
VP, Product
Role Overview
Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.
We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.
Platform Ownership & Impact
ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.
The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.
ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Roadmap
Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.
Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.
Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.
Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.
Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building
Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.
Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).
Governance, Prioritization & Intake
Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.
Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).
Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.
Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.
Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.
Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.
Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.
Client & Partner Orientation
Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.
Ensure ARM Suite produces standardized, credible artifacts for sales, planning, and renewal motions rather than bespoke, one-off deliverables.
Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Required Experience
10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership (Director, Sr. Director, or VP) at a SaaS, agency-tech, ad-tech, mar-tech, or analytics platform company.
Demonstrated experience owning a B2B platform or product line end-to-end — vision, roadmap, prioritization, governance, and stakeholder management.
Track record of leading internal product ownership through transitions away from third-party engineering vendors, contractors, or outsourced build partners.
Experience operating in environments that combine internal teams with external engineering partners, with a clear philosophy on what should be owned in-house vs. outsourced.
Deep, hands-on capability with API-driven product design — including standing up API pipelines, integrating third-party data sources for user-facing enrichment, and shipping products built on APIs from scratch.
Preferred Experience
Prior experience in media, advertising, agency, ad-tech, or mar-tech environments, with an understanding of planning, buying, measurement, and client reporting.
Familiarity with order management, finance/billing connectivity, and workflow tools that span multiple internal stakeholders.
Broad working knowledge of APIs across the advertising, media, and ad-tech ecosystem (e.g., DSPs, programmatic platforms, measurement and attribution partners, audio and CTV systems), with a track record of using them to extend product capability.
Comfort working closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Science functions; able to engage substantively on data models, BI tooling, and measurement frameworks without owning them.
Experience standing up product governance, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes in organizations transitioning from ad hoc to durable operating models.
Personal Attributes
Strong communicator and executive-level storyteller; can move comfortably between vendor architecture reviews, leadership strategy discussions, and client-facing conversations.
Pragmatic and business-oriented, with an appreciation for balancing ideal product strategy with real-world commercial and operational constraints.
High ownership mindset; comfortable being the only product leader in the room and building the function from the ground up.
Collaborative, curious, and motivated by building durable systems that compound the value of every team they touch.
Ad Results Media is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe strong product organizations are built at the intersection of operational excellence, business judgment, and a deep understanding of how teams and clients actually work.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
About DemandBridge
DemandBridge builds the ERP and e-commerce software that print, promotional products, and marketing-services distributors run their businesses on, from order entry and inventory to procurement and online storefronts. Hundreds of distributors across North America rely on our platform to serve their clients faster, keep costs under control, and grow.
DemandBridge is part of Fluent Software Group (a Valsoft Corporation operating group), a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. We focus on specialized industries where expertise creates lasting advantages.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to take our team through its most important chapter in years: building our next-generation ERP. This is a player-coach role — you'll manage and develop the team, raise the bar on how we build and ship software, and still get into the code and architecture yourself. You'll work hand-in-hand with a newly strengthened Product team to turn the roadmap into reliable, predictable delivery.
Location: Canada or US (remote)
The salary range for this role is $170,000 CAD– $200,000 CAD per year. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.
What You'll Own
Lead and Grow the Team
Manage, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and consistent feedback
Assess the current team's strengths and gaps, and make recommendations on hiring, development, and structure
Hire and onboard engineers, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
Build the Next-Generation ERP
Set technical direction and lead architecture decisions for the new ERP, including finalizing the technology stack (Java-based direction)
Stay hands-on: code reviews, design, prototyping, and contributing directly to critical components
Balance modernization with supporting existing product lines and current customers, and manage technical debt proactively
Raise the Bar on Engineering Practices and Delivery
Own the software development lifecycle: a shared sprint cadence, daily standups, retrospectives, and release schedules across all teams
Shorten and stabilize release cycles by strengthening automated testing, CI/CD, and Engineering's ownership of release quality
Set clear standards for code review, testing, and observability
Drive team adoption of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent)
Partner with Product
Engage early in epic kickoffs and discovery to provide sizing estimates and technical feasibility input
Own engineering capacity planning by quarter and sprint so roadmap commitments are realistic — and met
Communicate trade-offs, risks, and progress clearly to Product, Support, and leadership
Own Infrastructure, Reliability, and Compliance
Oversee IT/Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering alongside the software engineering team
Own production incidents and the on-call model, and act as the escalation point for outages and critical issues
Own the PCI compliance process end to end, from controls and audits through remediation
Own Azure cost optimization: track spend, right-size environments, and hold the team accountable for cloud costs
Keep the legacy platform (Linux, Perl, Spring Boot, Oracle, SQL) stable and secure while the next-generation ERP is built
What We're Looking For
8+ years in software development, including 3+ years managing engineering teams
Strong hands-on Java experience (back-end, enterprise applications) and genuine comfort still working in the code
Experience building or modernizing an ERP or complex transactional B2B systems (order management, inventory, accounting)
A track record of implementing agile practices, CI/CD, and test automation that made releases faster and more reliable
Strong relational database design and performance optimization skills
The ability to assess talent, give direct feedback, and make tough people decisions
Hands-on experience with Azure (AWS or GCP also considered), including managing and optimizing cloud spend
Experience building or leading a QA function and a test automation strategy
Experience owning production operations: on-call rotations, incident management, and Site Reliability Engineering practices
Experience with PCI DSS compliance, or a comparable security and compliance framework, in a production environment
Comfort supporting and modernizing legacy systems, including Linux, Perl, Spring Boot, Oracle, and SQL
Active, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into business impact
Strongly Preferred
Experience in distribution or supply chain software, or in the print and promotional products industry
Experience in an acquisitive, growth-stage vertical software business
Experience managing teams distributed across Canada and the U.S.
Join Us
Your next big build starts here. Join us to lead the team behind DemandBridge’s next-generation ERP.
We use AI-powered tools (including transcription and automated note-taking) during portions of our interview process to support a consistent and thorough candidate experience. Candidates who require alternative accommodation may request it at any stage of the recruitment process.
Fluent Software Group is committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and all qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.
#DemandBridge

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering & Analytics
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Relation Insurance is a leading, innovative company with a strong commitment to excellence and a passion for delivering cutting-edge solutions to our clients. As a key player in the insurance market, we pride ourselves on our dynamic culture, collaborative environment, and continuous drive for success. With a rich history and a bright future ahead, we are looking for exceptional individuals to join our team and contribute to our ongoing growth and success.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics leads the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continuous improvement of Relation’s enterprise data engineering and analytics capabilities. The individual in this role owns the data platform and analytics function end to end, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and trusted data solutions that support business priorities and measurable outcomes. The Director provides hands-on technical leadership, advances the responsible use of automation and proprietary AI, and leads and develops data engineering and analytics professionals.
The Director partners with executive, business, and technology leaders to translate priorities into a practical data roadmap and drive execution. The individual in this role establishes standards for data architecture, integration, quality, governance, security, reporting, and analytics while remaining sufficiently hands-on to guide complex technical work, resolve issues, and clearly communicate data, tradeoffs, and risk to non-technical stakeholders.
A GLIMPSE INTO YOUR DAY
Ownership and Accountability
Owns Relation’s data engineering and analytics function end to end, with full responsibility and accountability for execution and outcomes.
Translates business priorities, as set by executive and business leadership, into the data and analytics roadmap, sequences the work within those priorities, and drives it to completion, owning the outcome regardless of team size.
Serves as the primary point of contact and accountable authority for executives, business leaders, auditors, and carrier partners on data, reporting, and analytics matters.
Provides executive-ready reporting on platform health, delivery progress, data quality, and data risk, and walks executives through the numbers in plain language.
Partners with IT, Information Security, Finance, Operations, and business leadership to obtain source access, implement controls, and drive adoption, while retaining accountability for data interpretation and outcomes.
Personally designs, builds, and maintains production data pipelines from core brokerage and enterprise systems.
Owns data processes end to end: understanding the business need, profiling source data, modeling, transforming, validating, delivering, and supporting the result in production.
Writes production-quality SQL, Python, and PySpark as a regular part of the job; troubleshoots failed loads, data discrepancies, and performance issues down to the root cause.
Builds and maintains curated, reusable datasets and data models for core domains (e.g., Client, Policy, Submission, Carrier, Producer, Revenue, Commission).
Defines and standardizes KPI logic and Power BI semantic models (e.g., premium, revenue, retention, hit ratio, pipeline, cross-sell, service metrics) so the business works from one version of the truth.
Builds and delivers executive dashboards and self-service reporting, and works directly with business stakeholders to drive adoption.
Makes practical architecture decisions for the lakehouse platform (medallion bronze/silver/gold layers, ELT patterns, orchestration) with a focus on reliability, simplicity, and cost.
Directs AI coding agents as the function’s primary delivery capacity: decomposes initiatives into well-specified tasks, delegates implementation, testing, documentation, and source-data analysis to agents, reviews the output, and ships the result.
Builds AI-driven validation into every data process, including automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, and agent-based review of code and outputs, while remaining personally accountable for the accuracy of anything AI produces.
Sets and enforces the standards for secure, effective use of AI, and coaches any team members on working AI-first, including keeping sensitive client and employee data within approved tools and environments, maintaining human review of AI output before it reaches production or the business, and partnering with Information Security on AI governance.
Identifies and delivers opportunities to apply AI and automation to manual reporting, reconciliation, and data-entry work across the business.
Builds and operates production LLM-powered data workflows, such as document and data extraction from carrier and client documents, classification, and automated validation, with the same engineering rigor as any other pipeline.
Keeps the platform AI-maintainable: well-structured, documented, tested, and reproducible, so that any pipeline or report can be understood, modified, and recovered by an agent or another engineer without tribal knowledge.
Continuously evaluates new AI capabilities and adopts the ones that measurably improve speed, quality, or coverage. Leads, coaches, and develops data engineering and analytics professionals through hands-on work alongside the team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, technical standards, and opportunities for career growth. Reviews code and data models, whether produced by team members or AI agents, pairs on difficult problems, and raises the technical bar through practical coaching.
Manages intake of data requests, aligns prioritization with business leadership, sets realistic timelines, and keeps business partners informed.
Establishes lightweight engineering standards: Git-based workflows in GitHub, pull request review, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), testing, documentation, and production support, and applies them equally to the team’s work and to the output of AI agents.
Sets clear goals, provides ongoing feedback and performance management, and supports succession and development planning.
Defines and enforces data quality controls, testing, monitoring, and incident response (data SLAs).
Maintains practical governance: documentation, data definitions, lineage, and certified datasets, and supplies the data-flow and system inventory that Information Security relies on for enterprise data mapping.
Ensures access controls and privacy-by-design for sensitive data (client PII, financial data), including retention and auditability aligned to company risk/compliance standards.
Performs other projects, duties, and tasks, as assigned.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data architecture, data analytics or related technology roles.
Demonstrated ability to operate as the accountable owner of a data platform or analytics function, delivering outcomes against priorities set by the business.
Previous leadership experience, including responsibility for leading and developing technical teams, people leaders, projects, or complex cross-functional initiatives.
Currently hands-on: writes production SQL, Python, and PySpark as a regular part of the job, not only reviews it.
Demonstrated track record of owning data processes end to end and delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, daily, hands-on use of AI across the full engineering lifecycle, including agentic coding tools, LLM APIs, and automated validation, with concrete examples of delegating substantial multi-step work to AI agents, catching their mistakes, and owning the result.
Expertise in:
­ Data modeling (dimensional + operational/normalized patterns), MDM concepts, and entity resolution across systems and acquired agencies
SQL, Python, and Spark (PySpark)
Lakehouse and medallion architecture, ELT, orchestration, and pipeline reliability patterns
Data quality testing, reconciliation, observability, and production support
Role-based access controls, secure data handling, and audit-ready processes
Specifying, orchestrating, and reviewing the work of AI coding agents, including evaluation of AI-generated code, data, and analysis
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to and advising executives, and able to explain data, tradeoffs, and risk clearly to non-technical partners.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing executive priorities and to prioritize calmly in a fast-paced environment.
Detail-oriented while maintaining a strategic, enterprise-level perspective.
WHY CHOOSE RELATION?
Competitive pay.
A safe and healthy work environment provided by our robust benefit program including family health and wellness programs, 401K, employee assistance programs, paid time off, paid holidays and more.
Career advancement and development opportunities.
.
Note: The above is not all encompassing of the full position description.
Relation Insurance Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Relation, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is presented within this posting.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
.
$178,000.00 - $294,000.00

jobs.title: Senior Director, Energy Engineering Management
jobs.text:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Moss is a national privately held construction firm providing innovative solutions resulting in award-winning projects. With regional offices across the United States, Moss focuses on construction management, PV Solar & BESS EPC, design-build, and public-private partnerships. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses a wide range of sectors, including luxury high-rise residential, landmark mixed-use developments, hospitality, K-12 and higher education, justice, solar energy and battery storage, and sports. Moss is ranked by Engineering News-Record as one of the nation's top 65 general contractors, and the 3rd ranked solar EPC nationwide. Moss prides itself on a strong entrepreneurial culture that honors safety, quality, client engagement, and employee development.
POSITION SCOPE AND ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT
The Senior Director, Engineering Management is a strategic leader responsible for aligning departmental execution with the broader business objectives of Moss'sEnergy Division. This role provides leadership and direction for the Engineering Management team within Moss's solar and renewable energy EPC business, translating organizational goals into portfolio strategy, resource planning, and partner engagement frameworks.
The Senior Director is accountable for the engineering portfolio's overall success, including client satisfaction, Engineer of Record (EOR) strategy, talent planning, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment. Serving as a key partner to executive leadership, this individual drives portfolio performance, delivery predictability, and commercial outcomes while ensuring the organization is positioned to scale effectively.
Working through Directors and Senior Managers, the Senior Director empowers leaders to oversee day-to-day portfolio execution, EOR performance, and the standardization of engineering processes and best practices. While operational responsibilities are delegated, this role retains ultimate accountability for departmental performance and serves as a trusted advisor to the Vice President on strategic priorities, organizational effectiveness, and portfolio health.
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Define team portfolios, regional assignments, and resource strategy.
Coordinate with Preconstruction Management and Business Development on future project pipeline strategy.
Own hiring strategy and execution, including 6-month and 1-year workforce plans.
Define and track OKRs and 90/180-day plans for the organization.
Own the EOR strategic relationship, including MSA review and contract standardization.
Define roles, responsibilities, and governance frameworks across the Engineering Management organization.
Drive stakeholder services strategy and build trust with Owners, Trade Partners, EORs, and internal teams.
Resolve major commercial, multi-stakeholder, and project-level escalations with sound judgment and a bias for action.
Perform other duties as assigned.
EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field required.
Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration is preferred.
Professional Engineer (PE) license or comparable technical credential is preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, design management, or construction, including significant experience in the solar or renewable energy EPC sector.
10+ years leading engineering or project teams, with proven accountability for portfolio-level commercial and delivery outcomes.
Demonstrated experience managing external design partners or Engineers of Record, including contract negotiation, MSA governance, and performance management.
Track record of building and scaling teams to match pipeline growth across multiple regions and owners.
Strategic leadership: ability to set direction, define governance frameworks, and translate enterprise goals into executable portfolio strategy.
Commercial acumen: manages contracts, budgets, and value engineering with discipline and price competitiveness in view.

jobs.text:
Job Description
The Opportunity
FIS is one of the world’s largest financial technology companies, a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company serving banks, financial institutions, and businesses across six continents. We manage approximately 190 million deposit and wealth management accounts, power 1.1 billion payments accounts, and process more than 70 billion transactions annually. Our fraud and financial crimes capabilities sit at the foundation of that infrastructure, protecting consumers, institutions, and the financial system at a scale that few companies in the world can match.
The fraud and financial crimes product role drives the protection of millions of customer accounts world- wide every day. Preventing fraud here means protecting generational wealth, life savings, company assets as well as preventing financial crime, identity theft, and regulatory exposure globally.
We are in the middle of a significant transformation. FIS is investing heavily in building proprietary fraud signals, next-generation machine learning models, and AI-driven detection capabilities — not simply integrating third-party tools, but constructing a differentiated, data-rich fraud intelligence platform from the ground up. This role is central to that work, and the person who fills it will have an outsized impact on how FIS competes and serves its clients for years to come.
The Role
The VP, Product will own the product roadmap and strategy for FIS’s Enterprise Fraud & Financial Crimes portfolio. The position will report to the SVP of Fraud & Financial Crimes and lead a team of product managers, each leading their own PM teams across the portfolio.
This is a role for someone who has built and run product at a fraud or financial crimes company — someone who knows what a modern, technically differentiated fraud roadmap looks like, has shipped it, and is ready to bring that standard to one of the largest financial technology platforms in the world.
What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end product roadmap for the Enterprise Fraud & Financial Crimes portfolio
Set product strategy that reflects the full breadth of the portfolio. Your depth in transaction monitoring will raise the bar across the platform, but this role is not transaction monitoring alone, it spans the entire fraud and financial crimes stack.
Partner directly with FIS’s Data & AI product leads to define and drive the roadmap for proprietary fraud models, signals, and intelligence capabilities — a central pillar of FIS’s platform transformation.
Lead a senior product management organization spanning multiple product lines, providing clear ownership, strategic direction, and career development across the team.
Drive enterprise architecture and product strategy to ensure the platform scales to support financial institutions of every size, configurable to diverse client needs while maintaining a coherent long-term vision.
Engage directly with clients — from the largest global banks to community institutions — to validate priorities, understand needs, and surface outside-in perspective into the roadmap.
Align cross-functional teams across engineering, data science, compliance, operations, and commercial to deliver coordinated product outcomes.
Connect product decisions to business results — client adoption, revenue growth, fraud detection effectiveness, false-positive reduction, and measurable client outcomes.
What We’re Looking For
A product leader who has built fraud products. You have owned a roadmap at a fraud technology company, a fintech, or a financial institution where product was the core discipline. You know what modern fraud product looks like because you have shipped it. A background leading fraud product strategy at a cutting-edge fraud or financial crimes company is highly valued, as is experience leading fraud product at a financial institution or payments company — provided you owned the roadmap, not solely operations.
Deep transaction monitoring expertise. You understand the mechanics of rules engines, behavioral signals, and ML-based detection across cards and money movement. This is your strongest domain, and it shows — but you think in terms of the full portfolio, not just one capability.
Experience building proprietary fraud models and signals. You have led the product side of building proprietary fraud detection models and signals: defining which data and signals matter, partnering with data science to develop and productionize models, and turning them into differentiated capabilities clients rely on. You treat models and signals as products, with their own roadmaps, performance metrics, and feedback loops.
Breadth across the fraud and financial crimes stack. You understand end-customer authentication, identity, AML and financial crimes, and how these capabilities fit together into a coherent, enterprise-grade platform.
Technical fluency. You do not need to write code, but you need to be the kind of product leader who gets into architecture conversations, challenges technical tradeoffs, and drives roadmaps alongside engineering and data science. You have managed technical teams and held them accountable to delivery.
Commercial and enterprise orientation. You understand how to build products that serve large, complex enterprise clients and how product decisions translate to revenue, adoption, and client value.
Executive presence and stakeholder credibility. You can operate at the client C-suite level and internally across a large, matrixed organization.
Nice to Have
Experience as a head of product or equivalent at a fraud technology company or fraud-focused fintech.
Background leading fraud product at a financial institution or large payments company, with direct ownership of the product roadmap.
Familiarity with integrated fraud and AML transaction monitoring platforms.
Experience building or scaling AI, ML, or rules-based fraud detection products.
FIS is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive compensation. The pay range for this full-time position is $202,260.00 - $343,840.00 and reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this position based on the posted role, level, and location. Within the range, actual individual starting pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Any changes in work location will also impact actual individual starting pay. Please consult with your recruiter about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
Privacy Statement
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
EEOC Statement
FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here supplement document available here
For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer: In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Sourcing Model
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

jobs.text:
Job Title: Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will advance Enterprise Data Governance, FAIR data practices, and a data product operating model that makes trusted, reusable, and responsibly accessible data available for analytics, automation, and AI innovation.
The successful candidate will lead cross-functional data strategy and delivery across data domains, translating scientific and business priorities into scalable governance, metadata, quality, semantic interoperability, and data product capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the enterprise Data Governance, FAIR, and data product strategy and roadmap, aligning investments to scientific and business priorities.
Establish a value-realization framework to measure business outcomes, adoption, and return on investment from data initiatives.
Execute the Enterprise Data Strategy, including data ownership, reusable data products, lifecycle management, data contracts, and adoption measures.
Evolve a federated governance operating model with clear decision rights, data ownership, stewardship accountabilities, data councils, data standards, and escalation paths.
Evolve FAIR maturity across the enterprise, including embedding FAIR practices in the data lifecycle, metadata standards, persistent identifiers, controlled vocabularies, and access patterns.
Advance active metadata, data catalog, lineage, business glossary, semantic and knowledge graph capabilities to improve discovery, context, interoperability, and trust.
Set governance policies and controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, retention, and responsible use; ensure fit-for-purpose data for regulated and AI-enabled use cases.
Partner with Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Digital, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to operationalize governed data products across platforms and domains.
Enable responsible AI by defining and enforcing data readiness criteria.
Serve as the data engagement lead for an assigned business function, driving adoption of data management practices, including FAIR, to deliver measurable data improvements and business value.
Manage large-scale data programs, cross-functional initiatives, and external partners; communicate outcomes, risks, dependencies, and value realization to senior leadership.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is adata management leader with biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications
Doctorate degree and 2 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Master’s degree and 6 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Associate degree and 10 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
Mandatory Skills and Qualifications
Experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, with an understanding of regulated data, business processes, and compliance requirements.
Demonstrated leadership of enterprise data governance, data management, active metadata, data quality, or data product initiatives across business and technology teams.
Hands-on understanding of FAIR data principles and their practical application through active metadata, standards, semantics, interoperability, and access controls.
Experience establishing data governance operating models, including data ownership, stewardship, policy, standards, controls, and issue management.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex data topics into business value and decisions.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
Experience implementing enterprise data strategy, scaling FAIR, data products operating model, and data contracts.
Knowledge of modern data management capabilities, including active metadata, data observability, lineage, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and policy-as-code.
Experience with master data, data catalog, governance, quality, active metadata, and semantic technologies: Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, Reltio, SciBite, or TopQuadrant.
Experience enabling responsible AI, including data readiness for machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI agent use cases.
Ability to define measurable outcomes for data investments, including data product adoption, quality, time-to-discovery, reuse, compliance, and AI readiness.
Experience managing external partners and geographically distributed delivery teams in complex stakeholder environments.
What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:
A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
Stock-based long-term incentives
Award-winning time-off plans
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.
Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.
careers.amgen.com

Application deadline
Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.
Sponsorship
Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.text:
Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ) — a world-renowned education and poverty-fighting organization based in New York — seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission-aligned Director of Data for our After-School, Community, and Early Childhood programs.
The Director of Data provides strategic leadership for data governance, performance management, analytics, reporting, and data-informed decision-making across the Deputy Program Officer’s portfolio. Reporting directly to the Deputy Program Officer, the Director establishes the vision, standards, systems, and management routines that enable program leaders to use reliable data to assess performance, identify risks and opportunities, strengthen execution, and improve outcomes for scholars and families.
The Director serves as the senior program-side leader for cross-portfolio data strategy and directly supervises the Assistant Directors of Data. The Director provides formal supervision, performance management, coaching, role expectations, and technical leadership for the Assistant Directors of Data, while Managing Directors maintain a dotted-line relationship to support portfolio alignment, responsiveness, and day-to-day partnership. The Director will partner with organizational teams in IT Evaluation, HR, and other functions to strengthen Salesforce (Zora) usage, data quality and governance, dashboards and scorecards, OKR and core-metric monitoring, and the integration of data into ongoing performance management and strategic planning routines.
The ideal candidate is a strategic and systems-oriented data leader who can set direction, build organizational capacity, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, develop staff, and translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
For more information, check out Want to Work at Harlem Children’s Zone? Here’s 7 Things You Need to Know.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Location: Remote
About This Opportunity
Purple Squirrel Enterprises has been supporting startups and global firms through growth, change, and expansion for 19+ years. We provide flexible HR and recruiting solutions that allow leaders to focus on strategy while we handle people operations — and this search is no exception.
We are exclusively engaged by a high-growth health technology company to help them identify and hire exceptional product leadership talent for this role. We are embedded directly with their leadership team, have deep knowledge of the company, the culture, and what it takes to succeed here — and we will be your dedicated recruiting partner from first conversation through offer.
This is not a blind submission. When you apply, you are working with a team that knows this opportunity inside and out and will advocate for you every step of the way.
💜 If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. We will be in touch promptly.
Applications submitted directly to our client will be redirected back to Purple Squirrel Enterprises. To be considered for this role, all candidates must apply through this posting.
About Our Client
Our client builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.
Their platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. They support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.
Their results so far:
48% reduction in medication errors
39% increase in compliance
69% improvement in audit-ready documentation
💜 This company was built around a cause that is both personal and urgent. That authenticity shows in how they operate, who they hire, and what they build. If you are looking for work that matters — this is it.
A Note on Title, Reporting Line & Scope
Our client is posting this role as Head of Product, but the final title, reporting structure, and scope will be shaped by the experience and leadership level of the person they hire. Depending on your background, this could ultimately be structured as VP of Product or other. Reporting line will most likely be directly to the CEO, though for a more foundational-level hire it could sit under Engineering leadership instead. These specifics — along with compensation — will be part of the conversation as we get to know your experience and how it maps to what they need.
This is intentional flexibility, not indecision: our client is committed to bringing in the right level of leadership for where they are today and where they're headed.
About the Role
Our client is looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today — a Product Lead and a Product Specialist — with real influence over the type, number, and pace of hires as the team grows.
This is a startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to executive leadership. Product has been driven by the leadership team to date, and they are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you — including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.
They are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together — engineers here are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and the handoff model is intentionally not prescriptive.
Their product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and their customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.
As with all leaders at this company, you'll need to be both hands-on and strategic — that combination is core to their culture. Priorities, travel, and schedules shift with the pace of a growing company and its leadership team, so you'll need to bring your own ideas, act autonomously when needed, and stay a strong team player at the same time. Communication — proactive, reactive, and yes, sometimes over-communication — is essential in an environment like this.
What You'll Do
Own the Roadmap
Own product strategy and the roadmap across the full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy/EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12–24 months, and make the case for it
Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them
Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product — audit-ready documentation is a primary reason customers choose this platform
Lead Discovery
Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders — observing workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
Design for three very different users: administrators (oversight/audit), caregivers (speed/clarity mid-shift), and the individuals receiving care
Design into existing routines rather than around them — usability is a safety requirement here, not a preference
Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork
Build the Function
Establish how product gets practiced: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, how outcomes get measured
Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and shape the hiring plan — including roles that don't exist yet — as scope expands
Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and support strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters
Work With AI
Set the standard on AI rather than delegate it — use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes
Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value — not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize
You do not need to be a software engineer, and you will have strong engineering partnership. You do need to be willing and able to build.
What This Role Is Not
This is not a purely strategic or advisory position, and it is not a roadmap-maintenance or backlog-management role. You will be the most senior product person in the company, with no layer between you and the problem. If you're looking to set direction and hand execution to a team of PMs, this isn't the right fit today. If being close to customers, requirements, and shipped software is what you've been missing, it likely is.
What Success Looks Like
Ownership Established: You've taken clear, visible ownership of the roadmap and the leadership team trusts your judgment on what's next and why
Discovery in Motion: You are spending real time with caregivers, administrators, and state stakeholders — and using what you learn to shape decisions, not just validate them
Function Taking Shape: Product process, definition standards, and team rhythms exist where little or none did before
Team Growing With Intention: You have a clear point of view on team structure and hiring, and the team feels coached, not just managed
Trusted Cross-Functionally: Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success see you as the person who keeps priorities clear and aligned across the company
What We're Looking For
Required
6 - 8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a roadmap covering discovery, definition, and delivery — not solely execution of a roadmap someone else set
Experience leading product people, including hiring and onboarding rather than only managing an inherited team
A track record of shipping B2B SaaS in close partnership with Engineering
Experience building product process where little or none existed
Strong discovery skills: customer interviewing, problem validation, prototyping, and experimentation
Experience with products where the buyer and the user are different people
Practical, frequent use of LLMs in day-to-day work
Comfort working with data directly, strong written communication, and judgment to decide with incomplete information
Willingness to travel occasionally, up to roughly 15%, for customer/facility visits, team meetings, and industry events
Nice to Have
Experience in healthcare technology, IDD services, assisted living, behavioral health, long-term care, or medication management, or another regulated environment
Experience with enterprise, government, or state agency customers, including procurement and reporting requirements
Experience shipping products that combine software and connected hardware
Experience with integration-dependent products (HL7, JSON, REST APIs, pharmacy management systems, EHRs)
Experience scaling a Product function from a small team, or shipping products/internal tools personally prototyped using AI-assisted development
Personal Attributes
A builder — your instinct when you have an idea is to make something and test it
Low ego, strong point of view — you advocate hard and change your mind when the evidence changes
Comfortable with ambiguity
Intellectually curious about why, not just what was requested
Energized by the mission — many affected by this product cannot advocate for themselves
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary: $183,000 – $225,000, depending on experience, skill set, and the ultimate scope/level of the role (Head of Product, VP of Product, or other) — final title and comp will be calibrated to the candidate
Potential Equity participation
100% company-paid medical coverage (base plan)
Dental & vision available
401(k) retirement plan
Company-paid life, AD&D, STD & LTD insurance
Lifestyle Spending Account (wellness, personal use, and company swag)
Flexible PTO + company holidays
Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
💜 Mission-driven work with real impact on vulnerable populations
Why This Role — And Why Now
Real problems, real stakes — your work directly affects patient safety for a population that often cannot advocate for itself
True ownership — you'll build the Product function, not inherit one
Direct access to leadership — a real seat at the table, with influence over team structure and roadmap
High-growth trajectory — recent statewide contract win signals significant expansion ahead
Authentic mission — 💜 this company was built around a cause that matters
Working With Purple Squirrel Enterprises
We are exclusively engaged by this client — meaning we are not one of many agencies submitting resumes. We are their dedicated recruiting partner, embedded in their process, and we know this role inside and out.
Here's what that means for you as a candidate:
A dedicated PSE point of contact throughout the entire process
Advocacy with the hiring team to make sure the role is mutually beneficial
Preparation for each interview stage so you can put your best foot forward
Honest, timely feedback at every step
Support through offer negotiation to ensure the outcome is right for you and the company
Deep experience navigating complex hiring processes to get great candidates across the finish line
Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. They welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
This role is on-site, 5 days a week, working from our Flatiron office in NYC.
About Seated
Seated exists to help restaurants thrive in an industry defined by thin margins and underutilized capacity. We connect thousands of restaurants with millions of high-intent diners through demand-driven pricing and rewards, helping restaurants fill empty tables, reach new guests, increase visit frequency, and drive profitable incremental revenue.
Since launching, billions of dollars in restaurant spend have flowed through Seated, and hundreds of millions of dollars in rewards have been paid to Seated consumers. Today, Seated operates across 20+ U.S. markets and continues to expand nationally.
Our core marketplace is thriving. Now, we’re focused on expanding the value Seated creates for restaurants and consumers and building the company’s next major growth engine.
See it for yourself: seatedapp.io (restaurant side) · getseated.seatedapp.io (diner side) · Seated on iOS · Seated on Android
Role Overview
Seated is hiring a Director of Product to serve as our first dedicated Product leader, owning product strategy and execution across our consumer and restaurant businesses.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will play a key role in shaping Seated’s product direction, identifying and validating new growth opportunities, and translating business priorities into products that create meaningful value for restaurants and consumers.
This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll work directly with our SVP of Engineering and a lean engineering team to drive the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and data analysis to requirements, prioritization, testing, and launch.
We’re looking for someone who thrives in an environment without established product processes or a large team. You’ll bring structure to how we make product decisions, build a focused roadmap, and help establish the foundation for a scalable Product function as Seated grows.
Responsibilities
Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products in partnership with the CEO and Engineering
Identify, evaluate, and validate new product opportunities that can drive Seated’s next stage of growth
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, and business-case development to inform product decisions
Explore opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Drive improvements to critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner directly with the SVP of Engineering and engineering team to define requirements, evaluate technical tradeoffs, prioritize initiatives, and deliver high-quality products
Serve as the primary Product owner, driving initiatives from discovery and definition through development, launch, and iteration
Identify and execute product-led growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Establish lightweight product processes, including roadmap planning, requirements documentation, prioritization frameworks, and success metrics
Translate business objectives, customer insights, and data into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics
Help shape the future Product function as Seated grows, including identifying opportunities to expand product and design capabilities

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Parallax Innovations is a civic communications lab building modern persuasion infrastructure for the movement to improve American democracy and elections.
We support organizations and campaigns advancing nonpartisan democracy reforms through our narrative intelligence platform. We combine technology, data, and services to help our partners reach, engage, and persuade voters in our fast-evolving information ecosystem. We enable partners with strategic guidance and hands-on production and editing support to build strong vertical-video operations across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Our products make it easier for campaigns to mobilize supporters as creators, equipping them with tools that draw on our intelligence and predictive capabilities to improve content before it ships. And our data assets – including an enriched voter file with audience-specific insights – help campaigns deploy and amplify the right content to the specific voters they need to reach.
Our primary focus is solving the Primary Problem—a system of party primaries that excludes millions of voters and rewards elected leaders for answering to a narrow partisan electorate. We help advance open primaries that give voters more voice and choice and leaders stronger incentives to represent their communities.
Parallax is incubated by Unite America, and is based in Denver.
As Chief Technology Officer, you will own the ongoing development and improvement of Parallax's primary competitive advantage: a narrative intelligence platform that learns what persuades Americans on reform issues, and how. You own everything engineering, AI, data, privacy & compliance, infrastructure, security, with strong influence over adjacent workflows. You also serve as an organizational leader, driving strategy and organization prioritization.
We approach persuasion like infrastructure: a lasting capability that helps the movement learn, improve and win across campaigns and election cycles. Our ambition is to build a closed-loop learning system that gets smarter every time we speak. Its AI core will connect the content we create with engagement data, audience research and experiments to learn which messages, messengers and formats work with which voters—and feed those lessons back into how we create, target and distribute the next communication.
Over each election cycle, Parallax will support a number of reform campaigns, many of them ballot initiatives. Each campaign has to reach different audiences: progressives, conservatives, independents, and the large group of Americans who are disengaged or simply worn out by politics. Our product lowers the barrier for supporters to become compelling content creators, and our platform provides guidance on frames, formats, messengers and messages are likely to work.
This is an executive role requiring technical depth and a hands-on approach to using modern engineering tools, as well as broader organizational leadership skills. You’ll craft the product vision, lead the contract engineers in developing the platform, and be the decision-maker about architecture, models, data and resources. You’ll also champion the technical vision, progress, and investment requirements to executive leadership, the Board, and potential investors. You will inherit a contract data and engineering team, and from there you will determine how the team develops, including budget development and hiring.
You will serve as a senior executive responsible for the technical integration of Parallax’s data, products, and services. Alongside the Chief of Staff and VP of Product & Partnerships, you will develop and drive organizational strategy, translate priorities into work plans and budgets, and align the team around measurable results. Ideal candidates for this role will have the judgment and management ability to assume broader organizational leadership as Parallax grows.
This role reports to the President, and is based in Denver. Relocations welcome. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere will be considered if they can commit to periodic trips to Denver.
These will be your accountabilities:
Own the development of Parallax’s core technology and competitive advantage.
Set platform strategy and capabilities roadmap: what it should measure, what its learning agenda will be, what inputs it expands to include, and how it learns and improves quarter over quarter.
Define the scoring framework: how content engagement and persuasion are quantified for Parallax, how they are weighted, and how scores connect to real outcomes.
Extend our intelligence platform beyond transcript-analysis so that it evaluates videos, including visuals, presenters, format and production choices.
Make the model decisions: which commercial and open models to use and route between, whether fine-tuning or custom components are worth it, and the tradeoffs in cost, speed and accuracy.
Build the data loop so that performance data from platforms, partners, audience surveys and experiments flows back into the platform cleanly and in an accretive fashion.
Oversee the development of dashboards and reporting that can explain what the platform is accomplishing, for internal and partner audiences.
Ensure the platform adheres to data compliance laws and a set of AI ethics guidelines which will need to be fully articulated (e.g. no deceptive or synthetic content).
Prove that it works, explain its limits.
Design and run the platform validation agenda: back-test against historical content, compare predictions with actual results, and check findings against survey and experimental (including RCT) evidence.
Build the evals and guardrails that let the platform learn within defined limits, so its outputs can be trusted and explained.
Report clearly to leadership, funders and partners on what the intelligence platform can tell us today, how confident we are, and what it cannot yet do.
Turn intelligence into decisions.
Translate platform findings into clear, weekly guidance the creative team uses on frame, format, messenger and audience.
Work with the Creative studio and Partners team to support mapping the message-by-audience grid across active campaigns: what has been tested, what is working, and where the gaps are.
Help package Parallax's intelligence effectively so that partner organizations and campaign teams can use it to make more persuasive content themselves.
Shape our technology ecosystem, build the team as needed.
As the platform expands, expand your influence and help shape the roadmap for Parallax's other internal tools and products so they effectively interoperate with the core, working closely with the people who build and deploy them.
Take over the current contractor-based data and engineering squad; decide what to keep, build or buy. Own team development, budget, and hiring, in collaboration with leadership.
Build alongside the team with the latest AI tools, and set the standard for how Parallax uses AI responsibly.
Help the President and leadership team set Parallax's strategy, and work closely with the Chief of Staff and the VP of Product & Partnerships on org-wide initiatives.
What success looks like:
First 60 days: you’ve facilitated a shared platform vision that is in sharp focus, pulled together a leadership-approved roadmap and clear technical ownership. An initial intelligence platform scoring framework should be in place to enable the creative team to run strong week-to-week experiments, learn from results, and make each round of communications smarter.
First six months: a working feedback loop connecting content, audience and outcome data; initial scoring and predictive capabilities tested against results; and initial integrations with the partner voter file and Partner Portal. The team should be using findings to improve communications, with clear measures of progress and priorities for what comes next.

jobs.title: Director of Product Engineering
jobs.text:
Hometrack is seeking an accomplished Director of Product Engineering, to lead our efforts in building innovative mission critical products to power property decision making in the UK financial services industry. We offer a competitive salary, fantastic benefits, and flexible, hybrid working.
Hometrack’s market-leading property data sets, valuation models, and risk insights are delivered via our suite of B2B SaaS applications for mortgage lenders, brokers, and more. We’ve led the market for over twenty years!
Our services are mission-critical to the UK’s top banks, automating their mortgage offers. They’re used daily by home builders, mortgage brokers, local councils, and more to make informed property purchasing decisions. We have an exciting strategy to serve an even wider section of the market, with innovative products and services.
The Director of Product Engineering will provide senior technology leadership for Hometrack’s key product lines, owning the technical strategy, delivery oversight, and evolution, providing a highly utilised and relied upon set of capabilities for clients.
This role will lead an established set of teams as they evolve and support our existing capabilities to scale and meet developing client needs. The Director of Product Engineering will collaborate closely with Product peers and wider business stakeholders to shape the long‑term roadmap, ensure robust technical foundations, and guide our continued growth.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
Own the technology strategy ensuring alignment with our wider platform and technology strategy.
Partner with key stakeholders in product, commercial and delivery to define and evolve a clear, credible roadmap covering near‑term delivery and longer‑term technical direction.
Provide domain leadership and technical challenge
Delivery & Execution
Provide senior oversight of existing product engineering teams, ensuring delivery remains on track as the products evolve and new products are introduced.
Ensure strong engineering fundamentals, including resilience, scalability, security, and operational readiness, appropriate for an institution supporting banks and other major lenders.
Support the evolution of a highly utilised set of capabilities as they scale to meet future client needs.
Technology & Architecture
Guide architectural decisions in partnership with technical peers (Principal/Staff Engineers).
Act as a key contributor in setting our technology direction
People & Leadership
Lead and develop engineers and engineering managers (software and data).
Set clear expectations, provide coaching, and build a culture of ownership, learning, and delivery.
What We’re Looking For
Essential Experience
Senior technology leadership experience (Head of/Director or equivalent) preferably within or adjacent to financial services.
Demonstrable experience owning and evolving complex platforms, preferably in a high availability environment.
Proven ability to partner effectively with Product leadership to shape and deliver long‑term strategy.
Strong fundamental background in software engineering (.Net/AWS/Azure)
Beneficial Experience
Experience of evolving team working practices towards increasingly agentic SDLCs
Experience managing and leading data engineering teams
Leadership & Behaviours
Pragmatic and outcome‑focused, with sound judgement to balance speed, risk, and long‑term value.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and guiding teams through an evolving domain.
Clear communicator who can explain complex concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Role‑model for Hometrack’s Behaviours and expectations around ownership, delivery, and collaboration.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Commerce
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
About Data & Technology Solutions
WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data and technology organisation. We build the platforms, products, and engineering capabilities that power marketing transformation at scale.
WPP Open is our AI-powered platform for marketing. It connects people, data, tools, and AI into a single ecosystem, enabling teams to deliver better outcomes faster, more efficiently, and at global scale.
Our teams of engineers, product leaders, and operators work across multiple domains to build systems that power planning, execution, and delivery for some of the world’s largest brands.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for a senior product-minded engineering leader to drive delivery and execution for our commerce product area and to lead the application of AI into our SDLC.
You will be core part of our product development process and help to inform roadmap and will lead your team in translating product priorities into reliable, high‑quality engineering outcomes. Additionally, you will lead the application and adaptation of AI-driven development practices, ensuring systems operate effectively in real‑world, production environments. This role requires strong systems thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex integrations in a rapidly developing environment.
Work in this area spans both core commerce marketing systems and the data flows and pipelines required to interact with these systems, requiring a blend of data-aware system design, application engineering, and integration engineering.
You are:
A product-focused engineering leader with strong technical credibility and demonstrated ability in influencing and driving the roadmap.
Comfortable operating in integration-heavy, business-critical systems
Significant experience in programme design and systems architecture.
Demonstrated portfolio incorporating AI driven development into the end-to-end SDLC.
Data & metrics-driven, able to manage complexity across multiple teams, platforms and external partners.
Focused on outcomes tied to business performance.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Engineering Leadership & Team Development
Lead engineering delivery across teams building commerce marketing capabilities.
