jobs.title: Director, Data Strategy & Analytics
jobs.text:
Director of Data Strategy & Analytics
Job Location: US, Remote. Candidate must reside and work within the US.
Job Overview:
Lexia's data assets are central to how we grow and how we demonstrate impact. We are seeking a Director of Data Strategy & Analytics to lead the team that turns those assets into insight and action across the business, in alignment with our vision.
Reporting to the VP, Strategic Planning & Business Enablement, the Director will lead Lexia's internal business analytics function, directly managing a team of analysts and combining human analyst work with AI-enabled, self-service capabilities to maximize the use and business impact of our engineered data assets. The Director will be the primary analytics partner to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the Lexia executive team, and will own strategy and governance for our BI and analytics systems.
Reporting to this role is the leader of the Data Engineering team, responsible for data infrastructure and architecture. The Director of Data Strategy & Analytics will provide strategic leadership across both analytics and data engineering to ensure our data ecosystem enables business insights while maintaining the integrity, security, and confidentiality of enterprise data assets.
Job Responsibilities:
Team Leadership & Development
Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for data and analytics that aligns with the organization's mission, vision, and strategy, leveraging data to optimize decision-making, increase operational efficiency, and maximize impact.
Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts, providing regular feedback and fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
Own project management and prioritization for all business analytics work, including analyst and AI-enabled analytics projects, and oversee review and QA to ensure data products meet high standards for quality/accuracy, user-centricity, and action-oriented data storytelling.
Support the Director of Analytics Engineering and foster a culture of continuous learning and development across the Data Strategy & Analytics team, promoting collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
Business Analytics & Insights
Drive analyst efforts to mine revenue, operational, and customer data and turn them into insightful KPIs, models, and dashboards that help our teams pursue revenue optimization and operational efficiency.
Partner with stakeholder teams across the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data to drive innovation and improve operational efficiency.
Self-Service & AI-Enabled Analytics
Develop and maintain a scalable suite of self-service dashboards, AI agents, and conversational interfaces that enable non-technical staff to ask and answer questions of our data directly.
Establish enablement frameworks for self-service analytics that drive adoption, empower users, and provide guardrails to ensure effective and appropriate use.
In partnership with Analytics Engineering, oversee the integration of AI capabilities into analytics tools and workflows to scale self-service and operational efficiency.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Serve as the main point of contact and key data partner for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior leadership, ensuring the alignment of analytics efforts with business needs and priorities.
Serve as the main point of contact for Cambium and Veritas analytics requests and collaborations, delegating to and partnering with the Director of Analytics Engineering as appropriate.
Translate business needs into clear downstream data requirements and metric definitions, partnering with the Director of Analytics Engineering to ensure the right data warehouse marts and Tableau Cloud data sources are provisioned, and providing input into data architecture, integration, and AI infrastructure decisions.
Analytics Systems, Tools & Governance
Own Tableau/BI system strategy and governance, in collaboration with other analyst teams across the organization.
Lead vendor and tool procurement and management for analytics systems and team tools, in consultation with the Director of Analytics Engineering.
Chair Lexia's cross-functional data governance group, collaborating closely with Legal, IT, and data leads to establish and maintain data and AI governance policies, procedures, and controls, and own policy compliance and appropriate sensitive data usage across DS&A-owned systems, staff, and products.
Stay abreast of emerging trends and technologies in advanced analytics, AI, and data management, and provide strategic recommendations for business innovation and responsible use.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, economics, business, computer science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of experience in analytics, data strategy, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering data-driven solutions that drive business impact.
5+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading data analysts or analytics teams.
Exceptional leadership and management skills, with experience leading high-performing teams in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Excellent quantitative and analytical skills with experience in data visualization, statistical modeling/machine learning, and go-to-market domain analyses (e.g., campaign attribution, price sensitivity, account scoring, retention/churn analysis).
Professional proficiency in analytics and BI tools that align with our tech stack (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Python or R), and working knowledge of data engineering and cloud data platforms (e.g., Dbt, Redshift, AWS) sufficient to partner effectively with Analytics Engineering.
Experience owning BI platform strategy and governance, and managing analytics vendor and tool relationships.
Expertise in data management, including metric definition, data governance, and data quality management.
Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-assisted analytics workflows, such as AI agents, natural language query interfaces, or LLM-driven analytics, with a deep understanding of the data privacy, security protocols, and ethical governance required to deploy them, including hallucination guardrails.
Familiarity with sales and customer data platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and experience within a SaaS B2B or B2G organization preferred.
Excellent communication, data storytelling, and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive and non-technical audiences.
Strategic mindset and the ability to manage challenging priorities across multiple stakeholders.
To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .
Remote First Work Environment
Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.
If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.
The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.
As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.
An Equal Opportunity Employer
We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).
We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, NIRA
jobs.text:
Join the Tilt team
At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager, Nira
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our NIRA team, owning engineering across product, platform reliability, data infrastructure, and internal tooling. This is a high-impact role where you’ll work closely with Product, Data Science, Credit, and Marketing to build, scale, and improve a fast-growing business.
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
How you'll make an impact
Own and execute the engineering roadmap across NIRA
Raise the bar on engineering practices (CI/CD, testing, reliability, observability)
Lead and grow a high-performing team of engineers
Drive technical decisions that balance speed, quality, and scalability
Partner cross-functionally to deliver meaningful business outcomes
Why you're a great fit
7+ years in engineering, with 3+ years in management
Experience leading teams in startup or scaling environments
Strong track record improving engineering standards and delivery
Comfortable operating across product, infrastructure, and data
Clear communicator with a bias for action
Our Interview Process
Initial Recruiter Call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.
Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion about your experience.
Skills Panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach.
Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you'll contribute to Tilt's mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way.
Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.
What you'll get at Tilt
Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.
The Tilt Way
We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.
The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Credit Outcome
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM:
PCS helps small businesses find and take the right credit. The Credit Outcome vertical is the heaviest part of PCS: it owns the journey from a business's intent to a successful credit outcome, measured by our north-star metric, % 1st Outcome. It spans several markets and combines market-focused product teams (Scaled Markets, New Markets, India) with horizontal teams (Sales Engine and Platform). You will work hand in hand with a dedicated Engineering Director, Design, Product Operations, Analytics and Commercial Heads.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Vision, strategy and outcomes
Own the vertical's north star: set the strategy and roadmap to grow % 1st Outcome, balancing margin, efficiency and member experience.
Place the big bets: prioritise across routing, human connection, integrations and decisioning (e.g. pre-qualification), and be explicit about what we will not do.
Regional focus: make sound trade-offs between markets, including scaling established markets and building new ones such as India.
Leadership and team growth
Lead and grow product leaders: hire, coach and develop Product Leads and Senior PMs, giving each a self-contained area of the business to own.
Clear ownership: ensure one accountable PM/EM pair per workstream, with no ambiguity on who owns what.
Operating rhythm: run planning, OKRs and reviews that connect team work to vertical and company goals.
Partnership and delivery
Engineering partnership: work as a true pair with the Engineering Director on roadmap, capacity and technical investment, including platform health.
Cross-functional influence: align Design, Data, Risk & Compliance, Commercial and Operations on priorities and launches.
Data and experimentation: use funnel analytics and experiments to find friction, make decisions and show impact in commercial terms.
Applied AI: identify where automation and AI (e.g. lead scoring, agentic sales tooling) can raise conversion and efficiency.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience: 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years leading product managers or product leads [TBC level/years].
Commercial acumen: you tie product decisions to revenue, margin and unit economics.
Data-native: comfortable with funnel analytics, experimentation and BI tools.
Technical fluency: you can engage confidently with engineers on APIs, integrations and data flows.
Leader of leaders: you coach strong PMs, set a high bar and create room for people to grow.
Influence without authority: you align senior stakeholders across functions and regions.
Nice to have: experience in lending, credit marketplaces, fintech or regulated financial services; experience building products in multiple markets, ideally including India.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Finance Director, R&D Capital Allocation & Engineering Operations
jobs.text:
(GAQ427R231)
About the role
As Databricks scales at unprecedented velocity, how we invest our R&D capital—both human and compute—is critical to our scale. We are looking for a Product Finance leader to own R&D capital allocation and engineering operations. You will be a key finance partner to our senior Engineering and Product Operations leaders, with a mandate that spans product-level R&D ROI, global workforce and location strategy, and the rapidly evolving economics of AI-enabled software development.
The impact you will have
Drive product-level ROI and R&D capital allocation
Establish frameworks to measure product-level ROI across a fast-moving platform like Databricks where engineering velocity is extremely high.
Operationalize ROI metrics so they directly inform product investment and resource allocation decisions.
Define engineering economics in the AI era
Partner with Engineering to model how AI developer tooling and internal token spend scale alongside headcount, quantifying the tradeoff between human capital and compute capital.
Measure the end-to-end cost of AI-enabled engineering, including the second-order impact on cloud spend, and partner with Engineering to optimize investments.
Shape global workforce and location strategy
Drive multi-year headcount planning across global engineering hubs, balancing cost per hire, talent density, and university recruiting pipelines.
Partner closely with Workplace and Facilities leadership to synchronize R&D hiring roadmaps with global real estate strategy and multi-year CapEx planning.
Scale R&D finance operations and build the team
Bring systems-level thinking to R&D finance operations, building scalable, automated workflows across headcount management, PO planning, monthly accruals, and SOX audit compliance.
Dogfood the Databricks platform to modernize internal finance tooling and deliver self-serve operational visibility to engineering leaders.
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of finance professionals capable of operating seamlessly across strategic capital allocation and rigorous operational execution.
What we look for
Required
10+ years of experience in Strategic/Product Finance or R&D FP&A.
Deep experience managing large-scale R&D OpEx, headcount capacity modeling, and multi-site workforce planning within a high-growth enterprise software or cloud company.
A proven track record of partnering directly with senior Engineering, Product Operations, and People/Workplace executives to drive capital allocation and operational rigor.
Systems-level thinker with a demonstrated ability to re-engineer financial processes from scratch—spanning headcount tracking, procurement, close, and SOX controls—to support rapid scale.
Experience building, leading, and developing high-output finance teams in fast-moving environments.
Preferred
Direct experience analyzing cloud dev/test infrastructure and AI tooling/token costs.
Experience attributing shared engineering and platform R&D costs across a complex, multi-product portfolio to establish product-level profitability.
Hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, or notebook environments (especially Databricks) to automate reporting and self-serve insights from large operational datasets.

jobs.text:
(GAQ427R229)
About the role
AI is the defining platform shift of our generation, and Databricks is right at the center of it. We are looking for a Product Finance leader to scale the fastest growing part of our business with both speed and financial rigor. You will be the primary finance partner to our AI Engineering and Product leaders, with a mandate that spans the full arc of the AI business: planning GPU supply and demand across clouds, shaping how we price AI products, and building the unit economics that will define the margins of this category for years to come.
The impact you will have
Plan the GPU supply and demand that powers the business
Establish a trusted, unified GPU demand plan across production inference, internal research, and new product bets so we invest ahead of growth without over-provisioning.
Drive capacity commitment and procurement strategies across major hyperscalers and emerging neoclouds, optimizing the mix of reserved, spot, and on-demand compute.
Own AI product economics and partner on pricing
Lead revenue and margin analytics across the AI product portfolio, turning raw consumption telemetry into a clear read on customer adoption, retention, and product profitability.
Model the end-to-end unit economics of AI products before they ship, partnering with Product and Pricing to design consumption structures that drive adoption while protecting gross margin targets.
Establish robust KPIs and operations to drive best-in-class execution
Partner with Engineering to define north star efficiency KPIs (e.g., GPU utilization, cost per token/query, serverless efficiency) and translate them into committed engineering roadmaps.
Run tight financial operations, from auditable multi-cloud cost allocation to automated reporting, giving product and engineering leaders real-time visibility into their economic goals.
Bring finance rigor to the biggest investment decisions
Design ROI and capital allocation frameworks to evaluate asymmetric bets—including frontier model research, internal compute clusters, and strategic partnerships.
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of product finance analysts capable of operating at the intersection of deep technical infrastructure and commercial strategy
What we look for
Required
10+ years of experience in Strategic/Product Finance, complemented by foundational training in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting.
Deep fluency in consumption-based business models, public cloud infrastructure costs, unit cost analysis, and gross margin optimization.
A proven track record of partnering directly with senior Engineering and Product executives to influence technical roadmaps and commercial pricing.
Demonstrated ability to build scalable financial systems from scratch and distill massive, complex telemetry data into models and recommendations leaders act on.
Experience building, leading, and developing high-output finance teams in fast-moving environments.
Preferred
Direct experience operating in the AI and GPU economy, including familiarity with training/inference workloads, hyperscaler commitment structures, and neocloud economics.
Ownership of a multi-product P&L within a high-growth enterprise SaaS, PaaS, or data infrastructure company.
Hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, or notebook environments to self-serve insights from raw usage data.

blocks.text: About the role

AI is the defining platform shift of our generation, and Databricks is right at the center of it. We are looking for a Product Finance leader to scale the fastest growing part of our business with both speed and financial rigor. You will be the primary finance partner to our AI Engineering and Product leaders, with a mandate that spans the full arc of the AI business: planning GPU supply and demand across clouds, shaping how we price AI products, and building the unit economics that will define the margins of this category for years to come.
The impact you will have

items: Plan the GPU supply and demand that powers the business
Establish a trusted, unified GPU demand plan across production inference, internal research, and new product bets so we invest ahead of growth without over-provisioning.
Drive capacity commitment and procurement strategies across major hyperscalers and emerging neoclouds, optimizing the mix of reserved, spot, and on-demand compute.
Own AI product economics and partner on pricing
Lead revenue and margin analytics across the AI product portfolio, turning raw consumption telemetry into a clear read on customer adoption, retention, and product profitability.
Model the end-to-end unit economics of AI products before they ship, partnering with Product and Pricing to design consumption structures that drive adoption while protecting gross margin targets.
Establish robust KPIs and operations to drive best-in-class execution
Partner with Engineering to define north star efficiency KPIs (e.g., GPU utilization, cost per token/query, serverless efficiency) and translate them into committed engineering roadmaps.
Run tight financial operations, from auditable multi-cloud cost allocation to automated reporting, giving product and engineering leaders real-time visibility into their economic goals.
Bring finance rigor to the biggest investment decisions
Design ROI and capital allocation frameworks to evaluate asymmetric bets—including frontier model research, internal compute clusters, and strategic partnerships.
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of product finance analysts capable of operating at the intersection of deep technical infrastructure and commercial strategy

blocks.text: What we look for
Required

items: 10+ years of experience in Strategic/Product Finance, complemented by foundational training in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting.
Deep fluency in consumption-based business models, public cloud infrastructure costs, unit cost analysis, and gross margin optimization.
A proven track record of partnering directly with senior Engineering and Product executives to influence technical roadmaps and commercial pricing.
Demonstrated ability to build scalable financial systems from scratch and distill massive, complex telemetry data into models and recommendations leaders act on.
Experience building, leading, and developing high-output finance teams in fast-moving environments.

blocks.text: Preferred

items: Direct experience operating in the AI and GPU economy, including familiarity with training/inference workloads, hyperscaler commitment structures, and neocloud economics.
Ownership of a multi-product P&L within a high-growth enterprise SaaS, PaaS, or data infrastructure company.
Hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, or notebook environments to self-serve insights from raw usage data.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, AI Platform
jobs.text:
About AiDASH
AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.
The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.
Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!
The Role
AiDASH is scaling fast — our satellite and AI-powered utility products are set for aggressive customer growth over the next two years, and engineering is at the heart of making it happen. We’re hiring a Head of Engineering, AI Platform to join our engineering leadership team in a newly created role. In this role, you'll build our new Data Inference AI Pipeline team from the ground up to support our rapidly growing customer base.
This is a rare opportunity to build both the team and the system from scratch: you'll shape the architecture, culture, and hiring bar of a new AI team from day one, and own the pipeline that powers our AI products as our customer base grows. In this role, you will report to the VP of Engineering and have real ownership over technical decisions, team design, and engineering practices.
Our pending acquisition by Schneider Electric will accelerate our mission as we bring our combined offering to our joint customer base, and the systems you build will power outcomes at an even greater scale.
Location: Palo Alto, CA (hybrid/2 days per week in the office)
How you'll make an impact:
Build the Data Inference AI Pipeline team
Define the team's charter, headcount plan, and hiring bar, and make the first several hires, bringing in talent from both within AiDASH and outside
Architect a multimodal data inference pipeline that scales with customer growth while keeping compute and infrastructure cost per inference efficient
Build the model training and human-in-the-loop (HITL) feedback loops that keep our AI accurate and continuously improving
Establish strong engineering practices from day one, including code review, testing, on-call, and release process
Lead and grow the team
Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers and leads, and manage performance as needed, building a high-performing, high-ownership culture
Partner with Product, Data Science, and Design to shape roadmap trade-offs and sequencing
Own technical decisions within your team's scope, and partner with the VP of Engineering on cross-org architecture decisions
Give the leadership a clear, reliable view of progress, risks, and resourcing needs
What success looks like in your first 6 months:
The Data Inference AI Pipeline team is staffed with its first core hires, from within AiDASH and outside, and running on an architecture that scales with growing data volume without a proportional rise in infrastructure cost
The team has clear ownership, a steady delivery cadence, and visible engineering practices (code review, on-call, release process) in place
Leadership has a clear, reliable read on the team's progress, risks, and resourcing needs
What we're looking for:
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3-5+ years leading engineering teams (managing managers or senior ICs)
A track record of building a team or system from scratch, not just scaling an existing one
Hands-on experience architecting data/ML pipelines at scale, with a strong grasp of throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency trade-offs for inference workloads
Experience building modern AI systems, including reasoning frameworks, agentic capabilities, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), self-correction loops, and memory and state management, that shipped to production for real customers, not as research or internal proof-of-concept work
Strong background in cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS architectures (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices)
Proven ability to improve delivery predictability and accelerate onboarding and go-live for enterprise customers
Confidence owning technical decisions within a defined scope, while partnering with a VP on strategy and resourcing
Experience managing global, distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones
High ownership mindset, low ego, and a collaborative spirit, with a passion for building teams that do their best work
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote-sensing pipelines
A background in utilities, energy, or infrastructure
Experience hiring and scaling a net-new engineering team in a high-growth (Series B/C) startup environment
Open-source contributions, technical certifications, or published engineering writing
What you'll love:
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered
Parental Leave: Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you
Winter Break: From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends!
We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.
We offer a competitive annual pay range of $300,000 to $350,000 for this full-time position, which includes a base salary and bonus based on performance. This range reflects the anticipated annual pay range (base + bonus) for new hires. We strive to ensure our compensation packages are equitable and aligned with industry standards. Your recruiter can share more about compensation during the hiring process.
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.
Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

jobs.title: VP/ Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Juvare is a SaaS company focused on operational resilience, critical incident management, and mission coordination. Our products serve state and local government, federal civilian and defense agencies, public and private healthcare organizations, and critical infrastructure operators. Our portfolio includes WebEOC Nexus, the Unified Command Platform, Juvare Exchange, Juvare AI, HealthSuite, CrisisTrack, and related workflow, intelligence, communications, and recovery solutions.
Reports to: Chief Product Officer
Location: Atlanta, GA
Leadership scope: Platform and Vertical Product Managers
Direct product responsibility: Juvare AI (JAI)
The Opportunity
Juvare is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead our platform and vertical Product Management organization and directly own the strategy, roadmap, commercialization, and adoption of Juvare AI.
This broad, player-coach role will align Juvare’s markets, products, shared platform capabilities, product adoption, and New Product Innovation. The Director will partner closely with the NPI Accelerator Team to move promising concepts from market validation into commercially viable, scalable offerings while developing a high-performing Product Management team.
Key Responsibilities
Product Management Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop Juvare’s Platform and Vertical Product Managers; establish clear roles, decision rights, performance expectations, and operating rhythms.
Hold Product Managers accountable for customer problems, market strategy, differentiation, product health, adoption, and commercial outcomes—not only feature delivery.
Maintain an integrated portfolio roadmap and resolve cross-product priorities, investment tradeoffs, capability overlaps, and dependencies.
Partner with Engineering and Design to empower teams around clear problems and measurable customer and business outcomes.
Portfolio Strategy, Growth, and Product Adoption
Translate Juvare’s company strategy into a coherent portfolio strategy across Federal, SLED, Healthcare, Critical Infrastructure, and shared platform capabilities.
Build and institutionalize a repeatable Juvare Growth Playbook for net-new products, zero-to-one and one-to-many growth, adjacent-market expansion, and cross-sell and upsell within the installed base.
Define the evidence required before investment, including strategic fit, validated customer need, outside-in market evidence, differentiation, funding and willingness to pay, revenue potential, repeatability, technical feasibility, and delivery economics.
Own Juvare’s product-adoption measurement framework, observability, and Pendo operating model, including instrumentation standards, Core Events, page and feature tagging, segmentation, dashboards, data quality, and recurring portfolio reviews.
Own Juvare’s product data strategy, partnering with PMs and the Partnership program, to enable embedded data that drives differentiated insights, AI capabilities, and commercial value across the product portfolio.
New Product Innovation and NPI Accelerator Partnership
Own the Product organization’s New Product Innovation process and serve as the primary Product Management counterpart to the NPI Accelerator Team.
Partner with the Accelerator to define the product opportunity and target market, customer discovery and early-adopter strategy, prototype and first-version objectives, pricing hypotheses, learning goals, Alpha/Beta/LA/GA criteria, and organizational handoff.
Ensure new concepts are validated for customer value, commercial viability, strategic fit, usability, security, supportability, and repeatability, not merely technical feasibility.
Define graduation criteria and post-graduation ownership, roadmap, staffing, support, implementation, and go-to-market plans.
Maintain a transparent NPI portfolio and help scale successful offerings from design partners into repeatable, referenceable, market-ready products.
Juvare AI Strategy and Adoption
Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, packaging, and performance of Juvare AI.
Define differentiated JAI value across Juvare’s markets and develop an integrated roadmap spanning embedded assistance, role-aware agents, workflow automation, decision support, analytics, insights, and agent orchestration.
Prioritize JAI use cases based on customer value, market demand, data readiness, portfolio reuse, commercial potential, and operational outcomes; ensure JAI is embedded in the workflows where customers perform critical work.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal, and Compliance to ensure JAI is secure, explainable, governable, auditable, and appropriate for regulated and mission-critical environments.
Establish and monitor measurable JAI adoption goals, including activation, repeat usage, workflow penetration, time to value, task completion and time savings, trust and satisfaction, expansion, revenue influence, and referenceability.
Work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, and Support on positioning, demonstrations, enablement, onboarding, adoption programs, and customer success plans.
Commercialization and Customer Leadership
Maintain direct engagement with strategic customers, prospects, advisory groups, early adopters, and customer-facing teams.
Ensure every major launch includes validated positioning, pricing, packaging, enablement, operational readiness, Pendo instrumentation, adoption targets, in-app onboarding or guidance, and post-launch measurement.
Connect customer needs and adoption evidence to platform investment and vertical roadmaps, and represent Product Management in major customer, partner, executive, board, and investor discussions.
What Success Looks Like
During the first 12 months, this leader will have:
Established clear accountability across Product Management and an integrated portfolio roadmap connecting market solutions, platform capabilities, Juvare Exchange, data, and AI.
Implemented a repeatable Growth Playbook and NPI process with clear investment, stage-gate, graduation, handoff, and scale criteria.
Build and lead customer advisory boards and practitioner communities to inform product strategy, validate new offerings, strengthen adoption, and develop referenceable customer advocates.
Developed a focused JAI roadmap with measurable adoption and commercial objectives.
Established a portfolio-wide product health and adoption framework in Pendo, with reliable instrumentation, executive dashboards, and a recurring review cadence.
Improved activation, time to value, feature and workflow adoption, repeat usage, and customer referenceability across priority products, especially JAI.
Evaluate portfolio pricing and packaging strategy in partnership with Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing, including value metrics, willingness-to-pay validation, commercial guardrails, and pricing performance; recommending necessary actions.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or Master’s degree preferred
10+ years of product management experience, including enterprise B2B SaaS products.
4+ years leading and developing Product Managers or multidisciplinary product teams.
Demonstrated experience managing a complex portfolio across shared platforms, market-facing solutions, and multiple customer segments.
Experience taking products from early discovery and zero-to-one development through commercialization, adoption, and scale.
Demonstrated success with AI-, analytics-, automation-, or data-driven products and a strong understanding of agents, grounding, model evaluation, human oversight, explainability, and responsible AI.
Demonstrated experience operationalizing product analytics and adoption platforms—Pendo strongly preferred—including instrumentation, segmentation, dashboards, and in-app adoption programs, and turning usage data into product decisions.
Experience with pricing, packaging, go-to-market planning, customer adoption, and portfolio investment decisions, supported by strong commercial and financial judgment.
Ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Security, and executive leadership.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in GovTech, emergency management, healthcare technology, defense, critical infrastructure, or another regulated market.
Familiarity with FedRAMP, DoD IL5, or comparable compliance frameworks.
Experience building configurable platforms, workflow products, data exchange networks, analytics, or decision-support solutions.
Leadership Profile
The successful candidate will be strategic and hands-on, commercially accountable, customer-centered, technically credible, and comfortable making difficult portfolio tradeoffs. This leader will develop strong product talent and turn customer insight and product data into offerings customers adopt, value, expand, and recommend.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
EEO Statement
Juvare is deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe in equal opportunity for all applicants and encourage individuals from underrepresented groups in technology to apply. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building and maintaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of—and will be free from discrimination on account of—their race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, physical condition, developmental disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.
Any individuals with a disability requiring a reasonable accommodation to assist with their job search or application for employment should send an e-mail to human-resources@juvare.com. The e-mail should include a description of the requested accommodation and the position you’re applying for or interested in.
Affirmative Action: Juvare’s Affirmative Action Plan advances our principles of equal opportunity and supports that goal by enlarging our talent pool.

Maintain an integrated portfolio roadmap and resolve cross-product priorities, investment tradeoffs, capability overlaps, and dependencies.
Partner with Engineering and Design to empower teams around clear problems and measurable customer and business outcomes.

blocks.text: Portfolio Strategy, Growth, and Product Adoption

items: Translate Juvare’s company strategy into a coherent portfolio strategy across Federal, SLED, Healthcare, Critical Infrastructure, and shared platform capabilities.

Build and institutionalize a repeatable Juvare Growth Playbook for net-new products, zero-to-one and one-to-many growth, adjacent-market expansion, and cross-sell and upsell within the installed base.

Define the evidence required before investment, including strategic fit, validated customer need, outside-in market evidence, differentiation, funding and willingness to pay, revenue potential, repeatability, technical feasibility, and delivery economics.

Own Juvare’s product-adoption measurement framework, observability, and Pendo operating model, including instrumentation standards, Core Events, page and feature tagging, segmentation, dashboards, data quality, and recurring portfolio reviews.

Own Juvare’s product data strategy, partnering with PMs and the Partnership program, to enable embedded data that drives differentiated insights, AI capabilities, and commercial value across the product portfolio.

blocks.text: New Product Innovation and NPI Accelerator Partnership

items: Own the Product organization’s New Product Innovation process and serve as the primary Product Management counterpart to the NPI Accelerator Team.

Partner with the Accelerator to define the product opportunity and target market, customer discovery and early-adopter strategy, prototype and first-version objectives, pricing hypotheses, learning goals, Alpha/Beta/LA/GA criteria, and organizational handoff.
Ensure new concepts are validated for customer value, commercial viability, strategic fit, usability, security, supportability, and repeatability, not merely technical feasibility.
Define graduation criteria and post-graduation ownership, roadmap, staffing, support, implementation, and go-to-market plans.
Maintain a transparent NPI portfolio and help scale successful offerings from design partners into repeatable, referenceable, market-ready products.

blocks.text: Juvare AI Strategy and Adoption

items: Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, packaging, and performance of Juvare AI.

Define differentiated JAI value across Juvare’s markets and develop an integrated roadmap spanning embedded assistance, role-aware agents, workflow automation, decision support, analytics, insights, and agent orchestration.

Prioritize JAI use cases based on customer value, market demand, data readiness, portfolio reuse, commercial potential, and operational outcomes; ensure JAI is embedded in the workflows where customers perform critical work.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal, and Compliance to ensure JAI is secure, explainable, governable, auditable, and appropriate for regulated and mission-critical environments.

Establish and monitor measurable JAI adoption goals, including activation, repeat usage, workflow penetration, time to value, task completion and time savings, trust and satisfaction, expansion, revenue influence, and referenceability.
Work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, and Support on positioning, demonstrations, enablement, onboarding, adoption programs, and customer success plans.

blocks.text: Commercialization and Customer Leadership

items: Maintain direct engagement with strategic customers, prospects, advisory groups, early adopters, and customer-facing teams.

Ensure every major launch includes validated positioning, pricing, packaging, enablement, operational readiness, Pendo instrumentation, adoption targets, in-app onboarding or guidance, and post-launch measurement.
Connect customer needs and adoption evidence to platform investment and vertical roadmaps, and represent Product Management in major customer, partner, executive, board, and investor discussions.

blocks.text: What Success Looks Like

items: During the first 12 months, this leader will have:
Established clear accountability across Product Management and an integrated portfolio roadmap connecting market solutions, platform capabilities, Juvare Exchange, data, and AI.
Implemented a repeatable Growth Playbook and NPI process with clear investment, stage-gate, graduation, handoff, and scale criteria.
Build and lead customer advisory boards and practitioner communities to inform product strategy, validate new offerings, strengthen adoption, and develop referenceable customer advocates.
Developed a focused JAI roadmap with measurable adoption and commercial objectives.
Established a portfolio-wide product health and adoption framework in Pendo, with reliable instrumentation, executive dashboards, and a recurring review cadence.
Improved activation, time to value, feature and workflow adoption, repeat usage, and customer referenceability across priority products, especially JAI.

Evaluate portfolio pricing and packaging strategy in partnership with Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing, including value metrics, willingness-to-pay validation, commercial guardrails, and pricing performance; recommending necessary actions.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Creative Capability
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
Why we're hiring:
WPP Open is WPP's AI-powered marketing platform, helping teams move from insight and ideation through to the development and delivery of effective creative work at scale.
We are building the trusted environment where the best of AI and human craft meet, so that when a creative chooses to work in Open, it is because Open genuinely makes the work better, not just faster. Done well, this means creative teams across WPP trust Open enough to bring their best thinking to it first, every time, rather than working around it.
We are looking for a seasoned marketing and advertising creative technologist with a passion for building industry-leading products to join as a Director of Product for Creative and help lead the creative capability in WPP Open. This is a hands-on, practitioner-led product role for someone who has spent real time inside agency creative and production teams, using AI tools day-to-day to develop visual concepts, generate assets, produce video and iterate creative routes, not just experimenting with them in isolation.
Sitting at the intersection of code, AI and craft, you will work directly alongside creative directors, strategists and producers to prototype and stress-test ideas quickly, determining which combination of AI models, tools and human skill is needed to bring a concept to life at the speed and quality the work demands. You will be the hands-on translator who bridges the gap between what a creative idea needs and what WPP Open can build, benchmarking industry practice, evaluating new tools, and turning validated ways of working into repeatable product capability that the wider creative community can rely on.
A major part of this role is earning the trust of creative practitioners by proving, in their hands and on real briefs, that WPP Open can help them push ideas further rather than simply produce them faster.
What you'll be doing:
This role sits within Experience Development, the team shaping how WPP Open turns ideas, workflows and AI capability into usable product experiences. You will work closely with Creative, Product, Technology, Product Design, Research and client-facing teams. You will:
Lead and grow the creative technology capability within WPP Open, setting the standard for how AI tools and workflows are applied across the creative process, from first idea to finished concept.
Act as the hands-on translator between creative ambition and technical execution, taking a brief or idea and working out which mix of AI models, tools and human craft is needed to deliver it at speed.
Shape product priorities by prototyping and iterating concepts directly alongside creative directors, strategists and producers, stress-testing ideas before they move into production.
Own a defined product area within the creative capability, translating practitioner needs, client opportunities and platform strategy into a clear set of priorities and outcomes.
Define clear product requirements in partnership with design, research, engineering and delivery teams, making sure validated ideas can move from discovery into build without losing the creative intent.
Use practitioner feedback, client signals, usage data and market insight to make prioritisation decisions, balancing creative value, feasibility, adoption and commercial impact.
Benchmark and evaluate the fast-moving landscape of AI creative and video models, as well as native AI creative platforms, to identify what's working, what's missing, and where WPP Open should build, partner or buy.
Partner with product and engineering teams to turn validated creative workflows into scalable, reusable capability within WPP Open, including nodes, pipelines and templates.
Mentor and set craft standards for a growing community of creative technologists across WPP's agencies, sharing best practice on prompt design, model selection and creative-AI workflow.
Own the feasibility and quality bar for AI-generated creative work, validating that outputs are genuinely usable in real marketing campaigns, not just impressive in a demo.
Represent the voice of the creative practitioner in product discovery, roadmap planning and stakeholder alignment, ensuring new capabilities reflect how ideation and concept development actually happen.
Build and maintain a library of proven creative AI techniques, prompts and workflows that can be taught and reused across teams.
Support pitches, client demos and showcases by rapidly producing high-craft, AI-assisted creative work that demonstrates what's possible in OPEN.
Define clear success measures for new creative capabilities, including adoption by practitioners, quality of outputs, reusability across teams and value demonstrated in client-facing work.
What you'll need:
Extensive hands-on experience in an advertising, marketing or production environment, using AI creative and video tools to produce real campaign assets, not just personal experimentation.
A strong craft background in creative development, with a clear understanding of how ideas move from concept through to something that can be judged, shared and produced.
Proven experience prototyping quickly, ideally within agency creative or production teams, turning a brief or idea into a working proof of concept under time pressure.
Deep, current knowledge of the AI creative tools landscape, and genuine comfort experimenting with new models, tools and workflows as they emerge.
Working technical fluency, such as familiarity with APIs, no-code or low-code workflow tools, or light scripting, to prototype and integrate AI tools into production pipelines.
Experience leading, mentoring or setting standards for a team or community of creative practitioners.
The credibility and communication skills to work effectively with creative directors, strategists, producers and clients, helping them see what's possible.
A pragmatic, hands-on approach, equally comfortable in strategic conversations and hands-on tool experimentation.
Experience benchmarking, evaluating and recommending creative tools or vendors in a commercial or agency setting.
Strong product judgement, with experience turning user problems into product opportunities, making trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams around clear outcomes.
Experience working with roadmaps, requirements, discovery and delivery teams, ideally in a product-led environment where adoption, usability and business value are measured.
Genuine enthusiasm for pushing the boundaries of what AI can do for creative and production work, paired with a clear-eyed view of where it still falls short.
Who you are:
You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?
#LI-Hybrid
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobs.title: Design Director
jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About the Role
Monks is seeking an experienced Design Director to provide creative leadership for an embedded team supporting one of our largest technology clients. Working in person alongside client stakeholders, this role will maintain creative continuity, uphold a high standard of craft and ensure work remains cohesive across teams, shifts and deliverables.
The ideal candidate has deep experience working within robust design systems and knows how to apply established standards without making the work feel mechanical. You will guide designers and motion creatives, resolve design questions quickly and help the team deliver polished editorial and marketing content at speed.
An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.
Work Location & Schedule
This role requires working onsite at our client's office in Menlo Park, CA, 4–5 days per week.
In This Role, You Will
Provide day-to-day creative leadership for the embedded design and motion team.
Maintain continuity and a consistent creative standard across locations, shifts and workstreams.
Translate established brand guidelines and design systems into clear, actionable direction.
Ensure work is visually cohesive, accurate and appropriately tailored to its audience and channel.
Review and guide digital, web, editorial, presentation, graphic and motion deliverables.
Partner closely with the Executive Producer to balance creative quality with timing, capacity and business priorities.
Work directly with client stakeholders to clarify creative direction, resolve feedback and keep work moving.
Provide clear, consolidated feedback that enables teams to execute efficiently.
Identify when existing components or templates can be used and when a new design solution is required.
Support the evolution of templates, component libraries and documentation as program needs develop.
Collaborate with technical writers to ensure design supports the clarity and integrity of complex subject matter.
Mentor designers and motion creatives, providing practical guidance and helping them operate with greater independence.
Partner with AI and creative technology specialists to explore responsible ways to improve workflows, consistency and production efficiency.
Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.
Experience You Bring
8+ years of experience in design, art direction or creative direction within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and maintaining quality across high-volume or rapid-turn work.
Deep familiarity with established brand systems, component libraries, templates and scalable design frameworks.
Strong digital and web design experience, including responsive layouts and accessibility considerations.
Ability to assess work quickly, provide decisive direction and distinguish critical issues from subjective preferences.
Strong understanding of typography, hierarchy, composition, visual storytelling and motion principles.
Experience collaborating with production, editorial, product, legal and technical stakeholders.
Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required.
Excellent presentation, communication and feedback skills.
Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.
Working Model
This is an in-person, client-facing role embedded with the client team. The Design Director will guide a distributed creative team operating across multiple global locations and shifts, with availability during core client working hours and flexibility around urgent priorities.
At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.
#LI-INPERSON
#LI-ZZ1
What We Offer
Benefits
Excellent, full coverage medical, dental, and vision insurance
Generous PTO and 15 company-wide holidays
401k with company contribution
Paid parental leave
Work-life balance with an emphasis on personal well-being
Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network
A globally diverse & inclusive culture with employee resource groups such as S4 Melanin, Pride.Monks, Cultura.Monks, and more!
Authentic commitment to DEI efforts and sustainable growth. (Why Sir Martin Sorrell signed The Climate Pledge here!)
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.
Monks has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what Monks may pay for the position at the time of posting. Monks may ultimately pay more or less than the posted compensation range. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on job-related factors, but not based on a candidate’s sex or any other protected status.
Salary Range:
$130,000—$150,000 USD
About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation.
1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.
Your Title: Senior Director of Engineering
Your Location: Hybrid – Edison, NJ HQ
You Report to: SVP of Engineering and Chief Architect
Compensation: $225,000 or more depending upon experience
At 1Kosmos, our leaders are active, builder-first contributors. We are looking for an engineering leader who stays close to the code—someone who enjoys diving into technical challenges, understanding system internals, and driving execution from the front lines through active participation in architectural design, code reviews, and hands-on problem-solving.
You possess an "always sleeveless" mindset: no task is too technical, no bug is too small, and no architecture is too complex for you to dive into. You will step into a cloud-agnostic microservices environment, gain deep context on what we’ve built, and actively drive execution, performance, security, and system evolution.
What You’ll Do:
- Lead from the Front: Manage, mentor, and elevate a mid-sized engineering team while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in code, system design, and infrastructure.
- Master Existing Architecture First: Take full ownership of existing architectures. Deeply understand the whybehind our current design decisions before making tactical shifts or introducing new paradigms.
- Build Real Agentic Systems: Work hands-on with our agentic stack (AWS Bedrock / Python / Node), going far beyond basic LLM prompts or chatbots. Open the hood to optimize agent workflows, orchestration, reliability, and security.
- Drive Performance & Security: Maintain a relentless focus on low latency, high throughput, platform resilience, and enterprise security across our cloud-agnostic microservices topology.
- Own Delivery & Reliability: Partner with product and QA leads to ensure clean, reliable, and zero-downtime deployments.
- Foster a Zero-Ego Culture: Build a collaborative environment where ownership is non-negotiable, and execution speaks louder than slides.
What you bring:
- 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent, hands-on engineering leadership (Director / VP level in high-growth B2B SaaS).
- Core Microservices Stack: Deep, practical experience in Node.js (90% of our stack) alongside Java or GoLang.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on mastery of containerized, cloud-agnostic environments (Kubernetes, AWS).
- Applied Agentic Experience: Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing autonomous agents and agentic workflows (experience with AWS Bedrock is a huge plus).
- Security-First Mindset: Deep appreciation for platform security, identity management, compliance, and secure software development practices.
- Leadership Style: Proven track record of both building 0-to-1 systems and taking ownership of mature, inherited codebases.
Who thrives here:
Builders who love creating something from nothing and aren't afraid of rolling up their sleeves
Fast movers who navigate ambiguity with confidence and iterate at speed
Problem solvers who are energized by complex, evolving challenges
Collaborators who can influence without authority and build strong cross-functional relationships
Data enthusiasts who let evidence drive decisions, not opinions
Mission-driven professionals passionate about fighting fraud and protecting customers
What we offer:
Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup
Competitive salary and equity package
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Unlimited PTO Policy
Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible
