jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering, EPM
jobs.text:
About Us:
insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.
Job Description:
As Vice President of Software Engineering for our Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) portfolio, you will lead a global organization of engineers across multiple product lines that finance teams rely on to plan, close, consolidate and report. You will own how that portfolio is built, shipped and run.
2027 is a transformation year. We are modernizing established applications, building new SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities, moving to an agentic software development lifecycle, and putting AI directly into the hands of our customers. We need a leader who can deliver all four at once without compromising the quality and reliability our customers depend on for their most critical financial processes, and who measures success with the same discipline our customers apply to their numbers.
We enjoy our work as much as we enjoy working together, and we want leaders who get things done while having a positive influence on our workplace environment.
What you will deliver in 2027
1. Modernize legacy applications
Define and execute a modernization strategy for the EPM portfolio, choosing deliberately between re-platform, re-architect, strangler-pattern migration, and retirement for each product and component
Sequence modernization to deliver customer value incrementally, avoiding big-bang rewrites and protecting customers already in production
Reduce technical debt measurably, with a visible debt register, investment targets and progress reported to executive leadership
Plan and execute customer migrations from on-premise and single-tenant deployments with clear data-integrity, cutover and rollback plans
2. Build SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities
Lead the design and delivery of cloud-native, multi-tenant services, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, configuration and extensibility models
Build the shared platform capabilities that product teams rely on: identity, observability, metering, tenant provisioning, and self-service environments
Own SaaS operational excellence: SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident management, capacity planning, cost efficiency, and disaster recovery
Embed security, privacy and compliance (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) into architecture and delivery pipelines rather than treating them as downstream gates
3. Deliver with an agentic SDLC
Lead the shift from AI-assisted coding to an agentic software development lifecycle, where AI agents participate in planning, coding, testing, code review, documentation and operations
Establish the guardrails that make this safe: human review policy, test and evaluation gates, provenance and traceability of AI-generated changes, and secure handling of code and data
Redesign team workflows, roles and skills for agentic delivery, and coach engineering managers and engineers through the change
Measure the impact rigorously, proving gains in flow, quality and reliability rather than tracking adoption alone
4. Build customer-facing AI features
Partner with Product to deliver AI capabilities that finance users trust, such as natural-language analysis, forecasting assistance, anomaly detection and agentic workflows across planning, close and reporting
Build the engineering foundations for production AI: model and prompt management, retrieval over governed financial data, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring for accuracy, drift and cost
Apply responsible-AI practices appropriate to financial data, including explainability, auditability, tenant data isolation, and clear human-in-the-loop controls
Ship AI features on the same delivery standards as the rest of the portfolio: tested, observable, reversible and measured against defined quality bars
5. Raise the bar on quality and DORA outcomes
Own engineering outcomes against the DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, failed deployment recovery time, and rework rate), with transparent baselines and quarterly improvement targets for every product line
Build quality in: test automation across the pyramid, continuous integration on every change, trunk-based development, feature flags, and progressive delivery
Make reliability a product feature through service-level objectives, error budgets that inform prioritization, and blameless post-incident reviews that lead to lasting fixes
Shift security left with automated scanning, dependency and vulnerability management, and secure-by-default pipelines
Report development status, quality, operations and system performance to executive management using a consistent engineering scorecard, and act quickly and decisively to resolve customer-impacting issues
Leadership responsibilities
Lead multiple software development teams and product lines, including staffing, mentoring, and building high-performing teams across multiple disciplines and geographies
Collaborate with architects, product managers, software development managers and developers to arrive at the best technical design and approach, delivering value quickly without sacrificing quality
Drive engineering roadmaps, operational plans and delivery commitments within an Agile/Lean environment, balancing modernization, new capability and operational health
Manage departmental budget and resources, including the mix of full-time employees, contractors and suppliers, and negotiate contracts and SOWs with vendors
Build an engineering culture of ownership, psychological safety, continuous improvement and customer focus, where teams own what they build in production
Evolve the software development practice across the organization, including practices, tooling, reporting and methodology
Competencies
Proven delivery leader – Brings deep software development and operational management experience and shows what good looks like in practice
Transformation leadership – Leads large-scale technical and organizational change while keeping the business running
Quality and reliability mindset – Treats quality, security and reliability as non-negotiable outcomes, and knows how to engineer them into the system
Data-driven decision making – Uses metrics to understand flow and outcomes, and to guide investment, not to police teams
Leadership and vision – Inspires people at all levels to follow a clear technical and operational vision
Planning and management – Highly effective planning, organizational and operational skills
Discipline and perseverance – Commitment to solving complex issues through to completion
Adaptability – Operates in a fast-paced, iterative environment; learns and adapts to new business demands and fast-changing AI technologies
Problem solving – Strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities
Effective communicator – Excellent written, presentation and oral communication at both executive and team level
Prioritization – Uses a sense of urgency to prioritize effectively and manage time well
Qualifications and experience
Required
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Prior experience serving as a Vice President of Engineering, with 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience
10+ years of software development experience, with at least five years building and running cloud products using Java, C#, and JavaScript/TypeScript
7+ years leading multiple Agile teams and programs, with expert understanding of Agile and Lean principles
5+ years driving full DevOps and continuous delivery practices, with a demonstrated track record of improving DORA metrics and software quality at scale
3+ years managing global engineering teams and suppliers across multiple products, including teams built from a combination of FTE and contractor resourcing
Proven experience leading the modernization of legacy or on-premise enterprise applications to cloud-native SaaS, including customer migrations
Hands-on leadership experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture and operational production responsibility, including SLOs, incident management and on-call
Demonstrated experience using AI and agentic tooling to measurably improve the productivity and quality of engineering teams across a product portfolio
Proven ability to manage multiple product lines and meet release commitments
Experience negotiating contracts and SOWs with vendors
Preferred
Master's degree in a technical or business discipline
Experience shipping customer-facing AI or machine learning features to production, including LLM-based capabilities, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation frameworks
Experience with EPM, FP&A, financial close or other finance applications where accuracy and auditability are critical
Experience operating under enterprise security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR
Familiarity with platform engineering and internal developer platforms
Broad experience across application platforms, middleware, frameworks, cloud providers (AWS, Azure) and programming languages

jobs.title: VP, Product Management, Social
jobs.text:
Job Description:
Build the Future of Social Technology at Scale
Social is evolving fast. The technology that powers it should too.
At dentsu, we're looking for a strategic product leader who understands the intersection of social media, marketing technology, data, and product innovation. If you're passionate about building enterprise products, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and shaping the future of social activation technology, this could be the role you've been waiting for.
As our VP, Product Management, Social, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products that support audience intelligence, social activation, creator workflows, reporting, measurement, and emerging AI-powered capabilities across our media technology ecosystem.
This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll influence senior stakeholders, collaborate across business and technology teams, and drive products from concept through launch and adoption.
What You'll Do
Set the Vision
Develop and communicate a multi-year product vision for dentsu's social activation portfolio.
Identify market opportunities across social media, creator marketing, audience intelligence, AI, identity, privacy, and workflow automation.
Turn ambiguous business challenges into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
Drive Product Strategy & Execution
Lead cross-functional product initiatives involving business, engineering, data, design, operations, and external partners.
Prioritize investments, features, integrations, and platform enhancements based on customer needs and business impact.
Ensure products move from vision to delivery while maintaining alignment with strategic goals.
Create Scalable Solutions
Transform one-off client solutions into repeatable, productized offerings.
Improve workflows through automation, orchestration, and platform integration.
Establish operating models that support adoption, onboarding, support, reporting, and long-term growth.
Influence & Collaborate
Partner with senior leaders across social, media, technology, data, commercial, and product organizations.
Support executive presentations, strategic client discussions, product demonstrations, and new business opportunities.
Serve as a trusted advisor on social technology, activation, audience intelligence, and product strategy.
What Makes You a Great Fit
You're a product leader who can see the big picture while remaining close enough to the details to get things done.
You likely bring:
10+ years of product management, product strategy, AdTech, MarTech, media technology, SaaS, or related experience.
Experience building product vision and strategy, not just managing features or backlogs.
Deep understanding of social media technologies, workflows, and activation platforms.
Experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions and actionable plans.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Why Join dentsu?
This is an opportunity to shape a strategic growth area within one of the world's leading marketing and technology organizations.
You'll have the chance to:
Define the future of social activation products at enterprise scale.
Influence AI-enabled and next-generation workflow solutions.
Partner with industry leaders across media, technology, and data.
Solve complex challenges with real business impact.
Help create products used by practitioners and clients across the dentsu ecosystem.
Ready to Build What's Next?
We're looking for a leader who understands social technology, thrives in complexity, and can turn vision into reality. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.
At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.
The annual salary range for this position is $1360,000 - $170,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.
Benefits available with this position include:
• Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
• Life insurance,
• Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
• 401k,
• Flexible paid time off,
• At least 15 paid holidays per year,
• Paid sick and safe leave, and
• Paid parental leave.
Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.
To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.
Location:
USA - Remote - Maryland
Brand:
Merkle
Time Type:
Full time
Contract Type:
Permanent
Dentsu is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We do this without regard to race, color, national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
Dentsu is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to search and apply for a career opportunity with us, please send an e-mail to by clicking on the link to let us know the nature of your accommodation request and your contact information. We are here to support you.

jobs.title: Vice President, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Career-defining. Life-changing.
At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career
About This Role:
iRhythm is seeking a Vice President of Software Engineering to provide technical and organizational leadership across our regulated software platforms. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Systems Development, this leader is accountable for ensuring the successful delivery, performance, and scalability of software products and platforms. These solutions enable clinician workflows, enhance patient experiences, integrate connected medical devices, and provide the data infrastructure necessary to support innovation, operational excellence, and growth. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution at scale, requiring executive leadership and offering exceptional visibility across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Software Delivery & Operational Execution
Lead end-to-end software engineering execution across clinical, patient-facing, platform, and device-integrated software systems within a highly regulated Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) environment.
Establish and continuously evolve the engineering operating systems, governance frameworks, and development practices that enable disciplined planning, transparent execution, effective risk management, and predictable delivery across a complex software portfolio.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives that measurably enhance engineering velocity, product quality, release confidence, system reliability, and customer outcomes.
Ensure software development lifecycle processes consistently meet regulatory, compliance, and quality standards, including FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, cybersecurity, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
Translate complex technical concepts, delivery risks, and strategic tradeoffs into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Advance software engineering capabilities through scalable CI/CD frameworks, development platforms, automation, and engineering enablement tools appropriate for regulated medical technology environments.
Lead the responsible adoption and governance of AI-assisted software development practices to accelerate innovation, enhance productivity, improve quality, and reduce delivery risk.
Establish a metrics-driven engineering culture by leveraging meaningful operational and quality indicators to increase transparency, predictability, accountability, and data-informed decision making.
Team Development & Leadership
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of software engineering directors, managers, and senior technical leaders, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and execution excellence.
Serve as a thought leader, trusted advisor and mentor to engineering leaders, cultivating leadership capability, organizational resilience, and a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical excellence across the company.
Cross-Functional & Strategic Contributions
Partner closely with executive and functional leaders across Product Security, Software Quality, Research & Systems Engineering, Machine Learning, and IT to ensure seamless execution, architectural alignment, and delivery excellence across the product portfolio.
Drive alignment and shared accountability across Product Management, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and other cross-functional teams to successfully deliver innovative solutions from concept through commercialization.
Lead software engineering diligence, technical assessments, and post-acquisition integration activities in support of the company's mergers and acquisitions strategy.
Contribute to the development and execution of the long-term software platform, architecture, and technology strategy, ensuring scalability, innovation, and competitive differentiation.
Qualifications
Required Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive software engineering leadership experience, including leadership of large-scale engineering organizations and senior technology leaders.
Demonstrated success leading the development and delivery of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions within highly regulated medical device environments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Director, AI & Agent
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
AI is not a feature at OKX. It is the next fundamental layer of how we serve users, operate at scale, and maintain trust in a regulated, global market.
We are hiring a Senior Directort of Product, AI & Agent (Chatbot) to own OKX's full AI product agenda — outward, through a crypto-native AI assistant that transforms how users experience our platform; and inward, through agentic systems that make our operations intelligent, auditable, and scalable. This is a single role with a unified mandate: building the AI layer that defines OKX's next decade.
What You’ll Be Doing
User-Facing AI Lead the strategy and execution of OKX's conversational AI assistant — an experience that lets users onboard, trade, stay informed, and get support through natural language. You will define what this product is, how it earns user trust, and how it deepens over time.
Operational AI & Agent Systems Own the agentic AI roadmap for OKX's internal functions — compliance, risk, fraud, and operations. You will identify the highest-leverage workflows, lead their systematic transformation into agent-driven systems, and ensure every output is traceable and regulatorily defensible.
AI Platform Own the product design of shared infrastructure that powers both mandates — orchestration, evaluation, safety architecture, and the governance layer that makes AI products configurable and auditable across all markets.
What We Look For In You
12+ years in product & tech, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning technically complex products at scale
Proven track record shipping conversational AI or agentic AI products — as the owner, not a contributor
Deep familiarity with LLM product architecture: multi-agent systems, RAG, tool use, evaluation, and safety design
Experience operating in regulated environments where auditability and explainability are hard requirements
Strong consumer product instinct alongside operational product rigor
Fluency in financial markets and what it takes to earn user and institutional trust
Executive-level communication in English and Mandarin
Nice-To-Haves
Background in crypto, fintech, or financial services at global scale
Graduate degree in a technical field
Experience with successful Conversational AI or Agentic AI products
Why this role
OKX operates at a scale where the gap between what AI can do and what we have built is still enormous. This role exists to close that gap — on both sides of the platform, simultaneously. If that is the kind of problem you want to own, we want to talk.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
#LI-WWW
#LI-ONSITE
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
You
Are passionate about technology, wake up every morning to experiment, learn and develop new solutions!
You Will
Work on latest edge Cloud computing to solve difficult, manual and repeatable tasks for users adopting Cloud technologies like AWS, Salesforce, Microsoft and more
Use the latest trends on building SaaS applications using multitenancy, scalability large data volumes / Big Data and more
Develop and expand our portfolio to support most popular Cloud apps (200+)
Develop understanding of not just software development, but also how to design, develop and launch a product from concept to high customer use.
About Us
At DBSync we provide opportunity to use technology that creates innovative and next generation data integration products which helps our employees to cultivate their creativity and sense of belonging. DBSync is a leading provider for data integration and Data warehousing services for both cloud/SAAS-based-on-demand applications. We were incubated by Salesforce.com (as a part of Avankia), before getting spunned off as a separate company. DBSync provides data integration as a SAAS-based, Standalone or hosted integration at a competitive price with a plethora of benefits for business users.
Our main motto is to provide a strong foundation for businesses in solving complex problems and automating their workflows while acting as a pillar of support for all their data integrations needs. At DBSync we encourage innovation and creativity and our team is diverse comprising of a nice mix of cultural blends. We are a family where each talent is recognised and honed for the best of the individual and the company as a whole. We maintain a very professional, learn and excel vision with a hint of a start-up-like environment making each individual feel important and responsible with an equal opportunity to grow to the sky’s limit!
If you have a spirit of enthusiasm to grow beyond horizons, a determination to work hard, confidence to achieve success and influence future visions and products and be a successful part of the next gen trend, DBSync is the place for you!
Our Value System
We genuinely care
We do not waste time on manual or mundane task
We have a fun environment
We own it
We are experts on what we do
We win together
DBSync has been:
We have been rated 4.7 / 5 on G2. We have got around 125 reviews in 2023.
Based on the reviews G2 has awarded DBSync following badges.
- Best Relationship- Winter 2024
- Leader Americas Winter 2024
- Best Results - Winter 2024
- Best Usability - Winter 2024
About the Role
We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for working directly with development, support, implementation, and other internal teams as well as external vendors and clients. The Head of Engineering will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the engineering department within the organization. This role requires strong leadership skills, technical expertise, and a strategic mindset to drive innovation and ensure the successful delivery of engineering projects.
You will work directly with the CEO/CTO and will act as both a technology and business expert, making decisions that will impact the current and future operations of the company.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Manage multiple engineering projects and ensure successful delivery of products on time and within budget
Lead a team of engineers and provide guidance on technical issues
Collaborate with other teams such as product, design, and customer support to ensure smooth product development and delivery
Ensure coding standards, best practices, and security protocols are followed by the team
Hire, train, and mentor engineers and support staff
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve the engineering process
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and partners to ensure projects are completed successfully
Must have successfully delivered at least two projects end-to-end.
Oversight of the full software development lifecycle required for a group of developers and testers in an agile environment.
Leading staff to implement clients in the most efficient, time driven manner. The manager is responsible for the total quality of the technical deliverables in their domain, making sure that they are secure, defect-free.
Mentoring technical staff during projects to ensure continuous improvement. Includes working with each resource to define and act upon career paths and obtain appropriate training. Is responsible for the hiring, training, staff development, performance appraisals, corrective action and pay review of technical personnel.
Developing and establishing department standards and procedures.
Recommends the most efficient ways to ensure best implementation practices of new upgraded products.
Evaluates and reports progress and results.
Skills and Qualifications Required:
Must have hands-on experience in Java, Front end technologies like Bootstrap, jQuery, AWS, Modular software development, multi-tenant architecture and highly scalable systems.
Proficient with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Must have a minimum of 8-10 years of experience demonstrating required skills and competencies in engineering
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MS/MBA or other relevant graduate degree is a plus.
Must have hands on Full stack architecture experience
Have in-depth conceptual functional and non-functional knowledge of Docker Containers, Kubernetes Cluster management and orchestration, microservice architectures, DevOps practices and tooling.
Previous leadership or management experience required
Strong communication skills are a requirement, as this position must build consensus with numerous internal and external resources and effectively influence the technical direction of projects in order to be successful.
Ability to determine the best implementation approach/methodology for assigned project(s) based on established guidelines and best practices and determine appropriate strategy for ensuring desired objectives.
Must be very flexible with learning new technology quickly.
Location: Bangalore (Remote)
Shift Timings: U.K. Shift (1:30 PM IST - 10:30 PM IST)
For more information about DBSync, visit www.mydbsync.com.

jobs.title: Director, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.text:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.
Why you’ll love this role
Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the AI/ML engineering strategy, build and develop the team, and make the decisions that move our highest-impact opportunities forward. You’ll partner with Product, Data Science, and business leaders to decide where we invest, what we build, and how we measure success.
What you’ll do
Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.
About you
10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.
7+ years of practical ML or data science experience, including experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, search, or recommendation systems.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.
Clear, compelling communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, make tough prioritization decisions, and turn ambiguity into action.
Nice to have skills
Experience managing managers or leading multiple ML engineering or applied science teams.
Marketplace, e-commerce, or Supply Chain experience, particularly in search, recommendations, computer vision, or fraud and trust and safety.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; experience with AWS and shared ML platforms.

StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. jobs.title: Director, Scientific Data & Informatics
jobs.text:
About the Role
Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve >250 R&D institutions, including most of the top global biotech & pharma companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.
The Director, Scientific Data & Informatics will own the integrity, structure, and evolution of Drug Hunter’s scientific data across our knowledge platform and scientific databases. You will lead the scientific data team within our Technical organization and be the bridge between our scientists and our engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary internal subject-matter expert for cheminformatics and scientific data, with sufficient breadth across bioinformatics and drug discovery data to guide data decisions spanning chemistry and biology.
Own the scientific strategy for how Drug Hunter acquires, represents, integrates, normalizes, and maintains scientific data, partnering with Engineering on the architecture and systems that operationalize that strategy and Science on both automated and manual data curation processes.
Define how chemical entities are represented, registered, standardized, and resolved across sources, and establish curation standards, controlled vocabularies, QA rules, and tooling that allows data curation to take place at scale
Define approaches for extracting structured scientific information from unstructured content, including chemical structures, text, and tables from literature and patents, and establish how extracted information should be linked to canonical entities.
Own the scientific semantics, entity resolution, and ontology strategy that unifies compound synonyms, target and gene nomenclature, disease terms, organizations, assays, and other scientific concepts across sources, including approaches for handling ambiguity and conflicting source assertions.
Evaluate scientific data sources across chemistry, biology, DMPK, drug, and clinical domains, assessing their coverage, scientific quality, overlap, limitations, licensing considerations, and update characteristics, and determine how they should contribute to Drug Hunter's data.
Establish standards for scientific data quality, provenance, validation, completeness, and freshness, and ensure the Data team has effective processes for identifying and resolving data-quality issues.
Partner closely with Science to translate scientific expertise and curation decisions into consistent, maintainable data models, standards, and processes.
Partner with Engineering to define data models and technical approaches that accurately represent complex scientific information and support the Drug Hunter platform, jointly evaluating architectural decisions and trade-offs where data and application systems intersect.
Partner with Product Management to translate scientific and technical requirements into project specifications for the data team and communicate the trade-offs the technical decisions carry.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for scientific datasets, chem- and bio-informatics capabilities, and data tooling, partnering with Engineering where decisions involve shared technical infrastructure or application architecture.
Lead the Data team in translating scientific data priorities into executable projects, remaining sufficiently involved in day-to-day work to understand progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and workload.
Provide scientific and technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data team, creating, hiring, and managing roles as needed.

jobs.text:
UNPAID VOLUNTEER – Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Role Title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Role Type: Unpaid Volunteer
Number of Positions: 1
Location: Home-based / Remote
Time Commitment: Approximately 20 hours per week, flexibly arranged
Reporting To: Director-General
THIS IS AN UNPAID VOLUNTEER ROLE.
About DTID
The Digital Technology Institute for Development (DTID) is an international non-profit institute advancing the responsible use of artificial intelligence, blockchain and emerging digital technologies to support sustainable development and policy implementation.
DTID brings together professionals, researchers, technology specialists and other stakeholders to generate research, develop practical solutions, strengthen partnerships and support informed decision-making at the intersection of technology, climate change and sustainable development.
The Role
DTID is seeking an experienced, innovative and technically accomplished Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to provide strategic and technical leadership across the organisation's emerging technology portfolio.
Reporting directly to the Director-General, the CTO will lead DTID's work across Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)/Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Data Science, Big Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Quantum Computing and technology standards.
The successful candidate will be responsible for defining DTID's technology strategy, overseeing technology research and development, leading technical teams and translating emerging technologies into practical solutions that support climate action, sustainable development and policy implementation.
The CTO will also oversee the development of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology applications; strengthen DTID's internal technical capabilities; develop strategic partnerships; and provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary projects.
Strong practical proficiency in blockchain development and programming is essential for this role. Experience developing artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions is highly desirable.
This is a senior leadership position requiring strong technical expertise, strategic thinking, people leadership and the ability to communicate complex technology concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
The Chief Technology Officer will:
Define and lead DTID's technology strategy and roadmap across blockchain, artificial intelligence, IoT, data technologies, quantum computing and related emerging technologies.
Lead and manage DTID's emerging technology teams and standards-development activities, including recruitment, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.
Oversee the design, development, testing and deployment of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology solutions.
Guide the application of DLT/Blockchain, AI, machine learning, data science, data modelling, IoT and other emerging technologies across DTID projects.
Ensure appropriate standards for the quality, reliability, security, scalability and documentation of DTID's technology products and solutions.
Monitor and evaluate the performance and impact of technology initiatives and recommend improvements where appropriate.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to Technology Officers and multidisciplinary project teams.
Identify and develop strategic technology partnerships with research institutions, technology organisations, governments, international organisations and other relevant stakeholders.
Monitor emerging technology trends and assess their potential application to climate action, sustainable development and public policy.
Represent DTID at relevant conferences, technical forums, stakeholder meetings and external engagements.
Contribute technical expertise to DTID research, publications, standards, proposals and institutional initiatives.
Collaborate with the Director-General and other senior leaders to ensure technology priorities support DTID's wider strategic objectives.

jobs.title: VP Product Management
jobs.text:
VP Product Management
POSITION OVERVIEW
Speedcastis accelerating its expansion into high-growth markets, and the SIGMA platform sits at the center of that strategy. As Vice President of Product Management for SIGMA, you will serve as the de facto general manager of this business unit — owning full P&L accountability, defining the multi-year product roadmap, and driving end-to-end Go-To-Market execution across existing and emerging verticals.
This is a rare opportunity for a deeply technical, commercially minded leader to shape the future of a mission-critical platform deployed at the network edge. You will combine strong product instincts with edge computeexpertiseto evolve SIGMA from a managed connectivity layer into an intelligent, programmable edge ecosystem — unlocking new revenue streams forSpeedcastacross enterprise, energy, maritime, rail, and emerging markets including India and the Middle East.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
P&L Ownership & Business Leadership
Own the full P&L for the SIGMA platform, including revenue targets, margin performance, investment prioritization, and budget management
Serve as the internal executive champion for SIGMA,establishingaccountability frameworks and operating rhythms across product, engineering, sales, and delivery
Define and track KPIs that measure platform adoption, customer retention, revenue growth, and margin improvement
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Lead the development of a multi-year SIGMA product roadmap grounded in market requirements, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, andSpeedcast’sstrategic objectives
Drive the integration of edge compute capabilities into SIGMA’s architecture, enabling compute-at-the-edge use cases such as local data processing, AI inferencing, IoT aggregation, and application hosting in bandwidth-constrained or remote environments
Define and own the SIGMA portal strategy, ensuring a best-in-class operator and end-user experience for provisioning, monitoring, and managing edge services
Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to translate product vision into delivery roadmaps, managing trade-offs between speed, scope, and technical debt
Go-To-Market Execution
Architect and lead Go-To-Market strategies for each SIGMA vertical, from value proposition definition through sales enablement, pricing, and launch execution
Collaborate closely with the Head of Sales, Business Development, and vertical leads to drive pipeline generation and close high-value enterprise deals
Develop compelling commercial narratives and competitive differentiation frameworks that equip sales teams to win against both legacy connectivity providers and pure-play edge compute vendors
Represent SIGMA at executive briefings, industry events, and strategic customer engagements
Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
Identify, structure, and manage strategic partnerships with resellers, co-sell partners, white-label operators, and technology integrators acrossSpeedcast’sportfolio (LEO/Starlink, GEO, LTE, SIGMA, and applications)
Lead commercial negotiations and partnership agreement structuring in close collaboration with legal, finance, and product teams
Manage and growSpeedcast’sstrategic relationships with key ecosystem partners including Sify and HCL Tech, andidentifynew partnerships to accelerate SIGMA adoption
Build an ecosystem strategy that extends SIGMA’s addressable market through third-party application integrations, ISV relationships, and platform APIs
Cross-Functional Leadership
Operate as a senior cross-functional leader, aligning product, sales, engineering, innovation, and finance around a coherent SIGMA growth strategy
Present strategy, roadmap, pipeline performance, and investment cases to the CPO and Board-level audiences, with clarity and commercial rigor
Mentor and develop product managers within the SIGMA organization, building a high-performance team culture

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading API
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to develop and maintain our core API trading products. This includes managing internal and external stakeholders, developing product iteration plans, establishing and maintaining standards, translating user stories into an API specification, completing competitor analysis, and more.
What You’ll Be Doing
Gather business requirements and API feedback from both internal and external sources, such as feedback from institutional customers, and continuously improve the API product through effective iterative mechanisms.
Study the competitive landscape and industry trends, transforming this information into actionable API product iteration plans that align with the company's actual needs.
Utilize data analytics to create data-driven insights to understand client behaviour.
Cultivate and maintain robust relationships with customers and strategic partners, using their feedback to guide product enhancements and future development.
What We Look For In You
Demonstrates a strong interest in both the blockchain and finance industries.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Product Management or Engineering, preferably related to trading or technology platforms.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, or Finance.
Proactive and self-driven, with a logical and data-driven mindset, strong team collaboration skills, and effective communication abilities.
Proficiency in English & Conversational Mandarin (preferred to cross functionally communicate with non-english speaking engineers).
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in crypto, blockchain, building businesses, fintech, and/or financial markets.
Experience in trading financial products, such as stocks, funds, forex, futures, options.
Knowledge in data analytical tools like Python and SQL.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Vice President, Solutions Engineering EMEA
jobs.text:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope
Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.
At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.
Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
Location flexible in EMEA.
About the position:
Netskope is seeking an accomplished, strategic, and transformational leader to serve as Vice President, Solutions Engineering for EMEA. Reporting directly to the WW Head of Solutions Engineering, this executive will lead and scale a high-performing Solutions Engineering organization across a diverse, multi-country region.
The VP, Solutions Engineering will be accountable for building an organization that consistently translates customer requirements and business objectives into compelling technical outcomes, technical wins and revenue. This leader will work closely with regional and WW Sales leadership, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to shape go-to-market strategy, improve technical win rates, accelerate sales cycles, and strengthen Netskope’s competitive position.
This is a leadership role centered on scaling people, leaders, methodology, technology, and execution. Individual technical delivery is secondary to building an organization capable of delivering consistent, high-quality technical outcomes at scale. The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of organizational leadership, commercial acumen, technical credibility, and executive presence.
The ideal candidate is a builder and change leader who has successfully transformed and scaled Solutions Engineering organizations in high-growth technology environments. They understand how to develop world-class talent, establish operating discipline, create scalable pre-sales methodologies, leverage data and AI to improve productivity, and build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, and Engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Organization Leadership, Scaling and Talent
Lead, develop and scale a high-performing Solutions Engineering organization across multiple countries, cultures, and markets.
Build and develop a strong leadership bench through the recruitment, coaching, development and retention of SE leaders and individual contributors.
Establish clear career paths, succession plans, performance standards, and talent strategies that support sustained organizational growth.
Build multi-year headcount, capacity, and productivity plans aligned to revenue objectives and business growth.
Establish an operating model that appropriately balances field coverage, strategic account support, technical specialization, partner engagement, and organizational efficiency.
Create a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, technical excellence, collaboration and customer focus.
Develop the next generation of SE leaders and ensure the organization can scale without becoming dependent on individual technical contributors or executives.
Pre-Sales Strategy, Methodology and Execution
Own and continuously evolve the Solutions Engineering methodology across discovery, business and technical qualification, solution alignment, POV/POC execution, and technical close.
Establish consistent standards for technical qualification and customer validation, ensuring SE resources are focused on the opportunities with the highest potential business impact.
Drive consistent adoption of proven methodologies across countries and account teams while allowing appropriate flexibility for local market dynamics.
Establish a metrics-driven operating cadence across pipeline coverage, technical win rate, POV/POC conversion, sales-cycle velocity, capacity, productivity, and other leading indicators.
Identify systemic execution gaps and implement programs that improve technical performance, customer experience, and revenue outcomes.
Continuously improve the SE operating model through data, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable technical processes.
Revenue and Sales Partnership
Partner closely with regional and WW Sales leadership to align SE strategy, coverage, capacity and technical execution with revenue objectives.
Establish joint accountability with Sales for technical win rates, pipeline progression, deal velocity, POV/POC conversion and ultimately revenue.
Develop technical strategies for strategic accounts, competitive opportunities, and complex enterprise pursuits.
Ensure the appropriate level of SE engagement across opportunities based on deal size, complexity, strategic importance, technical risk and customer requirements.
Identify technical risk early in the sales cycle and establish mechanisms to proactively address obstacles to closing.
Coach SE leaders and teams to connect technical capabilities to customer business outcomes rather than simply demonstrating product functionality.
Product, Engineering and Market Leadership
Partner with Product Management and Engineering to translate customer requirements, field intelligence, competitive insights, and emerging technology trends into actionable product and go-to-market priorities.
Establish structured mechanisms for capturing and sharing customer, competitive, and technical intelligence across the organization.
Ensure the SE organization maintains deep expertise across Netskope’s evolving portfolio and the broader cybersecurity landscape.
Help shape Netskope’s technical positioning, differentiation, and market strategy across SASE, SSE, ZTNA, data security, cloud security, and AI security.
Represent the technical voice of the region in company-wide GTM, product, and strategic planning.
Create a strong feedback loop between the field, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
AI and Organizational Transformation
Lead the evolution of Solutions Engineering to support Netskope’s strategic direction in AI security and the transformation of enterprise security in the AI era.
Develop the organization’s technical and consultative capabilities to engage customers on emerging AI security challenges, use cases, risks, and opportunities.
Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation, data, and intelligent workflows to transform discovery, technical qualification, solution design, POV execution, and SE productivity.
Establish scalable mechanisms that enable SEs to conduct deeper customer, technical, and competitive research while reducing manual effort.
Drive the adoption of technology and automation that allows the organization to spend more time on high-value customer engagement and less time on repetitive operational activities.
Help position Netskope’s Solutions Engineering organization as a strategic differentiator in the rapidly evolving AI security market.
Executive Customer Engagement
Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and other senior technology executives at strategic customers and prospects.
Engage directly in the most strategic and complex opportunities where executive-level technical leadership can materially influence the outcome.
Lead or participate in executive briefings, strategic account engagements, customer advisory sessions, and industry events.
Coach SE leaders and teams on executive engagement, business-value selling, storytelling, and consultative technical leadership.
Represent Netskope’s technical vision and point of view with credibility across customers, partners, analysts, and the broader cybersecurity community.
Job Requirements:
The successful candidate is a builder, operator and change leader.
They know how to take a strong Solutions Engineering organization and make it significantly better by developing leaders, establishing operating discipline, improving methodology, creating organizational leverage and introducing new technology and AI-enabled ways of working.
Commercially minded and understand that Solutions Engineering is a critical component of the revenue engine. They can move comfortably between strategic discussions with the executive team, revenue planning with Sales leadership, product strategy with Product Management, and coaching leaders on the execution details required to win.
Technically credible without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room. Their value comes from building an organization where exceptional technical talent can consistently perform, grow, and win.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, challenge conventional approaches, make data-driven decisions, and have the leadership presence to influence across a global organization.
Qualifications and Experience
Proven executive leadership experience building and scaling large, high-performing Solutions Engineering or technical pre-sales organizations within a high-growth B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, networking, cloud, or technology company.
Demonstrated success leading through leaders across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.
A strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing SE leaders and building sustainable leadership succession.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving pre-sales methodology and operating models rather than simply managing an established process.
Strong understanding of modern cybersecurity and cloud technologies, including SASE, SSE, ZTNA, data security, cloud security, and AI security.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology into business outcomes and communicate effectively with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and other senior executives.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of enterprise sales cycles, technical qualification, POV/POC strategy, competitive selling, pipeline management and revenue execution.
Experience using data, automation, AI, and technology to improve organizational productivity, scale, and operating efficiency.
Exceptional communication, executive presence, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment while balancing long-term organizational strategy with near-term business priorities.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred. MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.

Netskope respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us, please refer to Netskope's Privacy Policy for more details.

jobs.title: Vice President, Earned Media, Technology - Burson
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
More about the role:
Technology is reshaping how we live, work and do business. For the companies driving that change, earning attention requires a clear point of view, credible proof and stories that connect innovation to what matters to people and stakeholders.
We’re looking for a Vice President, Earned Media — Technology who combines deep technology sector expertise, strong editorial judgment and creative thinking in order to help clients tell stories that shape their reputation and advance their business priorities.
Working across Burson’s U.S. Earned Media Practice and Technology teams, you’ll lead earned strategy and execution for leading technology clients. You’ll partner with client leads to help clients define what they want to be known for and determine what they need to do, say, create or demonstrate to earn that coverage and recognition.
You’ll bring Earned into the work from the beginning, partnering with account and client leaders, strategists, creatives and other specialists to shape ideas that breakthrough in the news cycle, develop narratives and identify opportunities to create news.
This role calls for someone who can translate complex technology into coverage that supports business and human impact, confidently.
What you'll do:
Lead earned media strategy. Translate clients’ business priorities and reputation goals into clear narratives, proactive storytelling opportunities and actionable earned programs. Define the audiences we need to reach, what we want them to understand, how to break through with the right earned outlets that can influence those perceptions.
Find and create the story. Work with clients to uncover the ideas, data, customer experiences and proof points that make their businesses newsworthy. Recommend what clients can do, say or create to give media a compelling reason to pay attention.
Make technology relevant. Connect technical capabilities and product innovation to broader stories about business transformation, competition, work and everyday life. Develop newsworthy narratives that resonate with business, technology and industry audiences.
Provide confident client counsel. Serve as a trusted day-to-day earned advisor, helping clients assess newsworthiness, sharpen their point of view and make informed decision. Help clients understand the evolving media ecosystem and bring sound judgment to sensitive issues, partnering with senior leaders and specialists as needed.
Drive hands-on media engagement. Develop and maintain relationships with national business and technology journalists, trade reporters, newsletter writers, podcasters and independent news creators. Lead pitching and substantive media conversations, securing coverage that advances the client’s narrative.
Integrate Earned from the start. Partner with account leads and colleagues across Strategy, Intelligence, Creative, Social and Digital to shape programs with a compelling earned story at their core.
Use intelligence to sharpen the work. Apply audience insights, media analysis, data and AI-powered tools to identify emerging conversations, narrative opportunities, white space, and timely opportunities. Bring editorial judgment to interpret those findings and translating them into recommendations.
Own Execution. Lead earned workstreams across launches, ongoing storytelling, company events and major industry moments. Set clear priorities, manage timelines and resources, and evaluate results against agreed audience, narrative and reputation objectives.
Develop people and grow the business. Coach junior colleagues on strategy, storytelling, pitching and client counsel. Contribute to new business proposals and presentations, identify opportunities to expand existing relationships, and partner with account leaders on scopes, staffing and budgets.
You’re our ideal candidate if you
Start with the business challenge. You ask what the client wants to achieve and what they want to be known for, then build an earned strategy that connects the two.
Think like an editor. You recognize a compelling story, understand why it matters now and know what evidence will make it credible. You can challenge an idea constructively and help make it stronger.
Understand technology deeply. You’re curious about how technology works, how companies compete and what innovation means for customers, industries and society. You can translate complexity into clear, accessible language.
Combine strategy with execution. You’re comfortable presenting a recommendation to a senior client, writing the pitch and speaking with a reporter.
Understand the modern media ecosystem. You understand the modern media ecosystem and the evolution across established newsrooms, trade media, newsletters, podcasts and news creators—and how to choose the right targets for a particular story to reach an audience.
Bring clarity and ownership. You offer a point of view, direct strategy, set realistic expectations and take responsibility for the quality of your team’s work.
Make the team better. You collaborate generously, give useful feedback and help colleagues build their judgment and confidence. You stay curious and open to learning.
Experience that contributes to success:
Approximately 10–12 years of relevant experience in technology earned media, media relations or communications, with substantial responsibility for earned strategy and execution. Agency experience is preferred.
Direct, hands-on experience in at least two of the following: AI, enterprise/B2B software, or early-stage companies.
A demonstrated ability to turn business objectives and complex technology topics into distinctive narratives and sustained earned media programs.
Strong relationships with business and technology media, alongside an understanding of relevant trade outlets, independent journalists, newsletter writers and news creators.
A track record of securing meaningful coverage through proactive story development, executive positioning, customer storytelling and data-driven ideas.
Experience leading earned workstreams within integrated B2B campaigns, including product launches, company-owned events and major technology industry events.
Experience counseling senior clients and preparing executives for media interviews and other high-visibility opportunities.
Exceptional writing, editing and presentation skills, with the ability to develop clear strategies, compelling pitches, executive messaging and briefing materials.
Experience managing teams and multiple client workstreams, contributing to new business and organic growth, and working within agreed scopes and budgets.
Experience using research, analytics and measurement to inform strategy, improve programs and demonstrate the contribution of earned media.

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.
The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:
$75,000—$180,000 USD
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
