jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Director, Trading Products
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.
We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.
What We Look For In You
Domain Depth
5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.
Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.
Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.
End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.
Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.
Ways of Working
Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.
You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.
You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.
Nice-To-Haves
Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.
Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.
Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Technology and Security Risk Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated Technology and Security Risk Manager within the Second Line of Defence (2LOD). You will be responsible for continuously refining and scaling the Technology and Security oversight program, guiding first-line of defence (1LOD) execution, and providing independent risk challenge.
You will be a key member of OKX's Risk team, helping to shape and scale the firm’s 2LOD Security & Data Risk programs. You’ll work closely with stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.
You will play a key role in developing and implementing a comprehensive Technology and Security Risk Management program. This includes 2LOD oversight of technology defects, issues, and incidents, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), key risk indicators (KRIs) and reporting.
The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Technology Risk (including Technology Resilience, Change Management, SDLC, CI/CD pipeline, and software quality assurance) and Cybersecurity (covering internal and external threat vectors, control weaknesses, and organisational cyber hygiene). We are looking for a candidate with a strong drive for improvement and career growth.
What You’ll Be Doing
Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the company to proactively identify, escalate, assess, and mitigate Technology and Security risks, ensuring adherence to the Technology Risk Policy.
Providing oversight of Technology and Security Risk incidents and issues, and partnering with 1LOD stakeholders to enhance related processes and ensure effective oversight
Lead the Technology Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process from a 2LOD perspective, ensuring adherence to the ERM RCSA methodology, and providing effective challenge and oversight of 1LOD Security risks and controls.
Support the Security Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) definition, monitoring, and reporting.
Supporting the implementation and ongoing enhancement of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems to enable effective risk oversight
Advocate and support the implementation of Risk Management frameworks for technology stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor for the first line.
Stay up to date on emerging trends and regulations in the digital asset space, proactively identifying and addressing new risk considerations.
What We Look For In You
8+ years in information security, with a strong security architecture or technical security background; fintech, crypto or cloud-native experience preferred.
Practical experience designing, implementing or reviewing cloud, IAM, cryptographic, network or application security controls.
Experience in risk oversight, or readiness to transition, with the technical judgement to challenge controls and recommend proportionate improvements.
Ability to threat-model systems and assess technical evidence, including architecture diagrams, IAM policies, logging configurations and dependencies.
Working knowledge of cloud resilience, multi-region/AZ failover, RTO/RPO and disaster recovery testing.
Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and relevant privacy requirements, including GDPR and PDPA, and their application to technical controls.
Ability to independently assess and test controls, evaluate incidents and drive remediation with engineering and security teams; GRC platform experience desirable.
Clear written and verbal communication, translating technical findings into prioritised actions for business stakeholders and governance committees.
Strong stakeholder management skills, providing constructive challenge and collaborating across functions and geographies.
A proactive, adaptable approach, with confidence taking ownership and improving practices in a fast-paced environment.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; CISSP, CCSP, cloud security/architecture, CISA or CISM qualifications desirable.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Head of Data & Analytics — Insurance & Investments
jobs.text:
Job Summary
The Head of Data & Analytics leads the organization's enterprise data, analytics, and business intelligence function, turning complex data into actionable insights for strategic, operational, financial, risk, customer, and investment decisions.
Within Insurance & Investments, the role typically covers analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer behavior, fraud, risk, portfolio/investment performance, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the enterprise Data & Analytics strategy and roadmap.
Lead data governance, data management, data quality, and data stewardship.
Establish enterprise-wide analytics standards, frameworks, and KPIs.
Lead Business Intelligence (BI), advanced analytics, predictive analytics, and data science.
Develop dashboards, management reporting, executive insights, and decision-support tools.
Support insurance analytics covering:
Underwriting
Claims
Pricing
Customer analytics
Fraud detection
Loss/risk analysis
Support investment and asset-management analytics covering:
Portfolio performance
Investment risk
Market data
Asset allocation
Performance attribution
Client/investor analytics
Build and maintain data warehouses, data lakes, analytical platforms, and data pipelines.
Drive data integration across policy administration, claims, CRM, finance, investment, risk, and other enterprise systems.
Implement predictive models, AI/ML, and automation where appropriate.
Ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, availability, lineage, and accessibility.
Partner with IT/Data Engineering on cloud, architecture, APIs, platforms, and modernization.
Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, regulatory, and financial-services requirements.
Provide reliable data for financial, risk, actuarial, management, and regulatory reporting.
Lead data transformation and the adoption of self-service analytics.
Manage analytics/data teams, technology partners, vendors, budgets, and delivery priorities.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to senior executives and business leaders.
Promote a strong data-driven decision-making culture across the organization.
Ideal Candidate Profile
12–18+ years of experience in data, analytics, BI, data science, information management, or technology.
5+ years in senior data/analytics leadership.
Experience as:
Head of Data & Analytics
Head of Analytics
Head of Data
Director of Data & Analytics
Director of Analytics
Data & Analytics Director
Chief Data Officer
Chief Analytics Officer
Strong background in Insurance, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, Banking, or Financial Services.
Strong expertise in:
Data strategy
Data governance
Data architecture
Data management
Data quality
BI and reporting
Advanced/predictive analytics
Data science
AI/ML
Data platforms
Data integration
Data visualization
Experience leading enterprise-wide transformation and multidisciplinary teams.
Strong understanding of financial-services data, risk, regulatory, and reporting requirements.
Ability to work with C-suite executives, Finance, Risk, Actuarial, Investments, Operations, IT, and business leadership.

Strong background ads measurement, identity, signals and large-scale data processing.

Track record of improving organizational execution, developing leaders, and creating distributed ownership.
Exceptional analytical thinking and ability to move from ambiguous business problems to measurable technical outcomes.
Strong executive communication and cross-functional influence.

jobs.title: Co-founder & CTO, AI for predictable drug discovery and development
jobs.text:
We're building AI to predict clinical trial and drug development outcomes, and quantify how much confidence those predictions deserve.
We're looking for a technical co-founder to join our biology and commercial founders. As Co-founder & CTO you take a built, already-used platform and lead its development, the research programme that measures and improves its predictions, and the first technical team. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months.
THE OPPORTUNITY
Drug development involves decisions about targets, treatment approaches, delivery and patient populations. Each decision depends on evidence that may not transfer well to the setting that matters: treating people. A treatment working in mice, for example, does not tell us how much confidence to place in its chances in humans.
Around nine in ten drugs entering clinical trials never reach approval. The causes run from efficacy to safety to commercial choice, and the claim here is narrower than blaming that number on translation: the field still lacks a systematic way to measure how far a given experimental result should carry into a specific therapeutic decision.
We want to measure how reliably different kinds of biological evidence predict human outcomes. Our approach is to link the evidence available when a decision was made, the judgement made from it, and what happened next. Those records become the data from which we can learn which evidence predicts which outcomes, and under what conditions. That is difficult to test. Outcomes can take years to arrive, suitable labels are often missing, and a failed trial does not necessarily reveal which earlier assumption was wrong.
The platform is already running. It has produced a scientific result through work with the Allen Institute, described in a public preprint. You can also see the engine run.
There is no established dataset or method that settles the measurement question. Defining what to measure, building reliable evaluations and choosing appropriate methods are central to the role, and the next funding round will fund that programme.
Clinical trial outcome prediction is a central test: predicting a specific trial outcome and explaining the biological reasons, using evidence available before the result. An LLM may already know a historical outcome, so retrospective tests need safeguards against contamination as well as confirmation on prospective cases. This article sets out our approach.
The aim is to make therapeutic development more predictable, and use those predictions to change which treatments get developed and how.
Read more in our thesis.
THE ROLE
This is a deeply hands-on role. The founding team covers biology and commercial development. You will be responsible for the technology and the research needed to evaluate it. There is no engineering team yet: you will be building the system yourself and should expect to remain hands-on for at least the first year. You will:
Develop the platform. Take ownership of the existing system, set technical priorities and implement improvements.
Build the measurement programme. Define the prediction tasks, link evidence available at decision time to subsequent outcomes, and develop and compare modelling approaches. Test predictive performance and calibration, and identify where the system is reliable and where it is not.
Prevent misleading evaluations. Address leakage, label quality and contamination. Retrospective tests need particular care when an LLM may have encountered the outcome during training. We explain the issue in this article.
Hire the first technical team once funding is in place.
Support fundraising. Explain the technical approach, evidence, limitations and development plan to investors.
The modelling approach is open. You will choose methods based on the problem and the available data, whether those involve Bayesian or hierarchical inference, graph learning, calibration, classical statistics or a combination.
Location: Flexible, UK-based preferred · Commitment: Full-time from spin-out · Equity: Founder equity, with technical authority from day one.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We're building an AI company that works on drug development, not a drug company that uses AI. The hard part is measuring what the evidence justifies, and biology is where we point that. So the depth we're searching for is in AI and statistics.
You have led a team or a substantial technical programme at Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta AI or a comparable frontier AI lab. Your own work is recognised, and your name opens doors with investors and people we want to hire. That credibility is part of why this role exists. You remain hands-on and will build the platform yourself.
You might know very little biology, and that's okay. The science is held by the founding team. What we look for is real curiosity about the biology and the drive to learn it quickly from the people who already know it.
You will be building the platform yourself. With the rest of the founding team you set what it is for and where it goes, and then you make it work.
These are essential:
You bring a recognised technical track record from a frontier AI lab and remain hands-on.
You hold your own in a room of researchers and a room of investors.
You lead from the front. This is a founding seat, not a board seat and not an advisory one.
You can go full-time from the spin-out.
HOW TO APPLY
Send a CV and a short note. In the note, tell us what you would measure first, and what you think we've got wrong about the mission above. Include links to work you have built or published. No separate cover letter is required.
One request, and we ask it of everyone. If your application reports a result (an accuracy, an improvement, a benchmark number), be precise about three things: what the baseline was, how the data was split, and how wide the interval around it is. A figure on its own tells us nothing.
If a founding seat isn't the right fit but the problem pulls at you, we're also open to advisory roles; say so in your note.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Database Excellence
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.
You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.
What you’ll do
Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders.
Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge.
Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company.
Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.
Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.
About the team
Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role

As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.

You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.
What you’ll do

items: Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders.
Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.

blocks.text: What you’ll bring

items: Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge.

Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company.
Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.

Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

blocks.text: About the team

Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Operations (009-01361)
jobs.text:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates
Job Role: Head of Product and Operations
Work Schedule: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Australian Business Hours
Compensation range: $3,000 AUD - $4,500 AUD / Monthly (before tax and deductions)
Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.
Who The Client Is: We’re a community-driven platform built to connect local businesses with fundraisers in a way that benefits everyone. By making it easy for merchants to share offers and for groups to raise funds, we create a simple, win-win model that drives growth, engagement, and impact without the usual barriers. Our mission is to keep commerce and community working hand in hand, making support effortless and rewarding.
Role Overview: We are not looking for a virtual assistant, general administrator or software developer.
We’re looking for a senior Product & Operations leader with previous experience working within a SaaS, marketplace, membership, subscription, fintech, loyalty/rewards, or comparable digital platform.
The successful candidate will take significant responsibility away from the Founder, owning the day-to-day operation of the platform and coordinating the technology, systems, and processes required for the company to scale.
This role requires someone who can identify problems, investigate root causes, determine effective solutions, and follow them through to completion with minimal direction.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Ownership
Own and maintain the company’s product roadmap.
Translate commercial requirements into clear development specifications.
Prioritise features, improvements and bugs.
Manage external developers and technology partners.
Challenge development estimates and timelines where appropriate.
Establish acceptance criteria for development.
Coordinate releases.
Maintain product and technical documentation.
QA & Technology Management
Take ownership of QA and regression testing.
Test development before production release.
Maintain bugs and issue registers.
Manage development priorities and delivery.
Understand web/mobile applications, APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure sufficiently to manage technical suppliers.
Coordinate security, backups, platform reliability and technical issues.
The successful candidate does not need to code, but must be technically confident enough to manage developers effectively.
Fundraiser Operations
Manage the operational process from:
Signed → Onboarding → Setup → Launch → Active
Including fundraiser accounts, pages, payment configuration, dashboards, reporting and support.
Merchant Operations
Manage:
Signed → Onboarding → Offer Setup → Approval → Live → Ongoing Management
Including merchant information, locations, offers, codes, terms and offer accuracy.
Member & Payment Operations
Oversee:
Registration → Payment → Fundraiser Allocation → Membership Activation → Usage → Renewal
Including Stripe/payment issues, failed payments, refunds, membership status and reconciliation.
Customer Support
Establish and manage support processes for:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Build systems, FAQs, documentation and automation that reduce repetitive support requirements.
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain management reporting covering:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Membership sales
Revenue
Fundraising distributions
Payments
Renewals
Customer support
Product development
Platform performance
Management should have a clear weekly view of the health of the business.
Automation & Scalability
A major part of this role is identifying manual processes and progressively automating them.
We want someone constantly asking:
“How can the company support 1,000 fundraisers and 100,000+ members without needing a huge operations team?"

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (Singapore)
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
About the role
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
What you’ll do
Sell
Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements
Deliver
Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time
Manage People
Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume
You may be a fit if
You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect / Technical Architect Director - Data Foundation Deli
jobs.text:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Customer Success
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.
This role leads the advisory, architecture, and delivery of enterprise Data Foundation engagements for Salesforce Professional Services customers. Drawing on deep data experience (10+ years for the Senior Technical Architect level; 15+ years for the Director level), you run discovery, set the technical vision, design/approve the target architecture, and drive delivery across a progressive, customer-calibrated maturity journey — advising customer stakeholders (up to CxO level at the Director tier) along the way.
You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.
You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. This is a customer-billable delivery role — a hands-on/senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
Advisory & Strategy
Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)
Represent the practice in complex, high-stakes engagements
Architecture & Delivery
Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines
Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)
Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management
AI-Augmented Delivery
Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP
Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)
Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery
Governance & Enablement
Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)
What You Bring (Preferred Experience)
Unified Identity & Harmonization — identity resolution, match/merge, golden records
Master Data Management — domains, survivorship, hierarchies, 360 views
Unstructured Data Management — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, RAG grounding
Data Architecture & Semantic Modeling — conceptual/logical/physical models, semantic layer, glossary
Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events, activation
Data Trust, Security & Privacy — classification, access control, masking, Einstein Trust Layer
Data Governance & Stewardship — catalog, lineage, data quality, stewardship & policy
Industry Data Models & Accelerators — FSC, Health Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud blueprints
Data Platform & Infrastructure — lakehouse, compute, catalog, cloud foundation
Analytics, BI & Data Observability — dashboards, self-service BI, freshness/quality monitoring
Required Qualifications
10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)
Executive-grade communication, up to proven CxO-level advisory at senior levels; ability to guide delivery teams and lead multi-workstream delivery
Experience integrating a vendor platform into heterogeneous/complex enterprise landscapes — balancing platform-agnostic and platform-centric approaches
Hands-on-to-deep fluency with AI-augmented delivery — using AI tools as a core part of the workflow and building reusable prompt/skill/agent assets
A forward-looking, and at senior levels recognized/published, perspective on enterprise data, AI, and the agentic future of SaaS
Certifications
Certifications are preferred, not required — a proven delivery and thought-leadership track record carries the most weight.
Preferred Certifications
Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
Salesforce Certified Data Architect
Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Director)
MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Sr. Architect level)
TOGAF (Director)
Additional Pluses
Informatica IDMC / MDM certification
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Sr. Architect level)
MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Director level)
DAMA CDMP or CDMC
Preferred / Differentiating Strengths
Experience/track record delivering agentic AI / RAG on a governed data foundation
Industry depth/expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing (industry data models)
Track record/history building reusable accelerators and prompt/skill/agent libraries
Prior Professional Services / customer-facing advisory or leadership experience at enterprise scale

jobs.title: Data Management Office Director
jobs.text:
We are seeking an experienced leader to join a Government Entity in Saudi Arabia as:
Data Management Office Director
The Data Management Office Director will be responsible for leading the organization’s data management and governance agenda, establishing the required frameworks, policies, and operating models to ensure data quality, compliance, and effective utilization of data across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the development and implementation of the organization’s Data Strategy and Data Management Office roadmap in alignment with organizational objectives and national data regulations and standards.
• Establish and oversee data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
• Lead initiatives related to data quality, data classification, data protection, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
• Oversee the development and continuous improvement of policies and procedures governing data management practices.
• Enable effective use of data to support executive decision-making, organizational performance, and strategic initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with applicable national data management, governance, and protection requirements.
• Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across business functions.
• Oversee initiatives related to data sharing, open data, master and reference data, and other relevant data management domains.
• Define and monitor Data Management Office KPIs, data maturity indicators, compliance metrics, and data quality performance.
• Promote a data-driven culture and increase organizational awareness of data governance and management practices.
• Build, lead, and develop the Data Management Office team while ensuring effective delivery against strategic priorities.

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Role:
We are looking for a visionary and strategic Field CTO with a "learn-it-all" mindset to serve as a high-impact technical advisor for our most strategic prospects and customers. In this role, you will act as a peer to client executives, translating complex business transformations into scalable technical strategies. You will drive innovation by championing Process Intelligence ,Agentic AI and Enterprise Modernization, ensuring our technology aligns with the evolving needs of the global market.
The work you’ll do:
Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, aligning their long-term strategic goals with the Celonis technical vision.
Strategic Architecture & Roadmap: Lead the overarching data, cloud, and innovation strategy for our largest global accounts, utilizing methodologies like Capability Mapping to identify high-value opportunities.
Innovation Leadership: Architect "first-of-a-kind" solutions using emergent technologies like Agentic AI to solve complex enterprise challenges.
Sales & Business Impact: Partner with Sales and Value Engineering driving revenue through new customer acquisition and strategic up-selling.
Product Advocacy: Act as a critical feedback loop between our Product & Engineering teams and the market, ensuring the voice of the customer shapes our future offerings.
Thought Leadership: Develop and deliver customer-facing position papers, assets, and presentations that establish our brand as a leader in architecture and innovation.
The qualifications you need:
Experience: 15 to 20 years of relevant experience, ideally having served as a CTO at a consulting firm, as Field CTO at a software vendor, or Director/VP of Enterprise Architecture within a major corporation.
Strategic Communication: Proven track record of presenting complex technical visions to C-suite stakeholders in a way that emphasizes business value.
Modernization Expertise: Deep experience in Enterprise Modernization, EA Methodologies, and a robust understanding of Agentic AI.
Technical Versatility: Ability to pivot from high-level architecture diagrams to hands-on demo.
Technical Foundation: Excellent background in Data Architecture, API ecosystems, and cloud-native SaaS solutions like Salesforce and ServiceNow.
ERP/Domain: Strong knowledge of Oracle
Education: MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent IT-related field.
Preferred:
Tech Stack: Celonis, OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
Certifications: TOGAF/Zachmann , AWS/Azure/GCP , and ESB/ETL certifications (e.g., Mulesoft, Informatica).
Industry Breadth: Experience across at least two domains (e.g., Finance, Supply Chain) and two industries (e.g., Pharma, Banking, Aerospace)
Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.
#LI-DB
The base salary range below is for the role in the specified location, based on a Full Time Schedule.
Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location.
The base salary range below is for the role in New York, based on a Full Time Schedule.
$204,000—$272,000 USD
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

blocks.text: About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. jobs.title: Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.
The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis.
Mission Summary:
As the Director of Data Science, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for extracting intelligence from petabyte-scale on-road fleet data and simulation ecosystems. This leadership role is centered on building advanced data-driven methodologies, developing predictive and generative models, and serving as the primary analytical anchor supporting not only the Systems Readiness and Performance/Metrics teams but the whole company. You will drive the statistical rigor necessary to translate raw road data into high-fidelity performance metrics that directly inform vehicle launch readiness and safety-critical decisions.
What You'll Be Doing:
Rapid Operational Analytics: Execute fast-turnaround investigations on emergent fleet issues, converting real-time operational data into high-impact insights for launch decisions.
Advanced Exposure Modeling: Build complex statistical models to evaluate vehicle safety and performance across diverse environmental variables and Operational Design Domains.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the primary analytical anchor for Systems and Autonomy teams (Perception, Prediction, Planning).
Executive Artifacts: Work with other systems teams to distill raw telemetry and rapid-response findings into high-level strategy documents, visualizations, and dashboards.
Team Leadership: Mentor and scale a dedicated four-person team, instilling a culture that pairs rapid analytical agility with absolute scientific rigor.
What We're Looking For:
Industry Experience: 10+ years of professional experience leading data science or applied AI/ML initiatives, with at least 5 years explicitly scaling data-driven programs for autonomous driving, robotics, or complex safety-critical engineering systems.
Educational Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, or a highly quantitative field.
Expertise in Advanced Analytics: Deep foundational knowledge in statistical analysis, density estimation, hypothesis testing, uncertainty quantification, and causal reasoning.
Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Python, SQL, and data science infrastructure libraries, alongside a strong understanding of modern sequence modeling (Transformers) and distributed compute scaling frameworks (e.g., Ray, AWS).
System Deconstruction: Demonstrated track record of translating ill-defined, ambiguous real-world performance questions into structured metric designs and concrete solution architectures.
Exceptional Communication: Proven capacity to articulate highly technical data patterns and trade-offs into compelling strategies for cross-functional engineering peers and C-suite executives.
Collaborative Leadership: Strong interpersonal ability to wield cross-functional technical influence, resolve technical disagreements across teams, and establish organizational best practices around data integrity.
Bonus Points (not required):
Experience designing reward functions or applying Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) to evaluate human-like driving intent, assertiveness, and comfort.
Familiarity with physical AI ecosystems, open-weights Vision-Language models (VLMs), or processing raw telemetry without text-translation bottlenecks.
Direct experience evaluating core onboard software subsystems like Perception, Prediction, or Motion Planning.
Deep familiarity with functional safety engineering standards like ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF)
This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at Motional by enhancing our data understanding and accelerating development speed for our industry-leading autonomous vehicle metrics and capabilities ecosystem. We take pride in having some of the brightest and most dedicated talent in the world on our team. If you're innovative, driven, and eager to tackle challenges, we'd love to have you join us!
Physical Demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.
Travel Requirements (greater than 20%):
Expected to travel for 1-2 weeks each quarter visiting all of our testing sites - mostly to LV, but also domestically as needed for the business.
Working Environment:
The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particlesThe noise level in the environment is low to moderate.
We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Executive Director of Product Management , Resiliency
jobs.text:
The Executive Director, Product Management – Supply Chain Resiliency reports to the VP, Product Management and owns the full product development lifecycle and go-to-market execution for GHX's Supply Resiliency Platform — the cross-application layer spanning two use-case tracks: Procure-to-Pay (hospital) and Order-to-Cash (manufacturer/supplier) workflows. This is a build-and-commercialize role: the Executive Director owns the platform requirements, product launch, and forward-deployed pilot through general availability, driving pilot customer selection and execution, product requirements and roadmap, commercial packaging and pricing, and cross-functional GTM alignment across Engineering, forward-deployed teams, Sales, Marketing, Implementation, Professional Services, Customer Care and Finance.
Areas of focus include, but are not solely limited to: pilot program design and stage-gate governance; product definition, roadmap execution, and technical alignment; commercial packaging, pricing, and profitability; competitive positioning; cross-functional consensus building; and executive/steering-committee reporting.
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Healthcare supply chain resiliency is now a contested category: well-funded, AI-native challengers are selling point solutions directly to hospitals. This role is chartered to win that fight — turning GHX's two-sided network of 600+ connected providers and their suppliers into a resiliency platform that out-executes single-sided competitors on speed, breadth, and proven customer outcomes. The Executive Director owns that competitive outcome end to end, from platform definition through GA and beyond.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Working with a broad group of stakeholders and partners — across GHX product pods, Forward-Deployed Engineering, current and prospective pilot customers, and the executive leadership team — the Executive Director develops and leads GHX Product Management execution for the Supply Resiliency use case. Responsibilities also include identification and qualification of future use case prioritization.
Specific responsibilities include:
Own end-to-end product development lifecycle (PDLC) for GHX Orchestration, from forward-deployed pilot and prototype through GA commercialization, across both use-case tracks (Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash).
Design, govern, and continuously refine the pilot selection engine: Layer 1 binary hard gates (data access, SME time, on-site access, feedback cadence, executive sponsor) and the Layer 2 weighted scorecard used to rank and select pilot candidates.
Own pilot cohort selection and all stage-gate decisions (entry, mid-pilot, exit), including go/kill/reallocate calls on stalled accounts.
Partner directly with the Forward-Deployed Engineering team to scope on-site pilot engagements, define track-specific entry criteria and success metrics, and translate pilot learnings into a repeatable deployment playbook.
Own product-level success criteria and report progress against exit bars: P0/P1 issue resolution, GA-candidate certification, referenceable-logo targets, and quantified ROI proof points, by persona and by track.
Lead product's input into the GTM execution plan, keeping the commercial (pricing/packaging), pilot delivery, and marketing workstreams synchronized against the shared milestone schedule and dependency chain.
Define and evolve the tiered commercial model (Foundation / Agentic / Outcome-Premium) and the hybrid pricing approach (base subscription plus metered/outcome layer); partner with Finance and Deal Desk on SOW structure, platform-level contracting, and pilot-to-GA conversion terms.
Translate persona- and value-based requirements (executive sponsor, operational champion, SME end-users, technical/integration owner, data steward) into a technical roadmap in partnership with Engineering.
Drive product-boundary clarity across adjacent and overlapping offerings (e.g., Price Workbench, Industry Data Alignment, Data Connect, Managed Services, and Resiliency Center capability) and own the resulting customer-facing positioning, flow documentation, and sales-enablement materials.
Analyze market trends and the competitive landscape — including well-funded, AI-native point-solution entrants — to defend and advance GHX's “orchestration” category positioning, and to win head-to-head competitive evaluations.
Build and sustain executive-level relationships with pilot customers and internal sponsors to unblock data access, named SME time, on-site access, and rapid structured feedback.
Lead through influence across Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute and deliver the roadmap and optimize product efficiency for implementation, supportability, and system reliability.
Develop and mentor Product Owners and Product Managers supporting the platform.
Utilize effective change management practices to execute the product roadmap and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the executive/steering committee.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
A minimum of 10 years of Product Management experience.
Experience leading Product Management initiatives within the healthcare space is required.
Demonstrated experience designing or running structured pilot programs, forward-deployed engineering models, or similar early-access/co-development customer AI engagements.
Experience developing or executing usage-based, outcome-based, or hybrid commercial pricing models for enterprise software.
Ability to clearly communicate; work in team environments, with a minimum of 3 years people management experience.
Proven software development experience managing product planning milestones from business concept through launch.
Competency at developing strategies and execution plans for new businesses or new platform offerings.
Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional project teams spanning Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services.
Strategic planning skills, including experience building and defending a go-to-market roadmap with executive stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills (oral and written communication).
Outstanding organizational skills and time management skills.
Travel is as needed (approximately 25%–50%), including on-site pilot customer visits.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
5+ years of healthcare software product management experience.
Experience managing healthcare supply chain products and services (Procure-to-Pay and/or Order-to-Cash) desirable but not necessary.
Experience launching or commercializing agentic AI or AI-enabled product capabilities.
Experience building pricing models that incorporate a metered or outcome-based component alongside a base subscription.
Experience showing ability to drive customer adoption of emerging technologies and solutions.
Track record winning head-to-head competitive evaluations against market challengers in enterprise or healthcare software.
Estimated Salary: $150,000 - $214,000 plus bonus

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.
