Lead product's input into the GTM execution plan, keeping the commercial (pricing/packaging), pilot delivery, and marketing workstreams synchronized against the shared milestone schedule and dependency chain.

Define and evolve the tiered commercial model (Foundation / Agentic / Outcome-Premium) and the hybrid pricing approach (base subscription plus metered/outcome layer); partner with Finance and Deal Desk on SOW structure, platform-level contracting, and pilot-to-GA conversion terms.

Translate persona- and value-based requirements (executive sponsor, operational champion, SME end-users, technical/integration owner, data steward) into a technical roadmap in partnership with Engineering.

Drive product-boundary clarity across adjacent and overlapping offerings (e.g., Price Workbench, Industry Data Alignment, Data Connect, Managed Services, and Resiliency Center capability) and own the resulting customer-facing positioning, flow documentation, and sales-enablement materials.

Analyze market trends and the competitive landscape — including well-funded, AI-native point-solution entrants — to defend and advance GHX's “orchestration” category positioning, and to win head-to-head competitive evaluations.
Build and sustain executive-level relationships with pilot customers and internal sponsors to unblock data access, named SME time, on-site access, and rapid structured feedback.

Lead through influence across Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute and deliver the roadmap and optimize product efficiency for implementation, supportability, and system reliability.
Develop and mentor Product Owners and Product Managers supporting the platform.
Utilize effective change management practices to execute the product roadmap and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the executive/steering committee.

blocks.text: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

items: A minimum of 10 years of Product Management experience.
Experience leading Product Management initiatives within the healthcare space is required.
Demonstrated experience designing or running structured pilot programs, forward-deployed engineering models, or similar early-access/co-development customer AI engagements.
Experience developing or executing usage-based, outcome-based, or hybrid commercial pricing models for enterprise software.
Ability to clearly communicate; work in team environments, with a minimum of 3 years people management experience.
Proven software development experience managing product planning milestones from business concept through launch.
Competency at developing strategies and execution plans for new businesses or new platform offerings.
Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional project teams spanning Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services.
Strategic planning skills, including experience building and defending a go-to-market roadmap with executive stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills (oral and written communication).
Outstanding organizational skills and time management skills.
Travel is as needed (approximately 25%–50%), including on-site pilot customer visits.

blocks.text: PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

items: 5+ years of healthcare software product management experience.
Experience managing healthcare supply chain products and services (Procure-to-Pay and/or Order-to-Cash) desirable but not necessary.
Experience launching or commercializing agentic AI or AI-enabled product capabilities.
Experience building pricing models that incorporate a metered or outcome-based component alongside a base subscription.
Experience showing ability to drive customer adoption of emerging technologies and solutions.
Track record winning head-to-head competitive evaluations against market challengers in enterprise or healthcare software.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
Ndustrial has delivered $100M+ in energy savings for food producers, storage operators and retailers across the cold chain. Our Nsight™ platform integrates existing systems to turn energy into a measurable production input. It deploys in weeks and verifies savings in real time, without disrupting operations. Trusted by industry leaders like Lineage, Americold and ABB, we’re revolutionizing the way the cold chain uses energy for a more sustainable future.
More About Us:
We are a Raleigh, NC based Series B startup backed by world class investors and serve global customers in energy-intensive sectors like cold storage, logistics, and manufacturing.
We live by our values: Teamwork, Customer First, Quality, and Curiosity. With a team of forward-thinkers and problem-solvers, we’re driving the digital transformation of industries globally.
Ndustrial builds software that helps the world's largest food, cold chain, and industrial operators understand and control their energy in real time.
If you want your work to make real change, this is the place.
About the Role:
The VP of Engineering is a key member of Ndustrial’s leadership team, responsible for leading, developing, and scaling our engineering organization while ensuring the team delivers against the company’s most important priorities.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this role requires a proven engineering leader who understands what it takes to build and lead teams in an early-stage, high-growth environment. The VP of Engineering will create clarity and accountability across the organization, develop and motivate a high-performing team, and ensure engineering priorities and execution are closely aligned with company objectives.
We are an AI-forward engineering organization, and this leader will help ensure our team is effectively using modern AI tools and practices to improve how we build, solve problems, and deliver value to customers. This is a people-oriented leadership role for someone who knows how to get things done through others and can build an engineering organization that consistently executes, grows, and adapts as the company evolves.
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, develop, and motivate a high-performing engineering team, creating clear expectations, ownership, and accountability.
Translate company objectives into clear engineering priorities and ensure the team understands both what they are working toward and why it matters.
Manage team and individual performance against defined objectives, providing direct feedback, coaching, and addressing performance issues when expectations are not being met.
Champion an AI-forward engineering culture, ensuring the team effectively uses AI-assisted tools across design, development, testing, problem-solving, and decision-making to improve both speed and quality.
Bring firsthand experience navigating the early-stage startup lifecycle, knowing when to introduce structure and process, when to move quickly with imperfect information, and how to keep teams focused and executing as company priorities evolve.
Partner with Product and other leaders to identify opportunities to incorporate AI into our platform and deliver meaningful customer value.
Provide strong technical judgment across architecture, cloud infrastructure, SaaS development, AI-enabled capabilities, security, reliability, and scalability while empowering the team to own implementation.
Own engineering execution, balancing speed, quality, scalability, technical health, and available resources.
Create visibility into engineering priorities, progress, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs for the CEO and leadership team.
Report directly and partner closely with the CEO by proactively bringing recommendations, surfacing risks, providing context, and constructively challenging assumptions when appropriate.
Serve as an active member of the leadership team, contributing to company strategy, priorities, organizational decisions, and growth beyond the engineering function.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and other functions to align Engineering with customer and business needs.
Drive decisions and execution in an environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and limited resources.
Build a culture that reflects what motivates strong startup talent: ownership, autonomy, urgency, collaboration, accountability, and meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Director, Market Access Analytics (Remote)
jobs.text:
About Ogilvy
Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
OGILVY HEALTH: WE INSPIRE PEOPLE AND BRANDS TO IMPACT THE WORLD
Guided by this vision, Ogilvy Health, part of WPP, combines borderless creativity, scientific precision, cultural fluency, and AI-enabled capabilities to build healthcare's most influential movements. We believe the future belongs to those who can seamlessly blend human ingenuity with emerging technologies, using AI not simply as a tool, but as a catalyst for deeper insights, faster problem solving, and more impactful work. We drive measurable impact and category-defining growth for brands ready to shape what's next. Our approach is powered by fearless creativity that dares to be different, sparks emotional connections, and inspires action, ensuring cultural resonance. Scientific precision translates complex data into stories that resonate, while our impact-obsessed mindset focuses on delivering real-world outcomes.
For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Threads.
About the Role
Ogilvy Health Market Access brings together market access strategy, analytics, technology, and creative capabilities to help pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare clients navigate the complexities of reimbursement and patient access. We transform complex access information into actionable solutions that support clients and field organizations throughout the product lifecycle.
We are seeking an experienced Market Access Analytics leader to drive the data strategy, development, and delivery of our proprietary market access solutions and custom analytics offerings. This individual will work closely with clients and internal teams to translate complex pharmaceutical market access data into accurate, actionable solutions for clients and field teams.
The Director will manage and develop members of the analytics team while remaining hands-on with complex data challenges, solution design, validation, and client deliverables.
What You’ll Do
Lead the timely implementation of data solutions supporting proprietary market access products, field-facing tools, and custom client analytics.
Integrate and analyze pharmaceutical data sources, including formulary and coverage data, prescription and medical claims, HCP data, payer and plan hierarchies, lives, geographic alignment, and CRM data.
Translate complex business questions into analytical methodologies, business rules, data requirements, and scalable solutions.
Use MySQL, advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI and other analytic tools to manipulate, integrate, analyze, and validate large datasets and troubleshoot complex data issues.
Apply deep knowledge of pharmaceutical reimbursement, including payer channels, formulary coverage, utilization management, payer/PBM relationships, plan structures, and patient access dynamics.
Develop methodologies that translate market access data into actionable HCP-, account-, payer-, geographic-, and national-level insights and field-facing messages.
Own quality control and validation of analytical methodologies and client deliverables, including investigation and reconciliation of discrepancies across data sources and systems.
Serve as the analytics and market access subject matter expert throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements, development, testing and validation, launch, data migrations, recurring refreshes, and enhancements.
Partner with development, UX, account, strategy, production, and external data-provider teams to ensure solutions are accurate, scalable, actionable, and delivered on time.
Serve as a senior analytics subject matter expert in client meetings and pre- and post-sale discussions, clearly communicating complex methodologies, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
Establish efficient, repeatable processes and high standards for analytical rigor and quality.
Remain hands-on as needed to investigate data, troubleshoot MySQL queries, perform Excel-based analyses, validate methodologies, and resolve complex data challenges.
What You’ll Need
8+ years of analytics experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, market access, managed markets, or a closely related data environment.
Ideally, understanding of pharmaceutical market access and reimbursement, including commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels, payer and plan structures, formulary coverage, and utilization management.
Significant experience with pharmaceutical data, including formulary/coverage, prescription or medical claims, HCP, payer/plan, and lives data.
5+ years hands-on MySQL skills, with demonstrated ability to query, join, transform, aggregate, troubleshoot, and validate large datasets.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated ability to analyze, validate, and present complex data.
Experience harnessing AI to streamline data processes.
Experience designing analytical methodologies and translating business needs into detailed data and product requirements.
Strong understanding of data quality, integration, attribution, aggregation, and validation methodologies and experience using a revision control system in a production environment (i.e. SVN, Git, Perforce).
Exceptional client communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage multiple complex workstreams.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to develop innovative solutions to complex data challenges.
Bachelor's degree required; STEM degree, advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.
AI Fluency: Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency in using generative AI and applicable emerging technologies. Ability to adapt to new tools and integrate AI responsibly into day-to-day work is expected.
Preferred Experience
Experience with pharmaceutical market access data sources such as IQVIA, MMIT, Symphony Health, or similar platforms.
Experience developing HCP- or account-level market access analytics and field-facing solutions.
Familiarity with Veeva or other pharmaceutical CRM/field enablement platforms.
Experience with payer hierarchies, PBM relationships, geographic attribution, HCP alignment, product launches, or major data migrations.
How We’ll Support You
Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.
#LI-Remote
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.
Pay Range
$100,000—$230,000 USD
At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.
We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.
Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.
Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Financial Platforms)
jobs.text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
About the Product team
The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
About the role
Affirm’s financial platforms power how loans are created, recorded, funded, serviced, and repaid, as well as how money moves across our products, partners, and markets. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead a portfolio spanning Capital and Affirm Bank, Loan Products, and Payment Services.
This leader will oversee a large, multi-domain product organization of approximately 15 product managers, including experienced people managers, with room to grow. They will set the long-term strategy for their portfolio, modernize Affirm’s ledger and downstream financial pipelines, strengthen Payment Services, and expand our Money Movement capabilities. The ideal candidate brings deep financial-domain knowledge, strong platform judgment, international experience, and a record of developing senior product leaders.
What you’ll do
Lead and scale a high-performing product organization. Manage and develop experienced product leaders and people managers across Capital and Affirm Bank, Loan Products, and Payment Services. Shape the organization as its scope and size grow, while setting a high bar for product craft, strategy, execution, and talent development.
Set the multi-year strategy for the portfolio. Establish a coherent direction across lending, Capital Markets, banking, the loan lifecycle, ledger and accounting capabilities, Money Movement, Open Banking, payment instruments, and processing.
Modernize Affirm’s ledger and financial pipelines. jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Auto Electric Service Ltd. is seeking a Vice President of Product to lead one of the most important functions in our next stage of growth.
Founded in 1943, AES is a locally owned Saskatchewan wholesale distribution company serving the automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, PBE, commercial paint, retail, OEM dealer, jobber, and service markets across Southern Saskatchewan. We are investing heavily in our Distribution Centre, inventory capabilities, technology, people, and systems as we build toward our long-term growth strategy.
This is not simply a purchasing role.
The VP of Product will have executive accountability for Product Assortment, Inventory Strategy, Purchasing, Pricing, Category Management, and Product-related Technology and Analytics.
The Opportunity
The VP of Product will answer some of the most important commercial questions in our business:
What should we sell?
What should we stock, where, and how much?
Which suppliers and product lines should we grow?
How should we price by market, category, and customer?
Where should we enter new categories?
How can data and technology improve these decisions?
The mission is to build a disciplined, accountable, technology-enabled Product function that delivers broad product availability while improving inventory productivity, contribution margin, GMROI, and return on invested capital.
Key Outcomes
Build a Smarter Inventory Network
Lead AES’s enterprise-wide inventory strategy across our Distribution Centre and branch network. Improve fill rates and product availability while reducing excess, obsolete, and unproductive inventory.
Grow and Optimize the Product Assortment
Identify assortment gaps, rationalize underperforming SKUs, evaluate new categories, and ensure our product mix reflects actual customer and market demand across Automotive, Agriculture, Industrial, Heavy Duty, and PBE.
Lead Pricing Strategy
Drive the continued evolution from traditional cost-plus pricing toward more data-driven, market-aware pricing designed to improve contribution margin while maintaining competitiveness.
Elevate Purchasing
Transform purchasing into a more strategic, analytical function. Strengthen vendor relationships, improve supplier accountability, negotiate stronger commercial programs, and align purchasing decisions with demand, inventory, and financial outcomes.
Build a Disciplined New Product Process
Ensure new product lines and categories are supported by clear business cases, expected ROI, required inventory investment, launch plans, and post-launch accountability.
Use Data and Technology as a Competitive Advantage
Work with internal and external technology partners to improve pricing, demand forecasting, product recommendations, customer insights, inventory positioning, and master data.
Build the Team and Function
Develop the structure, people, processes, scorecards, and operating rhythms required to support AES’s growth. Participate as an active member of the Senior Leadership Team and work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Marketing, and Technology.

jobs.title: CTO - Digital & AI
jobs.text:
Join EVA Pharma, a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to empowering the fight for Health and Well-being as a fundamental human right. Recognized and certified as a best place to work, we are committed to fostering a supportive and innovative environment for our team members.
Job Summary:
We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded, technology-driven and value-oriented CTO – Digital & AI to shape the Group's technology vision and lead its digital and AI agenda across Eva Pharma Group, including EVA Medicine, Limitless Care and Care Point.
This is a Group-level leadership role focused on leveraging technology, data and AI to build competitive advantage, accelerate growth, enable new business models, enhance organizational capabilities and enhance customer and patient impact.
About the Role:
Reporting directly to the Group CEO, the CTO will define the Group's long-term technology, digital and AI vision and translate it into a strategic roadmap aligned with CEO and Board priorities.
The CTO will act as a strategic partner to the business — identifying how technology, data and emerging AI capabilities can transform business models, strengthen organizational capability, improve customer and patient experiences, and unlock new opportunities. The role will lead and align senior technology leaders across Digital, Product, Engineering, ERP, Data & AI, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, ensuring a coherent Group-wide technology strategy, architecture and operating model.
The role will be accountable for ensuring that technology investments and initiatives deliver measurable business impact, value and return on investment, with clear priorities, outcomes and success measures.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Strategic Leadership
Define and lead the Group's technology, digital and AI strategy, aligned with business strategy and long-term growth ambitions
Set the Group's technology vision, enterprise architecture principles and strategic priorities across EVA Medicine, Limitless Care and Care Point
Establish technology investment principles and governance, linking major investments to strategic value, business outcomes and measurable ROI
2. Digital Transformation Initiatives
Recommend and propose technologies and digital solutions that address business needs and unlock new opportunities
Shape digital and AI-enabled business models, identifying opportunities for growth, efficiency and differentiation
Build a future-ready technology organization — leadership model and capabilities — to support the Group's transformation and growth
3. Process Improvement
Drive process optimization across the Group through digital and technology-enabled solutions
Provide strategic oversight of cybersecurity, data governance, resilience and technology risk
4. AI
Lead the Group's AI agenda, identifying, scaling and embedding high-impact AI use cases across the business
Ensure responsible AI governance and practices across all AI initiatives

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
FLiiP is a fast-growing fitness technology company building a SaaS platform that helps gyms and fitness businesses run and grow their operations. Working at the intersection of software and the fitness industry, the team is focused on delivering technology that supports day-to-day business management while creating a strong experience for customers and end users.
We're backed by two venture capital firms that have invested CAD 4.4M in FLiiP, and we're part of the Google for Startups Accelerator. And we're just getting started.
As Director of Engineering, you will shape how engineering operates and scales as the company grows. This is a high-impact leadership role with broad reach across our web, mobile, and data engineering teams. You will be a key driver of technical excellence, team performance, and the integration of AI into our engineering DNA.
You'll report directly to the COO/CTO and work closely with Product, Design, and Customer-facing teams to ensure we ship fast, ship right, and continuously raise the bar.
Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Development
Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers and data scientists across web, mobile, and data disciplines
Support individual growth through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development plans
Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, performance and continuous improvement
Manage hiring to scale the team as FLiiP grows
Engineering Excellence
Define and enforce engineering best practices, quality standards, and deployment processes
Manage on-call rotations and ensure system reliability
Own our SOC 2 and GDPR compliance posture from an engineering security perspective
Champion technical debt reduction and proactive platform reliability
Support your team during incident or when it is required
AI & Innovation
Lead the design and continuous improvement of our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC)
Embed AI tooling and practices across the engineering team to increase velocity and quality
Collaborate with the data science team on AI/ML product initiatives to drive innovation with product
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with Product and Design peers to align engineering execution with product strategy
Partner with Customer Success and Support to resolve escalations requiring technical depth
Report on engineering performance with clear, data-driven metrics

jobs.title: Head of Employee Tech & Experience (ETX)
jobs.text:
About the Team
Employee Tech & Experience (ETX) helps people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. Across Helpdesk, Executive Support, Systems Operations, Logistics and AV, we make technology simple, reliable and secure. Employee needs guide what we build, improve and choose to eliminate.
About the Role
Reporting to the Head of Global IT, you’ll lead ETX globally, building on the team’s capabilities and customer-zero work to continually advance the employee experience. You’ll shape ETX’s strategy, investment priorities and operating model in partnership with leadership across the company, turning new capabilities into measurable amplification. You’ll develop leaders and strengthen teams where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
This role is based at our San Francisco headquarters and requires an in-office presence.
In this role, you will:
Lead the next stage of ETX’s global growth across Helpdesk, SysOps, Logistics and AV, with a shared strategy and accountability for employee outcomes.
Continually elevate the employee experience through research and design, directing investment to simplify entire user journeys, remove unnecessary effort and amplify what employees can accomplish.
Accelerate ETX’s agent-led and customer-zero work as capabilities advance: continually challenge which workflows need to exist, extend what agents can own end to end and evolve the operating model to deliver measurable amplification.
Develop leaders who earn trust, grow others and sustain an environment where people feel valued, take pride in their work and enjoy working together. Give people meaningful ownership and opportunities to stretch and grow, with clear priorities and sustainable workloads.
Scale global services to support company growth, with clear commitments to reliability, security, responsiveness, and effective controls. Measure performance through employee effort, service quality, and time to resolution.
Shape priorities and investment with leadership across the company, accelerating execution across functions with accountability for adoption and measurable improvements in how employees work.
Translate employee friction into lasting improvements in policy, service design, and ownership. Hold ETX accountable for restoring productivity, communicating with empathy, and addressing the underlying causes of recurring failures.
You might thrive in this role if you:
Have led global organizations through growth and transformation, with measurable improvements in employee experience and reliability.
Start with what employees need. Use research and design to challenge assumptions and remove unnecessary work.
Rethink how the organization works as AI advances, expanding what agents can own and delivering measurable amplification.
Build leadership teams that help people grow, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
Set direction and investment priorities with leadership across the company. Own execution, adoption and lasting results.
The impact you’ll have
You’ll help people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. You’ll compound the impact of ETX’s agent-led work, turning advances in AI into measurable amplification, giving people back time and making technology simpler and more reliable as we grow. You’ll develop leaders who grow others, sustaining a culture where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy achieving together what once felt out of reach.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. blocks.text: About the Team

Employee Tech & Experience (ETX) helps people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. Across Helpdesk, Executive Support, Systems Operations, Logistics and AV, we make technology simple, reliable and secure. Employee needs guide what we build, improve and choose to eliminate.
About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Global IT, you’ll lead ETX globally, building on the team’s capabilities and customer-zero work to continually advance the employee experience. You’ll shape ETX’s strategy, investment priorities and operating model in partnership with leadership across the company, turning new capabilities into measurable amplification. You’ll develop leaders and strengthen teams where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
This role is based at our San Francisco headquarters and requires an in-office presence.
In this role, you will:
Lead the next stage of ETX’s global growth across Helpdesk, SysOps, Logistics and AV, with a shared strategy and accountability for employee outcomes.
Continually elevate the employee experience through research and design, directing investment to simplify entire user journeys, remove unnecessary effort and amplify what employees can accomplish.

Accelerate ETX’s agent-led and customer-zero work as capabilities advance: continually challenge which workflows need to exist, extend what agents can own end to end and evolve the operating model to deliver measurable amplification.

Develop leaders who earn trust, grow others and sustain an environment where people feel valued, take pride in their work and enjoy working together. Give people meaningful ownership and opportunities to stretch and grow, with clear priorities and sustainable workloads.

Scale global services to support company growth, with clear commitments to reliability, security, responsiveness, and effective controls. Measure performance through employee effort, service quality, and time to resolution.
Shape priorities and investment with leadership across the company, accelerating execution across functions with accountability for adoption and measurable improvements in how employees work.

Translate employee friction into lasting improvements in policy, service design, and ownership. Hold ETX accountable for restoring productivity, communicating with empathy, and addressing the underlying causes of recurring failures.
You might thrive in this role if you:
Have led global organizations through growth and transformation, with measurable improvements in employee experience and reliability.
Start with what employees need. Use research and design to challenge assumptions and remove unnecessary work.
Rethink how the organization works as AI advances, expanding what agents can own and delivering measurable amplification.
Build leadership teams that help people grow, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
Set direction and investment priorities with leadership across the company. Own execution, adoption and lasting results.
The impact you’ll have

You’ll help people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. You’ll compound the impact of ETX’s agent-led work, turning advances in AI into measurable amplification, giving people back time and making technology simpler and more reliable as we grow. You’ll develop leaders who grow others, sustaining a culture where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy achieving together what once felt out of reach.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design - AI & Context
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
We're looking for an experienced Design Leader to oversee our Context Platform Pillar, which homes several critical company initiatives including Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, Community, and more. Think of it as the team that drives the most important context for AI agents to help you design better products.
In this role, you'll tackle strategic challenges from building new products to evolving and scaling existing ones - all while empowering your teams to deliver ambitious, high-quality work. If you're a leader who is especially deep in understanding modern AI + Design Systems workflows, and very passionate about empowering Designers through platform-wide investments in Figma's ecosystem, this role is for you.
As a Design leader at Figma, you'll guide and grow a team of world-class designers, with the opportunity to expand this group as the scope and impact of our work evolves. In this deeply cross-functional role, you'll work in close collaboration with product management, engineering, research, marketing, and other teams to shape both product and business strategy in our next chapter.
This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
What you'll do at Figma:
Hire, manage, and develop a multi-team design group spanning Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, and Community
Partner with Product and Engineering leads in this area to improve team processes and execution and coach individual teams through setting roadmap and strategy
Develop a perspective on your team's product areas and successfully advocate for it across the organization
Lead critique, sprint, and design review practices across the pillar
Advance your own skills at people management in a supportive and growth-oriented environment
Operate hands-on across both people management and strategy and execution
We'd love to hear from you if you have:
5+ years of design management experience, ideally including experience managing managers and leading teams through ambiguity and change
Deep understanding of the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices
Strong hands-on expertise with Figma's tools, with the ability to mentor and guide design teams effectively
Proven track record of partnering cross-functionally to solve complex design challenges and drive meaningful outcomes
Strong strategic thinking and communication skills, demonstrated through influencing teams, adapting quickly, and taking a proactive, solution-oriented approach
While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:
Background contributing to open-source or developer-facing design tools
Experience partnering with Research and Marketing on platform-wide initiatives
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure
Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.
Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.
Annual Base Salary Range:
$290,000—$376,000 USD

Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.
Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:
Holding interviews in an accessible location
Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
Changing the mode or format of interviews
To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.
By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.
Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:
Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.
Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
Mission
As a Director of Product on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.
This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy,, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

jobs.title: Director - Technology
jobs.text:
Role in One Breath
You'll join the Simple Machines UK leadership team as a senior technology and people leader with deep roots in software engineering. You'll help ensure the success and growth of our existing enterprise clients while opening new relationships, shaping propositions and solutions, and helping us win significant new work.
You'll provide senior technology leadership to our clients, lead major pursuits and develop our technology people, with genuine influence over what we build, what we take to market and where Simple Machines goes next in the UK and Europe.
Help lead the UK business. Grow our strategic accounts. Win new clients. Build an exceptional technology team.
What This Role Actually Involves
This is a hands-on technology leadership role. You'll be deep in the work, helping our teams and clients successfully deliver complex software engineering programmes, while leading across architecture, clients, growth and people. You'll influence as much as direct: selling ideas, building alignment and bringing clients, teams and other business units on the journey.
Engineering and delivery leadership
• Get close to our most complex software engineering engagements and help ensure they succeed
• Lead the engineering of modern software solutions, increasingly including AI-native and agentic applications and systems
• Work directly with engineers, technical leads and architects to solve difficult technical and delivery problems
• Review architecture and engineering approaches, challenge decisions and step in where senior technical leadership is needed
• Drive strong engineering practices and ensure emerging AI and agentic solutions are engineered with enterprise-grade rigour
• Own the technical quality of our work and ensure what we deliver is something we are proud to stand behind
Architecture and technical leadership
• Shape software, solution and enterprise architecture across major client programmes
• Make pragmatic architecture decisions balancing engineering quality, enterprise constraints and delivery
• Provide technical assurance across our portfolio while remaining close to the engineering
• Stay technically current and credible with our most senior engineers and architects
Clients, influence and strategic accounts
• Help ensure the continued success and growth of our strategic enterprise accounts
• Act as a trusted technology adviser to senior client stakeholders
• Sell ideas and approaches to clients and internal stakeholders, building alignment and bringing people with you
• Work across consulting, delivery, data and AI to shape joined-up solutions and propositions
• Lead difficult technology, architecture and stakeholder conversations when senior intervention is required
Go-to-market and growth
• Open new client relationships and lead early-stage technology conversations
• Turn client problems into compelling propositions, architectures and delivery approaches
• Personally shape proposals, pitches, RFPs and major pursuits
• Ensure what we sell is technically credible, commercially compelling and deliverable
• Work across Simple Machines to assemble the capabilities and support required to win and grow work
People leadership
• Lead, mentor and develop our UK technology team
• Develop senior engineers, technical leads, principal engineers and architects through real client work
• Set a high bar for engineering craft, architecture and technical leadership
• Help attract exceptional technical talent and build a high-performance, low-ego engineering culture

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Search & Match
jobs.text:
We are looking for a Director, Product Management – Search & Match to shape and drive our core algorithm, ranking, discovery, and recommendation product strategies. Reporting to the VP of AI & Platform Products, you will act as a key product and business partner, translating complex data systems into high-impact executive narratives, commercial growth levers, and seamless marketplace experiences. This role requires an experienced leader who blends strong business sense with high-impact executive presentation skills to align senior stakeholders, optimize platform resource allocation, and lead cross-functional product teams.
Search & Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform’s two-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.
About this team
Our mission is to provide the best-in-class job search tools that drive the best outcomes for job seekers and provide long term value for our brand. This team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Design, and Finance to achieve business goals.
What you'll do
Shape and Drive Two-Sided Marketplace Strategy
Align Strategy to Business Impact: Define and own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Search & Match, directly linking algorithmic advancements to core business outcomes, enterprise customer value, and job seeker engagement.
Dual-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).
Resource & ROI Stewardship: Govern functional team capacity, compute/infrastructure investments, and feature prioritization—balancing trade-offs between performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Market & Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.
Executive Influence & Stakeholder Alignment
Executive Storytelling & Presentation: Translate complex search performance, algorithmic models, and marketplace dynamics into clear, compelling narratives and board-ready presentations for executive leadership.
Build Cross-Functional Coalitions: Drive strategic consensus across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Enterprise GTM, and Consumer Operations—ensuring alignment on roadmap sequencing and operational trade-offs.
Lead Through Change: Guide functional teams through strategic pivots, shifting organizational priorities, and technology evolutions with structured rationale and strong clarity.
Drive Operational Excellence & Execution
Orchestrate Execution at Scale: Lead cross-functional product squads across match scoring, candidate indexing, search relevance, and recommendation feeds to ensure predictable, high-velocity delivery.

jobs.title: Associate Director - AEP Martech Technology Strategy
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
Job Summary
The Associate Director, Martech Technology Strategy is a client-facing role responsible for supporting and advancing Mazda North America Operations’ enterprise Martech roadmap under the direction of senior Technology Strategy leadership. This role sits within Technology Strategy and helps connect Mazda’s business goals to the technology, data, platform, governance, and operating model decisions needed to drive measurable growth.
This role helps manage the integrated Martech picture across CDP, CRM, personalization, content operations, taxonomy, media activation, analytics, and data engineering. They translate strategic direction into clear use cases, requirements, workstream plans, governance inputs, and decision support that cross-functional teams and partners can build, operate, and measure.
The role supports Mazda’s audience, segmentation, and taxonomy governance agenda, including the use of Claravine as the operational system of record for naming, metadata, campaign classification, and audience definitions across the Martech ecosystem.
At the Associate Director level, this person is expected to be a strong day-to-day strategy partner to Mazda stakeholders and internal delivery teams, helping shape recommendations, clarify trade-offs, and prepare decisions for senior client and agency leadership.
This role requires a minimum of four days per week in-office presence, with travel to Mazda and key partner locations as needed.
Key Responsibilities
Technology strategy and roadmap ownership
Support the end-to-end Mazda Martech roadmap across CDP, CRM, personalization, content operations, taxonomy, analytics, media activation, and data engineering.
Translate Mazda’s business priorities and customer experience goals into workstream plans, requirements, roadmap inputs, and fundable use case detail.
Develop analysis and recommendation materials to support build, buy, partner, defer, or stop decisions across the Martech ecosystem.
Identify risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and decision points early, and escalate them with clear context and recommended paths forward.
CDP strategy, segmentation, and audience orchestration
Support strategy and ongoing optimization for Mazda’s Adobe Experience Platform and Real-Time CDP program.
Define audience frameworks, lifecycle segmentation, suppression logic, activation requirements, and measurement expectations.
Ensure audience definitions are consistent across CRM, paid media, personalization, analytics, and reporting.
Partner with data engineering and platform teams to validate feasibility, data readiness, identity logic, and activation dependencies.
Enterprise taxonomy and governance
Support Mazda’s enterprise taxonomy program, with Claravine serving as the system of record for naming, metadata, campaign classification, and audience definitions.
Help define and maintain governance standards across Claravine, Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, AJO, AEM, CJA, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, media platforms, WPP Open, Domo, and reporting tools.
Establish naming conventions, metadata standards, decision rights, approval processes, versioning, and change management for taxonomy and audience governance.
Ensure taxonomy supports activation, reporting, measurement, personalization, AI classification, and long-term scalability.
CRM, personalization, and journey orchestration
Support the strategic direction for Mazda’s CRM and personalization roadmap across owned channels and customer journeys.
Translate priority moments into use cases with clear owners, dependencies, triggers, suppression rules, success metrics, and platform implications.
Connect segmentation strategy to measurable outcomes such as lead quality, conversion, service engagement, loyalty, retention, and sales lift.
Cross-agency orchestration and stakeholder leadership
Serve as a Martech Technology Strategy partner across Mazda Marketing, Digital, IT, Legal, Data Privacy, Analytics, Media, and related stakeholder groups.
Coordinate work across VML, WPP Media, WPP Choreograph, Shift Digital, Adobe, TransUnion, Salesforce, and other ecosystem partners.
Partner with client, strategy, and delivery leadership to support roadmap decisions, maintain alignment, and build trust across teams.
Facilitate workshops, roadmap reviews, retrospectives, and executive alignment sessions that turn complex inputs into a clear plan.
Measurement, value realization, and business impact
Define the measurement framework for CDP, CRM, personalization, media activation, taxonomy, and content orchestration.
Partner with analytics and reporting leads to connect platform activity to business outcomes.
Support value-realization narratives for executive forums, steering committees, quarterly business reviews, and roadmap funding conversations.
Identify opportunities for influenced revenue, expanded scope, reusable assets, partner motion, and broader WPP Enterprise Solutions value creation for review with senior leadership.
Practice contribution and team support
Provide day-to-day guidance and support to Martech Technology Strategy resources across CDP, CRM, personalization, taxonomy, content pipeline, and orchestration as assigned.
Help maintain the quality bar for roadmaps, use case maps, operating models, taxonomy frameworks, business requirements, recommendations, and points of view.
Mentor supporting team members in business analysis quality, stakeholder communication, platform context, and client-facing delivery practices.
Contribute reusable frameworks, account learnings, and thought leadership to the broader Technology Strategy practice.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing, Business, Strategy, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in technology strategy, marketing technology strategy, digital transformation, business analysis, consulting, or enterprise platform delivery.
Experience supporting or shaping enterprise technology roadmaps across multiple teams, platforms, and stakeholders.
Strong knowledge of Martech ecosystems, including CDP, CRM, personalization, analytics, customer journey orchestration, media activation, content operations, and data governance.
Experience with Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Target, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Experience defining audience frameworks, segmentation logic, taxonomy standards, journey triggers, suppression rules, activation requirements, and measurement expectations.
Proven ability to support cross-functional or multi-partner programs, facilitate working sessions, and influence through clear analysis and communication.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technology considerations into clear business-facing materials.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in automotive, retail, financial services, or another multi-tier, data-intensive industry.
Experience with Mazda, MNAO, or automotive manufacturer / dealer ecosystem operating models.
Adobe certification or equivalent expertise across AEP, RT-CDP, AJO, CJA, AEM, or Adobe Target.
Experience with Claravine, Domo, TransUnion, LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, DV360, Meta, Google Ads, Salesforce CRM, or WPP Open.
Experience designing taxonomy councils, governance models, change management processes, and platform adoption frameworks.
Working knowledge of privacy, consent, profile stitching, deletion chain, and audience activation considerations.
Experience with content supply chain or creative automation platforms such as Adobe Workfront, GenStudio, Frame.io, Bynder, or Brandfolder.
Advanced degree in a related field.
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.

$75,000—$180,000 USD

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. jobs.title: Director, Capacity Planning & Engineering
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is looking for a Director of Capacity Planning & Engineering to lead the team responsible for translating platform demand into physical infrastructure reality — from supply-demand modeling and hardware procurement through data center deployment and FinOps. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of infrastructure strategy, operational execution, and software engineering.
You will lead a team of approximately 20 people organized across four functional areas and will be responsible for scaling Roblox's infrastructure footprint as it continues to grow rapidly.
What You'll Own
Capacity Planning
Translate platform demand forecasts into hardware requirements
Own the supply-demand matching process end-to-end, working closely with Data Center, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain teams
Build and refine capacity models that give the business confidence in infrastructure availability months ahead
Deployment & Delivery
Oversee hardware lifecycle from procurement through physical installation and software provisioning.
Partner with platform and data center operations teams to bring new capacity online reliably and on schedule.
Own delivery execution for major milestones including new data center buildout (Q4).
Data Center Automation (Software Engineering)
Lead a software engineering sub-team that builds and maintains DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management) systems.
Drive automation for rack delivery, decommissioning, and capacity planning tooling.
Identify opportunities to scale automation coverage as Roblox's 25+ global data centers expand.
FinOps
Oversee cloud spend optimization and on-prem vs. cloud allocation decisions.
Grow and develop the FinOps function, which is lean today but increasing in strategic importance as cloud spend scales.
Partner with Finance to ensure infrastructure spend is visible, justified, and optimized.
You Have:
10+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center operations, or related fields, with at least 3 years in a director-level or senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in capacity planning and supply-demand analysis for large-scale infrastructure environments.
Hands-on familiarity with DCIM systems and data center automation — this role is lower in the stack than platform software (not Kubernetes/cloud-native).
Experience working across supply chain systems, hardware procurement, and deployment execution.
Proven ability to lead and scale cross-functional teams including software engineers, planners, and operations specialists.
Strong analytical and communication skills; comfortable translating complex infrastructure decisions for C-suite audiences.
