jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (ID Activation)
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
Why We’re Hiring
We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Management – ID Activation to lead the strategy and development of identity-driven audience activation capabilities across the advertising ecosystem.
You will own the end-to-end product vision for audience onboarding, identity resolution, data syndication, and partner activation workflows. Your work will help make audience delivery more scalable, interoperable, privacy-conscious, and measurable across major media platforms.
This is an opportunity to shape products at the intersection of AdTech, identity, data, and media while leading a team and influencing partners across WPP.
What You’ll Be Doing
Define Product Strategy and Roadmaps
Set the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for ID Activation capabilities.
Identify opportunities to expand activation through new identity providers, destinations, channels, and strategic integrations.
Build business cases and prioritize investments based on customer demand, revenue potential, technical feasibility, and strategic value.
Translate market, partner, and client needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
Own the Audience Activation Lifecycle
Own the full activation lifecycle, from audience ingestion and onboarding through identity resolution, enrichment, qualification, governance, packaging, syndication, delivery, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Establish scalable operating frameworks that support consistent audience activation across products and partners.
Improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency across activation workflows.
Enable Multi-Channel Activation
Develop solutions that support activation across programmatic, social, connected TV, and emerging media channels.
Define product requirements for multiple identifier types, including email-based identifiers, mobile advertising IDs, RampID, UID2, hashed personally identifiable information, and platform-specific identifiers.
Partner with technical teams to support scalable, API-driven activation across cloud-based data platforms.
Lead Partner Integrations and Ecosystem Management
Lead product management for integrations with media platforms, identity providers, DSPs, SSPs, data exchanges, and clean-room partners.
Define integration requirements and frameworks for platforms such as Google Customer Match, Meta Custom Audiences, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Magnite, Experian, and other strategic partners.
Manage partner roadmaps and relationships to maintain interoperability, service quality, and competitive differentiation.
Work with Engineering to design and maintain scalable APIs and data-exchange mechanisms.
Shape Identity and Data Strategy
Develop strategies that improve addressability while supporting responsible, privacy-conscious data use.
Evaluate emerging identity frameworks, identity graphs, graph providers, and privacy-enhancing technologies.
Define requirements for deterministic and probabilistic identity-resolution workflows.
Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Security teams to support compliance with applicable privacy regulations and internal standards.
Drive Measurement and Execution
Define success measures for activation products, such as adoption, time to activate, match quality, delivery reliability, partner performance, and client impact.
Establish product-management and execution processes that support predictable delivery of roadmap commitments.
Use performance insights, operational feedback, and customer needs to continuously improve the product experience.
Lead and Develop Teams
Lead and develop a team of product managers responsible for identity and audience activation capabilities.
Serve as a primary liaison across Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Commercial, Privacy, Legal, and Security teams.
Act as a subject-matter expert and advocate for identity and audience activation across the organization.
Who You’ll Be Working With
You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leaders, Data Operations, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Commercial teams, Privacy, Legal, and Security. You will also collaborate with external identity providers, media platforms, DSPs, SSPs, data exchanges, clean-room partners, agencies, advertisers, publishers, and other technology partners.
What You’ll Need
Significant product-management experience in AdTech, martech, identity, data platforms, audience activation, or a related field; typically 8+ years or equivalent depth of experience.
Experience leading product managers and complex cross-functional initiatives; typically 3+ years in a people-leadership or product-leadership capacity.
Strong understanding of DSPs, SSPs, clean rooms, identity ecosystems, audience activation workflows, customer-match frameworks, and programmatic advertising infrastructure.
Experience managing external technology partnerships and complex third-party integrations.
Technical fluency in APIs, data-exchange platforms, identity-resolution systems, and cloud-based data platforms.
Demonstrated ability to balance long-term strategy with hands-on execution, operational delivery, and prioritization.
Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create alignment across technical and commercial teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with identity providers or frameworks such as LiveRamp, TransUnion, Experian, Neustar, RampID, or UID2.
Familiarity with data clean-room environments such as InfoSum, Snowflake, Habu, or similar platforms.
Experience building audience activation products for large advertisers, agencies, publishers, or media platforms.
Knowledge of retail media, commerce data, and advanced audience-targeting solutions.
An MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus, but not required.
Who you are:
You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work
Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
Why We’re Hiring
We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Management – ID Activation to lead the strategy and development of identity-driven audience activation capabilities across the advertising ecosystem.

You will own the end-to-end product vision for audience onboarding, identity resolution, data syndication, and partner activation workflows. Your work will help make audience delivery more scalable, interoperable, privacy-conscious, and measurable across major media platforms.
This is an opportunity to shape products at the intersection of AdTech, identity, data, and media while leading a team and influencing partners across WPP.
What You’ll Be Doing
Define Product Strategy and Roadmaps

items: Set the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for ID Activation capabilities.
Identify opportunities to expand activation through new identity providers, destinations, channels, and strategic integrations.
Build business cases and prioritize investments based on customer demand, revenue potential, technical feasibility, and strategic value.
Translate market, partner, and client needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.

blocks.text: Own the Audience Activation Lifecycle

items: Own the full activation lifecycle, from audience ingestion and onboarding through identity resolution, enrichment, qualification, governance, packaging, syndication, delivery, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Establish scalable operating frameworks that support consistent audience activation across products and partners.
Improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency across activation workflows.

blocks.text: Enable Multi-Channel Activation

items: Develop solutions that support activation across programmatic, social, connected TV, and emerging media channels.

Define product requirements for multiple identifier types, including email-based identifiers, mobile advertising IDs, RampID, UID2, hashed personally identifiable information, and platform-specific identifiers.
Partner with technical teams to support scalable, API-driven activation across cloud-based data platforms.

blocks.text: Lead Partner Integrations and Ecosystem Management

items: Lead product management for integrations with media platforms, identity providers, DSPs, SSPs, data exchanges, and clean-room partners.
Define integration requirements and frameworks for platforms such as Google Customer Match, Meta Custom Audiences, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Magnite, Experian, and other strategic partners.
Manage partner roadmaps and relationships to maintain interoperability, service quality, and competitive differentiation.
Work with Engineering to design and maintain scalable APIs and data-exchange mechanisms.

blocks.text: Shape Identity and Data Strategy

items: Develop strategies that improve addressability while supporting responsible, privacy-conscious data use.
Evaluate emerging identity frameworks, identity graphs, graph providers, and privacy-enhancing technologies.
Define requirements for deterministic and probabilistic identity-resolution workflows.
Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Security teams to support compliance with applicable privacy regulations and internal standards.

blocks.text: Drive Measurement and Execution

items: Define success measures for activation products, such as adoption, time to activate, match quality, delivery reliability, partner performance, and client impact.
Establish product-management and execution processes that support predictable delivery of roadmap commitments.
Use performance insights, operational feedback, and customer needs to continuously improve the product experience.

blocks.text: Lead and Develop Teams

items: Lead and develop a team of product managers responsible for identity and audience activation capabilities.
Serve as a primary liaison across Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Commercial, Privacy, Legal, and Security teams.
Act as a subject-matter expert and advocate for identity and audience activation across the organization.

blocks.text: Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leaders, Data Operations, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Commercial teams, Privacy, Legal, and Security. You will also collaborate with external identity providers, media platforms, DSPs, SSPs, data exchanges, clean-room partners, agencies, advertisers, publishers, and other technology partners.
What You’ll Need

items: Significant product-management experience in AdTech, martech, identity, data platforms, audience activation, or a related field; typically 8+ years or equivalent depth of experience.
Experience leading product managers and complex cross-functional initiatives; typically 3+ years in a people-leadership or product-leadership capacity.
Strong understanding of DSPs, SSPs, clean rooms, identity ecosystems, audience activation workflows, customer-match frameworks, and programmatic advertising infrastructure.
Experience managing external technology partnerships and complex third-party integrations.
Technical fluency in APIs, data-exchange platforms, identity-resolution systems, and cloud-based data platforms.
Demonstrated ability to balance long-term strategy with hands-on execution, operational delivery, and prioritization.
Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create alignment across technical and commercial teams.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience working with identity providers or frameworks such as LiveRamp, TransUnion, Experian, Neustar, RampID, or UID2.
Familiarity with data clean-room environments such as InfoSum, Snowflake, Habu, or similar platforms.
Experience building audience activation products for large advertisers, agencies, publishers, or media platforms.
Knowledge of retail media, commerce data, and advanced audience-targeting solutions.
An MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus, but not required.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Advertiser Growth
jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
As the PM Director for Advertiser Growth, you will own product strategy for a major monetization lever and serve as a critical thought partner to our Business Platforms leadership. You will sit at the intersection of AI and monetization growth, defining the "AI era" for our core advertiser tools.
This role offers a unique combination of platform depth and tangible business impact. You won’t just be managing features; you will establish durable platform strategies that scale. Furthermore, this is a dedicated people leadership role where you will have the mandate to develop the next generation of product talent at Pinterest.
What you’ll do:
Product Led Growth: Drive the adoption, retention, and revenue impact of our suite of business-facing tools through intelligent product investments.
Platform Leadership: Establish a durable platform strategy for the Pinterest Business Assistant, encompassing various sub-agents while leading the advertising and merchant sub-agent efforts.
Cross-Functional Execution: Drive business outcomes by aligning priorities across Engineering, Data Science, TPM, Product Marketing, Sales, UX, and UXR teams to deliver best-in-class business tooling.
What we’re looking for:
Platform Product Strategy: Demonstrated experience developing and scaling platforms, with a strong ability to distinguish between high-level orchestration and specific feature development.
Business Tools Product Experience: Proven background in designing and managing sophisticated business-facing tools, account management consoles, or complex user journeys in an advertising or related environment.
People Leadership: A track record of building, managing, and growing high-performing teams, including experience in talent development and performance management.
AI/Agentic Fluency: Experience building AI-assistance functionality, specifically in a chatbot or agentic capability context.
Strategic & Operational Rigor: Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence across multiple stakeholders, and drive durable revenue growth through principled trade-offs.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience
In-Office Requirement Statement:
We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.
Relocation Statement:
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

#LI-REX

jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Management to lead the strategy and execution of WPP’s next-generation Agentic Data Platform.
Within Cohort Solutions, you will own product vision, strategy, roadmap development and execution across multiple products and initiatives. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Governance and Market teams to deliver scalable, high-impact products that create measurable business value and strong adoption.
The successful candidate will combine disciplined product management with experience in data products, AI, commercialization, stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. The final role level will reflect the scope of the position and the experience of the successful candidate.
Why we’re hiring
To establish and execute a clear product strategy for WPP’s Agentic Data Platform.
To turn complex data and AI capabilities into scalable products that solve meaningful business and customer problems.
To connect product investment, adoption and commercialization with measurable value across WPP’s global network.
What you’ll be doing
Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across multiple data platform products and initiatives.
Translate customer, user, market and business needs into clear product priorities and outcomes.
Lead products through discovery, validation, development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Governance and Market teams to deliver high-quality products.
Define success measures and use data to track adoption, value, quality, cost and commercial performance.
Develop product economics and commercialization approaches, balancing customer value, business objectives, speed, quality and scalability.
Advance AI, agent and workflow automation opportunities through responsible experimentation, while ensuring appropriate governance, privacy, security and data quality.
How your time may be focused
The role is expected to be approximately 70% individual contribution and 30% leadership/management, with the balance adapting to business needs.
In this role, you will:
Create alignment around a compelling product vision and prioritized roadmap.
Move complex data and AI initiatives from strategy into valuable, adopted products.
Establish clear measures for product performance, customer value and commercial impact.
Build strong partnerships across technical, commercial, governance and market teams.
Help develop product talent and strengthen product management practices across the organization.
Who you’ll be working with
You’ll work across a global, matrixed environment with colleagues in:
Engineering and Data Science
Data Operations and Governance
Commercial and Partnerships
Market and business teams
Product, technology and senior executive leadership
What you’ll need
Significant product management experience, including ownership of strategy, roadmaps and product lifecycles.
A track record of building or scaling products in one or more of the following areas: data, analytics, advertising technology, Martech, SaaS, AI or enterprise platforms.
Experience taking products from strategy and discovery through delivery, launch, adoption and iteration.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional product initiatives or teams within a matrixed or global organization.
Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to connect customer needs with product economics, revenue drivers, costs and adoption.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and create alignment across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong working knowledge of enterprise data platforms and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering and Data Science colleagues.
Experience that would be valuable
Experience building or launching agentic, AI-native or workflow automation products.
Working knowledge of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration.
Experience working with responsible AI, data governance, privacy or security considerations in enterprise environments.
Experience leading, coaching or developing product managers.
We value relevant skills and experience gained through different career paths. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in place of rigid formal requirements.
How you lead
Strategic thinker: You connect product investments to business outcomes and build compelling, actionable roadmaps.
Commercially minded: You understand value creation, customer needs, product economics and adoption.
Influential collaborator: You build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities and resolve conflicts constructively.
Execution focused: You make informed decisions in ambiguous environments and balance speed, quality and scalability.
Who you are:
You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Sapience AI
Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share.
The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that.
Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose-driven for the organization it serves.
Let’s achieve more, together.
Where this role sits
This is the senior-most engineering role at Sapience AI. You own the technology, the architecture, and the engineering organization that build the collective intelligence platform.
You are accountable for MINERVA and the COGENT architecture: how they are designed, how they scale, how they stay trustworthy, and how quickly the organization can ship. You set technical direction and build the team that delivers on it.
You sit on the executive team, translating company strategy into technical strategy and back, and making the calls that determine whether Sapience AI can build what it has promised.
Why this role exists
Collective intelligence at the scale of professional communities is a hard systems problem: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning trust, protecting sensitive data, and doing it reliably. Someone has to own whether the technology can actually deliver on the vision.
In an AI market moving this fast, the durable advantage is an engineering organization that learns and ships faster than the field, on an architecture that can carry the next several years.
The Head of Engineering supplies that. You own the technical strategy, the architecture, the team, and the standards, and you are accountable for turning ambition into a platform that works and holds trust.
What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)
You hold eight areas of responsibility across the engineering organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and be accountable for.
1. Technical strategy and vision
Own the technical strategy that turns company goals into a platform that can deliver them.
Set a clear technical point of view on where AI is heading and how Sapience AI should build for it.
Make the build, buy, and bet decisions that shape the next several years.
2. Architecture of MINERVA and COGENT
Own the architecture of the MINERVA platform and the COGENT neuro-symbolic system, and how they scale.
Ensure the architecture can carry growth, new communities, and rising demands on reasoning and trust.
Balance near-term delivery against the durable foundations the platform needs.
3. Engineering organization and talent
Build, structure, and lead the engineering organization, including hiring, leveling, and leadership development.
Set the bar for engineering craft and hold it.
Create an environment where strong engineers do the best work of their careers.
4. Delivery and execution
Own how the organization plans, ships, and learns, and keep it fast without breaking trust.
Drive delivery through GR and GA milestones with clear accountability.
Remove the blockers that slow the whole organization down.
5. Trust, security, and reliability
Own the security, privacy, and reliability of a platform holding sensitive community knowledge.
Make trust a property of the architecture, not a review at the end.
Be accountable for how the platform behaves when it matters most.
6. AI and research translation
Partner with research and applied AI to turn frontier capability into dependable product behavior.
Decide which advances are ready for production and which are not yet.
Keep the organization honest about what AI can and cannot do.
7. Executive partnership and company strategy
Serve on the executive team, and translate between company strategy and technical reality.
Give the board and leadership a clear, honest view of technical risk and opportunity.
Partner with product on what is possible, and by when.
8. Cost, scale, and operational excellence
Own the economics of running the platform, including inference and infrastructure cost at scale.
Build the operational discipline that keeps a growing platform reliable and affordable.
Make scale a planned outcome, not a recurring emergency.
AI-augmented ways of working
You lead an organization that treats AI as part of how it builds. You set the standard for using AI to raise engineering velocity and quality, from code to review to operations, and you make sure judgment and accountability stay with people.
The standard is human in partnership: AI accelerates the work, you own the judgment, the interpretation, and the call. The people who create the most value here are not the ones producing the most output. They are the ones turning evidence into clear, durable decisions.
What this role is not
To keep the boundary clear:
This is not a hands-off figurehead role. You own real technical direction and are accountable for what the organization ships.
This is not a pure people-management role. You hold a technical point of view and make architecture-level calls.
This is not a research-lab role. You are accountable for a platform in production, not open-ended exploration alone.
This is not a product management role. You partner with product on what to build; you own how it is built and whether it works.
What success looks like
We measure this role on outcomes the team can see:
A platform that delivers. MINERVA and COGENT scale, hold trust, and carry the company’s ambitions.
Velocity with trust. The organization ships fast without compromising security or reliability.
A strong team. You attract, grow, and keep engineers who do their best work here.
Sound economics. The platform runs reliably at a cost that scales with the business.
Frontier, made dependable. Research and applied AI advances become production behavior members can rely on.
Clear executive partnership. Leadership and the board have an honest view of technical risk and opportunity.
Who you are
Required qualifications
Extensive engineering leadership experience, including leading and scaling engineering organizations.
Deep technical background in large-scale systems, and hands-on credibility that engineers respect.
Direct experience building and operating AI or ML systems in production.
A track record of owning architecture that scaled with a growing business.
Strong judgment on security, privacy, and reliability for sensitive data.
Executive presence, and the ability to translate between business and technical strategy.
A record of attracting, growing, and keeping strong engineers.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with neuro-symbolic systems, knowledge graphs, retrieval, or agentic AI.
Experience owning inference and infrastructure economics at scale.
Experience in trust-sensitive or regulated domains.
Familiarity with CRM, AMS, or knowledge-platform ecosystems.
Experience as a technical co-founder or early engineering leader.
How you work
You lead with the mission and name the real problem before the solution.
You hold a clear technical point of view and defend it with evidence.
You make hard calls and own the outcomes.
You treat trust, security, and reliability as non-negotiable.
You build teams where people do their best work and trust each other.
You keep the organization learning and changing course without ego.
Skills & Competencies
Technical strategy and architecture at platform scale.
Building and scaling engineering organizations.
Production AI and ML systems, including reliability and cost.
Security, privacy, and governance for sensitive data.
Delivery leadership and operational excellence.
Executive communication and board-level partnership.
Translating research and frontier capability into production.
Services & Tools Experience
Modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and large-scale infrastructure.
Distributed systems, data platforms, and ML infrastructure.
LLM, retrieval, vector, and graph systems at an architectural level.
Observability, security, and reliability tooling.
Engineering delivery and planning systems.
Cost and capacity management for AI workloads.
Deep familiarity with the MINERVA platform and COGENT architecture (as the accountable owner).
Prior Experience & Background
Prior senior engineering leadership (VP Engineering, CTO, or equivalent) at a software or AI company.
Experience scaling both an architecture and an organization through growth.
A track record of shipping and operating AI systems in production.
Experience partnering at the executive and board level.
Cross-functional partners
You partner most closely with the CEO and executive team, Product, Research, Applied AI, and Security. You lead the engineering organization and are accountable for how MINERVA and COGENT are built, scaled, and trusted.
How we hire
We review every application, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every line above. Research shows that talented people, especially those from underrepresented communities, often hold back when they do not meet every qualification. If that is the only thing holding you back, apply anyway.
Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a workplace where everyone, regardless of background, has a voice in building what comes next.
Compensation
Base Salary: $228,000 - $240,000 + early stage equity
Generous health and wellness benefits
Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation to complete our application process, let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Logistics
jobs.text:
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Overview
About the Team
Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.
Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.
Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.
Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.
About You
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).
Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.
Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).
Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.
Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.
Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.
#LI-Remote
Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.
Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

$291,000—$307,000 USD
WA
$279,000—$294,500 USD
OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$266,000—$281,000 USD
All other states
$242,000—$255,500 USD

You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job

items: Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.

Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, On-chain Payments
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
We’re looking for a senior product leader to shape the future of payments and financial applications on the XRP Ledger.
In this role, you’ll own product strategy and execution across areas such as stablecoin payments, on-chain liquidity and foreign exchange, and emerging forms of programmable commerce. You’ll work at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, financial markets, and real-world customer needs - turning new capabilities into products and experiences that can achieve meaningful adoption.
This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with engineering, business development, ecosystem partners, and customers to identify the most important problems to solve, develop a clear product strategy, and drive complex initiatives from concept through market adoption.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Own product strategy and roadmap for key payments and on-chain financial capabilities on the XRP Ledger
Identify and prioritize opportunities where blockchain infrastructure can meaningfully improve how value is exchanged, converted, and settled
Develop product-market fit hypotheses and validate them through customer discovery, market research, product data, and real-world usage
Partner closely with Engineering to translate market and customer needs into scalable product and protocol capabilities
Work with financial institutions, payment providers, liquidity providers, developers, and other ecosystem participants to understand workflows and adoption barriers
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Business Development, and external partners
Define the capabilities and ecosystem requirements needed to deliver compelling end-to-end customer experiences
Navigate technical, commercial, and market tradeoffs to drive clear decisions and maintain momentum
Represent the product strategy internally and externally with customers, partners, and the broader ecosystem
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
Significant product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, trading, or other technically complex products
Proven ability to define product strategy and lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment across technical and commercial organizations
Strong technical fluency and experience working closely with engineering teams on backend, infrastructure, API, or protocol-level products
Deep customer orientation and the ability to translate complex financial workflows into clear product opportunities
Strong systems thinking and judgment across product, technology, market dynamics, and go-to-market considerations
Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly when simplifying complex problems and driving decisions across diverse stakeholders
Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the market, technology, and customer needs are still evolving
Nice to Have:
Experience in payments, FX, liquidity, settlement, treasury, or financial market infrastructure
Experience building crypto, blockchain, or stablecoin products
Familiarity with wallets, digital assets, on-chain transactions, and decentralized or electronic trading systems
Experience with developer platforms, open-source ecosystems, or protocol-level product development
Experience launching products that depend on adoption across multiple ecosystem participants
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$248,000—$310,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

jobs.title: Director, Security Engineering
jobs.text:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and is trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.
About the Role
As Director of Security Engineering, you will lead the modernization of Fireblocks’ security infrastructure — across both our in-house-built tooling and the SaaS platforms we rely on. You will own the architecture behind security operations, our security data lake, SaaS security, and cloud security, and build the infrastructure that makes Fireblocks’ security tooling faster, more efficient, and ready for an agentic operating model.
This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the technical direction, build out a team and processes, and personally drive projects from architecture through implementation and measurable impact.
What You’ll Do
Security Infrastructure Strategy & Modernization
Own the multi-year modernization roadmap for Fireblocks’ security infrastructure, spanning in-house tooling and SaaS.
Analyze the needs across security domains, ensure we have the appropriate architecture for a centralized security data lake, and propose and drive optimized designs for agentic flows.
Security Data & Detection Engineering
Build and evolve Fireblocks’ security data lake and the logging, detection, and analytics pipelines built on top of it.
Optimize security data infrastructure to support faster detection, detailed investigation and automated response.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Coordinate and align with Security, R&D, and DevOps stakeholders to drive infrastructure projects end-to-end.
Lead projects from concept to delivery, and define the metrics that demonstrate their impact.
Requirements
7+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including leadership roles in SecOps, Application Security, or DevSecOps.
At least 3–4 years in a formal leadership or management capacity.
Security Engineering background — hands-on experience implementing and optimizing security systems is a must.
Proven experience building security systems and workflows that handle large-scale data (e.g., security data lakes, SIEM), including hands-on work with security auditing, logging, and cloud infrastructure.
Hands-on experience implementing AI processes, workflows, and tools to optimize security operations and workflows, and familiarity with AI security tooling.
Strong track record coordinating across Security, R&D, and DevOps stakeholders.
A builder mentality: the desire and ability to create infrastructure from scratch, lead projects end-to-end, and measure their impact.
Nice to Have
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP).
Fireblocks’ mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.
Please see our candidate privacy policy here.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Product
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees & Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. You will partner with engineering, operations, sales, compliance, and external service providers to ship complex changes that institutional counterparties trust and rely on.
What You’ll Be Doing
Clearly define product direction and roadmaps for Custody OES, drive its evolution and turn client and partner requirements into shipped features. Grow the client and partner base. Optimize operations through self-service portals and process automation.
Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.
What We Look For In You
PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.
Proven experience of leading strategic business reviews, facilitating on-site requirement discovery, and converting client feedback into prioritized product initiatives. Strong track record of partnering with Sales, BD, and Relationship Management teams in a B2B institutional setting.
Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
Own the agentic translation system
Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.
Build the agentic QA and quality automation
Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.
Make it self-improving
Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
What We Look For In You
PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.
Nice to Haves
Built an agentic system from scratch
Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
This role is on-site, 5 days a week, working from our Flatiron office in NYC.
About Seated
Seated exists to help restaurants thrive in an industry defined by thin margins and underutilized capacity. We connect thousands of restaurants with millions of high-intent diners through demand-driven pricing and rewards, helping restaurants fill empty tables, reach new guests, increase visit frequency, and drive profitable incremental revenue.
Since launching, billions of dollars in restaurant spend have flowed through Seated, and hundreds of millions of dollars in rewards have been paid to Seated consumers. Today, Seated operates across 20+ U.S. markets and continues to expand nationally.
Our core marketplace is thriving. Now, we’re focused on expanding the value Seated creates for restaurants and consumers and building the company’s next major growth engine.
See it for yourself: seatedapp.io (restaurant side) · getseated.seatedapp.io (diner side) · Seated on iOS · Seated on Android
Role Overview
Seated is hiring a VP of Product to own product strategy and execution across our consumer and restaurant businesses.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will be responsible for helping determine where Seated makes its next major product investment, strengthening critical parts of our underlying product infrastructure, and identifying new ways for product to drive growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with executives and the board while staying close to the work - talking to customers, digging into data, writing requirements, testing ideas, and working directly with Design and Engineering to ship great products.
The VP of Product will lead a Product and Design team and work as a close partner to Engineering. Scope may expand based on the individual, potentially including Analytics, Consumer, or broader GM responsibilities.
Responsibilities
Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products
Partner with the CEO and executive team to identify, evaluate, and validate Seated’s next major product bets
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, business-case development, and validation
Evaluate opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Strengthen critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, prioritization, and execution
Identify opportunities for product-led growth across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Build and lead a small, high-performing Product and Design team
Translate company strategy into a focused product roadmap with clear priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do
Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.
About the team
The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
United States Salary Range
$203,200—$345,600 USD

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
