jobs.title: Director - Gaming & Esports Innovation Product Strategy
jobs.text:
Overview:
Responsible for shaping the product vision, innovation strategy, and future experience roadmap for Gaming and Esports assets across Qiddiya. The role focuses on identifying emerging trends, technologies, content formats, and experiential concepts that enhance guest engagement and differentiate asset propositions.
The Director will define future-state product and experience opportunities, evaluate innovative solutions from global providers, and formulate strategic recommendations that inform asset planning, investment decisions, and long-term growth ambitions. The role acts as a bridge between asset teams, strategic partners, and enabling functions to ensure the delivery of Qiddiya’s Gaming and Esports ambitions.
Key Responsibilities:
•Translate experience and business requirements into high-level product and technology considerations.
•Assess emerging technologies, digital platforms, and product solutions to determine their strategic relevance and potential application.
•Define future-state product and experience requirements that inform subsequent technology planning and delivery activities.
•Provide strategic guidance on technology-enabled experiences, digital products, and innovation opportunities.
•Evaluate solution concepts, platforms, and product ecosystems from a customer, commercial, and experience perspective.
•Formulate recommendations on technology and product investment opportunities to support asset differentiation and long-term growth.
•Engage with technology providers, gaming platforms, content creators, and innovation partners to understand emerging capabilities and market developments.
•Develop concept-level requirements and experience frameworks that can be translated into detailed delivery plans by specialist technology teams.
•Provide strategic product and innovation inputs into governance forums, investment reviews, and key asset decision-making processes.
•Support technology and delivery teams by defining concept-level requirements, strategic priorities, and desired experience outcomes for future initiatives.
•Review and challenge proposed technology solutions, roadmaps, and innovation initiatives to ensure alignment with asset objectives and guest experience ambitions.
•Contribute to the development of standards, principles, and governance frameworks for technology-enabled products and experiences across Gaming and Esports assets.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, New Subjects
jobs.text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
About the role...
Over the last few years, Duolingo has expanded beyond language learning into entirely new subjects: Math, Music, and Chess. These products reach millions of daily active users, are growing quickly, and represent a CEO-level bet that Duolingo can become a platform for learning anything.
We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to co- lead our newest subjects, responsible for building and scaling products ranging from early stages through to some of the company’s fastest-growing initiatives.
This is a role for a builder. You'll make decisions about which subjects to invest in, how to allocate engineering resources across bets at different stages, where to continue investing and where to pivot.
You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to shape the future of the pillar while building the organization that delivers it.
This role is based in our New York, NY office on a hybrid (4+1) work schedule.
🧠 You will...
Drive the product and technical strategy across Math, Music and Chess, balancing short-term product impact with long-term strategic goals.
Partner strategically with Product, Design, Learning and AI to evolve our strategy, including decisions on when and how to expand to additional subjects.
Lead multiple engineering directors and their teams as they tackle some of the most interesting technical challenges in industry: AI-based content creation at scale, neural bots, and Unity-based gameplay.
Drive operational excellence across Duolingo’s engineering org, including reliability, performance, developer productivity, and efficient execution at scale.
Contribute to Duolingo’s engineering hiring bar and talent systems, playing a central role in hiring decisions, leveling, and organizational design to maintain a high-performance, high-density team.
Lead an organization that moves quickly, runs high-quality experiments, and translates product insights into measurable business impact.
Build and develop a strong leadership bench capable of bringing ambitious new products to market.
✅ You have...
Experience leading consumer product engineering organizations (100+ engineers), ideally across multiple high growth product experiences.
Product instincts and experience partnering closely with senior product leadership to define strategy, not just execute against it.
A track record of driving measurable impact on business outcomes, including growing early product development through significant company scale.
Experience building or scaling LLM-powered product features, with a strong interest in building engineering cultures that embrace AI-first ways of working.
Deep experience building and scaling high-velocity, experiment-driven product organizations, leading through multiple layers of leadership (senior directors, directors, EMs).
A track record of building high-performance, inclusive teams, and making thoughtful, high-judgment talent decisions.
Ability to influence senior executives and drive clarity in ambiguous, cross-functional situations.
Ability to work from our New York, NY office on a 4+1 hybrid work schedule.
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!
Salary Range:
$296,000—$444,000 USD
Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.
Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.
Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, VIP Growth & Operations
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity
OKX is seeking an experienced VIP Growth & Operations Leader to focus on creating exclusive product experiences and service solutions for high-net-worth individuals, institutional clients, market makers, and other VIP customer segments.
You will spearhead the overall strategy and product planning for the VIP Growth & Operations line, driving customer lifecycle management, personalized services, and continuous optimization of system functionalities to enhance customer retention and platform AUM (Assets Under Management).
What You'll Be Doing
Own the day-to-day VIP Growth & Operations execution for high-net-worth individual clients, ensuring VIP lifecycle programs are planned, launched, and iterated effectively.
Build and run a VIP lifecycle operations framework: define segments, triggers, and journeys; set weekly/monthly operating rhythms; and ensure consistent execution with Local Markets.
Partner with Local Market teams to to co-create market plans, align goals and timelines, and drive follow-through, while ensuring global consistency and scalable playbooks.
Plan and execute VIP offsites and online events (e.g., product sharing sessions, community/engagement touchpoints), including end-to-end coordination, stakeholder alignment, and post-event performance review.
Develop and scale VIP growth programs and tools (e.g., VIP trial cards and similar programs) that improve conversion, deepen engagement, and increase VIP contribution to trading activity and AUM.
Establish a data-driven growth operating model with clear measurement, experimentation, and continuous optimization to improve VIP contribution to revenue and AUM.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Engineering, Operations) to deliver workflows, tooling, and process improvements that support VIP operations at scale.
Track performance and continuously optimize: define KPIs, monitor results, gather market feedback, and refine programs based on data and learnings.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor’s degree or higher with 5+ years of product management or product strategy experience.
Deep understanding of the Web3/Crypto industry, particularly exchange products such as institutional services, API trading, and VIP incentive programs.
Prior experience in CEXs, brokerages, financial institutions, or high-net-worth client-related products is preferred.
Strong cross-team communication and coordination skills, with systematic thinking and sharp user insights.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and data-driven decision-making.
Fluency in English and Chinese; Multi-market collaboration experience is a plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity

OKX is seeking an experienced VIP Growth & Operations Leader to focus on creating exclusive product experiences and service solutions for high-net-worth individuals, institutional clients, market makers, and other VIP customer segments.

You will spearhead the overall strategy and product planning for the VIP Growth & Operations line, driving customer lifecycle management, personalized services, and continuous optimization of system functionalities to enhance customer retention and platform AUM (Assets Under Management).
What You'll Be Doing
Own the day-to-day VIP Growth & Operations execution for high-net-worth individual clients, ensuring VIP lifecycle programs are planned, launched, and iterated effectively.
Build and run a VIP lifecycle operations framework: define segments, triggers, and journeys; set weekly/monthly operating rhythms; and ensure consistent execution with Local Markets.
Partner with Local Market teams to to co-create market plans, align goals and timelines, and drive follow-through, while ensuring global consistency and scalable playbooks.

Plan and execute VIP offsites and online events (e.g., product sharing sessions, community/engagement touchpoints), including end-to-end coordination, stakeholder alignment, and post-event performance review.
Develop and scale VIP growth programs and tools (e.g., VIP trial cards and similar programs) that improve conversion, deepen engagement, and increase VIP contribution to trading activity and AUM.
Establish a data-driven growth operating model with clear measurement, experimentation, and continuous optimization to improve VIP contribution to revenue and AUM.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Engineering, Operations) to deliver workflows, tooling, and process improvements that support VIP operations at scale.
Track performance and continuously optimize: define KPIs, monitor results, gather market feedback, and refine programs based on data and learnings.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor’s degree or higher with 5+ years of product management or product strategy experience.
Deep understanding of the Web3/Crypto industry, particularly exchange products such as institutional services, API trading, and VIP incentive programs.
Prior experience in CEXs, brokerages, financial institutions, or high-net-worth client-related products is preferred.
Strong cross-team communication and coordination skills, with systematic thinking and sharp user insights.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and data-driven decision-making.
Fluency in English and Chinese; Multi-market collaboration experience is a plus.

Competitive total compensation package

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.text:
About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
About the Role
Design at Ramp looks very different than it did a year ago: we’re building tools and agents, designing memory, shipping PRs, and rethinking the process every few months as new capabilities unlock. A few things have not changed, the role of design is to distill problems to their essence, obsess over craft and delight where it matters most, know customers deeply and advocate for them, lead with creativity and storytelling, and keep it fun, because a product built with joy always wins.
We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead a team of builders across some of our highest-priority bets. This role is for you if you’re excited by:
Leading through craft, setting vision and unlocking customer impact: you will define where a product should go, then jump into the details with the team to unblock, teach, and ship. You raise the bar through product judgment, design craft, and your ability to make everyone around you better.
Actually shipping and demonstrating real impact: You'll start by owning a product area and team to build trust and get your bearings at Ramp, with room to take on broader leadership over time. You'll stay close to customers and ship meaningful work alongside your designers, product managers and engineers.
Building the environment where great work comes from: clear roles, high standards, low ego, and just enough structure to keep the bar high without slowing people down. That means building a caring yet demanding structure, investing deeply in people — coaching, feedback, growth — so designers can do the best work of their careers and develop in this new age of Design.
It’s never been a more interesting time to build.
Please note that this role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 3 days/week.
What You’ll Do
Lead and grow a high-performing team of product designers
Own product vision and design direction across critical product areas
Partner with product and engineering to shape strategy and deliver customer impact
Stay close to customers and use their feedback to guide product decisions
Jump into the work when needed to unblock teams and accelerate progress
Create clarity, raise quality, and help teams ship faster
Raise the bar for product thinking, interaction design, systems thinking, and craft
Coach designers through clear feedback, high standards, and strong mentorship
Help define how design works in an AI-native world
Build strong partnerships across product, engineering, data, and design
What You Need
Experience leading and developing high-performing product design teams
Strong product judgment, design craft, and systems thinking
Track record of shipping products with meaningful customer and business impact
Deep customer empathy and comfort operating in ambiguity
Ability to influence across functions and develop exceptional talent
Curiosity that borders obsession over how AI changes the nature software and how we work
Nice to Haves
Founder or early-stage startup experience
Experience designing AI-native, automation, or agentic systems
Experience building workflow or operations tooling
Experience leading managers or multi-layered teams
Comfort working closely with technical teams on implementation details
Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)
Flexible PTO
Centralized home-office equipment ordering
Health and wellness stipend
Budget for intra-office travel
Weekly coffee stipend
United States
100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
One Medical annual membership
401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
Pet insurance
In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
Canada
Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health
United Kingdom
Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi
Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay
Referral Instructions
If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.
Other notices
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.
Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Director, Supplier Development
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Job’s mission
As Director, Supplier Development at ASM, you will lead a strategic function focused on building and scaling supplier capabilities across critical commodities. This role will oversee the Advanced Materials and Machining pillars and partner closely with sourcing, engineering, and business units to ensure the right suppliers, processes, and controls are in place to support new product development and long-term growth.
What you will be working on
Lead Supplier Development for Advanced Materials and Machining, driving capability, scalability, and supplier readiness for critical categories.
Manage and develop a team of ~6 supplier development engineers, providing clear direction, prioritization, and leadership.
Partner with sourcing and business unit engineering teams to identify critical components and define supplier strategies for key parts and processes.
Evaluate supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing processes, capacity, and growth plans to meet current and future demand.
Drive a strategic, forward-looking supplier development approach focused on capability building and supplier selection (vs. tactical quality escalation).
Establish robust supplier process flows and controls, and transition ongoing monitoring to Supplier Quality once stabilized.
Ramp quickly on ASM products and supplier landscape to support NPI, scaling initiatives, and margin improvement efforts (e.g., should-costing).
What we are looking for
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline required).
Strong experience in supplier development, manufacturing, sourcing, or technical operations within complex industrial environments.
Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, supplier capability assessment, and design-to-manufacturing considerations.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across sourcing, engineering, and product development teams.
Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing experienced technical teams.
Ability to operate strategically - assessing supplier capability, capacity, and alignment to long-term business needs.
What sets you apart
Master’s or PhD in Engineering.
Semiconductor industry experience or similar fast-paced, high-tech manufacturing environment.
Experience supporting advanced materials, specialty chemicals, or machining-focused supplier categories.
Strong commercial mindset, with experience driving supplier scalability, cost optimization, and margin improvement initiatives.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global operations, sourcing, and engineering teams.
Background from larger, established semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing organizations.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Head of Data Analytics and Insights
jobs.text:
Angkas is the Philippines' leading motorcycle ride-hailing platform. We move millions of Filipinos through traffic every day while building real livelihoods for our driver partners.
We're hiring a Head of Analytics to own the data function end-to-end. You'll lead a team, get your hands dirty with the data, and work directly with leadership to shape how we think about our business — not just report on it.
JOB DETAILS:
You'll be responsible for the analytics roadmap and making sure the team is working on what actually matters. That means driver incentive programs, supply-demand dynamics, pricing, retention, unit economics, and others. You'll build the team's skillset, set up the right processes, and make sure we're tracking the metrics that actually matter.
On a daily basis, expect a mix of strategic work (presenting to executives, aligning with product, operations and finance) and technical work (reviewing analyses, debugging logic, writing your own queries when needed). It's a lean setup—expect to work closely with people across levels.
You'll also own data governance—working with engineering on pipeline reliability, pushing for better documentation, and establishing data lineage so people actually trust the numbers.

jobs.title: Data Planning Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
Who we’re looking for:
VML is seeking a Data Planning Director to be a trusted partner to our clients, navigating their business, understanding their challenges and connecting across VML, as well as WPP at large, to ensure we are setup to deliver success with world-class services and solutions.
This role is part of an integrated Data & Analytics team across measurement & reporting, predictive modelling, data strategy solutions, covering media, CX, CRM and more. The focus is to act as the glue between clients, WPP teams on all things data. As such, you will need to organise, motivate and inspire to connect all (data and non-data) disciplines in delivering success for our clients. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.
What you’ll be doing:
Team direction and oversight
Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.
Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.
Data & Analytics leadership
Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.
Develop proposals and methodologies for
Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn
Analytics & Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)
Data & Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.). Includes data, AI, martech and adtech transformation roadmaps, measurement frameworks and associated operating model development.
Inspire our clients and all of VML with thought-leadership and best practice.
Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data & AI vision, and make it happen.
Drive client success and satisfaction in all you do.
Business Development
New business – be a data and analytics lead for pitches to deliver winning proposals and presentations.
New & Organic business – be relentless at bringing new ideas and opportunities to grow our existing clients and bring our data offer to clients who work with us in other disciplines.
What you’ll need:
Exceptional experience leading across data and analytics in a consulting/agency environment, setting up teams and operating models with clients
A belief in the value of data-driven marketing & AI to deliver exceptional results.
Experience of building relationships with clients from junior to C-suite and dealing with the different and complex personalities involved.
Someone who can unify groups from across a wide skill set and unify them behind a clear brief or goal and deliver excellent work for clients.
A candidate with the ability to engage people with their presentation skills but show excellent active listening to create clear actions which meet client needs.
A person with a love for data-driven marketing and is constantly following trends to develop impactful and significant work for our clients.
Significant experience at scoping, resourcing, and developing commercial proposals.
Knowledge of data and analytics technologies across the marketing and digital ecosystem including media, commerce, social and digital platforms, CRM & loyalty
Knowledge of analytics solutions and how AI can be leveraged in marketing to drive growth.
Must have knowledge (you need not be a deep practitioner in all these areas, but do need have a good appreciation across them):
Data strategy consulting – data landscape (1st, 2nd, 3rd party data), data management, governance, roadmap and use case development
Analytics & AI – segmentation, predictive modelling, measurement & reporting, AI marketing applications and product development
Marketing technologies – data cloud solutions, clean rooms, analytics and reporting tools, CDPs, CRM / marketing automation, AI technologies
Marketing operations – operating models, process design, governance, data culture and skills development, client enablement and business change
At VML, we are committed to fostering an all-inclusive work environment that is both rewarding and career-forward. Our Inclusion, Equity & Belonging initiatives, alongside the VML Foundation, reflect our dedication to giving back and making a positive impact in our communities and beyond. Our people are the heartbeat of our organization—creators, doers, innovators, makers, and thinkers—who drive not just marketing, but meaningful experiences that resonate in every action and interaction.
VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.
Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Talent 360 is seeking a highly technical and hands-on Head of Engineering to lead engineering excellence across all teams.
This role is responsible for solution architecture, code quality, engineering standards, and technical execution. This role is not focused on high-level strategy alone — it requires deep involvement in code, architecture decisions, and technical problem-solving on a daily basis.
Solution Architecture & System Design
Own and drive solution architecture across all projects and products
Design scalable, high-performance, and maintainable systems
Lead architecture decisions, including frameworks, integrations, and platforms
Conduct architecture reviews and enforce quality, scalability, and security standards
Define and enforce architectural patterns (Microservices, DDD, Event-Driven, CQRS)
Evaluate build vs. buy decisions with strong technical justification
Hands-On Coding & Code Review
Actively participate in code reviews across all engineering teams
Ensure high standards in code quality, performance, and maintainability
Enforce best practices, design patterns, and coding standards
Contribute directly to critical and complex implementations when needed
Identify and resolve technical debt and code quality issues proactively
Mentor engineers through structured and constructive code reviews
Engineering Standards & Best Practices
Define and enforce engineering standards across the organization, including:
Coding standards and style guides
API design and integration standards
Database design and performance optimization
Testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E)
Documentation practices
Establish quality gates for code, releases, and deployments
Drive adoption of automated code quality tools and best practices
Ensure consistency across Backend, Frontend, and Mobile teams
CI/CD & DevOps Excellence
Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines across all projects
Ensure fully automated build, test, and deployment processes
Drive DevOps best practices, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Automated testing within pipelines
Blue-green and canary deployments
Environment and configuration management

jobs.title: Global Head of Renewals, Product & Engineering
jobs.text:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic's customers renew on a mix of committed and consumption contracts, and the number of renewals is growing faster than any team of people could keep pace with. We don't want to answer that by hiring hundreds of renewal managers. We want renewals to run as a system: Claude and agents do most of the work, from spotting risk to drafting the offer to closing a standard renewal in product, and people step in where judgment, negotiation or relationships matter.
You'll design, build and run that system. You'll own the renewal outcome for the business globally and the product and technology that delivers it. You'll lead a small team of builders and the human layer, internal specialists and outsourced partners, that handles what agents can't yet. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, Finance, Billing and Product Engineering.
This is a Claude-first role. You'll use Claude every day to do your own work, and the renewal function will be one of the clearest examples inside Anthropic of what AI-run operations look like.
What you'll own in your first year
The design of the renewal system: which work agents run end to end, which work goes to a person, and the handoff rules between them.
A standard renewal that needs no person: a Claude-generated offer in product ahead of term end, accepted and provisioned automatically, with anything outside guidance routed to a seller with a recommended quote.
The data the system runs on: contract, commit burndown and usage data clean enough that agents and people trust it, built with Billing and Finance.
Early-warning signals for consumption risk and commitment shortfall, and what happens when one fires.
The human layer: how internal specialists, outsourced partners and account teams work around the agents, and the measures they're held to.
The next large renewal cycles, run with fewer manual steps per renewal than today.
Weekly renewal and retention forecasts grounded in usage and contract data.
Executive renewal conversations on the largest and most complex accounts, alongside account teams.
You may be a good fit if you have
Owned renewal, retention or post-sale outcomes at large scale, either running the function or leading the product or service that runs it for others.
Led product or engineering teams and shipped software or agents that took over work people used to do.
Run or designed a blended model of people, outsourced partners and software, and know where each one breaks.
A working grasp of renewal economics: committed and consumption contracts, discount guidance, and the term, billing and CRM data behind them.
Built things yourself recently. You can prototype with Claude, read the data and pressure-test an agent's output without waiting on someone else.
Set direction with senior executives and held cross-functional teams to it without direct authority.
Strong candidates may also have
Usage-based pricing and commit burndown experience.
Built health, churn or early-warning models that changed what teams did.
Worked at a company whose product runs renewals, retention or quote-to-cash for its customers.
Worked across regions, including marketplace or cloud-partner billing.
Written or spoken publicly about agent-led customer operations.
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$350,000—$500,000 USD
Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager / Associate Director - Commercial Data Product (Pharma/ Life science
jobs.text:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 1000 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director with a strong Life Sciences background and hands-on commercial analytics experience to launch Commercial Data Product to support an upcoming pharma launch. This role will lead a small, dedicated pod to design and build a Snowflake-native, Power BI–aligned data product from the ground up. The position gives an opportunity to focus on data product ownership, metric design, and stakeholder alignment. The candidate should have strong experience and domain knowledge in gene therapy, with exposure to relevant processes, workflows, and industry applications.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with Life Sciences stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Own the end-to-end commercial data product for a kidney launch, from vision to execution.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.
📍London / UK Remote | 💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits ✨
⭐ Our Design team
We’re a team of 115+ Product Designers, User Researchers, and Brand Designers led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.
We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.
Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. There’s significant opportunity to shape the product, influence the organisation, and leave a lasting mark on millions of customers.
🔎 About the role
We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead design across Payments, one of Monzo’s most important and fast-evolving multi-market business areas.
You’ll partner closely with senior leaders across Product and Engineering to shape strategy, set direction, and drive exceptional execution across your area. You’ll play a key role in influencing the direction of both the product and the broader customer experience.
You’ll lead and grow a team of Product Designers, helping them do the best work of their careers while strengthening design thinking, collaboration, and craft across Monzo. As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.
Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.
Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.
Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.
Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.
Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...
You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.
You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.
You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.
You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.
You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.
You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.
You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design.
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor your visa
📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ Flexible working hours and trust-based work culture
📚 £1,000 annual learning budget for books, training, and conferences
🏡 Full remote setup support, including equipment and workspace essentials
➕ Plus lots more!
This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!
We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.
We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.
#LI-TR1
#LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

jobs.title: Practice Director, Platform Engineering & BI
jobs.text:
Since 2015, Agilytic has helped organizations reach their goals through the smarter use of data and AI. With over 300 successful projects completed in Belgium and abroad, we strive to be a leading boutique firm delivering high-impact solutions for marketing, operations, and finance decision-makers.
Our Platform Engineering & BI practice has been a major driver of our growth, and we are now looking for the entrepreneurial leader who will take it to the next level. As Practice Director, Platform Engineering & BI, you will own the vision, the commercial agenda, and the talent agenda of the practice. You will be the locomotive: the person who sets the direction, recruits and develops top engineers, and turns opportunities into a profitable business line.
We need a builder, not a caretaker. You will work side-by-side with the founding partners to scale the practice, sharpen our positioning on data platforms and analytics engineering, and make Agilytic the reference Platform Engineering & BI boutique in the Benelux market.
While regular presence at client offices is required, we offer flexible and hybrid working arrangements. Our main offices are in Brussels' city center, and we gather there every Friday to foster team exchanges and strengthen our collective culture.
What we expect from you
Vision. Define and articulate where the Data Engineering practice should go over the next three years: service portfolio, target clients, technology stack, partnerships, and differentiators.
Drive. Be the engine. Set the pace, raise the bar, and refuse to let things stall. We need someone with a knife between their teeth who creates momentum rather than waits for it.
Growth. Build a sustainable pipeline and deliver on ambitious revenue and margin targets. You will be incentivized on the commercial development of the practice.
Talent. Attract, recruit, coach, and retain the senior and mid-level engineers we need to deliver at scale. Build the bench so we are never the bottleneck to growth.
Delivery excellence. Set the standards, methodologies, and quality bar across all data engineering engagements.
Key responsibilities
Own the strategy, roadmap, and KPIs of the Platform Engineering & BI practice
Drive business development: shape offerings, qualify opportunities, lead proposals, close deals, and grow key accounts
Build and lead a team of data engineers and platform engineers, from junior consultants to senior architects
Define how we use AI within the practice, both in how we work internally and in what we deliver to clients
Establish a recognizable point of view on data platforms, analytics engineering, and modern data stacks (cloud, ETL/ELT, BI, Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
Coach team members on both technical and consulting skills, and create clear career paths
Partner closely with the Managing Partners on cross-practice initiatives and on the broader Agilytic growth agenda
Represent Agilytic externally: speaking engagements, partnerships, client executive relationships, and thought leadership

jobs.title: Director Technology - Data Platforms
jobs.text:
Director Technology - Data Platforms
London, UK
We are looking for a senior data leader to join Simple Machines in London as part of our Global Data Practice leadership team.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role focused on helping shape the future direction of our data platform capability across the UK and Europe. The individual will play a key role in defining our propositions, strengthening our technical capability, and helping clients modernise their data ecosystems for an AI-native future.
The role requires someone equally comfortable operating at executive, architectural, commercial, and delivery levels. We are looking for a leader who understands where enterprise data platforms are heading over the next five years, not where they were five years ago.
Key Responsibilities:
- Part of the Global Data Practice leadership team
- Helping define and evolve Simple Machines’ data platform propositions, technical direction, and strategic positioning
- Advising enterprise clients on modern data platform strategy, architecture, operating models, and AI readiness
- Supporting organisations as they evolve from traditional centralised data platforms toward AI-native, real-time, and data product-oriented operating models
- Working closely with Engagement Managers and senior leadership across major strategic initiatives
- Leading architecture and technical direction for complex enterprise data platform and transformation programs
- Acting as a senior technical counterpart across strategic client engagements and partner relationships
- Pre-sales, proposal development, technical solution shaping, and executive stakeholder engagement
- Building trusted relationships with strategic technology partners and staying current with emerging platform capabilities and market direction
- Supporting recruitment, mentoring, capability uplift, and practice development across the broader engineering organisation
- Leading major client initiatives across data engineering, platform modernisation, AI enablement, and operational data systems
- Contributing to thought leadership, market positioning, and growth initiatives across
the UK and Europe

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Hardware
jobs.text:
Compensation: $275K - $425K+
Travel Requirement: International travel required to India 8+ times per year
AI Foundry is an AI building and consulting business working with some of the largest companies in the world. AI Foundry is partnered with a major global company operating across finance, consumer, and retail verticals, leading their AI efforts from the ground up.
The team is seeking builders who want to be part of something massive: designing and building multi-agent AI systems that will reshape how hundreds of millions of people interact with financial services, retail, insurance, and consumer products.
AI Foundry is looking for a Head of Engineering to lead mechanical and electrical engineering work for a hardware business being built from the ground up. This role requires someone who can set engineering direction, build a team, make strong technical decisions, and move from prototype to manufacturable product.
If you have led hardware engineering through real product development and want to build a high-caliber team from scratch, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Do
Set engineering direction across mechanical, electrical, systems, prototyping, validation, and product development work.
Build and lead a hardware engineering team with a high bar for technical quality and speed.
Translate product and business goals into engineering roadmaps, technical requirements, and execution plans.
Own the path from prototype through design validation, reliability, manufacturability, and launch readiness.
Work closely with industrial design, manufacturing, supply chain, vendors, and leadership to align product intent with engineering reality.
Review architecture, designs, test plans, tradeoffs, and risks with enough depth to guide strong decisions.
Establish engineering operating rhythms, documentation standards, design reviews, and quality gates.
Identify technical risks early and create practical plans to resolve them.
Represent engineering in leadership conversations and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
Who You Are
You have led hardware engineering teams through real product development cycles.
You have depth in mechanical, electrical, systems, or product engineering and enough breadth to lead across disciplines.
You understand prototyping, validation, reliability, certification, manufacturability, and production handoff.
You can build teams, set standards, and develop strong engineering talent.
You make decisions with incomplete information and can defend technical tradeoffs clearly.
You communicate well with design, manufacturing, vendors, executives, and technical teams.
You are practical: you care about elegant engineering, but you also know products have to ship.
You are comfortable building processes from scratch without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
You can hold a high bar without becoming rigid or hard to work with.
You are energized by building a hardware organization from the ground up.
How We Work
We are looking for people who use AI to raise the speed, quality, and ambition of the work while staying grounded in customers, teammates, and measurable outcomes.
We are hands-on with AI and technical tools, and we make ideas tangible through prototypes, clear artifacts, and working systems.
We move quickly, share work early, and keep refining until the product experience feels useful, polished, and memorable.
We focus on the hardest problems and the outcomes that matter, with the judgment to change course when the evidence points somewhere better.
We communicate clearly enough that teammates, leaders, and AI-assisted workflows can act on our thinking across time zones.
We collaborate with openness and respect, build on other people's ideas, and treat shared ownership as part of doing excellent work.
We speak up directly and constructively when something looks wrong, then commit fully once a decision is made.
Benefits & More
Medical and Dental benefits
401K
Opportunity to shape AI strategy for 500M+ users

jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are

The plumbing of the exchange. Order management, matching, margin, risk engine, lending/borrowing — across both spot and derivatives. When you ship, millions of trades route through your work the same day.

Outlearning the competition. Talk to traders, take apart competing systems, and decide where we lead vs. fast-follow — across crypto and TradFi.
The instruments that show us the market first. Build the data and monitoring layer that gives us situational awareness of our own stack and the broader industry. If something's drifting, breaking, or shifting — you know before anyone else.

Bachelor's degree or above in mathematics, physics or computer science major.
5+ years experience in building sophisticated backend systems in either crypto or Traditional Finance industry.
AI native skillset that allow you to ship at 10x because you automate the work flow first.
Possess rigorous logical thinking, excellent teamwork, communication skills and be able to coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals between different departments.
You possess a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
You are proactive, enthusiastic and sensitive to customers' feedback from a product lens.
Fluent in English and Mandarin (to communicate with Mandarin speaking clients / cross-teams).

Trading experience in sophisticated institutions.
Excel in quantitative research with various mathematics tools.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Liquidity & Growth
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Institutional Liquidity Product Manager to own the management and improvement of liquidity across OKX's spot, margin, futures, perpetual swap and options markets.
You will work closely with institutional traders, market makers, HFT firms and quantitative teams to identify liquidity gaps and develop market-structure, product and commercial solutions that improve execution quality and market competitiveness.
This is a strategic and hands-on role combining market microstructure expertise, quantitative analysis, product delivery and commercial ownership. You will partner with Quant, Data, Engineering, Risk, Relationship Managers , Operations and external liquidity providers to turn order-book data and client trading behaviour into measurable improvements in spread, depth, slippage, trading volume, market share and resilience during stressed markets.
What You’ll Be Doing
Liquidity Strategy, Analytics and Delivery
Analyse institutional client needs, market-maker and HFT trading behaviour, market trends, competitor liquidity, fee structures, order types and liquidity programmes to identify opportunities for differentiation.
Own the liquidity product roadmap across spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps and options, including monitoring capabilities, order types, market structure, maker protection and liquidity improvement initiatives.
Translate quantitative analysis and institutional trading requirements into clear product specifications and solutions. Work closely with Quant, Data, Engineering, Matching Engine, Risk and Relationship managers teams to deliver scalable solutions from problem definition through launch.
Define targets, baselines, guardrails and post-launch measurement for each liquidity initiative. Use controlled or phased rollouts where appropriate, evaluate causal impact and ROI, and continuously adjust the roadmap based on data and client feedback.
Institutional and Market Maker Engagement
Understand participants' market-making, hedging, arbitrage, inventory-risk and latency-sensitive strategies, and translate these needs into product and programme requirements.
Partner with Institutional Relationship Management teams to onboard and engage liquidity providers, communicate product and programme changes, gather structured feedback and improve participation in priority markets.
What We Look For In You
Proven experience in liquidity management, electronic trading or market structure within a crypto or traditional exchange, market maker, HFT firm, proprietary trading firm, quantitative fund or institutional trading platform.
Strong understanding of institutional and HFT trading strategies, including market making, cross-venue arbitrage, price discovery, hedging, inventory and risk management, adverse selection, toxic flow and latency-sensitive execution.
A quantitative background in mathematics, statistics, computer science, financial engineering or a related field is strongly preferred.
Hands-on ability with SQL and Python, with experience analysing large-scale order-book, order and trade data. Experience with Level 2 or Level 3 market data is highly valued.
Deep knowledge of market microstructure, order books, matching, tick size, maker/taker economics, order types, execution quality and liquidity dynamics across spot and derivatives.
Front-to-back knowledge of crypto, FX, equities, fixed income or listed derivatives, with the ability to apply that knowledge to new products and market structures.
Strong product execution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional delivery across Quant, Data, Engineering, Risk, Finance, Sales and Operations from problem definition to measurable outcome.
Able to communicate credibly with traders, quants, engineers, senior executives and external partners.
Fluent in English and Mandarin.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Consumer Frontend
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox users expect and deserve a modern, standardized and coherent user experience across all platforms we support (mobile, desktop, console, VR, web, etc.). The role of Director of Product, Consumer Frontend is to up-level Roblox UI both directly, with a Core UI team, and, indirectly, through capabilities provided by our Design Systems team. Your goal is to measurably raise the quality of our UI/UX across all surfaces, and unlock greater UI/UX capabilities for the company from a centralized, platform position.
You’ll report to the Senior Director of Product for Apps. This role is based at HQ (no remote option open).
You will:
Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Consumer Frontend team which consists of Core UI and Luau architecture and Design System with tooling teams.
Be the leader for common UI paradigms in the Roblox Consumer Application, providing thought leadership on Roblox UI for both end users and Creators.
Invest heavily in relationship building and stakeholder management in order to drive UI standardization and design system adoption.
Help define what success looks like for your teams and measure their progress towards it.
Personally PM critical projects when required (hands on PM skills as well as management experience required).
Grow the PM skills of the team under you, hire when required, represent your team at external events with Creators.
Communicate updates, milestones, and priorities effectively to stakeholders across the organization.
Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies in user interface design and gaming to inform product decisions.
Research and deploy AI to drive efficiency and innovation at scale.
You have:
10+ years of Product Management experience with expertise in shipping high-quality consumer products across multiple platforms.
Experience defining, managing, or driving adoption of design systems, UI platforms or platform-wide UI changes.
Expertise in navigating platform product development where internal engineers/designers are your primary customers.
Deep experience in internal stakeholder management and alignment.
Experience leading cross-functional execution with various teams including engineering, data science, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and policy, to conceptualize, develop, test, and launch impactful UI changes.
Experience running complex, platform-wide AB tests and managing resultant trade-off conversations.
The ability to clearly communicate roadmaps, priorities, experiments and decisions across a wide spectrum of audiences from partner teams to executive levels.
Strong design sensibilities and a history of strong product to design working relationships.
Demonstrated technical proficiency and effectiveness working closely with engineers. Experience with Luau, similar languages, and/or the React framework would be beneficial but are not required.
A passion for gaming and a deep understanding of game UI or multi-platform UI delivery would be beneficial but is not a requirement.
You are:
A Product leader with a history of delivering high quality UI/UX work either directly or through a design system.
Experienced, with 10+ years of product management experience or equivalent and a history of delivering across multiple platforms at scale.
Analytical, with experience running complex AB tests to conclusion.
Design-orientated with a passion for high quality user experiences.
An excellent communicator and documenter, with fantastic listening, verbal, and written communication skills. You’re at home understanding and communicating an overarching vision at the 30k-foot level and diving into technical specifications, individual tradeoffs, and priorities.
Entrepreneurial, having worked in a fast paced environment, with competing resources and priorities, through the product life cycle from planning, development, through to launch and continuing support. You love to get things done.
Organized, understanding that the best way to build something great is through the joint efforts of many people.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$383,120—$439,280 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management (Platform & Growth)
jobs.text:
Death is our only foe.
Immortals was founded by Bryan Johnson and Kate Tolo to build a new standard for human health and longevity.
We’re building Autonomous Health: a system that uses measurement, scientific evidence, and personalization to help people understand their bodies and make better decisions about their health. What began with Bryan becoming the most measured person in history is becoming a platform for everyone.
Immortals brings together biomarkers, longevity medicine, nutrition, prescriptions, wearables, and personalized protocols in one place, turning health data into clear, actionable decisions.
We’re a small, ambitious team building what we believe will become the new operating system for human health. We move quickly, think from first principles, care deeply about the quality of our work, and hold ourselves to an unusually high standard.
Our mission is simple: help billions of people live healthier lives for longer, and ultimately, Don’t Die.
We are seeking a rare, hands-on leader who can operate at the intersection of high-scale systems and high-velocity commercial growth. As the VP of Product, you will lead the product and design vision for Immortals’ digital experiences, ensuring our technical foundation is modular and scalable while driving user acquisition and monetization.
A core mission for this role is creating a new, unified AI interaction experience that seamlessly ties together our commerce (supplements and meds), biomarker data, and our passionate community. This experience is designed to help deliver the best personalized solutions and recommendations to improve our users’ longevity and health. You aren't just a people manager; you are a "player-coach" who remains deeply hands-on in the product management process, leveraging AI assistance to drive 10x productivity and execution.
